Thin crust, almost no sauce, a sprinkle of cheese and a very sparse amount of pepperoni. We could have eaten the box and would have noticed very little difference in taste. There are plenty of other choices for pizza in this area, I recommend you find another one

place_category: Pubs, Irish Pub, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Sports Bars, Steakhouses, Nightlife, Bars
text: The best sandwiches around large and tasty. My favorite is the Tail Gater,roast pork provolone,and pepperoni ! great combo! also the roast beef is excellent .Great place to watch sports, The beer is always cold and the staff and patrons are freindly.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Chocolatiers & Shops, Coffee & Tea, Macarons
text: This place was recommended by a different restaurant we went to! (Green goddess) we walked around a ton today and needed a sweet and refreshing treat so we got raspberry sorbet here. Very friendly staff, nice atmosphere, needed on a hot day. It was delicious and we had 3 vegan flavors to choose from.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Brazilian, Salad, Steakhouses, Venues & Event Spaces, Gluten-Free
text: I'm writing this review from the Texas de Brazil toilet. Want my pajamas Too much salt for season Need to vomit Texas De Brazil is the reason Got dressed up for this special night Now I can't wait to get undressed or die I can't believe I paid money for this Someone please hold me as I cry (And vomit) At least our server was very enthusiastic and wonderfully nice? My, what giant doors these bathroom stalls have.

place_category: Gastropubs, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Beer Bar, Food, Restaurants
text: Go here now. When you do, you MUST get The Funky Farmhouse mussels and the Buttermilk Chicken Tenders. Both are OUTSTANDING. You will not be sorry. Trust me on this. Also great service, beautiful dining room and outdoor space. I hope they never stop doing takeout - a by-product of Covid that I hope stays!!!

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: We were so excited to go to Kreis' to celebrate our daughter's graduation. Unfortunately the service was miserable. The food was great, but we waited 40 minutes for drink refills after the food was served. No water, soda or wine! Instead of having dessert and I coffee, we just left. It was very disappointing!

place_category: Asian Fusion, Tapas/Small Plates, American (New), Restaurants, Vietnamese, Korean, Noodles, Ramen, Japanese
text: My initial excitement soon soured. THERE WAS A HUGE ROACH IN MY FOOD! How does one even handle that situation? I just left because I was embarrassed for them. PATHETIC.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Delicious and fantastic service! Special thanks to Bella and Jessie for always making it a great experience!

place_category: Restaurants, Caterers, Party & Event Planning, Event Planning & Services, Indian, Italian
text: The Toasted Walnut Salad and Key Lime Dessert were amazing but the entrees were just ok. I'm glad I got to check this place out but I don't think I'd go back.

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: Good food. Pretzel balls were good and Deluxe Pizza was very good if you like thin crust which we do. Not the best in St Louis but very good. Salad house dressing is zesty vinaigrette if you like that. Good value. Decor could use some TLC (ceiling tiles are stained all over)

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners
text: Looking at the reviews I thought this maybe a great place to eat. Nice location and decor. Our experience there was lack luster. Food tasted ok but if was hot I would have given them a 4 star. I just expected hot food on a Monday when it's not super busy. Our waitress ask how was the food . We said it's ok but she didn't care to ask us why. Won't be going back there.

place_category: Vietnamese, Vegetarian, Noodles, Home Cleaning, Soup, Home Services, Thrift Stores, Shopping, Restaurants
text: The broth of the pho needs some improvement, it is different from what I am used to in california. In my view, it lacks a bit of umami taste that is the signature of Pho. I almost feel the broth was diluted after it was done. In any case, a welcome addition to the Indianapolis restaurant scene.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Salad
text: Great spot for takeout. Use the online system. Especially in New Orleans, you have to respect their options like vegan and gluten free. And the pizza is great, I have never had a bad one from Naked. The pricing is just about right maybe its a little bit on the expensive side but I like the service and I like the ordering system so it's a place that I will continue to buy from.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: I went there trying to get an iced white mocha and the lady made this awful drink milk and coffee!!! She wasn't even nice I asked her if it was the drink I ordered? And she said yes it is. It was extremely bitter no taste of anything.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Pubs, Nightlife, Bars, Wine Bars, Gluten-Free, Mexican, American (New), Food, Tacos, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Excellent Bison Burger, quick service, and fair prices. Simple atmosphere that could use a little work.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Italian
text: Went here on a Sunday morning for brunch and a private event. I was pleasantly surprised by the amount of food on the buffet, both on the hot and cold sides. It was a great mix between breakfast food and lunch stuff as well. There was anything from pancakes that were stuffed with something good, to salads and fresh fruit. I would definitely come back for a sit down meal to taste other items as well.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Diners, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Venues & Event Spaces
text: Yes, this place is about 3 stars because it is just diner food masqueraded as nicer bar food [possible? the same thing?]. It seems like it's a good place to go for locals in the area.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Chocolatiers & Shops, Coffee & Tea, Macarons
text: Stick with the gelato but still disappointing. Had high hopes for a brownie sundae. But the brownie was super-dry and flavorless. The gelato wasn't bad but nothing special. Maybe the chocolates and macaroons are better but I won't be going back to find out.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Sports Bars, Pool Halls, American (Traditional)
text: On comparing the other three locations of O2's (Downtown, West and whyte} i would say O2's on south is really good. Free parking spots and patio with cushion chairs, fancy tables and couches. This place is really cool. I'm a big fan of their Jerk Chicken pizza.They used carry pierogies pizza but I don't see them any more. The waitresses are friendly and fast in service . Happy hour from 11 to 7 pm and they have wings night on 6 days a week except Fridays . Cool place !

place_category: Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: This place is really cute and the smoothies were delicious. My husband got a classic smoothie and I tried the West Side Smorey which was unique and delicious. Our 18 month year old loved both and kept asking for more. The man who was working who I think was the owner was really nice and kind. I do wish their hours were a bit later. Closing at the time they do during the week is tough for us to do, but this seems to be a struggle for many local businesses. Definitely worth a trip in!!

place_category: Restaurants, Smokehouse, Buffets, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Food, Burgers, Sports Bars
text: It's a great sports bar! The food is better than your average sports bar, too. The prices are decent and they run some good specials. It's clean and well kept. However, its usually packed for big games and fights. I will say though, I went there hungover to watch a game and it was great. Good bloody Mary and low key atmosphere

place_category: Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (New), Bars, Restaurants
text: The food is excellent as well as the service Stop here for an early dinner and had the scallops in a lobster sauce which was excellent

place_category: Restaurants, Tapas Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Seafood
text: Food was excellent- I had the granny sandwich and my husband had an omelette with goat cheese, mushroom, and tomatoes. I had an iced dirty chai which was wonderful, my husband had a cup of black coffee that was just okay. The service was subpar- refills were few and far between and the waiter was a bit awkward. The atmosphere was nice but we found two hairs in the food.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Soup, Salad, Bagels, Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Update: From Stay-at-home, now offer to-go. The packing is good, food is decent but not that cheap. They will bring your order to your car.

place_category: Restaurants, Comfort Food, Salad, Italian, Pizza
text: Looks like a hole in the wall pizzeria. Inside, small but clean. Food, delicious, simple and freshly prepared, service excellent, prices very reasonable. Have been back several times and the food is consistently great!

place_category: Salad, Comfort Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Bed & Breakfast, Hotels & Travel
text: Our server was not very helpful and 2 out of the 4 meals we ordered was awful and it was very pricey for breakfast. Cheese omelet was so thin and had juice as the cheese. The plate looked like a thin slice of egg in orange juice. The chicken fingers were hard and could barely chew them. And when I tried to talk to someone they didn't do anything about it. Never will I ever recommend or go there again. Sad.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Bars, Nightlife
text: Had a great meal yesterday at Besito. We like to sat outside and it was a little chilly, but we were able to sit next to the fireplace, Everyone enjoyed their meals, the service was excellent. Sunny was our waitress and she provided great service with a smile. She was very attentive to us, and even got the bar to mix a special lemonade for my daughter. Overall great experience and the price was reasonable as well.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: A neighborhood place. The decor is simple and clean. They have a small menu with some interesting eclectic items. There were four of us there for breakfast. The cocktails were so-so. And the food was uneven - I had the Shakshuka: poached eggs with tomatoes and feta, pita and wilted spinach. Neither the lamb nor the corned beef hash were very good. I'd probably visit again if I lived in the neighborhood to try some other dishes. Service was friendly and warm.

place_category: Nightlife, Pizza, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Vegan, Chicken Wings
text: Jameson is the best! He was working the front end all by himself and we were very needy. He kept his cool and took care of us and everyone else like we were royalty! Pizza was killer, as expected. NY style, tasty sauce and fresh toppings. I adore their specialty salad, chock-a-block with tasty veggies. I love this new restaurant in The Summitt as much as I love their location in Midtown. Thank you, Jameson!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: I ordered a large Plain pizza for take out. The young lady that answered the phone was very pleasant. The pizza was a good price... $12.50. When I went to pick it up, the restaurant was pretty busy (7pm on a Sunday). Being from Jersey, I'm probably a pizza snob.... but to me this pizza was just ok. It wasn't bad but it wasn't great. The crust was pretty chewy and the sauce wasn't flavorful. Not sure if I'd go back there.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Standard Mexican fare, meaning it's got all the usual suspects to choose from. The food and drinks are fine but not fantastic. I give it the 3 stars mainly for the atmosphere and waitstaff.

place_category: Shopping, Convenience Stores, Beauty & Spas, Food, Photography Stores & Services, Cosmetics & Beauty Supply, Drugstores
text: Horrible trying to get pain medicine with someone that even has cancer! Walgreens and cvs both are the worst!!!!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Wow steak and eggs for $5 bucks. I guess you can't beat the price. I don't think this place has changed ever, but it serves it purpose. That purpose is to serve cheap food and give you energy so you can go back to the slots. I noticed it gets a bit cold in there but other than that, it's typical casino cheap, quick, decent food dining. I don't think you can ask for anymore than that. Well maybe a smoke mask for the smelly smoke, but that's ok it is a casino

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Tacos, Latin American, Mexican, Bars, Nightlife, Beer Bar
text: Hipster tacos. Mediocre at best. Saved by the fresh juice and off the cob elote (street corn). Cute spot for a date night if you aren't necessarily concerned about GREAT food ..

place_category: Ramen, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Was excited because the ramen looks so photogenic. Eh... it isn't bad for Santa Barbara ramen but I found the soup to personally be too greasy to comfortably eat much of and the soup to be too salty.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: This place is amazing - the place is historic, well maintained and beautiful from the inside. We had brunch in the courtyard, which is to die for. The food was average and not worth the premium, but the service / place were excellent to be fair.

place_category: Diners, Restaurants, Food, Cafes, American (Traditional), Soup, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts
text: Food is mediocre. Ordered a local favorite. Idk how the locals like the southern fried chicken, taste like KFC. The restaurant is very nice but the staff just gives out the vibe as if in they hate their job. Only reason this place gets a 3 star is because it's very clean and articulate. Coming in here I was like wow this place must be great, then I got my food and then the service made this place even worst.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Pretty darn good BBQ. Large selection of sides to choose from. Couple of different sauces too. The mustard was our fave. Lunch was served quickly even though it was quite busy. Great stop when in the area.

place_category: Southern, Barbeque, Restaurants
text: It was just OK. The meat was overcooked, but good eating. The ribs were falling off the bone and shredded when cut. The pork and brisket were good, but not great. The place was laid out like a cafeteria style. Not the cleanest place I've eaten, but not the dirtiest.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Cafes, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Vegan, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Beer Gardens
text: I've eaten here twice and really enjoyed both of my meals. The buffalo cauliflower and omelet did not disappoint. The prices were on point as well. Pros: great food for reasonable prices. Decor is inviting and bright. Upstairs space is perfect for getting work done. Strong wifi. CONs: they were out of decaf coffee. Waitress had an attitude.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Fast Food, Food
text: When I want a good burger or chicken sandwich this place always comes through for me. They cook the burgers perfect and have a little char at the edges and yes hatch green chili is available. The French fries are thin and crispy and try their signature ice cream sundaes. The only reason not a 5 star from me is their soda fountain setup table. It looks like the ketchup, straws, lids, and condiments are stuck in a corner with no organized thought or room to maneuver.

place_category: Nightlife, Food, American (New), Pizza, Pubs, Bars, Breweries, Restaurants
text: I would never go back to this restaurant. I ordered a sangria, which was on the menu, but I was told they didn't have it. Then I ordered an iced tea, and the waitress brought me a CAN of GREEN TEA which was disgusting. There were very few menu items to choose from, and portions were very small. Dessert came in one of those mini glasses, but the menu did not indicate that, so that was also a disappointment. All in all, a big disappointment and I will not return.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Desserts, Donuts
text: Awesome ice cream!! Favorite is key lime pie , pralines and cream, salted Carmel, strawberry cheesecake,,, I'm a non chocolate gurl ... how bout white chocolate snickers??? Thanks TEEJays..

place_category: Comfort Food, Italian, Restaurants, American (New), Asian Fusion, Greek, Noodles, Salad, Specialty Food, Pasta Shops, Food
text: Two out of 3 staff had their masks well below their noses- including one doing the cooking. I really hope no one is sick or asymptomatic. I'm afraid to eat my dinner. Also no one was wearing gloves - this coupled with the incorrectly worn masks is concerning.

place_category: Religious Organizations, Restaurants, Local Flavor, Thai, Buddhist Temples, Churches
text: Always peaceful, no matter how crowded it is. Market on Sundays is a must-go for anyone who wants authentic Thai.

place_category: Wine Bars, Restaurants, Italian, Nightlife, Bars
text: As I walked in the host staff stared at me as though I had the Polish eagle standing on my head. I did not feel very welcome. I went to the bar and again the bar staff did not make me feel welcome. The Chopin vodka martini was prepared well and the food was good. As I ate at the bar the bartender finally spoke to me in a friendly demeanor. Staff - one dupa. Martini - five dupas. Food - four dupas.

place_category: American (Traditional), American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Seafood, Cafes
text: The turkey burger is gone. The hot bread is gone. Table cloths are gone, making the restaurant cold and sterile. They don't even have balsamic vinegar. The small size of Pellegrino is gone. Instead they now have dishes like fried chicken - trendy and unhealthful - and higher prices. For years this was a wonderful, welcoming little restaurant. It's been taken over by people who don't get it. Such a loss!

place_category: Sandwiches, Food, Donuts, Restaurants
text: Better than the other D-n-D that we tried to go to earlier in the day that was out of most of the regular donuts (how can they run out of glazed, whether they be regular or chocolate). Service was fast, got the order right, but I somehow don't think I would ever try the tuna fish sandwich here (they were advertising it all over the place). No drive through, but overall not a bad experience.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Convenience Stores
text: Wanna get caught by the cops while drinking and driving this is the place to do it! Right down the street from Reno PD this is the local hotspot for cops to take down the next problematic person, weather you be blowing a red light or stumbling out of your car you are likely to be questioned by a sober police officer who thinks your outrageously stupid, fun way to start a conversation with someone - wouldn't you say.....

place_category: Food, American (New), Restaurants, Pizza, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Vegetarian
text: This place rocks! The service is great, food is consistent, and the atmosphere is great. I highly recommend the hot and crunchy bowl!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: We asked to be seated in the main outdoor area. Was told it was for reservations only. I told our server that we did have one. She then asked the manager but they couldn't change our seat unless it was indoors. After that 3 other customers tables were changed to the main outdoor area with no problems whatsoever. The area in the parking lot feels like a parking lot. No music. Cars parking up against our seating area with fumes in our eating area.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Latin American
text: Pretty good food. I was not a fan of the corn tortillas but I am picky. The nachos were great, they came individually. Their margaritas were pretty watered down. They had just opened about a week before I went, and the service was pretty good. They could work on a few things, but nothing horrible.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Cafes
text: I really wanted to love this place. The interior space is well thought out, gorgeous, and calming. But what I came for the coffee was burnt and bitter. The almond milk was overheated and it separated. Your barista's need more training. There are far better options in NOLA.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Been coming here for years and this is the first time I've been disappointed! Steak Vaquero is burned as well as my daughter's chicken fajitas. We were with a large group, but over an hour and half for food is ridiculous!!

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Pubs, Food, Bars, American (New), German, Coffee & Tea, American (Traditional), Beer Bar
text: Great place in the most unlikely spot!! Awesome beer choices and the bartenders are cool and very helpful. They are even nice enough to give you samples if you are not familiar with a particular beer. The atmosphere is relaxed and the people who frequent the place are chill. I did not try the cafe but the smell was unbelievable.

place_category: Restaurants, Gastropubs, American (New)
text: Stopped in for dinner and sat at the bar. Very friendly staff gave me a menu and glass of water pretty quick. I ordered the Dry Aged Burger which comes with poblano peppers, cheddar cheese and a green herb sauce with a side of fries. This was one of the best burgers I've had in a long time. Hope it stays on the Menu for they next time I'm in Philly.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, Fast Food, Caterers, Restaurants, Buffets
text: Nothing special. Im always a little suspect of restaurants that already have chips and salsa on the table. The ones at our table were stale. the salsa was like fire. The cheese in the enchiladas wasn't even melted. The beans were running and the rice was like grainy stale sand. Not a good experience at all. If you go, go for the staff. They were suer polite and helpful. It was busy with parties yet they were super attentive. Nothing to write home about.

place_category: Delis, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Sandwiches
text: Don't let the line (sometimes out the door and down the street) scare you off. It is sooooo worth it. Get a Benton Park Po Boy. You won't be disappointed.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: I'm sure there are all sorts of opinions on where to get the best Po' Boy in New Orleans. Johnny 's is certainly way up there in the running. The blackened chicken one had a good amount of kick to it, and the crawfish po' boy with a side of gumbo was outstanding. This is a no frills deli style dining experience, but the food is tough to beat. Highly recommended!

place_category: Vegan, Vegetarian, Restaurants
text: The food here was excellent - creative choices and the beet lemonade was delicious. But oh my goodness - the service was Slow, slow, slow. Over an hour before our appetizers even appeared then another long wait before the main. I don't think our server even knew we were there - we had to ask the lady clearing the tables for help (after we sat and stared at our empty appetizer dishes for 15 mins). What a shame. It could have been a great place.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Sandwiches, Salad, Seafood
text: Great out door spot right off the beach. The Crab Fries are amazing (and I'm not a huge crab fan). GF had the fish tacos Cajun style. They were excellent. Plenty of fish. I had the super grouper Cajun style with beans and rice. The sandwich was delicious. The super is 6oz. The rice and beans were on point. Our server Ezra friendly and helpful. Well done.

place_category: Tapas/Small Plates, Desserts, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Tacos, Mexican, Food, Restaurants, Salad
text: We love this place. Food is great and staff wonderful. Fun to bring out of town guests to a place that seems so Tucson traditional.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Pizza, Cocktail Bars, Food, Gelato, Italian
text: "Not as good as Olive Garden; and that's saying something". - my daughter, age-12 Yep. It's just fine, nothing more and nothing less. We had pizzas and pastas. The ingredients seemed fresh. The service is good, the atmosphere is fine. The food is OK. Meh. Ok. Meh. Good. Meh. Fine. What's the opposite of "a pleasant surprise?" Oh yea...Porta Via.

place_category: Mexican, Seafood, Restaurants, Soup
text: I love this place! Being from San Diego, I know Mexican food! I'm probably a bit of a Mexican food snob. The service is always great, drinks are delish and food is always excellent! I highly recommend Mr. Tequila's!!

place_category: Local Flavor, American (New), Southern, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: Open til 2 am. Our last dinner in Nola. Had the fried chicken/mashed potatoes/collard greens. It puts all other iterations of this exact meal I've ever had to shame. It was so delicious I was about to shed a tear. Excellent last meal in Nola.

place_category: Bars, Seafood, Nightlife, Lounges, Restaurants
text: So according to app we checked in 3 hours ago....the atmosphere is what you'd expect for the location. In the three hours we've been here I've got two beers, a plate of onion rings, and promised at least 5 times the food will be right out...on a bright note after the last promise it will be right out we asked for our check....that came still no food. Normally we wouldn't have come here but it for a birthday party. The onion rings were edible but meh

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants, Seafood
text: I don't recall this place being so bad. It's been 10 years, though. Bartender and server were nice and attentive. The food and menu need an overhaul. The crabs were small and didn't have any meat. My other friends ordered items other than crabs and didn't care for it. I won't be going back. The owner needs to read these reviews and make some serious changes.

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Brazilian
text: Didn't eat here because when we walked in with a party of 5, they told us it was a 5 minute wait but a family of 3 who walked in after us who were told it would be a 10 minute wait but were seated essentially right away. Did I mention that this was at 8:45 pm on a Thursday night and the restaurant was half empty? We are on a cross country road trip and this was going to be our sit down meal of the day. Not really selling us on the city of Boise.

place_name: Lanna Culinary School and Events Center
place_category: Specialty Schools, Cooking Schools, Education, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Thai
text: Stumbled onto this place after a work meeting in the area last week. Had lunch here with two co-workers, and we were all impressed. The service was fantastic, and the food was quite tasty. I had the turkey club sandwich with potato salad on the side. The sandwich was fresh and very good. The potato salad was fantastic! Each of my co-workers reported their meals to also be very good. I will certainly give this place another shot if I find myself in the area during their hours again.

place_category: Diners, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: We have been here a few times and the service is always slow. Today, however, we and everyone else at the counter has waited literally 30 minutes since our orders to be served. Food finally arrives and it's cold. Off the list.

place_category: Restaurants, Delis, Fast Food, Sandwiches
text: Always tasty, Always fresh. Jersey Mikes is my go to for a great sub every time. The #13 or the #6 are awesome!

place_category: Restaurants, Gelato, Coffee & Tea, Food, Italian, Bakeries
text: Oh my gosh!!! How did I not discover this place until now!!!! I will come to this place every single time I'm in the area. You should too! Everything is excellent here. It's pretty much your modern European standard: focus on the food, desserts, and drinks...then everything else will follow (hip vibe and down to earth staff!). Their gelato is the best in the city!!!!!

place_category: American (Traditional), Seafood, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Went on a Friday and there was no one in the restaurant. This did not change the service which was terrible. Salad was brown and waiter brought dessert with nuts on top after we told him we had a nut allergy at the table. Won't be back.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Tex-Mex
text: Excellent food, made to order using only the freshest ingredients. Friendly staff. Worth the visit.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: Pretty terrible. Bad margaritas. Bad service. Overpriced. Unfriendly service. Good food.

place_category: Restaurants, Buffets
text: Edible food. No extra frills. Desserts were precut and hard to the touch. My anticipation was high as I got several recommendations. Went on a Tuesday (5 pm) for their usual menu (not a seafood person-which I guess is served on the weekends). For the price of three people, I think Golden Corral or Hometown Buffet would be better.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Noodles, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Japanese
text: Couldn't eat all my food having to fight off the flies and then watching the owner killing flies with a paddle zapper right over the sushi prep area and in the kitchen. Unbelievable!!!! I mentioned it but they didn't seem to care. Gave this place a second chance after a less than good experience the first time, it will be the last chance they get from me!!!!

place_category: Japanese, Asian Fusion, Chinese, Soup, Restaurants
text: We recently picked up takeout here and this is an attractive neighborhood place. Our order was submitted via the internet and it was perfectly packed (including some extra this and that we requested) and ready on time. We started with a Japanese appetizer and Chinese entrees; everything was beautifully prepared and delicious. Wish we had a local place that was this good but we live in the land sunshine (SW Florida) where the weather is beautiful and the food so average.

place_category: Caterers, Restaurants, Hawaiian, Event Planning & Services, Barbeque
text: I get the response from the owner, I message him with my contact info and over a week later...no response? This does not sound to me like someone who would "appreciate the opportunity to personally address your concerns."

place_category: Sandwiches, Pizza, Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Their pizza and wings are okay. Not the best of all the major pizza delivery chains but what makes them pretty cool is their delivery system. You can see online who is preparing your order and delivering it and how long it would take to receive it. Also if you are a member of American express credit card, you can sign up for the free delivery system, which I find a huge advantage over other pizza places.

place_category: Dive Bars, Nightlife, Music Venues, Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Soul Food, Restaurants
text: Great food and good music. Love the beet burger and the *pierogis* ;~6

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: I enjoyed this cheese steak especially because I didn't have to wait that long. Ordering is fun, but unfortunately something from it made me very sick the night of and I was not able to go out that night....I am not sure I will be trying Jim's again.

place_category: Tapas Bars, Cafes, Bars, Restaurants, Spanish, Nightlife
text: I came here very excited because it had been highly recommended. 30 minutes went by and we finally went and found a bar tender to get a drink. We are 90 minutes in and still no food. Thank goodness Leanne knew the bread boy or we would have been starving. Not how I wanted to spend a relaxing Friday night after a long week. Not recommended.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Vegan
text: Decor was great. Our party ordered multiple appetizers, entrees, and drinks. Drinks were ok, apps ok, entrees ok. It was just ok which was disappointing. Food and drinks overpriced too.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Pubs, Nightlife, Bars, Wine Bars, Gluten-Free, Mexican, American (New), Food, Tacos, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Every time we go here, they have interesting, inventive, dynamic dishes on the menu. Nice vibe. Indoor & outdoor tables. Always good stuff.

place_category: Burgers, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Lounges
text: Great menu choices. Stay away if it's busy as the kitchen is small. It took 45 minutes to get our food. I made the mistake of ordering Shrimp and Grits....DON'T DO IT! Shrimp and Grits tastes like oil and water. Omelets look amazing.

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Piano Bars
text: I paid $5 for a song and when the piano players changed the song and tip didn't transfer. This experience overwrites any other positives of the bar. Really it is too bad.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Bagels, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Limited food menu but everything we've tried is good and reasonably priced. Good smoothies. Very nice, open atmosphere and friendly staff. Still need to try the coffees and teas.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Books, Mags, Music & Video, Shopping, Bookstores, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Food
text: I stopped by Baldwin & Co for a take away latte while I was visiting the city and I am so glad that I did. The 'Notes of a Native Son' was everything you could hope for in a latte. I also had a few sips of the 'If Beale Street Could Talk', and it was equally dreamy. I appreciated the temperature check at the door and the overall beauty of the establishment as well as the book offerings. Keep being great, see you next time.

place_category: Mediterranean, Russian, Middle Eastern, American (New), Restaurants, Seafood, Kebab, Uzbek, Salad, Steakhouses
text: I would not recommend. The food was average at best. Just not that good. Felt like the chef was home grown not trained.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New), Bakeries, Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Not sure where the name comes from, but it's pretty much like Panera and Cosi. Service is pretty fast and it's usually crowded here for lunch. The wraps here are decent, but nothing to be excited about. Since it's in the King of Prussia area, there are tons of other places to eat. In comparison, it's just about average.

place_category: Fast Food, Southern, Chicken Shop, Restaurants
text: Banner sign at roadside said dining room open. 10:34am. It was CLOSED. Went to the drive thru. Website says full menu available after 10:30am. It was 10:38am. Was told only serving breakfast. Waited about 15 minutes for two cars ahead of us to get their orders before we could get to the window. When we rode by around noon noticed the dining room was still closed. Poor management here.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: BEST CHARBOILED OYSTERS EVER. Wow, as soon as my twin sister and I got off the plane to New Orleans, we ran (literally) to Acme and got our dose of charboiled oysters. The one at the airport is less crowded and cheaper than at the French Quarter location. I don't know if it's the cheese, butter, or garlic sprinkled all over the oysters but eating this always makes me one happy girl! Cannot wait to go back to NOLA very soon to eat these again!

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: Cute little place with delicious food. Staff was very friendly and accommodating of our large group. The food was delicious! Great for lunch or a casual dinner, will definitely come back!

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole
text: A nice quaint Italian Restaurant - had turtle soup and spaghetti -meatballs. The food was good and good service

place_category: Southern, Restaurants, Chicken Shop, Sandwiches, Soul Food, Comfort Food
text: I tried this place for the first time Sunday for dinner and had to go again Monday for lunch, it was incredible!! The Nashville hot chicken is perfect and I loved their Mac and cheese (I would definitely recommend the Kingmac sandwich). This was also some of the best service I've ever had, all of the staff was extremely friendly but especially the girl that was working the register when I came in.

place_category: Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bakeries, Modern European
text: This is a cool and charming venue for coffee, tea, breakfast, brunch or lunch. You watch the pastry chef making the goodies while you sit back in a large, industrial, open kitchen venue. I had the beet salad (perfect combination of flavors and a hefty portion) and the orange flourless cake (I took mine without the icing as they were just being prepared and I had a choice). Everything we tasted was delicious and the staff was friendly and attentive.

place_category: Sandwiches, Salad, Chicken Shop, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: More of the same. It was expecting better flavors and texture to the tenders....disappointing. The sauces were good.

place_category: Bakeries, American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Food, Desserts, Cafes
text: I fell in love with Fido's years ago when I visited Nashville, but now it's not nearly as good as it used to be. Their local latte was way too sweet and their food selection didn't look as good. Maybe they cut back because of Covid-19? I don't know, but the place seemed more run down as well.

place_category: Golf, Active Life, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces
text: We took Mom here for her birthday, since it's just around the corner from her house. We each enjoyed our meal and the staff was super friendly. My pasta was just ok, but the other folks at the table all said their meal was excellent, so I'd go back again. Go early though, they close at 8pm!

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Shopping, Desserts, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Coffee & Tea, Beverage Store, Art Galleries, Sandwiches, Cafes, Coffee Roasteries
text: I love their Pumpkin Spice Latte. It is better than Starbuck's. Their spinach croissant is so flaky and delicious! The shop is very cute, clean and cozy. I love coming here!

place_category: Taiwanese, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: I went to Gama cafe today and the service and drink was ok and it wasn't too busy. I knew their old location and their current location is much more welcoming. I personally love their ice teas and pancakes.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Brazilian, American (New), French, Asian Fusion
text: Went for restaurant week. Food was really good, but not as great as I thought it would be. SMALL portions. Amazing service with dish explanations. Overall, I was a little disappointed as I expected more out of the food. Maybe it was just because of restaurant week though.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Oh my gosh, the Margherita pizza covered with fresh chopped garlic. Delicious.

place_category: Greek, Restaurants
text: Nothing fancy and certainly not authentic Greek food. The gyro meat is full of fillers, substitutes and lots of sodium, but this is typical of most fast food type eateries. Generally my experiences have been OK with occasional overcooked or dry meat. Young staff are pretty nice though.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Restaurants, Pizza
text: i use to come here years ago, for their legendary slices, which are still good to this day - but, not sure what else is (my mother said her steak was just "ok). i ordered pick-up and still had to wait 20 minutes for my order (apparently, they forgot the steak) which made my pizza cold (yet, still worth it). the neighborhood is sketchy and, for what it's worth, so are some of the patrons and workers, but if you want a good slice of pizza, they have yet to fail ;)

place_category: Sandwiches, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood
text: I ordered the colossal fried grouper sandwich. It wasn't that big to be honest. It tasted great though. Fried to perfection. Flavor came through on every bite. Price was ok. Fries were also ok.

place_category: Restaurants, Buffets, Southern
text: I enjoyed the food , the staff and the atmosphere is just great . I loved the fried chicken ,mac n cheese and the ribs were all sooo delicious. The dessert bar was also impressive.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: Fast service, friendly staff, fantastic food! I am a breakfast lover, so being able to live just around the corner from a reliable breakfast (and lunch if you choose) spot! I get the loaded blueberry pancakes which are to die for! They are reasonably priced here, which is good because on a day off, my fiancé and I eat a hefty amount of bacon. Not to mention the fresh orange juice!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Brazilian, Salad, Steakhouses, Venues & Event Spaces, Gluten-Free
text: The lobster bisque always keeps me coming back for more.Had a delicious plate from the gourmet salad bar.Enjoyed the free Birthday cheese cake yum!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Sandwiches
text: I grew up in Roebling and have been coming here for 20+ years. This is a nice charming DINER. It's great for the "New Jersey Diner" experience. (Which should be on everyone's bucket list.) Pros: Good for families and large groups Cheap! Come dressed as your are. Sometimes the jukeboxes are working, and that's fun! Tasty diner food. Ps: The service people are hardworkers and many have been there for years. Tip them well!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Desserts, Salad, Food
text: My dad likes this place but being from Southern California, I have to say that this place is definitely not authentic and I have never finished my food here. When I received my nachos, most of the chips were already soggy. Overall, if you're looking for good authentic Mexican food, this is probably not the best choice. Good drinks, though.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional)
text: Delicious food and great atmosphere. It's going to become a regular stop for me in Philadelphia. The stuffed hash browns are insanely good, and a must-try no matter what else you order.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: I was excited to eat here after reading reviews but was sadly disappointed. I ordered Dave's Skillet and I found it to be very greasy and almost no flavor. I will give the place one more try because it was packed so there is something good there but I will definitely order something else. I will give it a plus for portion size.

place_category: Delis, Restaurants
text: Positive - the italian hoagie had tons of meat. Negative - the tuna hoagie was lacking in the tuna & both rolls were stale and hard as a rock

place_category: Seafood, Salad, Italian, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Lol the crabs taste like poo the fish was cooked slow on low heat they had rocks in the potato salad

place_category: Food Trucks, Latin American, Restaurants, Colombian, Food
text: Ordered 2 empanadas from this truck. The meat inside each one was cold. I wouldn't trust anything else from this truck.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: I am a fan of this restaurant. I have eaten at it many times. The service was off, really slow. My steak was overcooked. The taste of the food was good but not great last night.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bakeries, Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: Always good home cooked style food. Fresh and hot. The only problem here an be the line going out the door. It is well worth the wait.

place_category: Pubs, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Irish, Nightlife
text: Basically, if you've seen one Irish pub, you've seen 'em all. At least outside of Ireland. The grub is pretty good--the bangers and mash is quite tasty (the sausages are homemade), and the fish is okay. The best part about McGurk's is the outdoor patio, which is enormous. Sit outside when you can--inside is poorly lit and loud, as pubs tend to be. In all, it's a decent place to sit and have a pint and crowd-watch.

place_category: Bars, Pubs, Irish Pub, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Cool place, and a good selection on tap. But come on now...are they really going to charge people $6.50 a beer? (Which is basically $7.50 in reality, if you're not a jerk). Thought I was at a bar, not a Phillies game. Oh well...I guess if you're gonna drink in this part of the city, there's no use in being cheap. It's just a little offensive I think.

place_category: Breweries, Bars, Nightlife, Barbeque, Restaurants, Food
text: Fan of this BBQ! I've had the smoked wings and they are good, but almost a tad greasy. The sides are phenomenal- tots, fries, corn, slaw, collards, etc. The sandwiches are a good size and very filling. The homemade sauces are good, but more on the sweet side rather than spicy. Would go back and try something new!

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: I don't know why would people eat here. There's nothing like Maryland cheese steaks. I am so pissed I have no words to write this review.

place_category: Malaysian, Asian Fusion, Cambodian, Chinese, Restaurants, Thai
text: I used to love coming to Penang and had not visit Philly in a long time. It was nice to see that Penang was still operating. We had a quick lunch there it was quiet in the restaurant we took a table right by the kitchen, it was interesting to see that the entire kitchen was operated by non-Asians. They were hard at work grilling satays and making rotis. The chicken satays and shrimp noodle soups were good it hit the spot.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Mexican, Fast Food
text: I should know better than to exit a drive-thru without thoroughly checking the order first. It was dinner hour and I guess I didn't want to hold up the line. Regardless, got home to find I had been given the wrong bowls, no salsa, no receipt, and no sign of the side I'd ordered. Obviously, they handed me the next guy's order, and I paid a 25% premium for what I received. Hope he enjoyed my food.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Having lived within walking distance of Chinatown for 20 years, we were thrilled to find such amazing food in Elkins Park. And they will spice up anything. Love their sesame chicken, hot (have to ask), and crab Rangoon, and moo shoo anything!! Specials are great too! Only downside is no delivery but pickup is prompt and plenty of parking.

place_category: Seafood, Sandwiches, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Southern
text: this is the working man's Jaque-Imos. It is also another perfect representation of why the poboy is the superior sandwich on the planet, and how the various shades and eccentricities of the same rare wonderful ingredients can offer new perspective on things taken for granted. though sometimes not perfect, what do you expect for Jefferson Parish. go with anything fried.

place_category: Nightlife, Comfort Food, Restaurants, American (New), American (Traditional), Soul Food, Southern, Bars, Beer Bar, Sandwiches
text: Marshmallow sweet potatoes. That's all you need to know. I also had a kale chicken salad, but the side of the sweet potatoes/yams (they're the same thing, right?) was the absolute best and why this is a 5 and not 4. Sat at the bar and the bartender was super friendly too.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: We stopped by for lunch during the week. Good service but a limited menu of thai dishes at an affordable price.

place_category: Food Trucks, Smokehouse, Restaurants, Food, Barbeque, Soul Food, Food Stands
text: Had the pork dinner plate with slaw and baked beans. Truly best I've had...hidden gem curbside

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Unbelievable: cold, stale chips to start. 2nd was ordered a burrito and it came with cheese whiz on it. Room temperature meat and the cheese set up like cement in 5 minutes. Guacamole was green colored mayo. How can Mazatlan hang their sign on this BS.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Hotels & Travel, Casinos, Diners, Restaurants, Mexican, Resorts
text: Chile rellenos in the Tucson Area rated according to the Homeland Security Advisory System with three word descriptors. Tequila Factory: really strange batter. Yellow See photos.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants, Food, Thai, Coffee & Tea, Laotian
text: Wow! Soooo full! Great staff! Delicious food! BYOB! Good times! I loved the wings, tofu, and the catfish! I can't wait until I'm back in town to visit. It's slowly becoming my undisputed go to restaurant when I'm philly! Also heard from a patron that Uber eats started delivering. Wish I lived closer so I could enjoy more frequently. Absolutely one of my favorite spots for a good meal!

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Stressed out workers? Wow, talk about bitchy service. wow. The cashier was the rudest Ive seen in years. Probably getting ready to quit. I wont be back.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Really disappointed in this location in many ways. Breadsticks are undersized, they don't put the amount of toppings on the pizza that other locations do, and they refuse to accept Greek Pizzaria coupons. Drive a few extra miles and go to the Westfield location.

place_category: Caterers, Hotels & Travel, Mediterranean, Hotels, Event Planning & Services, American (New), Bars, Nightlife, Whiskey Bars, Restaurants, Seafood, Bed & Breakfast, Venues & Event Spaces
text: Charming hotel in a wonderful location. It is right in the center of town. The hotel is clearly haunted- make sure to ask the staff about Room 6

place_category: Golf, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Active Life, Bars, Restaurants, American (New)
text: It was fun .. The staff made u feel young again ... And the wait wasn't bad at all ... By the time we was done eating ... It was time to ... I think we stayed til it was closing time

place_category: Bars, Dive Bars, Salad, Restaurants, Diners, Wraps, Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Terrible place we were told because we asked to play a song and the bartender reluctantly did and we began to dance to Whitney Houston. The manager aggressively told bartender to cut it off and he told us we were told it is too much! Not sure why? Then we were told to leave ! It was a Monday and no one was there but we couldn't even get one song. Never will return to this place

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, Pizza, Restaurants
text: Ordered pizza and salad to stay. Pizza was great salad very good according to picky wife. Very busy but very quick service. Fair price. The Unknown Diner digs it!

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Fork is a great place for dinner in downtown Boise. We had the Asparagus fries to start and they were very good. For dinner we had the burger and short ribs. The burger was great and the Parmesan fries were an excellent side. The only knock was I asked for it medium rare and got it medium well. The short ribs were perfect and it is a large portion. If your in downtown Boise Fork is a must try!

place_category: Polish, Restaurants, American (New)
text: The food was absolutely delicious and Yummy! the service was good and the deco of the restaurant very colorful.I will going back try stuffed cabbage.

place_category: Pubs, Pizza, Sandwiches, Brewpubs, Beer Gardens, Breweries, Nightlife, Food, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Bars
text: The beer is great but the service is terrible. I've been here 4 times and I have never had a good experience with the staff. They always seem like you're bothering them when you have a question about the beers. They just really are not that friendly...

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Delis, Vegetarian
text: Great healthy options on the go. Fast and friendly service :) the owner is super nice and very helpful! Love the pepper jelly vinaigrette with the delly pear salad. So good and also very filling. The soup/salad combo is the perfect size for a quick and healthy lunch option.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: Nope., great effort to create Beachiness, however, Expected So Much More, service not great, Food less than mediocre, soggy burrito and rice, greasy. Definitely will not bother returning.Ants all over picnic tables outside! Not Cool. Expected So Much More., No Parking, can't READ ADDRESS, Playing Looped music NORA JONES, really??, Nothing beachy about NORA Jones, unless you want to go to sleep. Borrrring.

place_category: Food, Bubble Tea
text: First time trying Miucha today but have walked by and see the poster with thai tea on it. Decided to try today and im satisfied with the taste. Recommended with less sugar, i really like the thai tea, it is not made of powder. Prices are fair, four stars because still chance to try other drinks.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Jorge our waiter was the best! The food was amazing, great wine list and amazing desserts. I couldn't say enough about this place. Best Italian food and service I have had in s long time.

place_category: Italian, Nightlife, Bars, Steakhouses, Greek, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Seafood
text: Went thinking this was an Italian restaurant. I ended up Ordering a baked potato and salad for $6.99. They UPCHARGED me 2.69 for a CAESAR salad! This is supposed to be at least a partial a Italian restaurant-or so the name infers. A Caesar should be a staple not a commodity. It cost more for -mind you-the Worlds smallest plate of salad I think I have ever seen. I could have ordered a meal For what I paid for a lunch "special". Oh-they don't have chicken Parmesan so don't even try. Never again.

place_category: Caterers, Chicken Wings, Fast Food, Restaurants, Chicken Shop, Event Planning & Services
text: When I was a young boy my father took me into the city, to east some chick fil a. He said son when you grow up did you know that this place donates money to conversion camps for gays? He said will you defeat them or eat them all those waffle fries and shakes so shamelessly? Cause one day, I'll leave you a phantom to eat or not to eat, a moral quandary.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: What else can you say: It's a Philadelphia icon! No trip to the City of Brotherly Love is complete without getting a cheesesteak. And, for me, there's only one place to go: Jim's. Everything you love about a cheesesteak is here, even down to three different kinds of cheese. Be forewarned: Cash only!

place_category: Indian, Restaurants
text: Sub-par just ok Indian food. All the sauces were flavorless and watered down. We ordered delivery: 2 samosas and 2 mutter paneer. The samosas were good but sauces were watered down and flavorless. The mutter paneer was the TINIEST portion especially for $15 and the sauce was watery, had no flavor, and absolutely no spice. Hard pass for us. Bleh

place_category: Bakeries, Chinese, Restaurants, Food
text: The food here is so American-Chinese food. Generally it is great! But a little bit too salty and sweetly for Chinese. But the waitress there is not nice, that's why I only give 3 stars.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Pizza, Food Delivery Services, Caterers, Food, Italian
text: A great place for everyone! The pizza is the best pizza hands down! The staff is great too We will definitely be back.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars
text: Stayed at the connecting lodge and had the complimentary breakfast every morning. I also have eaten here before. Food is ok. A bit bland, service was fine, as a hotel guest maybe they could have been friendlier.... When i dined here months back service and food was also just "ok" PRETTY outdoor seating area with heaters and fire pit.... Overall it's meh, I don't think I'd ever go out of my way for this place.

place_category: Bakeries, Food
text: Absolutely amazing croissants! Great customer service and delicious baked goods make up for the limited seating. Worth going - maybe plan to take your treats home though if you're going at a typical "breakfast" time since the place will be packed. UPDATE: they now have an espresso machine!!

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: We waited a long time outside in the cold; no lobby. They served live Maine lobster at a reasonable price. The crab salad was obviously frozen crab, soggy and tasteless. The service was okay at best, but the waiter also used our entire gift card without evidence of what they had charged so there was no money left on it, where there should have been. Overall, a very BAD experience.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Cupcakes
text: The last couple of time I have gone into the shop the owner and the workers were a little off putting and not welcoming. Not to mention the desserts were a bit dry. I guess I fell for the hype too.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: It's called the "Egg Factory" because it does good breakfast... NOT because it does good lunch! Coffee is usually pretty bad, hashbrowns/fruit/toast are the usual blah of every other mediocre diner... but some of the egg scrambles and omelettes really are great. I still haven't been disappointed with an omelette and the Farmer Joe's Special is my favorite. It's good enough. Not great. Keep your expectations low. This ain't The Ritz.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: We had a wonderful sidewalk breakfast Sunday morning. The food was excellent, the service good, and the view of the park across the way beautiful. We will be back.

place_category: Sandwiches, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Phenomenal ! No other words required. I can't wait to come again. I tried the lobster roll, the crab roll and the shrimp roll. Lobster roll was my fave but any roll will do when you visit.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Pizza
text: I walked by this place many times finally I ordered a fried chicken platter & a cheeseburger. The chicken was good as were the sides it came with I would order from there again

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Interested in good cheesesteaks? Walk past this place and order from any random food truck and you'll definitely have a better one than Geno's.

place_category: Italian, Gluten-Free, Food, Restaurants
text: The food was quite good but the noise and service was deafening and dismal. It's one on those "Who ordered the " places that doesn't record your order by seat so it's aguesing game when it arrives. Some dishes were cleared before eveyone was finished. All the desserts came on one plate to be passed around and scraped off. Never again.

place_category: Jazz & Blues, Italian, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Music Venues
text: Some real jack-hole, presumable the owner/manager insulted us because we didn't know the band playing and went outside to listen to them on You Tube. We ended up thinking they sounded cool, but will head to the Blue Nile to see them where we won't be treated like crap. Note to said asshat: when someone wants to google an unknown band before dropping a cover, it's bad business to insult them before they even set foot in the door. Take my money, then treat me like an ass.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: I don't have a lot to say about peace-a-pizza. They make semi-gourmet pizza (not my thing), but they have the old standby's as well, and they do an pretty good job with it. You would be hard pressed to find a cheese pizza I didn't like, and this is no exception. All-in-all, it's pizza, but there are multiple places in the area I would choose before eating there.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Nice sushi restaurant. Sushi is very good. Easy to get to, easy parking, nice staff. My wife and I go there often.

place_name: Cinco De Mayo Mexican restaurant - Hermitage
place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Big place, plenty of seating. Very dim lighting which I Love! They seat us fast, serve our food quickly and always get our orders right. High quality food and generous portions, can't ask for more.

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: I really enjoy the food here, but the service has left much to be desired the last couple of times my family and I have visited.

place_category: Distilleries, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Whiskey Bars, Food, Wineries, Bars
text: Cocktails are great! The tasting room is comfortable and chic with a pleasant ambiance. Unfortunately, you cannot try their award winning Old Hamers Bourbon here due to law restrictions and their distillery permitting since it's made off premise. Gotta just go buy it in the store! Still a wonderful experience with very friendly and attentive staff. Located in the Kennedy-King neighborhood, just a block off of the Monon Trail. Bike racks available on site and street parking easily accessible.

place_category: Caribbean, Latin American, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Went through the drive through, ordered the chicken wing meal with black beans and brown rice. Side order of sweet plantains and a bottle water. Guy at the drive-through was too busy checking me out he almost forgot my drink (if I hadn't said "hey you forgot my drink") and also forgot my plantains. Chicken wings came charred and looking meat-less. Will not order this again.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Having lived in Southern California for 18 years, finding decent ethic foods that can even come close in Indy is a challenge. But the steak burrito I had here today at lunch came pretty dam close! This has just become my new goto place for burrito's. Looking forward to trying the rest of the menu. Staff was very friendly an regularly checked on me..... I will be recommending to friends an family!

place_category: Restaurants, Latin American
text: My very first Papusa! So very good and authentic. My daughter was craving so we looked this restaurant up. As far as she is concerned these are as good as the ones she remembers from El Salvador. The restaurant is a hidden gem. Food fresh, inexpensive and the service very friendly. I am planning another trip here when I'm in Reno

place_category: American (Traditional), Desserts, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants, Diners
text: Breakfast has always been good and the service excellent. Nice friendly, hometown feel. Tonight I was craving a burger and thought I'd get a better one than sonic down the street. I wish I'd gone to sonic. It was a frozen bubba burger and even though they don't close till 8pm the fryer had been turned off and it was only 720, so the fries were greasy and white. Stick to breakfast.

place_category: Restaurants, Jazz & Blues, Italian, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment
text: Stopped in with my wife before the Lightning's Saturday home finale. The location was excellent as it's right across the channel from the arena. The restaurant was not terribly busy as it was only 5:45. We shared the antipasto and we both had the lobster bisque. I had a Caesar salad and she had the mini crab cakes. The service was very attentive and responsive and the food was decent; not spectacular, but above average. Certainly worth a return visit.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Eatertainment, Bars, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Sports Bars, Arcades
text: Dave and Busters is 2 stars when it's busy and 4 stars when it's empty. The food is pretty standard pub grub. It's just sort of there. But the arcade games, which on my visit were in good working order, make the place a lot of fun. You can be seated the dining area (which I recommend if you have adults in your party and you want to converse) or seat yourself at the tables in the arcade area which is seriously LOUD. You will be shouting at each other almost like in a nightclub.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Pizza
text: Beautiful decor and we were seated immediately. We had excellent service and it was fun watching the guy make the pizzas. They are cooked in a brick oven and they have a thin crispy crust and extremely flavorful pesto sauce very very good.

place_category: Tours, Local Flavor, Hotels & Travel, Arts & Entertainment, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Music Venues, Barbeque, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces
text: This is a cowboy saloon, well a great bar. We went here back in August 2017 the week end that the bears beat the titans. It was an exhibition game. (The place was rocking, Folk's were backed up into the street to get in). My group did not like it, we were a bit too old for this 25 to 35 crowd. Sorry we moved on, but you young Folks will enjoy WILDHORSE SALOON in BNA.

place_category: Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Thai, Asian Fusion, Bars
text: You know the food wasn't bad at all. Nor was the service bad. My friend recommended this place and I checked it out. The waitress was fast, friendly, knew all the good foods to recommend, and was sweeping the floors! The only reason why I deducted one star was because the beef, which was the main focus of this dish, was dry.. the garlic sauce was kind of there to compensate for how terrible the quality of meat they use. I may or may not come back for another meal, but probably not for a while.

place_category: Food, Donuts, Coffee & Tea
text: No complaints about this location. Service is usually pretty good and fast. I mostly come here for Donuts. I like how the staff here is nice and friendly. They always get my order right even though I mostly get frosted or glazed donuts.

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Nightlife
text: This place was great! I was in town for a conference and decided to get my dinner here and it was bombskeez! I got the Buffalo breaded chicken sandwich with a macaroni side (macaroni was actually not that good) but sandwich was on point! ....and breadsticks were Fire!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Pizza, Italian
text: 3.5 Stars in my book, but could not rate accordingly in rating box. Garlic bread is yummy, chicken parmesan is the best I've had in St Pete. Salads are decent. Wait staff is very friendly and welcoming-make you feel right at home. Pricing is reasonable. Parking is only problem. Definitely recommend over other Italian restaurants along 4th in the northeast part of St Pete.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Salad, Burgers, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Three generations, soon to be four, have had the pleasure eating Jim's Steaks and Hoagies over the years. I've had cheesesteaks from all over the world from Singapore to LA and no one can compare to these guys. Just last week I made a 6 hour round trip just to get my cheesesteak fix. From the roll, to the fried onions that caramelize on the grill all day to the Whiz.....Jim's is hands down the best!

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Food, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Breweries, Bars, Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces, Pubs, Brewpubs
text: Meh....not good , not bad.... just so so. You go here for the music. The oysters are decent.

place_category: Bars, Desserts, Italian, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Pizza, Restaurants
text: Service was prompt, food was delicious. The food came surprisingly fast. My friends and I ordered three pies and they arrived in under ten minutes.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Bars, Greek, Nightlife, Pizza, Restaurants, American (New), Beer Bar, Pubs
text: I actually enjoyed most of what I had. Fresh flavors and tasty cocktails. My three stars is for two reasons. The veggies -- I like mine firm, but these were undercooked. And I had the shrimp risotto. $30 and it literally had FOUR itty bitty popcorn shrimp -- definitely overpriced. The octopus portion was small too, but it was well seasoned.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Food, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants
text: this is a great hangout for COLLEGE kids because there are so many of them. food is actually good. its a little loud and i went on a week day and packed. we sat close to the kitchen so it was funny to see the chef/cook get frustrated with the waitstaff who weren't picking up their orders. i just happen to know what this feels like from past experience. our service as great but it seemed many tables had slow service. honestly i want to give this a 3.5 JEAN: OK by far ORDER: waitstaff

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Soup, Asian Fusion, Japanese
text: This place always comes through. Their lunch special is a great deal! 2 rolls, soup and salad or 3 rolls and soup or salad for $8.50 and $10.50, respectively. And not just skimpy rolls, a lot of speciality roll options. Anyhow, good food, clean place, friendly service. Thanks!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: I found the service sub-par and quite honestly all aspects of my dining experience fell below expectations. Of my party of five, three of our orders arrived incorrect. Perhaps residing in New York I have to have higher standards but honestly speaking I've eaten better food at a chain restaurant

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Bars, Restaurants, Pubs, Beer Bar, American (New), Nightlife
text: Good if you order from the restaurant side. If you are ordering from the bar side, good luck. Tonight was another occasion when the floor service was incredibly slow. This happens every night the Pint Room is 75% or more full on the bar side.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, American (New)
text: We really enjoy Sacred Pepper. They get it right every time! From the ambiance to the wait staff and Chad with management, we leave so satisfied every time! I loved my grouper and my hubby loved the steak and lobster.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Friendly service in a reasonable time with good food. While you can dine in the take out business seems to be what they do most.

place_category: Burgers, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Pubs
text: Nice place but a half-hour wait on a medium burger with an empty house?! The cook's gotta be taking naps on the job...

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Soup, Chinese
text: Let me first say that there is no "good" Chinese food in the quarter. But, China Wall is a helluva lot better than Moon Wok. I had the chicken and broccoli with shrimp fried rice and crab rangoon. Everything was "good, cheap Chinese." They delivered in under 30 minutes; I have no complaints. If you're in the quarter, and have a craving for Chinese, this is the place to get it from.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Food, Food Delivery Services, Restaurants, Pizza
text: The pizza is ok...I've had better $1-2 slices and they're $4-5 but nice vegan options, no outdoor dining tho

place_category: Drugstores, Shopping, Food, Grocery
text: Asked five people for panko crumbs. No one had a clue. No one cared. Training. Training. Training

place_category: Teppanyaki, Italian, Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: This place has a name which is so confounding. It has "Italian" in its name but has no items on the menu which are Italian! It is a Chinese operated Sushi and Hibachi house with tasty sushi. The service is far from stellar but the food makes up some of the difference.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes
text: Fairly new. Came in after the lunch rush on a Friday. Sandwich was good, ok. I could have made similar at home. Gobbler had small smear of cream cheese, a half dozen dried cranberries and some pine nuts. Multigrain bread was fresh. Reno dip had fresh sliced warm roast beef. Nice touch- after the meal a server checked on us. Asked how the sandwiches were and if we like the thickness of the meat

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: so bad service!!! i ordered and i wait 40 minute. And i did not eat anything. So bad food. So cold and so dirty place!!!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: Fish was prepared very well. Friendly wait staff who were knowledgeable about the menu. I would not sit outside near the water though as the bugs were a bit annoying. Definitely worth a visit.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Food, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Pubs, Bars, Mexican
text: Definitely love the food, atmosphere, and drinks served here! Great HH specials, but this place gets bumpin and gets filled quickly. Tacos and salsas are super flavorful. Only thing is they took their nachos off the menu. Honestly was one of the best nachos I've had, so I was upset to find out they didn't have it anymore. Nonetheless, I'll still be coming back!!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Dim Sum, Asian Fusion, Shanghainese
text: Mixed dishes: Very good and authentic - Shanghai Shao Mai, Pork Soup Dumpling OK - Pork with Sauce Noodle (needs slices of cucumber), Shanghai Fried Rice Cake (a little too salty) Totally failed - cold dishes (Marinated Gluten, Smoked Fish in Sweet Sauce, Marinated Duck) ... wrong ingredients and wrong sauce. So the final advice... order dim sums and stay way from cold dishes.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: It was good, but for the money I would go to Morton's, Flemings. Or St Elmo's over this place.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Barbeque, Food, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Desserts
text: They don't even know how to slice brisket against the grain. Staff indifferent when pointed out; result - tough brisket. Used to be a good BBQ joint.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Pizza, Italian
text: Bad. Worst pizza I can remember! No taste. Nothing to recommend this place.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Food tastes great and is as expected. Saul and Oby are wonderful servers and beyond personable!

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Brazilian
text: Tucanos doesn't disappoint and this holds true for tonight's visit as well. We had A+ service from Mery and Adam tonight! Like all the staff here, these two helped make tonight memorable. Thank you Mery, Adam, and Tucanos for helping us celebrate a birthday! Look forward to seeing y'all soon

place_category: Diners, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, American (Traditional), Pizza, Restaurants
text: Well the name says it all, "It's Nutts" I've been here quite a few times, sometimes it's great, sometimes it's not. You never know from visit to visit. The food is generally good, and this place is a local favorite. The ice cream is good. It's not always the venue that's at issue, one day you have a fine relaxing bite before you head up the river road for a drive, another time it could be slammed with families and their young unhinged hungry kids. You roll the dice with this one.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Creperies
text: Amazing crepes! We got mocha crepe and caramel apple. Both sooo good. And big portions. Highly recommend.

place_category: Seafood, Grocery, Food, Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Manchu is the go to hood chicken joint. The wings are spicy and fried crisp and are one of my favorites the rice I can pretty much do without as its is super salty with dehydrated shrimp but overall the chicken is the star here. Its great for parties and gatherings and cheap if you can get past the hygiene of the place.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Gastropubs, American (New), Comfort Food, Bars, Pubs
text: I want to like this place so much, but I just can't. The service is spotty at best and when they open the large bay windows, it becomes unbearably hot inside. The beer menu is wonderful, so if you come in shorts and bring a lot of patience, you can have a good time.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Bland food but good service. Cheese crisp was yummy and piping hot but a little pricey at $10 for tortilla with cheese.

place_category: Italian, Food, Restaurants, Grocery, Specialty Food, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: This place is amazing. Everything is wonderful!! The lasagna, meatballs, sandwiches, bread, sauce and bakery items are all fantastic!!

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Seafood, Bars, Nightlife, Gastropubs, Restaurants, Pubs, American (New)
text: Came when they opened. Had high concept "mixologist" drinks which were wonderful. On return visit, one person was making drinks and serving tables. Must not have known the drinks because ingredients were missing and drinks tasted like they had cheap mixes. Food was still good, if a bit conservative considering how interesting gastro pubs now can be in Philly.

place_category: Italian, Local Flavor, Restaurants
text: This place is absolutely brilliant. My favorite thing is the baked artichoke with sundried tomatoes, parmesan, bread crumbs and pine nuts. Their homemade pasta dishes are lovely, and even the plank salmon is particularly noteworthy. My friend said their pizzas are incredible, so I plan to check those out next time. There's always a wait list here, particularly on weekends, so make reservations early.

place_category: Greek, Restaurants, Mediterranean
text: Great ambiance. I've been here twice. Once for a private party and once for drinks at the bar. The restaurant itself is small but the outdoor seating is fantastic. Food is good nothing that sticks out and drinks are average but the venue is great.

place_category: Restaurants, Mediterranean, Fast Food
text: Foods was excellent. But they nickel and dime everything- after buying a ton of foods and drinks, I went back to get a refill on a coke. The owner asked for additional $1.80. I couldn't believe it. They put a ton of ice in the first place and didn't get enough coke. Now for a small refill, I have to pay anther full price? Good luck staying in business much longer. Too many good solid halal foods few blocks away

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Really nice people. Just wish they could get my order right. I am a daily to double daily and my order is only right maybe half the time. And it is the same order every time

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Vegetarian, Restaurants
text: The food was good. Id say similar to five guys but with smaller portions of fries. If it was reasonably priced id give it 5 stars. My burger fries and soda come out to 15 dollars. Thats just way too much for a fast lunch. Chipotle has been wildly successful selling huge meals of fresh organic foods for under 10 dollars. Why does this place think they can get away with such a huge markup?

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Fish & Chips, Nightlife, Seafood, Restaurants, Bars
text: I had higher expectations... Nothing wow-ed me. We had: Hot combination platter - boo, thumbs down. I could do better without even trying.
