Clam chowder - good (better be good) Shark - good, lean - but very dry Swordfish - juicier then the shark, but nothing too exciting. Food was just OK, but I loved the view from the outdoor patio.

place_name: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers and Brews
place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (Traditional)
text: Why do I keep letting my kids talk me I to going to this place? The service is fair on a good day. The menu appears to be okay but the quality is hit or miss. We got a waitress in training. I'm a good person to practice on because I'm very patient but the service sucked! The new apprentice waitress was fine, it was her trainer that sucked. I'll try not to go back again but I'll get weak at some point and take my kids again.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional)
text: The service at this location is always friendly but they are constantly busy so don't Dine if you're in a big hurry. We take advantage of the early dine menu on the weekends. Several options for $8.99 before 3 p.m. My favorite is the Chicken Critter salad. Hubby likes the 6 oz sirloin dinner.

place_category: Seafood, Venues & Event Spaces, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Bars, American (New)
text: The food was average... The risotto wasn't good My son ask for a sundae from the the kids menu and they serve him coffee ice cream,...

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: We were looking forward to a night of fine Italian dining so we came this restaurant. There was no wait time, but we had a reservation. The server was pleasant. We ordered the Little Nonna's dinner Menu for $35/pp. The appetizers were okay. The Lemon chicken was bland but salt made it good. The swordfish, however was very bland, and tasteless. I had to order something else. I ordered the Eggplant, it was okay. The dessert was decent.

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Piano Bars
text: Aside from long wait to get in last night this place was so fun. The crowd was great and the songs played were those that brought back memories for all. The hurricanes knocked our two friends out! Would definitely put this on the list of must do's when returning to NOLA

place_category: Seafood, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Cajun/Creole, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Everything was amazing and fairly priced! The seafood was so fresh. I am on vacation and I keep wanting to go here everyday!

place_category: Cafes, American (Traditional), Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: Toooo expensive! 12.00 for a drink and a bowl of vegetable soup. At least serve dessert with it. Back home in Seattle I can get a large bowl of delicious vegetarian pho, a coke and cream puff for $9.00.This place is over priced. Won't go back

place_category: Restaurants, Greek
text: This place is the worst. The pita is soggy, the seasoning on the chicken is awful, the salad came without dressing, the potato salad (for $2.99!) was in the smallest container on the planet and is too salty to even eat, and they forgot the French fries. Honestly, couldn't create a worse meal if I tried. Genuinely upset about it and wish there was a number to call to get a refund

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Just found this place walking around Philadelphia. Seated right away and server took my order within 5 mins of being seated. All the food was very fresh! The waitress was very nice and food came very quickly. Great place to eat.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Salad
text: Pizza is not bad but very overpriced for a personal pizza. Also, today I went to get a affagato and the lady in the front gave me pretty less ice cream than espresso shot and would not give me more ice cream when I asked. She was rude about it and said that if I wanted something more I should get the higher priced one for $6 (mine cost $5.50).... ahh... ok not coming back here again!

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Italian
text: We went to Augusto's for my birthday with a fairly large group (10 people). Everything was delicious and the service was topnotch. Our servers were very friendly and attentive. We had the onion brulee which was to die for. They really go above and beyond to make your day special. Definitely going back and definitely would recommend to others! Great for groups and special occasions.

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Comfort Food, American (New), Sandwiches, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Very nice and often creative food. Wonderful setting, including an outdoor patio. A few meals have tasted a bit "gamey" to me, but that's just my personal taste. A disappointing drawback recently was when a dog on the patio got up to leave and shook dog hair all over my food - yes it was visible. I'm not sure anything can be done about that; when you have animals in the eating area, you have to expect a little bit of interaction.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: We had to wait about 10 minutes before a waitress even acknowledged we were there, and she just dropped silverware off without saying a word. We waited another 10 minutes without any contact from her again, so we got up to left. I stopped at the desk to let the hostess know what happened, and she used the excuse that they were "really packed," even though the restaurant was only half full.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Well I did go back and try their 10 dollar large pizza special.Long story short it was OK,nothing extraordinary.I do want to mention that the crust was better than I expected it would be for the price so I'm upping my rating from the initial 2 stars to 3.Will I return?Maybe but Pizza Hut and Papa Johns also occasionally run 10 dollar specials and they are closer to my house so I would probably choose them first.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Salad, Soup, Bagels
text: Over priced non sense in an over priced shopping center with horrible parking. I am not a Panera kind of gal. My mom was craving a Greek salad and cheese danish. So on my way to see her in the hospital and stopped and grabbed her lunch. Service was fine but the salad was super tiny! Very little feta and 1 Greek olive. Sad salad. Bread was good. Danish fresh. Won't return.

place_category: Delis, Restaurants
text: The quality is there. It's fast. It's an interesting atmosphere where the asian lady behind the counter reminds you much of the soup nazi in Seinfeld, other than her Vietnamese accent. In the end, if you're hungry, it just doesn't cut it. The sandwich would barely beat my 3 year old son.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Vegetarian, American (New), American (Traditional), Comfort Food, Cafes
text: Service was awful. Take out order was wrong and we had to send it back. They charged extra for the alternative order of coconut shrimp even though they were out of crispy tofu and failed to notify us at any point in the ordering process. This was the fourth time our order was incorrect, and last time they didn't record the order when we called so we had to wait an additional 40 minutes for the food to be prepared. Fries were very soggy too!

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: I can never turn down excellent BBQ, especially when it's made by this establishment. Eating their food makes you feel like it's your first time all over again, OMG! Savor every bite, take time to enjoy the smell and by all means save a lil for later. I'm renewing my vows to this place!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Some of the best salsa in town! It was very awkward though that the salsa girls seemed to expect a tip for making it. Cmon! Its standard to get salsa with chips at every Mexican restaurant in town, I'm not paying extra for it! Service was a little slow and the restaurant was empty. Everyone in our party of five bought the food was very good, but it was too expensive for Mexican food. $60 for 4 people before tip for the lunch special burros and a Caesar salad. Ouch!

place_category: German, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: A very small German/American restaurant where locals eat regularly. Breakfast is good and can be enhanced by having homemade potato pancakes and sausages of a different variety than the norm. Lunch & dinners offer traditional American dishes and many German entrees and sides. The food is good and the servers are well seasoned, like the food.

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife
text: First time here. Nice. Live band killing the Black Keys!!! Great Bar area. Friendly staff. Cool vibe. The menu is really safe pub fare. For this atmosphere Id expect something kinda quirky, but its nice. Id come back.

place_category: Seafood, Bars, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: So excited to try this place out! I got the crab legs had to ask for the tool to crack open the crab legs didn't have the small device to cut open the legs had to try to use my fork.... And my food was Luke warm at best. I'm giving 3 stars because my husband got the shrimp and it was hot and delicious. Wish I would have ordered the shrimp! won't be get crab legs again

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food
text: Clean and bright. Prompt and very friendly service. Everybody was great. Food was just okay. Right for the price, but nothing outstanding. Portions were on the small side, cooked well, taste was average. If you need a quick and decent breakfast, go here. If you are looking for more of a sit down experience, keep looking,

place_category: Italian, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Everyone raved about the food, but I was disappointed. I had the margarita pizza, roasted broccoli, and spaghetti ( more or less with tomato sauce). The handmade noodles were very al dente and would take some getting used to. The pizza was fine, nothing popped off the plate that's for sure. The broccoli was above average but not the best I've ever had. Seating was fine and casual. Waitress was very knowledgeable about the menu and helpful.

place_category: Steakhouses, Seafood, Restaurants, American (New)
text: My family decided to try J.B. Dawson's again for my Grandfather's birthday. Let me tell you it was a horrible experience. My pulled pork tasted like dish water and was dry, my grandfather's meal came out ice cold, and it took forever to get waited on. Not to mention that the prices are ridiculously high. McDonalds is better than J.B. Dawson's and that is saying something. We will never be back. Ever.

place_category: Caribbean, Restaurants
text: I thought it was just OK... I'm the future I will not order the jerk chicken with sauce, I'll ask for it on the side...

place_category: Korean, Restaurants, Barbeque, Mexican, Gluten-Free, Salad, Soup, Vegetarian, Vegan
text: I love the food here but they need to get it together. The last two times I've eaten here they have forgotten to give me either part or make my entire meal when ordering through the app. Over 30 minutes late and not helpful in person. Wish they could make it work because I do think they offer great healthy and tasty food.

place_category: Food, Bagels, Restaurants
text: My family and I have been coming here for years. The bagels are the best around, yet I'm still only giving 3 stars. This place is Kosher and it's located in Cherry Hill, a town with a large Jewish population. They close early and cater to breakfast mostly, the later you come - the less options you will have. I was actually a daily customer for quite some time, but I've been cutting back on visits due to one reason that could be fixed so easily: CUSTOMER SERVICE DOES NOT EXIST. AT ALL.

place_category: Sandwiches, Pizza, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Pubs, Italian
text: This pizza was awesome, it tasted so good. The only reason I'm giving a low review is because I got really sick after eating it. I had the worst stomach ache all night. They also had these cool beer glasses I wanted to ask the manager if I could buy one but never got the chance.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Asian Fusion
text: little pricey- but man can they cut a mean fish- they put little jalapenos on the yellow tail- brilliant

place_category: Gelato, Food, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Coffee & Tea
text: Authentic gelato, so much better than that stuff they pass off as gelato at the AC casinos. The place is in the perfect spot on Kings Hwy. Family owned and operated. In addition to gelato, they sell canolis and cookies and beverages. My entire family loved it. Very pleased and have gone back several times to try new flavors.

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New), Coffee & Tea, Food, Nightlife, Vegetarian
text: I must say I enjoyed my meal here, and the serving size and service are great hand in hand. I will be back for more potato soup :)

place_category: Nightlife, Burgers, Music Venues, American (New), Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Food, Cafes, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional)
text: Great atmosphere, but their portions vary greatly so it is hard to know what items are a fair price and which are expensive. Ordered some fajitas to split and they were very small. The taste was ok, nothing special, comparable to Chili's.

place_category: Latin American, Peruvian, Chicken Shop, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: This location does not live up to its standards set by Maryland locations servings are nowhere near ass big and the food is not as fresh. It also cost a tad bit more if you are from D.C. ,Maryland,Va area and know about Sardis don't expect it to be exactly the same. I wouldn't eat here if I hadn't been to the other locations which are all great. Sorry Philadelphia you don't get the real Sardis experience!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Gastropubs, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Seafood, Pubs, Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breweries, American (New)
text: It took 1 hour and 15 minutes to get fed. We had to make eye contact with our server whenever we needed a refill. The fries were cold after the fact that we waited so long. When we asked for a Manager it turns out our server was working the bar and acting as Manager. We tried this place several times and was bad every time. We even went in on a Friday night and it was a ghost town. I wonder why???

place_category: Breweries, Nightlife, Restaurants, Food, American (New), Bars
text: Lousy steaks but great beers The chefs don't know how to cook, seriously. This place needs a complete overhaul

place_category: Food, Cafes, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: If only I lived closer to here, I would come here more often to grab a cup of coffee and read or study. We only got to sample a few of the desserts and everything was really good. I'd be curious try their other food options.

text: Pizzas kind of pricey::: but good quality and tasteful. Kind of a contested entrance. Not a place to sit and eat. You sit in the back feeling kind of dungeon like.need to expand and move out of a strip mall.

text: I've had Greek Lady on several occasions now and generally find it always pretty decent. I'm giving it four stars because the food is not particularly stunning by any means, but it's always been enjoyable when I've gotten it. I'd recommend staying away from the gyros though and going for the salads (namely, the Greek Supreme). The gyros are okay, but the salads are huge (seriously, I could hardly finish), flavorful, and are generally much more satisfying (not to mention healthier).

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants

My absolute favorite things to get are the fried avocado and the rack of lamb. They cook the lamb exactly how you like it and the asparagus and grains compliment it perfectly. I will be back when my brother graduates in the spring! Thank you for an incredible dining experience once again.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: This Papa John's was a bit of a disappointment. Not because of the taste but because of the lack of service. I ordered my food and was told I would be called when my food was ready. I stepped outside and told the guy to let me know and I would come back in. Not knowing it my food sat on a shelf for 15 minutes while I stood there it having one employee say this order is yours till I finally questioned the situation. Good food, just not the respect a customer should receive.

place_category: Restaurants, Donuts, Coffee & Tea, Food, Fast Food

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants

Benedict eggs: the English muffin tasted like uncooked flour. Hash browns, completely insipid. Granola: burned and soggy Coffee was good. SERVICE: average. LOCATION: good.

place_category: Restaurants, Indian

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Very much overrated. No idea why this is on so many "best of NOLA" lists. It feels like it caters to the tourist masses. The food was fine. Some items were even really good. But the bar is high and they did not meet it. On top of that, we had to wait half an hour despite our reservation which I can handle. But the disregard of the inconvenience, the "too cool to even apologize" aspect to the service totally turned me off. Very mediocre experience overall.

place_name: Amish Country Market At The Feed Mill
place_category: Bakeries, Farmers Market, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Specialty Food, Cheese Shops, Food
text: Living in Boston, it's hard to find wholesome cooking like this. The food was more than what we can eat. I miss the South!

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Bars, Nightlife
text: It's cool atmosphere and the food is good enough. The beer selection is lacking, though, and the beer (both on tap and in bottles) always comes out semi-warm.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Vegetarian, Tex-Mex, Gluten-Free
text: Terrible food and drinks. Please do not waste your money. Our drinks were served in big plastic water cups with smoothie straws and food was very blend.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers
text: Gabby's is always a safe bet. Be prepared for a wait at peak hours (and especially on weekends). The space inside is fairly small. Pro-tip: ask for your burger to be char-grilled and DEFINITELY get the sweet potato fries!

place_category: Restaurants, Delis, Acai Bowls, Food
text: This place has great sandwiches, super flavorful and quality ingredients, but overall they are overpriced for what you get. For one of the most expensive sandwich places in town, it's pretty bread heavy, without a lot of meat. That said, the "godmother" is so delicious. I'd recommend asking for double meat when you order.

place_category: Food, American (New), Sandwiches, Restaurants, Desserts, Bars, Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Wine Bars, Nightlife, Seafood
text: Snooty staff - really bad first experience. Went back a second time and the food was good, but priced as if it were amazing. It's a date night place for people with money to blow. They won't be getting more of my cash after the experiences with their staff. Can't say that I recommend this place which is unfortunate because its conveniently located close to where I live.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Food, Pubs, Breweries
text: One of Ben's favorites! A big space in South Tampa that is unique and Bear (dog) friendly. South Tampa traffic can stink but the beers are worth it so stay a while! They often have different things going on, we have been there when the Champ for a Food Network BBQ contest was coming in and they had all this food driving you nuts from the smell, local artists selling work, food trucks out front, music, etc.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Chicken Shop, Fast Food
text: So disappointed about this place, how is it that every single time, something is missing in my order??? How hard it is to double check the order to make sure everything is in the bag? This is not the first time that happened!!!! So furious to spend 40 dollars to come home and see that my order wasn't in a bag and a simple sorry doesn't work for me anymore!!! I guess I will never buy from this place again!!!!

place_category: Mobile Phones, Electronics, Grocery, Shopping, Food, Discount Store, Fashion, Department Stores, Drugstores

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes

text: Its really good! It is comparable to Chipotle but comes with free chips and salsa and Guacamole comes free on the burrito instead of the $2 Chipotle charges. On the negative side, the chicken is rather bland with apparently no spices/seasoning added. They are always nice here!

place_category: American (New), Breweries, Desserts, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Food

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Seafood, Diners, Sushi Bars
text: We went on a Saturday night so it was very busy. The sushi was good, the service was ok. Our server was very pleasant but, kept forgetting everything. We didn't get any free balls that I've read about. Maybe he forgot? I would go again. Don't get the white sangria, not good.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Jazz & Blues, Fast Food, American (Traditional)
text: We meet the owners right after they opened the place up. They have put a lot of time, work and money into this place. It looks a lot better than the other bars that were there before it. The owners and wait staff have been great. They come up and talk to you and thank you for coming. It is a great place to go and sit and have a beer or cocktail. They do have TV's so if sports are on you can watch a game.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Brasseries, Breweries, Distilleries, Gastropubs
text: I thought this place was great. Big old historic building, excellent brews and great food. We tried a lot of the snacks, which of course was bar food, but it was really good bar food. the service was excellent too. highly recommended in Reno for casual dining.

place_name: Molly Maguire's Irish Restaurant And Pub
place_category: Sandwiches, Pubs, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Irish Pub, Restaurants, Irish, Salad
text: First time friends and I visited the place. We stopped in just for drinks on our way around the area. Very clean and a good sized place. Good selection of beer and spirits. Staff are friendly and attentive. We looked at the menu just to get an idea and the prices are fair and menu is diverse. I will try the food the next time I stop in. I would recommend checking the place out.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Fast Food, Food
text: I really, really, really...like their fries! Crunchy little shoe string fries and they are so good. I'm not big on burgers so I can't comment on that. Their chicken strips were good, but nothing too fancy. Service is great; we were greeted with a friendly smile and ordering was easy. Once our food came there was a mistake with the frozen custard desert and they corrected the order with no hesitation.

place_category: Ethiopian, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Cafes
text: Food was amazing! I had chicken Tibs with cabbage. So much flavor. I even ate with my hands as Amy suggested! I will definitely be back. I played it safe with the chicken but will try the lamb next time.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: My two Asiago chicken ranch wraps had no asiago cheese, no bacon, and no tomato. Instead I received two wraps with chicken, lettuce, and cheddar cheese only. That was it. I asked for no ranch so I could use my own low-cal ranch and at least they got that right. How hard is it to make two wraps that are exactly like your menu states minus the ranch? How can you get something so simple so wrong? I worked fast food as a teenager and it's not rocket science folks. C'mon!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, New Mexican Cuisine, Restaurants, Mexican, Tacos, Fast Food
text: I've been through the drive through here a couple times, and the service has been outstanding! Like, freakishly good. That's the only reason I can think of to write a good review of a fast food joint. Yeah, clean, consistent. Too expensive for what you get, but the service left an impression. A go-to after everything else has closed, and nothing at home looks good.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Bars, Tex-Mex, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Nightlife
text: Given the ownership and management had high expectations for this place. Sorry to say a bit disappointing. The redone interior is nice. Menu shows promise but mostly down hill from there. Service is uneven, although friendly. Food is meh, not bad, just run of the mill.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Cafes, Restaurants
text: After being on hold for 20 minutes was told they do not accept to go orders until after 7 pm (this was 5:30). Very disappointed. Called another restaurant.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Cafes

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: It has nice atmosphere, red/white checkered table cloths, old family photos, very quaint. We were seated right away but the wait to take our order and get our food was pretty long. We had pizza and salads. The pizza was good, thin crust and nice sauce. The shrimp ceasar salads were just ok. I've had better. Wait staff was frendly, just not as attentive as I'm used to.

place_category: Tacos, Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Mexican, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I wanted to love this location because they didn't mess up my order at all for once, but I unfortunately got sick from eating here. I have an iron stomach and usually things do not bother me, but I was not far from the bathroom all night after eating some tacos.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Chinese, Restaurants, Food

place_category: Chocolatiers & Shops, Coffee & Tea, Food, Desserts, Specialty Food

The presentation, and the experience made this an easy date, dessert date, friend experience.

place_category: Pizza, Nightlife, Food, Restaurants, Breweries, Bars
text: This little hidden gem was fabulous for a fun, informal Sunday brunch. The food was all very fresh, and lots to choose from. The only drawback was parking-none available in the restaurant's lot. Had to find parking near by, so a little annoyed with that.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, American (New), Burgers, Salad, Local Flavor
text: Great atmosphere, new place, good look. Indoor and outdoor seating with gas fireplaces. Service was good, but the food wasn't great. Salads $7 and appetizers around $10.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers
text: Terrible service and the cooks don't know the difference between "over medium" and "sunny side up." The waitress seemed to think that smiling and attempting to be nice to her was an affront to her being...while at work.

place_category: Hot Dogs, Burgers, Restaurants, American (Traditional)

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Food, Vegan, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: I had been watching this place on Yelp and Instagram and decided to take a look at their menu and place an order. I ordered a Viet wrap for my husband and a pesto wrap for myself. They are worth my ride

place_category: Steakhouses, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional), American (New), Burgers, Chicken Wings, Nightlife

place_category: American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Southern, Restaurants
text: As a veteran Nashville Hot Chicken connoisseur, I have to say I was quite disappointed in Hattie B's chicken tenders today. they lacked flavor and really lacked the famous crunch that were all after when we have Nashville hot chicken. I truly hate to say it but they really didn't even taste like chicken. I won't comment on the spice level. Hattie B always has great sides, no complaint there, but you guys need to up your game on your chicken fingers they were definitely not double-dipped crunch.

text: solid drinks, grimy atmosphere, gross floor. would give it a two but so many hot 18 year olds

place_category: Sushi Bars, Seafood, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Sushi was good but the service was pretty terrible. I've never been to a sushi restaurant that did not serve soup and salad (we didn't get either) and it took nearly an hour to get our sushi. The only times we saw our waitress was when she took our order and when she brought our food. Very disappointing experience especially since the food was good.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Chicken Wings, Comfort Food, Food, Specialty Food, American (New), Chicken Shop

I would have given them 2 1/2 stars but the Yelp app won't allow me todo half stars. Don't waste your money.

place_category: Tacos, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Soup, Beer Bar, Food, Mexican

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese

place_category: American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Bars
text: I may be biased because I really miss the Lobby, but last time I was at Caddy's, there was a terrible odor by the inside bar. Anyway, we took our drinks to the outside bar, finished them, and moved along.

place_category: Convenience Stores, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Grocery, Food
text: Bring cash! They don't take debit/credit for less than $5 purchases so I have not been able to buy anything here yet. The store itself looks ok if not a bit run down. And I haven't tried their ice cream because of the "no cards for purchases less than $5" thing.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, German
text: I went here for a Friday evening Happy Hour, and it is well worth it. $4 selected draft beers and $4 sausage sandwiches makes for a can't-be-beat German happy hour. This was my first time, but I am sure I will be going back soon. First experience was a good one!

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: We wanted to love it here. Waited 50 minutes and didn't get any food. All of the tables around me were without food as well. The menu looked amazing but I can't speak to the food at all. We left after hunting down a waitress to tell her. We will give it another try, because I want the restaurant to work. They just really aren't ready to be open yet.

place_category: Poke, Food, Bubble Tea

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants

place_category: Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Mexican, Food

place_category: Middle Eastern, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Syrian

Sci-fi stuff on TVs was a bit odd.

place_category: Vegan, Restaurants
text: If you're vegan, this is the place for you! Otherwise, it's a lot of cauliflower and sweet potatoes cooked in different ways with different sauces. It was okay. The tater tots were my favorite thing. I also ordered the buffalo cauliflower bites which I thought were kind of gross. The staff is super nice and I love the atmosphere. It's worth a try, I recommend everyone at least stop in once.

place_category: Burgers, Pubs, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Sandwiches, Irish, Nightlife
text: Mediocre at best, everyone raves about how fantastic this place is.. but not really, just like every other standard Irish Pub, kind of like the chain O'Charleys. I'd reccomend Pats, over this dump any day. Everytime I go there the waitstaff is incredibly rude, the food is awful, and it's slow.

place_category: American (New), Diners, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: To start, the chips and dip they serve you free when you get there are great and definitely hold you over until the food arrives. Because it has a pretty small interior it is best to arrive early (at least for dinner) because it can get crowded fast. This is one of my family's favorite restaurants and if you're looking for good American food, this is the best in the area.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Food, Nightlife, Bars, Brewpubs, Breweries, Pubs
text: Great service, food and safety during this crazy COVID time. My hubs and I enjoyed eating inside because the tables were spaced out appropriately. The beer was delicious and the food oh so good! We had the fried cheese curds, which came with a yummy sauce, and truffle pizza.

place_category: Breweries, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Food, Bars
text: The food was ok. The hostess pushed really hard for us to go to the "lounge", the not as nice/more sports bar area of the brewery, even when we were just looking for a table. When we got to the lounge didn't get service for about 10 minutes, not even menus. Everyone in my party order food and we order an appetizer that we didn't get until we got our good. It's still a cool place but wasn't happy with the experience, I would prob come back but eh...

place_category: Restaurants, Bagels, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: $8 for two bagels with cream cheese. Seems a bit excessive to me. Bagels were fine but won't be back because of the price.

place_category: Bakeries, American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Food, Desserts, Cafes
text: Wasn't even able to try the food the line was too long. I don't mind waiting even an hour in a line as long as it's moving. This one was stopped for at least 10 min with the same people at the front. After 10 min they opened a second cashier.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: One of the best meals I've ever had. Friendly in service (so much direct eye contact), creative and incredible execution in all dishes, perfect pairings. Everything I could ask in a dining experience.

place_category: Convenience Stores, Salad, Food, Delis, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Kosher, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: The food has always been good. But what's annoying to me is that on Grubhub, the shop is listed to deliver to my area, and when I place my order, it gets cancelled due to being out of delivery area. What the heck is it listed to deliver then? Change this.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: I came for the bananas foster! I did order the "shrimp & grits", their version of it. It was actually delicious, I just wish I had more in my bowl! The bananas foster was pretty good! They flambe it tableside, which is cool! My favorite part is the fire! Second to eating it of course. I can now say that I have been to Brennans and had their excellent bananas foster!

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Food, Wedding Planning
text: Place is beautiful from the looks of it but that is all it has going for them! Food was terrible. No flavor, bland and under cooked. The drinks were watered down and top shelf was not TOP SHELF. For the amount of money people pay to have their wedding here it is not worth it! The filet came out with a butter knife and i could not get a steak knife. Food is just not good and that is important for a party.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Fast Food
text: I've been staying at the days inn and ate here 3 times on my week long stay and they messed up my order each time . I ordered both GREEN BEANS and Mashed potatoes and always got beans and rice . So gross . Also apparently this location doesn't have butter . But then saw other customers get it. Very rude staff.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: I really wanted to like this place. A lot of people told me it was as close to new york pizza as you get. Well, yes and no, you can buy slices of pizza but the pizza itself isn't as big as one would be in new york. Over all the pizza is quite better than the rest of the pizza in Santa Barbara

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Fork is just another hyped up American food joint in Boise that is popular because of the owner. People in Boise love to go to the talked about restaurants to see and be seen, and sometimes forget about the quality of food. The menu is small, not many choices. I had the chicken entree one night, it was decent. The next time I had the steak sandwich, which also was decent. The atmosphere is nice, and the servers do a good job. They do have a good bottled beer list, but only a few beers on tap.

place_category: Chicken Shop, Korean, Restaurants
text: Excellent food, very busy place. Service was quick food was hot and delicious. Very reasonably priced 5 pieces of chicken fries or kimchi and a corn fritter for $11.00 with a pop. Different toppings for the chicken my husband had soy and garlic chicken my mother tried the yellow curry and I had hot mustard. All very moist tender chicken. Would recommend this to anyone that loves chicken. Will be back...awesome

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Food Delivery Services, Food, Vegan, Salad, Fast Food
text: Our favorite restaurant, family owned and the food is delicious

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Tiki Bars, Bars
text: Well it's interesting. Service was slow. Waitress seemed to be annoyed by our wanting to order. Took forever to get our orders said she wasn't ready..couldn't find a friends card who had just paid. Couldn't get the receipts together. Food wasn't bad but only know about the deviledcrab.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Food was delicious. Drink was tasty. Bill was enormous. We were afforded the beauty of watching our guacamole being made. We ate freshly sliced cucumbers. We had diced jalapeños. A couple of tacos. A quesadilla. Steak. Etc. Service was good. There were 4 of us. They don't offer or do a military discount. We were there no longer than hour. It was a neat little hole-in-the-wall. Our bill came to ONLY $153.00. NO JOKE.

place_category: Restaurants, Lounges, Bars, American (New), Nightlife
text: Friday night. Made a reservation for four for dinner, my son's 22nd birthday. It was deafeningly loud as we were seated at a table near the door. A group of hipster-wannabes were being noisy fools at the stand up table in the bar. Management refused to move or otherwise accommodate our group, and the too-cool hostesses were unpleasant about it. Don't go on a weekend night if conversation is part of your plans.

place_category: Food, Italian, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Stopped by to try the pizza and it was good, not the best pizza I've ever eaten but a solid pizza. The cheese is a mixture but the menu says you can get all mozzarella which I think I will try next time which is just a preference of mine. Significant other also got a salad and said it was good. The owner and staff are great. Definitely a place to give a try, we will be back.

place_category: Pubs, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Bars, Salad, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: went here on a sat. afternoon, able to sit right away. Beer selection great, husbands mixed drink good. I had chicken ceaser salad, very good. My husband had apple smoked bacon burger he did not care for, bun fell apart, fried taste not as good as grilled. Service ok, hostess took over when waitress was busy. Nice atmosphere.

place_category: Nightlife, Seafood, Bars, Restaurants, Tiki Bars, American (Traditional)
text: The best fried shrimp I have ever eaten is served at Rusty Bellies. My husband's grilled grouper sandwich was his favorite meal of our trip. The drive to TarponSprings and seeing the docks is fun. Rusty Bellies is at the end of the docks. Hey catch their own shrimp and grouper. It is cooked to perfection. Drinks are super. Superb Bloody Mary's. The black beans and rice are tasty and Cole slaw is good with celery seed. I look forward to another visit here!! Best shrimp anywhere!!

place_category: American (New), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Burgers
text: One of those spots you have to try ... we stopped by Mardi Gras weekend for breakfast and were shocked to see windows papered. Miss all the fun waiters, especially Mr. John ... anyone know where he may be? Mr. John is long-standing, proud member of Zulu and informs folks where to find him (float #) on Mardi Gras Day ... and offers lovely coconut .... miss you.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners
text: Not a bad place for the price. Had the crab cakes and veggies. I took several soccer players while at a tournament and there were so many options for everyone to chose from. Including kids with nut and wheat allergies.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Wine Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Restaurants, Southern, Cocktail Bars, Food Delivery Services, Seafood
text: Nice atmosphere for my best friends' wedding. We are from out of town but I wish that portions were a bit bigger. My husbands entree looked like an appetizer and even though it was good, we still had to go somewhere else afterwards just to stop the hungry lol.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Barbeque, Food, Sandwiches, Wine Bars, Diners, Bars, Specialty Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: Nice busy ambience and notable wine list. The food is good but overpriced. Get the tri-tip, worth the price. The Chef's Plate was interesting but not substantial. Not a big fan of their desserts either.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Salad, Sandwiches
text: Ummmm.... New management, not as friendly service and the ingredients / texture was way off! Floppy, soggy, and very greasy pizza!! Very disappointing!!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Delicious food, good service. Clean and happy vibe. Almost everything on the menu is good. Try the mushroom caps! The only down side are the hours (only open until 2pm) and that it is SO BUSY on the weekends, especially Sunday mornings with the church crowd. If you get there early you should be good!

place_category: Bars, Mexican, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Good spot for a late night meal, especially if you have had a few drinks. Resembles chipotle. The burrito was huge and fell to pieces after one bite, but was good nonetheless. Nothing special, but it does the job.

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Gay Bars, Burgers, American (New)
text: Use to really love this place! The food was great and they have interesting options. However, the last couple of times the same items have been different (smaller in size from $11 dinner to what looks like half an appetizer, cold, unseasoned) and also an instance where I ordered a wrap dinner and received... just a wrap. Not sure what's going on but I love supporting local business and they're a staple. Hope something changes, would love to eventually return!

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Pizza
text: Something about this place made it better than just okay. The menu was fine. The food was fine. The service was fine. It was just all around fine. Sorry but that's all I got.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: If you are looking for outlets, not good. Had to sit at the low counter with high unergonomic stools. Also the counter serves as the condiment area and the used tableware drop-off, so people would have to pass closely between your back and a what looks to be a supporting pillar. Service was meh, ordered a pour over and seemed like a bunch of latte orders after me, got their stuff before I did. This is at least more spacious then their 104 St location.

place_category: Mexican, Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Ordered food came super fast! But when we ordered dessert that's when it took 20 mins. When the dessert came to the table my gf asks me is this supposed to have tomatoes I say no. She is about to eat her second bite and I tell her to stop. I find a piece of paper inside the bread pudding. I ask for the manager and he comes over I inform him of these extra items. He offers me another bread pudding.... I decline. The waitress offered to refund my money for the dessert...

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Mexican, Fast Food
text: Good solid offerings for a so-called fast food joint. I like the flavor of the chicken and many of the Mexican offerings. I like their green sauce and the avocados in their salads and other items. This location is more convenient for me since I live in South Reno. Good alternate choice from "the burger routine".

place_category: Mediterranean, Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian
text: Love this place ! The food is so fresh and so many options to choose from ...Always clean and great customer service ...recommended this place to anyone who loves middle eastern food

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Bars, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional)
text: I made it to the ripe old age of 38 without ever setting foot in a Hooters before but, after a disastrous night out, my husband, our friends and I needed someplace for a quick meal. The whole concept makes me sad -- I mean, teenagers in support hose are not sexy -- but I was starving. My food was fine; it was kind of like Applebees with more boobs. Service was decent. I would not make it a destination but it was great in a pinch.

place_category: Food, Department Stores, Shopping, Fashion, Grocery
text: I guess it's your typical Walmart but worse? I noticed that staff actually doesn't know where anything is. I asked so many people where the item I was looking for was and got vague "over there" with waving hands pointing no where in particular. I bought T-shirts and was overcharged on one. Went to customer service and was told they were too busy to deal with me. Took 40 minutes to deal with their error. Sorry I don't mean to be a bother! Won't bother that location any more.

place_category: Greek, Persian/Iranian, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Indian
text: Chef Maurice is the star of this place. His food is wonderful. Even if it wasn't, I'd still eat anything he serves me lol. But really, everything here is delicious. Just save some room for the baklava dessert.

place_category: Gastropubs, Cajun/Creole, Southern, Burgers, American (New), Restaurants
text: I came in today to inquire regarding the possibility of a party. Basically was shot down, which is fine as I understand they couldn't accommodate the amount of people we had, but whoever I spoke with was quite snippy and rude about it. This is basic customer service. Would carefully think about replies next time.

place_category: Seafood Markets, Food, Specialty Food
text: I will never purchase from here again I have Given them to many chances I spend over $100 in cash every week . They will show me one size crab but when I get home they are not the size they showed me , they are empty just horrible. There prices are not reflecting there product .

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Diners, American (Traditional)
text: I don't expect much at any Denny's but this had the worst service. The poor food didn't help either.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Salad
text: 1 burger for pickup. Guy said it'd be 20 mins. 35 mins later I got my food. Bacon was gross

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: The food and service are outstanding. I started with the Scampi Isola Bella appetizer, which is big enough for two. The combination of the capers, shrimp, polenta, tomatoes, and sauce is perfect. My entree was the Bianco Nero. It's hearty with excellent flavor. I ended with the chocolate cake. The cake is decadent and big enough for three people. I'm not kidding. Best meal I've had in a long time. And the staff were all friendly and welcoming.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Sandwiches, Burgers
text: My husband and I always come to this Burger Up location and absolutely love it. I wish they accepted reservations because it's always quite busy, but you can walk around 12 South and enjoy the night while your waiting. We had the fried Mac n cheese balls and a classic burger and they were incredible. Best truffle fries I've ever had. Our waiter Matt was very friendly!

place_category: Steakhouses, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional), American (New), Burgers, Chicken Wings, Nightlife
text: Our spin dip appetizer took about 20 minutes and came out cold. The ceaser salad came out with little to no dressing. After our appetizer, we noticed two people who came here probably 20 mintues after us, enjoying their meals while we're once again, waiting. Thank God the actual meal was good. I got the bourbon street chicken and shrimp, it was delicious with the garlic butter. My boyfriend got the new Texas burger and loved it.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Greek, Cheesesteaks, Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, Wraps
text: Just awful! Went once to get a sandwich, a buffalo chicken wrap, and it was cold and nothing more than bland chicken with hot sauce and blue cheese dressing. Gave them another shot and they delivered pizza with RANCID cheese. Even worse, were not the least apologetic; refused to refund money. The owner was unkind and unpleasant--almost as nasty as the food.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Very very good but I preferred fins. The decore is superb and service is quite good and the food very good. It really is a standard in new orleans and not too far from bourbon st. Great view of jackson square. You do have to dress nice but still worth it

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Food, Grocery, Pubs, Nightlife, Bars, Salad
text: Food was amazing but definitely one of the worst experiences with customer service. There were no available tables so we sat at the bar...it took about 15 minutes before the bartender acknowledged us and asked for our drink order. We were not offered refills of our beverages the entire dinner. And when it came time to pay the bill we had to walk our tab to the register so we could finally leave. I can't say I'd ever want to sit at the bar again......

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Open sign was on at 4:15 am I sat on drive thru for 5 minutes before some girl sticks her head our back door and says we are closed!!! I said your open sign bis on she said "yea, I just turned it off"!!! Wtf kind d of shitty business is that? I will never return . And the app says they are open at 4 am mon - Fri it is Tuesday

place_category: Hawaiian, Tiki Bars, Gastropubs, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars
text: We went into this location as a bridal party meeting the groomsmen and his friends ... I was beyond disappointed by the staff and treatment From the servers to the managers - ultimate disappointed!!! We felt disrespected and based solely off of customer service I would recommend not going here

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: I hit this place on a day and at a time when there was pretty much no line ... a rarity! I guess the cooks and cashiers have tourist fatigue, because they barely look at you when taking your order and ringing you up. The service is fast and efficient. The price is what you would expect for a tourist joint. Unfortunately, my cheesesteak w/ provolone & fried onions was soggy and smelled very unappetizing. This is not to be considered destination dining.

place_category: Restaurants, Modern European
text: Ridiculously slow and owner does not care how long people wait. Wanted for 30 min. Only two people ordered. Bad 4 more to go. Food is good but not worth the price or the overhead.

place_category: Fast Food, Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food
text: Extremely slow service, missing part of our order to include a sandwich and fries, and no napkins/condiments as requested. Not convenient fast food, I'd head elsewhere if I were you

place_category: Bars, Mediterranean, Latin American, Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, Mexican, Food, Desserts, New Mexican Cuisine, American (New), Gastropubs
text: I have been a regular here for a while and it is my go favorite spot. The food is delicious every time and I am never disappointed. It's a fun, easy atmosphere and the food is rustic and delicious. My plate is always empty at the end of the meal. I think there is something here for traditional foodies as well as those that are more adventurous.

place_category: Pizza, Cocktail Bars, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars
text: This is an easy place to pass up, but the pizza is traditional and well made. Drinks are reasonable too. Definitely not the place to impress a date, but quiet night with a friend.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Nightlife
text: Unique, complex spices, beautifully prepared food but slow service. Also, better to wish guest a Happy birthday than to insult with a candle on an otherwise empty plate.

place_category: Drugstores, Beauty & Spas, Cosmetics & Beauty Supply, Convenience Stores, Food, Shopping
text: I went to this pharmacy for the first time last night. Asked, "can I help you?" I replied, "I have prescriptions to fill for tomorrow pick-up." The tech then said "We only have 7 minutes to closing" Wow!! I stood quietly as he conferred with pharmacist and then said, "tomorrow is fine." Whatever happened to customer service?

place_category: American (Traditional), Salad, Restaurants, American (New), Desserts, Food
text: First time to CF, made a reservation for 1100, doors did not open til 1105, had to wait in line, finally seated around 10 minutes later, ordered at 1120, came for the chicken and waffles Benedict, placed order then was told the hollandaise sauce was not available. Food took awhile, finally got it at 11:45. Also, the lamp at our table was filthy and the bottom of the window shade had a layer of dust. The food was great.

text: Ordered a takeout for 6 people one person only eats cheese quesadillas. Your cook gave him tortillas folded an cut but absolutely no cheese. Hire some cooks that can read! Every time we have take out here there is something wrong With the order but this tine you outdid your

text: The staff here is a joke! They have the RUDEST host I've ever encountered! Rolled her eyes at all customers and stood at the podium picking her nails as if she was so annoyed to be working. Management should be embarrassed how she acts and represents their company. Smile hunny! Girls that frown are super unattractive.

place_category: Italian, Desserts, Food, Salad, Restaurants
text: We've been going to Johnny's for years and have enjoyed Jeanne the bartender who is the best who can handle the bar and even a table in the bar why she's not there anymore on Wednesdays is beyond me what were you thinking Johnny

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: Hands down the best Alaskan Crab Legs I've ever had! And great beer. The staff was awesome and the view is absolutely beautiful from the pier! Highly recommend.

place_category: Mexican, Seafood, Restaurants, Soup
text: At Mr Tequila for an early dinner I had an Enchiladas de Mole which was just ok. I can't figure out if it was the chicken or the sause. My meal came with three corn tortillas filled with chicken and topped with Mr Tequilas special Mole Maria sause. But the Texas Margarita was pretty good though I order a pitch and mixed the peach and mango flavor to make a pretty awesome margarita.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Music Venues, Breweries, American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants
text: Best wings in Pinellas. Bomb place to go on a Friday night. Killer dj spinnin "records" if you kids don't know what those are it's time to check this place out. Oldest brewery in Florida so history abounds. Pretty good lookin waiters to boot.

place_category: Greek, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: True hole in the wall place, hence the lower score, dirty overall, but the cooks hands were clean, so got the cuban, tasted pretty good, not the best I have ever had, but not the worst either, probably won't go back.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Food, Diners, Restaurants, Donuts
text: Gotta love this place. The food is good with nice portions. The wait staff are very friendly and helpful. Some great donuts! And when the sign is blinking, the donuts are hot! And the offer a great lagniappe! If you buy a dozen donuts, you get a dozen donut holes for free! Lots of free parking and an outdoor seating area

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Tacos were pretty good until we noticed a cockroach crawling up the wall next to us. Killed it with a napkin and left it on the table, then we just got up and left. Fuck that. Seems like Marc S. had a similar experience recently.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Barbeque, Bars, Nightlife
text: Closed at 4pm on a Sunday. No hours posted on their door, no note saying when they will open. Will re-evaluate when this place is actually open when Yelp says it is.

place_category: Creperies, Cafes, Food, Desserts, Restaurants
text: Atmosphere here is great for a brunch or lunch date with your significant other. Good selection of drinks at reasonable prices. Only complaint was that for such a focus on their crepes, they really weren't all that good. Not all the cheese was melted and the crepe itself was overly crispy. I'm not a connoisseur of crepes by any means, but do remember the ones served at my college dining hall being vastly superior to Delice.

place_category: Cuban, Latin American, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Spanish, Empanadas
text: Great chain but they should look into the idea of a healthy "baked" Empanada. They are probably constricted to the rules/regs of the chain...nice idea though, huh? This particular store is VERY clean and has a friendly and courteous staff. Quick turnaround for the orders and nice seating arrangement.

place_category: American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: What an amazing experience from the time we walked in to the last cosmo. Great service, awesome atmosphere, delightful food, strong tasty drinks, and finally one of the best creme brûlée!!!

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Make no mistake, Sir Veza makes truly authentic Japanese dishes. Love the garage sushi rolls and the race car inspired bento boxes. Awesome place!

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Outback is one of my fav chains. The steak though was not as good as it could be. I will go back, but I hope the steak is a better cut next time.

place_category: Pubs, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Desserts, Food, Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Italian, American (New)
text: Terrible service! We waited a 30 minutes before anyone even acknowledged we were even there. We were seated right across from where the bartender resides. I had to plead with one of the period dressed waiters to help us. Finally, my wife and I left.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Art Galleries, Hotels, Arts & Entertainment, Hotels & Travel, Lounges, Bars, Shopping, Food, Nightlife, Coffee & Tea
text: Interesting place. Lots of glass. Very "Logan's Run". Wide open space, lots of windows and the views of the city all around was a nice touch. I was there mostly for 1st Friday things, so I was busy with that. They had a decent beer list and my First Friday Companions enjoyed their mixed drinks as well. I didn't try any of the food, what I saw looked nice though. If I am in the area again, I will stop in and perhaps try some food. It will probably get a higher star rating from me too.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Great cold drinks on a hot day, even better hot drinks on a cold day. Wonderful food and atmosphere. Nice owners and a reasonably priced menu. Charming decor and great location. I miss Chhaya.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Vegetarian, Comfort Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Caterers, Pizza, American (New), Vegan, Salad, Restaurants
text: Eh, it was okay. Nothing to write home about. Shockingly the place was packed at lunch time. For what I got, I think it's overpriced. They up charge in the most basic things. Really, I have to pay $1 for hot peppers on a sandwich... super basic food

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Food, Diners, Restaurants, Donuts
text: I would give this place more stars, food is good, decent atmosphere, but....... They have a server named Jenny that easy very inept. She is more worried about other stuff, like when is her breaktime, smoking, etc. Had her twice in last two visits. That was one time to many. Had got great service from other servers there. Will not be back.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, American (New), Diners
text: Went to this restaurant on a busy Saturday night. The pan seared pork tasted like they threw it in a microwave and dumped a can of Franco-American gravy on top. Terrible but they were kind enough to take it off my bill. I will give them another try as mostly everything else about the place (service, atmosphere) was pretty good.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches
text: I've eaten pizza all over the world. It was my first time trying this place. And fortunately I made a mistake when ordering. I thought I was ordering just a traditional hand tossed pizza. I got the Chicago Deep dish. Holy amazebalz! I ordered the 4 cheese with sausage, and fresh basil. Unbelievable. It sure won't be the last time. I can see myself driving the 2hrs from my place just for pizza. Sorry to the other decent places in town. Yiu lose. Pure yumgasm!

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, Salad, Pizza, Italian, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches
text: This place is absolutely ridiculous! My fiancé and myself ordered from here multiple times for delivery. Then one day we call and all of a sudden they don't deliver to my address with no explanation which makes it even worst they tried to tell me I didn't order from there cause they do not deliver this far.
