text: Friendly staff, however we waited almost an hour to get our food, and the waitress forgot to put in the order for one of our appetizers..... food was definitely not bad, however I we expected a lot more for the price we paid and all the nice reviews we read from yelp.

place_category: Italian, Sandwiches, Pizza, Restaurants
text: So yummy. We've had the fig and the pig, the meatball spinach, and the rock specialty pizzas. All incredible. Love the crust. The Marty's chopped salad is sooooo good. It's dangerous that I work so close... I've gone to pizza rock MULTIPLE times to grab lunch. Everyone I know that has been has raved about Pizza Rock. Gourmet pizza at an affordable price. I highly recommend giving pizza rock a try!! You won't regret it!!

place_category: Pizza, Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, Bars, Food, Food Delivery Services
text: Great pizza and bread sticks! The staff is always friendly! They are open late so it is a nice place to grab drinks or a slice of pizza after a game or night out!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, German
text: My friends and I met here for Happy Hour. Great Space. Great atmosphere. Good HH deals. I ordered the Brautwurst Sandwich with sauerkraut which came with mustard on the side. I really enjoyed the food and the time there

place_category: American (New), Cafes, Restaurants, Food
text: Amazing food. Great prices. Super relaxed atmosphere. I will be a replete customer for sure.

place_category: Food, Drugstores, Flowers & Gifts, Grocery, Shopping
text: High end & high price market Salad bar is so -so Sandwich bar is good for lunch check out the daily specials. $2.99+tax gets you a 6 in sandwich, chips and drink. You do need their value card. The check out lines are weird - but that may just be me :)

place_category: Salad, Nightlife, Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, Vegan, Bars, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: I like the menu, the beer selection is great too. Service ok and the food is actually really good. Here is my issue tonight 9:15 they are open till 10 but they just put all the chairs up. Not very welcoming. For that you lose a star.

place_category: Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, Tacos
text: My brother ordered catering for a little family get together and it was one of the best spreads I've seen. The ground beef and chicken were really good, but the steak and pork were a 10/10. Great salsa, great toppings and sides, great tortillas. We all ate til we hated ourselves including my Grammy, so you know everyone liked it as much as I did. Would highly recommend for catering.

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: Food is to die for, Lance at the host stand is friendly and accomodating. However, I have never had a great service experience. I keep going back because the food is worth it, but be sure to go in with the expectation of a very long meal and a low drink bill due to the inefficient servers.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars, Seafood
text: Love the wings with bbq sauce and my boyfriend loves the calamari. Service is always really good for us and never had an issue.

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Barbeque, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: Recommended by my realtor, who is a New Orleans native. The service was great, but the food was over-rated.

place_category: Buffets, Sushi Bars, Financial Services, Japanese, Tax Services, Restaurants
text: Ok, so my husband, the kids and I loved going here. However the last year it's gone down hill. They changed the all you can eat rolls also and took my favorite rolls off. The eel and the caterpillar. The service was awful. I felt like I was in some weird different universe. I have no idea what's going on but we won't be coming anymore.

place_category: Bars, Barbeque, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Burgers
text: This place is a better bar then it is a BBQ joint. The chicken thigh appetizer has a nice smokey flavor (although it is kind of a disappointing portion) but the boudin and pulled pork sandwiches failed to impress. Will I be back for a drink? Absolutely. But I may eat beforehand. The wide open indoor space with the picnic tables is great for groups!

place_category: Food, Breweries, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Brewpubs
text: My boyfriend and I really enjoy coming down to iron hill brewery for happy hour. Their beers are wonderful - and super cheap for happy hour!! They also offer a bunch of discounted food (4-6 M-F). Other menu items are solid, and their desserts are delicious. My favorite beer is Whitberry (raspberry Belgian wheat) and my boyfriends is the Pig Iron (English porter with coffee, chocolate and toffee). Their hummus and pita is fresh and excellent!

place_category: Nightlife, Sports Bars, Bars, Breweries, Pubs, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food
text: I had an amazing experience such professional service if you ever come highly I strongly recommend requesting for the bartender Danielle she went above and beyond and thanks to her secure it made my experience outstanding HIGHLY recommend!!

place_category: Music Venues, American (Traditional), Venues & Event Spaces, Wineries, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Food
text: Total amateur hour! Terrible food, terrible wine (which they didn't even make, despite what they want you to believe), and rude staff (seemed to be a manager behind the bar). For something with "winery" in the title, they don't seem to know much about wine and are pouring garbage by the glass. There are better glasses to be had elsewhere. Now back to Vintage or Bloomsday for me!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: We have eaten at Muriel's a number of times over the years and have never been disappointed. Food is always amazing, the cocktails have to be the best in town and the ambiance of the old french quarter building takes a step back in time, making the overall dining fun even more fun. Do yourself a favor...go.

place_category: Bars, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Super delicious! They cooked my fish so perfectly! I had the mahi-mahi which was grilled fish along with the rice on the side. In addition to my food, I had a house salad. The atmosphere was so nice and I liked the waitress, she was so friendly and nice. I recommend this restaurant and the I food that I ordered to anyone.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Burgers
text: Terrible experience. The music is extremely too loud and the service is horrible. We were told they were out of queso and the server came out with the queso after 20 minutes and it was literally nacho cheese for 14$.. I asked if this was the normal queso and he said no it's the new queso they just started making tonight? Okay so you ran to Kroger and grabbed nacho cheese in a can...The rest of the food was meh. Too expensive for sub par experience. We won't be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Bars, Burgers, American (Traditional), Steakhouses
text: Applebees is Applebees. It's not the best but it's not the worst. Their food is always the same. Service always meh. I don't expect too much when I go into an Applebees, however this one is the best of the Applebees in the area so if we do go, the Newtown one is the place of choice.

place_category: French, Event Planning & Services, Seafood, Salad, Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Caterers, Restaurants, Modern European, Barbeque, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: Just getting around to writing this although we ate there a long time ago. It was not good at all. We were seated outside, poor ambiance and seating situation. We waited an hour for an entree to share that ended up being pasta with strange flavors. It was not regular pasta it was thick noodles similar to I've had in Chinese restaurants. I would not return.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Desserts, Food, Restaurants, Burgers, Comfort Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Cocktail Bars, American (Traditional)
text: We waited a couple of months for them to work the kinks out. Trust me, the kinks are worked out! I had the kobe beef burger. I was reluctant to pay 15.95 for a burger. It was incredibly delicious and so juicy, I needed extra napkins. My husband tried the Beer of the Month (Harpoon) and said it was smooth and flavorful. We sat at the bar to avoid waiting for a table. The service was outstanding! Patrick and Amanda were friendly and attentive. We'll definitely be back!

place_category: Desserts, Specialty Food, Food, Macarons, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: It's an okay place. Nice looking area but hard to find parking, employees were also not that friendly. Ice cream wasn't at all great but the bubble waffle was good. Not a fan at all

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: I've eaten at Ming Lok for over 15 years and I have no complaints. The staff are extremely friendly and polite. The food is always prepared well. They always deliver, even if you're only ordering a combo for yourself. I also highly recommend the Chinese pizza. The dipping sauce for it is AWESOME.

place_category: Wine Bars, Italian, Food, Nightlife, Bars, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Observed owner being very mean to staff. I cannot support that type of behavior. You can find better food at other Oro Valley restaurants without supporting that type of person.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Ethiopian
text: The food is excellent, but the place is dirty. The bathrooms, both men's and women's, were so filthy the last time we tried to go here that we cancelled our order and walked out.

place_category: Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Salad
text: Horrible experience at 30th at station. Will never return. 1. I ordered a small Tuscan chicken sandwich. They charged me for a large. I pointed this out and they took forever to grudgingly fix it. 2. If you want a hot sandwich, they quote an additional 8 min wait time. 3. I opened my sandwich on the train and they had given me A COMPLETELY DIFFERENT SANDWICH than what I had ordered. My receipt had the sandwich listed correctly. Incompetence at its finest.

place_category: Barbeque, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Just finished dinner. It seems every time I go here it get worse. Tonight, sitting at the bar to eat, people were not getting salads until after the food arrived, one guy never got his. I got mine with my food and my steak was cold by the time I finished my salad. Never offered rolls. Come on, do better!

place_category: Bars, Creperies, Nightlife, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Restaurants, Food
text: This was right across from the hotel, super convenient! I got a large mocha and a muffin and spent about $10. They mostly had hot food, but I'm having brunch later so just wanted a snack. There is a lot of white as you will see in my pics but it has a clean feel because of it. The service was very friendly, two thumbs up!

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: So I am visiting from Utah, my new husband is always telling me Utah does not have good seafood. That maybe true, but this place does not have it either. Everyone was feeling sick near the end of the meal. I will not be back.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Food, American (Traditional), Pubs, Bars, Cafes, Burgers
text: Very relaxed place for a beer on the patio. The food is average at best, so just go have a beer. The staff is laid back and friendly enough. A good place to sit and relax for a while with a friend or to watch a game.

place_category: Nightlife, American (New), Burgers, Bars, Restaurants, Pubs
text: We reserved the party room last minute for a birthday party. What a great room, good service, good food, fun environment. Will be going back for sure.

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Salad, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: This place is so cute, great service and better food, I recommend it anyone!!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: My egg sandwich was pretty good but that pretty much it. It was a long wait and the service seem to be rush. Just order your food and get out. And what place doesn't serve lemonade!!

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Burgers, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Me and my wife and kids went here for a nice dinner and turned out to be a disaster. It wasn't even busy, it was us and two other tables and the girl didn't give us utensils. Come on man how the hell am I going to eat Coleslaw or chicken without utensils!! I even gave this girl a 15% tip and I just did it because I know that she makes her money from tips but she needs better service.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners
text: Went here for breakfast with a group of 8 while in town for a wedding. Everyone enjoyed their meals. Service was good, despite the mildly hard edge of our waitress, who, when I asked what some of their popular meals were said "none." hmmm... But fir a breakfast spot, cannot go wrong.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: I have never been humiliated like this in my entire life. The owner is rude, lies, and nasty with his staff. The food is mediocre, it is mostly a drunken bar for locals who don't know how unsanitary this place is. Do not waste your money there. Very disappointing. Go to Tee Off on States Street instead - their prices are reasonable, food is great and plentiful and the entire staff is very friendly and professional.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Dim Sum, Asian Fusion, Shanghainese
text: Fantastic DimSum. Best in Philly! HIgh Quality, fast, and consistently good.

place_category: Burgers, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Food, Nightlife, Dive Bars, Restaurants
text: The Backspace burger was so yummy! The bun is toasted and it's served with Brie cheese, highly recommend! Fries were hot and crispy, and the bartender helped us pick the perfect beer to accompany our burgers. When your tired of fish, this is the place to go in the French Quarter!

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Pizza, Italian
text: Another lunch with my sister and I have to raise my star opinion about Grassi's. It is a cafeteria style deli restaurant. The tables are quickly bussed so you can easily find a place to sit if it's crowded. Of course, my sister got the salad and garlic cheese bread. I chose the chili mac. The chili mac was good ( a lot of pepper went into it) and the side salad was good also. Would I come back here? If my sister wants to.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Taco Tuesday features $1 tacos. Drinks are also 2 for 1. While the sangria was a bit too sweet for my taste, the tacos are good and taste great with the nontraditional sauces on the table. Easily the best deal around if you're in Grand Center on a Tuesday.

place_category: Food, Cheese Shops, Specialty Food, Meat Shops
text: Everyone knows about DiBruno Bros but Claudio's is a somewhat hidden gem. Maybe not as extensive a selection of cheeses but they have all the basics and more and I find their prices to be better. They do, however, have a much better selection of olive oils and vinegars in my estimation. The store is larger comparatively speaking so it doesn't seem quite as crowded when waiting in line during the weekend rush.

place_category: Desserts, Cocktail Bars, German, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Pubs, Nightlife, Food, Beer Gardens
text: Our potato cake appetizer was tasty but lukewarm. Could have been cooked longer for heat and crispiness. Our entrees, the stroganoff and chicken schnitzel were yummy but not amazing. Our service was not great and the atmosphere was just ok. A disappointing choice for date night.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, American (New), Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Gluten-Free, Venues & Event Spaces, Burgers, Restaurants
text: Very good but not outstanding. Asparagus soup a bit insipid but main dish of rack of lamb was extremely good. Helpful Abercrombie-model-wanna-be staff. One of the better restaurants I've been to in Tucson.

place_category: Cuban, Caribbean, Cafes, Restaurants, Latin American, Spanish
text: I thought the food here was very bland. I ordered yellow rice, black beans and fish tacos. The yellow rice didn't taste like anything. The fish tacos were just plain, unseasoned fish in a white tortilla. I also ordered a cafe con leche and that was very boring as well. My boyfriend said his Cuban sandwich was okay. We came here because Las Palmas was closed for the holiday. I don't think we will come back again. Lots of better options in the Tampa area.

place_category: German, Restaurants, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, French, Brasseries, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Service can be spotty - Don't let them out you in the back- the whole point of a bistro is to have a bistro experience. great Happy Hour- and French 75s

place_category: Breweries, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: As with many establishments in Boise the food appears to come off the same sysco truck. Not bad just relatively uninspired. I understand why. It seems like any restaurant that try's to offer food that's above the level is doomed to fail. Yasmin, Erin and lee do a great job waiting tables and make it worth the visit. Super friendly , nice people. If the rating was based on them it would be 5 stars! Nice location. Seating indoors and out make it nice wether it's hot or cold.

place_category: Golf, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Active Life
text: I am just learning the game and couldn't believe how many balls I lost today. If you didn't hit it on the fairway, good luck finding your ball in the grass and clover. The back nine seemed much better. Very disappointed.

place_category: Bars, Food, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Seafood, Sports Bars
text: If there is a negative marking and negative stars it deserves the max number that a system can generate.Worst Worst Worst Service and the guy at the bar counter is rude and may be deaf to take the order. We have ordered for a Veggie burger but in return we got a different meat burger. And it took 30Min to get the wrong order or burger...........

place_category: Caterers, Venues & Event Spaces, Breakfast & Brunch, Gastropubs, American (New), Restaurants, Food, Event Planning & Services, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: They did a nice job renovating the building. The food is just ok.....over priced. I'm sorry because we were looking forward to having a nice new dining spot in the Marigny. Perhaps, since this is a new business they will work on the quality of the food and rethink their pricing

place_category: Burgers, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Food, Nightlife, Dive Bars, Restaurants
text: The space is small but quaint and comfortable. Most spaces in New Orleans are smallish. I ordered the Whitman roast beef and it was delicious.

place_category: Hot Dogs, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Bars, Food Stands, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Omg! This place is horrible. Service was horrendous waited almost an hour until I got up and canceled my order. I normally don't post but this experience was so bad. Never, ever going to this place again.. Probably going to be close in a couple a month because of the horrible service and ok food.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Chocolatiers & Shops, Specialty Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants
text: I showed up at 7:45am (they open at 7) and they were just getting food into the oven. They had a few day old cookies and that was it. If you open at 7, food should be ready by 7! I asked the woman who worked there when food would be ready and she couldn't tell me. If was so disappointing!

place_category: Polish, Restaurants, American (New)
text: This place serves delicious, authentic Polish food. If you're in the mood for a place with excellent customer service and hearty comfort food, this is your place!

place_category: Bubble Tea, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food
text: The worst experience ever messed up on my drink 3 times, honey dew milk tea with boba just tasted like water with boba. Regular milk tea tastes like water as well, asked for boba came with lychee instead. Got another drink gave me the wrong size they fixed it but still tasted like water. I don't know if they forgot how to do it or what, but it was terrible.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Patisserie/Cake Shop, Hot Dogs, Donuts
text: We've been going here for years. These are the best donuts in the valley. They are so fresh and tasty. They even have kolaches!

place_category: Mexican, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars
text: Food was average. The fajitas were good. Happy hour is a good deal. Service is slow. Servers are not very experienced. They left dirty dishes on the table.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Food, Sandwiches
text: One's experience early in the morning must be very different than mine at 11:45. This strip mall café was "sold out" of pastries when I arrived. I had a choice of 1 almond pastry, 3 chocolate filled croissants or some muffins. This does not a bakery make. They were all priced at about $3.65, very high for individual pastries, in my experience. I was not greeted, nor offered a menu. I looked at the blank pedestals, the prices and no offer to help.....and decided to eat elsewhere.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Seafood, Bars, Steakhouses, Nightlife
text: I am consistently impressed with Fleming's from the quality of the food, to the wine list, to the service. Had Robert as a waiter last night and he went out of his way to interact with my young child & make sure she was having a great time while I enjoyed my meal. Thanks for another great experience Fleming's!

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Seafood
text: Signature sirloin wedge salad...yum. Good food, good service. Always friendly and welcoming.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Delis, Sandwiches, American (New), Restaurants, Bakeries
text: The outside dining was really, really nice. It was right next to an art museum, which was convenient since we could just go there after viewing the art. The service took a while, but the lowest point, I think, was the freaking WATER. It tasted like drinking vinegar infused with urine and salt. Ugh. Anyways, after a few minutes, we got our food. Turns out they actually cooked it. I got the Cafe Burger, and I don't regret it at all. ;)

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Food, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Breweries, Bars, Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces, Pubs, Brewpubs
text: first stop in NO- we all got gumbo and apps: alligator, the seafood cheesecake, meat pies, boudin balls- flavors were outstanding. Beer sampler was a good time- nice variety. Service was great- the girl from MI was fantastic.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Fast Food, Chinese, Gluten-Free, Restaurants
text: Pei Wei is essentially the medium between fast Asian and sit down--the food is decent but you still seat yourself. However, realize that if you just look a little around Tucson you can find some solid, authentic Chinese/Japanese food in a lot of other places. Pei Wei won't disappoint, but it certainly won't impress.

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Seafood, Bars
text: This place is great for lunches and drinks. Their dinnersWere very small portions and very expensive for what you received. I will visit during lunchtime only in for drinks later in the evening but not worth a dinner.

place_category: Restaurants, Soup, American (New), Seafood, Salad, Italian
text: Excellent grilled ceasar salad. Cheesesteak wrap outstanding! Fresh fries and even the grandson liked his homemade pizza they came up with for him. Service was laid back so be ready to take your time. I can't wait to go back for dinner!

place_category: Home & Garden, Home Decor, Restaurants, Shopping, Indian
text: Food was tasty. Portions could be bigger. Decor is interesting. Service was good but for some reason it took quite awhile for dinner to arrive at the table. Went there with a party of 7 on a Sunday night.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New)
text: My husband and I had a great dinner at the Rose Tree Inn. Living in the area my entire life, surprisingly this was my first time to the Rose Tree Inn. Our server, Paige was fantastic; so attentive, friendly and fun. The manager even stopped by our table just to check in and welcome us. My husband had a great steak and the salmon I ordered was very good. Both entrees were cooked perfectly and the portion sizes were substantial.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, American (New), Southern, Restaurants
text: We started of with the stuffed chicken wings which were delicious! Followed by the drum and the duck. Fish was awesome, duck a little dry! Food was delicious!! A bit disappointed as the "f" bomb word was dropped twice as one chef walked out and the other replaced him! Really? In front of us! Really? At least we know it really happens. Well worth the drama!

place_category: Bagels, Delis, Restaurants, Food
text: Disappointingly subpar bagels. The everything bagel I ordered was small and didn't have much of anything on it. The bagel itself was tough and a bit stale, even though I went early in the morning. There was a severe dearth of cream cheese. I'm hoping I just got a bad bagel and I will be giving this place another shot.

place_category: Sandwiches, Food, Gas Stations, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Automotive, Convenience Stores
text: It looks like Wawa has learned after these few years, and the corporation has decided to close this location at 11:00 p.m. every night. On-Duty uniformed police officers are there to guard the doors, and escort the crazies and homeless and gangsters and drug dealers out at 11:00 p.m. prompt. Bravo.

place_category: Donuts, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food
text: This is the worst most disgusting Dunkin' Donuts I been too they take long when there's nobody on line they don't get your order right they don't want or know how to make any of the baskin' Robbins drinks everytime I come they tell me the blender Is down some of the staff is rude . I'll rather take the extra drive to gulf bay smh

place_category: Bagels, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Cute little place, staff member that helped me was not very happy and a little rude. They were out of a lot of what we tried to order (by 10 am). I ordered an everything bagel toasted with plain cream cheese. I was given an untoasted blueberry bagel with a long hair (which I found a few bites in). Pretty disgusted and won't be going back.

place_category: Lounges, Restaurants, Mexican, Nightlife, Bars, Tex-Mex
text: Not good. Disorganized. Meat tasted a little old, like it sat out perhaps.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Vegetarian, American (New)
text: This place is great if your a hipster. It felt more like a sandwich shop in Denver. The food was good and fresh but definitely not New Orleans. I had the shrimp po boy which came with grilled shrimp. It's a small place so there's not a lot of room to sit.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Food, Ethnic Food, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian, Specialty Food, Israeli, Restaurants
text: I can no longer be bothered by a place that will not return phone calls or mail. I have eaten there and it's good. But when you treat your customers like dirt you may not be the "greatest" anymore. And where will the people you were so rude to be then? Not begging you to come back! Try to be a HOST/ not a jerk!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: A friend and I met here for lunch. I had the chicken quesadilla. It was great, I'm not a big eater so it was just the right size for me.

place_name: Bacon Me Crazy Cafe and Market
place_category: Shopping, Meat Shops, Food, Cafes, American (Traditional), Specialty Food, Flea Markets, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Had a good brunch visit here at about 11 am. Not too crowded and we got a seat right away. Service was great. We could tell they were working as a team because different servers offered to help us out. Food was good! Tex mex omelette hit the spot. We tried a side of bacon and it was good. I was expecting more though. That being said, I must be fair. I did not opt for the bacon sampler. Leaves more to be desired for next time. Would return in the future for sure.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Steakhouses, Greek, Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Southern, American (Traditional)
text: A definite go to for anyone in the area. The food is amazing and the ambiance is great- always happening. Love coming here and seeing what's new...

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: I will not argue that the sushi here is good, but it is really expensive in comparison to other sushi bars and japanese restaurants. Also, the only option for parking is on the street. It is a good place to go though if you want some of the best sushi and town and pay quite a bit for it at the same time. There are, however, better options, that cost less.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Been here 3 or 4 times. This is a great place to hangout for a coffee or to sit down and eat. Great food and very nice selection to choose from. Very cool layout and decorating, creates a very nice ambiance. Better than going to Starbucks because the coffee and food selection is better, plus less hipsters. Very clean inside and great location. Employees are very friendly and helpful. Highly recommend for breakfast or brunch.

place_category: Teppanyaki, Italian, Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: I do not understand why this was well rated. The food is mediocre. The beef teriyaki wasn't even teriyaki. It was beef cooked separately, and then placed in a watery brown sauce that had some sugar to it (and that was supposed to be the teriyaki sauce). I ordered takeout, and I was severely disappointed. I love food, but this was not worth it. I do not recommend this place.

place_category: Active Life, Beer Gardens, Grocery, Middle Eastern, Specialty Food, American (New), Parks, Cafes, Food, Nightlife, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Lebanese
text: Beautiful place, service was fantastic and the food was great. 5 stars is tough to give, wish I could give it 4.5-4.75. Will bump up to 5 if I experience it again, because consistency is important.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese, Korean
text: Worst service but forced 15% even for take out orders. Don't want to go back ever, just not worth it.

place_category: Food, Grocery, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Anita's red salsa - spiciest salsa I've ever eaten. Bright red and tons of seeds and some added dragon fire.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Service is incredibly slow and waitresses were indifferent to our presence. Got the Popeye salad. Avacado was missing, vinaigrette was watery and the crab was scarce. Also the tables were really dirty. Would not recommend.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Event Planning & Services, Party & Event Planning, Bars, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces
text: I have experienced the worst service in this restaurant today. My server Lester was not friendly he was not attentive. Once me and my colleagues received our food we never seen him again until it was time give the bill. I had to grab other waiters to help out and the management staff was no where to be found. I just don't see how you guys allow someone like him to be the face of your restaurant. Thanks but no thanks.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Bagels, Breakfast & Brunch, Food
text: I'm done with this place. Love the chain but hate them in Philly. Just tried calling to pickup and said goodbye because of the rude person on the phone. I know it was the manager because I recognized her voice. I've been there enough times to memorize her voice. No more though. Compared to any Beueggers in Rochester, for example, this place is horrid in food and service quality. So I'm done forever at any Philadelphia Brueggers. For this area Manhattan bagel is better anyway.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Greek, Restaurants
text: Decent meal. The cashier (middle aged man) needs to either focus on answering the phone or his customer waiting to order. He answered the phone twice while taking my order, took my card, gave card back and didn't swipe it, then couldn't remember if he charged me and couldn't remember what I'd ordered. Poor people skills. Won't be rushing back for breakfast any time soon.

place_category: Sandwiches, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Salad, American (New), Breweries, Bars, Food, Gastropubs, Pubs
text: Horrible service 15 minutes at the bar and both bartenders won't make eye contact. Asked for menus and bartender later came and picked them up without even asking if we would like to order.

place_category: Cafes, Modern European, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Sandwiches, Soup, Salad
text: Excellent food! Awesome ambience and owners are super nice!! Truly a hidden gem! I had the beef bourguignon which was excellent! Cappuccino was legit also. Small inside seating (10 tables or so) had an awesome European vibe and was comfortable. I highly recommend.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Really bad service, food was ok like every other Mexican restaurant around. Didn't have a Mexican feel, more of a greasy spoon feel. Got the supreme burrito and it was literally 4 bites worth. Was told we had chips coming but never came. Told the waitress when she finally came by,I was done (my plate was empty) she told me she would get it later and left to talk to another table, crazy. So many other real Mexican restaurants close by, so don't bother with this one.

place_category: Mediterranean, Restaurants
text: Over all nice looking place but does show some age. For the price of the food VS the flavors, quality and portion size I just don't see the justification. I definitly would not go out of my way for the place. If I was close buy and I was hankering for Mediterranean food, I might stop in and give them another try.

place_category: Restaurants, Grocery, Ethnic Food, Event Planning & Services, Convenience Stores, Specialty Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Asian Fusion, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Filipino, Imported Food, Caterers
text: Made a quick stop in just because I had to check out the only Filipino restaurant in NOLA! Wish we were hungry bc I would have ordered more food! Judging by Chef Cris' hospitality and lumpia, and very homey feel of the restaurant, I know everything else on the menu will be just as good as the lumpia. Will have to try the sisig and crispy pats next time we're in town!

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Pubs, American (Traditional)
text: Impressive food and beer menu and love the decor. The Cajun seasoned fries are great w beer . Crowd may be older but the atmosphere is chill

place_category: Nightlife, Tex-Mex, Bars, Tacos, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Their margaritas are incredible. I'm a big fruity drink gal so their margarita flight really won me over. I got- white peach, strawberry, and mango. All so yummy, but white peach won me over. Also tried their Lucy's fire taco... and wow. So good. Don't plan on eating more than two tacos, they are super filling, I barely finished one.

place_category: Restaurants, Bagels, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bubble Tea, Donuts
text: Couldn't say enough good things about this place! The ladies here are wonderful group and kept us MEATHEAD MOVERS fed well for our big job today! Thank you all for the bagels and doughnuts!!!!

place_category: Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Nightlife, Food, Sports Bars
text: I love love love wings. The service was excellent. We arrived there very early so there was no crowd. The wings are amazing. They are all evenly cooked and they are a nice size. Very clean. Not too noisy.

place_category: Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants, Dive Bars, Bars
text: Stopped in on a Tuesday night and the place was empty. Stayed anyway because the staff was extremely nice. Had three tex-mex tacos (beef, roasted chicken and shredded chicken) with rice. Meal was decent enough. Tuesdays and Thursdays they have a margarita special. Ordered one and it was good. Overall the place is clean, the staff is friendly and the food is ok.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Comfort Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Overrated poboy that's my opinion. Good drinks though! Great place to go hang and chat with friends.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants
text: The plus side: cool location, looks great. The meh: food was acceptable but not exceptional. The lamb vindaloo - normally as spicy as lava - was so tame that I thought it was just tomato sauce. Portions are a bit small. The downside : pushy wait staff and the courtyard area get very loud and it's hard to hold a conversation.

place_category: Bars, Italian, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Beer Bar, American (New), Pizza
text: Ate at the bar. Bartenders always nice. This was not the 1st time that I asked for hot vegetables with a mushroom swiss burger. It was all just warm Mushrooms were hardly cooked. Swiss was half melted in a blob on burger. Not as good as a year ago. Last time I was there, a server at the bar opened a jar of olives, took 1 put with her fingers, ate it, and put the lid back on. Managers need to be positioned around to talk to customer's and watch what us going on.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: In town, staying next door at the Drury. Ordered for pickup, it was ready by the time I walked across the parking lot. Fried Dumplings were good. Veggie fried rice was okay - some broccoli and pea pods, but pretty average. I wouldn't drive across town for this, but it was convenient.

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: Poor service. Order was wrong and took forever to get the correct order. No apology and then had to wait for the check. This is not the first time we've had bad service here. We won't be back.

place_category: American (Traditional), Diners, Restaurants, Salad
text: Food is definitely delicious and I would definitely be interested in coming back to eat lunch or dinner here. Very reasonable prices and just from what I had the food is fresh not frozen like so many other places. My fiancee and I both enjoyed our time here and thoroughly enjoyed the food and conversation.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Desserts, Bubble Tea, Food
text: These 3 star people are crazy! Best ice cream I've had since my grandma was alive! Will certainly be back!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: This was an outstanding restaurant. Idk what happened but it's terrible. Shrimp taste terrible, chicken over cooked and dry. Used to be our go to but last 2 visits have been terrible and inedible. Will not be back. Sad to see it fail so terribly.

place_category: Burgers, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Pubs
text: Went here to lunch with 2 co-workers. Right when I first walked in it smelled like bleach/incense. It is kind of dingy, but I guess because it is a bar/grill. We all got burgers. My burger was perfectly medium cooked, juicy and a great size. Not sure if I'd go back.

place_category: Delis, Food, Restaurants
text: I grew up in the Wenonah area so I've seen this corner location go through many changes over the years. Great to see a business here. That being said I tried their cheesesteak with fried onions to go. Overall taste was ok. Kinda mushy. Roll was good. I'll be back to try some more things.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Lounges, Bars, Nightlife, Sushi Bars
text: This was the best Mexican food I've ever had! We discovered this place today and it is going to be the place to go to whenever we come to Reno!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Mexican, Restaurants, Food, Food Trucks, Food Stands, Latin American, Venezuelan
text: They were at the latest Starlight Racing event at the Fairgrounds. They need more help at big events. Many people including myself complained about the time it took to get your food. I got the pork tacos and they were dry and hot with pepper and not much taste after that. In fact one of the worst tacos I have ever had. Must have been because of the large crowd which it appeared they were not prepared for. $8 tacos better be good and these were not even close.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, American (Traditional)
text: The shakes were very good. Overall, I would say the food may be on the same level with chick-fil-a, but a higher price

place_category: Food, Grocery, Drugstores, Shopping
text: Several staff members had their masks on improperly (just covering their mouth, not nose). I understand masks can be hot, uncomfortable, etc., but it's the law to wear them covering both your mouth and nose. I will not shop there again during this pandemic for my own safety.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Seafood
text: Food is good but even when requested spicy it really wasn't. The bubble tea is like a frozen slushie and juice balls not tapioca balls.

place_category: Restaurants, Vegetarian, Food, American (New), Burgers
text: Elevation Burger is tasty and better all around than basic fast food joints. It has wonderful shakes and juicy burgers and thin, fresh, handmade fries. But there's also that higher price tag that makes it difficult to justify going when I could go to a restaurant and probably leave with leftovers. I go here once in a while when I feel that craving for McD's. I'd say it's worth trying.

text: To the sole fact that the hours are wrong on here like update that shit........................................

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Barbeque, Caribbean, Seafood
text: Awful is the only word for this place. I decided to go here because the parking lot is always full. Maybe it's the staff's cars. My burger meat tasted off as in rotten undertones to it. My buddy's food was not rotten but was too offensive to eat.

place_category: Food, Grocery, Delis, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Let me just say how amazing Pauline from the bakery/Deli is!! She went above and beyond for my mother I, I have NEVER experienced such amazing customer service!!! Thank you Pauline you are amazing!!!

place_category: Soul Food, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Southern
text: For this to be a 'famous nashville hot chicken' place, the chicken wasn't that great. Kind of disappointing. The fried whiting sandwich I had made up a little for it though. Super big serving of whiting with mustard and onions - add cheese! That day,they were out of leg quarters and catfish... what I wanted to order so that was disappointing. heavy with the salt where they shouldn't be, stingy where they needed some.

place_category: Salad, Wraps, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Thai wrap with white meat and brown rice is my go to meal here. I probably order it 99% of the time I visit which is about 2 times a month. I'm not sure what happened today. It appears there was a shortage of brown rice and chicken because my wrap had barely any in it. I took my order to-go, otherwise I probably would have brought it to their attention. If I wanted a salad...which is primarily what this wrap turned into, I would have gone next door to Bread Co. Sort of disappointing.

place_category: Sandwiches, Bakeries, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Bagels, Food, Soup
text: I've been to Panera almost every day in Houston after the storm. The employees are just trying to do the best the can with what they have available.

place_category: Sandwiches, Soup, Cheesesteaks, Event Planning & Services, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Caterers
text: Loved eating here! A lot of food for a good price and good quality! They also have La Columbe coffee which was a huge plus. My boyfriend and I sat at the "bar" and you could watch them cook and interact with the staff. It felt like being at home talking at the breakfast table with friends and family. Didn't have a single issue, definitely going back!

place_category: Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Salad, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Had lunch that this cute place today. The menu was very limited with a few weird sandwiches on it and spaghetti special and a few egg dishes. I don't eat eggs and was really craving a good salad which there was none of one the menu. Lots of pastry. For lunch? The spaghetti as good and nicely served in a timely manner. Wait person was friendly. The place was not crowded so the service should be nothing but good. I think this is a breakfast restaurant and may go back for a carb loaded meal.

place_category: American (Traditional), Barbeque, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Service wasn't good, wait time wasn't bad but it seemed like our food had been just sitting up in the window because it was so cold. My steak seemed really raw for medium rare. Got no butter with my now tiny rolls. Was really sad paying 40$ for mediocre food. Friends sides came in a styrofoam bowl. Not planning on returning. Sad thing is that it used to be so good. :(

place_category: Street Vendors, Food, Restaurants, Pizza, Food Trucks, Italian
text: This is probably the best pizza on wheels -- EVER. A while back they stopped up in Fishtown by the Circle of Hope. It was a First Friday and they had a line of folks waiting. The smell of the wood oven brings you right over reading the menu of ingredients - You're SOLD. It was worth every penny and the wait. I wish they'd come back my way more often... [hint hint]

place_category: Sandwiches, Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: Came here due some of the great reviews. Sat ourselves and waited for 15 minutes. No one brought menus, no one spoke to us whatsoever. It was not that busy, we decided to give them a few more minutes. Still not one person came to obtain drink orders or anything. I had to get up and get menus for my party. People sat next to us and was waited on immediately. Waitress didn't even acknowledge my husband and I. After a total wait of 23 minutes, we walked out. Will never go and visit again.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Barbeque, Caribbean, Seafood
text: The restaurant is spacious in and out, decor is good, server is friendly but the food that I ordered is so-so. I had the onion crusted salmon and I wouldn't recommend it. The onion overpowered the salmon, which is also lacking flavor. I had to use salt, pepper and hot sauce just to enhance the already delicate salmon. Anyway, my husband liked the hogfish sandwich and I may have to order it next time...yes, we want to give it another try and update the review.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: This place used to be the apple of my eye. Then people from LA started making up the core. Not that I have anything against THEM, but the place has started to turn into a blander, less spicier place, as if to cater to their newer customer base. Then with the film fest in town it seems the place was loaded with this rude jerks last time I went. I need a Chorizo every once and awhile, ,but they need to remember who brought them to the dance.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Skip this restaurant. The Caesar salad had little flavor and the ravioli that I had as an entree was pre bought and were flavorless as well. Go to trattoria Vitoria instead.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), Arts & Entertainment, Event Planning & Services, Southern, Venues & Event Spaces
text: Amazingly decadent food. I know this sounds crazy but the bologna sandwich is to die for. The chef has it custom made from his own recipe and has nothing to do with Oscar Meyer. The tater tots are crazy good. And anything with the smoked chicken is super good. And the love music is phenomenal. My biggest criticism is that there is no NY location.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Food
text: Luckily ran into this place while driving through town. We were so glad to! The bibimbap bowl was so good! My daughter had their crazy roll and she finished the entire thing. Definitely recommend if you like Korean food!

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Good food and good service. Can't give any extra stars for the food delivery. Food took over 45 minutes to deliver. Troy was a great server but WOW; the food was SLOW...... we ordered the shrimp quesadilla pizza and cheese quesadillas. Also the Mahi tuna salad. Awesome food awesome service terrible delivery in time relative to food. I'm not sure if we will be back

place_category: Bars, Chicken Wings, Sports Bars, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: Really disappointing. For a place that calls itself a wing house the quality of the wings was mediocre and the selection of flavors was very limited and quite frankly not very good.. I was assuming this place would be at least as good as Buffalo Wild Wings....but it was not even close. On the plus side service was quick and friendly but it wasn't that busy. I don't plan on going back.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: When we drop our son off at college in town, we always visit this place. Food, ambience and value are excellent. Our fabulous server Ben (who we seem to get every time) is the best. Efficient, friendly and knowledgeable. Would highly recommend this restaurant.

place_category: Nightlife, Sports Bars, Bars, American (Traditional), Pizza, Restaurants
text: This location is the weakest of the Bully's franchises. I swear the food isn't as good as the others and the wait staff is not as good and friendly. They spend most of the time grouped by the soda fountain discussing god knows what. All the while your soda remains empty.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Breweries, Burgers, Sports Bars, Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: Realize you are busy but maybe schedule more than one bar tender per bar. You are already getting your but kicked, I can only imagine if the Cards game was not called off!

place_category: Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food
text: It doesn't matter when you go or how busy they are, the service is always slow and they always mess up order. Ordered 2 mcdoubles without pickles, and or course after waiting 15 minutes @ midnight both burgers had pickles. Will be calling to complain tmr!!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Our favorite pizza place in Conshy! unbelievable deal, $9 for a large personal size pizza with unlimited toppings....and I'm not just talking normal toppings, theirs are out of this world (homemade mozz and whole milk ricotta, hot chili oil, fresh veggies, spicy tomato sauce, I could go on and on...)

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: ive been to both Geno's and Pats... i think Geno's food is okay but the d-bag meter is off the charts as far as the "English Only" sign at the window and the huge hummer parked nearby..its a tourist trap plain and simple and the prices reflect it. i prefer Pats...you get your sandwich and you get no overblown BS.

place_category: Delis, Restaurants, Bakeries, Event Planning & Services, Desserts, Grocery, Food, Caterers
text: This store is not on taylorsville road but rather washington crossing road. Years ago it was a cumberland farms. Now with a new name many positive changes have taken place. Now it is bright and appealing inside and many new items while still offering the old favorites. However as far as I know they never prepared food rather offered pre packaged items. And I have been coming here since 1975. Nice spot.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Cute little place. The service was good, food was fresh and tasty. They had lots of seafood choices. I had the shrimp tacos. I would come back and eat here again when I'm in Boise.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Italian, American (Traditional), Pizza
text: This is the type of pizza I like - thin and crispy. The pizza was good. We had the one with eggplant. I think the sausage might have been a better choice. The salad was fresh and crisp - and there was plenty. I tried their wings which are cooked in the coal oven. They were interesting. Not a cheap pizza dinner but worth trying. I don't think pizza places with large screen TV and no draft beer deserve more than 3 stars.

place_category: Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Soup, Specialty Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Fruits & Veggies, Acai Bowls, Restaurants
text: One of the best places in Newtown always friendly and delicious. I saw some reviews complaining of the price but you get what you pay for. It's delicious and fresh, if you want a cheap $4 smoothie it will taste like a $4 smoothie. I highly recommend the Tropical Dream & Cha Cha Chocolate Banana if you need something sweet!

place_category: Convenience Stores, Pharmacy, Health & Medical, Drugstores, Food, Shopping
text: Do not use this minute clinic. I went to this clinic in 2016 and my federal blue cross blue shied covered the visit in full. I went in 2019, when I made the appointment I gave my insurance information. I am now being billed for the visit because this clinic is no longer a preferred provider on my plan. I should have been told of this change up front as they knew what type of insurance I had.

place_category: Local Services, Food, Coffee & Tea, Community Service/Non-Profit
text: Great coffee, except when I ordered a second pour over they were suddenly "all out". I ordered the eden bowl for lunch and it was affordable, healthy, and filling. The bathrooms were absolutely filthy which was a real bummer.

place_category: Burgers, Fast Food, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Every aspect of our visit was bad (except the fries - they were good). Our order was taken by Sal. He was rude, arrogant, and condescending. Our burgers were dry and flavorless. We couldn't even enjoy one another's company because the music was so horribly loud.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood, Burgers, Tacos, Sandwiches, Mexican, Bars, Food, Beer Bar, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Nightlife
text: We come back again and again. Our favorite place to go after a nice beach day on Santa klaus lane. They have a plethora of vegan/vegetarian options which is always extremely appreciated. I think the menu overall has great variety. Portions are big and the seating is relaxed and family oriented. Sometimes the line to order can be long but they try to keep it moving along. Our only wish was all the tables had umbrellas. We are always eyeing to get an umbrella table out front. We'll be back!

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Salvadoran, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, Tacos
text: I came here for the tamales, which are very much tasty. The chicken and jalapeno tamales the meat inside is not dry like others that I have tried.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Desserts, Middle Eastern, Asian Fusion, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Food
text: If a place is bold enough to put a dish on their menu that most folks make at home, then it better be amazing. So Thought I would try the spaghetti bolognese. If the pasta was made in house, then I am Julia Child. The sauce was very bland. Good Service, but one and done.

place_category: Restaurants, Specialty Food, Grocery, Fast Food, Coffee & Tea, Food, Health Markets, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Its my go to store. I'm on this diet and its easier when the store you buy the product from can cut and cook it for you. They also use healthy seasoning and oil. I can't have much on this diet but WholeFoods helps with that.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners
text: Stopped by here on our way to DC. Very friendly server. The fries here so fresh crispy and hot. The eggplant parm was good and the portion size was hearty. Would definitely recommend for all stop on your way.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: Holy dive bar!! Filled with young drunk people and super smokey, but it is a bar ladies. Dart boards a plus and good strong drinks. Bathrooms are a hot mess as expected. Bartenders super friendly and attentive. Huge patio, a big plus for fall nights, but like I said before cigarette city.. If your looking for somewhere to have a drink where nobody cares what your doing or how you look this is the spot.. Great end your night hammered spot. Lol. Would definitely go back..

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Diners
text: Everytime I go to st louis I have to Stop by this fine restaurant the food Is served in huge amounts the pancakes Fill up the entire plate the 1st time I went The server was awesomeness the 2nd time I went she was getting ready to leave so I had A new server

place_category: Restaurants, Korean, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Donuts, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: I'm a fan because the donuts are just exquisite - I can still remember the lavender and cinnamon flavors. The coffee is good too. We didn't try the chicken, but I'd like to go back for that. The only downside - its so tiny that you have wait, and also I found the some of the staff a bit too preoccupied in their own conversation.

place_category: Salad, Desserts, Restaurants, Food, American (Traditional), Seafood, American (New)
text: way to big of a menu which makes turning tables a HUGE problem. The cheesecake of course is to die for but some of the dishes they have make me wonder what were they thinking

place_category: Restaurants, Delis, Sandwiches, Food Delivery Services, Fast Food, Food
text: Jimmy Johns is always a good go to for lunch if you're looking for a quick fix. Sandwiches are all good. Best part is the roll they use to make the sandwiches. Super fast and very friendly. They deliver too. Would recommend for a quick sandwich if you're in a time crunch.

place_category: Restaurants, Halal, American (Traditional), Bakeries, Food, Soul Food
text: Meh. The folks at the register aren't the most friendly. Food was good but if I ask/pay for cheese, I expect that. I was clear on no tomatoes and guess what? Tomatoes. Thankfully I am not allergic. They also forgot a part of my order. It's like they weren't paying attention. My daughter was pleased with her order.

place_category: Salad, Soup, Italian, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Nightlife, Bars
text: Poor excuse for management. Utterly disgusted. Terrible experience. Staff stole from me and management couldn't have cared less. BTW, kitchen was absolutely disgusting! Wrote to corporate. Nobody cared. Will never give them or their other restaurants my business.

place_category: Restaurants, Cuban, Chicken Wings, Latin American
text: Sometimes you get everything right but what matters most... It looks like this place is an more upscale version of PT. And they nailed just about everything but the taste. The presentation is great. The service is great. The place is spotless. But the food is bland and tasteless. You would be shocked by how pretty it looks. Everything looks wonderful but completely underwhelming, including the sauce, once you bite into it.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Latin American, Mexican
text: They do not know customer service. I'd just gotten dental work and I specifically asked for soft shell tacos. I get home and they are fried so hard. I called them to tell them about the mistake and he said I don't know and hung up in my face . Very unprofessional

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Nightlife, Southern, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza
text: Sat at the bar. Staff friendly and the food was great. Loved the meatball pizza and great selection of liquor.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Seafood, Steakhouses
text: Took me a bit to find this hidden gem but so glad I did. We ordered a ribeye and blackened grouper. Both were delicious. We had to get it to go as we were visiting the area during the COVID-19 pandemic. We were so appreciative that the restaurant was open and the chef so talented.

place_category: Street Vendors, Food Trucks, Mexican, Restaurants, Food Stands, Food
text: This truck travels around - follow on twitter to find out where they are. I believe they offer either steak or pork tacos. The first time I had them it was in Broad Ripple at 2 AM after leaving the bars, and I thought they were amazing. Eventually a few sober tastings revealed them for what they are - decent tacos at a decent price ($5 for three). if you find the truck near you'd I'd give them a shot. But I wouldn't make a trip or anything.

place_category: Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food, Caterers, Delis, Grocery
text: Omg! I can't even to begin to explain how Amazing this place it is! The staff is awesome and very helpful! This is the go to sandwich shop for me! The butchers serve only the best product!

place_name: M.L.Rose Craft Beer & Burgers - Sylvan Park
place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Bars, Beer Bar, Nightlife, Pubs
text: Loved the sweet potato waffle fries topped with pork!!! Yum yum!! Very decent Bloody Mary:) The night owl burger was quite good as well. Skip the jalapeño slaw it is unremarkable. Service was quick and friendly. Good spot if you are on that side of town!

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars
text: Its another Buffalo Wild Wings branch. Food is the same, wings ands fries. However, this branxh always run out of the seasobal or limited sauces. And you end up getting the regular sauces. I've never had the chance to dine-in. If you like greese food, then this is the place !

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Hookah Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Mediterranean, Greek, Middle Eastern
text: Downtown Indianapolis finally has a Middle Eastern restaurant. Ali Baba is in the old Tea Cozy space. I went on their opening day for lunch, and the lunch deals here are pretty good. I got half a beef schwarma (you can substitute a gyro) sandwich and a Greek salad (you can substitute fries) for about $7. Next time I go, I'm going to try their spicy gyro. place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Tacos, Mexican, Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Fast Food

However, $2 for a medium drink, chips, and Gordita supreme is rather appealing to someone poor and self loathing like me.

place_category: American (New), Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: This place is never a disappointment. Typically very good service, excellent food and drinks. Very customer service oriented, managers have always greeted our table to ensure everything meets up to standards. The ambiance is just as lovely ...the place is always very clean including their restrooms. Price wise I thinks it's fair.. Not too expensive and definitely not cheap.

place_category: Delis, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: I did not really enjoy the Breakfast Burrito. The place was clean and the staff was nice. Just was not blown away

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Really good food!! So I was going to order the veggie omelet with potatoes and toast. The chef must have read my mind and brought out the veggie omelet for free. Delicious!! So I ordered potatoes and a waffle, both were good even though I needed the potatoes to be fried hard, they did and they were great. My SO ordered the bananas foster French toast and is still trying to duplicate the taste, to no avail. Guess we have to go back!

place_category: Seafood, Nightlife, Restaurants, Comfort Food, Bars, American (New), Sports Bars
text: Just all around disappointing. The first time I ate here shortly after they first opened I had an awesome dining experience. Great service and great food. place_category: Food, Korean, Restaurants

place_category: Cafes, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: 2.5. To be fair, the chicken pesto protein bowl was really good (although, it could use a little more chicken and be dropped a 1$ in price). Now I've been to firstwatch before and am usually pretty satisfied. But after this experience, I probably won't be going back.

place_category: German, Restaurants, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, French, Brasseries, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Luke is in the Hilton New Orleans. It was late, raining, so stopped in for dinner. I was impressed by the number of people that came in that weren't staying at the hotel. The service was good, food was okay - but not particularly special. Breakfast was better than dinner.

place_category: Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Salad, Sandwiches
text: I eat out a lot being a truck driver. I try to hit all the BBQ places I see. I really enjoy good BBQ! And Whole hog does it right! The brisket is my favorite it is smoked perfect! I think it's the best around even better then Sweet Lucy's! The ribs are awesome too! The cornbread is one of the best I ever ate! But don't take my word for it, give it a try!

place_category: Restaurants, Caribbean
text: Was traveling though Tampa for work and decided to hit this well reviewed restaurant with some coworkers. Ordered the Curry Chicken and it was excellent but far too much food (I don't consider that to be a bad thing). Service was exceptionally friendly and the person serving us told us that he owns the restaurant with his wife who is the chef. Great spot!

place_category: Bakeries, American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Food, Desserts, Cafes
text: I DON'T GET IT. I don't understand the long lines, over-priced coffee, pretentious employees or any of it. My husband and I attempted to get coffee...COFFEE. We walked across the road to Provence where there was a shorter line, laid back space, DELICIOUS coffee and yummy food.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Bakeries, Indian

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Wine Bars, Restaurants

place_category: Thai, Chinese, Seafood, Restaurants
text: I have heard so many great things about The Smiling Elephant, but left a little disappointed. First of all, I didn't expect such a long wait on a weeknight. place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Chicken Shop
text: BUYER BEWARE!!! This is a Bojangle's disguised as a Chick-Fil-A!!! Do not expect the standard Chick-Fil-A service... get your chick nuggets, fries and Polynesian sauce AND GO before your day is ruined. It's not a great day at this Chick- Fil- A EVER!

place_category: American (Traditional), Seafood, Restaurants

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Pizza, Restaurants
text: I've been coming to the Irish Mile since January 2013, solely for a Kilkenny. It's my favorite beer that I hadn't had for over 12 years since being stationed in Northern Japan. Today, I am here for a Kilkenny and their $1.00 lunch sandwiches. Horrible tasting roast beef with a side of small flies. Yes, flies as in plural for a FLY. Three of them flew off my sandwich once it was delivered. Fly infestation. Well, I am only coming for the Kilkenny. If you like a quieter scene, then come before 4pm.

place_category: Local Flavor, Food, Caterers, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Gluten-Free, Bakeries
text: Got the sandwich with turkey, brie, apples, and honey mustard on gluten-free bread. Bread was okay, but a little dry. The turkey slices were huge, which made the whole sandwich hard to eat. But tasted good. Cute place. Would come here again.

place_category: Food, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Caterers, Smokehouse, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Great bbq. I had a half rack of ribs. Yum. They have four bbq sauces. I liked the sweet sauce, but the Pineapple Express was my favorite. The bbq beans were great with a little heat. The coleslaw (I tried my husbands) and potato salad were both great. My husband had the burnt ends and really enjoyed them. I don't think you can go wrong. The service was great and they were helpful and friendly.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Salad, American (New), Modern European
text: Adorable ambiance, but food was extremely salty. Once you get over the salt, it was pretty good. Fries were limp and soggy, but the aioli they came with was delicious. Happy hour makes it much more affordable, but even only ordering from happy hour, spent about $40. I had the mushroom ragout, deviled eggs, fries, mint watermelon martini, and white sangria.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Burgers, Local Flavor, Salad
text: 45 minute wait in line on a Thursday night just to order a Classic burger. They need to speed up the line by chatting with patrons less. A tiny 2 oz burger and an almost obligatory small tip (touchscreen in your face) will set you back around 7 dollars. And yet, best burger ever.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers
text: Took over twenty minutes to get food. Last visit several weeks ago was not good either. Place has gone downhill over the past year. Plenty of good alternatives close by. Do yourself a favor and choose one.

place_category: American (Traditional), Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Not the best, most of the food seems pre-made. But when you get there two hours later than you wanted to because of traffic you eat what you can. place_category: Sandwiches, Southern, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch

place_category: Sports Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Restaurants, Burgers, Bars

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Bars, Nightlife, Mexican
text: Working Lunch = delicious decision. We used Uber Eats it was there in no time. It was excellent! The only bummer I thought it came with rice and beans. The taquitos were excellent! The tacos looked LEGIT! Definitely check it out if you have a hankering for Mexican!

place_category: Diners, Tex-Mex, Restaurants

place_category: Tapas/Small Plates, Desserts, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Tacos, Mexican, Food, Restaurants, Salad

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants

text: Unfortunately I was not impressed with the hot dinners anyway. I will try the sushi and update my review if it's good. I love the location and the vibe. I was referred for the shrimp lo mein. place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants, Seafood

text: First place we ate in New Orleans and it just wasn't my tub of butter. I felt very sick after eating the BBQ shrimp...it was swimming in butter and after eating I felt greasy and gross. I left with a stomach full of butter and burnt fingers from trying to peel overcooked burning hot shrimp. Not the place for me.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers, Food, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Bars, Restaurants

The fries were very good as was the house made ketchup but when burgers are the largest part of your menu, do them right. Wont be back.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea

Located right next to the bike pump (great touch!) there is a jar of dog treats for your fur friend. The staff is friendly and I would go back for sure.

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches, Convenience Stores, Food
text: The good: great selection, healthy salads and snacks, and friendly employees. The bad: the made to order sandwiches- SO messy! Sandwiches should be made to pick up to eat, not dripping and having everything fall out. And soggy bread... ugh. See the attached photo. I mean, this is ridiculous.
