text: Yes, it's not the nicest place so u order to go. But there is no doubt the food is amazing and a great deal for prices. Workers r also extremely friendly. By far my favorite Chinese place I have found!

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Dive Bars, Cocktail Bars, Southern, Nightlife, Bars
text: Bizzy place @ lunch! Had the pulled chicken sandwich. It was moist & flavorful. Nice decor & atmosphere. Looks like a good place to hang out with the gang! I will return to sample more of their menu.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Social Clubs
text: Had a meeting here. It was nice, but pretentious. I suppose that's the point, but it's just not my style.

place_category: Burgers, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Comfort Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (Traditional), Cocktail Bars
text: I was very excited when I saw this restaurant under construction. I couldn't wait to see the decor and soak up the atmosphere. I finally was able to get in last week for dinner with friends and I was not disappointed, what a fun and comfortable setting! Nice variety of menu options and beer on tap. We went for the burgers but all ended up choosing something else. The pulled pork, meatloaf and fish and chips we're just what we were looking for. I will definitely visit again.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, Hotels, Resorts
text: One of my favorite spots in Clearwater however probably due to COVID the outdoor tiki menu is very limited! The website showed a full menu but once on location we were given a very small food menu. Still fun for drinks and listening to music. You must be sitting at a table before you can order drinks and there no longer is a dance area due to safety.

place_category: Barbeque, Korean, Soup, Restaurants
text: The food was yummy!! But, the service was not up to par. We had to wait for more food, wait for the grill to be switched and even had to wait to pay! :(

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Smoothies are great! Lady with dark, short hair was quite rude when we had trouble using the $2 coupon on the app. No accountability for the manager and she would not even give us $2 off for our frustration. Bad customer service for sure. I prefer going to another store.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Burgers, Sandwiches, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Went to Hi Pointe having high hopes after its association with Mission Taco and Sugarfire. The abaconing was very disappointing. The bacon was barely chewable, and overall a terrible sandwich. The chicken on the chicken sandwich was thin cut, and again, overall a terrible sandwich. However, we did enjoy the fries. We won't be back to Hi Pointe.

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Performing Arts, Arts & Entertainment, Hotels & Travel, Food, Convenience Stores, American (New), Beauty & Spas, Restaurants, Museums, Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Cinema, Resorts, Day Spas
text: Expensive. Tips already included. Get outta the pool if it's lighting. Overall amazing! Bring your savings account. ;)

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Nice little place, appears to be very authentic and food handmade from scratch. What I had was delicious however portions were very small for the price.

place_category: Tapas/Small Plates, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Bars
text: Been wanting to try Irwin's since we loved Res Ipsa, but it's completely different (res ipsa was a cafe with great food). Irwin's has a great ambiance with poor food. Service and Ambiance are very good. But food was not pretty bland, small portions, and pricy! my wife and I shared 6 half pastas and 2 appetizers and left hungry after a $200 bill (with wine). Pic of the Orecchiette below, looks great but incredibly bland and basically paying $1 per "ear"

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Hands down - best pizza in Nashville. After living in Chicago for 3 years, nothing in Nashville comes close to quality WITH THE EXCEPTION of Jet's. The 8-Corner pizza is my favorite and the only kind I order. I'm also a big fan of their wings - not sure what it is about their ranch dressing, but it's legit. Check their website before ordering, you can usually find some pretty solid coupons.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Sandwiches, Chicken Shop, Caribbean, Fast Food, Latin American
text: Scond time here..this time dinner on sunday pm.apparently a coupon frenzy? The place is still new and not ready for big crowds yet..out of ice..out of toppings at bar.maybe short handed? I hate to rate them yet..but help is still needed here til the kinks are worked out. My roll was dry and my chicken dry and overcooked.i love pollo tropical so i know they can do better...will try again in a month or so..may21 @6:30

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Mexican, Bars
text: Just stopped in for a marg to go. Granted we did upgrade to casamigos but 44 dollars for 2 margaritas was ridiculous. Above all I had a 2 fruit flys in the overpriced sour mix heavy drink. Won't be returning.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Buffets, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Pretty decent for breakfast hangover Buffett. I think it was $17.50. Made to order omelettes, carving station, full breakfast, salad bar,deserts, Mexican, Asian, Italian. Nothing was fantastic but still pretty good. Quick and no line.

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Vegetarian, Breakfast & Brunch, Latin American, Mexican
text: This place is indeed in a convenience store and gas station. The food was great. There are a few tables inside to eat and we found one. The atmosphere is not good. Bathrooms are not good. But A+ for the food. By the way, we are vegetarians. It was difficult but we found something that we could eat.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: The best bbq I've ever had the brisket is amazing you can't go wrong with their menu...the Smokey sweet is the best unless you like it hot!! If so they have just about anything you could imagine to drink at the bar you name they can make it, I really would try it if you haven't you won't regret it... the manager Cory has always been available and helpful with any requests... one of the top places to get lunch or dinner in Mooresville hands down...

place_category: Electronics, Food, Shopping, Drugstores, Grocery, Department Stores, Fashion, Discount Store
text: Out of all the Walmart's around this area (4 including Levittown pa) this by far has to be the most ratchet Walmart of them all. I stopped to get one item and all I wanted to do was to get out really quick, this just a ghetto

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, American (New), Pubs
text: Great experience, we had a part of 8 on a Saturday night at 7:30 they sat us right away . Wait staff were attentive. Food was really good and very fairly priced, we will be back thanks

place_category: Restaurants, Latin American
text: Tried the most basic thing in the menu. Yellow rice. Tasted instant made... Over priced for the portion received and quality/taste of food.

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Everything was awesome! Our waitress was a total sweetheart and made great suggestions. The French press coffee is definitely worth it. We can't wait to come back for another breakfast!

place_category: Burgers, Italian, Restaurants, Pizza, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The pizza at this place is greasy, I have found better places, and the staff could be a little nicer.

place_category: Florists, Food, Gift Shops, Chocolatiers & Shops, Specialty Food, Flowers & Gifts, Shopping
text: I placed an order for my mother in laws birthday last minute.. When I called the store the Representative I spoke to was very helpful, she suggested different items I could choose from and let me know how quickly they could have it ready. I picked up the arrangement the same day and it was incredible. I would definitely recommend this location to all my friends & family. Great Job!!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Food is good, they have tasty tempura options. However, be prepared to wait a long time for your food to be prepared. Overall I would come back since not any good options in the area, however, for a chain restaurant, this isn't so bad.

place_category: Bars, Food, Brewpubs, Nightlife, Breweries
text: Great local bar everyone was very friendly, nice to go and just have a few drinks and hangout with some friends, bartenders were great at helping pick out a good drink. Had a good location and also well priced, would defiantly recommend it to anyone in town and will be back :)

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: So I've been to pretty much every branch of this place this Michael guy owns and there's not really anything that makes it any more special than any other diner I've been to, but I've never been disappointed with the food or the service. It's pretty much just your average, standard diner food, though their desserts and milkshakes are good.

place_category: Steakhouses, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New), Burgers, Juice Bars & Smoothies, American (Traditional), Diners, Fast Food
text: Exactly what I wanted - a Frisco Melt and cheese fries. It's not great but it's home for me. Nice and greasy.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Szechuan
text: I didn't know upscale Chinese places existed until I went to Han Dynasty. Portions are HUGE, so come prepared to share and take home leftovers. Or come during lunch and get a bunch of the smaller plates to share with a group. There's a rotating centerpiece on every table which makes passing dishes super easy so everyone can have a taste.

place_category: Food, American (New), Restaurants, Breweries, Nightlife
text: I think Iron Hill has good food, but is incredibly overpriced. I'd much rather try places that are more original, with less of a chain-style feel. But, if you are a picky eater and like good old American options, and beer... you won't be let down. Just prepare to pay a premium for their name.

place_category: Bars, Pubs, Cocktail Bars, Sandwiches, Restaurants, American (New), Food, Breweries, Nightlife
text: Bar food at its worst. Onion rings that are so much more breading than onion! .. Lots of grease & thick breaking! Cuban sandwich was also very greasy. 20 questions geek entertainment. Not sure it was really entertainment. Boring & exceedingly loud! The chips were pretty good; the salsa not much so much. The only plus this place had was The beer selection. I'm not sure I would go back for Just that!

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Steakhouses, Burgers
text: Great start to a late night. Shared a burger with a HUGE baked potato. My hubby had the salad which was loaded with olive relish. The Monsoon was over the top. We actually wimped out and asked for more fruit juice. I preferred the gombay which had coconut flavored rum. Was a good way to prep our stomachs for the rest of the night.

place_category: Pubs, Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Nightlife, Burgers, Gastropubs
text: Food has been going downhill in quality over the last year. Couldn't eat half my meal.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: The hours need to be changed online. It says they are open till 4, they close at 3... very disappointed when I drove all the way there

place_category: Wine Bars, Bars, Brazilian, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Went here right at 4 when the doors opened. It was the best time. All the meats were fresh off the cooker and all the cuts were delish. Drinks came a little slow however over all the visit was good. I must say they did have a lot of fruit flys around. Owner might want to look into that.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Burgers
text: A bit overpriced- the pastor taco was 90% fat trimmings and 10% meat.. did not enjoy that at all. Nachos were good. Don't know if i'll eat here again..

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Tex-Mex
text: The most flavorless and mushy burrito of my life. Taco Bell is better and I don't consider that to be anything like Mexican food but it at least tastes like something. I can't imagine the palate of whoever makes the recipes is very... ahem... authentic.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Diners
text: Horrible greasy food, eggs were bland, potatoes had no seasoning, toast was dry. Orange juice was so sugary I thought I was drinking tang. My entire group felt lethargic and queasy for the following few hours. Avoid this place if possible

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Food, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Barbeque
text: The food was good, not great, but good. The ribs were tough, and hardly any meat on them at all. Flavor was good. Chicken was good, coked well and tasty. The brisket was bone dry, could stick it with your fork, it just crumbled. Overall, the food was ok, but not what I would like to see for the price. Which at $18.00 for my dinner plate it should have been much better. I won't go back for that reason, too expensive for dried out, overcooked food.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pubs, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Irish
text: Incredibly low quality food. Probably nice if you just want a drink. I wish I had checked more places before I chose this one.

place_category: Delis, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Bars, American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Been here several times. Several people came in 20 minutes after us, and got their food way before us--only pizza and burgers for us--when we had ordered a half hour before.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Southern, Nightlife, Diners, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch
text: This restaurant was highly recommended but it was really disappointing. The crepes had some kind of wax paper in them, the soup was at best warm and the sauce to the steak had a pound d and a half of salt in it. I will say that the the meat was perfectly cooked and the wait staff was nice but overall very disappointing.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: I can say this.....I don't like much on the BK menu, but one item that no one else makes even close is the classic Double Cheeseburger.....the right beef to bun balance and simply dressed with ketchup, mustard, and pickle. Can't pass it up when I need to taste that flame broiler.

place_category: Food, Thai, Restaurants, Diners, Desserts
text: I've had a lot of Thai food, living in north OC; we had a Pho hut around every corner. This place is pretty good! I was really excited to find this place for takeout, 5 minutes from my house here in Sparks. Walking inside, I can tell the owners take pride in their restaurant and the authentic food that is prepared. I can't wait to try more of their food!

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Comfort Food
text: It was my first time in NOLA and I loved it. This meal was soo good. Our waiter was so nice and he was super cool. This meal was honesty the best seafood boil I've ever had, the seasoning was perfect! I almost asked for a small jar to take back home! I can't wait to go back! Also I split this 100 dollar meal with three people and it was more then enough.

place_category: American (Traditional), Pizza, Burgers, Hot Dogs, Restaurants
text: First Tim and more than likely the last time I eat here. The breaded tenderloin was warm at best, I am pretty sure that their "32" ounce drink is smaller than 32 ounces. I got cheeses sticks that were barely cooked all the way through and had to pay 80 cents for a small cup of dipping sauce. Want a refill on your drink... another $1. Can't leave tips on your credit card.... cash only. There are too many better places to eat.... don't bother with this place

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Chicken Wings
text: Stopped in for lunch. First time here. Sports bar environment. Plenty of screens. Our server was Rebecca. She was very friendly and answered all of my questions. Now for the food. Wife had the shrimp platter. I had the salmon. Neither of us were impressed. Thinking this might more of a burger place. May try again but not sure.

place_category: Fast Food, Mediterranean, Pizza, Restaurants, Italian
text: Just had another great lunch there--delicious warm bruchetta bread to begin the meal--homemade soup and delicious entree! Glad to see they still have great standards in food and service!

place_category: French, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Well I don't want to be a hater but I don't feel the food or the dining experience was that great. The strawberry shortcake was delicious but the rest of my meal was just okay. I had the blackened fish which was just okay and the turtle soup which I thought was bland. I got sick later that day and that was my only meal.....so I tend to think it was from my lunch. Service was just okay too...I felt like they were just going through the motions and not really enjoying their job.

place_category: Chicken Wings, American (New), Restaurants, Bars, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Sports Bars
text: The food is very generic and in desperate need of adding items to the menu. We went often, but without ever adding to the menu, we are looking other places.

place_category: Burgers, Nightlife, Food, Bars, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (Traditional)
text: I love this place but it's so inconsistent! Sometimes we've had great service and sometimes it's sucked. We sat out on the patio once and were told they didn't have a beer list, we had to get up and go walk inside to look at the taps which was annoying but not a huge deal. The fried pickles are always amazing.

place_category: Seafood, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Bars, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Expensive Crabs were over cooked and mushy. Lobster pizza came with shrimp and the manager told us "we use a different kind of lobster." Really! One of our party ordered a sandwich that came 15 minutes after the crabs. Our waitress said, "our sandwich area is backed up tonight." Really!

place_category: Irish Pub, Restaurants, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Pubs, Bars, Nightlife
text: If you like rude, surly waitresses, really bad food that makes you feel ill, and mice running around your feet as you eat, then this is the perfect place for you. Otherwise, DO NOT eat here.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Korean
text: I LOVE their deuk guk. I've gotten it a few times now and I'm definitely coming back for more. The serving sizes are great and the restaurant is fairly priced. I was slightly disappointed with their wings though, they lacked a little less crunch and flavor compared to Bonchon.

place_category: Seafood, Sandwiches, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Southern
text: Picked up lunch today. They do give you a lot of shrimp, but they were very soggy and not light and crisp. The bread is not real New Orleans bread. I do not know where they are getting it. Staff was friendly. Won't be back.

place_name: World Famous N'awlins Cafe & Spice Emporium
place_category: Herbs & Spices, Seafood, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Food, Specialty Food
text: Service was slow but the waitress taking our order was polite. Stopped to try the gator on a stick and it was pretty good. If you are close by stop and try it but don't go out of the way to try the food.

place_category: Shopping, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Fashion, Men's Clothing
text: The coffee is perfectly fine. Better than what you find in most of Philly, but their cup sizes are especially small. I paid $2.75 for a large coffee and by any other coffee shops standards it should have been a medium at best. For my money I think HubBub is a lot better, unless you need to buy socks with your coffee.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: Food was good, I would even say great, but it felt very overpriced. I am used to paying in the teens for special rolls but when I looked at the menu and saw that most special rolls were $17+ I was a tad surprised. Service was slow but our waitress was training a new employee.

place_category: American (New), Chicken Wings, Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars, Restaurants
text: This place is skanky. I do wish it were an Olive Garden instead. Heck, Applebee's would be an improvement.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: First time I tried this place, I wasn't totally disappointed... Average food. Gave it a second chance- big mistake. The food tasted like cleaning products, and smelled like bike seats. My wife and I both had...... Got sick. Never again.

place_category: Vegetarian, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (New), American (Traditional), Seafood, Food, Wine Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Gluten-Free
text: I like Seasons. Great for lunch, dinner, or a late night snack. Live music is always most enjoyable. The barmaids seem to be not as attentive as they could be - my only complaint.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Average quality for above average price. Ive never understood the hype about this place. If it wasnt for the gift card i received for Christmas i wouldnt have come here. Texas Roadhouse is still better. Oh and it was as hot as the Australian Outback that i was sweatin my bloomin onions off.

place_category: Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Specialty Food, Restaurants, Health Markets, Cafes, American (New), Coffee & Tea
text: Food is good--when you eventually get it. My friend and I arrived around 12:15 on Monday. At least three other tables received their food before we did. I ordered their special of the day-quiche; I got my food after having waited at least 30 minutes. It took more than 10 more minutes for my friend to get her food. Awful. Will not return.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Venues & Event Spaces
text: The carpet in the first room they gave me was disgusting. It was a first floor room that opened to the pool area. My company was paying over $200 a night for the rooms. I went to the front desk and showed them a picture and they moved me to a new room. It seemed like an entirely different hotel. I was staying for a week during the DNC and I know they were booked solid. Luckily, the were able to accommodate me.

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Food, Bagels, Coffee & Tea
text: Love the ice tea, love the food. I wish I came to Einstein's enough to know what to order. Everything looks so good and the place smells wonderful, I am just overwhelmed by options and I can never decide what to get. I have been to this specific Einsteins 3 times, I love the decor and wish I were a student so I could go there to study. The staff have always been super friendly and even help me try to figure out what to order. Can't wait to go back!

place_category: Pizza, Pubs, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Pizza was okay but the wait is absolutely ridiculous. The woman working was a sweetheart but she told us it would take an hour and a half for a thin crust pepperoni and sausage. After waiting an hour and forty-five minutes, she told us that our pizza just went in the oven.....what??? Bathrooms were disgusting. We will never go back. And the owner clearly has WAYYYY too much time on his hands. Haha

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Food
text: It's a donut place. I feel like there are probably better ones in the area.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Home & Garden, Food, Arts & Crafts, Home Decor, Flowers & Gifts, Event Planning & Services, Cards & Stationery, Shopping
text: Seen a lot of cute things in the shop's window but alas, after waiting 10 minutes past the posted opening time on a scorching hot July morning we gave up on actually getting to shop INSIDE the store.

place_category: American (New), Canadian (New), Restaurants
text: A romantic evening with my wife could not have been better! Service was the best, the Martinis were smooth and the Pork Belly appetizer was so delicious it could have been dessert. I had the Lamb and my wife had the Steak. Both cooked to perfection. Thank you for a wonderful evening!

place_category: Nightlife, Beer Bar, Bars, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Had the Roast Beef was ok. The meat was real not store cooked but the gravy seems packaged. It appears the shrimp is the top seller but a good shrimp poboy is not as hard to find compared to roast beef. Nice size but well over priced. Will come back if in the area for the shrimp but doesnt warrant a special trip. If you want shrimp poboys and your a downtown kid like me, Parkway Bakery will save you a trip.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Donuts, Bagels, Restaurants
text: i sometimes plan super early commutes to work so i can swing in here, and am always greeted with friendly service (it's hard to be friendly before 7!). i do wish that i would be lucky enough to get donut holes or pastries when they are warm, but i'm not sure when i'd have to show up to get the elusive "warm treats". tasty treats, but just don't taste/appear/feel to be "fresh".

place_category: Food, Grocery, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: It is a great convenience to have a full service market close to home. Fresh fish, meats, deli foods, cheese, premade food and bulk items in one little grocery. Hard to find and organic items are available as well. Be prepared for sticker shock, it is not your cheap market and service can be uneven. It is te anchor store for Swarthmore so many Swarthmoreans shop here occasionally to keep it open.

place_name: The Original French Market Restaurant and Bar
place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Specialty Food, Restaurants, French
text: All I can say is get the crawfish boat or the seafood muffalatta they were great. If you are here during a "special event" they charge you automatically 18% gratuity but do not tell you. During our visit this actually hurt the server we were all going to give over 20% but since we were not told and found the tip ourselves that's what he got.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Nightlife, Karaoke, Beer Bar, Bars, Breweries
text: Very rude manager. Came there for the Harry Potter Event. No explanation and when I asked what we were to do, he very condescending said- sit and and this is if. Will never return. Have not heard anything good about this place but decided to take a chance. Will not be back.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Food Trucks, Food, Restaurants, Hawaiian
text: Loved the Huli Huli chicken sandwich with the pineapple salsa! Definitely check their schedule on Facebook.

place_category: Restaurants, Southern, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife
text: Everything here is so good and the brunch menu is great. Lots of awesome beers and bloody Mary options. Plus I love Kevin Markee. Love him.

place_category: Caribbean, Puerto Rican, Restaurants, Latin American
text: if you don't speak spanish, you will receive less and pay more. shame. this is the third time they've done this to me so it's not on a whim that i write this review.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: We had brunch plans and de dutch had a long wait. We went here. We got seated very quickly. They were out of eggs. May be you'd consider a bop over to 7eleven or perhaps closing for brunch? The tots agitated the roof of my mouth - this was noones fault but my own and may be the tot producer. How are tater tots made anyways? Eating tots without sourcream is a crime. Our server was really nice

place_category: Cafes, Burgers, American (Traditional), Tacos, Seafood, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Unflavorful food, small portions, yes it's over priced from the tacos to the burgers. Should have known this when u had to pay for the chips and salsa. The staff are super friendly and the views are awesome. Come for some beers.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Desserts, Salad, Gluten-Free, Pizza, Italian
text: The only comparison that I can really make is to Greek pizza. The crust is thicker, and without great character. It is a great vehicle for good quality toppings, and comforting cheese. New Yorkers expecting anything better than comfort food will likely not be thrilled, but this spot is quaint and is a good example of self proclaimed "gourmet" 1980s pizza.

place_category: Nightlife, Beer Bar, Bars, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Best Po-Boys around. Maybe the best sandwich period. Seafood combo is top notch. Loved the brisket. Hope they add it to the menu permanently.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Filipino
text: Limited tables and the music is too loud and I wish they would also play Filipino songs instead. The foods that we ordered were a little bit salty except for the talangka rice. Talangka means crab in Filipino but I didn't taste any of it in my rice but I still liked it. I mean, there's always a room for improvement. I would still gonna go back in here and give it a second try.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Steakhouses, Sushi Bars
text: The sushi here is great, but the service isn't. No sooner did my friend and I sit down we were asked what we wanted to eat. It was her first time here so we needed a few minutes. Not even one minute later she's back mumbling asking if we were ready. Service isn't good, but the food is.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: So glad we stopped by here on a whim. I loved their red sauce & they have fantastic quality mozzarella. This isn't a hipster joint with wacky stuff. Just good ole quality pizzas.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Cafes, Food, Burgers
text: Legitimate 3.5 star breakfast. Not to many frills here but you will get some decent eats, no doubt. Eggs Benny, corned beef hash, and the basic two eggs / ham / hash brown / and toast are all solid choices.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: I've lowered my rating. Went back here this week. While the pizza is good, the price value is decidedly not. Two personal pies, a salad and a gelato are not worth $50.00 (tip included). Service was as good as ever by the way.

place_category: Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Bars, Gastropubs
text: We've been here 3 times in the last 2 months, but have not eaten here. The reason? Sat on the patio, left after 20 minutes of no one even coming by our table. This location used to be great, but the service is just terrible. We will never go back. Prime location in Kirkwood needs a better venue.

place_category: German, Restaurants
text: Dinner Nov 16 Would like to give 4.5 stars! Hidden Gem! No idea this place existed. Living in Tampa, I will make the drive to get this freshly made and truly authentic German food. The Red Cabbage was the best I had ever had. Loved the garlic butter spread with the bread. The freshly breaded and beaten schnitzel was phenomenal! Can't wait to come back and try more dishes! Oh yeah and sides are all you can eat!! Small restaurant, so if you're making the drive, make a reservation.

place_category: Grocery, Drugstores, Pharmacy, Shopping, Food, Health & Medical
text: It is an Albertson's. Albeit a small one. But its not a bad idea to stop here for groceries on your way to Santa Barbara for camping or other outdoor activities. Its maybe a mile off the highway, and not crowded.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Gelato, Food
text: One of my favorite Italian Restaurants in Tucson. Service is impeccable, food is deliciousness!

place_category: Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars
text: Mediocre food that as way overpriced. Good service but as far as the quality I'd just as soon get fast food.

place_category: Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Greek, Restaurants
text: Food was okay, ordered the chicken shawarma and it was pretty plain and not very tender.

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: Excellent service and food. Julia the server is delightful and friendly. Great Martini

place_category: Asian Fusion, Japanese, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: Decent buffet. Everything seems fresh and mostly hot in temp. I go for the vegetarian sushi because it's a great value, especially during the lunchtime hour. It's a better oriental buffet than many that have been to in Greenwood and Indy area. The restaurant seems clean and tidy. The bathrooms are always a good indication.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners, Burgers, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: If you're looking for a typical greasy spoon with a solid breakfast offering, this is the place. Food is great, portions are large, and the coffee was good. I had a mushroom sausage omelette and they didn't skimp on the fillings. Not the fluffiest omelette you'll have but it was filling. My wife has her bacon crispy, I had mine not, and both came out perfect. The hash browns weren't just plain potatoes, but rather had bits of bell pepper and onion to add flavor. Seating indoor or out.

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Event Planning & Services, Salad, Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Caterers, Restaurants
text: Tried this place based on the awesome Yelp rating and it was a mixed bag. $10 20" cheese pizza is a great deal but they made the crust so thin that it burned. The parts that weren't over cooked had very good flavor. Had it not been burned I think it would have been an upper tier thin crust pizza. Bbq chicken pizza was awesome and I was basically stuffed after one slice. Wife got the penne alfredo which was fine, but not world beating. Sauce tasted like something right off the shelf from Publix.

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries
text: Boudin and eggs on a bed of yellow grits. Yes please. Great spot, nice split between indoor and outdoor tables, laid back (you pour your own coffee), and tasty food.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Half and Half's pricing is crazy! I ordered their buscuits and gravy and hated it, the taste was weak and the price of $11. Coffee was $4 and a side of sausage, which consisted o $ 1 patty, was $3. Crazy! The ambitious was clever and comfortable, service was neutral, but the prices were ridiculous.

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Pizza, Delis, Food
text: Cheese steak was awful. And Italian sub was mediocre. Price may be good but good and service not worth it. Took over 30 mins for our 2 sandwiches!

place_category: Fast Food, Poke, Food, Restaurants, Hawaiian, Japanese
text: Reached out and said they contacted me and never did. I reached back out to them... said they need the exact day and and time of my purchase... lmao months later you want me to recall a the exact day of crap experience. Then they say they need my card number and or name I provide.. no response terrible customer service. Still no resolve. Place won't last. Changed it to a 3... sent me a refund and offered complimentary bowl... will update after next visit.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole
text: Unfortunately on our third time here the service was terrible. Food undercooked. Order wrong. And no one can back to refill our drinks. Went to counter to complain and they literally "shrugged their shoulders". Place is empty. Luckily there are similar places opening up nearby. We will bring our business elsewhere.

place_category: Desserts, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Morning coffee before my flight!! Great service - they got my husbands order wrong so they willingly gave us the drink they had already made (for free of course) and then made his drink.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Recently visited on a Saturday night for a birthday dinner for my fiance. This place is beyond amazing. Yes it's expensive. Yes you probably should make a reservation. My fiance and I have dined literally around the world and have visited some pretty iconic steak restaurants but he even said this place is now competing for the best steak he's ever had. The staff was knowledgeable and made great suggestions for drinks, appetizers, etc.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Hot Dogs, American (Traditional)
text: Decent burger. Got the rodeo burger. Kind of small. Was still hungry after eating. Onion rings were soggy and trashed my stomach

place_category: Pakistani, Pizza, Restaurants, Indian
text: Thanks to Uber Eats I had the chance to enjoy this spot. Ordered several items to try and the portions were more than enough!! The garlic naan was warm and tasty. You could definitely taste all the spicy fresh Indian spices throughout all the dishes. Been craving lamb and the boti kebab definitely satisfied that. Tender and spicy. Good spot for sure.

place_category: Fast Food, Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants
text: This is the third time this place didn't put salt on their fires. It's an absolute travesty!!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood
text: Avoid! Great location with dynamic view of Jackson Square, but it has nothing else going for it. Lackluster food and service; no locals would ever eat here, for it is known as just a tourist rip-off. Pay attention to your bill, as they sneak in an obligatory 15% "service" charge.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood
text: Waitress was very friendly but a bit slow at lunch time, plate was hotter than the food. We got a wrong salad but the waitress fixed it quickly which was great. This place also needs to use better soap to wash the silverware had tons of spots and made it all look soooooo dirty, so i asked for plasticware. This place really needs a good rennovation it truly looks so old and run down i honestly dont know if i will be back to this location.

place_category: French, Creperies, Restaurants
text: Delicious crepes. I love the sweet crepes but I have not yet tried the savory ones. Its a small place with not a lot of seating. My one complaint is that the crepes are a little small for the price. With the ingredients that it takes to make a crepe they could afford to put a little more batter on the pan. Besides that, love the taste!

place_category: Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Thai, Restaurants
text: We had the American breakfast. Good basic food, not great. Pleasant server. If you live in the neighborhood, give it a try.

place_category: Sandwiches, Chicken Shop, Fast Food, Cafes, Restaurants, Salad
text: PDQ is a really good place but their chicken tenders are really stringy. My kids do not like them anymore because they are hard to eat. Please fix your tenders because everything else is really good.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Chicken Shop, Fast Food
text: Fast food is overrated but Chick-Fil-A's chicken is pretty darn good and not greasy. Ordered their chicken nuggets for the first time with their famous waffle fries....soo good! We dined in....in line we had one of the clerks come up to us to take our order, after we were seated our food comes out within a minute, customer service was quick. The only thing is the menu should expand to more choices.

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Ethnic Food, Mexican, Restaurants
text: They didn't have my food order at all, didn't even check to see if they had it when I call, didn't ask to take our order again. We had to call 3 times and reorder. The order was not even ready 35 minutes later after 2 other parties were enjoying their dinners. It's a shame.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Gelato, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Always such a good experience. But I have to say there Is always a line when you walk in. But don't be discouraged it is well worth the wait. A vast variety of favors that changes with the seasons. I visited recently and I had chocolate, champagne mango, and papaya. All very different and good on a such a hot day.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: Overall very great experience. The place has an extremely positive vibe and the server was interactive and warm. They have very tasty food. I could tell the chef cared for the product being placed on our table. Prices are fair. I was a little disappointed with the portion size of the raw tuna salad, but at the same time, it's a salad. If I expected more substance I could have ordered something else.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Food, Restaurants, Desserts
text: We waited for 45 minutes for a table for Sunday brunch, only to wait another 50 minutes for our food to come. The pancakes were hard around the edge, the mushrooms in the garden skillet were from a can. Overall a terrible experience. Will not return.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers, Steakhouses
text: Eaten here twice. Both times they had the soggy cold fries that must have been sitting out for hours. Burger was barely warm. Avoid this place

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Steakhouses
text: Service was abysmal, at best. The majority of the wait staff moved at a slug-slow speed, seemed less than thrilled to be there, and enjoyed lengthy chats/sits while we waited for service. I am usually a big LongHorn fan, but was not impressed by this location at all. My only reason for a 2-star rating was the food wasn't terrible (when it came out right- the 2nd time).

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Barbeque, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: The service was good and the staff are attentive. The food is disappointing. The fish of the day was dry and tasteless. It was supposedly caught that day - it could not have been. The burgers we over cooked and served on a dry onion bun. The fries had grated cheese. Not a good experience.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Salad, Sandwiches
text: We live close and so Jockamo is convenient, but the atmosphere is so plain and boring. The pizza is good but I wish it was more fun to go there to eat. Lawrence needs more restaurants to move in, but they need to be fun with a great atmosphere.

place_category: Food, Breweries, Sandwiches, American (New), Restaurants
text: Ran out of $10 mugs 5pm on day 2 of 3 day festival poor planing or a scam, they had tons of beer going out the door and the next choice was a $26.00 boot for half the size, plus the guy was rude as s**t keep telling us we are out of mugs over and over again left and got great service at 4 HANDS

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Cuban, Cafes
text: I tried to grab a sandwich here shortly after it opened last summer. I was gluten-free at the time so I just asked for the insides of the sandwich (no bread). It was the worst naked sandwich I've ever had. It was supposed to be a cuban sandwich with pork but instead it was some thinly sliced ham and a slice of Kraft-like cheese. I could have gotten a better sandwich at 7-11. I can't believe Garces owns this cafe.

place_category: Kebab, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Lebanese, Restaurants, Greek, Food
text: Excellent Greek/Arab/Israeli food. Had the lunch special Greek salad with gyro meat. Good portion size and very good taste and freshness. The odd brand of soft drinks using real sugar is nice, though the tea was mediocre.

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Chicken Wings, Food, American (New)
text: Came in last week to watch the game bar was over crowded so we went to the other side whatever no big deal game was showing there too. Food was excellent and service was alright. Hailey was our server who I've previously had take care of me at the bar, her service is always very hit or miss as it is easy to tell when she's overwhelmed and struggling to do her job. Would surely hope that her attitude changes soon since I almost felt propelled to say something to her.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: This is more of a sit down fast food American cuisine restaurant. This is located in the Mall. Ended up getting Corona beer and spicy tuna poke bowl. The ingredients were fresh but it was more of a rice bowl as the tuna was more of a topping :(. Should call this dish rice bowl w. sprinkle of tuna unlike tuna bowls in Hawaii &/or California :) Service was ok...took a while to get seated as it was packed due to holidays. Will not be back.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Food, New Mexican Cuisine, Coffee & Tea, Mexican, Caterers, Soul Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Comfort Food, Asian Fusion
text: The service and food were both on point. I have to admit, I was skeptical of the General Tsos tacos. I ordered them anyways and I'm so happy I did. The balance of sweet, spicy and savory was incredible. We will definitely be coming back!

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Bars, Nightlife
text: Excellent meal!!! Server, Sam, was a over the top but added some character to the place I guess. Had a drink in the bar before dinner and our server was super friendly and accommodating. Cannot recommend this place highly enough. Much better than any of the chain options down the road!

place_category: Fast Food, Cuban, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: They get the bread right! Too bad the service and atmosphere were extremely lackluster.

place_category: Lounges, American (New), Burgers, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Awesome environment! Friendly staff! If you want interactive drinking, this is the place to go ! LOVED IT.

place_category: Noodles, Restaurants, Salad, Vegetarian, Vegan
text: Food is always delicious but I feel like everytime something is forgotten. Everytime I've ordered delivery something was missing and there was nothing I could do about it but call and get a refund. The most recent time I was there was for pickup and I took my order to the car and realized my side of bread was missing. I went back and got it. Then when I got home I realized that my dressing (on the side) was missing. I absolutely love this place but I hope they work on this issue.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Reliable, consistent Chinese delivery. The food is as expected, not fantastic but exactly as ordered and described. Service and delivery are above average. Many years of ordering and never a mix up - which alone is pretty impressive. Want food delivered? This is the answer.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Brazilian, Salad, Steakhouses, Venues & Event Spaces, Gluten-Free
text: My wife and I used to go almost every 3 months or so about 4-5 years ago and experience was awesome! However; I recently went for someone's birthday and it was the most disappointing experience I've ever had. We had a party of 8+ and spent almost $1,000 and the service was not on par and restaurant was dirty. The main waiter, the gauchos barely came to our table and the bathrooms (all three Men's, Women's and family) were extremely dirty! Doubt I'll ever go back after this experience!

place_category: Diners, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Really enjoyed eating here! Had a unique and fun menu with good food and big portions. Service was good and the Bloody Mary was even better. Would try again.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Coffee Roasteries, Sandwiches
text: A lonely beacon of hope in the dreary, fluorescence of Suburban Station. Coffee quality is superb. Iced and Expresso drinks are molto bene. Service is friendly, and quick.. think of the opposite of Dunkin Donuts They offer Gluten free this and that.. fine selection of Croissants, 4th street cookies, biscottis, bagels, fruit. Only negatives.. coffee prices a tad up there..and need to add real/fresh cream cheese and toaster for the bagels.. cmon, DD can do it.

place_category: Restaurants, Cambodian
text: Very lazy when it comes to notifying people about when they don't feel like working for the day. Make sure you call before you go. I was refused seating because they felt like closing early. No reason given. There were a handful of people eating right then. The service has been consistently terrible everytime

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Pizza, Restaurants
text: Horrible, horrible horrible, ordered off grubhub and its been well over 2 hours, I've called the store and all they told me was its getting prepared, its on its way....called and canceled my order and the girl was so nonchalant, so on that note I'll keep my $40!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Brazilian, Salad, Steakhouses, Venues & Event Spaces, Gluten-Free
text: We really enjoyed the service and food. We were able to reserve a table using Open Table with no problem. We also signed up for the emails for discount. Do note: sodas are charged by the bottle/glass. Pricey yes - but if you love meat it is well worth the price. Many unlimited skewer choices and the salad bar was scrumptious.

place_category: Barbeque, Soul Food, Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Southern, Restaurants
text: My favorite is easily the chicken and dumplings. On days when that wasn't available, I've tried other items. The fried chicken sandwich is great too, though, and the fried catfish was a joy. Crispy on the outside with the fish inside still delicate. Just lovely. I still haven't been in on time to get the Sunday rosemary chicken, but one of these days I'm hoping to!

place_category: Restaurants, Caterers, Italian, Hot Dogs, Pizza, Event Planning & Services, Sandwiches
text: I guess since I've found me another pizza spot I'm going to have to close it down here. They're too up and down management needs to do something about that. Sometimes pizza good and sometimes burnt and that is just not good I can't deal with hot or miss. It's close to Chicago pizza but just doesn't cut it.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, French, Specialty Food, Seafood, Diners, Cajun/Creole, Seafood Markets, Event Planning & Services, Southern, Caterers, Salad
text: I agree with the other 4 star reviewers. This place is a solid joint if you can get seated. I snuck in at the bar and was able to find 1 seat pretty quickly. I had the cooked oysters here. Which reminded me of oysters rockefeller. They were buttery good. I also had the craw-fish etouffe. I should have gotten the barbecue shrimp since thats what they seem to be known for, but no complaints from me. I was very satisfied with my etouffe.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Salad, Bars, Burgers
text: Went to Frey Smoked Meat Co today for the first time. Took around 45 minutes to an hour to get the appetizers. When the food came, I ordered the brisket platter. There were 5 slices on my plate and of the 5 slices, three were 50% fat and 2 were all fat with no meat. Service was good but the food and wait times were horrible. Not a place where I want to spend my dining dollars.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Salad, Italian
text: Simply the best Italian specialty, catering and lunch take out on the Main Line. I am from South PHiladelphia, often visit the Italian Market there. This is as good or better than the best places there.....

place_category: Japanese, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Sushi Bars
text: Overpriced food. Services just so so. Wouldn't want to come back bc of the price is to high. Food taste pretty good.

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants, Italian
text: Consistent hoagies......the hot sandwiches are not freshly made like most places......they have excellent tuna with roasted peppers and sharp provolone.....the tuna is right out of the can........good but not great.

place_category: Breweries, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Review of goat race Ticket system to get beer - easy to get draft or canned beers Food lines and bathroom lines were long but this is to be expected. Just a great time listening to German music, eating sausages , and swilling Hefeweizen

place_category: Restaurants, Greek
text: AMAZING! Food is homemade and worth the wait, a great addition to Downingtown that I hope stays around for a long time, I know we will be heading back soon.

place_category: Restaurants, Ramen, Japanese
text: Went here to get sushi but end up ordering ramen cause it was ramen day. Not as good as Santouka Ramen inside Mitsuwa market in SD but maybe like Raki-raki restaurant.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: One of the worst customer service i have ever seen!!! This girl was so rude to me! she did not greet me at all just stood there staring at me and waiting for me to say something. Then took my order and didnt say a word just started dojng her thing and talking to her co workers!! just the worst!! and the drink i ordered was so disgusting!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Spanish, Cuban
text: Food and service are wonderful at Carmine's. Ordered the baked lasagna and my friend ordered the roast pork meal. Both were excellent. The lasagna was bubbly hot and cheesy. The sauce was just like how Nonna used to make it. The roast pork was tender, slightly sweet and tangy. Can't wait to go there again.

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Hot Dogs
text: The Thai garlic chicken fingers were excellent and the onion rings were crispy and yummy. They actually have a parking garage right behind the place that gives you 2 1/2 hours without a charge. That helps since most of the places in Nashville have street parking and on Saturday night you cannot find a place on the street to park. Would definitely go again.

place_category: Southern, Wine Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The food was absolutely phenomenal, the service needs work! Our service brought my husband's drink in a cracked glass...second drink came with a floater. The side item was delivered before the mail dish is was to accompany. Any visits from the service were incredibly limited and the actual timing of the food being delivered was past "awkward time for cooking". However, again, the food is INCREDIBLE!!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: I am a Seis fan! I was off the hook happy that they expanded to river. I bring all my out of town guest and it's my highest recommendation for a quick bite. But my fave, the Al Pastor street taco has become the gristle pastor --yuk! Buyer beware

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: I entered was overlooked and finally the lady addressed me. I told her that I needed to order takeout she handed me a menu and said "go sit over there". Customer service at its best. Not! I went back to ask her a question about a particular roll she pointed to the back of the menu even though I had already read it and had a question smh ! I just ordered some California rolls and left.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: this place is known for prime rib. the ppl in my group who ordered that were extremely pleased. the waiteress was very attentive. that being said, the other food is pretty bad. the lettuce on the side of my quesadilla was browning. and the sour cream on the side came in a little container. the presentation was just cheap. some ppl dont mind that. and it works for some restaurants...but here the whole feel is just uncomfortably cheap.

place_category: Soul Food, Restaurants, Seafood
text: This place is great. I wish their food portions were a little bit bigger but they are still really good. Worth your time and money.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Pizza, Italian, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: I feel the pizza is often filled loads of sodium. Especially when you order meat toppings. Wings are really good though.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Sucks. If you know good Mexican food don't even bother. Not good at all. Don't doooooooooooooooooooooo it

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: My wife and I both wanted a shrimp po boy. Obviously in reading some other reviews we ordered the wrong dish. I would give the po boy only about 3 out of 10 stars. Bread makes a po boy and I could find better at Kroger. The shrimp seemed small and pretty minimal for $14. I think the po boy at Brothers Burger Joint was much better as they use Leidenheimers bread. Downside of both is the use of mayo instead of remoulade(personal preference).

place_category: Delis, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: YUCK! 35.00 for 3 awful sandwiches, spoiled potato salad, warm mayonaise, bad customer service, one piece of lettuce...NEVER AGAIN!!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: After waiting in line for a while, we weren't really impressed with the food that we got. We've had better gumbo in the area and I can say the same thing about Jambalaya. It's still better than what I'm used to but my expectations were higher :) It was definitely warm on a warm day even if the AC was on, but the service was good.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, Desserts, American (Traditional), Food
text: This is how fast food should taste but rarely does. I really am so impressed with this place - totally surprised at the quality of food. Even my picky kids ate their entire burgers. I highly recommend stopping by Atomic if you're ever in Metairie.

place_category: Soup, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Chinese
text: I have ordered takeout many times and ordered eggplant tofu with garlic sauce with a side of fried zucchini. Weird/funny/annoying thing though...the last two times we ordered the zucchini, it was cucumber. Yes, CUCUMBER. Fried cucumber. Anyway, I'll still order the eggplant & tofu.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, American (Traditional)
text: I can't believe I waited for this location to open....the burgers are salty and warm ...my fries were cool to the touch and my shake was like waterI've never been so disappointed...the young lady said you have to get here when the fries first come out but the watery shake was by far the worst!!! Won't be back

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes
text: The food was phenomenal. We enjoyed everything we ordered. You must try the crab cakes and the salmon dish.

place_category: Grocery, Coffee & Tea, Convenience Stores, Food
text: Always rude and unfriendly, especially the black girl who thinks she's all that. I hate this location and encourage others to stay away.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: Server was lovely but the food was really unsatisfying. Coffee was thin and tasted horrible. Breakfast potatoes were hard in the middle and the million dollar bacon waS burned. I won't go back.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Felt a tourist trap, gumbo not that great, none of it was that great. And I had a huge crab leg in my gumbo which grossed me out. Not sure if the entire leg was supposed to be in there.

place_category: Active Life, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Bowling, Restaurants, American (New), Gastropubs
text: Harp & Crown is a cute restaurant downtown Philly. It's located right in the heart of Center City. The food is good, however the portions are very small. I would recommend this restaurant if you're in Center City and looking for a swanky restaurant with small plates. Parking is a challenge in this area, I ended up parking in the parking garage at the corner for $37 for two hours. But if you're up to it, you could ride around and maybe eventually find street parking.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Grocery, Food, Cheesesteaks
text: Ok, so this is the true Philly Cheesesteak joint! The sand which was fresh, flavorful and had that authentic taste. This place is by far waaaay better than Geno's which it too comercial. If you want a true Philly Cheese Furillos's is the place!

place_category: American (New), Lounges, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Restaurants
text: 2 stars for the view and dessert. Made reservation on Sat., got there on time and had to wait for more than an hour for our table. They didn't seem very apologetic. Horrible bartender and horrible hostess. There were only two good things. 1. Dessert: awesome pastry chef 2. View.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Hawaiian, Vegan, Sushi Bars, Poke
text: They've got a wide assortment of toppings and lots of options for sides, drinks, etc. I tried the forbidden rice yesterday and it was really yummy! Don't let the color of the rice dissuade you. The spam musubi was cooked to order and topped w a great, umami sauce and greens. Really enjoyed my lunch here! Just wish they let you add more of the "premium toppings" given the price you pay for the bowl.

place_category: Food, Wholesale Stores, Shopping, Grocery
text: BJ's in Clearwater has toilet paper this morning, but was sold out before 9:15. Maybe if they limited one 34 roll pack per customer more people can receive, and feel less panicked. Literally watching a family drive away with 128 rolls of toilet paper.

place_category: Salad, Bars, Nightlife, Italian, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Soup
text: Waited for 20 minutes while the host just stared at us and the place was empty. Seriously horrible service.

place_category: Soul Food, Restaurants, Caribbean, Latin American
text: Decent food but the service is consistently horrible. The last time I went there at 3 in the afternoon, my party of four waited over an hour with only water. And to make matters worse the server who was the bartender had an attitude with us when we asked where our drink orders were. It was really unfortunate and we ended up leaving.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, American (New)
text: By far the worst experience I've had in the city of Philadelphia. I've gone here 3 times and each time was worse than the time prior. We walked in for coffee and sandwiches to go stating that we would love to sit but we were in a rush to get going. The coffee took 30 minutes and it took 45 minutes to be served the wrong food.

place_category: Bars, Soup, Restaurants, Nightlife, Italian, Salad, Wine Bars
text: The food was great. I ordered the chicken gnocchi soup and the tour of italy. But the most surprising this was the service was amazing. We ate at the bar and were waited on by Lori the bartender. She was both professional as well as pleasant. Her attention to detail ensured our every need was taken care of. Cudos to Lori and the Olive Garden.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Seafood, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Lounges
text: YUM. Amazing oysters, ambiance, menu, drinks (Hot Fuzz!), and a bar tender from New Zealand who seriously MAKES the ambiance. Possibly the best oysters I have ever had -- I think it was the beausoleils but I don't even remember. I loved everything I had from the drink to the Yellowtail app to the fries. The horseradish really is spicy -- "kicks like a horse." But YUM all around. Go there!!! I went alone while in town for a wedding and it was amazing.

place_category: Wine Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Italian, Bars, Nightlife
text: They could do better. Lack of GF options. Many items could be GF but they lack the effort. Ordered the GF pasta side and rib-eye. They said NO to mashed potatoes and salmon. Couldn't take an order correctly.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Over the weekend, I had a pizza party for my grandkids, and family. They love pizza, and they wanted Hungry Howie's. It's always specials, so I ordered plenty. I'm not a pizza eater, but I had a slice of pepperoni, sausage and mushrooms. It was really delicious. I ordered a total of 5 pizzas and wings. I'll order again when I visit Tampa, again.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: Le Viet is really fancy looking so I thought it was going to be expensive but it wasn't at all! The plate was huge and delicious and it was only $6.95!! Nice atmosphere, friendly staff, good inexpensive menu. I highly recommend it.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Mexican, Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Caterers
text: Ordered this place to go. Fast service and got our order correctly minus the extra cheese. Sadly to say the food here is absolutely the most bland food I think I've ever had. Salt doesn't even exist on their food Neither does flavor. Everything was soggy and overpriced. Hell Taco Bell is leagues better than this place. However the end dining atmosphere does seem nice. The darkness of the restaurant will cover up the lack of flavor in the food.

place_category: Food, Candy Stores, Gelato, Specialty Food, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Nice store that has really accomplished the feel of a family owned store. Smells so good walking in the door of the pralines being made in front of your eyes! Lots of packaged candy -bulk candy, handmade chocolates including truffles, peanut butter cups, chocolate pretzels and oh- those candy apples. Seems like an appropriate stop while in this welcoming southern town.

place_category: Bars, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Lounges, Southern, Irish, Nightlife, Seafood, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Cool vibe and excellent, creative food, the only drawback is the service is erratic. Last time I was there, the want staff was hanging at the corner of the bar socializing when a customer had to come up to the bar and ask for the waiter. Would be easy to fix this place with a good manager, otherwise just be an assertive guest and you'll be fine.

place_name: The Spice & Tea Exchange of John's Pass
place_category: Food, Specialty Food, Local Flavor, Herbs & Spices, Coffee & Tea
text: I spent a good 45 minutes sniffing all the spice blends, tea and sugar blends. If you like to cook this place is awesome. Check out the website for awesome recipes. Or just grab some FREE recipe cards with purchase or if you're too cheap to buy some product the recipe cards are 25¢ each. Staff was super friendly. Making great suggestions for use of each spice I enquired about how to use!

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: My son and I were in town for a soccer tournament and decided to check out West Chester. Split Rain Tavern was a great choice for us. There are a couple of veg options, I chose the falafel sandwich which I thought was very tasty. My son had the fried chicken sandwich which he also enjoyed. The place was a hit! One of the best things is that they do not use plastic straws! Very, very important. #banplasticstraws

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Chinese, Asian Fusion, Desserts, Szechuan
text: They ask for my first review to be taken out. So I say again. I eat there two times. I was not treat with niceness. They make me feel fat because I ask for more chicken. I order chicken and garlic with rice . It come with three very small piece brown chicken. The rice also very small bowl. The price too much for small food. I think they no treat me nice because I am speak not great English and I ask about some foods made their that I don't understand about.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches

place_category: Chinese, Cantonese, Noodles, Restaurants
text: Horrible. Literally the worst takeout I've ever had. I ordered the Korean beef noodle soup. I asked for extra spicy. Not only was it not spicy but also flavorless and not worth 10$. The wonton soup was basically all broth and no wontons and the egg rolls were awful. Don't waste your time or money on this place.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: I love the atmosphere to watch sports. Beer is always fresh and they have an outdoor patio that has 2 large flat panel tvs. Good amount of seating outside on the first floor. There is also outdoor seating upstairs. The reason for the 2 stars is the food is bland. The chicken wings cooked perfect but need more sauce. Also they water down their blue cheese. THE worse way to increase profit margin. Always got to go thick w blue cheese.

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Pubs, Irish
text: We stopped here on the way to a concert to grab a beer. Wound up with a beer and a shot. 2 beers and 2 shots were only $24, not too bad for this part of town. I'd go back. They were serving brunch and it looked good but I didn't try it.

place_category: Sandwiches, Pizza, Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Never received my order. So hard to get in touch with store. Manager kept saying driver delivered it. He may have delivered it but not to the correct person. Manager said they are backed up so they are just going to give me a refund, even though I would've just wanted my order re delivered. Horrible experience!

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Korean, Asian Fusion, Chinese, Restaurants

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian, Seafood

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Barbeque, Bars

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Donuts, Bagels, Food

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Vegetarian, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Food tasted good - I especially enjoyed the Carlos Tacos which I would call street tacos (open faced, garnished with onion and cilantro). A disturbing addition to the menu: four dishes featuring Doritos and Fritos. Most everything else is standard Mexican chain fare. Decor is the vivid multi colored chairs and walls you expect. Good if you are in the area but would not seek it out.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Vegetarian, American (New), Venues & Event Spaces, Gluten-Free, Breakfast & Brunch

However, the service was excellent.

place_category: Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Sandwiches
text: I have never had a bad meal here, well I did once but it was my own fault. They had a breakfast dog...it was not good. The Chicago and Nashville are my two favorites. Enough fries to share and friendly staff.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Mexican, Restaurants

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Mediterranean

place_category: Gastropubs, Restaurants, Nightlife, Southern, Bars, Indian

Bad decor, bad service and bad food.

place_category: Sandwiches, Fast Food, Restaurants

Honestly their large menu seemed exactly like el maguey.

The waitress wasn't dressed appropriately, she has red bra straps hanging out Lastly, the bathroom toilet looked like it hadn't ever been cleaned, gross.

place_category: Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Seafood, Mexican

If a kid is crying loudly, you take them out of the area; people should do the same w/ their dogs.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Seafood, Restaurants, Thai

text: Much improvement since last year. A cold, snowy night produced low crowd level and no lines. place_category: Caterers, Tex-Mex, Event Planning & Services, Seafood, Food, Restaurants, Mexican

place_category: Southern, Restaurants

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Bars, Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Sports Bars

The meal itself was pretty good but since it got reheated it didn't taste the same, it was a little drier....

Our waitress, Gabby, was very nice but a little forgetful, but it was crowded so we didn't blame her.

place_category: American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Sandwiches, Burgers, Caterers, Bars, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cajun/Creole, Delis, Nightlife, Diners
text: It was a decent breakfast. Good choices healthy choices always good to see. Service slow for not busy time. Friendly nice servers but not great service. It was my first time so I'll update if this changes. I did see they started a trivia nite that's New & I'm willing to try it out!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants

text: Like being back in the islands. The food is the real deal. People are friendly and the food was fantastic. We will be returning.

place_category: Hot Dogs, Restaurants, Food
text: This is the best place if you're in the mood for a hot dog. They even have vegetarian options. The employees are very friendly too! Everything is yummy!

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Vegetarian, Diners, Seafood, Szechuan, Soup, Chicken Wings, Chinese
text: Food is decent, but nothing more. I ordered the Sesame Chicken, it was okay. IF only they actually put more sesame in and not just sprinkle it on top. General's Chicken was good, I asked for extra spice but it came regular. Shrimp toast was greasy. Overall, okay. The portions are huge though. They also have a wide delivery area so that was a plus.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Food was mediocre for the prices...i got 1 cheese enchilada and rice and bean off of their lunch menu and that was $12 or $13. Oh you get two types of salsa with your chips, both extremely bland, zero kick! Actually the tomato salsa was on the sweet side, to me had sorta a basil taste to it. The corn, black bean salsa again needed some salt, paprika, pepper, maybe even some lemon. Anyways, I really was not impressed.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Nightlife, Diners, Venues & Event Spaces, American (Traditional), Bars, Music Venues, Breakfast & Brunch
text: It was way too noisy to have any kind of engaging conversation. Our server was rushed. The main dishes came out too fast, the food was good. I found it strange and disrespectful that there was no information on the civil rights history that took place there.

place_category: Vegan, Restaurants
text: The food was great! Got the portabella/avocado/cucumber wrap and my friend got falafel with a side of hummus and pita, and everything was fresh and delicious! Good prices too. A few downers: Picnic tables outside were grimy with grease and food pieces everywhere, and an obnoxious political sign hung on their wall which was unnecessary and polarizing. Also no trash can anywhere outside. So I give it halfway stars...

place_category: Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Diners
text: All around AWFUL experience. Waited over an hour for EGGS. Couldn't get a refill without asking and our server was more concerned about smoking a cigarette than us. VERY DISAPPOINTED. Wish I could leave zero stars

place_category: Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Thai, Asian Fusion, Bars
text: Ordered takeout green curry with chicken. It was okay but likely would not have this again and would consider other menu items.

text: Heerlijke wijn, kaas en andere snacks. Een late-night dinner gehad. Omdat het zo goed beviel, gingen we de volgende dag terug voor een drankje en hapje tijdens happy-hour (er stonden zoveel lekkere dingen op de kaart!!) Wederom te gek. Omdat dezelfde bediening het Waardeerde dat we terug kwamen, kregen we een appetizer van het huis!

place_name: Blue Sea Fish Market and Restaurant
place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Food
text: This place is in a sketchy area and is a little scary from the outside so you know the food is amazing. The grouper sandwich is so delicious it's ridiculous. All the seafood is fresh. We come here often!

place_category: Mexican, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Tex-Mex, Restaurants
text: Food and service are great! Margaritas are cold and tasty! Get the steak tacos and try the mango habanero salsa!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Japanese
text: The hibachi service is horrible, but the food is pretty good. If you have a large party or want to have the hibachi service I HIGHLY recommend going somewhere else. (My personal suggestion is Tokyo Japanese steakhouse, which is right beside the gold parking lot for green hills mall, 8 mins away from Ninki.)

place_category: Automotive, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Burgers, Beer Bar, Sports Bars, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I love this place, generally great food and atmosphere. But you better have time! A burger and some cheese fries-90 minutes! The speed of kitchen is just barely outpaced by the slow service. To bad, they have a great location and great product but who wants to spend two hours for lunch?

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Tex-Mex, Fast Food, Tacos, Mexican
text: We stopped by because of the $5 box and they didn't honor the price. They said that they are a separate franchise and cannot honor the sales.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Whiskey Bars, Burgers, Restaurants, American (New)
text: I went here with some friends and I would recommend this place for some great drinks. They have some unique cocktails and cordials. But I was disappointed in the food. It was just bland and nothing exciting. The service was pleasant but it didn't make the food any better. Come here if you're looking for a variety of booze but don't come hungry.

place_category: Middle Eastern, Specialty Food, Halal, Food, Ethnic Food, Imported Food, Restaurants
text: This is a decent Mediterranean place. The food was nothing special; honestly your run of the mill Mediterranean food. The area is kind of spotty and we almost drove past the place the first time, but the inside is nice enough.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional)
text: This was definitely one of the most romantic restaurants in the area. It was not as busy and in a classy setting. I took my boyfriend here for his birthday and we had wonderful memories here. We got their 50 oz tomahawk ribeye. I never had such a huge steak before and it was really good. If you are a bacon fan, must get the bacon.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: Went for the "Bun". Nice presentation for the bowl. However, that is where it stops. Miss Saigon, and others have a better tasting sauce to pour over the dish. Seemed to be missing the traditional fish sauce. Vui's pork was extremely tender and rather tasty, but a bit on the sweet side. I'd say it was a more modern version of Vietnamese food rather than the traditional. Good, but would choose the Pho next time.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Donuts, American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Swung by the shop for some donuts. Bought a good assortment. They had a good selection, but not a great selection. They have a very eclectic assortment of donuts and flavors. The donuts themselves are good but not to die for. I wouldn't go out of my way to get the donuts. A smidge above a Dunkin Doughnuts

place_category: Restaurants, Pasta Shops, Pizza, Italian, Vegan, Fast Food, Chicken Wings, Specialty Food, Food Delivery Services, Salad, Sandwiches, Food
text: Pizza is good. But was disappointed when i got back to my hotel room after getting charged extra for pepperoni on my calzone and ended up with none in it, didnt want to drive back though. Wasnt packed either and label says pepperoni. Smh

place_category: Tacos, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Mesquite smoked carne asada? Ummmmmm... yes please! The meat was so good I forgot to pay attention to anything else. :)

place_category: Fast Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Mexican, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: The food is as good as any other Qdoba, which is a good thing in my mind (who doesn't enjoy a good burrito and some chips, right?).
