The space is also pretty large with plenty of seating, so that's also a plus. But the biggest downside on our last visit was the service. With all the people standing around in the back you'd think someone could help the one person making orders for customers. But hey, guess not...

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Internet Cafes, Cafes, Restaurants
text: People are very nice and the coffee is good. Nice pastries too. Check this place out for a coffee place outside of the "St" world

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Bars, Latin American, Laotian, Caribbean, Seafood
text: I love this place ! Everything is always sooooo good ! But I am very sad they took the chicken plantain sandwiches away !!! They were sooooo good , please put them back on the full time menu !!!

place_category: Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Greek, Restaurants
text: Great value for the money, hands down! The staff is always incredibly friendly both in store and over the phone. We frequently get the falafel, combination plate, Lebanese tea and Burma or baklava and it's always consistently delicious. Keep these folks on speed dial!

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Really attentive waiters and excellent food. I got the shrimp and grits as an entree and creme brulee for dessert. Both were excellent. We sat towards the back of the restaurant, near the open kitchen so we could see all the action. It was a great experience.

place_category: Laotian, Restaurants, Thai, Vietnamese
text: This restaurant is pretty good. Not very clean and service was not great but ok. Native hot food was mediocre, and not warm when served. Overall an above average Experience

place_category: Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Food, Latin American, Mexican, Burgers, Nightlife, Bars, Cuban, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants
text: Let me start by saying that I am a big fan of CRG and their restaurants. But not a huge fan of luv child. It was good not great. The prices are not cheap but in line with soho much better during happy hour. In all fairness, not a big fan of cuban fusion. Why can't we just have a great Cuban upscale restaurant that doesn't have to reinvent the wheel. the decor is kind of tacky. I will be back and try different menu items, but if I am in the mood for Cuban my first thought won't be luv child.

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Food
text: Drastically overpriced and the food isn't anything special. They have inched up their pricing over the past several years to the point that it no longer is worth making the trip when there are other comparable food options around the area at drastically lower prices and they have nice views too.

place_category: Burgers, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: I should have checked the ratings before I came through the drive-through and became stuck! I order 3 things and they came to to 3.21. I handed the cashier 5.25 and she could not figure out the change. While I was in the drive through, the cashier was taking to everyone except for me. I will not be returning to this location

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Barbeque, Breakfast & Brunch, Dance Clubs, Pubs, Nightlife, Music Venues
text: Sometimes a boy just needs his bbq. This place is exceptionally delicious. I was chatting with the bartender and apparently there's live music on Fridays and Saturdays? If I'm not busy, I'm going to come watch John Dawson play on the 28th. Anyway, my Pile Driver was mouth watering, I basically inhaled it! Very stoked on The Hellfire Saloon. Much love, peace out!

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), American (New), Desserts, Bakeries, Restaurants
text: On a Saturday night, do NOT even put this place in your plan to eat here. They do not take reservations & I was told a 70-90 min wait at 4:20pm & at 6:50 was not seated after 3 attempts to even be seated with my party. Management is terrible & no one is accommodating no matter how long we waited. I am in absolute disgust with how we were treated.

place_category: Sandwiches, Barbeque, Restaurants, Vegetarian, American (New), Salad, Bars, Seafood, Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Desserts
text: This is hands down one of the best restaurants in Nashville! Super consistent high quality food. The fish tacos are some of the best I've ever had. The goat cheeese salad is to die for. It is very reasonably priced here. Tacos are $4 each with some incredible fish. The bartender with the blonde hair is super sweet. My favorite restaurant in Nashville.

place_category: Fast Food, Latin American, Restaurants, Caribbean
text: Yes, I went a THIRD time to the Smyrna location since some out of town guests were excited about it. This itme, I ordered the chick wings and the fried yuca. This time the meal was a winner. I especially loved the yuca. Crispy and savory little nuggets of goodness. The rest of the table had maduros, which I don't really like. I prefer plantains. The chicken wings were just fine. I would order the same if I ever go back...which I probably will.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Food is alright but their salsa they serve for the chips is the worst I have ever had my entire life. I grew up on the frontera, I have literally tried countless of resturants salsas... It literally tastes like they took a can of plain tomatoes and poured it into a bowl. I would rather have salsa from a jar ...Pace Picante would be 200 times better than that sorry excuse. Oh and the best part was the waitress told me they actually made it in house... That was even sadder.

place_name: Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant - Town & Country
place_category: Arts & Entertainment, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Wineries, Wine Bars, Desserts, Seafood, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Wine Tasting Room, Food, Soup
text: Only got take out here once. The burger was a good burger, but really expensive -$17 with fries. The inside seemed interesting. May try again, but a bit too expensive for me.

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Cross compared Geno's cheese fries with the cheese fries from across the street (won't name names!). I much preferred the fries from across the street. Geno's cheese fries were not tenderly cooked and too soft for my liking. I do not eat meat otherwise I would have also tried the Philly Cheesesteak.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Fast Food, Sandwiches
text: Subway is a super convenient lunch option in the CBD. It's clean enough and definitely the best option in that little collection of three restaurants fast food restaurants. It doesn't always have to be a foodie destination.

place_category: Shopping, Wholesale Stores, Grocery, Food
text: good food samples!! Unfortunately the Costco employees were stuck up.. Looked down on you if you try to enter store without card... uppity attitudes galore!!

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Asian Fusion, Sushi Bars
text: First social distancing restaurant review. Some restaurants have established good customer service practices in response to the pandemic. Mt. Fuji is not one of them. Awful. Was told that order would be ready within 45 minutes for pickup.... almost two hours later, still no food and only communications with restaurant was thru a speaker at the front door. Too bad because the food was pretty good.

place_category: Breweries, Food, Pizza, American (New), Restaurants
text: First off our waiter, I forgot his name. Well just call him Sassafrass. His service subpar for a lack of better term waiter was very slow and seemed to have a attitude, drinks were constantly empty ordered food took over 50 minutes to get it and it was no better then a dollar menu at McDonald's probably won't be coming back. And I asked them to sing my nanny happy birthday.... And nothing that absolutely upset me the most. She passed the next day.

place_category: American (New), Lounges, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Restaurants
text: Dynamite location at 16th & Walnut at Liberty II Plaza. The view alone is worth a visit, the food is fabulous with a generous bar menu and a dynamic American Fare dining room menu... dishing lobster, steaks and seafood favorites. DO NOT SKIP DESERT, their warm Vanilla cake is a diamond in the rough that all restaurant desert carts will envy. Stop by the bar lounge to catch the sunset just before 8 PM in the summer, fabulous.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Mexican
text: Nothing says class like a sign by the door warning that anyone doing drugs on the premises will be reported to the police. The chili rellenos were very large & well filled, but had no sauce and the ground beef in them was very bland to my tastes. To the point that a spice sensitive friend of mine could have eaten them.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants, Pakistani, American (New)
text: Really didn't like the food here. Wasn't warm at all. I looked like it was leftover food. Very few options to choose from.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Fast Food, Chinese, Noodles, Diners, Gluten-Free
text: The food is ok and it gets the job done but..... Let's start with the fortune cookies. They have a slightly off flavor like maybe they are vanilla flavored or something. Stick with the regular style. I always find that the veggies are under cooked. Almost raw in most cases. Wish I could get them cooked a bit more. Other than that. The flavors are good

place_category: Restaurants, Buffets, American (Traditional)
text: Average at best. Food is okay, but restaurant is old and has a musty odor to it, like it definitely needs a serious carpet change.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Seafood
text: Amazing flavors!! We love unique places and we weren't disappointed. Service was great, he coursed everything out perfectly, yummy cocktails and delicious food made our last night in Nashville even more memorable. Highly recommend the spicy crab noodles, kinoko and the salmon.

place_category: Mediterranean, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Greek, Restaurants
text: They serve breakfast all day and are open 24 hours Saturday nights! They have great American breakfast as well a delicious Mediterranean lunch and dinner food. The gyros were great, but the French toast is fantastic! Feels very much like a diner as opposed to a Greek restaurant, but all of the food is delicious! Can get quite crowded on the weekends

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Hot Dogs, Burgers
text: This is the worst Wendy's I've ever been to. I have been through the drive thru many time and every time I go the service is very slow and when I finally get my food they forget to put items in the bag. The items that are in the bag are cold and slopped together, then when I return to get my forgotten items the employees are rude and unhelpful. I have given them many chances to redeem themselves but they always disappoint. I will not be back.

place_category: Food, Grocery, Specialty Food, Health Markets, Farmers Market, Organic Stores
text: Still haven't been back since they went full mask crazy. Hope that is no more. But should you ever go to the store for eggs and worry about someone asking for your papers?

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bakeries, Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: Once again I tried this place because my wife liked it. Semi good food but very poor service. Where do they get some of these waitresses? Our waitress with a long braided blonde ponytail could only walk by us flirting with another waiter. She never even asked us anything until we were ready to leave. Very disappointed once again!!!

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, American (Traditional)
text: This place is not consistent. We've been to this restaurant maybe 5 visits. Couple of times great service and good food. The rest, real lousy service and the food mediocre. Last time we were completely ignored. We walked out. We won't be back. I hope someone in this organization reads these blogs. They need to get their act together

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Between Pat's and Geno's, I prefer Geno's. I like the cut of the steak and taste of the roll. I get it with cheese, mushrooms and peppers. It would be so much better, and get a higher rating, if they accepted credit cards. Seriously people, cash is a thing of the past.

place_category: Donuts, Bakeries, Food, Cupcakes
text: What a great addition to Bristol Borough. I've been there twice already, first time I ordered a cannoli and today I had the mini cheesecake and coffee. Both were delicious and the coffee was perfect to enjoy with my dessert. I'm looking forward to trying more sweets at this bakery soon!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Nightlife, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Bars
text: Came in last week and noticing the cutbacks Landry's is implementing on this once great restaurant. The French Dip meat was rubbery and tasted like it was prepped previously and re-heated. I didn't understand in such a big restaurant that the hostess was seating tables next to each other. It appeared they only had one server for lunch. Not impressed and disappointed from this location.

place_category: Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, American (New), Mexican
text: Wow...this place is something. It was great the beef could have used abit of seasoning.The burrito was huge about a half pound.the guacamole had to way much garlic no tomatoes or onions but it was still ok because I love garlic.They had a great hot sauce bar with all my favorites I am a hot sauce junkie. The owner was very helpful about what was on the meau.I will be back for sure

place_category: Pakistani, Kosher, Restaurants, Indian
text: I used to love their food and atmosphere, interior, everything. But recently it's kind of random. During lunch buffet, it wasn't worth at all. Food was so dry and tough to chew, not fresh. But evening, when the price is high, seems like food is so much better. I tried Indian food for the first time in this restaurant and I fell in love with it right away. But now , I'm reluctant to go back

place_category: Restaurants, Bubble Tea, Coffee & Tea, Food, Chinese, Shanghainese, Tea Rooms
text: Had black milk tea and grass jelly tea here. It's a cool little spot. They have a couch or two and a table where you can play jenga and card games. The milk teas were pretty good - nothing special. I guess it's a cool spot for locals.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Been here twice now. Best Mexican I've had since leaving the West coast! Super cheap too, large portions. Highly recommend!

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Comfort Food, American (New), Sandwiches, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Every single time we come to Prep and Pastry, the food and service is exceptional (although, the pace of the service is leisurely, so keep that in mind). I know that there is always a long wait, but it is completely worth it. Favorites of ours include the sides of bacon and Prep's potatoes, as well as the Morning Prep omelette (with egg whites) and Return of the Mac. I also love their iced coffee--bonus is they will give you a to-go cup for the road when you are leaving!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Awful. Terrible experience. Ridiculous customer service. They delivered my sweet and sour chicken without the sauce (DUH, how could you forget THAT). After I paid-including a tip- and called requesting the sauce, the woman was extremely rude and screamed at me that they were very busy and didn't know when they would be able to bring it! Maybe 45 minutes! Hunh?!?! Never. Again. Mind you, I live 10 minutes by car from this place. Ugh. So over it.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Came out for my husbands birthday. Everybody's food was great except my mother in laws. Her teriyaki medallions was raw. She sent it back and it came back raw again. Still made the best if it and had a nice night. Manager did take it off the bill which was nice.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: WOW - Not often do you find a complete failure! Dirty facility, miserable food and a unfriendly staff. Go across the river to Lambertville where you will find several good south American restaurants.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Food, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Sandwiches
text: Love the decor! Service was excellent. When I ordered my Patty Melt "rare," out server said, "We only cook them well-done, but in such a way it stays nice and juicy." I think the real reason is, there was SO LITTLE MEAT, it would burn if it were under the broiler for more than a few seconds! Fortunately, it wasn't expensive. My wife said the same about her cheeseburger. She also said her vanilla shake was one of the best she's had!

place_category: Ramen, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Honestly one of the worst ramen places i've ever had, i fail to understand why it's rated high. I like that you can choose between broths, but the ramen was so bland and on top of that the charsiu was disgusting, it was pretty much 80% fat

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: We decided to give Montgomery's a try for dinner last night. The ambience was really cozy and welcoming. Our waitress was very friendly, courteous and attentive. The place seems like a local hangout place and most people seem to know one another. I ordered the Border Burger with a side of fries and my partner-in-dine ordered the Patty Melt with a side of chips. We also shared a plate of mozzarella cheese sticks. The food was good.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Sports Bars, American (New)
text: Sesame chicken salad was tasty! Like Chinese food in salad form- perfect!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Food was delicious. Service was ehhh. We ordered 3 rounds of beers/drinks and waited each time with empty glasses. Other members of the waitstaff were more attentive to us. We received a round from another server. Our actual server never checked in with us once our food arrived, which came out fast and hot. We were just a thirsty group. Even though we could have had a better server, I won't hold that against Stella. The pizza was amazing and we saw potential in others working there.

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Cajun/Creole
text: This is a great little bar. It's a full bar with plenty of draft beer on tap. It's also a great place to watch a game. There are several TVs around the U shaped bar. The staff is friendly and the atmosphere is nice. The food however is mediocre at best. BTW the beers are 241 on Sunday.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: While I did not order the pizza, the customer service I received from Mindy was above and beyond. It was my first time visiting and I wasn't sure how this whole take and bake worked. She stopped what she was doing and patiently explained all of my questions. Including discount days and the discount for ordering online!! I look forward to placing my discounted order and trying this take and bake.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners, American (Traditional), American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: My 4 star rating is mainly for the service. The food is okay with the waffles being pretty darn good. The prices are very reasonable and meet the quality of the food. The servers and kitchen staff are fun to watch as it looks like organized chaos. The service is outstanding and everyone helps each other to be sure you're not missing anything. If you want a fancy meal, look elsewhere. If you're looking for something to fill the breakfast void,,, this is your place!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Bars, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Restaurants
text: Gave this an extra star because the service was quick and friendly. But really, the food was more or less Alpo. Got a meatball poboy with something they called marinara, but it was some kind of canned fecal matter. My lady friend felt similarly about her roast beef with gravy. My advice is to go anywhere but here.

place_category: Italian, Salad, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Soup, Wine Bars
text: Olive Garden is right around the corner of our house and as much as we like to frequent this place, the price and quantity ratio kills the deal every time we eat there. They seem to have greatly reduced the portion size served, especially for dinner. We were also charges $1.39 each for the two pieces of bell pepper and onions that I wanted on my otherwise bland pasta. We won't be eating here for a long time.

place_category: Comfort Food, Korean, Chicken Shop, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Fast Food, Soul Food
text: Sweet chili Double fried crispy wings are really delicious, the pricing is what you would expect in center city, especially since it's right across from Jefferson Hospital. The inside looks like a fast food place, so don't expect much. I would not eat inside because it's really dirty. Use Take out!

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Cocktail Bars
text: Enjoyed the patty melt while my fiancé got the bbq chicken pizza. Loved the shoe string fries. The pizza was good but didn't have toppings over the entire pie. We found 3 good size chicken bones on top the pizza too. The service was disappointing. We had to ask for everything we needed. I would suggest to go not at a peak time? All and all...all the food was pretty good and I'd return if I ever come back to Nola.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: Was looking for a good burger. It wasn't a top choice but enjoyed it. The shakes are a good way to flush the french fries down.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Coffee is good, but it's so slow. I would be a frequent customer if I didnt have to wait so long.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: This place is so dirty. They had premade chicken in a bucket where they keep their drinks and then threw into deep fryer! Woman was handling food and money. This place needs a surprise health inspection! Never again

place_category: Fast Food, Asian Fusion, Chinese, Gluten-Free, Restaurants
text: This place isn't bad for a casual Asian food. A bit higher quality than Panda Express, but not quite like PF Chang's. Their food is nice and fresh. But I prefer my Chinese food with some more punch and flavor.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: The food is tricky. I have stopped going there because I am never sure if I will be able to keep it down. The lady who took my order on the phone, while pleasant, repeated my debit card number several times loudly. The restaurant is too small for any kind of privacy of my financial information, so delivery is not a good option. The prices are reasonable and the delivery personnel are very nice. I recommend trying other Chinese restaurants, you may pay a little more but it will be worth it.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, Desserts, American (Traditional), Food
text: I love the place when the food is good but the problem is a lack of consistency. The portobello sandwich is my favorite and the fries but it's never the same. Sometimes you get one solid slice of portobello mushroom and then I get one in thin short slices. Sometimes perfect, sometime cold and sometimes way too salty. I must say that when it's good, it's very very good.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Chinese, Bubble Tea, Vietnamese
text: Just ordered the curry w/ rice and found metal from what looks like a kitchen scrubber in my food. Wondering how it got there. Lost my appetite. This is also a safety hazard as the metal is quite sharp.

place_category: Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Thai, Asian Fusion, Bars
text: Completely unremarkable Pad Thai. Food very slow to be prepared. Nice venue and friendly waitstaff. Tap beer selection quite pedestrian. Not worth a return visit.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Ok so the wait staff is a little slow and slightly apathetic or snotty, not sure which. BUT the food was spot on genuine italian cooked just right.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Desserts, Food, Fast Food
text: This is one of the most amazing things about Tucson !!!! Eegees are extremely delicious and I could have one every day. They the best French fries in town and their ranch is one of a kind. The sandwichs are good but not the reason I love this place. Eegees will forever hold a special place in my heart . Only in Tucson !!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Gas Stations, Sandwiches, Automotive, Restaurants, Convenience Stores, Food
text: Pulled in from doing Uber to get gas and use the bathroom but of course someone was just sitting down to take a long sh and I didn't have time for that because I didn't want to be parked at the gas pump that long... thanks bud.

place_category: Sandwiches, Pizza, Restaurants, Italian
text: The pizza is fairly good the appetizers are fairly good the drinks are fairly good the service was excellent. It's a large place oriented towards groups but also has single people at the bar ordering food and drinks. Frankly, their quality is good. If they would stop microwaving things or reheating pasta I probably could raise it to four stars.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Happy Chinese New Year! Started the Year of the Rooster by eating at the Red Pavillion in Meridian. Awesome food, wonderful fast and friendly service. We've been eating here about once a week since we heard of its opening. We've loved everything we have tried. The Calamari is outstanding! A few of our favorites are the double mushrooms with beef, pepper shrimp, honey almond shrimp, and the iron sizzler with scallops and shrimp.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Pizza, Cajun/Creole
text: Saw this place on tv and thought I would try it. Family ordered shrimp po boys, one "all the way" and the other plain. I have to be honestly say I've had better. The shrimp wasn't seasoned well at all and no "special" sauce on the sandwich except mayo. The order of fries for $3.50 is plenty for two people to share.

place_category: Sandwiches, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Lounges, Beer Bar, Burgers
text: Average at best. I'd recommend against the wings. The sauce was good, but multiple of the wings aren't even edible- meat over cooked, or bare bones exposed with next to no protein on the bone. My wife said the burger wasn't too great either. Bright side, chili was really good and loved the seasoning on the fries.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Food, Pretzels, Burgers
text: Never witnessed such horrible or unprofessional animals trying to run a fast food joint. Lady took 25 mins to take 2 cars orders. Snapped at me and started screaming at me when I drove up to second window. She screamed fuck you bitch. This place deserves to get burnt down. Will never come here again and advise everyone I know never to go there as well.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: The coffee is not as strong as is prefer, but the food is fresh and tasty. Appeared homemade and not frozen. Cute little restaurant and a very friendly and attentive staff. I would come back here.

place_category: Diners, Restaurants, Food, Cafes, American (Traditional), Soup, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts
text: Our server Lani was excellent she had patience and was very attentive thank you for your time

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: I really enjoy this place. The ambiance is great! Soft Italian music playing in the background, great decor, and the guy that takes the orders smells GREAT! I've only tried one thing from here... The Tortellini, with ham, peas and baked mozzarella. It is DELICIOUS!!! I get the lunch portion which is more than enough for me. It is creamy and very filling.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Simple and seemingly fresh Sushi, Samurai has nice menu of simple sushi dishes. There's not much to speak on in terms of the atmosphere. I wouldn't recommend it early on if you're taking a date there. No frills, except tasty sushi.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Desserts, Breakfast & Brunch, Gastropubs, Bars, Food, American (New)
text: This place is good and I'm really confused by the ratings. It's a tad over priced, I had their shrimp special and 4 shrimp was $22. It was ok not fantastic and a bit bland. The food is good not stellar or innovative, just ok. Server was excellent though.

place_category: Food, Grocery, Indian, Cafes, Restaurants
text: A freaky lil place that suits me just fine. tasty indian food (not the best, but still pretty good) at a great price. Dinner for 2 with a couple of Stellas, less than $30. Friendly waiter, free WiFi, and bonus Liquor Store.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: Decent selections of craft beers. The bartender Casey makes this seem like a neighborhood bar in the big city.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: I enjoy then burger special between 11am-2pm weekdays. Not incredible food and its usually pretty quiet. They put Tony's Cajun seasoning on everything - but I dig that sometimes.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional), Tex-Mex, Nightlife
text: The food is as horrible as the service is bad. Kitchen and server staff are completely unprofessional, actually hanging out seated in one of the customer booths while I stood at the entrance waiting to be noticed.

place_category: Desserts, Bakeries, Donuts, Food
text: What a great place for donuts. This is a must stop for donuts and coffee. I look forward to this with every visit to NOLA

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Seafood, Nightlife, Bars
text: It's cheap for the price; that's all that can be said. Had the beef burrito, chile rellano, beef taco, Horchata. The food is salty; the ground beef reminds me of school lunch crossed with canned food; in fact, the entire meal reminded me of a school lunch. Definitely had better; not sure if this is fair since I've eaten Mexican in San Diego, but I probably won't be coming back if I could help it.

place_name: Bertha Miranda's Mexican Food Restaurant and Cantina
place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: This place was horrible, the food was burnt and the rice was cold... I wouldn't recommend eating here. We won't be back.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Breweries, Burgers, Sports Bars, Food, Gluten-Free
text: Great food and a great atmosphere! The staff is very friendly. Would recommend the fried pickle appetizer and the grilled sandwich with pulled pork and Mac n cheese on it! Was a nice day out so we sat outside by the fireplace. Great time here.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Spanish, Cuban
text: On past visits we loved the Grouper here. Well on this visit my wife's was very good and mine was not, so bad, sent it back. Switched to a Cuban sandwich.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Loved this place. Stopped at the bar and had fresh oysters and the grilled shrimp. Both were great. Good service. Place has an upscale, yet relaxed feel. Super busy and a fairly noisy place. We ate at several nice restaurants including Cochon and Peche was right at the top.

place_category: Irish, Restaurants
text: Food was Great!!!!!!!! The bartenders are what buried this restaurant......They would leave the wait staff waiting for a while for drinks to be brought out, all while the bar staff was talking with the regulars.

place_category: Greek, Restaurants
text: The service here is terrible . Waiting 45 minutes for chicken skewers is totally unacceptable. It appears the kitchen staff does not know how to complete an order. Half our table got food in 10 mins and the other half waited 45 minutes. Guess this is my first and last time!!!

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Nightlife, Cheesesteaks, Italian
text: I was in for lunch with some girlfriends and had Ashley as our waitress, what a sweet heart. The service was amazing. Probably the best waitress I've had. The food was great too. Definitely would recommend this place.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: This used to be our favorite Thai restaurant in Indy. Although pricey, we were willing to pay the extra dollar for fresh veggies. We went yesterday to celebrate and were deeply disappointed. The whole model has changed for the worse. The prices are the same, yet you are not waited on and the food is not fresh. The broccoli is a sickly color, almost like it's been cooked and reheated too many times.

place_category: Restaurants, Pubs, Bars, Irish, Nightlife
text: Although it's a great location and nice decor, the food is sub par. My husband had the fish and chips, which he said was so-so. I had the so called grownup grilled cheese, which came out looking like something I made in college after a night of drinking. We will not be returning.

place_category: Food, Burgers, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, American (Traditional), Desserts, Restaurants
text: The steak burgers are so good here and so is the frozen custard. The frozen custard here is way better than the competitors. The fries are small, skinny fries and they have a fry sauce that pairs well with it. The staff is always helpful and friendly and the prices aren't too bad. Try it, so much good stuff.

place_category: Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Sandwiches, Pizza, Italian, Arcades
text: Best pizza in town! Every pizza has fresh ingredients, the perfect amount of sauce, and a yummy crust. The only negative is that they don't deliver.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Seafood, Restaurants
text: I don't know what people are complaining about, but this place has the best seafood seasoning ever! The shrimp and the crab legs are DELICIOUS with the Asian Special sauce! Yum! Even their fried calamari with the cocktail sauce is a must have! I can do without the crawfish but the owner is so nice and actually cares about what you honestly think about their food! Affordable and tasty!

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Food, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Sandwiches
text: Unimpressed is my first impression. Burger was small and just ok. Cole Slaw average. Service was slow. 30 min to get seated and served. It was very noisy when we were there probably because of the large amount of kids of all ages in there at the time. Almost every table had kids seated at it. The BLT was better than the burger. Lots of Bacon. The home fries were good.

place_category: Chinese, Cafes, Taiwanese, Restaurants
text: I ordered the #1 bento box which included kimchi, half a hard boiled egg, corn (no ham like other pictures have), and Taiwanese sausage. The pork tasted nice mixed into the rice. Some may definitely think it is too fatty or oily. The portion size is decent. At ~$9, I'd say it's not worth the price but being in Goleta there aren't many other options for this kind of food. This cafe kind of combines Taiwanese, Korean, and Japanese elements.

place_category: Mini Golf, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Golf, Active Life, Food
text: I am reminded not to use the batting cages. Horrible and useless. Office would not refund the coins unused. Softball is set to 70 mph? I don't recall Olympians training there. Shame and a waste.

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Love the ambiance! Over priced for what we ordered. One braised short rib and mashed potatoes, $24. No veggie. Salad extra. But it was delicious! no need to be that expensive. Too many other places to eat.

place_category: Specialty Food, Event Planning & Services, Food, Seafood Markets, Caterers, Seafood, Restaurants
text: I believe this is where the locals get their crawfish? $3.99 a pound for cooked crawfish. Not bad at all. No complaints, it was good but not great. I think I've gotten used to the sauce-y, garlic butteryness lathered on my crawfish so this was just well boiled crawfish. Other items on the menu: + turkey legs + sausage + boudin + neckbones + corn, potatoes

place_category: American (New), Bars, Food, Pubs, Breweries, Pizza, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Craft beer is where it's at but not the food. It was so bland, no flavor at all. The beer fries were good and our waitress was super nice but the food is a no go.

place_category: Restaurants, Street Vendors, Wine Bars, Food, Event Planning & Services, Bars, Mediterranean, Greek, Nightlife, Caterers
text: Today was our first visit. The food was good and the server was very nice. The only unpleasantness was from the order taker. We found her to be curt and dismissive. We'll give it another go.

place_category: Tacos, Live/Raw Food, Mexican, Seafood, Burgers, Restaurants
text: No one was dining when we went for lunch. No masks, no paper menus. Just meh. Lobster bisque had NO LOBSTER. REALLY??? Oysters were good, how can you ruin raw oysters? Chicken sandwich was tough and bland. Planked salmon was ok. We wanted to get in an air conditioned food place. We should have kept walking, as we know why it was empty inside.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Shopping, Southern, Burgers, American (Traditional), Grocery, Restaurants, Food, American (New), Buffets
text: Service was good and the fried chicken was excellent. Stay away from the mac & cheese it was not good at all. Tasted as if it was prepared from a box and not fresh!! t

place_category: Fish & Chips, Desserts, Barbeque, Restaurants, Food
text: This Claremont hang out had some nice charm lots of decorations! The service was understated but not unfriendly. The medium sauce was plenty flavorful but the spicy took it to a whole new level!My wife enjoyed the pulled pork and I had the rib tips; the baked beans were also good and the coleslaw average. They could use to serve beer and maybe some sides like pickles and onions to accompany the barbecue; definitely worth a try!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: I've had worse I guess. The carnitas in my tacos was dried out and crunchy, no oil or juice at all. Fortunately, they have a nice selection of salsas, and the carrot/jalapeno mix is good, but the cut limes were also dried out. We were here at noon on a Monday. No one in the place, waitress acted like she just woke up from a nap.

place_category: Modern European, Coffee & Tea, Food, Sandwiches, Gelato, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Belgian, Waffles, Cafes, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Creperies
text: This is a place to satisfy cravings for unusually good paninis, authentic gelato, soups and salad, pastry all made on the premises!

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Szechuan
text: Terrible service! The waiters just ignored their customers, citing that they were too busy. They forgot serving one of our orders but still charged us. The Chili Chicken we ordered was basically made of fried red chili and flour.

place_category: Pizza, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Been ordering from this Domino's since 2008 and can't recall having any issues. I only do carryout so I can't comment on delivery.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Food, Cafes, Gelato
text: Easily my favorite spot to treat myself on any given day. Most people love the sea salt and English Toffee (which is amazing) but for me the showstopper is the Peanut Butter and Local Honey. My wife and I will get a pint of each when we grab a small cup. The pints typically only last a few days. I have branched out and tried many flavors and I'm never let down. I am eager to try the Key Lime Pie flavor when they have it again!

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Acai Bowls, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Health Markets
text: Way overpriced. Can go to Good Vibes and get the same bowls for half the price. If you want to needlessly spend more $ than Grain and Berry is a good choice. However Good Vibes has the same fresh bowls and made to order for nearly 1/2 the price. I'm an advocate for shopping locally owned small businesses.

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Salad, Restaurants
text: Went to Nomad on Locust last Sunday. We've gone to the 7th st location many times and were usually very satisfied. However, this time on Locust was not good at all. Ordered the meatballs with broc rabe. They were ok and served with kale. Kale is not even close to broc rabe and the waiter made no mention of the substitution. Now for the pizza... I've never seen it rolled out with a rolling pin before. It was undercooked and flat as a pancake. Not good at all. Hopefully this was just an off night

place_name: On The Border Mexican Grill & Cantina
place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Food, Tex-Mex
text: Would not recommend if u have a party of more then 5. Mt laurel will not allow u to have tables pushed together. Celebrating a friends achievements. Really come on

place_category: Food, Seafood, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Specialty Food, Seafood Markets
text: We asked the locals where the good seafood places are. We were directed to Shells or Red Lobster, lol. My friend said if we were in Clearwater, we needed to try this place. We were shoved in a corner upstairs and kinda forgotten about. The waitress was rude, I even tried to ask her about her day and any specials, but still rude and no suggestions. The drinks were cold and so was the food. I won't go back. If your in Clearwater, go to Frenchy's down the street, much nicer people and better food.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Chinese, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Terrible customer service, and then hung up on me. I've ordered before the food was just ok. It was a little greasy went to try again before reviewing and then this happened.

place_category: New Mexican Cuisine, Mexican, Restaurants, Tacos
text: Great service and good food. We are transplants from Dallas (where the Mexican and Tex Mex food are very different) and this is a good Mex spot. Wish they would have made their own tortillas but that's a cost and labor till I'm sure they don't want to absorb.... would recommend it

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food Delivery Services, Caterers, Venues & Event Spaces, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Wedding Planning, Nightlife, Food, Event Planning & Services
text: Amazing food and great location. The wedding planner Melissa was rude, however, which sucked.

place_category: Seafood, Grocery, Food, Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Some of the best fried chicken in Louisiana. They also have shrimp fried rice, bbq chicken, etc.. I didn't care to much about the BBQ wings, but the fried chicken is the best. I'm giving it 3 stars, because they don't accept debit cards. I think it's hella dangerous to be walking around in that area with cash. I also think they need to upgrade that place as well, because it look really old, and really small in the inside..

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Candy Stores, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants, Soul Food, Specialty Food
text: The food and service were amazing!!! Our server Nicholas made great suggestions and was very attentive. The food was perfectly seasoned without being over salted. I highly recommend checking this place out.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Cute little cafe off the 101 on the way to Santa Barbara. Good selection of sandwiches and a decent kids menu. The Indian Summerland chicken sandwich was decent. Came with some good veggies including mushrooms and spinach and Swiss cheese. The cheddar broccoli soup of the day was pretty average. They have outdoor seating which is nice on a sunny day. The charging for water thing was a bit annoying but understandable due to the drought.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Tapas Bars, Bagels, Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: This place is pretty alright. I got the chestnut praline iced coffee and it was fine. Not sweet enough in my opinion but it was okay. The inside of the coffee shop was pretty to look at while enjoying my coffee

place_category: Burgers, Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Salad, Restaurants, Seafood, Buffets
text: Had lunch there recently. The food was good, but the place was filthy. Food on the floor around the salad bar, and finger prints all over the glass between the booths and the fake brass railings separating the booths. No one has cleaned in a long time. I realize it was lunch time but the staff just walked by the spilt food as if it wasn't there. Not one member of the staff took the time to sweep up the mess. My wife and I love the salad bar but I double will be back. Too dirty.

place_category: Pizza, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Got food delivered by Uber. Pizza was tasty but soggy. Salad was good. Will give them another chance but maybe try dine in.

place_category: Food, Korean, Restaurants
text: Excellent! Highly recommend the short ribs. Everything was delicious , craving for it already , definitely will come back.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, American (New), Chinese, Buffets, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Asian Fusion, Desserts, Mongolian
text: Nice people but seemed unorganized and poor service Wooden grilling sticks used - not sanitary

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Dive Bars, Cocktail Bars, Southern, Nightlife, Bars
text: Not a huge fan of this place. a coworker of my sister's recommended it. the portions are large, but the food is lacking in flavor. there were 5 of us and we tried the pulled pork, pulled chicken, rib tip sandwich, pulled pork nachos, mac n cheese, greens and black eyed peas. everything was kind of bland and the meat didn't have the smoke taste that we all know and love. the sides were ok. the restaurant itself was super cute, but i probably won't go again.

place_category: Local Services, Food, Coffee & Tea, Community Service/Non-Profit
text: Well - if you want an ok cup of coffee this might work. No wifi... so don't try to work there. The girl behind counter was rude. With so many options - I will happily go elsewhere.

place_category: Mexican, Gluten-Free, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Vegan
text: It was good until guy fiery came and then the prices doubled overnight. I really like the food but now I can't afford it. If you're in town visiting, you must go here! But if you're a local, know that the fiery bump is not just a term for the amount of people who will flock after he features a place, but also the bump in the price everything gets because of his promotion.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Asian Fusion, Food, Bubble Tea, Hong Kong Style Cafe, Taiwanese, Restaurants, Chinese
text: Delicious authentic Hong Kong, Taiwanese food. Pork porridge and fish curry ball are my kids favorite, the fried fish with salted egg is really good, the flat noodle beef with poached egg is very good. They have variety of drinks as well. Grass jelly, Bibi, taro, etc.

place_category: Burgers, Nightlife, American (New), Beer Bar, Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Love the atmosphere and the patio. Just stopped by for a drink and appetizer. Ordered a Chardonnay and Seattle cider. Both were good. Ordered the cheese and fruit plate. Shy on the fruit and bread but nice portions of cheese. Service was very slow!!! Almost non-existent. So many other choices in town.

place_category: Food, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea
text: hmmm, this place is not quite what it used to be. The fun, cool atmosphere seems more greasy-spoon diner and the food is not quite the same. The menu is different, but the crowd-pleasing staples are still there.

place_category: Food, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: Charming little place for a credit at the moment. The ice cream is good to make it Front of you while you wait.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Soul Food, Fast Food, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional)
text: Customer service was OK. Food was OK, not great and definitely not the best chicken I've ever had! The honey biscuits are good! I order 3 piece tenders and they were greasy. Fries were seasoned and average! No need to try again....

place_category: Active Life, Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Tacos, Mexican, Bowling, Food, American (Traditional), Coffee & Tea, Eatertainment, Gastropubs, Nightlife, American (New)
text: The overall ambience and decor of the place is really neat! We stopped in for a bite to eat. Their menu is small, we got the chili and tacos. The tacos were street style and very small. I believe it was 3 for $12 or something near that. Wouldn't recommend them, we also had drinks - the drinks were pretty good. We watched others bowl and cheer their teams on! Lots of tvs in there and music going.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food
text: Terrible service. Took 3 attempts for them to get order right. Cashier got dramatic when asked to fix order.

place_category: Restaurants, Soup, Bagels, Food, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches
text: The Food was great, but we went to this place because it had a Starbucks inside or so we thought..turns out they serve starbucks coffee- but not all starbucks drinks....like an Iced Venti Vanilla Latte... The parking was crazy. Had to park in front of the dumpsters and because of how many people were trying to find a space or get out of there, we had to exit through the drive thru.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: This place is very close to where I work, so it made sense to give it a try. The fried chicken was very dry and the mashed potatoes were tasteless. Luckily, I had honey and salt packets at the office. The macaroni salad was tasty and all the portions were generous. The woman at the counter was friendly and efficient. It's unfortunate that the food wasn't good.

place_category: Specialty Food, Event Planning & Services, Food, Venues & Event Spaces, Real Estate, Restaurants, Southern, Food Court, Bars, Shared Office Spaces, Nightlife, Home Services
text: If you eat here DO NOT eat at Graze. Service was terrible took 45 minutes to get food that was cold and unappetizing. Not worth it should've went with literally anything else.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Lounges, American (New), Restaurants, Nightlife, Music Venues
text: Bar tender was amazing was able to take drinks back to our room. we didnt like our first drink and she happily made us another cant wait to go back to the peppermill

place_category: Food, Breweries
text: Great that it's in town, but the beers (pricey) and staff are average at best. So many breweries in NJ that they should visit more and take some tips from them. Fingers crossed they turn the corner ...

place_category: Barbeque, Southern, Pan Asian, Thai, Vietnamese, Asian Fusion, Salad, Restaurants
text: I've heard a lot of good things about this place, finally got to try it. It was good but not amazing.... We ordered a couple of dishes that were good, didn't not like the peel and eat shrimp nor the fried hard shell crabs. The shrimps were tedious to eat, and the crab barely had any meat. They gave us two heads with all the meat scooped out and the legs which were kind of small. The grilled peppers and cucumber salad were really good though. Also the drinks were kind of weak

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Cocktail Bars
text: I got the Oyster BLT, which was delicious, with a side of rosemary fries. The fries were good, but I may opt for a vegetable next time. I will return to try their charbroiled oysters.

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Nightlife, Bars, Seafood
text: The food wasn't great but the waitress was very attentive. I later had a drink at the bar and the bartender was also very nice.

place_category: Desserts, Event Planning & Services, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Food, Italian, Venues & Event Spaces
text: Always amazing! Great food and fun atmosphere! Opera night in Monday's is great! Try the veal parm!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: They did not take my Restaurant.Com Certificate. Food was really good but very pricey......

place_category: Nightlife, Beer Bar, Bars, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Good sandwiches with a fun atmosphere. They pretty much only have Po-Boys to eat, and the group all agreed that the shrimp was the best!

place_category: Shopping, Butcher, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food
text: Decent place for a sandwich. I had the turkey, avocado, tomato sandwich and my wife and kids all had the pastrami. It was good, but I honestly don't get all the hype. Maybe I should try other things off the menu.

place_category: Bakeries, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Food, Custom Cakes, Cupcakes, Desserts, Food Delivery Services
text: Used this business for a carrot cake for my husbands birthday. My husband isn't a big sweets person and he had two huge pieces of this cake back to back. Safe to say he LOVED IT! Claudia was so helpful with my order and if I left a voicemail she always got back to me in a timely manner. I will be sharing her business with friends and family. Thank you!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Thai
text: Went here for take out one night. It was aight. Pricing was reasonable. Being that I'm no stranger to Thai, the food was eh/okay. I asked for Panang with beef, as hot as they could make it. The spiciness held up, but I was a bit disappointed in the amount of actual meat and veggies in my big takeout bowl container. It resembled soup more than it did a curry. It's on my block, so I had to give it a try, but like many other reviews have indicated, it's not superbly awesome by any means.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Food, Salad, Seafood
text: Great place. Get the char-broiled oysters -- at least a dozen. Service and quality is top notch. Seared Ahi/avocado salad was a little over dressed, but very good.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Pizza
text: Delicious pizza with great unique types to choose from. Very cozy inside and love that it's a byob. Friendly staff and great service. Have been here a few times and will continue to go back.

place_category: Pakistani, Restaurants, Indian
text: Ok - I give them credit for good food, but the terrible service overwhelmed the food. Asked for extra rice twice - never received it. Asked for the check three time - never received it. Only 3 other tables in the restaurant were filled. At least three servers walking around looking very busy.

place_category: Restaurants, Soup, Salad, Thai
text: Recently closed and reopened as Meun Fan Thai Café. I think the food is great. It's gotten bad service reviews but the service has been fine whenever I go. It's a little pricey but I think the quality is worth it.

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Who doesn't love a good sushi place!!? This is a must visit in Tucson! They have a good variety of rolls and a great happy hour! Make sure you check which rolls are half off as they change every day. The place is not too spacious but there's plenty of sitting. Staff is great and the sushi of great quality!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: the buffalo pizza was great ,usually when I order a buffalo pizza from somewhere else they overload it with the buffalo sauce making the pizza too salty.I also ordered a plain pizza a month later which I thought was the worse plain pizza I ever had; don't understand how one pizza can be great and the other bland ,so my 5 star turns into a 3

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants, Seafood, American (Traditional)
text: This place had terrible service and overrated food. Management needs work. When you don't know how to treat customers who are spending thousands of dollars, you probably should shutter the doors

place_category: Gastropubs, Restaurants, Nightlife, Southern, Bars, Indian
text: Loved it...had Vegetarian Chili Relleno. Amazing. bit pricey but worth it!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Please call this place before you visit it. This place is closed. Number does not work and place doesn't exist.

place_name: Mixx Japanese Cuisine and Noodle Bar
place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese, Asian Fusion
text: I've been to this place three times, there weren't much customers in it but it took FOREVER for them to get me the dishes. The Udon noodle was not fully cooked, the waitress kinda have an attitude, I don't hate the sushi but the rice tasted wet and also not fully cooked. I wouldn't rush to come back.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: The food was cold and subpar. The crab Rangoons was more cream cheese and anything else. Nothing had any real flavor. Service was fast and friendly, but unfortunately the food does not live up to the quality of service.

place_category: Food, Event Planning & Services, Asian Fusion, Chinese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Thai, Vietnamese, Caterers
text: I came here for pho, and was massively disappointed with the service. I ordered the vietnamese iced coffee and it was sub par and didn't come until after the pho. Once the pho arrived, it wasn't served with the customary sides of lime, bean sprouts, and basil. I am giving it two stars, because the pho was good.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: We celebrated a BSU graduation on Dec 21. Brandon was our primary server and his attention to detail was impeccable! Rene helped organize a private room which was great for our large group. Would use them again for a special celebration or a normal outing.

place_category: Pizza, Food, Restaurants
text: The best calzones in the area no question. The rest of the menu is delicious too. The food is consistently prepared.

place_category: Burgers, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: We have more problems that tonight we have decided to not go back. Have it your way is a joke at this place. We have orders missed, made incorrectly. Today my wife ordered a Chicken sandwich, when we got home .....no sandwich, she decided to go back it was there, just wasn't put in our bag. One time we even got someone else's order........WE ARE DONE

place_category: Mexican, Tacos, Restaurants, Food Stands, Food Trucks, Food
text: These are the best tacos in Tucson. The carne asada and tripas are amazing. I drive an hour from Sierra Vista just to eat here.

place_category: Shopping, Butcher, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food
text: came to NOLA for a brief work trip. chose this place based on reviews. I don't understand the hype. It was out of the way, and just not that great. It was ok, not good, not bad. Perhaps because I'm not a HUGE meat lover, I just couldn't appreciate their menu. It wasn't crowded at the time, around 11 am, but I can see that seating could be difficult during the lunch rush.

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Barbeque, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: "Sorry we don't allow men's sleeveless shirts." But women in sleeveless shirts are totally cool. It's 90 degrees in New Orleans and you aren't going to allow men in tank tops? Maybe we looked too gay, our apologies.

place_category: Cantonese, Chinese, Restaurants
text: This is the best Chinese restaurant I had gone to I go head as much as I can plz come and try their food oh my goodness it's amazing my favorite is crab rengoon, fried rice and many more it's sooo tasty!!!

place_category: Food, Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Mexican, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Great building, great location, great atmosphere, completely bland food. I was in shock, I expected so much better for all fresh food and being independently owned. My advice to the owners is to check the food daily. Beans were dry and tasteless. Taco's had no flavor and over priced. Salsa was bland. Queso tasted just like any other I have had. I was so looking forward to something great and was so disappointed.

place_category: American (New), Bars, Nightlife, Lounges, Restaurants
text: Racist flag outside and Patriots fans inside. The place is vile. The food stale and the tables dirty. Gross.

place_category: Sports Bars, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Burgers
text: Sherry and I stopped in for half-priced apps during happy hour on a Sunday night. We ordered a wedge salad, boneless wings, chicken wonton tacos, and a sangria to share. While the wings were tasty and spicy, the green goddess dressing served with the wedge (they would not substitute blue cheese) ruined it, the wonton tacos were unremarkable, the sangria, while good, was mostly ice, and the service was very slow. Overall a disappointment.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Seafood, Specialty Food, Food
text: This place was recommended by our Airbnb host as the best seafood around. We were served by Dan who is awesome! He was spot on with his recommendations so if you are not sure what to try, just trust Dan the Man. Everything we tried, from the shell fish to the grouper, was delicious. They also tend to recommend one of their special receipie dipping sauces, take it! Oh, and their draft beers are great too.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea
text: Town Hall brought a city-style coffee shop to the suburbs. It's too bad they seem to have closed down the Main Line branch. The area is much worse off -- too bad most residents seem to prefer McStarbucks.

place_category: Sandwiches, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Burgers, Cafes, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Salad, Music Venues, Bars
text: Such a fantastic new addition to Soulard! The staff is incredibly friendly and professional. Not to mention, their homemade chili and bloody marys are delicious. They may just be the best of both in the neighborhood. Would highly recommend Howard's for their food, drinks, and ambiance.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches
text: Had a large Supreme pizza and some fried mushrooms. Pizza was good! Love their dough and that they use banana peppers on their Supreme, adds just a little sweetness but not to much. Dough is lite and not over filling. Also had the fried mushrooms, they weren't fried, but baked. Still they were good and I would order them again. Overall good pizza and we will be back.

place_category: Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Food is pretty good especially the different pastas and the half chicken dish. Bread before the meal is mediocre. Drinks are fun but watered down and over-priced. Did not enjoy sitting outside one bit either. You're directly on the street with tons of cars passing by and people walking in between your tables. Also, there's no lights so once it was dark I could not even see my date, let alone what I was eating.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Pizza
text: Great service but I was highly disappointed when I ordered the Margherita pizza and it had onions in it. That's unusual for a Margherita pizza. I hate onions and that needs to be listed on the menu as one of the ingredients (it says on the menu the ingredients are plum tomato, mozzarella and basil).

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Fast Food
text: Great place. I'm vegan and my friends ar not. This place made a great vegan pizza for me with whatever toppings I wants and a great side salad too. The build your own and still cheap model is a great one. They were fast and aware of me vegan needs.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: Don't go it's not the same anymore big John used to be the chef now it's terrible worst burger ived had to be honest and terrible service sorry to say but If u want a good burger don't go. the soda was flat the fries were burnt list goes on

place_category: Japanese, Vietnamese, Restaurants, Chinese
text: Call to place a small order from work, Owner tried to over charge me and when I questioned him about the price. He became very rude and mean about it... asking me harshly "do you want it or not, If so give your credit card?" Why would I buy from you after were so RUDE to me..I would worry that you would SPIT in my food SO NO! I DO NOT I WILL NOT BUY ANYTHING FROM SOMEONE WHO TREATS THEIR CUSTOMERS RUDELY.

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Fast Food, Asian Fusion
text: Mikimoto is a bit over-rated in my opinion. The sushi, especially the sashimi, is inconsistent. I don't really eat a lot of rolls, but prefer the sushi pieces and sashimi and at times I find the fish to lack freshness and quality. On the other hand, sometimes it is really good, thus the 3 stars. There are definitely better sushi places in NOLA. In general, the sushi here is acceptable and I eat it often, but as someone who comes from Dallas/Houston, this sushi is only ok.

place_category: Restaurants, Specialty Food, Pasta Shops, Food, Chicken Wings, Pizza
text: It was just ok.. Crust was not crisp. The cheese was tasty and toppings (pepperoni, sausage and onions) were average. I didn't hate it but was not a favorite.. nothing I'd race back for.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Irish, Pubs
text: The place was fine, but really nothing special. Good place for a happy hour. Good beer selection. Good service. Good food. Nothing really stood out to say I'm a fan. Fish on the fish and chips were good, but the chips were plain fries.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Noodles, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Food, Salad, Vegetarian, Vegan
text: I had wanted to go to this place since it'd opened many many years ago. Finally did go and... was not impressed. The company and it's model seem good enough but the food... unexciting. Not that is was terrible but I wouldn't be anxious to spend money here again. I got vegetarian stir fry and was so disappointed. The portion of vegetables seemed very stingy. The flavor was ok, not bad or great. It was edible food but I can happily bypass this restaurant next time.

place_category: Seafood, Noodles, Chinese, Restaurants
text: Pretty disgusting place. I had wonton soup, chicken with vegetables , and egg rolls. Wonton soup- disgusting, the worst I've had. Chicken with vegetables - OK. Egg rolls - disgusting! They had 0 pork in them even though they were "pork egg rolls" I feel legally scammed by them. Beware. Suggestion: oriental pearl

place_category: Hotels, Caterers, Restaurants, Seafood, Hotels & Travel, Sandwiches, Salad, Event Planning & Services
text: My friend and I came here for drinks and dessert and had the best time! Our server, Amy, was very knowledgeable and friendly. Would come here again!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Ramen, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Having eaten at most sushi restaurants in St. Louis, I can confidently claim this my worst experience to date. The pieces were small and expensive, and the fish was not fresh. The salmon skin roll arrived at the table tepid and drenched in fat. The only way this place can manage to stay open is through a constant influx of new uninformed customers.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Was expecting a little cheaper given the "$" rating on yelp. In reality two sandwiches, one cheese fries, and two standard (small!) drinks came to $29. Still the selection of sandwiches was very different to other places, tasted very good. Given the price point though we won't be coming back too often.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Average. I only ordered off the happy hour menu, so it's possible the regular stuff is better. Mango shrimp tacos: ok, very bland and shrimp were slimy Calamari: ok, fried stuff is always ok served hot, which this was. The batter was pretty salty, and the dipping sauce was very bland white stuff that tasted like nothing

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Chicken Wings
text: Came here for a quick lunch and while it is clean and the waitress greeted is promptly and took our orders the food took over 40 mins for 10 wings and fries. I was 1 of 3 tables being served so no excuse. I would've spoken to a manger about the experience but they are nowhere to be found. Good luck but they aren't ready to serve people.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: I spent $27 on a pizza that wasn't that great. This is an exact copy of Antico's from Atlanta, but more expensive and not as good.

place_category: Greek, Restaurants, Mediterranean
text: Great food at a great price! Friendly service and a nice patio overlooking a pond. Overall great experience.

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Seafood, Caribbean
text: We have eaten at Doc Fords on Captiva at least a dozen times. ( our boat was docked down there) food was much better. Same items. Panko Grouper was fried not sautéed and the pork chop was tuff. Yucatán shrimp was awesome. Perfect ! Kyees, our waiter, was a real pro. Wonderful service. Chef needs to check out the plates before they leave the kitchen. Practice makes perfect!! I gave Captiva a 5 on Yelp more than once. Get ur game on!!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Pizza, Italian
text: I ordered a Canadian bacon and onion thin pizza. I was shocked the cheese was under the meat and sauce was spread too thin. I could barely taste it. There was no olive oil on the crust which was a bummer. Pizza did not look baked. Soup was good but I won't be back .

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: I usually have the breakfast skillet and French toast with fresh cut strawberries. I have not had an issue with either one. Servers are always friendly and very prompt when it comes to service. I have to add, the last time we went in to eat we got there about 30 minutes to close. I know, I know I should be ashamed (I'm a server as well) I apologized for how late out was and told her we could go elsewhere, she insisted we sit and carried on as if it was no big deal. They have our approval.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Sushi Bars, Food, Restaurants
text: I'm not a Sushi eater but my wife loved the Salmon/avocado roll and the yellow tail roll. She said the fish tasted fresh. I stuck with the safe play: chicken lo mein, which was excellent. Reasonable prices too. The have a $20 all you can eat sushi night, which I'm told is a good deal for quality sushi.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Colombian, Empanadas, Latin American, Venues & Event Spaces, Bars, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife
text: Beans are very flavorless and are what mostly filled my plate. The sausage was so overcooked I couldn't eat about 1/4 of it cuz it was fried to hard powder. Their steak wasn't bad. It had good seasoning. Their side salad was my least favorite thing as it consisted of hard pieces of cabbage Service was decent but not all that great

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Ordered 2 cheese steak sandwiches on Door Dash for $7.00 each. Weren't anything like the menu. Small with meat and cheese only. No onions, bell pepper, or sweet peppers. Too much cost for what you get. Won't order with them again. Very disappointed! First z as and last time customer!

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Noodles
text: Went there for lunch with hubby the other day. Inside it's really nice with great ambient lighting. Food was a little pricey though. Both of us enjoyed the salad. Sushi was good. Hubby had Stonepot Bibimbap which he loved. I had Tempura Noodles which were ok. Oh, and their Lychee Martini was very strong, didn't taste much else which I found disappointing.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Thai
text: The food was awesome and fast. This will be my spot. Come and try it. You'll be very pleased with the service also.

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Candy Stores, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants, Soul Food, Specialty Food
text: This is my third time to NOLA, and I've been trying to get to this restaurant since my first visit. I finally made it this time and the fried chicken was amazing! I wish I had made it here sooner.

place_category: Restaurants, Noodles
text: I had takeout from here once. The lemon chicken was quite tasty, but overall the food was just average. The menu is easily accessible online and the staff were friendly.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Elegant, subdue interior. Service is warm, friendly and attentive. Food is pleasantly average. I had the pad thai. Dish tasted fresh, but was bland with little of the distinct complex peanut flavors. My father had pho. Again, dish nicely presented, but broth was somewhat flat without the complexities.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Food Delivery Services, Italian, Food
text: This place is Ok. The jalapeño pepperoni pizza was good, I also had the BBQ chicken which was fine. A little greasy, definitely New York style, thin crust, with a large bread rim; I'm a Chicagoan- so not my preference- but it tasted just fine. A bit pricey for pizza considering you can make 10-12 sales from baking one pie but, the slices are large.

place_category: Barbeque, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Bars, Restaurants, Whiskey Bars
text: To begin. Carly was not only outstanding, she made my first experience at Tradesmen Exemplary. She was so kind and even through dealing with a bunch of crazy playoff football fans she served our drinks timely and with a smile. Carly and Tradesman's is the shit. I'll be back for sure.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Guy would not give me a little sample cup (maybe 1oz cup) to take two pills so I could eat my ice cream that I purchased. I asked him for any water tap would be nice, anything just to take my meds to eat my ice cream that was melting, just said sorry can't give out water. Ended up asking for a refund due to this jerk not letting me take my meds. Would rather go to cold stone where they are friendlier.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Seafood, Diners, Sushi Bars
text: Very very yummy! Food was delicious, drinks were good. Just not giving 5 stars because the service was suuuuper slow and it was a little pricey I felt. Although, CL deals had a deal $15 for $30 which is a really good deal. I was there probably 3 hours at least and had only ordered one app and 2 sushi rolls. Waitress was very friendly but it took FOREVER for food to come out and they weren't even busy! Other then that it was delicious and prob some of the best sushi I've had.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Loved the outdoor seating, they had heat lamps at night. It's BYOB which is awesome, food was really good and the prices aren't bad at all.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers
text: This place is a complete shit show! I mean good lord! I got jalapeño added to my child's burger my 6 year old may I add. I try to give it another go and the bottom of my snickers blast has styrofoam. I mean you had one job.

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Been here several times, always terrible service. Almost every time I've been here I've been over-charged - like I wasn't going to check my bill. Gave 2 stars for the potato skins & Michelob Golden Draft beer.

place_category: Seafood, French, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Cajun/Creole
text: Not terribly impressed. Service was good, food was good but not spectacular. Menu is small and desserts were mediocre at best.

place_category: Health & Medical, Saunas, Sports Clubs, Hotels & Travel, Active Life, Beauty & Spas, Resorts, Day Spas, Food
text: Best place ever! Wonderful hospitality and great food. I recommend gyoza and beef bulgogi followed by a good soak and 1 hour scrub. My dream place to be!

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Pubs, Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), American (New)
text: Really nice staff, accommodating. Food is...acceptable, chain pub type food. Good place to go & watch a game, have a drink & a snack :)

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Southern
text: I've been to Felix's seveal times and had a fair number of items from the menu. If you are looking for raw or chargrilled oysters, this place is very good. Their fried seafood, however, is mediocre. There is much better in town. I recently had a fried oyster poboy which was not very satisfying. The oysters were small and full of shells. The breading which was cornmeal just overwhelmed the oyster. Another positive note is the view which is great including the dock. Hope this helps.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Korean, Custom Cakes, Restaurants
text: I've had better but you have to take what you can get when you are in town visiting. The place looks clean and the cashier was friendly.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Cajun/Creole
text: Do not come here. FIRST OF ALL, the grade is a 70 and hidden in a corner where you can barely see it. I would not have stayed had I seen that when I first walked in. They were out of the appetizer I wanted, ran out of numerous sides, don't let you substitute your sides and to make matter worse...the food is nasty. Mac n cheese that looks like Kraft. Seasonless catfish. And the shrimp tastes fresh out the water. Just go next door to Neyow's.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Pubs, German, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: In town for a couple days for a buddy's bday. Came here, since we collectively love this place. Turns out we reserved was given away in front of our eyes, so we're sitting a group of 14 on benches. This has made me very sad: you shouldn't lie to your patrons. Added one star back for our server, the dude is on point.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Caribbean
text: Everything here is mouthwatering!!! During lunch, they serve buffet for $10! Ackee and salt fish on Fridays!!!

place_category: Mexican, Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Tacos, Nightlife, Bars
text: Terrible Just Awful Do not come here Got there and had to wait 30 minutes. Did not even get food. Just walked out.

place_category: Delis, American (New), Restaurants
text: Sucks! Like it's owner, this restaurant isn't worth the space it takes up. They treat people like crap and it's not too difficult to cook up breakfast without making people puke. But somehow they managed to do that here! Greasy spoon? Try greasy fork, knife, cup, seat, etc. You get the picture. Edible Difference, do us a favor and get into the rendering business cause you sure as hell can't cook, or treat people with respect!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Wineries, American (New), Wine Tasting Room, Gluten-Free, Arts & Entertainment, Party & Event Planning, Wine Bars, Food, Seafood
text: I'm used to the wine bars in Northern California; local wines, farm to table fresh dishes, thoughtful, tapas style or smaller dishes to allow for tastings of more varieties of dishes, so I think I was a little taken aback when I saw the portions of the meals here! They were huge, very rich, slightly too salty and left me feeling really bloated. Great service though.

place_category: Food, Cafes, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: You've gotta love La Colombe. They serve delicious coffee and are located in a gorgeous space. I just wish they had WiFi!

place_category: American (New), Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: 2 stars for having a sunny terrace - there are too few places with outdoor seating around here. The beer selection is OK and the food as well. No, the worst part here is the service.
