I have come here at least 3 times (I love eating alfresco) and every time the staff was incompetent and arrogant. If you want to have a better experience, go somewhere else.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese, Sandwiches, Local Flavor, Food Stands
text: Bui's? Oh, you mean salt-pepper-ketchup. It's completely fine. Not my #1 favorite food truck in University City, but it is for lots of people. I'm happy to eat breakfast there.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: I wouldn't even feed this food to my dog if we are being honest. I've ordered from here once before and it has never been quite this bad. The pizza crust tasted like glorified cardboard with under seasoned marinara. It had barely any toppings on it and it was lukewarm. In addition to all of that my onion rings were burnt. Needless to say I will NEVER be back to this establishment.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Nice open restaurant area. Clean. Great service. Food was eh. Margarita was eh. I've had better. And I've had worst. Probably visit again but not to impress anyone.

place_category: Donuts, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Had some great ice cream and donuts! The staff were really nice and I will definitely be back!

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: Marissa was a great server. She was helpful and knowledgeable about the menu. She checked on us consistently. Dave was an excellent bartender. We didn't have to wait to get another refill for our beers. The Witkowski was delicious. Rice rice baby chicken was really yummy. If you like veggies and Tasty chicken you'lll enjoy this. The DJ was spinning all the right songs. Any Friday night here is where you should come to unwind.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: totally agree all negatives reviews! The employees no feedback when you have request.

place_category: Salad, Pizza, Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: Upper Crust probably has the best lunch special in town...you get a giant slice of pizza and a drink for under $4. The pizza is pretty good, definitely one of the better pizza joints in Tucson. It's greasy (like, needing to blot with a napkin greasy) deliciousness!.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Well, I'm the "kuntry" and it's hard to find food, especially in a restaurant, that lives up to mountain cookin'. This place nailed it. While it's not perfect, it's really dang good stuff. I highly recommend it if you're in need of your "kuntry" fix. The only thing missing was a couple Dixie (rebel) flags!

place_category: Irish, Chicken Wings, Irish Pub, Nightlife, Pubs, Bars, Restaurants, Fish & Chips
text: Concept is awesome. Great tasting food, ok selection of beers. But this is definitely nothing special. I paid almost $30 for a double whiskey. For that price, I'll drive a little further somewhere else. The owner is a complete jackass also. He seems very nice at first but you'll quickly see he only wants money. He takes credit for the entire establishment. Feel bad for the workers there. Save your money!

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers, Hot Dogs, American (Traditional)
text: Not a destination burger, but the people were friendly and the homemade potato chips were excellent.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Diners, Waffles
text: My 1st experience at Waffle House. The food was very good. Good value for the price. The service and leadership was outstanding. I would highly recommend. Make sure you say hello to the manager Mr. Stubbs

place_category: Chinese, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Fast Food, Gluten-Free
text: The lettuce wraps are really tasty! Love them. This location is really crowded at lunch time, with plenty of folks on the pick-up and to-go lines too. I think it is worth the wait, which is not too long.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Awesome curry! I was craving something that resembled the dishes I had in SE Asia and this hit the spot. Need to come back for the pad thai because I am too stuffed to try it all at once. Staff was super friendly too, perfect fit for bucktown!

place_category: American (Traditional), Pizza, Burgers, Hot Dogs, Restaurants
text: What a fun, hole in the wall, place to get some lunch!! Not only is food phenomenal, but for those prices!!! This place is so cheap it doesn't even feel legal. Their root beer is to die for. Hot dogs, burgers, and onion rings are so good you want to eat them all. Fun, outdoor dining experience that allows you to enjoy the weather. The also have a drive up option that allows you to order and eat in the car, or take it to go. The staff is friendly and overall recommend coming here for quick eats.

place_category: Food, Breweries
text: A lovely cooperative space in an up & coming part of Santa Barbara. We walked over from the Figueroa Brewery, and enjoyed our visit. That said, I think that I would prefer Figueroa - it's a little more of a beer lovers brewery with a little less fancy.

place_category: Caterers, Restaurants, Hawaiian, Event Planning & Services, Barbeque
text: Ever since I spotted this place I have been dying to try. Finally I did and wished I hadn't. The KALUA pork is so bland it was hard to tell what it was. The rice is not Hawaiian steamed Ono rice, but rather Uncle Ben's. Lastly, the macaroni salad was from a carton and past expiration. This place is not any example of Hawaiian food.

place_category: Salad, Pizza, American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants
text: We go here whenever we go to the mall. And food is delicious, service is very nice. We always get pizza and Thai peanut noodles they are delicious. Highly recommend.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Sad salad, cheese missing, had to ask for extra dressing, mesquite chicken on salad was tasteless-sysco precooked nonsense. The sopapillas for 6.00 consists of one sopapilla with ice cream , it is extremely misleading on the menu. The margarita by the liter is a ripoff and they fill the carafe with ice it's all water to share? Very disappointing

place_category: Greek, Persian/Iranian, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Indian
text: What a great place. The waiter was very friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable. The food was terrific, and the chef even came to our table to great us. The prices are reasonable. Looking forward to coming back. Thanks!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Salad, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The food here is DELICIOUS . It's also a great atmosphere. There's occasionally live music . Perfect for the summer months - love their happy hour. My favorite thing on the menu :: Cobb salad!

place_category: Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Pizza, Restaurants
text: This place have Awesome wings no doubt but if only they weren't so slow and the price wasn't so much the timing Kills the price. Just expect to wait a little bit when you order from here that's the only downside I wish they had more staff

place_category: Restaurants, Irish
text: Lots of beer at a descent price, I did not try out the food. It has the basics and a pool table and seems like the a spot for locals.

place_name: Daddy Dawgs Hot Dogs & Ice Cream
place_category: Hot Dogs, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Food
text: Really enjoyed the Chicago dog and waffle fries. Also had a pretzel dog which was excellent. Good place, will be back.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Distilleries, Farmers Market, Food
text: When I first order from them, I actually liked it because of the amount I get along with the taste of the food. So not too long after, I've placed the same exactly order. The second time I did not get the amount that was advertised. I got the number 9, which is the steamed Dungeness Crabs without the shrimp. The menu says 2 pieces, but I ended up getting only one. I guess next time I have to specifically include the amount it supposes to be given. Or I might just have to find another place.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Great alternative to your chain type sandwich shops. I ordered the Sub Club toasted. It was very good with fresh tasting condiments. The sandwich was large enough I would have been full by eating half of it. Great customer service and minimal wait time while your sandwich is prepared fresh. I'll be back to try other menu items!!!

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Mexican, Sandwiches, Latin American
text: Skip it until they grow into the restaurant they want to become. The food looks good, but the hostess staff hired is young and inexperienced and would rather cut up with each other than take names for seating. We and three couples behind us left without hearing how long the wait would be because we just were garnering enough attention and they were with each other

place_category: Shopping, Convenience Stores, Drugstores, Food, Health & Medical, Pharmacy
text: Scary parking lot. I've been approached many times in the parking lot by random strangers with long, exaggerated stories looking for a couple of bucks. I was approached this evening while putting my children in my car - don't mess with me when my kids are present - I will bite! They need a cop parked in that lot because the shady crackheads are out there day and night.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Delis, Sandwiches
text: I will not be back. I had to wait for them to make sandwiches for the two guys behind me before they would complete mine and send me on my way. Fortunately, my sandwich was pretty good, or this review would have been nastier!

place_category: Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Bars
text: A great little hidden gem near the Hillsborough River, this seafood shack has more than fish to tempt your tastebuds! Whether it's their cheeseburgers, chicken or to-die-for Grouper Sandwich (in season only, ask first), this is a fun stop and the bands that play here never disappoint!

place_category: American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Restaurants, Diners, Food
text: Open late, fairly good diner food. Always crowded for lunch and weekends. Not the best food i've even had, but it has lots of vegetarian options for a diner. If you're comfortable enjoying a diner without an injection layer of grease, this place is alright.

place_category: Nightlife, Seafood, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Service was decent. We ordered the shrimp tacos and mussels. Tacos tasted okay but were bland. The mussels were good but 11 didn't open and couldn't be eaten. 3 people who sat down after us were served first.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Desserts, Bubble Tea, Food
text: I went Sunday at 2pm and there was not a long line. The ice cream was very good and I highly recommend that you try this place for cool, unique rolled ice cream!!

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: This place is huge, and packed to the gills all day and night. It's what you would expect from Stephen Starr and a Bistro on Rittenhouse, pretentious and expensive, but pretty good.

place_category: Breweries, Nightlife, Restaurants, Food, American (New), Bars
text: Great service, beautiful restaurant, food was mediocre at best. Great place for drinks, sports on TV, happy hour! The food is doused in sauce, oil and/or salt. Also tried the triple chocolate brownie which was unfortunately stale. Truly disappointed.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Barbeque, Desserts
text: I found this place on yelp and let me tell you, there is no way you will leave this place hungry and not a smile on your face. Unless you have eaten to much because it was so good. The three meat is great the turkey is real good. The pickle Rick sandwich is bigger then my belly but it was great.

place_category: Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Delis, Sandwiches, Salad, Restaurants
text: On a business trip in Carmel, really wanted a salad bar, I don't like prepared salads. The hotel recommended Jason's Deli. Spot on! I made my salad from the salad bar and ordered half a turkey sandwich. It was yummy. Great menu selection. Great service, I got there around 8pm tonight and the place was empty. The young lady Alanna was very helpful and sweet. I am probably going back tomorrow evening. Yup I went back for more of the salad bar.

place_category: Restaurants, Greek
text: Phenomenal gyro. It's loaded with juicy meat that's well seasoned that I came back for the next night. Great price for what you get.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: Came here at 9 pm on a Saturday night and the service was horrible. We were told by the hostess that there was a 2 hour wait and when we said we didn't mind waiting they said they are not writing any more names down. Hostess was super rude and we will not be coming here ever!!!!

place_category: Fashion, Shopping, Department Stores, Drugstores, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Flowers & Gifts, Grocery
text: I was refused life-saving blood pressure medication today because their "system" was down. I was told to, "Go somewhere else." Appalling. Do not do business with this piece of junk store.

place_category: Bakeries, Donuts, Sandwiches, Food, Comfort Food, Cafes, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea
text: Actually a nice addition to plainfield franchise lineup. Friendly staff and tasty food. The hash rounds are really good and seasoned well. I'm going to work this stop into my breakfast rotation!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: The food is great and always a nice presentation. The ambiance is great and very comfortable. However, prices are really high for what you get compared to other same style Mexican places.

place_name: Hattie B's Hot Chicken - Nashville West
place_category: Beer Bar, Bars, Southern, Soul Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Chicken Wings
text: Over rated. All it is is fried chicken with buffalo sauce poured over it. I don't see what all the hype is. The cole slaw is bland.

place_name: Porta Via Italian Kitchen Cool springs
place_category: Bars, Wine Bars, Italian, Nightlife, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Awesome salads, pizza, gelato, and traditional Italian desserts and pasta dishes!!! every time I come, Leave happy! It's absolutely delicious.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: This is by far our favorite pizza place on the mainline. Our favorites are the caramelized onion and prosciutto. The combination of salty and sweet. So good. We also like to order the Felicia Special which is a nice contrast. It's spinach with roasted tomatoes and this amazing garlic oil. So good. The owner had a great personality and super nice.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Chicken Wings, Sports Bars
text: French Dip sandwich was excellent. Food was hot, juicy roast beef, and firm bun. Wow. Onion rings , beer batter were good Husband got a chicken salad - large portion. Alcohol drinks were enjoyable

place_category: Italian, Grocery, Delis, Restaurants, Food, International Grocery, Bakeries
text: Terrible pastry or maybe i had a higher expectation. Taste like a crappy mass produced desserts. good coffee. The place is very busy.

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants, Tapas/Small Plates
text: Excellent restaurant. Very fresh food and super fast service! All of the people that work there are very friendly and one of their signature things is different Lemonades and Teas every week. I have been here several time and was great every time! This time I had the Tortilla soup and the Fig Salad and wow it was very good!! The Mango Lemonade was excellent as well. This is a very new location in West Nashville and I love it!

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: They have some really good meals here-- a personal favorite is the huevos rancheros-- but it seems there is always a wait and it's always noisy. I enjoy the food but hate feeling rushed and cramped.

place_category: Southern, Restaurants, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Gastropubs, Nightlife, Beer Bar
text: First, great to see vibrancy in Fountain Square. The food was pricey but fair, nothing amazing. The cocktails were delish, lots of attention to detail there. Wait staff was friendly and showed us to an empty table about 10 seconds after we walked in and were about to turn around and leave as it looked like nothing was available. I will say, it's so hipster it hurts, and the music- so loud we were screaming to hear each other.

place_category: Poke, Food, Hawaiian, Restaurants
text: This place rocks!!!!! Lived in the Bay Area for years and always compare poke to their standards. The Poki is even better!!!! Love the options and the staff are so helpful with suggestions. The place is clean and new and I will be back regularly.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: I don't know why this place has over 3 stars. You walk into an extremely unwelcoming atmosphere and almost feel like you are intruding. The barista messed up our drinks and and we noticed right away, we pointed it out and she told us how much work it would be to fix... rude. You can get much better coffee just down the street.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Steakhouses, Cajun/Creole
text: Good, but probably not worth going to in a city amongst some of the Greats. Nothing bad to say besides the waiter was a bit pushy when my friend and I were just trying to enjoy a long dinner. We were happy with the food and wine, though.

place_category: Gyms, Tanning, Fitness & Instruction, Beauty & Spas, Food, Tanning Beds, Active Life, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: Great gym. The staff always greats you with a smile. The gym is always clean. Plenty of equipment. I never have to wait or share machines which is nice because you can get in and out quickly. The cardio theater is the only time I've enjoyed running on the treadmill. This gym is the best. Try the smoothies made by chris they're fantastic. Fun contests make coming back each time more exciting. Love this gym.

place_category: Bars, Creperies, Nightlife, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Restaurants, Food
text: Was excited about going based off great reviews. Ordered a French press and a panini. The French press is in a paper cup and when I received it they already pushed it down. Coffee was terrible. Panini was average. Yolk overdone. Average place with average service. Much better places to go.

place_category: Flowers & Gifts, Gift Shops, Cafes, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Food, Souvenir Shops, Shopping
text: Sadly a one star for the company's human values. I have come to this icon spot of New Orleans every time I have visited New Orleans. Sadly today aug 4, 2020, because of COVID, Hurricane Laura, etc. I got the answer " we are not responsible for your needs" when I requested a restroom. C'est la vie, I don't complain. However I am sad for their values down the drain don't expect me to come back for anything else besides first time experiences.

place_category: Restaurants, Irish, Irish Pub, Sandwiches, Bars, Nightlife
text: We ordered the fish & chips and the shepard's pie and both were great. The bread pudding was a pleasant surprise..too many times it turns out to be a cinnamon flavored brick..this was a wonderful combination of fluffy bread and apples, served with whiskey flavored sauce and ice cream. Will definitely visit again.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Food Delivery Services, Delis
text: I placed an order today (January 22nd) at 1:02pm for 4 sandwiches, called and spoke with store manager Nick at 1:30pm for a status check, he advised me they're running behind. Called again at 2:03pm and spoke with Nick again, I asked him to cancel the order as it's been too long and I'll drive over to pick them up myself. I also asked for a credit due to the long deliver time, he advised me he wouldn't issue as credit, he stated life happens and to get over it.

place_category: Halal, Indian, Restaurants
text: The meal was wonderful and the staff was very accommodating we ordered the chicken tikka masala and naan which were both very tasty, definitely will be stopping by if I am in the area again!

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Fork was amazing! Great menu and service. I went on a Wednesday and the place was packed but they still made room for me. I definitely recommend the grilled artichoke and butter cake! My only suggestion was less berry coulis. It kind of over powered the butter cake. Other than that, I really enjoyed it. I travel a lot and this was definitely a gem!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Food, Breweries
text: Went for happy hour. Small location, packed to the brim. Beers were awesome. $5 pickle bowl was very generous. Will b back for sure

place_category: Head Shops, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Shopping, Tobacco Shops, Grocery, Flowers & Gifts
text: Plenty of selection. Only 3 stars for customer service because it's challenging to get help.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Food
text: While the facade of this corner coffee place is sort of classic, the coffee here is perhaps the weakest of the main W. Philly coffee places. It generally comes a bit bitter, cold, and watery. That said the outside seating is nice and they sell pretty decent sandwiches It must be said however that this Green Line does not have internet (while the Locust one does, that one is next to clave which is in every way better).

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Local Flavor, Desserts
text: I was a little thrown off by this place there is a lot of selections and it was overwhelming! Being new to this place and no one telling me what this place is about I just ordered a shake it seemed like a reasonable and safe choice. I didn't enjoy it. I like custard but this wasn't good. But I will say I had my friends pistachio custard and that was great! Next time I know.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: I'm not really impressed by this Steakhouse. For the price, you'd expect more. Better plating, better quality of meats, better service. While service isn't necessarily bad, it's just not as attentive as some other steakhouse around town. If they knocked down a couple of dollars or boost their wait staff, I could justify giving this place 4 or 5 stars but at this rate, it's just OK.

place_category: Bakeries, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Desserts, Gelato, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Patisserie/Cake Shop
text: I absolutely love this place. I'm sure somewhere in Italy there are better gelaterias and pasticcerias. But there aren't that many in the U.S., and very few on the level of the 110 year old Angelo Brocato. Every time I go I get a gelato, and every time, a different suite of pastries. They're all perfect, mostly traditional, and with all of the favorites you might expect.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: The frozen grocery store White Castle can not compare to the real deal. It is soooo good, and whenever I visit my relatives in the STL I have to have those lil sliders. One time I almost missed a flight back to Cali just to get me some White Castle...Yeah, it's that serious!

place_category: Nightlife, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars
text: Let me start by saying they have really improved the look and feel of the interior. I would go on to say that this place is a poor man's J. Alexander's, except the prices are higher. Pretty good appetizers and okay entrees, a couple beers/wines and $100 later I wasn't all that impressed.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Not very clean place. Poor customer service and bad co-worker vibe. Sorry I came in.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Comfort Food, Bars, Diners, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Came for breakfast. It wasn't good. The server didn't know the menu at all. I decided on the corner beef hash and eggs. Worst ever. Just slices of corned beef on top of hash browns with a couple of eggs on top. The server let my coffee go dry and brought the check But never offered to refill the coffee. I'm moving to the area and am looking for a good coffee shop. I might come back and try the pastries and or lunch but won't be back for breakfast again.

place_category: Fast Food, Sandwiches, Shaved Ice, Food, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Food wasn't too bad. But tables were dirty in the dining room. Had to move seats because tables were ignored being clean. Been here for about 30 minutes and no one has come by to clean. Pizza was expensive for what it was. I bought the meat trio and it was literally that like 4 pieces of salami, 5 mushrooms, 6 pepperoni for the whole 12 inch pizza but the picture shows it stacked up with toppings. Pizza was burned on the bottom, leaving our hands black. Staff was nice and booths were too small.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Food was fresh and nicely done however i noticed a huge cockroach crawling near the kitchen. Staff was nice and took it out of sight

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Reno, NV Great service. Everything is in time, relaxing atmosphere. No hurry type of restaurant. Good price will defiantly come back and not be ashamed of.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Tacos, Tex-Mex
text: Quite expensive tacos ($3.75-$4.75). My shrimp in my taco was overcooked and tough. The chips had an oily aftertaste as if they used old oil. The Mexican rice is definitely not Mexican style rice. Spent about 17 dollars on a meal and it was not enjoyable or worth it. 10/10 would recommend going somewhere else.

place_category: Vegetarian, Gluten-Free, Pizza, Caterers, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services
text: They have good pizza, good woody wings, good wildebread, and good cinnaslices. But I've had a lot better. Chill place to hang. I still like it.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Most food is pretty good ate here everyday while we were on vacation. Deducted two stars because servers didn't come by us at all except for when taking our order and bringing our food. We were without drinks after the first one. Also, my son ordered mac and cheese and got the kraft boxed mac and cheese, YUCK. My recommendation is that you train your employees to check on guests a lot more often. I understand if you're busy... but then you should hire more employees.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, American (New), Burgers, Salad, Local Flavor
text: I gave it two stars cause the wait staff are great, and the bartender does a nice job. But I've been to this place many times since it opened, because it is close to my home, and the food has gone straight downhill. The burger i had tonight tasted like they ran over to the college dining hall and grabbed one from under the heating lamps. Gross. Won't be back.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: I ordered ceasar salad with seared ahi tuna. The tuner was ice cold as if the salad was stored ahead of time in a refrigerator. When I questioned the waitress she offered to heat up the tuna. I'll never come back. Unless McDonald's is closed.

place_category: Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Shaved Ice
text: The watermelon bingsu is good but it is a lot for one person.I suggest sharing it with your partner.The strawberry mountain was very bland and had almost no strawberry flavor but it was a good price for the amount we got.I would definitely come again to try all the other flavors.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Ramen, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Burgers, Japanese, Seafood
text: I always forget not to come here if I have something to talk about. I think about the music more than my meal. Maybe next time I'll bring earplugs

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Comfort Food, Diners
text: Not as good as I remember from 5+ years ago and I think the brunch menu got way smaller (didn't have fried chicken and waffles for example).

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: I came here before and ordered pad thai and it was good, but today when I ordered a pork pad thai to go.... it was just awful. The pork was so bland and unappetizing, and the pad thai had way too many shredded carrots it was not good. I don't think I will ever eat here again after my experience.

place_category: Department Stores, Shopping, Grocery, Discount Store, Drugstores, Fashion, Food, Electronics
text: This Walmart down town is always scary for me. I went with a friend to this one and we still saw customers YELLING at each other ...... Was just happy to get out of there

place_category: Caterers, Restaurants, Food, Asian Fusion, Soup, Chinese, Event Planning & Services, Noodles
text: Ate dinner there Christmas Day. Great service. The food was ok. Was disappointed as I expected better food based on the reviews.

place_name: You Korean And Japanese Best Cuisine
place_category: Restaurants, Korean, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: Came for a weekday lunch. Not at all crowded. We ordered bibimbap, bulgogi and two types of kimchi as sides. Terrific food! The cucumber kimchi was *life-changing!* So delicious! Definitely recommended!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: Vegetarian offerings have been taken off the menu. You can now choose from four side items. This is extremely disappointing in 2018. The service was lack luster at best.

place_category: Lounges, Burgers, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Sushi Bars
text: I have always liked Subzero for their yummy sushi, however the last few times I've gone, my palate has not been satisfied with them. I'm hoping this will fade, since I love the atmosphere at Subzero.

place_category: Japanese, Asian Fusion, Chinese, Restaurants, Food, Thai
text: Food: 3. Good amount of food for the price. Nothing really great. Hot and sour soup smelled weird. Service: 1. all of our waters were empty most of the time and had to track down the waitress. My husband found a piece of metal string in his hibachi and they didn't offer to refund or anything. Still looking for a good Chinese place to eat

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food
text: Everyone needs to try Raw Juice! I really want this business to last!!!! So yummy, and I think the price is very fair for what you get-- its a meal in a cup! I've loved everything I've tried & they are always happy to customize it to your liking. TRY IT!

place_category: Seafood, Southern, Food, Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Desserts, Local Flavor
text: I really enjoyed the artful display and flavorful seafood served at Grande Isle. The service was great, very friendly and knowledgable staff.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Sandwiches, Local Flavor, Restaurants
text: Best coffee I've had in awhile. I got their coco mocha cappuccino two different times and both times it was amazing. They did cute latte art, which made me smile :) Also, they are genuinely friendly and so nice! Recommend this for sure!

place_category: French, Restaurants
text: The best white tablecloth fine dining in Middle Tennessee--and at reasonable prices. Lunch was almost better than dinner. Great service and crepes to die for....so many varied menu choices from salads and sandwiches to fine French cuisine, the biggest problem here is what to choose.

place_category: Smokehouse, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Barbeque
text: I absolutely love this place and have never had a bad meal. Daily specials are the best and the brisket burger and Montreal are my two favorites. Great little hidden gem that you don't want to miss out on. Beans and applesauce are always my sides of choice.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Arts & Entertainment, Food, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Music Venues, Southern, American (Traditional), Pubs
text: Service was very friendly and kind. Food was horrible and we found a piece of plastic in the salad. Will not be returning.

place_category: Cafes, Vegetarian, Food, Bakeries, Restaurants, Vegan
text: Happy that they are Vegan ! I'm a cook and figured out suboptimal quality for this order. Disappointment that the curry bowl was excessively greasy. The French fries looked and tasted like a batch was refried. I've eaten at Cafe Mosaic for more than a decade and am not happy to see the quality deteriorate.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Wine Bars, Soup, Restaurants, American (New)
text: The Sidney Street Café in St. Louis' historic Benton Park neighborhood. Run by Chef Kevin Nashan, the Beard Best Chef Midwest in 2017. Started with the Veal Dumplings, Lobster Turnovers and Octopus Confit, followed by the delicious Watermelon Gazpacho. For entrees, the Berkshire Pork and Ribeye. For dessert: Berries, Ricotta Pound Cake, White Chocolate Cremeux and Lemon Honey Gel.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Donuts, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches
text: These are the best hot donuts in the city. I left home early to get some for breakfast. There's nothing like hot fried dough covered in sugar. It was worth the early wake up and the extra drive. I ate most of the first one before leaving the parking lot. Can't wait to go back and get more. Yum!!!

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Food Delivery Services, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Great bread sandwich, wish there was some meat. Overall it was too expensive with too few toppings. Will not return.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: I went there today for lunch and the waitress was so rude. Soup or salad is supposed to be included with the lunch special, so when I asked her about it she gave me this attitude. Then was sloppy pouring the water that it got all over the floor and didn't bother to clean it up, and she took forever bringing the water in the first place. I never see people there, and I think I know why. The food is good, but I won't ever give my business to them again.

place_category: Japanese, Ramen, Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Local Flavor, Food, Specialty Food
text: Not bad! There is a kind of the small size noodle in the restaurant. Suitable for lunch.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: I have been looking for Pho since moving here. I came across this jewel on Metairie Rd. Rolls-n-Bowls made me nostalgic for the home Pho my neighbors mom used to make. Pictured are the avocado spring roll and dark chicken pho. (Yes Pho is usually ox or beef- both are on the menu.)

place_category: Jazz & Blues, Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Wine Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: Visited New Orleans in July and this restaurant took the cake! Great ambience, awesome music and most of all excellent food! The branzino was out of this world!! The outdoor seating gives you that laid-back-under-the-stars feeling. If you go to one restaurant when you visit New Orleans, you HAVE to make it this one!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Wine Bars, Bars, Salad, Pizza
text: We ordered pizzas to go...one potato and rosemary and one pepperoni. We eat at or take out from Sauce all the time. We should have checked the food before we left Sauce. The pepperoni pizza was burnt - I mean the crust was black. The potato Rosemary had all the toppings dumped in the middle of the pizza. It looked hideous. Tasted just ok. Please don't go too far down hill, Sauce.....

place_category: Mexican, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Great carne asada tacos & cool bonus is the chip/salsa bar. Prices are decent considering this place is downtown. Sides of rice & beans could be bigger but overall a yummy place to grab a bite to eat

place_category: Department Stores, Shopping, Food, Furniture Stores, Fashion, Electronics, Home & Garden, Grocery
text: UGH!! Im very disapointed that i couldnt find a bible in target! Ive bought a bible at this target here before, so the thought that they took them away really grinds my gears.

place_category: Restaurants, Gelato, Coffee & Tea, Food, Italian, Bakeries
text: Went here for my birthday and after I had taken the LSAT and not only did they make us wait an hour and fifteen minutes when we had a RESERVATION they were pretty unaccommodating.... Obviously the food and gelato was amazing but wow... Not what I would call good service in the slightest. Figure it out guys

place_category: Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Wine Bars, American (New), Bars, Restaurants
text: I had an amazing time here. Our server was nice and funny and I loved the interior design. Yes it may be small but it's comfortable and private from all the Ybor hustling. There's a large wine and beer list and also a nice menu for munchies while enjoying your glass of choice. The amount of drink poured and food is a large portion so a big plus! Will return!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Came here after a show at the kimmel center. Nice that it was so close by, but I'm always concerned with these prime spots that a fair amount of your price is going to the high rent in these buildings and not the food. The service was nice, but they didn't really have much to do. The food was ok I suppose. Maybe I should be rating this two stars instead, but I didn't pay for my meal so I didn't feel the hit directly. The wine was mediocre but maybe it's my fault for ordering what I did.

place_category: Restaurants, Pubs, Food, Bars, American (New), Nightlife
text: I have tried several times to go and enjoy a meal at Pub and Kitchen. They are my neighborhood spot. I have never had bad food, when I could get some. place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Burgers, Sandwiches, Soup, Pubs

text: Rather over-rated, and cash only? Come on. I hate that this is hailed as the end all be all of mexican food in Santa Barbara. I'd rather go to Lilly's, avoid a line, use my credit card, and not deal with throngs of white people that don't know any better.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican

text: The simplest of foods has not been stable in the last few months. From blueberry pancakes to a BLT. How can you mess up something as simple as that. Bloody Mary's are the same. Yea! I miss the old kitchen staff.

place_category: Thai, Desserts, Seafood, Japanese, Chinese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Food
text: I have to be honest, first time my wife and I went here, the service was kind of a mess, but in the midst of that the food was just fantastic. Our favorites include the homemade pork dumplings, the pink lady roll and all of the sushi in general. Great quality and consistency. Our go to Asian food place, you won't regret it.

place_category: Chinese, Thai, Restaurants
text: I am always suspicious of Thai restaurants that have a Chinese side of the menu. We ordered the cashew chicken and the yellow curry. To me both dishes tasted more like the Chinese version of those dishes. Still good but not authentic Thai. The Tum Yum Gai was correct. Service was very good.

place_category: Bars, Pubs, Nightlife, American (New), Restaurants
text: The beer is as good as advertised but the food menu, and prices, are a letdown.

The salmon was overcooked and was dry. We noticed that the manager was kept busy at several tables fielding complaints and so we paid the bill and left. We will never go back.

place_name: State of New Jersey Motor Vehicle Comission

It had a great level of spice without being overwhelming. Definitely will be trying more things the next time we drop into Auction House Market.

place_category: Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Dance Clubs, Bars, Music Venues, Mexican, Sports Bars
text: Great hangout place, I dig the outdoor/indoor setup. Its got comfy lounge areas for bigger groups, tables all around, open space for dancing... very chill. Good music. ((Guacamole Dip)) was delicious! We were just snacking but the food looked yummy. They didnt have El Jimador, but Herradura was good even if it wasnt as chilled as I wanted it to be. Waitress was sweet and provided good service. Look forward to coming back next time Im in town :)

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: Yikes. Eight of us on the first night in NOLO. What a tourist trap. Food was cold. Service horrible. Dishes came out individually. We sat around waiting to all eat at the same time. They did give us a 50% discount for ruining our night. Pass and don't look back. Nothing to rave about. Go to Mr B's Bistro and have a great gastronomical experience. Then hit up the Carousel bar at the Hotel Monteleone for some cool jazz...and of course Beignets at Cafe Du Monde...

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Cafes, American (New), American (Traditional)

My food is just okay, not crazy about the loafs of bread hopefully they can get some bread with seasoning with garlic or other flavors.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Vegetarian, Noodles, Restaurants, Thai

text: Terrible service. Seated by a waitress only to have the hostess tell us that we can't sit there because the it was reserved. Um, ok. We moved and were promptly ignored for 10 minutes. Ordered and then waited for refills forever. The rest of the meal took forever since we were ignored for a good portion. The food was bland and standard hotel fare.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Soup, Restaurants, Japanese
text: For having to not be near an Ocean aka Treasure Valley, this place was very good, and reasonably priced. The Sushi Chef is a Chinese guy that Trained in New York, I still have to ask who he trained under, since his style is very traditional to most Sushi Chefs that live near an Ocean.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Romantic and cozy, Sorrentino's is located in the heart of Little Italy and the perfect place for a romantic destination. Service is quick and friendly, and while the menu might be a bit pricy, it is worth it for the experience. The pasta dishes are an excellent value with large, flavourful portions. There is also a number of entrees featuring meat anf seafood. Bread is complimentary -- so are the smiles!

text: Stood at the bar without being acknowledged while two men counted their tips with their backs facing towards the costumers...for about 10 minutes. You might have more money to count if you did your job. We were not the only ones ignored.

place_category: Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Food, Restaurants, Donuts
text: I LOVE their beignet. Compared to other places that serve beignet, this cafe seems to serve the fluffiness, freshest, and most delicious beignet. Make sure to pick up their coupon where you get a free cafe au lait (milk coffee) with a purchase of another item. It's a great jazzy haven from the craziness on Bourbon Street and it is great that they are open until 10pm (unfortunately I am always too late to go to their Royal St. location which closes at 5pm).

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Distilleries, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Bars, Nightlife

text: This location is running a scam with a towing company. We came here this afternoon for a to-go order. Parked in a spot which had a sign indicating 30-minute parking. Well, guess what?? place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Burgers, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sports Bars

text: The Bao is a St. Louis gem, with many superb offerings. If you haven't been, you need to soon. There's is plenty to choose from: savory or sweet, soups or bowls, wings or bao sandwiches. place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, Irish, Irish Pub, American (New)
text: I am here on a Monday night at 9:30pm. The first three items that I attempted to order were unavailable. Add in a homophobic waiter (Alex according to my receipt), and it was not a pleasant experience.

text: I was excited to try this cafe based on all the reviews. I had ordered the bubble green milk tea. The tea was very diluted and the bubbles were very gummy and not chewy as it should taste. place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants
text: We were tired of our free hotel breakfasts, so we set forth into the French Quarter and let Yelp take us here. Monday at 8am must have been a quiet time, because there was no line, though people arrived steadily after we did. Food was OK, not outstanding (veggie omelets), a bit on the greasy side. Service was counter-surly. Coffee was only so-so, and, of course, no refills. I'd go back, but I'd try somewhere else before doing so.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Nashville's best sushi. Original, fresh, and delicious. The atmosphere is just OK but it doesn't matter when the food is this good. The Hawaii roll is out-of-this-world good and so is the Sushi Burrito roll. Even their green salad with ginger dressing is amazing. This place is a must for sushi lovers.

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, Bars, British
text: Eh. I sure wish I liked Elephant and Castle because it's in such a convenient location and my job gets me a small discount there.. but no dice. I've been there twice and it's been less-than-great service, and the food is just alright. It's your standard Pub looking interior with the dark wood and random vintage things nailed all over the walls. The menu isn't that extensive, and they have a weird tag-line printed all over their napkins and menus, "Bang on!!" No thanks.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Desserts, Patisserie/Cake Shop
text: I was so very excited to see this place was on the Westbank! I had the creme brulee crepe cake. It was light and not too sweet, it's the perfect dessert for those who don't like sweets. I love that it's torched when you order. I realize now that I am just not a fan of crepe cakes. While I didn't cake for what I ordered today, I will come again and try something else. The person behind the counter who helped me was very nice!

place_category: Bars, Salad, Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Italian
text: Looks really good and a friend took me there but I wonder if people know how unhealthy calzones are. But they look awesome. I did have a great salad. For someone who doesn't have to worry about their health like myself, enjoy, wish I could.

place_category: American (New), Sandwiches, Food, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Place is hidden.... have to go into Erin Rose and walk to the back to find em.... my son and I had ordered the beer braised beef and the glazed pork belly poboys and split em... hands down... the pork belly was my fave.... the sweet glaze made gave it a nice touch with the slaw underneath the pork.... the order came out quick too.... not sure how it may be when busy..... but overall I enjoyed it!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Waffles, Restaurants
text: The food was decent - not much flavor in the omelettes...waffles were average/good...service was just okay. Ambiance was really nice - loved all the knick-knacks - and the man who seated us was super nice.

place_category: American (Traditional), Convenience Stores, Food, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Pizza, Restaurants, Bars, American (New)
text: This place has some of the best pizza I've had in New Orleans. Great wings too. Really nice setup, lots of TVs, cool bar, and right on the water. Staff is also very nice. This place is a gem in West End. I highly recommend it.

place_category: Restaurants, Vegetarian, Vegan, American (New)
text: The place is gorgeous. It's in its infancy and the training seems to be dedicated. The food however is soulless. It's pretty, healthy ingredients but things aren't that flavorful. It's all Ho hum.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: Beware! LaCumbre Habit pre cooks the burgers and they sit and wait for you to order them. The burgers aren't hot when you get them. I even ask them to cook me a brand new one and they did not.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: Cold Springs Tavern is one of my favorite places and I can't believe I never reviewed it. It's special because it's a little cabin hidden in the mountains above Santa Barbara and it feels like it's own little get away. I came up on a cold day to get some chili which was very good and of course to get away from it all. I tried to come back on a Sunday for breakfast but the restaurant was inundated with bikers. I will try to get back up there during breakfast time as I have been wanting to try it.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Burgers
text: Very friendly and helpful staff, on a Saturday night we got seated fairly fast to a nice 2 person booth. Our waiter was young, down to earth and very helpful, which is rare to find in the restaurant business. The food arrived very quickly and the young waiter checked back several times even on a busy night. I was very pleased with the service, however the food was so so. Again it is a chain restaurant, I would defiantly return for the A+ service.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Shop
text: The brussels grain bowl with fried chicken was unsatisfying because of how small it was. There wasn't enough quinoa, beets, or brussels sprouts. That said, the few brussels were good and well charred, and the fried chicken was crispy until the last bite. For the price, it was just a bit too unsatisfying.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Started off with the flatbread, which was amazing - highly recommend it. We therefore thought this was a good sign of what was to come in our entree. Wrong. Pasta was very disappointing. Bland, boring, and pretty pricey. All in all, service was great but food was mediocre at most. Probably wouldn't go back.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Whiskey Bars, American (New), American (Traditional), Venues & Event Spaces, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: If I could give it no stars, I would. The worst, most favorless meal ever. While they were semi-apologetic, it didn't make up for the food. Just bad.

place_category: Nightlife, Mexican, Bars, Restaurants, Dive Bars
text: Very low key spot! Comfortable with a nice yard. The shed outback is a little spooky but overall it chill. I would have liked bigger drinks but the tacos more then made up for it. They were really amazing. This is a great place for day drinking and conversation!

place_name: Guadalajara Grill - Mexican, Best Mexican Restaurant in Tucson
place_category: Caterers, Tex-Mex, Event Planning & Services, Seafood, Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Was really disappointed it's not how it was back then. Not much of an "authentic Mexican restaurant" all I can day is I've had better. Horchata was supposedly fresh didn't really seem like it was way too sweet like it was from concentrate. We would ask for limes we had to go chase them down because they never came. The freshly made tortillas were bad!! Definitely wouldn't recommend this place. Service was bad seemed like they only had two waiters

place_category: American (New), Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: For a bar in a train station this place is pretty damn good. I wish there was a place like this in that dump of Penn Station here in NY. Great beer selection both on tap and in bottles. Perfect spot to kill time while waiting for a train or your buddy to pick you up. Never tried the food, so cant speak for that. The next time I find myself at the philly train station I will head right here.

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Most disgusting Cheesesteak in Philadelphia. It is for Tourist, I have no reason to go there unless I want to go to the bathroom afterwards. TMI I know but this is true Tourist beware this is not what a Philly cheesesteak is supposed to taste like. Try Joe's formerly known as Chinks the best cheesesteak in the city!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Diners, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Breweries, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Brewpubs
text: This used to be a favorite, but they changed the food and it was disappointing. My fish tacos were paltry, all cabbage and almost no fish. My sons burger sliders were "sad". These used to be our favorite meals. Won't be going back for dinner, just a drink when the game is on. Too bad, but too many better choices close by. Bummer.

place_category: Bars, Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Restaurants, Hotels & Travel, Bed & Breakfast, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Pubs
text: We stopped in on Mother's Day and were seated outside in the lovely courtyard. Our waitress was so sweet and the food was delicious. A great surprise for a spur of the moment trip into Lambertville! Would return.

place_category: Nightlife, Italian, Restaurants, Bars, Seafood
text: Our favorite Italalian Restaurant in Largo. We have tried the Veal Marsalla and Lasagne. Both were excellent as was the Ceasar salad. Also enjoyed the cannoli. You will be well satisfied with their breads.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Noodles, Vegetarian
text: Just ok... This was much better in the past. It is not bad but not up to what I would consider good Thai food

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Una tarde fresca anduvimos de paseo en busca de una sabrosa Agua con frutas :') es el lugar más espectacular de todas las Paleterias del mundo hispano, dándole sabor a los países extranjeros y llevándolos a un sabor inolvidable!! Paleteria Tocumbo lugar donde encuentras el amor a primera vista. Tengo que volver!! Atte: Javier Amaya & Yuri Sabrosa

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional)
text: I decided that this would be the first upscale restaurant on my Philly burger tour so I made a lunch reservation and came in.As it usually is with these places the service was exceptional and everyone was really nice and the place was mixed with both well dressed and casually dressed people here's the breakdown Bun-- the bun was good and nicely toasted Meat--very high quality but not seasonEd Toppings--the fancy cheese and gourmet onions were adequate good but not outstanding

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Sushi Bars
text: Dragon Ball appetizer excellent, spicy & delicious. The sashimi was cut on the thin side, for the price, but taste was very good.

place_category: Seafood, Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: So I've gone back twice before updating this review and both visits were meh. The service was good, but the food was a miss. It lacked flavor and freshness. The seafood fondue was full of mayonnaise and tasted spoiled so I sent it back. The seafood entree was bland and the lobster was tough I guess over cooked a great deal. The kids didn't even enjoy their fish dinners and they love fish. I use to love Bone fish, so disappointed with the quality of food that I received.

place_category: Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Greek, Restaurants
text: Have had delivery from this place multiple times and have picked up orders now and then. Food is always solid. Unlike some places these days, actually delivers hot and ready to eat. Very polite and attentive staff. I would highly recommend. I'm a fan of such food and lived near a Greek community for many years so I've sampled a lot of this fare. In a section of town thats littered with retail/dining options, most are disappointing. The Parthenon does not disappoint.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: The shrimp enchilada with goat cheese was spectacular. Unfortunately, the restaurant was so loud I would hesitate to go back. (We visited on a Sunday evening in February when the weather was unusually warm. Maybe everyone who is suffering from Cabin Fever went out that night. I don't know.) Also, the free Margarita tasted like Sweet Water. However the enchilada was worth the price alone. I would give the food five stars.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Soup, Sushi Bars
text: The baked mussels wit wasabi was good and there Tempra was good. My entire which was a pork cutlet was not so good it took for every to come to my table and the pork was dry and tempra Crush was falling off the pork.

place_category: Tours, Local Flavor, Hotels & Travel, Arts & Entertainment, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Music Venues, Barbeque, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces
text: Got kicked out because an under-educated bouncer decided that he thought I was a "jerk" and was "slurring my words." I recorded the entire episode. I was severely embarrassed in front of the party I was entertaining, all because some bouncer had an ego-trip on me. I will NEVER go back!

place_category: Desserts, Coffee & Tea, Food, Gelato, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: The gelato here is great and the store is beautiful! But I'm consistently met with rude employees that just brush me off. Literally every time I come into this location the employees are less than great. The Ina location must have all the nice employees.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants
text: GREAT hole in the wall. This is where the locals come and its for a good reason! Priced fair and the flavor and portions are very pleasing. The type of comfort food your family makes served to you while in the NOLA. I was in NO for just a few days but started my mornings and lunches here. Avoid the advice from your hotel to try other places and stop by here!

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Fast Food, Coffee & Tea, Burgers
text: Worst McDonalds around. 20 minutes to get a quarter pound meal inside? Rude employees. Mismanagement. Dirty. Bad smells coming from outside near drive through. Avoid at all costs.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: They are recently opened but by six months they should do a little better Food freshness seems to be a little far from this place and I think thats why everything is so spicy here Waiter mixed up checks and never removed items that wasn't ordered I wouldn't go again

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Gastropubs, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Lounges, Bars
text: Cute restaurant and great location. Service was poor. Waitress took 15 minutes to greet us and get our drink orders. Would have been okay, but she had slight attitude the rest of the night and made us seem more like a burden. Food was good. Not great, but good! Also, it was uncomfortably chilly, so bring a jacket.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: wasn't impressed at all! Server says "Beers are buy one get one free" We order 2 Bill comes and we are charged for 2 beers...WHAT???

place_category: Sushi Bars, Salad, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Came in tonight for a quick dinner and it was EXCELLENT!! The Dumplings were fresh and the Steak and Shrimp Hibachi was DELICIOUS!! I would recommend this place and I will be back again.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Cajun/Creole, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: Went there for dinner Sunday evening. Had the trio gumbo, red beans rice, étouffée. They tasted ok. Lots of rice in the small bowls. The waiter and staff were great. But an hour after eating dinner, I got sick and it all came back out... yuck! Could be food poisoning. Not sure. But I wouldn't go back. :(

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Soup, Delis, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Cafes, Caterers
text: Turkey Corn Chowder is AMAZING. That is the only thing I ever order. The girls at my work and I call at least twice a week to see if they have it. They don't make it as often as I'd like, but it is reallllllly good.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Chinese, Bubble Tea, Taiwanese
text: - always good service - usually very quick service - no to minimal wait time - good to Great food - Great prices!

place_category: Vegetarian, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Sandwiches, Food
text: There were lots of people outside Surrey's waiting for a table so my hopes were high. I was particularly delighted when, after walking inside, I noticed there was an empty seat at their very small bar area where I, dining alone, could sit. Unfortunately, the service was cold and the food (poached eggs, grits and a biscuit) were all unremarkable. The 16 oz fresh OJ was very good but not worth $6.25.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Pizza, Fast Food, Italian
text: Well this little town has a reputation as the granite capitol of the world. As we nestled at our table i was looking around and the people all looked alike ,the average weight of a person was 250 pounds and more. The food was as many carbs as a man can have. But for the eating joints in this sleepy deer hunting town thats all we desired some good old pizza. If in Elberton if you want a carb over load Pizza Hut is the place.

place_category: Restaurants, Bakeries, Diners, Food
text: I always use to love going to this diner. Maybe it was just a bad experience but the food was just okay and the service could've been better. Are 75% of diner Employees on some sort of drug? Im not sure if I will ever be back again.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, Chicken Wings
text: Can't complain too much. Dominos is consistent and cheap but I wouldn't recommend paying for extra cheese. $1.50 paid and it's barely more than you'd get normally if anymore at all. Just a tip not to waste your money thinking you actually will get extra cheese after paying for it.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Seafood, Specialty Food, Food

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Izakaya, Tapas/Small Plates, Japanese, Ramen
text: The food is good, but not worth it for the price point. Being from the D.C. Area I'm use to over priced food. It's good food, but there is so much more available in Tampa at a better price and portion size.

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, Food, Bars, Burgers, Pubs, Brewpubs, Nightlife
text: Food was good but service was horrible. We had ordered 3 appetizers. The waiter forgot to put in the order for the appetizers despite being asked about it 3 times. He ended up cancelling the appetizers without asking us since our food came out first. We had to ask several times for drinks that were ordered. One drink took 30 min for him to bring, again with being asked a couple times for it. Throughout the meal we had to ask for things multiple times.

place_category: Salad, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Soup
text: Very cute and quiet. Convenient. Good assortment of yerba mate's and juice! Breakfast burrito was good!

place_name: On The Border Mexican Grill & Cantina
place_category: Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Mexican
text: Food was good, however with being allergic to avocados they seemed inconvenienced when I asked to leave it off. They still brought the guacamole to the table and I had to return it due to being allergic. So I would say the food gets a 3 but the service a 1.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: My hubby and I had lunch on Sunday we enjoyed ourselves and the food was great. I had the spinach and cheese ravioli he had the meats spaghetti!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Pizza
text: Order was not correct and the roast beef tasted spoiled. I will not be ordering here again

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch
text: As a new transplant to the area, I thought this looked SUPER cute from a drive-by earlier in the week. My friends came to visit from my hometown, so I figured this would be a great little place to check out. It is typical diner food, nothing fabulous or noteworthy. Was great for our hangover, but I wouldn't say it was the best food I've ever had.

text: The place was aight. I would not saw they have the best dessert but it's interesting. If you have a date, and want a place to experience, come to this spot. Not bad.

place_category: Active Life, American (New), Bowling, Lounges, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Nightlife, Southern, Cocktail Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Music Venues, Bars, Event Planning & Services
text: The howling experience is always fun for family. I wouldn't say the same for the food, though. My husband ordered the angus burger. Flavorless YET super salty.. asked for a double of Don Julio, can definitely tell I was jipped. Looked like one shot, with some ice in it. Smh. But hey, ya live and ya learn, next time, I'll make sure it's neat.. anywho.. I'd be back simply for the bowling

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Salad, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Worst service ever! Our waiter did not come back one time. Almost 2 full hours for the full unacceptable experience. I even had to go to the bar to get my own refill of iced tea, asked for another cup of ice and the waitress set the glass down next to the iced tea. (for me to fill it). No apologies, no "sorry the food is taking so long" by the way, it was cold when we got it. No concessions until we told them we weren't paying for the sandwich (BLT) with BLACK bacon. I'm so disappointed.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers
text: Pulled in off the interstate about 9:15pm Friday evening in hopes of ordering food and using the restroom instead I get a locked door and some rude girl sweeping the lobby laughing and waving. While the drive through is backed up 9-10 cars. Looks like this location is run extremely poorly.

place_category: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Food, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Dinning area closed. No signs, being right off the highway many people stopping to use restroom/ get food.

place_category: Convenience Stores, Food, Gas Stations, Automotive
text: Sandwich cards for a free sandwich is a bit deceptive since you can only get $5.00 off. Small print should be LARGE print since most people don't read the other stuff.

place_category: Food, Breweries, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Brewpubs
text: The Iron Hill Concept is well replicated in the Center City Space on market street. 16 different beers on tap, including the well known standards like Pig Iron Porter. I had the Oktoberfest Marzen which was a good representation of the style without being overly sweet. Service at the bar was efficient considering it was a crowded Thursday evening. Look forward to returning.

place_name: The Cake Bake Shop by Gwendolyn Rogers-Broad Ripple Village
place_category: Restaurants, Bakeries, Desserts, Patisserie/Cake Shop, American (Traditional), Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Cupcakes, French, Sandwiches, Food, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: It looks like a french dollhouse, my 5 year old daughter loves to watch them make cakes in the back. Great for very special occasions with immediate family. And the cakes are good but I'm not convinced it's $10-$14 a slice good. I actually prefer the taste of Illinois street food emporium cakes at around 1/3 the price. Still- awesome destination sweet shop to have in Indy.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Southern, Chicken Shop, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional)
text: Awesome chicken love the flavors! Juicy and delicious. I have had chicken from all over the US and Joelle's is as good as it gets. Sides were excellent and the pie in a jar was great even took one home! They even have catering! I would highly recommend this place!

place_category: Food, Salad, Barbeque, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: I must have picked the wrong day - back twice and De-Lish. Loved it.

place_category: Italian, Gluten-Free, Food, Restaurants
text: Good place to go and recommend. We had an enjoyable time here. Very large portions. The service was friendly and moved quickly. The place was a little tight for sitting though. Worth going to!

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Kinda slow service for lunch time, waited around then finally had to get it to go just to make it back to work on time.. to be fair I've only been a couple times so I hate to be too harsh as both times they were quite busy.. their pad Thai was pretty bland, asked for a 5 on a 0-5 heat scale, was like a 1 and plain. A little pricey for lunch as well at almost 13$

place_category: Seafood, Salad, Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Best margaritas in town. Get the "original" margarita. Their staff is super friendly and we love coming here!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Bars, Salad, Nightlife, Soup, Wine Bars
text: The food was very good however my wife and I were joined by my mother in law and 2 grandkids and seated directly behind us was a large table of loud people swearing and whistling at all of the ladies that walked by , we could not be moved to another table and were forced to endure this activity our enture meal. Asked for a manager but none came befire we left. Not a great experience.

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, American (New)
text: If we are in New Orleans they should have more seafood items or Cajun items on the menu. I have been wanting to go to Emeril forever and I wasnt impressed at all!!! The food wasnt nasty but whats all the HYPE about!! UGH

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: Disgusting Vietnamese food. Not authentic at all. The noodles were NOT fresh and the broth did not taste anything like an original Pho soup. Took a zip and got my money back. If you want to experience true Vietnamese cuisine, DO NOT go to this place.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Okay for a hamburger late night, doesn't have any ambiance especially for a steak house. Service with no smile. Given three stars because the French fries were hot and very good, hamburger okay.

place_category: Burgers, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Comfort Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (Traditional), Cocktail Bars
text: The first time we went to Fords Garage is was very good. Good atmosphere, great burgers and beer. The second time we went, the service wasn't great and the burgers were lacking. Not sure as to what happened but will have to go for a third time to see how it goes.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners, Burgers, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Hubby and I decided to walk to a breakfast spot this morning.Ryan's was in perfect walking distance.The area was tucked away,but very cozy inside.Hubby ordered the Breakfast Quesadilla,and I pancake.Everything was fresh and tasty! Definitely worth the money$.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, American (New), Cafes, Food, Comfort Food, Desserts, Restaurants, Canadian (New), Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: SugarBowl is a nice place, but there are lots of things they could improve on. Their table management wasn't very good and had us waiting outside when there were lots of open spots to sit. The service was slow, but the food was very nice. Drinks were spot on as well and it was a reasonable price for it all. Overall, I would recommend this place if you are not in a rush and want casual service.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Specialty Food, Restaurants, French, Delis, Food
text: Very nice restaurant in a very cute part of East Nashville. The almond croissant was so delicious, definitely a highlight. The peaches and ricotta to share are just ok, I would say go for the croissant instead. The crepe de jour was amazing, perfect amount of heartiness after such a lot of sweet for a great brunch! Get there early, this place fills up.

place_category: Food, Thai, Restaurants, Desserts
text: My husband and I got takeout from here. They only let you use one of the Yelp offers, either 10% off or the banana dessert...not sure why they have them both listed then. The drunken noodles were ok, definitely not the best we've had. Unfortunately it tasted a bit bland. Red curry was OK, but again nothing that I'd be craving weeks from now. There wasn't enough tofu and I feel like the veggies soaked up a lot of the curry...needed more liquid. Portion sizes are pretty generous.

place_category: Dive Bars, Burgers, Cocktail Bars, American (Traditional), American (New), Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Came here for a quick bit to eat. They keep the doors opened so the inside isn't much cooler than the outside. We came unknowingly on a televised soccer game or something so everyone else there was screaming and chanting at the multiple tvs airing the game. The food was okay, everyone that recommended is to this place claims it's the best. I think I just came on the wrong afternoon. I'll try again soon and post an update.

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Sandwiches, Grocery, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food
text: This location is the closest food shop if you're visiting the Garden District. No budging on the daily specials they only offer them on the date specified, weird I know. All types of Po-Boys here at a decent price. I read previous reviews saying they did not accept credit cards but they accepted them when I visited in April. Seating is in an open area with lots of windows giving you cool breeze while you enjoy your food.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Chinese
text: Decent Vietnamese food in Reno. The price is almost decent. If I'm in town and is craving Vietnamese food, I'll hit this place up again.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Seafood, Burgers, American (Traditional)
text: I had the Eggs Lafitte at Russel's Marine Grill. Very nice plate indeed with a wonderful lump crab meat sauce over poached eggs that sat upon a delicious fried green tomato and fried eggplant medallion. Chase it with an Arnold Palmer, then take a nap... It's a great place for family with nice folks working the tables, a lot of fun to come to. Thanks Russel's!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Southern, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: The food was good. I had the fried green tomato BBLT (bologna, bacon, lettuce, and tomato) and it was a great bite for lunch. I'm not sure I would seek this place out if I weren't going to the Country Music Hall of Fame after, but for a quick bite beforehand, it was perfect. They also have a good selection of local beer.

place_category: Malaysian, Nightlife, Bars, Salad, Cocktail Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Japanese, Restaurants, Ramen, Filipino, Pan Asian, Chinese, Asian Fusion
text: Came here the other day and I was a little disappointed. Although the restaurants overall idea is creative and the ambiance is cool, the costumer service was hectic and not at all very kind. It seems as if it is not organized and wait time was long for anything. I recommend to try but you most likely won't go again, unless you want bad service and westernized tapas.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Bars, Lounges, Restaurants, Nightlife

place_category: Restaurants, Wraps, Salad, Sandwiches

place_category: Food Court, Food, Restaurants, Distilleries, Breweries

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Not impressed, we ordered half the menu, prices were a little steep for what you get (I thought the prices were good until I saw the portions) I prefer East LA tacos any day. place_category: Restaurants, Beer Bar, Pizza, Beer Gardens, Nightlife, Burgers, Bars

place_category: Delis, Restaurants, Convenience Stores, Grocery, Food

place_category: Food, Event Planning & Services, Asian Fusion, Chinese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Thai, Vietnamese, Caterers

Atmosphere was great.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Delis
text: Slack's is always clean and bright with relatively fast service. The overhead television is always tuned in to ESPN during lunch which is a bonus. Their cheese steaks are decent, however, every time I go to Slack's, I leave wondering why I went back in the first place... $8 for a foot long, mildly stuffed cheese steak with mushrooms and $2 for a fountain soda is not necessarily what I call value.

place_category: Food, Donuts, Coffee & Tea
text: Far in between but every time I come here I have a problem, I was the only one in line and didn't get helped for at least 5 minutes.... after that I ordered a larg matcha for almost 6 dollars and it's literally nearly half empty. I only come here for convenience but it's proving to be inconvenient every time. And now after my first sip the drink tastes too milky too so I can't even give them that.

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: My husband and I finally visited Basil's, we were not disappointed for the casual Italian food atmosphere we were seeking. We ate outside to enjoy the fresh air, ordered their feature salad of the evening, Fennel and Arugula which was very good with pickled fennel. We were tossed between several items to order for the main, went with the Lasagna which I'll have to order again it as it was an authentic family recipe, filling, and good. Bread, olive oil, balsamic vinegar added to the meal.

place_category: Latin American, Colombian, Restaurants, Food, Caribbean
text: Honestly, pretty disappointed in my meal here. text: Favorite new spot! They have a great and unique beer selection, which I love! And the owners are awesome! So nice, and they know their beers!! place_category: Restaurants, Korean
text: This place is great and I love the concept. It's reasonably priced and given you a diverse selection of food which is an overall healthier choice for lunch that will still fill you up. We got the tteokboki, a bulgolgi kimbap, and mandu. everything was very good, the kimbap was stuffed with filling and flavor and service was quick. Next time I go I am going to get there lunch plate to try it. Very great choice for lunch in the area

place_name: The Red Cedar Grill and Cocktails
place_category: American (Traditional), Seafood, Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Went to dinner with my wife and 3 kids. Wife ordered a glass of wine kids ordered sodas. Took forever to get the first glass of wine. Had to ask several times for it. Wife's entree came out after everyone was finished with their dinner and it was over cooked. Manager comp'd the meal and her drinks to try and make up for it. Which was a nice gesture. Won't be going back anytime soon.
