place_category: Restaurants, Gastropubs, American (New)
text: Stopped in while traveling to Philadelphia for work; super convenient to the Marriott Marquis if you don't want to go far. Service was attentive and food came out super quickly. The meatballs had good flavor with the pesto sauce and my pork chop was cooked perfectly.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Chinese, Asian Fusion
text: I've been to several Wok Box locations and liked it. At this location they were VERY skimpy with the meat. I ordered the beef rice box and there were only TWO small pieces of meat and just a few veggies in the box. It was 90% rice. If this was my first wok box experience I would be write off the whole chain as terrible. I will be going to Edo over this location for sure.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: LOVE the Worker Bee. It's like being in your grandma's home kitchen. The owners are are so sweet and cheerful. The decor is lots of Bee stuff and Wizard of Oz. Great breakfast all the time! Yummy Patty Melts. You can't just help but be happy in a place full of lots of smiles and good food. There should be no complaining allowed in a place like this! :-)

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: We did not feel safe not welcome at the Popeyes near Bourbon Street. Many homeless just hanging out inside and out. ..... food was dry and not fresh. This was a very poor choice for dinner.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Fast Food
text: Best BBQ I've had in a long time, other than at home! We have had bbq all over this country, from South Carolina to Texas to Wyoming. Here in Reno, to find brisket that was tender and smoky, what a treat! Sides are homemade goodness. The dad and son team here are doing some tasty bbq.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Japanese, Bars
text: A very traditional Japanese tasting menu. This seven course tasting gives you the most amazing experience of a true Japanese meal. Staring with an appetizer box in which the food represents good fortune, health for the new year to desert of sweet potato or a sesame pudding. Not only was the taste pleasing to the pallet, but the presentation was beautiful.

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants
text: Service was extremely slow. Not many customers and probably took close to 45 minutes. No kitchen staff came in and had manager cooking. Out of a couple of items. Should have not open if you can't serve. Last time we ate here we had a good experience but not today.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants
text: Disappointing. I had the chicken teriyaki with extra chicken. Hmm . . . the chicken was definitely strange. The rice was good. The sauce was flavorful. It was not real hot, just warm. In all, my meal of this and a coke was $11. I could have had much better elsewhere.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Food, Specialty Food
text: The sushi nor the service was very good. Really long wait times and the place wasn't even full. Poor service. The sushi was just blah. The sushi ya in Twin Falls is much better. I am going to have to agree with the other yelpers on this. Sushi Ya Boise is just not good.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: The food has always been delicious at this restaurant at Macho! Service is not all that... but the food sure is worth it.. they just gotta work on being more friendly..

place_category: Gastropubs, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional)
text: If you like diners, this place is a gem. After a very long day of traveling, it was pretty nice to sit in the diner and listen to the crowd enjoying karaoke night in the lounge. My regret is that I took my food picture after I already started eating. My Folk of Seamulls was a very good patty melt. The fries were true home fries. I indulged in a (2) refreshing mint julep. But first, I had a very refreshing Green Tea shot.

place_category: American (New), Seafood, Restaurants
text: Meh. I was so excited about this place and after several vists, I'm underwhelmed. The neighborhood needs more restaurants lke this. The cocktails are fantastic, but the food is always off in one way or another. I wonder if they actually taste some of the stuff they are serving. Prices are gooo. There doesn't seems to be a lot of consistency even when my friend and I ordered the same entre. Open late. Along the same lines as Root, but not as well executed.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: The chicken LoMein had hardly any chicken in it. What chicken was in it were nothing but insignificant scraps. It was a slap in the face. More and more Chinese restaurants are charging you more and you're getting less. I think I'm going to steer clear of all of it.

place_category: Szechuan, Bars, Lounges, Nightlife, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Chinese, Karaoke
text: MEH says it all. Bunch of super drunken peeps upstairs and not enough seats. Will not be going back.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Portions are great for the price. Private parking is a PLUS. It's not a homemade ice cream parlor but the soft ice cream is delicious. I only gave it a 3 star considering my banana split had 4 banana slices and few strawberries, there was no pineapple or nuts . Like I said prices are cheap for a big portion of ice cream but when it comes down to the actual toppings and syrups they dont give you next to nothing.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Mongolian
text: Clean, tasty, 10 bucks. That about sums it up! Plenty of room, not too crammed in like some places, booths were comfortable and clean. I would go back again!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Rice too big, fish too thin, wait too long, fish too bland. Bar has better service than tables. If you like rolls covered in sauce, this is ok. If you like traditional nigiri, where the flavor of meat is important, stay away.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: The food.was ok, but the coconut chicken soup didn't have much coconut richness and the super soup was tasteless, with all food missing a full bodied flavor. It wouldn't be hard to remove the MSG and add some flavor...

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I called and put a order in for chicken and waffles I got a call 5-7 minutes later to say they have no waffles substitute something I said okay French toast we hung up we agreed. place_category: Caribbean, American (New), Restaurants

I give more stars to the corn casserole, balsamic tomatoes and plantains. For parents, the green beans are kid friendly. Top of the list of unique options is the garlic cilantro sauce. The only negative was that the rolls are cold. I want them warn and soft. Waaaa waaaa, poor me. Also, there is a boneless chicken option.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: This place is okay Maybe I went on a bad night, my meal was nothing to write home about. My lobster was very small and very bland. The waiter was friendly and very attentive.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Vegetarian, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: We are leaving the Tucson area and had to stop by our favorite breakfast place. This was our first stop three years ago and our favorite ever since. I highly recommend this place, you won't regret it.

place_category: Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Thai, Asian Fusion, Bars
text: My fiancé and I decided to try this restaurant out for the first time since we were nearby. Service was nice and quick but the food could have been better. It was just meh. The best entree we ordered were the shrimp tempura sushi rolls and that's saying something since this is a Thai restaurant. We ordered three entrees from the lunch menu and with tip included, it was around $50. The entire experience was pleasant but would not personally come back.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Cheesesteaks, Burgers, Pizza, Sandwiches

My wife and I both agreed we'd skip the appetizer if we return.

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants
text: nothing special, except the vast menu for chicken wing lovers. Wings are good, but not noteworthy. Avoid this joint on national party days and especially super bowl sunday.

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Seafood, Caribbean
text: Another great meal at Doc Fords. Arrived and my companion was already seated with menus and water. Hostess are was busy, so appreciated bypassing. Had crab cake appetizer, ceviche and iceberg (wedge, not called wedge) salad. Tasted great. My 2nd visit, Doc Fords is becoming a fave!

place_category: Fast Food, Chicken Shop, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caterers
text: Been to chick fil A's just about everywhere I can find them. I love how kind the staff is anywhere I go. The food is always the same. Nothing phenomenal from a culinary aspect. But there's just something about it.. I really love the waffle fries dipped in the chick fil a sauce I also appreciate how clean chick fil a is compared to other fast food chains.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Soup, Chinese, Cantonese, Asian Fusion
text: Wait staff somewhat rude and condescending. The Fried Rice was lukewarm to cold and very bland. Taste like it had been several hours beforehand and just sit there. The Green Tea was extremely weak and practically colorless. When we finished we are light eaters and so we left some on our plate the waitress said "you want to take home", we said no Thank you we are full. place_category: Comfort Food, Bubble Tea, Restaurants, Tea Rooms, Asian Fusion, Coffee & Tea, Food

text: Terrible service. Waited 40 minutes with no service and without as much as a drink or acknowledgement. Save yourself and your friends and family. It isn't worth the letdown. Left after almost an hour. Worst service ever. Never again.

place_category: Cafes, Canadian (New), Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife
text: The reviews and pictures looked awesome. But when we arrived June 23, the menu had recently been revamped. There was 7 of us and no one was super impressed with their craft cocktail orders. They also took the sticky toffee off the dessert menu: Boooo. We tried the (very) deconstructed rhubarb: not great. More pretentious that tasty.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Wine Bars, Restaurants, Cafes, Food, Bakeries, Nightlife, Bars
text: Great cup of coffee, they didn't have much for baked but goods, but who cares when the coffee is this on point. Means we got to come back and try it again.

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: Just don't go with a groupon. The food was less than stellar and worse than anytime I have eaten there paying full price. I got a crab joint with tiny legs while the lady sitting next to me got two crab claws. I may go back, but may not.

place_category: American (New), Bars, Sandwiches, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Cocktail Bars
text: My friends and I visited this establishment for brunch because it came up as one of the top 10 best brunch spots in Philly. Three of us went and only one of us would return. My friend is a huge fan of Prince and purchased their "Purple Rain" drink and it tasted like Purple bubble bath. The music was great and so was the customer service but the food was below average in my opinion.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: You really do get a lot of food for your money, and it's reasonably cheap. There's nothing really special about it-or bad about it. The "eat in" experience is a little rough, because their plastic forks are tiny and make it a pain to eat. It's pretty much as advertised, and it's not expensive by any means. Whoever said they paid $30 for something is thinking of somewhere else, because everything in under $10 in this joint.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood
text: I would not go here. We waited two hours. She told us 45 min. Food was cold and service sucks. Order was .messed up. I highly recommend you don't go here. They had empty tables. Very slow

place_category: Food, Cafes, Sandwiches, Internet Cafes, Restaurants
text: Very yummy! Food is great and the variety in the soda machine is fun. I love finishing my meal with some frozen yogurt.

place_category: Latin American, Vegetarian, Mexican, Restaurants
text: You will get war flashbacks to middle school. Okay, hear me out...why is this restaurant decorated with those weird blue chairs that you had the displeasure of sitting in all throughout K-12. Other than that, this place is extremely expensive. The tacos were 4.50 (compared to bar taco 2.50) The margarita was subpar. The burrito was pretty good tho.

place_category: Food, Health Markets, Vegetarian, Specialty Food, Salad, Restaurants
text: Fantastic Healthy Fast Food. Locally run and owned, this Salad Bar is a hidden gem amongst the crappy greasy places that serve food in and around the University. The portions are large and price is great. The co-owners will most likely serve you so there is heart behind each order taken and served. And the kicker is almost all meals can accommodate a Gluten Free lifestyle. Celiac Friendly!

place_category: Southern, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Live/Raw Food, Hotels & Travel, Hotels
text: The crawfish bisque was delicious. And I bought thee bottles of their house brand hot sauce to take home. However, their oysters on the half are atrociously bland. I had to pour salt and cocktail sauce (really good cocktail sauce) just to get a slight rise out of them.

place_category: Food, Desserts, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Food marginal, specialty cocktail weak. Staff very nice but won't go back. Same as when it was "canoe's"

place_name: The Drafting Room Tap Room & Grill
place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Bars
text: Have been to this place many times and very good. Unfortunately, we were there in early Dec and had food poisoning later that evening. Don't know if they changed management or chefs but can't go back after suffering thru! Sorry, they need to better control food spoilage and handling

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Wine Bars, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Service was wonderful. Very prompt and genuine. I had the traditional eggs Benedict. My eggs were way overcooked! No ooze at all. My husband ordered the daily eggs Benedict. One of his eggs was perfect, the other was overcooked. The potatoes looked like fast food hash browns! Very surprising! We are leaving the city today, but based on this meal, I would not have had brunch here again. Very expensive for such a mediocre meal. I'd go to Stanley's or the Ruby Slipper instead.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants
text: This place has very good tandoori chicken and the rogan josh curry was great (lamb). Great service as well. We would definitely come back here again, on our next Santa Barbara trip!

place_category: Malaysian, Nightlife, Bars, Salad, Cocktail Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Japanese, Restaurants, Ramen, Filipino, Pan Asian, Chinese, Asian Fusion
text: Average at best. My wife and I had 2 apps and 2 lunches and all were just ok. Nothing stood out as must have again.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Bakeries, Food, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: ZolliKoffee is the coffeeshop inside Jackelope Brewing. It's tiny - just the coffee bar itself, but you can sit in the brewery with your coffee. It's not a bad place to enjoy a coffee, but I wouldn't get a coffee here unless I was at Jackelope anyway getting a beer. Because who wants to enjoy just a coffee at a brewery? And, let's be honest, who wants to park at Jackelope just for a coffee? But the coffee's not bad.

place_category: Vegan, Food, Vietnamese, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Bubble Tea
text: ... always enjoyed downtown location... first Time to lounge... awesome spot, great food and nice people!

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Lounges, American (New), Restaurants, Nightlife, Music Venues
text: I Came in for happy hour and was wonderful . Half price appetizers ,try the avocado rolls and the . Calimari

place_category: Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Acai Bowls
text: Pricey. Got the regular Sedona bowl almost $12, with tip almost $14!! By the time you get it and stir all ingredients together you are lucky if you get 1/2 - 2/3 full!! I went back at another time thinking maybe it was just that one time & nope came up short again. So I asked if they could top it off w/ more Acai & they charged me $2.50!!! Bowls are good however not worth the price, maybe for a full cup it'd be worth it!!Employee said cups have 5-7 oz in them!! Guess I'll go elsewhere!

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Pizza, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Food, Bars
text: Get the pizza special on Friday night. Ask for it well done and pick up a fancy 6 pack. You don't like fancy, they have plenty of "normal" beer too. If you stay Jager is always cold and the Superfries are great. This is a regular Joes bar with a nice food menu and some great beers. You can do a shot and a beer too and no one will bat any eye. Great stop.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces, Restaurants, Hotels, Event Planning & Services
text: I had a booking at the westin Philadelphia, I called a few days before my stay and was told there was no cancellation fee (as I needed to make a change to my plans). I cancelled but the end the charge was not refunded. They lied to me and I had to pay for it Thanks. Won't do business there again.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Crap service, decent salads. My friends ordered crab dip which was dropped on the floor and left there. When we pointed it out to the server, she muttered "Accidents happen!" smiled weaklyvand left. Guess what? It was left there for the rest of the meal and we weren't even compensated!!!

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants
text: The food is not bad, just your average.I have a problem when people are cheating me out of my correct change which has happened twice here. The first time I thought it was an honest mistake. However, I was still standing close to the counter and the next customer (paying the same amount) was given the correct change. There are many restaurants and I will not give this one any more of my business. Honesty is always better for business!

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Candy Stores, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants, Soul Food, Specialty Food
text: Loved it! Had the red beans and rice and a side of collards. It was delish!! My husband had the turkey wings and crowder peas and okra. We were stuffed. So much good food. Large portions.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Ramen, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants
text: The best thing about this place was when they had $1 Nigri on Mondays. They now increased the price to $2 and half the selection, without updating their website. Not really good enough to go besides that. I would recommend going to United a few blocks away from 430-6 everyday for half off sushi. Half the price and better quality.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Great neighborhood sushi spot. My husband and I love to walk over for some All You Can Eat. I just noticed that they have opened a new Sakana Express in the parking lot next to Raleys on Robb Drive.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: This place is a nice place to eat with friends but for people with dietary restrictions, their plates are not flexible! For example, we wanted to take bacon out of one of the pizzas but they couldn't do it. There were no recommendations either... We ended up getting the sausage chicken pizza after reading the menu for awhile and it was delicious! Agood size for how much it was. Hopefully they can be more flexible with dishes in the future!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: This is a fantastic place to eat the service is wonderful and the food is the best, the prices aren't bad but mostly you cannot beat the service.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Local Flavor, Tacos, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Mexican
text: This is a good after-work bar with cheap beer to appeal to the boys. The better liquor selection is lacking, but it's not supposed to be that kind of bar.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: The food is consistent and tasty, and the prices are good. For $15 You can get enough General Tso's, rice, and dumplings for 4 meals.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Buffets, Ethiopian, Coffee & Tea
text: I traveled through Ethiopia for three weeks. I have tried many of the Ethiopian restaurants in Nashville, and this is by far my favorite. The Kitfo is amazing. And the Shiro Wat is my other favorite.

place_category: Food Trucks, Food
text: Can I give half a star? $12 for a beef brisket bowl, which had 3 tator tots, a scoop of coleslaw, and 4 tiny slivers of beef. When we asked if that was it, they threw in 5 more tator tots. Tough meat, overpriced, and bad service.

place_category: Donuts, Food, Bakeries, Diners, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea
text: Get the same coffee every time I come here. This morning it tasted horrible and seemed like there was more cream that what I asked for. Icing on the long john had completely run off the donut in the bag within the 2 minutes of me leaving the drive through. Coffee needs more consistency from worker to worker.

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Chicken Wings
text: Nothing like going to a place and be ignored. The worst part is that hostess knew and walked past us three times. We felt invisible. So we walked out. We watched people sit near bar waited on the second the sat down and arrived way after. We are not likely to go back

place_category: Local Flavor, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Pizza, Salad
text: The pizza topping options are creative and generous. The restaurant has a wonderful patio to sit on when the weather is nice. Pizza is just okay in my opinion, which is why I gave it the a-okay rating. I don't go out of my way to go on my own, but will go if friends want to go. I'm generally not a huge fan of soft spongy crust.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Bars, American (Traditional), Mexican
text: The food was good but I feel like this place may just need a management overhaul since they seem to be skimping. There were more people waiting for a table than in the practically empty booths. They took most of the items I used to order precovid off the menu and my margarita was all ice. Not even exaggerating when I say I got 5 sips out of it.

place_category: Food, Donuts, Burgers, American (Traditional), Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Cute place but donuts were almost flavorless. The dough was lackluster. I had maple bacon and my husband had Boston cream. Maple bacon was okay, but the boston cream had no flavor at all. We also tried the nitro coffee brew which I enjoyed. Maybe it was the donuts on that day but they look better than they taste. I think they tried to think of unique and interesting flavors but fell short in actually perfecting their recipes.

place_category: Seafood, Venues & Event Spaces, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Bars, American (New)
text: Really disappointed. Service Was lackluster. The lobster roll was underwhelming and the oysters were tasteless. Clam chowder was good but could have used pernod. Beautiful location, great patio. It should do well with tourists but as a local I would not return.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Southern, Sandwiches, Chicken Shop, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Wraps, American (New), Tacos, American (Traditional), Mexican, Food, Donuts
text: I've been before and the sandwich and donuts were amazing but this time ordered wings to go. Have to say highly disappointed in them. Flavor just ok but to spend $11 on six "jumbo" wings is ridiculous especially when what we got could barely be considered normal size. These fell short on expectations big time.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Korean, Japanese
text: I drove a little bit to get to this spot but it was totally worth the drive! Great customer service from the waitress to the sushi chef. The owner, Joe was very appreciative and gave me a complimentary mochi ice cream ball! The recommended lobster roll did not disappoint either. They have a all you can eat lunch special for $17.50 and dinner for $24.50, which I plan to do next time. Happy I found a nice little sushi spot in my new city!

place_category: Tiki Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: Love this place. Grilling here is excellent and the hurricanes are lovely. Been a few times and will always come back. Nice and chill. Recommended.

place_category: Food, Salad, Barbeque, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: My favorite place we ate at in Nashville. Good BBQ- I loved the pinto beans, brisket tacos, and corn bread pancake. Pretty noisy and cold in the place. So don't plan on talking much and bring a sweater.

place_category: Tapas/Small Plates, Nightlife, Pubs, American (New), Wine Bars, Restaurants, Italian, Coffee & Tea, Bars, Food
text: The worst freakin service.... I almost left before anyone came. The food was HORRIBLE ... No basil as listed in my caprese .... Giant peppercorns that almost broke my tooth. I couldn't even finish it!hige waste of time and money!

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: Oh. My. Goodness. This place is awesome. I definitely suggest checking it out (especially after an evening of over indulging). It's super easy to order and it only took us about 10 minutes to get our food. The biscuits are perfect. Think soft, buttery, melt in your mouth goodness. The sandwiches are a good size, so one is enough for a meal. I also suggest getting a side of their fries. They are seasoned really well and just overall delicious.

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Nightlife, Bars, Seafood
text: Passed though twice in the past week. Ok food. They really need to clean the beer tap lines. Two different beers same sour taste. It's clear that the Chase family sold their name.

place_category: Southern, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Breakfast & Brunch
text: well the peabody location is closed ......its supposed to open in downtown franklin..... so we had to go to the granny white pike location.... it wasnt as nice and the food was a notch off so hence the minus one point

place_category: Pizza, Sandwiches, Burgers, Restaurants
text: Did delivery and got two pies, one with vodka sauce and one with pepperoni /Calabrian chili. Both had excellent flavor and enjoyed the pleasantly greasy and crispy square Detroit dough. The $15/$18 for a personal pie stings. And though I loved the dressing, the $15 for a small raw Brussel sprout salad stings more. I don' t regret the order but its not quite enough bang for your buck.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Gastropubs, Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Caterers, Seafood, Event Planning & Services, Beer Bar
text: Good food but really bad service. Ordered take out and they put in the incorrect order. Manager came over and she did not apologize. They got the order wrong a second time - no apology and wanted to charge me more than what I originally paid . Will not return

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Salad, Delis, Bagels, Food, Restaurants
text: Decided on a whim to try this place. Was extremely underwhelmed for the price. Blueberry Bagel did not taste fresh or have much blueberry taste at all. Also, it was a little smaller than I'm used to. I didn't expect the eggs to be microwaved either, a big no for me. The employee was okay, but could've said the price and thank you. Will not be returning.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Local Flavor, Desserts
text: One word- delicious!!! This place lives up to the hype. It's in the middle of a neighborhood that made me think of Boston or philly. They don't want to move off Route 66 so they stay. The were lines and they moved super fast. We had 6 different things and they were all good. I loved the mocha one the best. We got micros but could have eaten minis. Yum!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food
text: Slowest backyard burger I've ever been to. Takes 60+ seconds for them them to answer the drive through. And don't try the peach cobbler...Burnt, old and dry. Stay away from the sorry excuse for a backyard burger.

place_category: Southern, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Sandwiches
text: Service was very slow for breakfast. She was nice, but kept being called away by the manager to help other servers. The biscuits (homemade) needed a lot of work. Very dry. Hopefully it was just 1 batch gone wrong. Very expensive for what we ordered, simple breakfast fare. We will try again, maybe for lunch instead.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Burgers, Fast Food
text: this is the McDonalds i only hit up after a night out on the town,... it seems to be the only fast food place around or place i can remember where fast food is. plus grease is great after drinking. the service is alright at best, they are an average for speed, the food is OK for McDonalds, it doesn't rock or stand out better than any other McDonalds, but if your looking for McDonalds, here is an OK one

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: I got the chicken platter. Not very much season to be honest . However. It was supperrr tender. Fall off the bone. I guess if you pair it with some BBQ sauce it's not that bad. Side dishes weren't so great (fries and green beans ). Was told they were out of ribs somehow several people who ordered after received some. Guess it was miscommunication in the kitchen. Idk.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Pleasant staff. Excellent waiter. Pasta a bit pricey for a strip mall dinner experience. Pasta properly cooked, sauce OK, portions large. Nothing 'off' yet not unique enough for a return visit.

place_category: Diners, Tex-Mex, Restaurants
text: Always a pleasure coming here. Probably will be back next week! Favorite brunch place in STL!

place_category: Nightlife, Food, Delis, Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants
text: Excellent beer selection! They even had Bell's, a Michigan beer which I've missed a bit since moving to Philly. They are a bit pricey, and most things don't have prices so the trip the register can be a bit surprising. The food looks good too, but I have yet to try it.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Quality has gone down since the last time I ordered here. My last order was really bad and they messed it up. Probably gonna have to find a sushi place that delivers

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Brazilian, Restaurants
text: Great location, great food, and great service. The restaurant is elegantly decorated, the food is perfectly prepared with a very Brazilian and organic flavor. The host, servers, and management do a superb job. I would certainly recommend it for steak lovers. Prices were on the high side, but commensurate with the overall quality of the experience. Must try!

place_category: Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Bars
text: Nothin' fancy, fer sure. But, it's a place to meet with friends, have a nice, cold beer, maybe some wings and enjoy the boats that cruise along the river. Service was quick tonight, even though it was very busy. My beer was cold. I was relaxed with friends. Mission accomplished.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: .Burger Madness Special Cute place sit outside on a nice day! Good food! Great Staff! We had a nice time.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Disappointed tonight....Linguini and clams had zero flavor, where was any seasoning? The chicken piccata also had no flavor. Went to bed hungry.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Salad, Sandwiches
text: Always seen this burger place and never really payed it too much attention until a friend of mine compared them to in & out. After that statement it was a must try. iordered tha club something or other with onion rings.. an boy was it delicious! Kant wait to go back and try other menu items.. thank you Habit Burger Grill!

place_category: American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants, Lounges, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Chocolatiers & Shops, Food, Specialty Food, Desserts, Bars, Fondue
text: Let's start out with this: 3 different glasses of wine were chosen, and they were out of ALL of them. I felt bad for our waiter, having to come back that many times (and by the time we got our 4th choice 2/3 the way through our chocolate fondue). The young staff was nice, and were trying, but the whole experience put a bad taste in my mouth. To be fair, the chocolate fondue put a great taste in my mouth. I won't write the chocolate bar off completely, but it's further down my list for sure.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Comfort Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Best shrimp poboy I've had in a long, long time. Bread was light and crusty, shrimp were fried to perfection, light on the mayo, lettuce and tomato were fresh, and topped it off with a Barq's root beer. It doesn't get any better, period. Tip - Crowded when we got there, but took a seat inside. Took my order quickly, served quickly, food was piping hot. If the line is long outside, try the bar area inside. Lots of tables.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, French, Bakeries, Salad
text: I am obsessed with the Les Tomates/Garlic Lovers sandwich and the seasonal Lavender Lemonade. I would buy it by the gallon!!! It's soooo delicious. They also have a terrific dog-friendly outdoor patio. My French Mastiff loves to eat at Ghini's as much as I do :) Probably because he gets spoiled with treats whenever I bring him.

place_category: Fast Food, Mexican, Restaurants
text: This location is awful. Things are never cooked right and they run out of food all the time. I dont usually write reviews, but I thought I could at least save someone else's time and money. Don't go here. I love chipotle, but this one sucks.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Fast Food, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Do not come here if you're looking for a quality QDoba experience. This restaurant is frequently out of staple items on the menu. The staff are not courteous & move extremely slow. Today, the temperature in the restaurant is unbearably hot. There is liquid on the floor near the soda machine, an accident waiting to happen.

place_category: Sandwiches, Gluten-Free, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Add another top-notch brunch spot to the list for Indy. The menu certainly has something for everyone, though my favorite is Kalamity Katie's Border Benedict (and I've tried other items, they just aren't the same!). The coffee station makes any wait you may have bearable, and the bar is perfect if there are just two of you.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Barbeque, Bars
text: Gave this place another try. Poor quality food , poor service, increased prices. Never again.

place_category: Pubs, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Dance Clubs, Bars, American (New), American (Traditional), Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Fell in love with this place my first time going in. The food is good and the beer is better. Vegetarian friendly which is always a plus. The atmosphere is nice if you just want to hang out and don't feel like being bothered with typical bar shenanigans. Definitely going back

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Went there for my bday with my girlfriend, salads were good, my fettuccine Alfredo was good my girlfriends food did not taste good at all, waiter was rude and an ass, bus girl literally tried to clean up our food every 2 mins when we clearly were not done eating which was annoying so it was hard to enjoy my food. Overall food was decent and service was shit.

place_category: Food, Donuts, Coffee & Tea
text: this establishment always seems to mess up my Iced Mocha Latte :-(

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Restaurants, Acai Bowls
text: The drinks are always great but the customer service is horrible. The workers always seem to be annoyed they have to do their job.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Great sushi rolls in an unexpected location. The albacore roll was my favorite with spicy jalapeños on top. All sushi rolls come with a house salad and miso soup. The service was fantastic and we were well taken care of. They also offer 10% off for active duty military!

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Their Mi bo kho was very tasty. Make sure you are not wearing any white when it because it can get messy. I really loved their soup, it was very well made. This place is definitely a neighborhood gem and a must try to all the Pho or vietnamese soup lovers.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Avoid at all costs. This food was absoultely terrible. The wonton soup had no taste. The Chicken Teriaki was awful. Gave it to the dogs. The seafood combo was mushy and tasteless. Could not eat the california roll. Waited over 40 minutes to get this junk.Do not order from here.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Went here on business, searched for local pub. Their menu on here is NOT right they do not have pub food. They have things like fried Brussel sprouts, bone marrow, general thao's chicken, and lamb. Their menu is SO random and apparently "changes every week". Their beers were extensive and probably the best part of the meal. If you're feeling adventurous this is the place to go, otherwise... NOT pub food.

place_category: Waffles, Creperies, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: The name says it all. The best breakfast in town hands down. Fresh fruit on the Royal is so worth it.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Cafes
text: Went for breakfast on a Friday morning at 8:45. Only a few customers when I walked in, but the place filled up after I got there. Just had a couple of eggs with home fries and toast. Not bad. I didn't try the biscuits and gravy just because I don't eat that kind of stuff. Service was reasonably quick, quite friendly and courteous. Clean bathrooms. For straightforward grub, I don't see any reason to avoid it.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Nice French bistro style lunch, but have had better. Could pay a little more attention to detail. Great location, right next to the park. The service was good and enjoyed our lunch.

place_category: Cafes, Themed Cafes, Restaurants, Shopping, Florists, Flowers & Gifts
text: Really is a beautiful spot for some pictures so wish I could have given more stars. Had high expectations but I ordered the chicken waffles and chicken was not cooked. So ordered pasta instead and it was ok. The service was not the greatest either. Staff was a little rude but Dessert and coffee was lovely.

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Grocery, Delis, Restaurants
text: Recently bought produce from this store. Within a day, fruit was moldy. Also bought greens and went bad in two days. I've bought chicken from here in the past and it came out cooked with a plastic texture. Clearly employees here do not care about quality. This establishment is expensive and has awful food to boot. I'm taking my business to another shoprite or even a different food chain. If you HAVE to go here examine everything you buy!

place_category: Breweries, Restaurants, Food, Gastropubs, Latin American, New Mexican Cuisine, Pubs, Bars, Nightlife, Tacos, Mexican, Salad
text: We ordered 2 hours in advance through Grub Hub. When we arrived, they said they forgot to put in the order and it would be ready in 20 minutes. It was ready when we returned but they didn't offer anything for the inconvenience. The steak was a little rare for our liking but I don't think it was option to select how it should be cooked. The portion sizes were very small compared to eating in. They only provided 3 tortillas but the meal needed 5.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Seafood, Chinese, Dim Sum
text: The food here usually good, but this time, it is a let down. The skin of the roast pork is chewy, and should be crunchy. The beef dish should be a quality beef but just flank and the sauce is also wrong, it's black bean sauce instead of brown gravy. The last dish didn't served until the dinner is done, they claimed they have a big take out order. Two other dishes are good, but overall, just not good enough since there are choices around the area.

place_category: Gastropubs, Cajun/Creole, Southern, Burgers, American (New), Restaurants
text: The Parish is a good restaurant, but the limited menu is what keeps us from coming back. How often can you eat gumbo, fish and chips, the drunken angel, or burgers? The chef at the Parish is consistently at the top of the Tucson food scene and should be able to come up with a few more items on the dinner menu. The drink menu is great. Make sure you get the Jalisco Holy Water.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Donuts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Great doughnuts, I asked babe to cook breakfast...... And this is what I got....... #winning lol.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Great food! Love the Green and Red Curry. Green is fresh, and when they say spicy they mean it. Recommended for vegans

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: You won't be disappointed. The food is exceptional and the staff very efficient. I can't have spicy foods. The selection is varied and there is something for every palette. Also they have brewed ice tea, not Brisk, and a wonderful cheese sauce. Try them, you'll love the experience.

place_category: Salad, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Soup
text: I ordered my food 20 minutes prior, pickup 4:04 got there at 4:10 and STILL waited 20 minute for A sandwich! When I arrived there were 5 ppl "there" ONE working and the rest gossiping about who walked out in the job. It was not until more customers started coming in they got it together... horrible first experience at the NEW Baggin's old Vail. Only gave it one start cause the food was good when I finally got it

place_category: American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Restaurants, Food Stands
text: I love Ybor eats! The food is delish! Great service, super friendly, and great prices! My favorite quick morning meal is the sausage, egg, and cheese breakfast sandwich on a Kaiser roll!

place_category: Greek, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Cafes, Salad
text: Pappas used to be an overall wonderful dining option. Somethings gone very wrong. The food is still on the tasty side...as long as your order is correct and you've not waited a half an hour to 40 min in a heavily populated and tense line for it. Employees are discombobulated because management has failed. I hope they get it together and soon.

place_category: Beauty & Spas, Food, Shopping, Cosmetics & Beauty Supply, Drugstores, Convenience Stores
text: Was the first in line at 10:55 out of 4 with a scheduled vaccine at 11. We we the last to get ours at 12:05 with 4 pharmacy workers.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: No Management No Customer service they seat who they want when they want. I Ask to speak to the manager and the old mofo just walked away and would not speak to us. I think he has little man syndrome. Please shut your doors or get a new management team.

place_name: Arugula Ristorante at Cold Point Village
place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services
text: Found Arugula as per an outing to the Ambler Theater. Odd finding a restaurant anchored off the parking lot to a condo complex. Was a nice place, quickly greeted and sat. Choose outside as I thought it would be nicer now that good temps are here. Nice menu, plenty of options, usual good categories. Attentive servers. Is a BYOB.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Barbeque, Bars, Music Venues, American (Traditional)
text: CMA fans do not go! Our waitress had the worst attitude and was upset that we asked for separate checks. She just decided to divide it evenly between everyone. Food was just ok. The windows were open and it started pouring down raining on our table and not a single person came to help up clean up. Our food was soaked but luckily most ppl had finished eating. Spend your money on better food and service somewhere else.

place_category: Burgers, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Lounges
text: Great bloody Mary's and awesome patio. I've eaten here at least 10 times and never had a good meal. I'm giving it three stars for the atmosphere - it's almost always packed on a nice day. So definitely grab beers here on a Saturday but I wouldn't recommend the food.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Ordered delivery when we got the order it was cold and no taste! It cost $35 for two little containers of bland cold noodles with chicken. Never again. Yummy Thai, not so yummy!

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Lounges
text: I ordered the Mediterranean Pasta because my girl pal had one. When my meal was delivered it was lacking quite a few components. It was very dry and there was no bread with it either. The kitchen basically threw it together. I sent it back and they corrected the issues...it was my first visit and first impressions are everything.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: The decor should be a little more Japanese. For an example the music should be more Oriental style. The employees are a little friendly but they need to stop talking with one another and serve the food. The sushi is pretty good but its a warm. The sushi needs to be served cold and not at room temp.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Fast Food
text: Every time I come here they literally have NOTHING. They really need to make the food when it's half way gone instead of making it when everything is gone. I left after they started filling my box with rice and chow mien since there was no orange or teriyaki chicken ready they said i would have to wait 5 minutes.

place_category: Restaurants, Food Delivery Services, Food, Thai
text: I'm glad I gave this place another chance. I came here with a few friends for dinner last week, and we all enjoyed our meals. I had the drunken noodles with shrimp which had a great spicy flavor and was not too oily (which is a problem that I found in other dishes I've ordered here before). It's a byo, which is always a plus, and the restaurant is pretty big so we didn't feel rushed because there were plenty of open tables.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Sandwiches
text: They recently changed names from Java Daves to Brentwood Perk. Since the transition they still have great food and coffee but service is WAY slower than in the past (only one in line- 2 drinks took 13 minutes) . I'll be back but probably in a few months once they have ironed out any kinks and the pace is picked up.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Sandwiches
text: The best hot sausage around! Always good food and fresh rolls. Only giving 3 stars because of the customer service. I have to say the girls are very rude. When I go to the window the ask "what do you want" and I always feel rushed at the window. I understand it can be busy, but it's a hot dog stand. It's happened on numerous occasions and I continue to go back. But I must admit it eats me up

place_category: Japanese, Ramen, Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Local Flavor, Food, Specialty Food
text: I always get the miso ramen but spicy and it is so good. The broth has the right amount of spice and it is very flavorful. I would definitely recommend this and the pork curry cutlet. This place, to me, is definitely one of the better places for Japanese ramen.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Macarons, Food, Gelato, Bakeries, Specialty Food, Custom Cakes, Desserts
text: Best people watching in town! Arugula Salad with duck confit is yummy! Awesome happy hour. Service can be spotty but when its ON its a great time

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Seafood, Chinese
text: Convenient location, broad menu, and I was shopping in the complex and craving sushi so I stopped by. I ordered sushi to go and I was pretty satisfied with my order. The price was decent and the service was fast. The sushi was nothing to rave about, but it was solidly good food. I'll definitely stop by if I've got a hankering for fast Asian good in the future!

place_category: Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Food, Latin American, Mexican, Burgers, Nightlife, Bars, Cuban, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants
text: good drinks and good food, a very responsible price for not only wonderful food but, also a great atmosphere. i highly recommended going to their thursday ladies nights for great drink deals. their burrito suave is delicious and their strawberry mojito is so yummy !!

place_category: Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Nightlife, Food, Sports Bars
text: Got boneless wings for takeout. I don't know what they think a wing is, but what we got was little chunks ranging in size from a marble to smaller than a golf ball. I'm not even sure it was chicken, hard chewy rubber is a better description. Half of the pieces were inedible. The sauce is really not that great, I have better bottled wing sauce. People rave about how great this place is, they must not have tastebuds. If you want good wings, go elsewhere.

place_category: Seafood, American (Traditional), Music Venues, Caribbean, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Location is great, next to the bay, and that's all the good things about this restaurant. Horrible service: my waitress showed up for 5 seconds and completely disappeared for more than 15 minutes before I can ask her a question about today's special. I moved to the bar then and sat there for more than 5 minutes, the bartender didn't acknowledge me, didn't say anything to me, didn't even look at me the whole time. Enough said!

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Shirley Valentine with blue cheese instead of feta was amazing today. I've had all 3 veggie sandwiches, and shrimp, numerous times but finally asked for that change bc not crazy about feta. Wow. Delicious blue cheese and was great compliment. I need to come back more often. Too hungry to stop for picture...sorry

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers
text: The food was good. When we walked in we were seated immediately. The place was relatively clean. The carpet could use some cleaning. The waitress Lennell was very friendly. She took care of us and the other patrons near by.

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Don't know what happened here but something has changed. I came here for the first time probably close to 15 years ago. For whatever reason I stopped going until about a year and half ago and it was excellent! Until recently it has been sub par with everything from the attitudes of the employees to the food. Too bad because this was a great place and it wasn't a chain or franchise. Hope someone can fix it because it's definitely broke!

place_category: Chinese, Noodles, Seafood, Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: My friends and I have been waiting for this place to open for what feels like EONS but it was worth the wait. The noodles are fresh and the flavors captured in the dishes are amazing. Soups could use more meat and veggies but I was too focused on the noodles to be bothered. Definitely check it out!

place_category: Lounges, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bar Crawl
text: Management was so so rude to our group. Will not be returning. As a manager, it's important to treat your customers with grace despite the situation.

place_category: Wraps, American (New), Vegan, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Super cute addition to the neighborhood. They've done the bowl concept right and here in Seminole Heights. Our bowls were delicious and there were more to choose from on the menu, though next time we are going to build our own. We also loved the little shop area with various sundries from all over like cool candies, sodas, chips, protein bars - you name it.

place_category: Bars, Salad, Sandwiches, Restaurants, American (New), Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: This place is gross. The hostess seated us while carrying an armload of dirty dishes. We were seated at a dirty table and no one was around to wipe it off, so we changed tables. The food was well below average. The salad was made with bagged lettuce. The kids macaroni and cheese was the junk from the box that I wouldn't make at home. Chicken fingers were pre frozen. The Reuben was ok. It had a lot of horseradish in the dressing. Overall, it was a bad experience. Drive past this one.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Cocktail Bars, Bowling, Active Life, Venues & Event Spaces, Bars, American (Traditional), American (New), Lounges
text: I haven't been bowling in a long time, but I used to enjoy it. The atmosphere of this place is decent, but the food and drinks are pretty awful. The bowling lanes themselves felt like they were improperly oiled, as I have a pretty strong curve that pretty much didn't move. Still, if you want to bowl without leaving the city, your options are pretty limited. I'll probably be back for lack of better alternatives.

place_category: Pizza, Arcades, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Indoor Playcentre, Active Life
text: Am I the only one creeped out by a dude in a rat costume making it rain with tickets and having all the kids picking them up off the floor? Pizza was sad and games were expensive. Place seemed kind of clean at least though. Better than I expected.

place_category: Iberian, Event Planning & Services, Spanish, Restaurants, Basque, Portuguese, Caterers
text: Delicious food and great service!! The sangria is awesome. There were 8 of us dining, and we all loved each of our meals, all different entrees.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, French, Specialty Food, Seafood, Diners, Cajun/Creole, Seafood Markets, Event Planning & Services, Southern, Caterers, Salad
text: The service was trash. The appetizers were cold , and our servers took forever and didn't even bother to check up on us! (We came in multiple groups and sat at different tables.) They gave us the wrong orders, and the food was somewhat cold like it was back for there a while, plus we waited forever just to get the check and then waited another 30 minutes just to get our money back. Wouldn't come here again

place_category: Shopping, Arts & Entertainment, Pick Your Own Farms, Pumpkin Patches, Farms, Fruits & Veggies, Farmers Market, Home & Garden, Food, Specialty Food
text: Admittedly, perhaps this is not the time of year to visit. Tons of pumpkins -- not much of anything else. Not sure if this is a farm or a local attraction.

place_category: Hot Dogs, Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Food is great!! They are brand new so I understand there are going to be hiccups. The only reason I gave 3 stars is the customer service needs to improve!! I'm sure with the non-stop orders coming thru the staff is frustrated or even nervous but that shouldn't reflect out to the customers! I'll be back because I'm from NM & I love Blake's but I'm gonna wait until the hype dies down.

place_category: Restaurants, Indian
text: Buffet food is not good. Almost felt they intentionally don't serve quality food at buffet to attract for dine in customers for dinner. I tried dinner as well, food is decent but I felt most items are $2-3 expensive than they deserved to be. Maybe one of the reason I didn't see many ppl in there. I tried twice and both times the place was mostly empty with just 3 tables occupied. I would revisit if they improve the quality of food and reduce the price.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Asian Fusion, Sushi Bars
text: So we have had dinner alot inside and last night is the fight night we got to go. For 67.00$ you would think you get a nice amount of food. Normally when we dine inside we have left overs. This was a compete joke it was less food then you would get at lunch had to pay for steamed rice even. Sweet and sour chicken had maybe 15 pieces of chicken and they looked to be the bottom of the bag scraps. We will never eat here again

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: Don't go here if you are in a hurry. I just spent 40 minutes waiting in the drive-thru. Wasn't super busy. 3 cars in front of me. Took 20 minutes to get from the order board to the window. They still didn't have the food ready when I got up there. Won't be going back. Edit: Added 2 stars because the philly cheesesteak was very good.

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants, Cheesesteaks
text: Used to be my go to, but I'm a barry's man now. Not bad, but not worth the wait in my book.

place_category: Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Sports Bars, Bars, Gastropubs, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Katelynn is a great bartender who always remembers our order and makes us at home. Thanks for the great service and keep those Sparkling Rubies coming!

place_category: Mexican, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars
text: Food was cold and not fresh at all. Prices are high. 4 out of the 7 people in our party got sick after eating here. Even the environment was bad, nobody eating there when we came in should've been our warning.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Food was great! Except one of the salsas was super runny and the other was canned tomatoes straight up. Service was awful and very unprofessional. Never got my bill my son and I waited 20 mins before I decided to get up and walk to the front. Make sure to bring a jacket place is freezing.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Mediocre service. Waited a long time to get our food when other customers came in atleast 5 minutes after us and already got their food. Food came out cold.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bagels, American (Traditional), Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Food
text: this place is full of adorable people avoiding each other at all cost, bring your laptop

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Horrible twice my card has been charged twice for one order and now today's visit they got my order wrong just horrible any los betos is better than this one

place_category: Nightlife, Specialty Food, American (New), Japanese, Ramen, Bars, Food, Beer Bar, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants
text: Nice service but very bland food and overpriced. As an appetizer we ordered ox tail it was decent, better than the ramen. For drinks we had a choclate alcohal drink that wasn't bad. But the main meal was a huge dispointment we had pozole ramen and brisket ramen they were both very bland. 3 of us tried it and none of liked it. The flavors were boring we just wanted to finish and leave. I was disapointed because there was no flavor. The atmosphere is cool though. They have nice plants.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: I enjoyed the food, but wish I would have chosen the in restaurant experience. I ordered a load of food that I could no way eat in one setting or while still hot. I think I would enjoy the food more if hot. The dumplings were good, but I was looking for AMAZING. Like I said, was likely because I didn't eat the food piping hot. I look forward to visiting again!

place_category: Falafel, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Greek, Mediterranean, Salad
text: Really, really poor quality food. I'm a big fan of Greek, and this was rather disappointing. Ordered a gyro, and it was so greasy the pita was completely wet with grease...I could literally squeeze it out of the bread. Seemed like they deep fried each individual part of the sandwich and then again after assembled. The lettuce, onions, and tomatoes on top were also covered in grease. Fries came on plate in puddle of grease. All around terrible food. You might be happier going to McDonald's.

place_category: Food, Cafes, Sandwiches, Internet Cafes, Restaurants
text: I think one of the worst things that you can deal with at any place that you're eating is people cleaning all around you as if to say "hurry up and eat so we can get out of here". I think that is so tacky. It made the person I was with uncomfortable and asked if we should just get our stuff to go. I could understand if it was five or 10 minutes prior to locking the door, but starting that 30 minutes before you're going to lock the doors is just not right. Only my opinion.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches
text: Went once before and it was way better. Bread seemed old The small chicken cheesesteak was the size of a hotdog I asked for extra cheese on a cheesesteak and half had none. Thank god I only come through here once in a blue moon. Won't be back.

place_category: Mexican, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars
text: Server was ok until the end, then seemed not to care when we barely ate our food. Food was super bland, salsa sucks, fajitas had no flavor. Pork tacos were the best thing and they were terrible to. There's a reason this place is dead on a Friday night.

place_category: Nightlife, Steakhouses, Bars, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: We went to Spotted Bull for the first time last night. We were enthusiastically greeted by our server (Megan) which made a great first impression for us! We were satisfied with the food, the prices, the wait time, and the service! We are happy to have a steak restaurant in Vail! Thank you!

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Caribbean, Latin American, Bars
text: Went here with 2 work friends for some drinks and food. It's a nice place and the staff was friendly. The drinks, in my opinion, were not very good. The food just mediocre. I did get ice cream for dessert which was delicious, but wish it were bigger! Prices were a bit steep, but nothing too outrageous. I won't go out of my way to visit again.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: 2 kids meals, two burgers and a small fry, 2 combo meals. I can say that there was something wrong with every single thing in this order. I will never go back again. Stay away! Burgers were wrong special orders were wrong and when I got home one of the meal wasn't even in the bag... I guess shame on me for not checking but really? Do you have to check? The service was extremely slow and I verified the order several times

place_category: Food, Shopping, Convenience Stores, Drugstores
text: The service is soooo slow all the time. I like the products you sell, but the service is abhorant. It takes longer to wait in line than to actually shop. The computers are slow, the receipts way too long. The staff yawns in your face and often seem like zombies at their posts keeping guard. Usually seems like I am disturbing them when i try to buy something. Also, when the line is really long it seems no other employees step up and help at checkout. Get self check out soon.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: We used to come here a lot, but recently the quality of the service has gone terrible. Food is OK (not great) but our last two visits ended up being forced to pay 20% automatic gratuity by our server (for a party of 2) although she was extremely ignorant and paid little attention to our table. We refused to pay last time but she said it was restaurant's policy. Well, we are never coming back, we wish good luck to the owners. This place is being dragged down by their waitresses.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Sandwiches
text: Adorable little cafe right by 100 Oaks Shopping Center. Lots of vegan/vegetarian options, friendly service, reasonable prices. I had the breakfast burrito with veggie sausage and it was pretty tasty. It was very crowded when I went on a Saturday morning so you may want to plan on getting your order to-go.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Italian
text: The food is very good but the owner/chef should watch his language when there are customers in the store. He has a very fowl mouth. If you're picking up food or waiting for it in person, you may want to leave your kids at home. Very inconsiderate and unprofessional. No one wants to hear effin this and effin that. Bad mouth......

place_category: Gastropubs, American (New), Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Definitely go for the shareables. The pork rinds are very tasty! I had the mac and cheese, which you can add protein, veggies, and a crunch topping to. It was perfectly fine. I don't know that I will go back, but the thought of their pork rinds may be what takes me there.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Italian
text: Flashback to the early 90s when I went to pizza huts because it sure looks like nothing has been changed. Kind of dirty and dingy...both the place and the clientele. Chose this randomly as a middle meeting point with a friend, won't make that mistake again. Our waitress was happy, but a little too happy if you know what I mean.. She got our order wrong, but then gave us a free pizza. Even with a free pizza I can't give this more than one star.

place_category: Restaurants, Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Beer Bar, Burgers
text: I enjoyed the ginger beer however the food was nothing to write home about. Nothing short of fast food! Aaaaw! It's a little to dark inside for my liking but the decor was interesting. My friends and I sat outside which was a too close to the street and noisy. Maybe I'll try again soon.

place_category: Seafood, Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Tacos, Mexican
text: Used to be my favorite Mexican restaurant until they changed the menu recently. We ordered the "el chapo" quesadilla and it gave us food poisoning the same night after we left.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Chinese
text: Visited this place due to the Yelp ratings, turned out to be a bad experience. They did not turn on the A/C so it was very hot inside. The food tasted much worse than similar Chinese restaurants we've been to, and the services were unfriendly.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Great food. LONG wait! Don't go here if have plans, ie Butler BB game. Florentine Omelet, corn beef hash, mimosa are all good!

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: Well, so much for my rave reviews of this restaurant. Last several times have been disappointing. Need to get back to good! Will not be back unless some radical change occurs. $100.00 for 2 apps, one entree, and a few drinks. Chef needs to learn how to make beef stroganoff. I can help!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food Delivery Services, Salad, Food, Pizza, Gluten-Free
text: Good pizza if you're already in Manayunk, but I don't think I'll be leaving Center City for Couch Tomato. Rustica and NYPD Pizza are just more convenient.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Food, Salad, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Pizza, Breweries
text: This place is a pleasant surprise. Super friendly staff, great food and fantastic choice of draft beers. Pizza is excellent. Price is very reasonable and I strongly recommend you give it a try...you won't be disappointed!!

place_category: Cupcakes, Caterers, Food, Chocolatiers & Shops, Bakeries, Specialty Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Shopping, Desserts, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services
text: 3.5 Stars The decor was nice and the guy that helped me out as really friendly. I saw some fruit flies in the far left muffin case and was a bit turned off about getting anything in there Their creme brulee truffle was really good and melts in your mouth. I really like the almond wedding cupcake. I didn't care much for the frosting, but the cake was delicious! One of my favorites. Their red velvet was A-OK. I've had way better. I wouldn't recommend it.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, Hotels, Resorts
text: I've never stayed here. I just visit the bar! The best Pina Coloda ever in my life. Our waitress on our last visit (tonya) was awesome! Staff in the bar area is always great. They always have great live music. Always a stop on our tour of the area!

place_category: Donuts, Gas Stations, Coffee & Tea, Caterers, Automotive, Event Planning & Services, Food
text: If I could give this place 0 stars, I would. No matter how many chances I give them, they always mess up my order. EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. The employees are EXTREMELY rude to everyone except other Indian customers.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Desserts, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The breakfast here was not anything too brag about, BUT I loved the atmosphere! I always come here to study and I would consider it to be better than B&N because it's so quiet there. I love the triple berry cake that they have. It is beyond words. The fruits on top tastes fresh and the cake itself is so moist. the only thing about Parrot Pete that I don't really like is the high prices. They a trip with those pricing!!

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: IMO, it's never too cold for a water ice. Today I tried a small cotton candy and watermelon. I'm sooooo glad I live 20 minutes away because I'd probably visit Joe's everyday. True water ice with the familiar "Philly summer" flavor. I'll definitely go back to try their other flavors, including the custard/ice cream. I wonder if he sells by the bucket?? (Just kidding.....but not really). :)

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Diners, Burgers, Desserts, Restaurants, Hot Dogs
text: I've been here 3 times and every time I get the CHEEESY...I'm obsessed!!! If you love a REALLY cheesy patty melt, this is for you. Taste better with mayo and mustard. Staff is less to be desired, but hey, it's a burger joint ‍ Not rude, but not very friendly. All in all, it's worth the 13 minute drive for such a delicious burger on grilled sourdough toast

place_name: New Orleans Ernest N Morial Convention Center
place_category: Food, Convenience Stores, Event Planning & Services, Party & Event Planning, Venues & Event Spaces
text: I attended the Zulu Ball here and was happy with the convention center staff for the service. The bathrooms needed more attention

place_category: Restaurants, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Friendly staff, helped out a lot when I had questions about the menu because being a transplant from up north, I didn't know what some food was..

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I've been to Biscuits a few times in the past couple months, and I'm not sure what has happened, but I absolutely love it. Their breakfast specials are amazing and all come with rice and beans! I suggest the super breakfast chimichanga special. My wife loves the breakfast quesadilla, and I will admit it's delicious! Their Bloody Mary is still very spicy but not a bad thing. Next time I come I want to try the chilaquiles as I am always tempted.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Food, Salad, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Pizza, Breweries
text: I do not see how this place has more than 3 stars. It was not good. To start with, All Burgers are cooked well done. I had a burger, fries and shared some wings. None of it was good. McDonalds has better burgers and I am not a McDonalds fan.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New), Food
text: Better than a regular diner. But the food is meh. Ordered hash, pancake and eggs. The hash had roasted sweet potatoes instead of rosette potatoes. That was still not the main issue. The main problem was that the entire hash dish was so wet and unpalatable. I ended up eating only the salad on the side.

place_category: Restaurants, Gelato, Coffee & Tea, Food, Italian, Bakeries
text: I give this place 3.5 stars for the gelato alone. I usually don't like gelato, however, the concierge at our hotel gave us a complimentary tasting. The gelato flight included about 5 or six varieties which were all delicious. I tasted the mango, almond, chocolate, black cherry, and pistachio. The cherry was my favorite. I had the veal braciole over noodles with Sunday sauce. It was ok. The cocktails just ok. Go for the gelato.
