text: We love kitzmo. Owner is very nice and courteous! Ask for Bjohn or B he makes one of the best sushi's in town!

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: It does not deserve star. Meet was not fresh. After 15min my stomach started pain. Ted was rudest guy ever. Especially if you are foreigner please stay away from this place because obviously he does not like us.

place_category: Restaurants, Caterers, Sandwiches, Burgers, Event Planning & Services, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: I love the brunchery but after today I lost my appetite. I usually eat here when I get my car fixed or in the area. The food is great and my server was nice and on point. But after eating I found a roach by the bathroom, it looked dead but was still twitching just a major turn off. I know it's Florida it happens, but after eating and it was in plain sight just didn't settle well in my stomach.

place_category: Gluten-Free, Brazilian, Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: I'm only putting two stars because most of the food was good. The salad bar was really good. Everything seemed fresh. Most of the meat was good but a couple of cuts tasted rotten. The fillet tasted spoiled and the garlic beef tasted very ripe and fatty. A half hour after we left my husband was throwing up profusely. He never gets sick. I think I did not get sick because I only ate a tiny bite of both. Eat with caution.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Shaved Ice, Desserts
text: I love the Vanilla Italian Ice! However, my mom and I were passing by one morning, trying to kill time until places were open for lunch, I thought we might grab some Italian ice while we waited. One of the clerks came outside and was super rude, telling us harshly that they don't open until 11 (it was 5 minutes til). We would have been happy to wait if she hadn't been so rude, but after that I didn't want to go near the place.

place_category: Gastropubs, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars
text: I had visited after a roller derby scrimmage. Still, the late night fare was pretty decent. I had a cold Victory Beer and some fries with sea salt, infused with mushrooms. Talk about absolutely yum.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Barbeque
text: They literally take away plates you are working on to kick you out 30 minutes before closing. They spray the cleaner all over and around you and your food so that you finish up and leave. I was working on my food and this waitress brought out boxes to hand them to me out of no where, staring at me and waiting for me until I grabbed them out of her hands. And another waitress came and quickly took away all our plates, even dropping a spoon on my husband. Ridiculously rude service.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Chinese, Gluten-Free, Korean, Fast Food, Asian Fusion
text: Food is good but it to way too long and orders were incorrect. Needs organization. Not a place to go in a hurry. Shame that need for speed is precisely why we came here and what we expected. They gave us $10 off coupon but it is for next visit. Kept me from giving 2 stars but not very helpful.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Japanese, Restaurants
text: My wife and I both liked our bowls but the value of what you get for what you pay is not very good relative to other places with the same fare.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Fish & Chips, Nightlife, Seafood, Restaurants, Bars
text: Absolutely love this place. I come with my husband and family almost every chance we get. Oyster shooters to begin with are good! You get big pieces of oysters for your money. And Always have to get a cup or bowl of their clam chowder- my favorite dish to go for. Also try the Baked Garlic Clams! Service is great as well, very friendly service

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Barbeque, Bars
text: I like this place. We came here on a wednesday. . Bike night, it was pretty busy but we still got good food and good service. They don't accept cards so bring cash..there's an atm on site if you forget though. We both got burgers and thought they were delish.... I'd say as good as five guys and it's not a chain so that makes it even better. Definitely divey but it was good. Seriously it's hard to beat five guys burgers in my opinion. I'd come back and that's saying alot.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Cafes, Creperies, Coffee & Tea
text: I love discovering wonderful new places in town. Menu is full of delicious options for breakfast and lunch. I had the chef special crepes with all kinds of goodies like avocado Italian salami spinach. Very nice decor and great brew (coffee not beer). If you have a sweet tooth, this place will be a slice if heaven. It's located right near Costco so 2 birds with one stone!

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: They never have more that 10 flavors. Visited in multiple days free they said they recover their shipment and they still never have all the flavors. My husband also had a dead fly in his smoothie Never Again

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Alright! I downloaded Yelp for this. Nothing like getting hairy cockroach pad Thai! Threw up twice. Not cool.

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: They were more interested in their phones than getting us a drink. Also the managers wife and screaming kids being fed with the rest of the staff rolling their eyes were the kiss of death for us. Go to the end of the block and hit the District. Classy and attentive.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Fast Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Little over priced and get boring after a few times. Nice kids in the place but just no that special

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: I come here often since it is near where I lived. The servers are very pleasant, makes you feel at home the moment you enter. The food, let's just say it is fair enough to satisfy my craving for Japanese food. They put too much sauce on their teriyaki chicken. Rolls and sushi are just okay.

place_category: Seafood, American (New), Steakhouses, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Service was slow and food was served cold. Those are the highlights! Steak on the salad was charcoal and the waiter said "too bad". Avoid at all costs!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: This place might deserve four stars if they provided something more unique. For now, it is a good pizza place in a decent location. The front patio isn't great. Inside is nice but nothing special. The pizza taste good, definitely better than the chain places but not as good as some of the other local pizza joints. I can't really comment on the beer or other food options. I might give this place another chance but probably not before I go to some other places a couple times first.

place_category: Wine Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Local Flavor, Coffee & Tea, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: It was super quiet when I came in, but livened up about 9. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. They have a lot of space for community meetings and events which they rent out. The staff said it could hold up to 70 people! What a great idea for a wedding or bridal shower! Only four stars because my chai was a bit watery. I will be back to try a different drink and enjoy the atmosphere.

place_category: Ramen, Restaurants, Japanese, Noodles, Chinese
text: Decent food though a little pricey. Food is delivered to the table on a motorized tray, sorta 1970's futuristic kitsch. Worth trying but I nothing too exciting.

place_category: Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Food, Restaurants, Donuts
text: Scrupulous melt in your melt beignets. The coffee is the perfect compliment to this delicious treat that can be enjoyed at any time. The wait is incredibly long at peak times though.

place_category: Tapas Bars, Nightlife, Tapas/Small Plates, Bars, Lounges, Restaurants
text: Decided on a random night out. Looked for a gastropub on Yelp and came across this restaurant. Definitely worth the visit!! The truffle Mac and cheese is delicious! Pork belly and hanger steak were our dinner choices and those were fabulous as well! Everything comes out when it is ready instead of coming out all at the same time. Loved the atmosphere and decorating as well. Will definitely be coming back in the near future.

place_category: American (New), Italian, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Food, Coffee & Tea, Caterers
text: Went there with a party of four. The servers were very nice but the provided service was weird. We asked for several things at once (butter, coffee, oil) and they brought everything out one at a time and like 5-10 minutes apart. Also they took away our appetizer before we were even done eating. Food was underwhelming as well. The place was cute and everyone was very nice but I won't be back.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Pubs, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Will never go back to this bar again! Second time with a bad experience. Bartender was rude, owner is rude. If he's unhappy in his job, he needs to get out. No wonder this bar is always empty when we go to 4th street!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Ok dinner...oysters had lots of broken shell in them and was disappointed. Average food and experience.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Bars, Nightlife, Italian, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services
text: Their slogan should be "Where America comes to eat". Family style restaurant with HUGE portions. The balsamic glazed salmon with orzo and spinach was decent, although the salmon could have been softer. The Bloody Mary tasted as it was partially derived from a Bloody Mary mix (not sure if it was). Overall an ok chain restaurant.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Always such long waits for mediocre food. Customer service is bad and majority of the time get the wrong order.

place_name: The Egyptian Cafe and Hookah Bar
place_category: Cafes, Internet Cafes, Food, Mediterranean, Greek, Middle Eastern, Bars, Nightlife, Hookah Bars, Restaurants, Egyptian
text: Casual hookah spot. Sometimes the service is slow, but if you get Barb, she'll take care of you. I've been a few times. The vibe is different depending on the crowd, but it's usually pretty chill. You can ask to hook your phone up and use your playlist if there aren't very many people in there. This is my first time trying the banana strawberry smoothie and I was pleasantly surprised. The Egyptian rub wings are delicious!

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, American (New)
text: Whoever was working today at 3:40 would not get off her phone to help customers get service. She actually walked away from us and went back to the bar to get back on her phone! We have had the best service every other time we have been at the bar/grill. This time we actually walked away. Very sad.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Again they are out of a bunch of menu items... lame. The tomato zucchini soup is delicious and super garlicky. If they're not out of it that is!

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: Definitely a hipster bar, that serves taco platters. I really liked the atmosphere and lay out of the location, but did not care for either tacos I ordered... had the brisket and pulled pork. The mac-n-cheese as a side was pretty good though. But not enough to bring me back. There niche certainly is an acquired taste... hopefully they will grab yours.

place_category: Chinese, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants
text: I've only been here once, but the service sucked. Got seated right away, and we were told to wait and someone would take our drink order. That took forever. Then when we finally got the food it was all just not good. Sushi was awful probably the worst I've ever had and all of the other dishes I tried were just disgusting. Will never be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Salad, Sandwiches
text: This is twice now that they've messed up my order within 3 weeks. This time I read my order back twice to the lady whoever was taking over the phone today I repeated everything twice she already sounded like she had an attitude and she still messed up the order. There definitely needs to be a staff meeting or something because customer retention and rapport is horrendous. Tried to give them the benefit of the doubt the first time but this is getting ridiculous!

place_category: Acai Bowls, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: I'm middle of the road here. Service was lame with multiple people on their phones as I waited for someone to start my order. Açaí bowl was less than spectacular. If you have options then travel away and pay another dollar and visit SoHo juice.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Seafood, Buffets
text: I enjoy sushi very much and this sushi buffet satisfies all of my sushi cravings. I can eat anything from fried rolls to slices of sashimi. They have a wide variety of rolls. I tried to try each one of them and by the end I was rolling out of there. It's nice to go with a family because they have food for everyone. They have some cooked meats and fried rice/noodles. They also have a crepe bar and udon bar. My favorite part is getting match icecream after my meal to top it all off.

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: I came to Philly to try Genos and Pat's to see who was the king of ring. The winner on my book is Pats. Genos steaks didn't have much flavor. @raulvsfood

place_category: Restaurants, Indian
text: Ordered the Lamb rogan josh & chicken chutneywala for a late evening pickup, both sauces flavored practically same, none of which were right to the name. Though this place is practically steps from my place, but I would say this is not really the quality of Indian food that I would go for even on a lazy day. The food was ready for pick up pretty quick & was warm when I got them, which is like 20 minutes from when I ordered, but was really a disappointment for the taste.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Been going here for years. I only get one thing and it never disappoints me. (General Tso's chicken w/ shrimp fried rice combo)

place_category: Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Mexican, Food
text: Great food but the wait can sometimes be annoying... best thing to do is not go during normal busy times i.e. lunch or dinner rush. Other than that, you'll appreciate the food and I encourage you to get a tamale!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Burgers, Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: How hard is it to put ketchup, straw and napkins in your bag? Especially after I asked for it!! You weren't even busy

place_category: Food, Specialty Food, Meat Shops
text: Small shop with some great pierogies and my parents love the fresh kielbasy. Get there early because they do sell out and close early.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Solid pizza spot on Broadway in Nashville. I stopped in here with a few friends on a road trip and we really enjoyed the pizza. I had their pepperoni pizza and loved the spin on a simple pizza. Their spicy red marinara sauce was delicious. The 10" pizza was enough to fill me up and glad I didn't go with the 16", even though I was starving. I'll be back next time in Nashville!

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: Pizza was good, that's why I gave it two stars, but the delivery was awful. Took over two hours to arrive and everything arrived cold. I called 3x and the lady told me 1 hour, but she did not tell me it would be close to 2 hours and calamari was all dried out! I used to order here all the time. Go for pick up option it's probably better

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Cocktail Bars, Tacos, Mexican
text: We are obviously different than most. The nachos were okay. The quesadilla decent but not superb. The first margarita had to be sent back due to mix being too sour. Turns out their mix was bad. And $10 for an average margarita in a plastic cup seems pricey. Service was terrible. Asked 3 times for forks and plates. And we were only customers in entire restaurant. $50 before tip for nachos, quesadillas and 2 margs. All in all, would not recommend.

place_category: Japanese, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Ramen, Restaurants
text: The chicken in rice bowl was very dry. Cucumber came with it does not pair well. Ramen soup is not made from scratch and tasted like something from packaged food. Host's attitude was terrible. Chairs were too low compare to tables' height. Only thing good was the egg.. very creative!

place_category: Food, Mexican, Restaurants, Seafood, Desserts
text: Normally I love this place when I return to UCSB but today I ordered 2 breakfast burritos with potatoes. Of course it was my burrito Machaca with egg add potato that was made with no potato. It's a small thing but I would appreciate it if they got my order correct.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Delis, Convenience Stores, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea
text: Wawa in general is great. Only reason this location gets 4 stars is that they seem to have trouble moving the lines when it is busy.

place_category: Diners, Restaurants, Food, Cafes, American (Traditional), Soup, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts
text: Great service and great food, the Peppermill burger was super good and the service is great Especially Lani!

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Good spot for breakfast/brunch... apparently turning point restaurants occur all over philly area. Came to this one on a Saturday morning. They have great coffee and very complete breakfast. I got a chocolate flavored coffee... no sugar- super crisp taste. Got the iron man combo- very good no complaints- food prepared very well. Restaurant has very nice interior with great decor and light!

place_category: Specialty Food, Active Life, Hotels & Travel, Car Rental, Sporting Goods, Day Spas, Trainers, Pilates, Food, Beauty & Spas, Health Markets, Gyms, Fitness & Instruction, Massage, Shopping
text: Absolutely horrified that we were charged the month of April during the shutdown. Most people were out of work, and they were still taking our money. I talked to lots of people that attend other gyms, and none of them were being charged (you know, because why would you pay for a service that can't be used?).

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Tonight was our first time at Sakana and we loved it. We have been to many other Sushi bars and we have our favorite but this place is as good as it gets. The fish is fresh and melts in your mouth. The Basil Fluke(Halibut) is to die for. We tried two different specialty rolls and both were good. We will absolutely go back. Just a note, we got there early and it looks like there is a wait after 6 PM so go early or be prepared to wait a bit, but well worth it.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Pubs, Nightlife, Bars, Wine Bars, Gluten-Free, Mexican, American (New), Food, Tacos, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Well, I just wrote a very long review and there was a glitch on the site so I'm going to write a shorter one, because I'm ready to move on to the next review. A group of friends and my husband and I met up for a small birthday dinner. Server was sweet, but it took 45 minutes for her to come take our order. the place wasn't busy either which I found odd for a Saturday night. The pretzel bites and beer cheese was great. The sweet potato fries were a solid good.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: I can't say enough nice things about this place! Everyone that works there are very nice. (Not just the name)Tonight I went and the guy was so nice got me cookie butter without me even asking. I've never had a bad flavor but the cookie butter is amazing.

place_category: Mediterranean, Southern, American (New), Restaurants, Kebab, Greek, Sandwiches
text: Came here on a weekday night for a late dinner. We tried the Zoe's Club Pita which was warm and yummy. My chicken salad sandwich was good, but a little on the bland side. The potato salad had no flavor to it, yet the marinated slaw was really tasty. Service was good. We bought some of the pita chips to take home and they were a bit stale...which was disappointing. It seems like there are some really GOOD things to be had here. They have a Simply 500 menu and a gluten free menu.

place_category: Pubs, Dive Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Burgers
text: Went there last night after a night of drinking beers. Needed a big juicy burger. I ordered the peanut butter bacon burger and my wife ordered the Bleu cheese butger. Our orders came super fast considering how crowded it was. Only problem was that the bartender was not very attentive and had an attitude problem, I heard her mention to one of the local patrons she didn't want to be there and her attitude showed it.

place_category: Specialty Food, Health Markets, Nutritionists, Health & Medical, Food, Grocery
text: Great customer service (nice, friendly staff) but the food was incredibly bland and dry. I wanted to like Fitlife foods but I honestly could make better at home. The containers hold up pretty well though; I'm still using them almost a year later:)

place_category: Cajun/Creole, American (New), Southern, Restaurants
text: Eaten here twice. Once for dessert only and this past summer, for brunch with a large group. I had no clue this was an Emeril restaurant. Really? It was just OK. It wasn't memorable. Some people raved about their desserts and shrimp with grits but I wasn't too overly thrilled with my food.

place_category: Pubs, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Dance Clubs, Bars, American (New), American (Traditional), Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: I go here regularly for lunch cause the veggie burger rocks. It's even better with bacon and cheese. Great lunch prices. Beer list is ever rotating and they have great draft and bottle selections. Service can be slow...both on the floor and from the kitchen. However, the place has the two bartenders work the whole floor during lunch on a weekday.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Don't let the name fool you. US-101 is between this cafe and the beach, and since it's raised you can't even see it. But out on the deck you do get some nice sun to make up for the dominant sound of highway traffic. Had the eggs, bacon, sausage and waffle combo. Not too much better than Denny's. With orange juice and tip, $22.

place_category: Barbeque, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Haven't gotten to the food yet just didn't realize that curbside togo means have to come in and pick up my own food. I figured they would bring it to the curb to me. Specially when I was asked what kind of car I would be in for curbside. Forgot my bread....

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Cafes, Restaurants
text: I'm a Texas girl so it's wonderful to find a good BBQ place near by. I've been going to BJ's since before they moved and they have always been wonderful.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Cocktail Bars
text: This place was really hyped up, so I was picturing something amazing in my mind. The food was good (I had fish tacos), but it really wasn't anything special. In fact, the best part of the whole meal was the queso dip we had for an appetizer...now THAT was good! I had heartburn for 3 days after eating it, so that's how you know it was worth it :)

place_category: Sandwiches, Vegan, Restaurants, Pizza, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Vegan AND Gluten-Free? Plenty of topping options? Nice staff who offer free tastings and will share their whiskey? This place is the real deal - and I will be stopping in every time I go through Reno from now on.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Vietnamese
text: Best pho in town hands down. Boba tea is a 8 out of 10. Their menu is larger than the average restaurant but most of dishes I've had are above average. Their padd Thai is average. Their spring rolls and egg rolls are above average.... This is where you go for pho and boba tea. Prices are reasonable. Atmosphere is very nice. Owners continues to put $$$ back into the place.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: God bless Drago Cvitanovich and his little garlic butter and cheese filled mollusks! Be sure to order a dozen because a half-dozen isn't enough. Hell, I don't even think a dozen is enough if you ask me! The crawfish etoufee and stuffed lobster were also good but the charbroiled oysters were definitely the highlight of the meal. The servers were attentive, friendly, and accomodating. My only complaint is that there isn't a Drago's in Los Angeles. Hit me!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Went in for a coffee and breakfast this morning and meeting a client for some paperwork exchange. After ordering I was the only customer in the store (with my mask on) and I was told that all the tables are closed......ok so I went outside. Odd I could eat my food or anything. A real bummer and I don't understand. Staff was nice but I think 4 behind the counter all staring at each other was weird too. So drive through but don't plan on sitting down.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: This is some great pizza and has been since the formers owners opened in up in 2009. The only negative are the young girls who work the front...not real personable and seem more involved with their smartphones and taking phone orders.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Pork fried rice was good. Portion was good. But the general tso's chicken was too salty for me. I didn't have an egg roll, but my friend loved them. Also, I tasted the orange chicken, and it was flavorful and not overly salty. So, ok Chinese but I'm not raving.

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Brew Ha Ha has the best coffee and pastries of any coffee shop in the area. They provide a nice atmosphere as well with friendly staff and comfortable seating. My biggest gripe is that their wi-fi scarcely works and there are few outlets around the place. I would love to come here to do work often but the lack of reliable wifi makes me choose other places instead.

place_category: Caribbean, Chicken Wings, Herbs & Spices, Specialty Food, Food, Seafood, Restaurants
text: First time ordering here, ordered jerk chicken wings. Thought I heard them putting them in microwave, food came soggy and cold.

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, American (Traditional), Beer Bar, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Food
text: Yes, I know it's a bar, but I don't need the attitude for ordering a non-alcoholic drink. Especially if its something to prevent a diabetic emergency. Don't be quick to judge your customers. A bad customer service experience for a bachelors party night out.

place_category: Nightlife, American (New), Burgers, Bars, Restaurants, Pubs
text: Good selection of appetizers, burgers, and salads @ reasonable prices. The half order of nachos will easily feed three people and at $8 is very reasonable. Good selection of beers and signature cocktails all in a fairly comfortable environment. Service has always been good and wait staff friendly. Definitely worth a visit.

place_category: Nightlife, Dance Clubs, Burgers, Restaurants, Bars
text: Went last night for pride night. Chilled on the first floor, but really turned up on the 2nd floor. Totally worth the $5 cover. Was able to hang out and take pics on the balcony too. DJ could have been better. The music would just stop during transitions, totally killed the vibe at times. But the selection was awesome. Old vibes and new dance songs.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Pizza, Food Delivery Services, Caterers, Food, Italian
text: Terrible customer service. Food is hit or miss depending on if the owner is present at the time.

place_category: Convenience Stores, Food, Gas Stations, Automotive, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Truly the worst QT in the StL area!! They are aware that the service is far from typical QT service but the refuse to address the poor service, poor management and poor attitude.

place_category: American (Traditional), Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea
text: Eaten at the bar twice and it's a perfect spot to get a good daytime meal. Lots of menu options, not over priced, friendly staff. Post review update- I've been a couple times since and the food has been, meh. Which is too bad... Bryn Mawr needs a great brunch place. * i have been back a couple times since my last review and sadly the food has gone way down hill. Takes forever to come out, comes out cold or burnt and they serve fake maple syrup with pancakes-yuck :(

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Delis, Salad, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: Delicious and creative food! Complimentary and fantastic popcorn and lemonade! Win win kinda deal if you ask me!!! Already a return customer!

place_category: Comfort Food, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Amazing and lots of food ! It is a little bit pricey but the food was great ! The people were a little cranky because we had a big group and were all taking food to go but the food is what counts and that is an A :)

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Wasn't a fan, much better places in Tucson for sushi, and far cheaper. Family of 5, split Love boat and had 2 rolls and 2 happy hour rolls - came out to $120+Tip - could easily get all you can eat for less price somewhere else (better sushi too). Took far too long to get food after ordering. Won't be back unless I'm dying for sushi after a movie (rather have the Sonoran hot dogs at the eatery on the south side of the theather)

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers
text: Very slow service, long wait in drive thru. Customers started blowing their horns. People kinda of okay, probably different every visit. We couldn't understand them and they couldn't understand us. Icee machine working!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Pizza, Italian
text: Disappointed. 75 minutes for a to go order last weekend when you quoted 20-25 minutes. Gave you a second chance the next night. Same thing. And tonight two open tables but because we are only a party of three you said it would be 25 minutes as to not take up your 6 seater. Food is decent but not worth that service. Won't be back.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Vegetarian, Noodles, Restaurants, Thai
text: We've eaten great Thai food all over New York and I've got to say this was fabulous stop for us, we were pleasantly surprised with the flavoring of all the food. Keep up the good work.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, French
text: Get the duck gumbo! Delicious! One of the most memorable dishes I had in New Orleans! We went at lunch time and the service started out really well but maybe the shifts changed, because then the service wasn't as good.

place_category: Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Restaurants
text: Sahara Grill is very delicious and the food is of great quality. The prices are fair, as well as the portions. I recommend you come when you want a great meal.

place_name: West Ave Grille Jenkintown Restaurant and Food Truck
place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Caterers, American (New), Comfort Food, Food Trucks, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Food
text: I just wanted to thank you for the amazing sandwich tray! There was plenty for everyone! And they raved about all of them! I have to admit the chicken salad was my fave! Everything was ready as promised and Molly was so helpful when I arrived! Thank you again and I will definitely recommend West Avenue for catering! I know I'll be ordering catering from you again! I already love and recommend eating at the restaurant! You guys are the best!

place_category: Basque, Tapas Bars, Spanish, Restaurants
text: Our waitress acted as if she was annoyed by us. Really expensive if you have the appetite greater than that of an anorexic teenager. Sangria could have been better. Can't tell if there is any wine in it or not.

place_category: Department Stores, Shopping, Grocery, Discount Store, Drugstores, Fashion, Food, Electronics
text: It's a Walmart- but clean. Great selection of hunting Gear. Food section is varied and fresh. Good selection of fruits and vegetables. Stopped for some DEF and purchased many items as plaid shirts where on sale. I'll shop here again as prices are much cheaper than competing stores.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Very very very very very average. It costs waaay too much. $7?? U kidding?? It's not like the ice cream tastes bad or anything. I got the breakfast club with trix and Oreo mixed in it. Wasn't bad, it's a creative twist to ice cream, but it's deeeefinitely not worth the price. The reviews aren't lying when they say it takes forever to come out. I get it, it takes effort to flatten, roll, whateva. Props to the girl workin there tho, she was the only one and had to deal with like 10 customers

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Very friendly people. Your typical Chinese TOGO! I've enjoyed their "House Special Lo Mein". 4 stars for taste - service but 3 stars overall because ! FYI it's very HOT inside so I highly recommend just TOGO orders. # 813-908-7988 Location is OK. I'm very picky about Lo Mein & they are on point here. I only suggest adding chilli for some spicy kick.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, American (New)
text: We were looking for a great night with great friends and a great meal! Instead we had an hour wait WITH a reservation! Frustrating and Unacceptable. Very disappointed and wouldn't recommend using online to book your meal here. We left and went down the road for a great meal elsewhere...

place_category: Restaurants, Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Salad
text: I'm from Philly, took my picky boyfriend here for a cheesesteak and we really enjoyed it. Staff was very friendly too. Would def go back

place_category: Italian, Food, Restaurants, Gelato
text: I arrived at 6 o'clock for a pre-theater dinner. We ordered about 15 to 20 minutes later and by 7:15.we had yet to be served. I had notified them that we had theater tickets for 730. Others around us had been served, eaten and left for the theater. Although we did have salads out main course never came. Although we have had several good meals there I will never return. This kind of service is inexcusable. There are too many really good Italian restaurants in our city to put up with this.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Casinos, Hotels, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, Restaurants, Pet Services, Pets, Arts & Entertainment, Pet Sitting
text: Can't really complain about this hotel. It provided a good priced normal room with an okay view of Las Vegas. The stores downstairs are also pretty good, it was almost like a mini mall.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Food excellent, service eh. I got the enchiladas my wife got the tacos. Both were really good. Again the service was really slow so I brought it down from 4 to a 3 stars

place_category: Food, Nightlife, Breweries, Restaurants, Pizza, Pubs, Bars
text: Love this place and super glad they are finally in east! A killer selection of beer (there's a full bar, too!) and OMFG THEIR PIZZA. I had the Mac & cheese pizza and about died. It was heavenly. For sure come check this place out if you haven't already!

place_category: Food, Poke, Hawaiian, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Seafood, Salad
text: Delicious! Pretty expensive but great poke and the staff was super nice. Everyone seemed like they were in a good mood. Definitely will be back for sure. I love poke!

place_category: American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Came here for an event. service was good. Drinks for happy hour were standard wine or lager. Food seemed interesting... but it was tastier in print then actuality. Truffle popcorn for example was nothing more than stale popcorn and some cheap truffle oil. Would go back to try their dinner menu though. Maybe its just the apps that are forced?

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: It is not the best pizza in the world but it is definitely good enough, and the prices are fair. They're in a nice part of the Ville as well. Also the staff and owners are friendly and they care about their customers. Some of the items beyond pizza on the menu are pretty decent as well. All in all a solid place.

place_category: Gastropubs, Nightlife, American (New), Sports Bars, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Beer Bar, German, Restaurants, Modern European
text: food was pretty good. We had a lunch jager schnitzel, potato pancakes, chicken salad and flatbread. Prices are a strange range. During lunch I had 2 glasses of wine for $5 but skipped a cheese and sliced meat board which was $24. I will try this place again but Dunderbaks around the corner is stiff competition.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Food, Specialty Food, Grocery
text: Big oriental market with lots of products, but not well laid out. Small aisles and kinda dirty, compared to the MD in Pinellas Park. As with all locations, you can find virtually everything here. All employees have dedicated posts/positions and so don't expect to see them floating around to answer your questions. Prices are comparable to other oriental markets.

place_category: Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Southern, Desserts, Cafes, American (New)
text: I love the atmosphere of this place. The food is amazing and the service is fantastic. Try the salmon toast or burger! Will definitely visit again when I'm back in New Orleans.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: I go to orange leaf all the time and it's 100x better than this FroYo! I didn't like this place because the yogurt was either runny or too hard to get out. The fruit toppings were over ripe. The yogurt tasted more like ice cream instead of the fresh taste of orange leaf.

place_category: German, Restaurants, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, French, Brasseries, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Ehhh... At least for lunch. Étouffée was ok if you live in Wyoming. Value and cost are not commensurate... Not even close. Go to a diff John Besh (like Borgne near the Hyatt Regency)...

place_category: Food, Bakeries
text: My favorite bakery! I go there for all occasions, including my wedding cake. Went there most recently for my anniversary cake and they did an exceptional job.

place_category: Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Delicious. Yummy. Tasty. Warm and comforting. All things that describe this great breakfast joint. And I have the shirt to prove it =) I wear my rooster proudly.

place_category: Lounges, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: Been in that bar for number of years. Tonight's pizza order was appalling. Like cardboard, dry, and tasteless. I usually order the same choice so I know what was "normal" and this sure as heck wasn't. Always a laugh when the publicity refers to the "fine dining" available. What a joke today.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: I like that you can order online and request extra bake time. They also have thin crust which I like. One blah comment is that the mushrooms they use are canned.

place_category: Seafood, Nightlife, Piano Bars, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Cajun/Creole, Bars, Sandwiches
text: Came here for a bachelorette party and the service was so not good. Four people from our party didn't receive their food until 20 minutes after the rest of the party. And we never even got our appetizers!! Very disappointed and was hoping for a much better experience

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Steakhouses, Sandwiches
text: Had the chance to attend brunch at this location and I was completely satisfied with the service. I had the spicy scramble with toast. My friend had the steak and eggs. Our food was amazing and the mimosas were great too. If you're going solo, a simple mimosa will do. However, if you are going with friends it would better to just get a bottle and split it. You get to choose the juice you want, and we got grapefruit and orange. Can't wait to return again soon!

place_category: Food, Pubs, Bars, Breweries, Nightlife
text: This place is a laid back brewery with good pizza and a huge patio for a Sunday beer. There are games to play at your table or games like corn hole to play outside. There's plenty of screens to catch the game too. I have not had anything but good things to say the 3 times I've been.

place_category: Nightlife, Sushi Bars, Karaoke, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Really overpriced for what it is. Sushi was mediocre at best and the noodles are terrible. Worst sushi I've had in New Orleans. Extremely disappointed

place_category: Asian Fusion, Desserts, Sushi Bars, Food, Japanese, Restaurants
text: I like their variety unique rolls and nigiri. They put so much rice, it's like double rice comparing to regular rolls at other sushi restaurants. Not too many choices on the appetizers. Service was great but they're very slow since the server has to take all your orders. They don't do the sheets so it was kinda hard to order.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: I've eaten at greeks a few times during my trips to Indiana, and I was very pleased. Their staff and servers were incredibly nice and welcoming and I loved the food. They took great safety precautions due to covid and the restaurant was very clean. I will definitely be going back on my next trip!

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Food
text: Great little Chinese place. I absolutely love the steamed dumplings. Plus probably the best crab Rangoon in the city. The hot and spicy beef is exactly that! The place is kept immaculately clean. The only reason not to give it a fourth star is they have only one size of fountain drink. Small. And they seem a little pricey. But definitely worth the time to stop in.

place_category: Food, Arts & Entertainment, Wineries
text: Went wine tasting here on Mother's Day and I was disappointed. The woman who poured our samples was very nice, but we felt very rushed and squished in. We really were not able to enjoy our wines at all. I think they should have had a better plan for the amount of clients they had. No free tastings, or anything else for mothers. However, we did get to keep our tasting glass, which is always great. I didn't think the wines were that great. I bought a bottle, but nothing worth coming back for.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Okay food, but extremely dirty!! Always ask employees to wipe down tables and booths!

place_category: Donuts, Restaurants, Food
text: Simply terrific donuts. The jelly filled was one of the best I've ever eaten (and I have tried a lot) and the friendly cashier made the experience five-star. Best thing about the donut was the way it was lightly fried without being greasy and no aftertaste. Frosting was literally the icing on that cake. Mmmm good. If you like good donuts, try this classic on Route 66.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: Nice people to deal with but the prices are off the wall. Hundred dollar bottles selling for 500. 35-40 for 100. I was a bit shocked when the cashier told me $600 for two 750ml bottles. But judging by the other bottles by the register I'm guessing many others walked out disappointed.

place_category: Comfort Food, Restaurants, Chicken Shop, American (Traditional), Sandwiches
text: Saw the reviews on Yelp and decided to check in out. Was NOT disappointed! Sister had the caprese, mom had the cheeseburger and I had the lobster. Delicious. Very friendly people who explained the delicious menu options. Really clean ladies room was a plus. Definitely will be back when we visit Tucson again

place_category: Restaurants, Gelato, Coffee & Tea, Food, Italian, Bakeries
text: Awesome service and great food! Got lucky with them being able to accommodate a party of 7 last minute. Very different main course dishes with paired Gelato. You have to have an open mind to try it and it was well worth it. 10/10 would recommend.

place_category: Food, International Grocery, Grocery
text: This T&T is much better than the one located in the west side. It is a smaller store but it is quite clean and workers seem more friendly. They also have most things in stock that would be out of stock at the WEM location.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Caribbean, Music Venues, Bars, Pubs, Lounges
text: Possibly the most unique bar in St. Louis. I love the inside, but not as much as the patio. Really nice bartenders. Super cheap canned beers. They also get great local bands to play, which can make it really cramped on the inside. This is part of the allure. Make sure to bring cash!

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Fast Food, Chicken Shop
text: The health inspector who allowed this place to remain open should be in JAIL! Filthy, and food past the expiration. Health Inspector, are you blind or just stupid?

place_category: Hot Dogs, American (New), Barbeque, Burgers, Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: Its like you're in your backyard but more expensive. Great char on the hotdog. Relish not listed on the toppings but they do have it if you ask. Potato salad was a bit too mashed for my liking. 1 Hot dog, 1 beer (on happy hour), and potato salad = $12

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Pizza, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Food Delivery Services
text: Not bad, it will do. A slice of cheese pizza was on the menu for me on this beautiful day in Exton. The sauce is a bit salty for my northern palate, but the crust was light, crispy and nice. Not good enough for 4 stars, I'll go with 3...

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: good tacos good salsa bar lots of other choices in the area but this place is fine if you want to eat tacos

place_category: American (New), Public Services & Government, Landmarks & Historical Buildings, Diners, Salad, Bars, Burgers, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Steakhouses, Seafood, Breakfast & Brunch, Cocktail Bars
text: Awful. They charge way too much. Decorations are not good. Just all around disappointing. Don't know why it has four and a half stars. Their band kept asking for 20$ bills. This isn't vegas, it's Nashville. People come here to have a cheaper fun getaway. 20$ cover for their "show." Which was not good.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Mexican, Salad, Empanadas
text: Pros: Great food and menu. Cons: Orders are consistently served incorrect and menu items regularly not available. Also they advertise delivery and regularly refuse to deliver. Also they do not accept advertised payment methods. Customer service and general business operations needs to be improved significantly.

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Thai
text: My go to Thai restaurant. I've only ever had the Pad Thai, Drunken Noodles, dumplings, and Thai Tea but all are ALWAYS good. Sometimes the wait is long, but there is a martini bar next door to kill the time. If there isn't a long wait, it's ready right on time and is always piping hot! I give 5 stars based on my To-Go experiences only as I've never dined in. Hope you enjoy as much as I do!

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: We had a really good time at this place! It looks like a giant, aged mansion, and that makes it even cooler. We admittedly first came for the advertised "Free Appetizer" (with Yelp check-in), and wound up not even using it. (You have to purchase 2 full entrees to get it, we wound up with something like an entree and 2 appetizers. No big deal.) The balcony is fantastic, service is good, and the food is impeccable - all right in the Quarter. I highly recommend the crab claw dish.

place_category: African, Restaurants
text: My first time here and I was so satisfied! I had rice and cassava leaf and oh my days was it yummy! It was spicy and full of flavor...completely worth the 2hr drive from Harrisburg! I will definitely be back. I took a star off because parking is challenging and its located in the hood.

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Delis, Grocery, Specialty Food, Health Markets, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, American (New)
text: I love shopping at Gelson's because it's close to my house and the ready to eat items are always yummy and the salad bar is great. Im not to sure though whats going to happen when the bakery changes (so Iv heard.) I am a big fan of local products and support them when I can. I am addicted to Rori's Ice Cream and I always get it through the bakery (Jeannine's.) whoever takes over will they carry it? I don't get why its just not in the freezer section with the other ice cream. ???

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian
text: Damn good pizza all around and the best in the area. I frequently order from here and have never been disappointed! Everything from cheesesteak pizza to fries to sicilian is amazing every single time. Wing sauce is the best and a must-try! Highly recommend this family owned restaurant, TRUST ME ITS WORTH IT

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Salad, Sandwiches
text: This a nice family spot with a varied menu. They have a wide variety of menu items and most are quite good. They serve 3 meals a day so you can go anytime. Service is efficient and prices are reasonable.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Bubble Tea, Desserts, Creperies
text: first time trying this boba place out! It seems that this is one of the few boba places in this area. The menu is huge, there are so many different flavors of drinks to choose from. There are also fresh desserts on display for customers to choose from as well. The aesthetic of the boba shop consitists of a panda mural, lots of k-pop band posters and different plants around the shop. The only thing I would have to say is that the boba was a little hard.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Lounges, Venues & Event Spaces, Nightlife, Event Planning & Services
text: Great cocktails and service in a grand atmosphere. Initially we sat at a table that someone had left and it took forever for the glassware to be cleared. Eventually went to the bar since we sat for 10-15 min waiting for someone to take an order. At the bar both bartenders were wonderful. Had 2 sazeracs and they were great. Expertly crafted! Great atmosphere and would go again when in town. This is my 3rd time visiting this bar over the last 5 years.

place_category: Nightlife, Food, Pizza, Brewpubs, Restaurants, Fish & Chips, American (New), Bars, Pubs, Breweries, Vegetarian
text: I cannot find any restaurants that serves better raviolis!! I get them every-time I go for the most part unless something catches my eye on the weekly special menu which is always booming with kick ass options!!! Service is okay but never he best.. BUT Good atmosphere and drinks!! Tip: stay away from window seats during cold seasons ITS COLD and very uncomfortable when trying to enjoy your meal

place_category: Barbeque, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: I bet this place would have been awesome IF IT WAS OPEN during the day.... it was NOT great to drive thru the Nashville 'hood and arrive at a closed place...please post hours.

place_category: Food, Latin American, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food Delivery Services, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Cuban
text: This is a hole in the wall. A local took me here since he likes their Cuban sandwiches. I never would have stumbled on this place. The Cuban was very good. I liked the mustard since it was milder and smoother. The sandwich was huge! The deviled crab was less successful. Over fried and a bit bland. There are only three tables so not much for dining in.

place_category: Restaurants, Buffets, Southern
text: I love coming to Fred's. I can't really think of any buffet around that keeps so much food at an acceptable quality as they do. I don't mean that as a tongue in cheek comment. Their food is good, not the absolute best ever but definitely enough to scratch that itch for southern cooking. If you can't make it to your grandma's house, Fred's is the next best thing!

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars
text: Wings, wings, wings. I like Wing House, the staff is always friendly, the food is served fast & hot. Always ask to have your wings served in a mixture of Dallas Sauce & Hot Sauce. The restaurant is always clean.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Southern, American (Traditional), Beer Bar, Bars
text: we had apps and beers during covid and it was chilly outside. liked the music and the wait staff bartenders. all good.

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: Great place to have lunch during the work week. The lunch specials are only 10 bucks which comes with a soup, app, and entree. Although the service only consist of only one waiter. He is pretty fast with your order. They recently added an additional waiter for the busy lunch. The spicy evil jungle princess is great and they make sure they always refill your water because you will need it for that dish.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Seafood, Chicken Shop
text: Overpriced tiny wings and small portions. I'm normally satisfied with a six piece and fries. Not from this place! I gave them multiple chances. Quality has gone down while the price has crept up.

place_category: Vegetarian, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Sandwiches, Food
text: Came across this little place about a month ago. When I decided to write a review today, I could not remember what I had. Not a good sign. After looking at the menu, I remembered I had the crab melt. It was so-so. I wasn't a huge fan of the remoulaude sauce and it wasn't a very big sandwich. I got the coleslaw as a side which was a mistake. It was not your typical coleslaw but was very mustard-y. Should have stuck with breakfast after seeing the pictures!

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Salad
text: I used to love coming here for breakfast and lunch but on multiple occasions I've been served undercooked food. Maybe I should stop being lazy and walk a few more blocks to another location.

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Music Venues, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife
text: Awesome show...but upstairs closed and only 2 bartenders downstairs. 25min for each beverage is ridiculous. More staff please

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Diners, Restaurants
text: Just had breakfast at the all new Brooklawn Diner. Food was great and the service was excellent. It also appeared very clean. I will be back.

place_category: Bed & Breakfast, American (Traditional), Comfort Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Salad, Restaurants, Hotels & Travel
text: Would have been five stars, I ordered dinner which came with rolls (I declined) I was offered Toast if desired (declined) Wife had pancakes, sunny side up eggs and Sausage ordered toast, was charged $2.09 cents for toast, subtracted $2.00 from a 20% tip which would have been 25% Waitress should have included toast which would have been part of my meal and who ever heard of breakfast (sunny side) with alacarte toast?

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Breweries, Restaurants, American (New), Pizza
text: Unfortunately this place served us a mediocre meal including our first ever frozen salad. My friend and I looked and were like is your lettuce frozen omg. At least it was refreshing :). Sorry to say that other than really nice people and service this place has little to offer. Won't be coming back this is the third poor experience in a row. Don't waste your time here when we have so many cool bars and gastro pubs in Reno.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Barbeque, Desserts
text: Order took forever, then they forgot part of it. I didn't notice until I got home. I tried calling to let them know, couldn't get thru. Place sucks.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, French, Specialty Food, Seafood, Diners, Cajun/Creole, Seafood Markets, Event Planning & Services, Southern, Caterers, Salad
text: I was recommended this restaurant by a tour guide, but the food was not as good as I expected. It had a Denny's ambiance and the food tasted the same. No overwhelming flavors or sense of NOLA culture. The service was good, clean restaurant, I just wanted more culture and flavor.

place_category: Nightlife, Latin American, Bars, Laotian, Seafood, Caribbean, Restaurants
text: My food always comes out different from what I order. Last time I said on my salad well done salmon and no beans. Salad came with beans and uncooked Salmon. I told tHe young lady nicely my food had beans. Therefore, she apologize to me and my appetite left.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: ONE STAR!!! What happened here? New recipe?!?! Pizza is totally different and defiantly not what joeys used to be. I don't know what happened they changed everything and not for the better... sorry this used to be the best place in around, hopefully things turn around.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: On the day I came they weren't offering anything but the buffet. We were meeting for a grand center tour and did not partake in anything except coffe. That was done well. As was the kambuchi which was a fermented hangover cure. I wasn't hungover but it tasted pretty good

place_category: Tapas/Small Plates, Nightlife, Jazz & Blues, Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Thai, Restaurants
text: Food was very good. Service was very slow. The wait staff was very pleasant and knowledgeable about the menu. There were only 2 of them covering the whole floor at lunch rush. I couldn't see the kitchen, but given how long it too for the food to arrive, I'm guessing they were under staffed as well. I would certainly return when I wasn't time constrained. But I think lunch is not realistic.

place_category: Pakistani, Indian, Restaurants, Food, Food Delivery Services, Vegetarian
text: It's been 2 hours and I am still waiting for my delivery order that they said would take 15 minutes. I have called to check in 4 times and each time they said that it should be here "soon". I am hungry and angry.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Chicken Shop, Soup
text: We ordered the cashew chicken combo and chicken broccoli. The were both excellent. The egg rolls were even better. They were so crispy. Great food. We will order from there again.

place_category: American (New), Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: I'm definitely having mixed opinions about this place. I do love grilled cheese and milkshakes, however their grilled cheese was way too salty for me. I got the classic and a chocolate milkshake for $12. The place is small and cozy with plenty of seats. The toast is crunchy and buttery and the cheese was stringy. I just wish it wasn't as salty.. otherwise the milkshake was really good and chocolatey!

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Barbeque, Cantonese, Chinese
text: Very inexpensive lunch combos but not very much flavor. I had the Hunan beef and asked for it to be extra spicy but it didn't come out spicy at all or have much other flavor. My friend had the chicken lo mein which I tried and I thought that was equally as lacking. So if you are looking for inexpensive this is it but if you prioritize flavor then I'd go elsewhere. Maybe extra extra extra spicy would have been about right?

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: I love this place the only thing is the service, they're not as attentive as they should be but as someone who's been to Asia over 10 times that's how they serve over their, they're very lackadaisical. But the food is authentic and it's pretty good, although Vietnamese food is a little spicier in Vietnam but it's good nonetheless...

place_category: Food, Smokehouse, Restaurants, Barbeque, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: This was my second visit here and I was not disappointed at all... Ribs were very tender and the glaze in my opinion was just right... The big beans also very good... My wife had the pulled pork nachos and it was as tender as it could be... we tried the fried pickles and they had a great kick to them...this is one place that you will not be disappointed, but will return anytime you're in the area and it is just off of I-44...it deserves the five star rating that I gave it.

place_category: Specialty Food, Candy Stores, Food
text: Wanted to try one of the chocolate frozen shake things, but in her attempt to make it the lady dropped the entire blender with the liquid chocolate stuff on the floor. We felt pretty bad and didn't want to rush her so we told her we'd be back in 10-15 minutes. When we came back she handed us the shake. A sincere apology, but no complimentary chocolates or anything for the wait and mishap. The shake was good, but so small and $7?!! Come on Godiva that's why the store is always empty.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza, Southern, Italian, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Today was a very bad experience. The hostess are continually declining, the service was way too slow when we were ready to leave and the food was not worth the cost. They used to be really amazing. Wonder what happened.

place_category: Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Southern, Restaurants
text: The food was not bad and the service was aight. The hostess told us it'd be a 5-10 minute wait then we ended up waiting almost 30 minutes. But our server DJ was very friendly and helpful. We got our food only about 10-15 minutes after ordering. Honestly I'd give this place a 4 rating because our waiter was nice. But the food wasn't killing it for me. I would come again if I'm craving late night carby comfort food (closes at 12AM Saturday nights) Would I go out of my way to eat here? nah.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Tacos, Restaurants, Fast Food, Tex-Mex, Mexican
text: Never a problem with this location food is always fast, hot, and well put together. no sloppy burritos here.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: This place is really sketchy, food is more like a snack bar. Creepy atmosphere. So many good places to eat, don't eat here!

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Italian, Pizza
text: Good food not great. Order the pizza well done or it may be a little chewy. Sandwiches and dinners average for a local pizza place. Unfortunately they just switched to Pepsi products bleh !!!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Gluten-Free, Bars, Diners, Vegetarian, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Pubs
text: The food was pretty good. The service was bad bad bad. The door lady was weird and kind of rude to me and my friend, which I didn't know where did it come from at all. Honestly their service just ruined everything, which made me don't enjoy the food any more.

place_category: Nightlife, Karaoke, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, American (Traditional)

Other than that, it doesn't have much going for it. Save your money and time.

place_category: Cafes, Food, Restaurants, Mexican

text: This is our go to spot for Indian buffet lunch. The food is delicious, comes out regularly, and the service is polite and courteous. We especially love the Naan, and the butter chicken.

place_category: Food, Organic Stores, Burgers, Restaurants, Vegetarian, Fast Food, American (Traditional), Salad
text: I loved this place! I had a championburger (mushrooms) and my husband had a garden veggie burger. The bread is so soft, light, and delicious. Fries are air fried and they have 4 types of ketchup. Garlic ketchup was the best! We also had an organic low fat chocolate milkshake. I recommend this place for you that want to go for fast food but healthier.

place_category: Sandwiches, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood
text: I think things are going down hill with Frenchy's food quality. Grouper nuggets still had the bloodline going thru, the "large" scallops were small. We scalloped this past season & they were mucho twice as big. The octopus was cold & slimy. Even the chicken wings were soggy. We're likely not to return.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Must admit the food is good, but the hours are always changing, they are never right on the website and the service is slow and they don't care to answer their phone most of the time. Would eat there more if they could get it together, meantime I'm ordering food from a bsuiness that is open when they say they are and answers their phone!

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Food was prepared promptly, and it was good and hot. Portions were very generous. The Lemon Chicken was breaded but it had NO sauce, so it was not lemony. Very disappointing! I believe this was an error, and not the way it was supposed to be. The Honey Walnut Shrimp was good, with lots of shrimp, and some actual walnuts. The variety platter of appetizers was also good. We might try this place again some day. Not cheap!!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Japanese
text: Service was subpar and the food was not worth the money spent...The waiter was inattentive and got my drink order wrong several times and seemed bothered when I asked her questions...She then had the nerve to come back and demand a tip... and I explained to her why I did not leave one and she harassed me about a tip, very unprofessional. Needless to say I still did not leave one.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Barbeque, Caribbean, Seafood

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), American (New), Sandwiches
text: I have been to Mimi blues twice now, and have decided to go with a 3 star review. I ordered the veggie meatballs with the mushroom sauce. The lady that took my order seemed rather rude, and said the she wouldn't get that combo if she were I, because it did not taste good together. Also the second time I went the food came out rather slow, but overall the meatball sliders were very tasty. I'm coming back for more and hope to have a better experience!

place_category: Music Venues, Bars, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Great salad bar. Steak was overcooked, bland, and chewy. There were barely any grill marks on it. Please take my advice, come for the salad bar only. Don't waste your time or 23 dollars on any steak dish.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: I am not big on Italian food generally but this place does it right. I had the special which had a very tender filet with mushroom on top. The flavor from the sauce was unique and put this dish over the edge. Our server was also very knowledge and willing to share his 12 years of knowledge about the different dishes.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: One of my favs. Always fresh and tasty never a disappointment in my stomach!!! Highly recommend the all u can eat. Prices are very much so reasonable for the pockets. I've been to many of many sushi bars and I seem to always find myself back here. Matter of fact as I type this I'm here NOW grabbing some to go

place_category: Cuban, Restaurants
text: Andy's has the finest roasted pork you will ever eat, but the real gem here is the spicy sauce they offer to dress your meal as you slide your tray down to the register. The sauce is incredible on anything, it's super spicy with the perfect flavor to compliment and protein.

place_category: Donuts, Coffee & Tea, Hot Dogs, Food, Restaurants
text: Day 1: Thank you Jason for great recommendations we truly enjoyed our meal. Please support this business as their craftsmanship of in house handmade items is superior. Day 2: Welp we are back. Will informed us to not miss the doughnuts on yesterday and so we came back this morning. They are amazing and the Smoked Latte is great too. Tip: Park in the back as it's free and for their customers only. Make sure to check behind the bush for Ninjas though if you're not picking up a doughnut or dog.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Gastropubs, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Lounges, Bars
text: Wouldn't come here if you're looking for a great meal. Tuscan fries were cold and soggy, got charged for a large salad as an appetizer, my girlfriend got a turkey club and it was also cold but the cheese was melted? Buffalo cauliflower was pretty good but they were out of the "blue cheese fondue" which they didn't tell us til it got to the table. Nothing special.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, American (New), Southern, Tapas/Small Plates, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife
text: Ahh Boucherie, amazing cocktails, small plates were wonderful. Didn't like the fries everyone flips out over. Do yourself a favor & get the collard greens,they're made of magic & fairy dust. Seriously, the most amazing greens I've ever encountered. Krispy Kream bread pudding was way over the top. Thai chili chocolate chess cake gave me the "O face." service was total class.

place_category: American (Traditional), Tex-Mex, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: As with everywhere in Tucson, AZ... awesome service! Thanks Danny, the bartender, for being so wonderful!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Visited here a few times after moving this side of town. Bartenders are very nice, pizza is great, veggie sandwich was wonderful. Very friendly atmosphere. ..will be back :)

place_category: Pizza, Bars, Pubs, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Nightlife
text: This is a review specifically about the pizza. I got a carryout order of Rockstone pizza last week. I LOVE pizza, and I have been on a quest to find the best pizza in Indy. This certainly isn't it, but it isn't bad, either. Lots of toppings and a great-tasting crust, but in my opinion it was too cheesy and greasy. It's reasonably priced, though ($12 for a large cheese). I'd recommend it for a step above the pizza chains, but not in the same league as Bazbeaux, Jockamo's or South of Chicago.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (Traditional)
text: Delicious club with cranberry mayo! Homemade potato chips were also yummy. Very good service.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Southern, Salad, Chicken Shop
text: Never Again!!!!!!!! If you want rude servers this is the place. The food is ok, but way overpriced. Not going back.

place_category: Shopping, Drugstores, Delis, Mexican, Grocery, Restaurants, Food, Bakeries
text: I can recommend Food Source. I liked the quality of items sold here. They positioned themselves as a low cost store. I went there the day after I stocked up on some household items at my local Target and Target had them beat on just about every item. Some of the food items were better priced. I found things there that were cheaper than Smith's/Kroger and more importantly they seem to have a better selection than Smith's.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Thai, Sushi Bars
text: I've only ever ordered take-out from here and it's your average Asian-American restaurant. I like that it has a variety of Asian food and it does it all pretty well. The sushi lunch/dinner deals are great and I think the portion sizes are good.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: This place use to be really good when Maggie was the owner. But now its new owners and it's not as good and service has gone down. Still better than 777, Asian Noodles, and Golden Flower though.

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Pizza, Delis, Food
text: The Italian Kitchen did an amazing job catering my wedding this past weekend! We had approximately 125 guests who were served a delicious buffet dinner and desserts. The food was so flavorful, our guests are still raving about it. I had family come from Italy who complimented the meatballs and pasta sauces! The staff was so friendly and helpful. I can honestly say they made my day worry free and were on top of everything. Thank you Italian Kitchen for making our day so memorable!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Latin American, Mexican, Salad, American (New)
text: This place has been on a steady decline ever since Poe left to go open up his own restaurant. They got rid of the touch-screen computers so you have to place your order manually now. This wouldn't be a big deal, except the service is slow, slow, slow, when both operating the cash register and cooking the food. It's hard to go wrong with a burrito stuffed with french fries, but it's definitely not what it was when it first opened all shiny and new.

place_category: Sandwiches, Food, Caribbean, Seafood, Desserts, Restaurants
text: The food and service was really good. I had the stew chicken and my boyfriend had the jerk chicken both were full of Caribbean flavor. Portion sizes were very good. I was so stuffed, it was ridiculous. If the air conditioning had been working I would have given them five stars. Even though the place was quite small, the atmosphere was nice. Wednesday, 21 June 2017

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Food, Breweries
text: This is a nice place. The food was better than average, though not amazing. Presentation was good. The beer had flavor. I do think some of the menu prices were a bit higher than warranted.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: So yummy and the little waitress she works so hard I can tell and is slaw has smelling and greeting us love it

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Comfort Food, American (New), Sandwiches, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I do like this place, I don't know if it truly has anything to set it apart and be unique from other breakfast eateries. It has fresh food, light atmosphere, and great service. But I wish it has that pizazz, I truly believe a breakfast place could.

place_category: Polish, Restaurants, American (New)
text: This was my second visit here. It was just as wonderful as the first time. The staff makes you feel very welcome. They were very happy to answer our questions. We had invited another couple to join us. This was their first visit. They were just as happy as we were. The food is delicious!! Cooked to perfection and very flavorful. The portions are more than generous. We enjoyed a leisurely dinner. I highly recommend this restaurant. I will return with more friends. Wonderful experience.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Chinese
text: The food is okay atmosphere is also fine as well. Not too much to complain about or praise for that matter. It isnt overpriced but the restaurant is outclassed by another chinese place nearby.

place_category: Fast Food, Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: not usually one to leave bad reviews, but after having multiple bad experiences at this location i felt i had to. From being rude through the ordering speaker to being ignored at the window. and being over charged we will never visit this location again.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Hotels & Travel, Restaurants, Hotels, Seafood
text: Great location: walking distance from lots of restaurants and historic sites. The worst feature was the lack of refrigerator in the room! There is a mini fridge but only for the sale of their items. You get charged for merely opening it (see photo). So, if you plan to bring back leftovers or drinks, you're SOL. For over $200 per night, that is completely unacceptable.

place_category: Cafes, Burgers, American (Traditional), Tacos, Seafood, Restaurants, Mexican
text: The food here is just so so, people come here for the ambiance. Its the only place that I know of, where you can sit on the sand and eat breakfast while having a bloody Mary.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers, Hot Dogs, American (Traditional)
text: Burger grisley and bacon under cooked. Girl at the counter double charged me and I was told it was her first day. Why wasn't she supervised? After lunch we went back to order 2 shakes and waited 20 min. Until we went up asked if they were going to make them, and they found them, already made, just sitting there. They handed them to us and the guy muttered a rude comment to his coworker. Never will we return. Subpar food and poor service.

place_category: Bars, Italian, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Beer Bar, American (New), Pizza
text: Portions although large have shrunk some while some prices have gone up. Food is ok for families, but expect a lot of noise. Servers are always great. Kitchen can vary. Salty one time, spaghetti not drained properly. Most of the time food comes out just fine.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: The proportions are huge, enough for two meals. The food was decent but nothing to brag about. The person who picked up the phone was somewhat rude. He asked if I would look up their menu online because I asked if they had a few things. The garlic chicken had a lot of vegetables and not as much flavor as other places I've tried. There is take out beer which I guess offsets the mediocre service and so-so food... Or maybe not. I will go to other local hot spots next time.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: I'm so excited! My husband and I moved to Tucson last year and have been in a bad way with Chinese delivery. Finally tried Mantis based on reviews and loved it. The food came within 30 mins, great portions, and good flavor. Ordered the vegetable lo mein, Kung pao chicken, and Mongolian chicken. Will be trying it again-- specifically the pho! Bottomline: match made in Chinese heaven

place_name: Hattie B's Hot Chicken - Nashville West
place_category: Beer Bar, Bars, Southern, Soul Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Chicken Wings
text: I love Hattie b's but I hate this location . For some reason they get lazy with the hot sauce for the chicken and will only have about 2 lines of hot sauce through the whole chicken when I asked for "medium" and my boyfriend asks for "mild" somehow we end up with 2 lines of hot sauce and the rest is plain chicken. I have to ask for a container of hot sauce to pour on it myself because apparently they don't know how to put the right hot sauce on the chicken anymore.

place_category: Candy Stores, Specialty Food, Food, Chocolatiers & Shops
text: Cute place. Fresh pralines made there. Sugar high. Advertised as the oldest candy store in town. It's nice and close proximity to everything.

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Salad, Restaurants
text: On a crowded Saturday night, the lady and I were seated immediately at the bar area. I haven't been back since the YEE held here two years ago. The pizza is just as awesome as I remembered. After consuming a Spicy Sausage, a chocolate old-fashioned, and a sip of the vodka cocktail with jalapeno and peach, I was filled with pizza coma and ready to sleep. Can't wait to come back with more friends to try more pizzas.

place_category: Bars, Beer Gardens, Food, Breweries, Nightlife, Tours, Pubs, Wine Tours, Beer Tours, Hotels & Travel
text: No firepits lit anywhere. Did not get the smores that I paid for in advance. Kicked out after 40 minutes due to weather even though the website says they do not cancel due to weather. No refunds within 24 hours of reserved time.
