place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Great place for Pho..the best I've had in the city so far. You can ask for your regular pho to be "spicy" and they add this special sauce to it which just pumps up the flavour. Green onion cakes and spring rolls are great too! Fresh squeezed orange juice is de-lish and also their mango drink as well. I live quite a distance away and I would drive so far just to eat here at least once a week! Keep in mind they are closed on Tuesdays for some odd reason but any other day is fair game!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: First it seems like it's not going to be much of anything, but it's well worth your money. The portions are incredible for that amount spent, and the food is fantastic. Salads blow, but who's there for the salads. Recommend for casual dinner or takeout

place_category: Grocery, Food
text: Horrible owner. You have to let people use the restroom when you sell food. Tony was rude and not helpful. I would take your business elsewhere.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Mexican, Food
text: These tacos guys!!! They are so good. Being Mexican I have high expectations for Mexican food. And the stuff this place serves is just amazing. I heard they have a new bigger location, which is great because the small original restaurant was no match for their customer base! Awesome place.

place_category: Delis, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Sandwiches
text: Excellent choice. Great sandwiches, more quality meat than you'd ever get on a Jersey Mike's or Firehouse sub for less and it's local! Well done!

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Food was great, and server was very personable but SLOW, but I think the kitchen was mostly to blame (not enough cooks?) Huge menu, almost too many choices, save yourself some time and review the menu online, and order when you fist see the server. I'd go again, but not if on a timeline. Highly recommend the pork roll sandwich. Arrival to departure was 60 min. BTW - we're from south jersey, and we approve!

place_category: Sandwiches, Religious Organizations, Juice Bars & Smoothies, American (Traditional), Salad, Food, Restaurants, Fast Food, Chicken Shop
text: You will not find better fast food fried chicken. Period. Also, the sweet heat sauce = out if control

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: I've rarely been to this Superfresh, but, they are a bit smaller compared to other locations. Including on South Street. Never remember any issues with staff and the prices were as expected for any A&P store. Sushi from the deli was fresh and typical supermarket variety. Wouldn't mind shopping if close-by.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants, Chinese
text: I couldn't tell you how the food is the three weekends in a row that I have tried to be served there I have been turned at the door apparently they do parties but yet there was no one in there

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: I tried this place recently out in Reno and I loved it! Was looking for a place with good biscuits and gravy and this one definitely hit the spot. Would definitely recommend it and can't wait to try it again.

place_category: Restaurants, Bagels, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bubble Tea, Donuts
text: You know good service when feel it. Joy and her family are awesome, they have created an environment that is family friendly which makes the customers happy. Its like a donut party up in here! Bagels, sandwiches, cronuts.... All made fresh... 10 stars

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Fabulous experience! The bbq lobster, shrimp raviolo, and crepes were the individual winners at our table. One member of our party said it was the best meal - start to finish - she's ever had!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Bakeries, Bagels, Food
text: Everything was great! Coffee was good, service was awesome. If they have a chocolate espresso ball covered in coconut, GET IT!! It was amazing and I rarely enjoy coconut!

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Chicken Shop
text: why four stars ? ? because i took burger home and waited 3 long hours to grub- duh... where's the beef? right freakin here! meat quality is kick ass, sweet egg bun is soft and lovely- i kept bomb burger very simple- extra cheese cause mo' cheese the mo' better - carmelized very sweet onion and of course the fun dipping sauces available- the peeps that work here are super sweet and on top of game ! keep up killer food

place_category: Specialty Food, Bars, Candy Stores, Desserts, Cocktail Bars, Lounges, American (New), Chocolatiers & Shops, Restaurants, Nightlife, Food
text: This was a surprisingly nice choice for drinks before dinner. Appetizers on the tables are chocolate chip cookies and they do have great chocolate martinis that all aren't on the super sweet side. Beyond this they also have a great selection of chocolate themed beers and berry beers that pair with those well. Also for those perhaps not so great with dairy or vegan they have a sorbet banana split that's super delicious and can make a few of the martini's without cream or ice cream. yay.

place_category: Southern, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: Mostly ok, sometimes interesting. The brunch here is above average and bread focused, most likely to maximize efficiency. Most kitchens hate brunch, but it's a chance to increase drink sales. It's more about the experience than the food, I guess. I can think of one exception being a really stellar chicken liver pate, but that was dinner. My friends like it so I end up here more than I would choose otherwise

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: I say this many times, so I'll say it again - most of these Mexican places are the same, especially in Edwardsville. But they're all good, not so great - just an excuse to eat fast Mexican food. Service is alright, better if you know fast Espanol. Pre-prepared but good food that comes out five minutes after you order it - you can't go wrong.

place_category: Cafes, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: It was our first visit and we were very disappointed. The service started off great but went downhill very fast. Our food came out timely but was not hot. I'd maybe say it was room temperature and kinda soggy. Our drinks sat empty until I got up to ask for refills. I don't know that we will return as there are so many other great places in Carmel for breakfast.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Hands DOWN the best sushi in philly! i know there are alot of choices here in the city but this is the BEST!! the rolls are cut small so you can easily fit them into your mouth whole (the way it should be). the sushi is made with care and knowledge. The food is truely a work of art! and it's BYOB! You gotta try it!!! and the BEST SPICY TUNA ROLL YOU'VE EVER HAD, I promise!!

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Salad, Restaurants, Hot Dogs
text: Striving to reach mediocrity. Cheese on the burger wasn't melted and the bun seemed as if right out of the fridge. Fries weren't bad. Can't imagine what would bring me to try this again. Jake's needs to be wayback somewhere else.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: So... this place changed owners, and the quality isn't the same. Hope they step up their game and make some positive changes. There is so much competition out there and they need to set themselves apart and above from the same old pizza/wings/cheesesteaks that you find everywhere. Food is now just OK. I miss the old owners.

place_category: Pizza, Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, Bars, Food, Food Delivery Services
text: Came in on a lunch business meeting on a Friday afternoon. Was greeted and served my drink right away. Very friendly atmosphere. However, I ordered the deep dish mahgerita pizza and was not impressed. It was very bland. I'll return but I'll be trying something else on the menu for sure.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Great breakfast!! Seafood Omelette was delicious. Fluffy eggs, fresh plump shrimp, crab and Brie! French Toast made with vanilla rum and cornflakes so delicious!! Great coffee! Great service!

place_category: Pizza, Vegan, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Gluten-Free, Food
text: I was supposed to post a pic of a whole half veggie half all meat pizza but neither my wife or I could contain ourselves. Delicious pizza!!! Will definitely come back again and again.

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Vegetarian, Food, Coffee & Tea, Vegan, American (New)
text: Buffalo Tempeh Wrap is killer. The Biscuits and Gravy are green and taste like Thanksgiving stuffing. Great joint!!

place_category: Bars, Pizza, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: I love the pizza in this place. Don't order online because it got our order wrong. We came to pick up and had to wait while they sorted it out. Ultimately they fixed the issue. The wife and I had a drink at the bar while we waited. The pizzas were good though. Recommend calling your order in if you're picking up.

place_category: Barbeque, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Food and greeter really good BUT the timing for the food was horrible. We sat down ready to order since we looked over the menu prior. We ordered an appetizer. The appetizer came out the same time a salad but less than 10 min. Later i didn't even have time to finish the salad no less touch the appetizer our entree came. We took the appetizer home. Note for next time, probably won't get appetizer or fix timing of food.

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Donuts, Food, Desserts, Coffee & Tea
text: Went in on a Saturday morning and it was pretty crowded but not too bad. My kids loved that they could build their own donuts!!. I got the maple bacon donut and it was so decadent and delicious. I also ordered an ice coffee and had it "their way" and it was wwwaaaayyyyyy too sweet. But I really enjoyed the experience and prices were very fair.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Karaoke, Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Sports Bars, Restaurants
text: I was stranded overnight because a winter storm came in and headed in from across the street at the Marriott. It was overall a typical bar environment. Service was pretty good, food was simple, but good. The music was pretty loud since they have the speakers above the bar. Nothing makes it really stand out above the typical bar scene, but it was acceptable.

place_category: Street Vendors, Restaurants, Food, Venezuelan, Food Trucks, Latin American
text: I can spend $60 to feed 3 people elsewhere. We felt like we walked into a staff social hour and waited an obscene amount of time for our food (45 minutes). Note to the staff: Proper hospitality is always important and remember: your customers may also speak Spanish. Thanks for picking your nose while making our food too. 2/10

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: If someone calls to do a reservation outside, and they tell you they need to sit outside, you need to tell them before they arrive that you can't seat five people together outside. My trip here was totally avoidable and now we are in a crunch to last-minute plan a dinner that is Covid friendly.

place_category: Gastropubs, Tapas Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, IT Services & Computer Repair, Restaurants, Tapas/Small Plates, Mobile Phone Repair, Local Services
text: Food was alright. Pretty good but nothing that really made me go wow. They were out of a lot of stuff on the menu which was disappointing. Our waiter was awesome though. Some Russian guy or somewhere like Russia. He was awesome and very attentive.

place_category: American (New), Italian, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Food, Coffee & Tea, Caterers
text: This place is delicious and I will come back. The specials are always good and seem to be updated all the time. The wait staff is very attentive and give good options on the food.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Pizza
text: We ordered a pizza today for delivery. It arrived smashed to the side of the box, burnt and cold. Horrible experience.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, German, Gastropubs, Restaurants, American (New)
text: The atmosphere and aesthetics were awesome. So beautifully done. The service wasn't bad but it wasn't great either. The hand crafted ginger and tamarind soda was out of this world amazing. We enjoyed the brisket...cooked well and the sauce was good. Every other dish we got was so so though...pretty bland and needed to add salt to everything. Overall not totally impressed...would only go back for the soda.

place_category: Wine Bars, Salad, Restaurants, Nightlife, Soup, Italian, Bars
text: We eat at Olive Garden frequently. This particular restaurant was just as good as any we've tried. Trayvon our server really did well--brought us extra Marsala sauce!

place_category: American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Restaurants, Diners, Food
text: A staple of my breakfast addiction for years.. WHY HAS SERVICE GONE TO SH*T??? The last two visits, I have been virtually ignored, and waited for over 40 minutes for food each time (which also included no offer of a refill on my coffee...) - time to pick a new spot. The food is always good. Bad and slow service is not acceptable. I tip more than most of the 4 and 6 top tables...

place_category: Italian, Brazilian, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Breweries, Restaurants, Brewpubs, Food
text: The owner was yelling at staff most of the time we were in there eating, the server even wrote down exactly what we wanted and the owner, cooking our food, screwed up the order and then blamed the waitress, she then said sorry to us and that it was her fault and I told her that it was NOT her fault. The owner here is a real jerk and you wait forever for your food. 2 tables after us got their food before we did! - not going back!

place_category: Pizza, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Nightlife, American (New), Italian, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Literally made an account just to say I saw two mice chasing each other on the roof deck. Hard pass.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Great breakfast! Great service! Very reasonable prices. Right near Blue Jays stadium. Yummy!

place_category: Discount Store, Drugstores, Department Stores, Grocery, Fashion, Shopping, Mobile Phones, Electronics, Shopping Centers, Food
text: Why does this walmart stock WAY less of food products that all the other Reno walmarts do? It's close for me to go but it's almost worth just driving further to the other ones. They are always out of simple things and you can't find half of what you are looking for

place_category: Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Persian/Iranian
text: Persian Grill has the very caring owners and their food is like honey to your aching throat - so soothing, calming and very delicious! The best part about them, however, is great service. Not pushy and very knowledgeable. You can spend a nice, relaxing evening here and not feel hurried, or unwanted. As far as cost, food is not to pricey, but it definitely isn't cheap. But soooo worth it! Go and see for yourself!

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Southern, American (New)
text: Southern hipster food. Everything on the menu is sourced from TN, KY, or GA and everything is homemade including the mustard and soppings. Great intent although the execution was not great. It was a little bit of haute cuisine blended with comfort food with a southern twist, that lacked a proper personality. I would go back and try again as they do change the menu. Also, it was very loud when we got there around 7.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: The staff at this location are friendly and efficient, and they make a good hot 'n ready. What more can you ask for? If choosing from the ready made menu or waiting 5 minutes after you place your order doesn't strike your fancy, you can also put your order in online. I like this location for delivering exactly what you expect from Little Caesar's, plus friendliness and efficiency. Nice work y'all!

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), American (New), Desserts, Bakeries, Restaurants
text: Not a chance of me ever going back here. The menu has hundreds of items so that should have tipped me off. Completely average diner food for premium prices. Can't believe this place is actually in busoness. 21 page menu and the food is terrible

place_category: Social Clubs, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Donuts, Arts & Entertainment, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea
text: BEST coffee ever! Service is excellent, they know my car and start my "usual" when I'm walking in. The repeat business is all about the 100% KONA!!! Haven't gotten past that to the rest of the very tempting menu.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Great speed delivery with sandwiches(in shop, delivery service is a hit or miss) but I can't stand when I get a sandwich that has charred grill all over it. CLEAN THE GRILL. I get that it's a popular sandwich spot and you get a lot of traffic but clean the grill accordingly for the sake of the quality of the sandwich

place_category: Southern, Restaurants, Jazz & Blues, Sandwiches, Arts & Entertainment, Barbeque, Nightlife
text: Not bad, not great. Just so so. Good service, ordered the Tennessee trio. Brisket, smoked sausage, and ribs. I smoke a lot of meat at home and I can tell you there was no smoke flavor to any of the meat. Somewhat bland. Ribs seemed boiled not smoked. Brisket was a weird cut, not bad but just meh. Everything else was ok. I would eat here again, just don't expect top notch smokehouse quality. It's like the Denny's of bbq joints.

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Breweries, Restaurants, American (New), Pizza
text: SO UPSET! Came here for lunch on a sunday afternoon for my sweet 16. we made reservations, that they delayed!!! they also took 30 minutes to greet us and ask for our drink orders at our table. they forgot our appetizers and took close to an hour to bring out our food. even after bringing food and appetizers, we never received napkins and silverware. i would not recommend this to anyone! BJs needs to improve their services ASAP!!!

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Nightlife, Burgers, Steakhouses
text: These steaks are both 8oz steaks. Big difference. I'm not sure if our waitress Joshua is new or not but he needs to help in his section. UNACCEPTABLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. Took forever to even order our drinks. The restaurant wasn't even packed and it took a long time. I'm patient But this is horrible. Never again will I got to this restaurant even though I live right around the corner. I'll drive to the other side of town

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: My girlfriend and I tried Thai Basil on 7JUL2018 and LOVED it! Excellent food, gorgeous dining room, fast service and fair prices. We will be back....frequently!

place_category: American (New), Pizza, Restaurants, Local Flavor, Vegetarian
text: Pizza Box is a small place with friendly staff and a good wood fired brick oven pizza. However, the pizzas are quite small so if you are wanting lots of cheese and pepperoni or even a white pizza, this is not the place. Other negatives are the absence of any salads on the menu and the absence of ice, they simply don't have it. Thin crust with sparse toppings, then this is your place. If you want a regular size pie with lots of toppings then try Cappy's.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole
text: The seafood was excellent , the service was awesome it's was our first time there. The atmosphere was very quiet n well decorated. Try the pick your own combo that way you can try a variety of things.

place_category: Italian, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Comfort Food, Sandwiches, Bakeries, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Great stop for lunch. The red gravy was excellent. We ordered the meatball sandwich and added a side of the famous gravy as well as some ricotta to top it all off. The service was friendly and accommodating. Parking is somewhat difficult, but the food makes it worth the trouble.

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Meat Shops
text: This place has been my go-to for quality meat for years! The ownership/staff are knowledgeable and friendly. They are never stingy on the portions either. Try their samples of smoked wings etc, they're always a delicious treat! I'm a guy who takes pride in the outcome of whatever I throw in my smoker, and I always ask them to season whatever I order with their special rub! If they served beer on tap, they'd never get me to leave the store!

place_category: Wineries, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee Roasteries, Arts & Entertainment, Desserts, Food, Bakeries, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cafes
text: Stopped by here before a movie for a quick bite to eat. My date and I had the croissants filled with spinach or ham and cheese. They were delicious. The atmosphere is quiet and cozy. I wish we had more time to spend here. Looking forward to coming again.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: After years remembering two great breakfasts here we finally returned. Disappointment. The Breaux Bridge Benedict I loved was lacking the burst go flavor I recall and the bread was stale. My wife's Reuben was so tough she had to use a knife. When we gently complained the response was "I'm sorry" but the bill didn't reflect that. Bottom line: there's better places in this town.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Rather overrated actually. I found the broth, while very good, not the best. A bit thin on the aromatics. There is the novelty of the restaurant itself where the only thing on the menu is noodle soup. Good, not great.

place_category: Pizza, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Hands down... Solid option. Closed on Sunday though? What are football fans to eat?

place_category: Spanish, Cafes, Cuban, Latin American, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Best Cuban! The Tempeh is also so freaking delicious! I could go on and on honestly. One of my absolute favorite places to go. Delicious food, delicious cold brew coffee, and friendly service!!

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: I just tried to put a large order in and because I was 5.8 miles away the rude lady on the phone wouldn't allow it to be delivered? She said 5 miles. It's a real shame people trying to keep small businesses going during this pandemic that they wouldn't go .8 miles more??? I always heard that thee cheese steaks are awesome there, but will probably never find out. Very bad service!!!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Customer service is awful. The owner/host really doesn't care. He wouldn't seat our party of 3 until everyone was there, even though his restaurant was half empty. When we were all there, he continued to make us wait while he putzed around in the back. The food is not worth this man's attitude.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Ehh... Just okay. The food was pretty good but the service was soooooooo slow. Typical sonoran mexican food. Very casual atmosphere. Staff was nice, but again, slow. Had the cheese crisp and some fish tacos. They were good, nothing memorable. The chips and salsa was pretty good though. There are a lot of options for Mexican in this area. It may be awhile before I come back.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Food, Creperies, Internet Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The crepes here are the best!!! The service however sucks!! I live down the block from the cafe and order here quite often. 4 out of 5 times the lady who answers the phone always picks up and hangs up on you. Once I didn't have a menu so asked what the bacon crepes were and she hung up on me mid order. A friend wanted to build her own crepe with "Nutella and bacon" and the lady at the counter looked at her like she had 2 heads.

place_category: Mediterranean, Restaurants
text: Good tapas restaurant in Conshy. It's only been open for 4 months. The interior is cute and the service is good. There were some great dishes and some that had potential but were bland. Would like to give it another try after it's been open longer.

place_category: Shopping, Pharmacy, Health & Medical, Food, Convenience Stores, Drugstores
text: So this is the 2nd cvs i have tried to get a covid test done and the set up is STUPID. You have an appointment but no not really because you get in line at the pharmacy drive through with people doing prescriptions and one person doing it all. How stupid. Do one or the other but not both. Spent an hour at the drive through. Stupid stupid stupid. Stop doing appointments as the time really does not matter. All the CVS are doing this same stupid thing.

place_category: Vegan, Mexican, Restaurants, Tacos, Asian Fusion
text: Wanted to try something different so picked. Anew place. Would get the avocado salad and the plantains again. Everything else was eh. The pretzels are tiny and not worth it: the flan was bland and the mushroom taco was not worth it. I don't like the harsh flavor of black mushrooms. I wish I knew which kind it was. Overall, not bad but prices are still high.

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: I come to this Kroger often since it's literally in walking distance from my home. I'm very disappointed in the fact that the door says they close at midnight, however when I had to make an emergency run to grab my 5 month old baby Tylenol the manager locked the door at 11:52. I usually don't leave negative reviews and I understand the staff and closing manager were probably eager to go home, but as a person who has had previous management experience you don't lock the door until closing time.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Salad
text: Best restaurant in New Orleans!!! Ordered the Louisiana Shrimp Alfredo it was cooked to perfection. The dish was seasoned to perfectly, plenty of shrimp, and even included ham. The staff is also extremely friendly and attentive. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting and even locals.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Noodles, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Food, Salad, Vegetarian, Vegan
text: This was not the best, at least the salad. The dressing just did not taste good and they were out of two of the toppings I wanted. It was really dry and an overall disappointment. Stir fries looked much better.

place_category: Food, Sandwiches, Gas Stations, Convenience Stores, Restaurants, Automotive, Coffee & Tea
text: Okay I now give Wawa five stars. They are very helpful and always try to make the best outcome. give up On Wawa cappuccinos, back to Starbucks. The staff at the Fort Washington Office Center Wawa are the best.

place_category: Restaurants, Peruvian, Soup, Desserts, Food
text: At first I thought it was a New York style Deli as posted but there was nothing New York style. Otherwise I might give it a higher rating. Need to try more of their menu to come up with a more credible rating.

place_category: Bakeries, Coffee & Tea, Bars, Donuts, Beer Bar, Food, Bubble Tea, Restaurants, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Gluten-Free, Vegan, Cafes, Acai Bowls
text: The best baked donuts! I fell deep in love with the peaches n' cream donut! I have never had anything like it before but the taste and texture of the donut was a match made in heaven. Also for drink options I recommend the Matcha Iced tea with almond milk, thank you for this drink and donut combo BP. You are the realest in the bakery bizness :)

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Burgers
text: Eggplant entree = amazing! Salad, Poboys, fried catfish, crawfish queso & alligator bites are great! I appreciate this place! Come in, order you're food, they're quick and easy going. Great first experience.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Salad, Sandwiches
text: Excellent food and service. This small, corner sandwich shop will blow you away with their truly delectable sandwich creations. The Nashville hot chicken is unbelievable with the perfect balance of spicy and sweet. I also loved the house smoke brisket which was so tender and flavorful. The buffalo chicken mac and cheese is just out of this world and bursting with flavor. Portions are large and priced right. I'm marking off on the menu each item I eat and plan to work my way through.

place_category: Food, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Friendly and quick service on a busy Saturday night. Definitely satisfied my ice cream craving.

place_category: Food, Popcorn Shops, Restaurants, Chocolatiers & Shops, Specialty Food, Candy Stores
text: Like the many flavor options the popcorn not so much. The flavors I purchased were white cheddar and spicy buffalo. White cheddar flavoring was not very flavorful and same thing with the spicy buffalo. The popcorn is very greasy. The popcorn itself wasn't very good either. Seemed like it was some bagged popcorn from the supermarket, which I don't think it was but it was extremely similar to that. I won't be back.

place_category: Italian, Gluten-Free, Food, Restaurants
text: The service was awful. When we asked for recommendations, the server quickly brushed us off hurrying to the next table. Later, my significant other was given the wrong food and we had to wait for 20 minutes until the correct dish was brought to us. On top of all of this the food was a bit too "salt forward" for me.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Food, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Sandwiches
text: Delicious breakfast! Good portion sizes and the prices are extremely fair. This is our go to breakfast place!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Ordered an omelette for brunch. It was SWIMMING in grease on the plate. Cocktails weren't bad. Won't be going back. Move on - way better options within a 2 block radius.

place_category: Soup, Thai, Restaurants, Salad
text: Was really disappointed after reading such great reviews. I didn't know this cuisine had the ability to be bland. Additionally, it was cold on the plate. Two stars may be generous.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bakeries
text: Food isn't great and super expensive. Cool atmosphere/decorations and lots of options for coffee tea and smoothies but not much for food. Options for meals aren't great, take forever, small portions, and really expensive.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Music Venues, Food, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Breweries
text: Food was horrible. Service was slow and environment was lack luster. Mcdonalds would have been better. Save your money.

place_category: Specialty Food, Cajun/Creole, Local Flavor, Sandwiches, Food, Restaurants
text: Delicious! You know it's all about the bread ppl. I don't know why but the bread at Guys holds up better than others that serve leidenheirmer french bread... Cash only but they have an ATM inside! Wonderful staff, limited seating!

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Piano Bars
text: Definitely a must see when in New Orleans and on Bourbon Street!! Food is OK but a trip to NOLA is incomplete without a Hurricane from Pat O' Brian's. My first visit was 35 years ago and it's hasn't changed!!

place_category: Greek, Mediterranean, Restaurants
text: Exactly what we were looking for: authentic Greek food, and a bit nicer than most places. Wait staff even communicated among themselves in Greek. Had the lemon chicken soup appetizer. Good homemade chicken soup with a touch of lemon. Entree was a Greek spaghetti with spicy feta, grilled shrimp, fresh tomatoes. For dessert couldn't resist the baklava and also the baked custard. Looking forward to going back, lots more on the menu!

place_category: Tacos, Food, Mexican, Restaurants, Food Trucks
text: Stopped here on the way home from Clearwater beach . Ordered tacos , a burrito , and chips and salsa . Absolutely delicious ! Huge portions and quick service .

place_category: Cafes, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: So glad to see first watch in Brandon! Part of the appeal of first watch is the fast service and delicious healthy food. Our crepes were burnt and they brought the wrong muffin after our long wait. I think they need more time to get into a groove but I have faith that they will! I love first watch!

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Pubs, Nightlife, Gastropubs
text: Really good food, service could've been better. Reason for my 3 stars. But I will go back to try a 2nd time because of the food was really good.

place_name: Happy Joe's Pizza & Ice Cream Parlor
place_category: Gluten-Free, Salad, Food, Pizza, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants
text: Am I in heaven? A pizza join that also serves good ice cream? Amazing. Also, there are several specialty pizzas here that are served with sauerkraut; which makes me happy. I love a good taco-style pizza, too. Now, you don't even have to go to Happy Joe's to get pizza; you can order it off the web! (You can't order the ice cream off the web, though.) The restaurant is quite big and you'll almost always find a place to sit and enjoy your Mexican pizza (not served with sauerkraut).

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Bars, Steakhouses
text: Nice atmosphere. Good shrimp cocktail Nice salad. Terrible filet beef ! Poor quality. No flavor

place_category: Chicken Wings, Food Trucks, Food, Restaurants
text: The best smoked chicken I've had. The heat was perfect and had just the right flavor.. Very tender and juicy.. Will be back again very soon!

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Szechuan
text: Have stopped by for dinner on two occasions several months apart while visiting a student at UPenn. The Dan Dan noddles are a definite must-have (get them spicy if you can). Comfortable but sleek ambience, friendly service, great food. The restaurant definitely has western influences, most notably in the environment and decor, but the food was fairly authentic. Would recommend coming with a small group.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Their portions are amazing. Their prices are amazing. Their menu is extensive. And the food is oh so good

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food
text: The term fast food cannot be applied to this Wendy's locations. I regularly wait 5-10 minutes just to order my food. Today I waited in line for over 20 minutes with only 3 people in front of me. I love Wendy's and it is a shame that this is the closest one to me because the service is awful.

place_category: Lounges, Restaurants, Greek, Nightlife, Bars, Japanese, Mediterranean
text: This is an awful place that restricts you from certain parts of the bar if you don't have a drink. I wasn't drinking so I ordered a soda and was asked to pay $5 for a coke. Just a coke. When I refused to pay I was harassed and kneed in the side by the owner and subsequently kicked out. Stay away.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: What can I say, the Monte Cristo was very good and the staff couldn't get any better. Not only did they ask me how my sandwich was when I was going to wash my hands, they remembered what I had. Today was my first time there but I will be gong back.

place_category: Restaurants, Hawaiian, Food, Poke, Seafood
text: This was my 1st poke experience. I let the employee suggest what I should try since I'm not very picky. He was spot on and it was really good. I will definitely be back there. I would like to try some other places just to make sure they aren't the best show in town. But sometimes there's nothing like the 1st place you tried.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Steakhouses, Seafood, Nightlife, Bars
text: Two People = $309 with tip. Two steaks, Two sides dishes total, 6 drinks and we split dessert. I've ate at a lot of great steak houses and none have commanded a price like this and that didn't deserve it. This place wasn't worth it at all. The food was good and the service was fair at most. But I fully believe you don't broil a steak and YOU NEVER serve a guest potatoes that are under cooked. Not for this price. With the prices they are commanding I am demanding perfection.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food
text: Breakfast is outstanding! Ming, the owner, gives it it's personality! She remembers you and appreciates your business. The food is awesome. Eggs, bacon, potatoes, pancakes, it's all good!

place_category: Seafood, Chinese, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Korean
text: Great food. only Korean restuarant in town. Food was good. service was as excpect with restaurants like this.ill go back and try it again.

place_category: Pakistani, Indian, Buffets, Restaurants, Halal
text: Naan is good. Service is not so good. Food could taste a lot better, but overall average.

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants
text: I'm sure this food is great but we ordered food 55 minutes ago and still no dinner. Yikes.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Not terrible, but lots of Mexican places do better on tacos, decor & menu options. It does have a faithful following of spanish-speaking customers, has a nice mexican market next door (Noa Noa) and I really like their chorizo tacos. Missed dropping in on Dias de los Muertos to see if they had any skull bread.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Vegetarian, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: This is my absolute favorite place for breakfast. Wish I lived closer! The snickerdoodle pancakes are a must, the stuffed french toast with berries is delectable. And their specials are great too (if they have the daisy peach pancakes with streusel in it you must try.) Everything comes out hot and fresh and the wait staff is excellent always keeps the coffee refilled.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Asian Fusion, Restaurants
text: Teriyaki is decent and they pour sauce over it with a large spoon if you don't say something when you order. DO NOT order sushi...not very tasty, limited selection, and I LOVE sushi...went twice and second time they were out of Philly roll and I ordered Cali roll..went twice around 1, and had to wait 15 minutes each time, so got into a time crunch.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Didn't think this place was anything special. Food was very blan and the sides were once again a disappointment. My best friend had the peel and eat shrimp, a rubbery mess, even charged $0.50 for old bay seasoning.

place_category: Steakhouses, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Called this place to check if they are open and the Asian manager said they were open until 9pm. When my party arrived they suddenly couldn't seat us. Horrible service. I've been coming here for 12 years when they were called somethings fishy. Guess I need to look for a new sushi place

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Well I can't give a great review bc I didn't get to eat, I am tired of restaurants that close mid day.. I am ok with lunch specials ending, but I was looking forward to trying this place since it recently opened its new location (and I enjoy the other location). I arrived at 2:30 and was told to order to go from the bar. No thank you. Unfortunately, I likely won't make it back.

place_category: Cinema, Nightlife, Pizza, Italian, Arts & Entertainment, Burgers, Restaurants, Lounges, Bars
text: Horrible experience, my lady and I went to this place for our first time and what we read in the reviews is totally truth, place is dirty, food was cold and terrible. The chairs were comfortable but disgusting dirty , there were spills everywhere and it look like they were never cleaned.

place_category: American (New), Sandwiches, Cafes, Restaurants
text: No longer open for breakfast :-( and them has changed from upscale deli style with great food to upscale restaurant. Disappointed.

place_category: Vegetarian, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Sandwiches, Food
text: This was a pretty cool mom and pops type of spot. I enjoyed the crab omelette. The service was simple and easy. It was a fun style place. The visuals in the wall was a plus. The art was for sale which I thought was cool. Price point was great, taste was great. The one kick back is that it's a small place. There's no area to wait if there's a long line. Had to wait in the rain to be seated because of the lack of space.

place_category: Restaurants, Delis, Sandwiches
text: Raising my rating from 2-star to 3-stars. We came in and the entire staff was a bunch of young male kids ... probably 21 and under. They were a-OK. It seems like our order took longer than it should have - parties of equal size that came in after us got their order before us. But overall, this visit as OK; getting better!

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Chinese, Bubble Tea, Vietnamese
text: This place make the best spring rolls and egg rolls the price is decent too, and it's walking distance from ucsb!

place_category: Noodles, Chinese, Restaurants, Szechuan, Seafood
text: One of my favorite restaurants in the city. This was very were welcoming place and I recommend this experience. The atmosphere is fun and service very attentive. The prices are a little high but its okay, worth the pay.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Food, Pan Asian, Asian Fusion, Cantonese, Thai, Chinese
text: Amazing food you can order huge plates of food and share with everyone. The food was on point and delicious I will deff be coming back. Always have leftovers to take home

place_category: Wine Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Steakhouses, Seafood, Bars
text: The last time we ate at the Prime Rib, we had a bad experience. The food was good as usual but we found a cockroach crawling on our booth. When we brought it to the waiter's attention, we just got a shrug and had to request a change of tables. That was that. Nothing else was done and a shrug was all we got from the manager. Not expecting a comp but some jesture would have been better than none at all.

place_category: Comfort Food, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian, Kosher, Restaurants
text: In addition to having great falafel, they also have really nice eggplant sandwiches and burekas. the free sides are also a huge plus if you love olives.

place_category: Thai, Sushi Bars, Chinese, Asian Fusion, Restaurants
text: Food was disgusting, me and my boyfriend went because of the reviews were good, we ordered two dishes, the chicken was pure white slimy fake meat, the pork tastes like rubber. We ate the rice which I could tell was on a heater all day and left. It looked and tasted like really cheap Chinese food... never got water.. really disappointed! Won't be back...

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Shopping, Cafes, Food, Coffee & Tea, Delis, Sandwiches, Arts & Entertainment, Art Galleries, Wine Bars, Paint & Sip, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Don't waste your time with this place. Picasso and Wine has friendly staff. The owner of Crafted Pallet always has a scowl look on her face. Doesn't seem approachable

place_category: Personal Chefs, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caribbean, American (New), American (Traditional), French
text: The restaurant is located in a hotel. The neighborhood isn't the most attractive, but once inside, it is charming. They have an interesting decor and fantastic food. We shared a baby kale salad, a soup (smoked meat and charred okra), and a yucca gnocchi dish. The tastes were fresh, balanced and modern. Dessert was superb - a guanabana cream/ice/cake log with coconut, and celery.

place_category: Vegetarian, Live/Raw Food, Vegan, Restaurants
text: Nice B.O.B. Food was good. The raw cheesecake was okay. Staff and customers were friendly. Parking is a little difficult but will return if I'm in the area.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Desserts, Middle Eastern, Asian Fusion, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Food
text: I should know better. Never go anywhere for restaurant week. It happened by accident. Service was blah. First course blah. Main course awful. Wasn't even offered the dessert course... and it was included. Manager was clueless!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Latin American
text: I came here with my family today, we have ordered a lot of appetizers, food was great and it was fast. But, omg, customer service was horrible, and as much as i don't like talking bad about servers, bc I'm the bartender, i was so unhappy, it took her forever to bring ice for out bottle of wine, glasses were dirty, we couldn't even pay our bill, she was just really unprofessional.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Event Planning & Services, Specialty Food, Food, Caterers, Cheesesteaks
text: Seriously- if you are a breakfast lover- the French Toast sandwich is out of control good. Runny and drippy. Sweet and Savory. YUM. Got the fries with the Truffle Wiz as well. That stuff is NO JOKE. I would put it on anything!

place_category: Diners, Restaurants
text: Stopped in for lunch during the week. Paoli DIner is one of the nicer looking diners that I've been to. The hostess was friendly and so was the waitress. I ordered a spanakopita lunch special which included a greek salad. I started off with a new england clam chowder which was tasty. The greek salad was pretty good and unfortunately, the spanakopita was so-so. The bathrooms didn't quite reflect the look of the rest of the restaurant. Could use some improvement there.

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Cafes, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Coffee & Tea, Party & Event Planning, Diners
text: Went here once & never will I go again. A friend told me they had a good breakfast menu so I tried it out. Service was horrible, place was unclean, and the food was nasty. I ordered scrambled eggs & hashbrowns. The eggs tasted like they came out of a jug and the hashbrowns were mushy & watery! Not the typical crispy hashbrowns EVERY other place has. Waffle House is definitely better for breakfast food late night.

place_category: Vietnamese, Delis, Soup, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants
text: Slamming banh mi and much more. It's got a very "back at home" feel. The service was great. I'd recommend this for the quick bites.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Cajun/Creole
text: Came here due to long wait at Neyow's. Waited nearly 25-30 mins for service. Very disorganized, with unfriendly "servants" who acted like they did not want to earn a tip. I don't care about the food, if he experience is bad, then it's not worth it. Stay away from this place, if you are on vacation seeking a good experience.

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Pizza, Fast Food
text: I am so disappointed at the service I got tonight. And I really liked this place the last few times I went. I'm sorry to say this, but you need to be happy when you're at work. Don't ignore your costumers, you won't have many left if it stays the way it is. I did like this place. What a shame.

place_category: Desserts, Coffee & Tea, Food, Shaved Ice
text: Favorite caffe from now on, green apple ade plus banana walnut honey bread. Wow out of this world. Omg the smell of the banana cake is wow and did you see the packages presentation

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Tried this place and it is expensive the ice cream melts quickly, better to eat it inside, this franchise has been closed twice due to contamination issues it has made the news I don't think I'll return anytime soon...I do like the half sizes served

place_category: Discount Store, Department Stores, Food, Drugstores, Shopping, Grocery, Fashion, Mobile Phones
text: Worst ever. Dirty, unstocked, horrible parking. I gladly drive the extra 12 miles to Lebanon's Walmart. Whoever is in charge up there needs to come give Brownsburg Walmart a lesson.

place_category: Restaurants, Whiskey Bars, American (Traditional), Southern, Bars, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Barbeque, Nightlife
text: I always come here when I am looking for over salted BBQ food, slow service and a dismal atmosphere. When you have experienced real BBQ food in places like Kansas City and Austin Tx then this is barely recognizable as food. A step up from Tony Romas though so that must be something......

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Came here while visiting NOLA with a few friends for NYE weekend. The line was long but moves quickly. We had the crawfish pasta in a creamy white sauce which was delicious. The second dish we had was the jambalaya combo with red beans and rice. Not a terrible choice but there were other restaurants in the area that we tried the same dish at (Felix), that I thought was better. Pro tip: use the bathroom at home because I'm not sure how often they clean theirs...a little sketchy.

place_category: Seafood, Bars, Steakhouses, Wine Bars, Nightlife, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: AMAZING FOOD. Even better service! We went there this afternoon to celebrate my little brothers graduation and I was blown away by the food, customer service and atmosphere. This is definitely a must go to spot. Shout out to our server Janice - she provides A++ service! P.S. their bread pudding is to DIE for!

place_category: Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Stay away! The worst service and food I have ever experienced. Sat and waited 23 minutes before we got someone to come to out table, although every table in our perimeter was taken care of. Someone took our order, and never brought the food. Waited another 38 minutes. Food finally came out and was wrong. Complained to Manager, never took food off the bill nor a discount for the terrible experience. Stay away!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Barbeque, Food, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Desserts
text: Loved this place, and have been coming here for years! I ordered the pulled pork platter like I always do, with the corn pudding and Mac n cheese. I was very disappointed however, when I received my meal and instead of corn bread, I had been given a stale hamburger bun?!? What happened? If they were out of cornbread I would have at least liked to have been notified or offered another side for their lack of a regular menu item. Oh well, maybe next time it will be as I remembered...

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Salads had brown lettuce and paninis were lacking their main ingredient. My Coworker ordered a portobello mushroom panini and it was mostly peppers and onions. Not impressed with the food at all. I was looking for someplace new to try in the area but I won't be going back. The pizza was decent but with all of the good places surrounding us no need to have mediocre food.

place_category: Food Trucks, Restaurants, Street Vendors, Food, Mexican
text: Very terrible and poor excuse for mexican food - unless you're looking for dirty mexican food with roaches. Their is seriously a roach mishap here every month or so it seems.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Truthfully this should be zero stars. We order from here once a week and spend between $60 and $80. They mixed up our whole order. We called and told them and they didn't help at all. If anything they tried to blame us and charge us more even tho it's there fault. We will not be going here any further.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Nice courtyard, good food, lovely atmosphere and fabulous waitstaff! It was nice that they offered a vegetarian gumbo, & red beans & rice although the gumbo was bland as another reviewer mentioned, however it was still tasty and I do realize that the Gumbo Shop is not catering to the vegetarian - so it was still nice to have the option. The fresh bread was also a nice touch and our drinks were delicious. I would definitely return.

place_category: Brazilian, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: All you can eat meat! How can you go wrong, their meat is prepared wonderfully, with so much flavor, their salad bar is to a new level. This place is very good -- and very pricey, but good for special occasions.

place_category: American (New), Breweries, Nightlife, Food, Bars, Pizza, Restaurants
text: Love this place! Clean, good soup. I love going here, just wish it wasnt at the mall, parkings HELL.

place_category: Mexican, American (New), Seafood, Bars, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Food was ok, nothing to write home about. The presentation of the meal was nice, but a little pricy for what you get. $7.50 for a guava specialty drink that was mostly ice and very little liquor in it. The glass of wine for $4.50 was pretty reasonable and they gave you a good size.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Fantastic tacos. I've never really had anything else here because I have to eat gluten free, but I'm told the burritos are delicious as well. I'm not a huge veggie fan but their veggie tacos are my go to every time I come here.

place_category: Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Bagels
text: This Bagel haven creates masterpieces that are as delicious as they are instagram worthy! Each bagel is hand crafted and made with love. I would highly recommend everyone indulge in this one of a kind experience!!

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Mexican, New Mexican Cuisine
text: Here's another restaurant with good intentions that succumbs to greed. Example: you have a reservation by way of checking in and being on a list. Party of four. Table for four opens, you're excited to be seated, but, no. That 4 top just became two, 2 tops for folks who arrived after you, therefore, behind you on the list. Food is fine: not great, not lacking. Loud, weak management unless the owner is present, and some of the most clueless bartenders in Santa Barbara.

place_category: American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Southern, Restaurants
text: Some of the best home-cooked Fried Chicken in the land. I floated back to my hotel after this meal, well float sank. Let's be honest it's still Fried Chicken so don't go thinking it's gonna save your soul...or will it? Either way I feel like a better human for having experienced this meal.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Barbeque, Specialty Food, Restaurants, Food Trucks, Food
text: So we arrived late and most items had sold out. We were able to try the potato salad and brisket. The brisket had good flavor but had a fatty roast beef texture in a way. It wasn't tough or tender just the fat hadn't really rendered. The potato salad was dry and mustard forward. The pricing felt a little high for value overall.

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Delis, Food, American (New)
text: Started out with the chicken tortilla soup, which was pretty good. Got the lamb pita which was basically like a pile of lettuce on a piece of pita with some lamb on top.

place_category: Comfort Food, Southern, Food, Restaurants, Chicken Shop, Chicken Wings, Soul Food
text: I seen this place on "Cheap Eats". The show states that a meal here should around $12. The parking is tricky. I ordered Tender Royale with two sides fried okra and collard greens. The grill cheese is deep fried in panko. The bread I believe is Texas toast. The bread taste like a doughnut / elephant ear (sweet). There was to much bread for me. The okra was mushy and had no flavor. This meal is big enough for two people to share. That would make it a cheap eat to me. Apologies no pictures.

place_category: Sandwiches, Bakeries, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Bagels, Food, Soup
text: The panani's are pretty good. My beef with this place is the confusing store layout. They have the only trash cans in store, the drink machines, and the counter you pick up your food at all in about 3 feet of each other. And they also have tables right where people need to walk. I went on a busy Saturday afternoon and unfortunately, the only available table was right in the middle of the walkway. I think if they opened another store in a larger location, it would be so much better.

place_category: American (Traditional), Seafood, Nightlife, Event Planning & Services, Cocktail Bars, Wine Bars, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, American (New), Bars
text: Great view and ambiance for a unique experience. A bit overpriced for the quality of the food. If an entree is $45, it better be the best crabcake I've ever had, which wasnt the case. Food is good.

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Pubs, Restaurants, Bars, American (New), Sports Bars
text: Met here for a couple beers and a turkey wrap before our softball game last night. The service was good, beer was cold and the wrap was fine. Pretty busy little place. Looks like many other strip mall pubs in the area. Our server quickly rang up our separate checks so we could get to the game. Nice place.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood
text: Same as the rest but very filthy and not a great service. About 2/3's empty and 1hr waiting for the table. Waited at the bar a lot for drinks, sticky bar and tables. It's ok to eat but don't expect good service

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Restaurants, Eatertainment, Arcades, Nightlife
text: Dave & Buster's is the place to go if you want to combine dinner, drinks, and games. I hadn't been here in awhile and was surprised about how many new games they had. My wife and I had a good time being competitive and trash talking with one another. The food was also pretty decent, but the service was slow. Overall, we had a pretty good time and enjoyed playing games and acting like kids for a couple hours.

place_category: Nightlife, Food, Bars, Breweries, Pizza, Brewpubs, Pubs, Restaurants
text: Hoped this would be as good as the one in Bloomington. NOT. Nice try. I suppose people go for the beer.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers, Hot Dogs
text: Just wear a mask and wear gloves. There's multiple staff inside; none wore masks or had on gloves.

place_category: Italian, Wine Bars, Bars, Mediterranean, Pizza, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: This place is a must! They are passionate and it shows. Amazing food. It's a small place and they don't take reservations but if you're in Philly and love home made pasta and oven brick pizza, it's a must. Amazing charcuterie plates too. My only complaint would be the oven roasted Brussel sprouts. Good but a tad acidic.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: It was fine. Nothing special. Nice lobby.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Chicken Wings, Pizza
text: Messed up order. Burnt pizza and missing side orders. The garlic bread was not even sliced. When called store, I was placed on hold for 25 minutes and finally when was able to speak to someone, his response that he can't do anything.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Burgers
text: Wings wings wings. So good. Wings over Broadway had some pretty good ones too!! We got a lot of them and some fries so I was filled up good :) The wings I got were pleasantly spicy-it didn't burn my tongue off. And I definitely recommend the garlic fries!

place_category: Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Asian Fusion, American (New), Southern, Cafes
text: Braised beef is very tender. Great presentation. Better yet is the Chicken and Waffles. Outstanding. Both different from the usual fair. A great meal. Highly recommended.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Diners, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I placed an online order, and... Friendly staff, good food, but my order was short a short stack (2 pancakes).

place_category: Restaurants, Bakeries, Food, Desserts, Beer Bar, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, Bars, Caterers, Pizza
text: Truly as good as it gets. It's quite expensive; 4 people, 4 pizzas, 4 drinks was close to $70. It was incredibly delicious though. I'll be back, after I save up my $$'s.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Service was very slow and food was mediocre. Our chef was under par compared to the one behind him. When you order a drink, such as Jack and Coke, they will give you what ever cheap booze they have on hand instead. Had a talk with the guy in charge to find that out. Won't be back.

place_category: Tapas/Small Plates, Restaurants, American (New), Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars
text: I'm a sucker for nice interiors and this place is very cute!! Not to mention their food is soooo good too! Came here for brunch and definitely will be back when I'm in the area. They're best known for their chicken and waffles and they were phenomenal! I mean these are some of the best I've had. The banana pancakes were also yummy and filling. Nothing to complain about!! ...which is nice right?

place_category: Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Mexican, Food
text: This place is LEGIT! Since I've moved to FL I have been searching high and low for an authentic Mexican place and while I've found some, they're all quite a ways away. My barber recommended this place and I'll definitely be coming back. If you're looking for authentic tacos, sopes tamales, and more, this is your place. Cannot give five stars ONLY because of the limited seating.

place_category: Japanese, Asian Fusion, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Girl that made my poke bowl was rude and although I paid for extra sushi was not given a portion even 50% greater than what was ordered. Wouldn't go back

place_category: American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Hotels & Travel, Hotels, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Arts & Entertainment
text: Good luck getting waited on.. Once you do... The wine is reasonable & yummy. The food is good, but I just can't stand being blatantly ignored.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Just went to eat there and they are supposed to open at 12 but sign says 12:30. Fine we can wait. 12:30 comes and the worker says that the cook didn't show and they need another 20 minutes. I will take my money elsewhere. Disappointing

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Seafood
text: Try the charbroiled oysters and a swamp water! Waitstaff is great, Chip is awesome.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Fantastic food and great service. I've been here twice and very much enjoyed it both times. I hope to return more frequently.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Seafood, Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, Caribbean
text: Bad service. The poor waitress had the whole restaurant. We were there for two hours. The food was good before but it's not worth it. They were almost out of Grouper so we got served next to nothing. In my taco half of it was empty. Not to mention everything was cold because they had no runners. It's a holiday week so I don't understand their staffing.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Burgers, Sandwiches
text: Tony would not be pleased with this location. We've tried it twice just to rule out a first time fluke, but no, both times were poor. First off, they're very slow. But more importantly the quality isn't the same here. There is not enough meat on the roll. It's completely disproportionate. I'd rather buy the frozen version at shoprite!

place_category: Specialty Food, Seafood Markets, Seafood, Food, Restaurants
text: Rude. Worst service. Ever!! The place is a dump. It's dirty and smells terrible. I wouldn't eat here again if you paid me. I don't know how they are getting these 5 star reviews. It makes absolutely no sense!! I'm surprised they haven't been shut down by the health department.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Salad
text: If you're visiting the Barnes Exhibit, this is a good add on to your afternoon. It's definitely good gourmet pizza. Great crust. The rotolos are probably my favorite. All of the ingredients are very fresh. A fun, casual place that also serves a good local beer menu. I ranked it a 3 because Its a bit expensive and the toppings never seem to be exactly what I'm looking for. Maybe it's the idea of a tuna fish pizza that turns me off a bit?

place_category: Buffets, Indian, Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Vegan, Pakistani, Kebab
text: We visited Reno with our friends on a Christmas evening. Stopped by this restaurant for dinner. Total disappointment.

place_category: Seafood, American (Traditional), Music Venues, Caribbean, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Typical beach bar/restaurant. The food is so-so, but the sunsets are pretty. Some nights they have live music, and there's always people there. I would say go for a drink and to people watch or to take in a sunset.

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Burgers
text: Omgggg this might be my new favorite pizza place! You must try the ham and cheese (Gerber) pizza and add pickles. It is life changing. The grilled wings are pretty tasty as well. The bartender John is very nice and he will make you laugh.

place_category: Burgers, Caterers, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Event Planning & Services
text: I may be dating myself - but I went here when I was in college at Penn in the mid nineties. Cav's is still kicking (and they also have the "River Deck". It's your basic bar. Bar food. Bar Music. Frat-boy (and college-gals) crowd. Meat-marketing and bozzing of the basest nature. Decent wings as I recall. I preferred Smokey Joe's.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Best ice cream in Tucson. Great friendly ownership. Not much else they could do better.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Horrible. The food was not what was expected. The waiter was no where to be found for most of our meal. I had a choice to eat my food with my fingers or go hunt down an employee to gain silverware. I chose the latter... I will not done here again.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Burgers, Nightlife, Bars, Gastropubs, Pubs, Sports Bars
text: When the customers are warming there hands over the candles that is a clue it's cold. The bartenders were working super hard and the managers were letting them down by not controlling temperature in restaurant. Only reason it gets three is the supper work by bartenders and the food was ok.

place_category: Caterers, Mediterranean, Delis, Greek, Cafes, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants
text: Food is great but it takes a long time. I've waited a considerable time on both occasions I've picked up an order.

place_category: Lounges, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Vegan, American (New), Dive Bars, Sandwiches, Cocktail Bars, Burgers, Local Flavor
text: I usually come here on Sunday afternoons with a few friends to enjoy the craft table they put out. Most recently, we went and had a blast making coasters. The upstairs is closed then, but I did get to enjoy it last Friday. There is a room with repurposed whip cars and some really neat art on the walls. I never have a problem getting service at the bar, and the bartenders are always friendly and personable. I will keep coming back here for glitter glue and beer!

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Burgers
text: This is a great place to eat! 30 cent wing night is busy but worth the wait. For those who don't like the rules for 30 cent wing night go somewhere else! They are reasonable rules! The wings are big and fill you fast, the staff there is great! Keep in mind they are open other the rest of the week too not just tuesdays!

place_category: Bars, Lounges, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Hot Dogs, Burgers, Nightlife
text: Got this as a recommendation from a tour guide in the area and decided to check it out. If you want a good shrimp po boy this is the place to go! They're good is fairly priced for the area and the service was great!

place_category: Restaurants, Diners, Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Frequently come here during both brunch and dinner. Food is always great, and this place is one of the only diners that I know of that has a bar. Service is sometimes a toss up as we've had great service and horrible service on various visits, but with a place that is always open, I can't complain for convenience.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Lounges, Tapas Bars
text: Great views but service time was horrible. 30 minutes for the drinks to get to our table. Server comped it, but basically seemed like it was usual. Need to get this place run correctly!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Nightlife
text: The J Dawg was delicious!!! Downtown burger was huge and good- the foie gras just added a weird taste for me. Tucson lemonade was delicious and strong!!!! We sat on the patio and had a great time! Service was ok, nothing spectacular. It would be great to see vegan options- there really weren't any!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services
text: Amazing atmosphere! Cutest little place for a date. Enjoyed everything. Pineapple beer is a must!!! Had the tacos and all of them were amazing. Can't wait to go back

place_category: Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food, Caterers, Delis, Grocery
text: The sandwich and service was great! I like that you can grocery shop while you wait. Will definitely be going back!

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Food, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Sandwiches
text: To be fair, this was our first time eating here. We had to try the goody original with cheese with the "secret sauce". No secrets there, it's just a marinara sauce with meat which clashes with the pickles and makes the bun soggy. The fries were really good and my daughters chicken strips had a good flavor. We did wait 30 minutes to get our food. We had to try Tampa staple, but we wont be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Bars, Nightlife, Italian, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services
text: The food is good, but I'm giving it three stars because it was absolutely freezing. I couldn't enjoy my food, because it was way too cold. Apparently the one thermostat controls both the kitchen and dining room so the chefs are hot and the patrons are freezing. Give the chef a raise and management get the air situation under control. Thanks to the Chef for the good pasta!

place_category: Mexican, Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Tacos, Nightlife, Bars
text: The food here was good. I had a Machete which is basically like a quesadilla. The steak inside had good flavor and was tender. We ordered sides of the charro beans but they were too salty to eat. The salsa was ok, not spicy as I prefer but easy to eat. The chips were really good.

place_name: Paddy Whacks Irish Sports Pub - Welsh Road
place_category: Pubs, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces, Irish Pub, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants
text: I was just there i ordered 2 Gin&Tonic it was water down so I left my drinks paid my tap. Won't be back "good luck bartender"

place_category: Burgers, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: I think they may need to change the oil jm their fryers. My homestyle chicken sandwich which is usually crispy was soggy at this location and the chicken was very rubbery and hard to bite into and tear. I ended up just pulling the chicken off and eating the bun and toppings. It just seems a bit expensive for fast food tk have such poor quality, especially with Chickfila right down the road.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Cajun/Creole, Seafood
text: We were excited to go here after reading reviews. When we pulled up at 6:00, there was already a long wait. Since we have small children, we opted for takeout rather than waiting. It's unclear whether the food was subpar, or if it just didn't travel well. Very greasy, and soggy. We loved the crawfish beignet, but everything else was just okay, or almost too greasy to enjoy.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Very good food, curry shrimp is sooooo good! Nice and clean restaurant,i will be back to try other dishes on the menu.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Food
text: This tiny restaurant is a very stylish place in a hip part of town, but kind of upscale and pricey for a pizza joint. The food was decent all around, but for the price I expected better pizza and better service. The atmosphere is kind of cool in a local-downtown-business-that-deserves-some-support kind of way, but overall, I don't think we will be returning. Nothing to wow us here.

place_category: Japanese, Vietnamese, Restaurants, Chinese
text: The service is pretty slow like usually a 20 min wait + a wait when you get there to pick it up. When my husband went to pick up the food one day the lady working the front kept saying "take out or to go" and then placing an order instead of realizing you were there to pick up your order. My husband witnessed people leaving just because they didn't understand. The noodles are good and the crab ragoons were huge but personally I've had better Chinese food and won't be back.

place_category: American (New), Bars, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Lounges
text: Over-priced (and terribly) salty food. Too bad. Nice enough atmosphere and pleasant workers.

place_category: American (Traditional), Steakhouses, Nightlife, Bars, Seafood, Restaurants, Lounges
text: Drinks are pricey. Music is extra loud but played good songs. No cover. Cute bartenders. Fast service. Strong drinks.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants
text: We had several good breakfasts immediately after opening, but today the food was cold and this is the tomato that was in my toad-in-hole sandwich!

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: Meat was flavorless and service was rude. I don't get it. If I had stood in line for that I'd be very upset.

place_category: Nightlife, Irish Pub, American (Traditional), Irish, Bars, Salad, Restaurants
text: Food was very good but that is the only good thing about our evening. Took over one hour to get our food. No communication or apology from our server. One person NEVER got their food until the rest of us were done eating. Manager apologized (only after we tracked him down and complained) and comped the one meal but that was all. Miserable experience and will definitely not be coming back.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Vegan
text: I have been here maybe three times and I love it. The ambiance is amazing. The food is great. I feel like they give a lot of food. You might not finish all of it.

place_name: Grillshack Fries and Burgers - East Nashville
place_category: American (New), Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch
text: A local joint that is like no other. Outdoor patio seating only, but don't let it fool you. Great and original food when it comes to breakfast. Staff is always friendly.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Hit or miss. Sometimes the sushi is great and other times it is terrible. More importantly, I would never sit down at this restaurant again - the service is terrible. But, there is a $9 lunch special that includes three rolls and a salad. That's a deal and it only takes 10-15 minutes.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Me and my wife love this place!! They have great food , fast service and reasonable prices.

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: I really love this place! Have had the pad Thai, drunken noodles, mixed veggies, and curry. Loved it all! Support local and come here!

place_category: Gastropubs, Restaurants, Nightlife, Southern, Bars, Indian
text: Beautiful restaurant - really good for a date night. Drinks are as amazing, if not more, as the food.

place_category: Bars, Gastropubs, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: This restaurant was somewhat of a disappointment. It's relatively new and still finding its legs. It was busy but the wait for food was ridiculously long for a place with only a few tables. The food is average at best but the ambiance is relaxing. Also a bit overpriced for the quality and style of the food.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: This is the best burrito in New Orleans. The ambiance is funny -- they have a big flat-screen TV that has a glimmering image of a waterfall on their lime-green wall -- but for me, that adds to the appeal. While they don't serve alcohol, they do make a mean horchata, which I recommend. I get the vegetarian burrito without cheese or sour cream and always leave feeling like it was the most spectacular burrito I've had on the dirty coast.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Italian, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Food, American (Traditional)
text: Breakfast- service slow... tv radio and customer chat is overwhelming in the dark uninviting environment. Eggs were good. Hashbrowns cooked with garlic butter. Garlic was burned. Sour dough toast only toasted on one side. If you have lots of time and like garlic its your kind a place.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: So this was my 3rd trip to Koizi. We always go with at least 6 people. Our service is always good. Our food comes out hot and servers are ready to take more orders. We love it there!! But bring a light jacket, its chilly in there.

place_category: Food, Local Flavor, Restaurants, Chicken Shop, Ethnic Food, Specialty Food, Southern, Indian
text: Roosters offers the basic hot chicken and sides typical of other area places. Baked beans were quite good. The chicken breast quarter I had was just a little overcooked, not quite as super-juicy as what most of the Nashville hot chicken restaurants are so good at serving up. Probably worth another try.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: This Starbucks is my " I feel crafty" stop. It's right near Home Depot and Pet Store. They have great staff. Jade rocks the house!. She goes out of her way for her customers. Well stocked.

place_category: Restaurants, French
text: Very disappointing. Overpriced. While I'm a good cook, I expect to eat food that is way better than mine when it is as pricy as this. That was not the case. Everything was just ok. Not worth a second try.

place_category: American (Traditional), Steakhouses, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Canadian (New)
text: Poor, slow service plague this location and today they do not have the all you can eat ribs which is their currently advertised promo. They didn't mention it until after we ordered our drinks. We stopped coming 6 months ago because we could never get in and out in under 2.5 to 3 hours. They are consistently under staffed. -Update: It ended up taking an hour to get the food.
