We had stopped in for a quick dinner, by the time the bill was paid and we were out the door we were at 1 hr 45 minutes.

place_category: Comfort Food, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food, Restaurants, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: Love that the food is prepped! Took a little long but was well worth it. I got the stuffed New York strip with garlic potatoes!

place_category: Mexican, Vegan, Restaurants
text: The food is always good here, but the restaurant is so gosh darn cold! I went for dinner on Wednesday night. Outside, the weather was about 50 degrees. It felt colder inside the restaurant. I sat and had dinner with my coat on the entire time. I went to use the restroom, and it was actually warm in there! I hate to say it - I love the food here, but the fact that the thermostat is set so low is a deterrent for me to not come back any time soon.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Mexican
text: Don Pablo's used to be a decent Mexican'ish place to get your fill of enchiladas, tacos, etc. Now it's bad and not for any single reason but many. Food tastes plastic the service is substandard and the prices are higher than an authentic Mexican place with non of the fun. Pass by keep looking. Good bye Don Pablo.

place_category: Basque, Tapas Bars, Spanish, Restaurants
text: Spain restaurant has a nice atmosphere and good service but it's not a good value. Expect to pay near entree prices for appetizer portions. The portions are too small for the prices they charge. One tapa with manchengo cheese and Serrano ham was $13 and only had three thin slices of cheese and about four slices of ham. Don't go there on an empty stomach otherwise you will spend a lot cash trying to get full.

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Brazilian, Restaurants
text: My friends and I waited till restaurant week to go with the special prices, but we did not expect lesser treatment. We waited all night for the churrasco until we had to ask for it (more than once). The waiter got mad and, before we knew it, there were surrounded by four men holding churrascos and the waiter making snarky comments. In addition the restaurant feels like a huge cafeteria and not a high end restaurant.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Noodles, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Food, Salad, Vegetarian, Vegan
text: My newest favorite lunch place near my office. Expensive but worth it. The lines move fast. The staff is friendly the food is great. My kids like it, casual atmosphere. Kale smoothies could be colder. Love the free seltzer. I'm good for lunch at HoneyGrow twice a month.

place_category: Food, Pizza, Restaurants, Italian
text: Very long wait! But their texting system to warn you when a table was ready worked well. This place is VERY enamored with its own pizzas. The price was extremely high for what we got. I anticipate that very soon you'll be able to walk in for a slice without the wait. The service was good, though.

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Bars, Sports Bars, Fish & Chips
text: Ate there 2/28 food was great and Brian was awesome! Ribs were fall off the bone tender, gator tail yummy.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Mexican, Fast Food, Caterers, Restaurants
text: This place is good but what makes it stand out frm other qdoba is how friendly the staff is!

place_name: Hattie B's Hot Chicken - Nashville West
place_category: Beer Bar, Bars, Southern, Soul Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Chicken Wings
text: Holy cow the best spicy chicken sandwich I've ever had. It was so good I went for a late dinner Friday and lunch Saturday. So glad I made sure to call ahead on Saturday - the wait was at least 50 people, well out the door - and it was 2pm!

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants, Seafood
text: My wife and I decided to have dinner here on date night. The service was sub-par. The food was just OK. They did have large portions however and the draft beers were what I consider a good deal. I would rank this more of a 2.5 star but I am not given that choice so I had to lean more towards the two stars. This review is based on an interaction with three of the staff members and only having made one visit.

place_category: Breweries, Bars, Restaurants, Food, Nightlife, American (New), Pubs, Gastropubs
text: Large space with tons of natural light that offers outdoor seating. Obviously they brew their own beers and their IPA is pretty tasty. Have only had the pretzels and fondue but they were tasty and complimented the brews. Bartenders have been attentive and professional but not exactly what I would call friendly.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Food is always awesome, atmosphere is great and it's ok if you have a cranky kid with you ! Pistachio pizza and grilled octopus are amazing !

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: This location is a convenient alternative to the more crowded one a little further down, sans drive-thru.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Food, Caterers, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Diners
text: Meh. The food is alright - service is awful. The associates who work here act like they do you a favor waiting on you. They don't listen to orders - ordered a latte HOT and came iced down. OK. Just poor attitude in my opinion. It's a shame could be a step above McDonalds if they put any effort into it. Gave it three tries - I'm out. Not on my list next time in Nashville.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: HIGH PRICE CRAP!!! I'm from Los Angeles & I am Asian & I know what real Chinese food is and this is FAR from it! I'm so disappointed! Chicken is NOT seasoned & then just pour on greasy sauce. Noodles are not fully cooked; just gross! The Pepsi was good though! Lol

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: Great appetizers... entrees were okay! Oyster Duo and the stuffed mushrooms were amazing!!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Excellent service and food!!! Will definitely go again! People and environment is great. Its family owned

place_category: Restaurants, Gastropubs
text: A special night in a local restaurant,with fantastic entertainment that kept the evening moving.Although the the kitchen was slow in getting orders out,Hope our waitress made an effort to move things along.Fortunately the singer John Morsa provided such a show the long wait was more bearable. John s skill ,personality and variety of songs make a return visit assured.If you get a chance follow this excellent entertainer.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: This establishment provides take-out and delivery services. The food is always good and the service is always timely, but the place, itself, is in need of a renovation.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Really disappointed with our service here. I ordered two pizzas. That's it. An hour to make. And 25 dollars. No thanks. Horrible customer service. Would not recommend

place_category: American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Restaurants, Diners, Food
text: The hostess was unfriendly and the food was mediocre. The coffee was dull and the interior was tacky, which I suppose some people enjoy. I wouldn't return here based on the service or quality. I really wanted to like it, but I can't lie to myself and pretend it was good when it really wasn't. I paid $15 for me and $15 for my partner for our breakfast and didn't feel it was worth it.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: 15 minute wait which wasn't bad and the food was delicious but slow and inefficient service. Waitress didn't bring cream with my coffee and she didn't offer water or coffee refills. Didn't offer a to go container either. We had to ask for all! Probably won't be back although the food was good.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caterers, Barbeque, Seafood, Personal Chefs, Soul Food
text: BBQ pork and brisket is amazing! The greens, mac & cheese, yams & homemade cole slaw was out of this world! Best around I would give more than 5 stars if I could.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Looooooved this place!!! Always get the ALL YOU CAN EAT !!! If you can get helped by DANIEL , he's the best!!! He's helpful and very attentive. Place is awesome and very great prices. Must go if you're in Sparks !

place_category: Sports Bars, American (New), American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants
text: Good food had the chicken shrimp combo was real good fries way to salty. . . Wife had fish tacos she says it was really good. . Overly friendly staff but to be expected out of a hooter . . . . Tilted kilt kinda establishment. . . . Music selection was kinda something out of a late night club seen

place_category: Breweries, Nightlife, Bars, Food, Pubs
text: Love the pale ale. Tucson brewers need to brew more ipa.

place_category: Food, Breweries
text: My boyfriend did a tour here one Sunday afternoon and have been coming back ever since. We love the atmosphere and the bartenders are always friendly. The beer is awesome- we always leave with a growler or two. Red Zone (with the sugar rim) is my favorite. Nachos with beer cheese are perfect to munch on while watching a game. And you can't leave without having some bacon fingers.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: 1st time here , service was fast, waitress was friendly and food was good . Margaritas need a bit more tequila and the salsa for the chips they serve looks fresh but lack a bit of spice need a little bit more heat. But overall good : )

place_category: Mexican, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Don't go after 7pm the staff can't keep up with the customer traffic. They're always short staffed.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Buffets
text: I dont know how the other person gave tis place such a good review. I went on a Friday evening around 7:30. Just about everything we put on our plates was cold and/or dried out. Not much of a selection either. I did let them know the crab legs were cold and they did make new hot ones for us which was nice. However I feel like I threw my $$ away. The best part was the cream cheese things and ice cream for desert.

place_category: Restaurants, Indian, Nightlife, Bars, Food, Cocktail Bars, Desserts
text: Wonderfu meal great presentation and the food was delicious really great atmosphere and service was very good as well I'll definitely be coming back regularly

place_category: Restaurants, Irish, Irish Pub, Sandwiches, Bars, Nightlife
text: Perfect Guinness, Profane Staff--let me start with the staff. I sat at the bar and the bartender, she was great. However, when a male server showed up to watch the end of a college basketball, the profanity flew. While it didn't bother me, I would have been concerned for guests with kids. Drinks-I started with a perfect Black and Tan. It was then followed up with cold Guinness perfection. Extremely happy with the beverages.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Pizza
text: The taste is eh. The cheesesteak I ordered did not have extra cheese or ranch like I asked. It was very try and the roll was not toasted. Their pizza tastes nice but towards the middle it's very weak and if you get any toppings they are not supported.

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Delis, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Used to love this place but the current menu is limited and they no longer offer old bay seasoning for the lobster bisque soup. The staff is still pleasant and the food comes out rather quickly but I was very disappointed in the selection and lack of seasoning. I would suggest going to Panera Bread until this place gets the full menu back in a few weeks!

place_category: Bakeries, American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Food, Desserts, Cafes
text: Good place for a friend date. It reminds me very much of San Francisco and the crowd is lively. Standard Cafe Food .

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Always fantastic food. Some don't like the decor, so don't eat it! The food is why you should go. Basics like chicken fried rice can blow you away! My only wish is for a wider range in the degree of spice a dish can have. Mild, Medium & Hot is fine, but how about more variety. Medium Hot, Thai Hot, etc. Also, traditional Thai tea would be a great addition to the menu.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Burgers, Seafood
text: Had the pork platter with mac & cheese and baked beans. Pork was fine, but the sauce could be described as colored vinegar. There was macaroni, but not really any cheese other than whatever cheese water was at the bottom of the cup. I could fill a shot glass with it. Baked beans were overwhelming with onions, the first bite was more reminiscent of cucumber salad something else that tastes like raw onion. It's more of a meat and 3 than a bbq joint, similar to a ready to eat grocery store meal.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Dive Bars, Cocktail Bars, Southern, Nightlife, Bars
text: They have got to do something with the ordering system here. We waited about 20-25 minutes (most were standing up in everyone's way) on 2 sandwiches and 2 sides. If you're going to wait that long for your food at a "fast and casual" place... it better be warm. It wasn't. It tasted pretty good but I won't be rushing back anytime. I'm hoping the new location opening up in April; is better as it's walking distance from my place!

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Dinner Theater, Cinema, Restaurants
text: After one bad experience, I gave this place a second chance... big mistake. The drinks, food, and service were bad enough to almost ruin THE AVENGERS INFINITY WAR. I know, right? I would have experienced finer dining if I had driven through the McDonald's in that shopping center and eaten in the parking lot before the movie. If you find yourself in the unfortunate predicament of being at this Movie Tavern, stick with popcorn and a beer.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, Bars, Italian, Nightlife
text: I went on an Anniversary luncheon hosted by my job so I ordered prior to arriving. Lunch time didn't appear to be very formal. I would say business casual. Was seated in a nice private area but it did not feel closed off due to a glass wall. The ceaser salad was really good. My steak was ordered medium but it was well done which was disappointing. Didn't have time to send it back due to being on timed company lunch. Great company and nice environment.

place_category: Education, Food, Chocolatiers & Shops, Specialty Food, Special Education, Desserts
text: There are a number of chocolate joints around town, so make this one your first stop. It smells good, perfectly lit and the staff is nice, which is greatly appreciated in all business's. If you can't totally pronounce the name of a chocolate they'll know what you meant too. My favorite piece is a white chocolate ball with a fruity dust on the outside, and a smooth finish on the inside. I love you Chocolate Maya :)

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Food was pretty good. Drinks were good. Staff was arguing in front of us constantly. Restaurant was way over packed (seemingly above capacity), hot as hell and the chairs/seats were so worn down that our tailbones were resting against the wood of the chair frame (and we are not heavy people)

place_category: Dance Clubs, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Bars, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: I never go for the food, I usually just go on Saturday nights when the club part is open. It's definitely a college crowd but its fun if you want a somewhat laid back time. The dj is nice & takes request. Come here if you want to hang out & dance

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Transportation, Hotels & Travel, Restaurants, Shopping Centers, Shopping, Tours
text: This famous railroad station is worth seeing for the architecture of the retored waiting room -- now the lobby of a Hyatt Hotel and some of the exterior architecture. The renovation into a shopping mall looks pasted in and unlike some Rouse-ified developments like Quincy Market it does not seem to draw many people. Other than souvenir places, there is little of local color either. A good example of how not to restore an architectural masterpiece.

place_category: Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Asian Fusion, American (New), Southern, Cafes
text: Awful new menu. We ordered multiple items on the menu to try and it looks like Asian should not be the cuisine. The only positive of our meal was our amazing waiter.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes
text: I ordered delivery via UberEats , and my food was fresh and hot and it was very good. The seafood Mac & cheese is the absolute best !

place_category: Restaurants, Cheesesteaks
text: For our last visit, which was last night, we are giving them a 3. They forgot to put cheese on both of our cheesesteaks (Philly Dilly and the vegetarian). Also, my vegetarian is supposed to be a blend of vegetables, but last night it was 80% hot peppers so, my mouth was on fire and it was not enjoyable. The first 2 visits were perfect; we gave them 5 stars on Google etc. Yesterday it was a 3 and it's a 3 because the food was hot and the service was great, but the cheesesteak preparation was a 1.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Should be called Rosa's Mexican Nightmare. Stale broken chips from a bag. Terrible Kraft quality enchiladas. Nothing was even melted. Low grade everything. Waitress was on last leg. Gross dishes. No love in the cooking. The McDonalds of Mexican food at Outback Steakhouse pricing. Don't waste the trip. Go to a steakhouse for the money or you'll cry.

place_category: African, Venues & Event Spaces, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Seafood, American (New), Event Planning & Services
text: Excellent experience! We thoroughly enjoyed a fabulous dinner with business associates and friends. Jade provided excellent service. I would highly recommend the cuisine at the Rusty Pelican. I had the sea bass and it was fantastic. Big thanks to Jade for creating a memorable evening!

place_category: Mexican, American (New), Seafood, Bars, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: My husband and I enjoyed our breakfast. We ordered the breakfast tacos with bacon and it came with one side. He chose grits and I had house breakfast potatoes. Both of us agreed that we enjoyed our meals, it just wasn't anything special. We dined in on a Tuesday about 20 minutes after they opened at 10. We requested the rooftop area but it and the all day weekday drink specials weren't available until 11. Which wasn't a deal breaker, we just enjoy a nice rooftop view.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Sandwiches
text: Great place to stop for a quick breakfast sandwich and coffee on the way to work. I always swing by when I;m working over that way.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: No air conditioning.... no draft beer ( as stated on menu.) No prime rib. ( as stated on menu.) I got fired ,,cuz i mentioned that its a 100 degrees in there,,,,,, sucks going 2 a table pouring sweat.... dont do 2 the bathroom cuz its 300 degrees in there. I feel sorry,,,,4 poor tina ,,,the dishwasher. Its like being in a sauna..... alwYs PUTTING ice in her shirt,,, making her milkshakes. NOW I CAN BE FIRED. WORKED THERE ON & OFF 4 6 YEARS. Zero stars....

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: They've had a management change and it's made a difference in taste and presentation.

place_category: Gluten-Free, Food, Bakeries, Restaurants, Vegan
text: The sweet rolls are effing awesome. The cupcakes were dry and the icing was kinda like a frozen blob of crisco. Get yourself some sweet rolls.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants, Seafood, Desserts, Food
text: This was the best Indian food I've had in a LONG time. The chicken in the chicken tikka masala was so tender it cut like butter with a fork. I mean 10/10.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Food, Salad, Seafood
text: Best chargrilled Oysters ever!!! We loved New Orleans!!!

place_category: Specialty Food, Event Planning & Services, Food, Venues & Event Spaces, Real Estate, Restaurants, Southern, Food Court, Bars, Shared Office Spaces, Nightlife, Home Services
text: Nice ambiance and idea but food was very disappointed in three places we tried, very grease, low quality Hope the promoters bring better quality food, otherwise will go there to walk but not to eat, really disappointing!

place_category: Creperies, Desserts, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Specialty Food, Local Flavor, Food
text: The Marie Antoinette (Nutella, strawberries and bananas with Bailey's) was just okay. The real issue here was the texture of the crepe, which was hard to cut, chewy and over cooked. I wanted to like this place but not a good first impression.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Barbeque
text: have been a first choice customer for 15 years, the smokey ribs with no fat and the fantastic fresh cut french fries, all the side dishes were great! was bragging to a friend how they were the best until recently, he mentioned the ribs had no no smokey taste and were soft from being boiled. he was right....what happened, very sad.

place_category: Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Restaurants
text: Very disappointed. I ordered vanilla soft serve, as soft serve is all they have, with caramel. Not great service and an extremely skimpy, no taste, no love put into pitiful dessert. I recommend going up the street to Super Scoops.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Barbeque, Sports Bars, Dive Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues
text: Monday night have the ribs with grilled shrimp. There is a medium sauce and hot sauce. Waitress said that the hot sauce was not that hot. That's about relative because it was pretty hot. Delicious the baby back ribs are the best. I didn't see any bikers but this is also winter in Pennsylvania. Workers looks great. The baked beans are very good

place_category: Comfort Food, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian, Kosher, Restaurants
text: The best falafel in the city, hands down. It's clean and bustling inside. The music is mellow and comforting. The falafel and latkes aren't greasy at all, and the veggies are fresh and crisp. As another said, the hot sauce adds plenty of charm. The food isn't as garlicky as Philly Falafel either, a plus. The prices and selection is the best in the city. I acknowledge the others, but this is most certainly where I spend my vegetarian dollars.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Great sushi, has all-you-can-eat that includes appetizers. There are two different AYCE menus, which sucks, but overall I love Ijji and I'd definitely come back.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Fast Food
text: Well concept is fun, atmosphere up beat.... Dough is tasteless and my pizza was undercooked! I got a mozzarella, red, tomatoes, garlic basil and Asiago... Something had a bitter aftertaste maybe Asiago. Very reasonably priced by size and you can top it with as much as you want.... They give you a calorie count Decor is hip, music is good and not too loud... I'll come back if nearby , want a salad and there is nowhere else to have pizza or have a fixed budget

place_category: Food Trucks, Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Been to this place several times at the old location. Was always a humdinger, so to speak, especially when I had to pay at the tire store next door! That's authentically quant. From the people to the comida. First visit at the new(er) place.. bought $14 worth of tacos. ..and they wanted extra $$ for a couple more salsa cups. (they only gave me 2) Maybe I've had too many tacos, maybe I expect too much. Maybe I just need too much salsa. Meh..

place_category: Restaurants, Soul Food, Southern, Soup, Sandwiches, Barbeque, Comfort Food
text: The chicken sandwich and whole chicken are seasoned to perfection. But the cornbread is what's bringing it down 2 stars. Just bad. Really really dry. Not sweet. It's confusing. But I love the chicken sandwich. The chicken is juicy and flavored so well. My partner loves the whole chicken and eats most of it in one sitting. Just make the cornbread sweeter and more moist please:)

place_category: Food, Nightlife, French, Restaurants, Bars
text: Inattentive service with long waits. Restaurant was empty, so the delays were unexplainable. The onion soup came out almost luke warm, with no cheese still melted. This is not a place that I would return to, and does not seem to fit in with the hotel that it is a part of. Atire said classy, but very casual was more fitting based upon the clientele. The decor appears to have escaped from the 70s.

place_category: Coffee Roasteries, Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food
text: I really liked the atmosphere. I can see myself enjoying a good book or knocking out a project. The wifi was spotty but the coffee shop was packed. I ordered the alchemist, a local favorite, but found it to be a little to spicy for me.

place_category: Gastropubs, Nightlife, American (New), Sports Bars, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Beer Bar, German, Restaurants, Modern European
text: Great atmosphere! Very hipster inside. This is a great place to go to and sit down with some buddies and have a few drinks if you're looking to just hang. Waiters are kinda slow, so if you're just looking to have a quick lunch then this place is not for you! But overall food was great and their brunch potatoes are awesome if you love a crunch! A little salty though so prepare to have water on hand

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Food Trucks, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: I dont know why people rave about the donuts at this place? Even though the staff think their product is special, the donuts are okay but nothing special. In a competitive donut market, not sure their donuts are worth the price.

place_category: Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants
text: First time when I went, the burger came out undercooked. Waitress made some other minor mistakes. Overall was ok. Second time I went back, we went when it first opened. There was no one in the restaurant and the hostess seemed annoyed and overwhelmed by our party of 6. The waitress this time was great! She gave great recommendations, was friendly, attentive, and happy. I got the lamb sliders which were much better than the undercooked bacon burger from my first visit.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Caribbean
text: Absolutely LOVE this place! Apparently I've passed this little gem time after time without even noticing it. Luckily, my GPS has a restaurant feature and I put in carribean and up pops this place! The staff are so friendly and the food is authentic Jamaican! Curry shrimp, rice and peas, mac and cheese, and brown stew red snapper are just a few of my favorites!

place_category: Seafood, Sandwiches, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Delicious seafood! I had the 1/2 and 1/2 platter with shrimp and fish. Big plate of food! It came with fries and cole slaw and two slices of French bread. This was my first time at this location... I usually go to the one on Iberville in the French Quarter. At this location there was no wait... I walked right in and got seated at 6pm. Nice! That's never the case at the French Quarter location; there's always a line there.

place_category: Sandwiches, Salad, American (Traditional), Cheesesteaks, Breakfast & Brunch, Active Life, American (New), Beaches, Restaurants
text: Definitely a keeper. Glad we stopped here. Philly steak was good but I forgot to get peppers and mushrooms. Doh!

place_category: Buffets, Pakistani, Indian, Restaurants
text: Food is good. Chicken Bryani best I've had outside India. Service not so good.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Alright charashi bowl. Shrimp and some of the fish wasn't firm. The cabbage salad was flooded with sauce to the point that was unedible. The rice was cold in the hand roll. And make sure to watch out for the bill cuz still charge you dinner prices at lunch. And that there's no other sushi places in the area I'm still come back if I was trapped here.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, American (Traditional)
text: We have eaten here 3 times and I always hope it gets better...but nope! There is always a wait. The food is just so so. Over priced for the amount you get. And the service is very, very slow! Today was the last time we will ever go to this place. Take your business elsewhere folks.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: The food is always good. This is not about quality of the meal... we were there at 9:00 this morning and the place was packed. I was coughed on, sneezed on and crowded without safe distancing. I have been extremely careful about being exposed and this was terrifying. Florida is hot at the moment and this was the wrong direction. NOT Covid SAFE!

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Wine Bars, Restaurants
text: They changed the menu so no more mac and cheese and no pot roast sandwiches. They wouldnt even make the sandwich even though they had the items to make it.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars, Chicken Wings
text: We waited about 55 minutes for sub par fish and chips and soggy chicken wings. The worst part though is that it's was dead in there on a rainy day. The decor and cleanliness were an issue. combined with the fact they gave my wife a plastic fork originally to eat her fish and chips. We won't be going back. The wings were tasty but no better than Bully's. We almost left to just go get food at Bully's twice.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Donuts
text: Best donuts in town! This morning I had to wait about 5 minutes for some new chocolate covered and it was worth every minute! I would gladly wait 10 minutes for these babies. Nothing compares to a fresh, hot choco covered or glazed donut from this place!!!!

place_category: Halal, Restaurants, Mexican, Steakhouses
text: My wife and I met in Pilsen Chicago and love to eat Mexican together. We've had a really hard time finding a Mexican restaurant in Philadelphia, GLAD TO SAY WE HAVE FOUND THE BEST MEXICAN RESTAURANT IN PHILLY. Did I mention the food is halal? The standards of halal meat and ingredients offers a wonderful flavor. Can't get enough. Were stuffed, but smiling. If you go check out the nachos. Mmm mm m

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Since the opening, we have been back twice. The food is ok, but the sauce hasn't improved much. So much of barbecue relies on the sauce and every single one of their 6 sauces are bland. A little bit of brown sugar mixed with ketchup would go a long way. We also had the fried chicken which was so painfully over-seasoned, it had a gritty texture. I honestly If they improved the sauces, this restaurant could easily merit 5 stars.

place_category: Food, Seafood, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Seafood Markets
text: Zimmer's Seafood, located at an underdeveloped pedestrian friendly intersection in the heart of Voscoville, prepares arguably the best dressed shrimp po-boy in town (Castnet's are very good as well). You pay for quality here as Zimmer's is not the cheapest but we want real shrimp not the dried bite sized variety right? Of course. My only gripe is that they are closed on Sundays in opposition to my stomach's occasional Sunday po-boy craving. Check it out!

place_category: Gluten-Free, Barbeque, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Hawaiian, Sandwiches, Bars, Nightlife, Vegan
text: Easily the best BBQ in town if not the state. It's the sides that blow me away. Whoever is making the sides needs kudos and a raise!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Food
text: The most disgusting DD I've ever been to. Donuts were mushy and tasted like soap. The cashier was not even paying attention to us and what we were ordering. Would not recommend. Also very very cold in here

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Buffets, Bars, Pizza, Italian, Nightlife
text: My favorite pizza on Earth!!!! Everything about this place is awesome. Every time I'm in town I hit it up! I want my last meal before death to be a large plain, salad with house dressing, and bread and peppers.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: I've had many vermicelli noodle bowls in my life, this would rank as one of the worst. Everything tasted burnt, and typically I like anything blackened, but this didn't seem right. Also the fish sauce had no flavor, thought it was very bland and thrown together.

place_category: Shopping, Food, Health & Medical, Drugstores, Convenience Stores, Pharmacy
text: They are always understaffed in both pharmacy and front store. They also don't treat their employees fairly and only have one person up front store. Don't recommend this cvs

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Eatertainment, Bars, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Sports Bars, Arcades
text: Would you like to pay $5 (cash only) for the privilege of buying more overpriced beer and games? Come right in!

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Please stay away from this racist dude's sandwich shop. I was excited to come to Philly and try one of these cheese steaks but when i read all the signs and stupid sayings all over their walls it ruined the whole experience. it's really ignorant and disgusting how they wear their racist shirts and try to say its in the name of america. losers i will never buy from you again and i will tell all my friends to avoid your nasty shop.

place_name: The Gallery Venue at Tomas Bistro
place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, French, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants
text: I really loved this place - the food and wine were delicious (I had the grouper special and my husband had the carpetbagger steak--both were done to perfection), the service was excellent (Sommer is great!), and the building is beautiful. Even the music was so very pleasant! I definitely recommend it.

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Japanese, Chinese
text: Got the shrimp w lobster sauce this time and it lacked taste. Maybe their specialty is sushi. Since their pricing is on the higher side, I'd expect outstanding. Clean restaurant, good menu, nice ambiance.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: I want to like this place, but can't. The burritos we ordered had more lettuce than anything else, I didn't order a salad. They where not good.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Sports Bars
text: Very good food and interesting specials daily. A refreshing take on 'bar food'. Huge HD tvs line the bar. Was a fun place to catch some Olympics during lunch. Give them a try and you'll be back.

place_category: American (New), Pizza, Sports Bars, Dive Bars, Diners, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: I came with a group of 5 people and when we went to ask the bartender to close our tab, he ignored us and continued his conversation . When we finally got his attention, he told us to give him a second . You could've acknowledged us in the first place.

place_category: Local Flavor, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Slightly overrated but not bad. I respect that it's been open for so long and continues to operate at relatively low prices. That being said, I would have preferred more variety. My cherry and pineapple ice was quite good but I've had better in Philly. I would come back here but I wouldn't seek it. There must be better places to get italian ice around these parts!

place_category: Indian, Restaurants, Seafood, Desserts, Food
text: I have ordered the food from the restaurant but it is very less in the container given and not enough serving called about it but no proper response from them .This not how a response should be for any one as a customer

place_category: Specialty Food, International, Restaurants, Food Court, Arts & Entertainment, Breakfast & Brunch, Fruits & Veggies, Food, Festivals, Farmers Market
text: SUMMARY: Touted as the "Biggest farmers market in the Southeast." Offers a good selection of organic veggies (vendors large and small), prepared foods and arts & crafts. Definite go-to place when visiting the area. RIPE: - Wide lanes, good layout - Raw dairy (for pet consumption only!) - Grass-fed beef - One (large) organic veggie vendor - Good variety of prepared foods MUSHY: - Parking at the market is $5. (If you can walk 3 blocks, you can find free street parking.)

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants, Cheesesteaks
text: In my hunt for the best cheesesteak, I would have to say that Dalessandro's holds the number one spot right now. Even though its location is out of the city scene, it's completely worth the drive. No grease dripping from the bottom of the sandwich. I repeat: NO GREASE. The space is small, but it adds to the strong neighborhood loyalty vibe. Every single time I go to Philly, I make an effort to come out to this place. I absolutely love it and cannot say enough good things about their sandwiches.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Barbeque, Desserts
text: Best Brisket in town!. Potato salad just like Mom's. French fries were good. Baked Beans were outstanding. Sauces were different and good. One other surprise was the Soda made with came sugar. Forgot the brand but really nice. Like the serving trays.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Buffets, Seafood, Japanese
text: Came on a night when the food was pretty decent. The fellas enjoyed themselves here. Still wish they had kept to the original menu they had when they first opened. Not a bad place to get your Chinese food fix, and as I mentioned before, surprisingly their American dishes are much better than other Chinese buffets.

place_category: Salad, Fast Food, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Went here for the first time today. Staff was super friendly! Both my hubby and I got salads and they were excellent. Love how many toppings you can choose from.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners
text: I personally did not care for this place. When I received my salad I could tell they did not take much care in cleaning their vegetables because the label was still on the tomatoes that were in my salad. I brought it to the attention of the waitress and the manager and neither could care less. I did not stay for my meal because I worried about what else could I possibly find in my food.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Food, Custom Cakes
text: Hopefully just an off night for Ben and Jerry's. The milkshake was super runny, my wife's Sunday was tiny for the cost. There was disgusting mold in the water fountain looked like algae.

place_category: Bars, Food, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Seafood, Sports Bars
text: We had a great time and the staff was excellent. Our bar tender Jessica took great care of us despite how obnoxious we can sometimes be. If you see her ask her about buying furniture.

place_name: Hattie B's Hot Chicken - Nashville West
place_category: Beer Bar, Bars, Southern, Soul Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Chicken Wings
text: This place knows what they are doing and they are twice as fast as Princes Chicken.The food is really good and they give you plenty of what ever you order.Hattie B's is a must try if you like fried chicken!

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New)
text: The review in the Post Dispatch sounded good, so four of us decided to try it. I'll say that the oysters were good and it only took a little longer than expected to get them. It was all down hill after that. The meals were mediocre at best. It took forever to get served. It was very noisy. And it was very expensive. A pretty disappointing experience overall. I wouldn't bother with this place. There are many others in St Louis that are much better.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Food, Desserts
text: Wandered in this place looking for bubble tea. got a coconut.. very good indeed. Discovered a sweet soup with taro and small tapioca pearls sitting on counter for $1.50...amazing...i"m hooked. Tofu/wginger was very good. Nice lady...man a bit grumpy but they are very helpful. Place always busy..good sign. Also very good were the noodles w/ veg and the unsweetened iced 24 herb tea..

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Event Planning & Services, Salad, Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Caterers, Restaurants
text: This was a serious disappointment for delivery... we ordered a large pizza and quesadilla... the quesadilla is a pizza base and served with ranch. Horrible. Especially because we ordered it for someone who can't eat pizza dough...(sorry but are tortillas really that expensive?)... pizza was really soggy and couldn't stand up to the toppings, they were sliding off.... delivery took an hour. Wouldn't recommend.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, French, Bakeries, Salad
text: We had the breakfast sandwich on a baguette with ham, it was delicious! Hot chocolate is great, hot chai not too sweet so if you like it a little bland then it's a great cup!

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: I might be the only person that has said this, but I don't think the house specialty cocktails are good at Planter's. The ingredients individually look and taste good, but when put together, the flavors don't come together. Any place with decent ingredients can make a good Manhattan, but this place is known for their original drinks. For me, there are much better places to spend $12 on a cocktail. Also, service from staff has always bordered between aloof and terrible.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Caribbean, Restaurants
text: This place has disappointed me several times. I now will quit trying to give it a try. I have tried to call ahead taking the drive to verify having a simple beef patty available, however I never get an answer. More than half the time I have gone here for a beef patty, it is not available. For this location to be a drive thru concept and not have a popular item available during peak business hours is confusing.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Tex-Mex
text: We went here because of the excellent Yelp reviews. It must be self-reviewed or they were having a very off day. Taco Bell would have been more satisfying. We ordered pretty much everything off of the menu (7 people) and a pitcher of margaritas. The margs were too sweet and the food was mediocre. Do not believe Yelp, do no go here. Also, they don't have their times listed on their website or on Yelp (should have been a tip off to their lack of attention to detail) - they close at 10pm.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Fast Food, Mexican, Tacos, Tex-Mex
text: Let's start with the dining room. Co- worker and I noticed small ants crawling across our table. They weren't on the menu. Next: The men's room. Honestly, it smelled like they have a major sewer problem. I had to hold my breath or breathe through my mouth to keep from wrenching. My food was fine. Service was fast. But the above 2 items are the details that set a well-managed place apart from a rag tag restaurant .

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: They need to seriously re-work their menu. The dishes are greasy and over fried. Little options for allergies or diet limitations. The food was a supreme let down. As well, they charge around $30 for some meals and you can buy 1.5kg of shrimp for that cost and yet their portions are very small for what you are paying for. Their fish was poorly cooked flat,blan, and greasy. Their fries where undercooked and floppy. Overall nothing like their counterpart in the south. If I was Forrest I would run

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Burgers, Pubs, Nightlife, Armenian, American (Traditional)
text: Dude if you wanna wait 1hr for your food then come on down. Like my stomach is hurting so bad waiting. This is terrible im not having a good time. My vibes are so down. So down. I just need food in my stomach and this restaurant is torturing me. It's like they enjoy wasting paying customers time. I'm appalled. The only reason i'm giving this 2 stars is because the tater tots kinda slap.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Specialty Food, Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: This is just plain bad Mexican food. Their only claim to fame seems to be that they finally have a liquor license. I tried it because of a Groupon offer. What is it? Do places that are otherwise failures list with Groupon to try to get custoners?

place_category: American (New), Wine Bars, Restaurants, Soup, Italian, Bars, Nightlife
text: Not worth the money, small servings ordered veal parm with 2 pieces of cheese was terrible and dry with small portion of pasta, Soup and salad extra not included with meal. Paying for atmosphere only. Will not be back

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Hookah Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Mediterranean, Greek, Middle Eastern
text: Located downtown near the Capitol building and many businesses is this yummy Arabic restaurant, modernly decorated with booth and table seating. The service was friendly and it wasn't crowded so we didn't wait long. The food was flavorful and had many typical Arabic choices and seasonings with the menu.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: WTH.. ordered shrimp with potatoes and sausage . Since this is a staple on their menu I figured it would be good. It wasn't fresh. The potatoes were reheated there was no seasoning on them whatsoever. So right before they put it in the go container they dumped salt, butter and hot seasoning on it.Tried to let it soak before I ate it , no luck The sausage was horribly salty. The only three flavors I could taste were heat , salt and reheated potatoes. Couldn't eat it. I will not be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: 2 of us ordered the sushi combo for $15, fresh made sushi, miso soup and ginger salad was good, fast service, good value.

place_category: Irish, Nightlife, Restaurants, Pubs, Bars, Irish Pub
text: Anytime I've gone into this place to get something to eat (I'm smart enough to stay the hell away during high drinking times), it's taken forever--even if it's 2 or 3 tables seated. The food's edible though if not a little overpriced.

place_category: Cafes, Canadian (New), Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife
text: Decent meal. The flank steak was good but came with way too much chimchurri and an excess of fries. House sour drink was decent but a tad too sweet. All in all a decent meal but nothing to write home about.

place_category: Cuban, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Spanish, Restaurants
text: Stopped in for the first time recently; got several Cuban sandwiches and had a coffee while I was waiting. The coffee was fantastic, as were the sandwiches. And, they were incredibly inexpensive - about $5 each for a huge sandwich.

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Food, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Poke, Acai Bowls
text: We tried it for dinner. It was ok. My spicy tuna roll was anemic to say the least. Very little tuna. Our Gyoza was good. Nothing special about this place. The cucumber saketini was lame. There are better places.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Go through the drive through at your own risk. Ordered my combo and the lady was distracted had to ask me 3 times what I wanted. Forgot to give me napkins, silverware for my mashed potatoes and NO sauce for my tenders. Also some of my friends Nedra were pink and undercooked. Worst Popeyes I've ever been to.

place_category: Restaurants, Food Delivery Services, Food, Thai
text: PROS: Large portions, flavorful CONS: Greasy, not amazing As far as Thai food goes, Bangkok Thai 9 is alright. The pad see ew (basic noodle dish which I use to judge most Thai restaurants) was flavorful, but also quite greasy and overcooked. There are better Thai options in Philly.

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Burgers
text: I've never gotten everything I ordered, nor have I ever gotten fries that weren't cold.

place_category: Caribbean, American (New), Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Latin American
text: You have to go and try Marker 39, you won't be disappointed... the food is unbelievable and the service top notch..

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Side Wok Cafe is like any other Chinese takeout place except that the restaurant is very clean and the food is excellent! I have been here many times and the food is consistently good. I try to make myself get something different every time, with the exception of their hot and sour soup. It is by far the best I've ever had. It's packed with vegetables, mushrooms, tofu, and other delicious things. I'm convinced it can heal any ailment.

place_category: Korean, Barbeque, Restaurants, Asian Fusion
text: Wow! Kogi Grill was really a surprise! I was expecting more of a traditional Korean restaurant experience, but instead I was treated to more of a Korean-fusion creation. Still, I'd classify this as fast food, and definitely not a substitute for Korean BBQ, but only because Kogi Grill is something totally different. Try it for yourself and see. You're welcome in advance. :)

place_category: Soul Food, Southern, Comfort Food, Restaurants
text: Was not impressed. Food was good but nothing special. For the price it should be gourmet, not sandwich shop style. Also took 25 minutes for my order of side salad, garlic bread and mostaccioli. Sara B could whip this up in 10, and much tastier.

place_category: Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Bars, Wine Bars, American (New)
text: Great cocktails and friendly bartenders who care. I want to make this place my cheers.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: Stopped in here during our Yelp event for a beer and quick bite. Wow, the food at Busch Gardens is just horrid! I can't believe they sell this crud but I guess when you're trapped in a park and have to eat you don't have much of a choice. That being said, the pub part was ok, nice selection of beers and mixed drinks as well

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: New to the area from NJ we are constantly looking for good restaurants, especially pizza. We gave this place a shot. A mistake. The pizza was terrible, the sauce was tasteless, the cheese was uncooked, the crust was barely passable. We even tried the ravioli. Overcooked, bland and tasteless, and they used the same sauce used for pizza. This place is NOT even a mediocre Italian restaurant. They need a new chef badly. To be fair, the service was good. But without good food, why bother?

place_category: American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: This was a great spot for breakfast. I had the grillades and grits. It was delicious, especially the sauce. My fiancée had the full blast Benedict which was good and very filling, it can be split between two people. We also got mimosas which were good as well. This place is definitely worth a visit.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Chicken Shop, Fast Food
text: Oh I love Chick-fil-A ! Haven't had it in over 3 years since we lived in Florida !!

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: I was very satisfied with this fine dining establishment, however it did not blow me away. We had the crab cake appetizer which was extrememly small but good, not great. The filet I had was once again good, but not one of the best I have had. Service was great and the owner came around and greeted everyone. I also saw him helping out with delivering orders, which I thought was very nice. It is a well run family owned restaurant. I recommend it to other steak and seafood lovers!

place_category: Delis, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: I feel like this place is never open... I finally came one day for brunch when I finally caught them being open, it turned out mediocre at best. I could've made everything at home... nothing special. They don't even offer eggs benedict... like what type of brunch is it without eggs benny on the menu?! Shrug

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, American (New), Comfort Food
text: Solid place for dinner, especially for a place attached to a mall. Menu was pretty wide ranging, which is tough to pull off. Recommend their garlic fries. Good appetizer. You'll like it, probably won't love it.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Soup, Korean
text: A nice addition to Claiborne Ave. great effort at authentic Korean. Enjoyed the sides very much and my spicy fish soup. Prices are reasonable and very friendly service.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Dim Sum, Asian Fusion, Shanghainese
text: More like 3.5 stars. I love me some dumplings - pan fried are my fave - so when I order them pan-fried, I expect at least one side to be kinda crispy for extra texture. I ordered pan-fried vegetable dumplings. Meh, the fried side was facing down on the plate that it was served on, so it was kinda soggy. It was fine, I ate it. Service was good, they were busy as hell so they are doing something right. Next time, I may find another spot to try.

place_category: Gastropubs, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Beer Bar, Food, Restaurants
text: Been here once or twice never had an issue. As I'm here now dinner crowd is leaving and when I asked for a table for four and said we'd be getting drinks I was told "we won't seat you." If I weren't here already I'd have left. Currently 3 open tables and nobody waiting. Those seated are only having drinks.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food
text: Just looking for something quick on way to airport..... saw the Beignets and coffee sign. Cute 1930s style coffee shop. Easy to find next to mall. Quick and friendly service. Coffee a little on the bitter side for me, but nice and hot. Beignets are fresh, and less greasy than cafe du monde' (sorry guys). Also serve gumbo, jumbalya, etouffee.... I will come again to those.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: Lunch , party of 13 people around 1 O'Clock . horrible service , note down the wrong orders , and charged for gratuity even though the waiter knew he gave bad service . our bill total out to be 464.00 . they'll not be getting my business when I go to new Orleans again.

place_category: Food, Health Markets, Vegetarian, Breakfast & Brunch, Specialty Food, Acai Bowls, Food Trucks, Restaurants
text: Horrendous. Overpriced for a bowl of fruit with little to no açaí. Having spent a tremendous amount of time in Brazil what they call Acai had zero resemblance to what Acai really is, what little they gave me was all ice. Oh and the attitude of the girls working in truck was appalling

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Thai, Asian Fusion, Japanese, Chinese
text: I'd say the three and a half stars is about right for here. First time trying it out because I was craving sushi and the area has slim pickings. We ordered salad, fried rice and a couple of basic rolls. For $30 it was a lot of food. Salad dressing was yummy! Sushi was average, but that's comparing it to higher end places. Didn't eat there but it was clean. Service was friendly and good was ready fast. I'd go back.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Barbeque, Caribbean, Seafood
text: A very family-friendly restaurant. Good drinks, good food. I just really want non-Jamaican Caribbean theme restaurants to stop calling their grilled chicken "Jerk chicken" when it has absolutely no heat. Spicy heat is a significant element of jerk chicken. If it's not spicy, then it's not jerk chicken.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Convenience Stores, Sandwiches, Food
text: Management should tell the employees making the food that they should keep their masks on, especially so customers can't hear how many expletives they use. Absolute disgrace.

place_category: Seafood, Noodles, Soup, Tapas/Small Plates, Thai, Restaurants
text: Came back and highly recommend the Tom yum gai or tom kah gai soups! Love the lemongrass! Other dishes also delish!

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Bars, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional)
text: This is a shit hole Hooters. No staff working. Slow to get food. Was just told last call for alcohol at 9:45. We tried to come here Tuesday and they had 2 servers working 7 tables seated and no one at tables had food. Stay away from this place. Hopefully a better restaurant will lease this space in the future.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Overpriced and not very good. We have had better guacamole from Aldi. There was no flavor in the salsa or and guacamole tasted like raw onion. Ten dollars for a quesadilla with no sides, no beans or rice. I feel ripped off.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Nightlife, Bars
text: Had House salad and bang bang shrimp of course shrimp was good. Also ordered the shrimp tacos, which came out with a nice presentation. Coconut shrimp freind ordered and was good. It's still a chain with chain food but decent enough to enjoy

place_category: Bars, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings
text: Good food, great prices. We had a restaurant.com coupon and when we got there we were told they would not honor it. I explained I had just bought it. The bartender spoke to the GM who then said he would honor it. That's good customer service. Friendly staff. They don't seem to have AC just swamp cooling so it was a bit warm for my taste. I will defiantly go back, just maybe in cooler weather.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Ordered a pizza for delivery from the 22nd street location. Was told it could take up to an hour and was ok with that since we usually get a great pie from Mamas. After 1 hour and 20 minutes I called to check the status. Was told there was only one driver and they were on the way. Pizza arrived after 1 hour 40 minutes. Worst pizza I have ever had. Cold, soggy and the crust was so hard I almost broke a tooth. Never again Mamas, never again!!

place_category: Breweries, Nightlife, Restaurants, Food, American (New), Bars
text: The food was just so so. I had stayed next door at Harrahs for a meeting and actually are here two days in a row. The first night I had Artisan grilled cheese and garlic fries. The bread was dry and it was rather bland. The garlic fries were ok, but hardly had garlic flavor. Tonight I had a cheese burger and garlic mashed potatoes. Both were just ok. Not terrible but not good. Would I eat here again? If there was nothing else, but I wouldn't recommend it. The service was good both days.

place_category: Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Diners, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Stumbled upon Carne today looking to score a cheap happy hour . Which I did , martinis are only 3 dollars and they do the job . Our food took over 50 minutes to receive . The bread is horrible just hamburger buns . The pork chop was amazing and that's it . My order was beyond wrong and took forever to correct . Waitress was sympathetic and nice about it

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: We had a lovely server here who earned a star on her own. Otherwise, it's all about the food, which is very much "meh". The pork and brisket were dry. The sides tasted like they were bulk orders dumped out of a giant vat. Four tables full at dinner on a Thursday tells you all you need to know. You have options for BBQ in Indianapolis, both locally-owned and chains. There are better choices - don't waste your time here. Eating BBQ should be a joy!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: Oystercatchers is a wonderful restaurant with an amazing view of the bay. I got the Lobster BLT and I am beyond happy with the meal. The bread was toasted perfectly, the bacon nice and crispy and the lobster fresh and delicious. The marinara sauce, which I am not usually a fan of, was also tasty and I used it with almost every bite. Jasmine was a great waitress and helped with everything I needed. I will definitely be coming back for the food and of course the amazing view and ambience.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Very expensive prices and small portions. I split a $20 meal with my spouse and it was not enough. Year after year the menu stays the same also. Needs more options than just "fried basket" or "boiled shrimp".

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Food, Restaurants, Delis, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Gastropubs, Beer Bar, Sandwiches
text: Eggplant Parm Sandwich Highlights: - bun construction allows for optimal per-bite composition - great balance of ingredients, including sauce - basil is a notable addition, adds freshness Low Points: - eggplant slices may slide out during large bite - a little smaller than the average eggplant parm grinder - bread leaves a little to be desired - not super hot Recommendations: - eat this it's delicious

place_category: Bars, Beer Gardens, Food, Breweries, Nightlife, Tours, Pubs, Wine Tours, Beer Tours, Hotels & Travel
text: The standard tour (45 minutes) through the factory is free! I am not a drinker so was not too interested in the tour; however it did have its interesting moments (seeing the Clydesdales they use in the commercials). My husband enjoys a beer every now and again and loved the tour! His favorite part: 22 ounces of free beer at the end! Since its free, it is definitely worth it when in St. Louis.

place_category: Spanish, Restaurants, Lebanese, Middle Eastern, Venezuelan, Halal, Latin American
text: Great little place! The food is delicious and the portions are decent. We had the Venezuelan arepa, Lebanese pita, pulled chicken arepa and cheese cachapa. The pita and the arepas were amazing!!! Fresh ingredients and very filling. I wasn't that impressed with the cachapa, but maybe I'm just not used to that kind of food. Service was on point, prices are very reasonable. I'd definitely go back for the arepas/pitas!

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, Nightlife, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Burgers
text: To celebrate the national chicken wing day, we came to Applebee for their half price double crunch bone in chicken wings. We picked the Thai peanut sauce. 9 pieces of the deep fried chicken wings with some peanut butter sauce on them. They tasted average. The service was nice.

place_category: American (New), Cocktail Bars, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Hotels & Travel
text: It was just "ok". Service was a bit slow. 60 minutes from the time we sat down until we got our entree. The escargot was lacking flavor. I had the burger, while it was tasty, it was almost "slider" sized. And the fries were your average ordinary unseasoned fries. The coffee and the banana tart were divine.

place_category: Peruvian, Restaurants, Latin American
text: Cute place, good service, fair prices. Not too Peruvian for most Americans, probably not too American for Peruvians. Better-than-average food, too.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Salad, Hot Dogs, Delis
text: Been coming here for years... Still have the same great service, sandwiches, and 'can-do' attitude if you need a custom hoagie or something made special that is not on the menu. Good Job!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Ordered salt and pepper calamari, 2x almond chicken, and crabmeat cream corn soup. The almond chicken was basically plain chicken and vegetables floating around in a cup of water. The crabmeat cream corn soup was eggdrop soup with bits of corn and crab. Very unsatisfied. The only thing was the salt and pepper calamari.

place_category: Barbeque, Soul Food, Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Southern, Restaurants
text: The wait took forever! We ordered over the phone and they said the wait was going to be about 30-45 mins. So we waited then headed over. We ha to wait an additional 30 mins for our food. Time management needs some work. But overall, the food was ok.

place_category: Bars, Food, Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Diners, Bakeries
text: The food was ok Deanna the hostess was unbelievably nice to me she was probably the only good part of my experience! My waitress didn't have a name tag on but she was very rude

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese, Soup
text: Wow this is the worst Vietnamese food I ever had. I had the beef pho takeout . My soup was only 75% filled . And my noodles were hard. The broth taste so salty and old. Never will I ever order from them.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Very affordable, Great portions, nice service, and vegetarian options!!! Tofu was actually cooked and lots of veggies in the pho

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Ethnic Food, Specialty Food, Cajun/Creole, Food
text: Service and food was very good. We had the fried Grouper special of the day, presentation was great and was stuffed when left. Local fair with a twist nice to have something new thats not just another po boy shop in St. Bernard.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Pubs, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Pizza, Nightlife, Food, Bars
text: This place is one of my favorites in Nashville! Their deviled eggs are out of this world and their salads have so many toppings and taste so fresh! Pricing is very reasonable too.

place_category: Diners, Restaurants
text: A nice diner in the strip mall. Small and friendly with traditional items like eggs, hash browns, and bacon. A good price for a quick breakfast.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Desserts, Restaurants, Food
text: All you can eat dinner was roughly $20 per person. False advertising as the server said it was anything on the menu, but the 3 things I picked was not included on the all you can eat. On the plus side, the rolls and nigiri are made with minimal rice. Service was decent. The decor was nice.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Salad
text: We went here for a luncheon following my cousin's christening. The food was delicious. I had their chicken parmigiana and a cannoli for dessert. The service was ok, we were a large group so It took a good while for us to receive our drinks. Def think they should of had an extra set of hands helping out. My only complaint is that when we had dessert and asked for coffee, they told us they ran out! How do you run out of coffee?

place_category: Cuban, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Spanish, Restaurants
text: The best coffee I've ever had! Their egg sandwich is also amazing. And this place is cheaper than most other places too.

place_category: Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Grocery, Restaurants
text: Good food, but NOT a clean restaurant. My friend had a hair in her food and my water glass had white sludge at the bottom.

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Fun place to go grab a PBR and fireball shot for $5... Seriously, it's a real deal at this place. Perfect for pre gaming before the bars. Also, karaoke rooms you can rent out and have sushi delivered to your private room??? Sign me up motha' licka! Tip - the waiters always seem high and have zero idea what is on the menu. Other than the random stoner taking your order, cheap prices for a lot of food.

place_category: Restaurants, Gastropubs, American (New)
text: Went on a Monday for half priced burgers. I had the beet burger (which the waitress was kind enough to make sure I knew it was only beet and no beef) but my friend got the house burger and reported it was delicious. Fries were great too. I'll bring my guy back for burgers and brews soon!

place_category: Food, Italian, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Pizza, Restaurants
text: So this is definitely good pizza made with high quality ingredients. The problem is it is not earth shattering in flavor and it took a whole pizza to fill me up. And I honestly could have eaten more. I just don't know that $17 per person is worth it for any pizza. For $17 for a 12" pizza I would expect a higher ratio of toppings. We got the pepperoni, the sausage, and the mushroom. All were very good, but just not worth $17.

place_category: Restaurants, Indian
text: Went there for sunday lunch buffet. It was fairly busy. Host and servers were attentive. The salads were fresh. Starters tasted good but were a bit too oily. Out of the the main dishes, kadhi and palak methi matar were good. Breads were stiff. Chole was bland. Manchurian had a strange sauce. Wasn't Manchurian at all. 3 is a generous rating.

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: First time I've had a California King Crab. Was much smaller but it was tasty and fresh! If they have them in, I highly recommend you order it. This was like 4 months ago from this writing.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Mediocre at its best. Have not been there more than four times, once they gave us the wrong food but charged us for the walnut shrimp. Another time everything we wanted was going to take five minutes to prepare. This place kind of reminds me of, "you get what you get, now take it and leave" There are better places in Mount Juliet to eat.

place_category: Hot Dogs, Restaurants
text: Very good hot dogs, highly recommend the Hawaiian. The only thing holding me back from giving this a 5-star review is their doordash ordering options did not include French fries unless you upgraded the dog to a combo, and even then the French fries were unseasoned and I would actually say below average. But what it lacks in fries definitely makes up for with hotdog. Desserts weren't an option at all. Very limited door dash options. Otherwise food was good.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Fast Food, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Went here for lunch with my mom and we both had burritos. My burrito was almost tasteless and my mom's burrito wasn't bad. All of the tables and chairs in this place looked dirty. After we were done eating and left we were both feeling nauseous from our meal. We were afraid the food was rotten. Never coming here again. Don't go!

place_category: Wine Bars, Italian, Food, Nightlife, Bars, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Look at the other bad reviews. Food and service use to be good, long time customer but lately, I would definitely refuse to eat there. Service is horrible, understaffed kitchen and wait staff. Ordered two pizza's one came first, the 2nd one for my dinner partner was 15 minutes later and cold. They managed not to have additional seasoning available on table, which if you get a pizza would like shaker cheese, and oregano. Restaurant was even busy, HORRIBLE! DO NOT GO THERE!

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Decent sushi, not the best. But it's a good place to get your foot in the door. A great place for tempura lovers that just haven't got a taste for sashimi yet.

place_category: Dim Sum, Buffets, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Chinese, Seafood
text: I tried this place when I first came down to Florida. Compared to up North, I would never come back again. But for Florida, this place is good from my experiences here. I wouldn't come here for food, if I had a choice though :I

place_category: Automotive, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Burgers, Beer Bar, Sports Bars, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Walked in and sat down in a fairly busy section at a 2 top. The sign said to seat yourself. Saw 3 or 4 servers look at our tables or pass us. They saw we had menus and no drinks and nobody stopped once to ask if we had been greeted. After 10 minutes of being ignored we left.Their menu looked good but not going to spend money where it was obvious nobody wanted us there.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Beer Bar, Barbeque, Nightlife, Bars
text: My experience was not what I expected it to be. The tables are too close together. And the service was not so good. Sorry , maybe the second time around it will be better. The food was good.

place_category: Grocery, Specialty Food, Restaurants, Food, Seafood Markets, Seafood
text: Ok so today I went to go look around for a seafood place, and I found this placee. Anyways just to let you know people this is NOT a restaurant, this a store where they sell seafoods; like a king crabs which is $20.0 per lbs. .. they have fish .. etc.! So yeah this is not a restaurant

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Indian, Pakistani, Butcher, Halal
text: Oh so good! We had the butter chicken and it was amazing! Naan and samosas were super good too! I can't wait to come back.

place_category: American (Traditional), Laser Tag, Arcades, Arts & Entertainment, Active Life, Amusement Parks, Restaurants
text: Although this place is nice and clean I find it too expensive. The bumper cars are fun but 5 bucs for 3 mintues come on now.....

place_category: French, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Service was awful, food was mediocre... Extremely disappointed. To add insult to injury the waitress couldn't get our bill right and charged us extra. She charged our card a second time in attempt to fix it, but now our credit card has $400 charges and we have to wait for one to fall off to make it right.. Ridiculous. This is not fine dinning, save yourself the headache and go somewhere else! This is also my first bad review to write on Yelp. That's how disappointed I was.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants
text: The retaurant is very nice, and the waitstaff is friendly and attentive. The food was good. The Thai Hot Soup with Chicken was very good.

place_category: Nurseries & Gardening, Shopping, Farmers Market, Fruits & Veggies, Specialty Food, Home & Garden, Food
text: Ok for a Fresh fruit and veggie farmers market with a flea market. Food court is not restaurants but a food court like at a mall. Definately not a destination, but if you happen to be passing by and looking for fresh corn, tomatoes and peaches, stop!

place_category: Food, Salad, Barbeque, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: This place is delicious. It was very highly recommended to me by a close friend (well, not that close), but I surely wasnt disap[pointed at all! If you are in the mood for some BBQ this is the next spot you need to check out!

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Ate here over the weekend and the service along with my pulled pork sandwich was equally bad. How do you mess up pulled pork sandwich as a "BBQ place"

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: On a Monday at 3:45pm, I called for take out that I was going to pick up. They said it was a 2 hour wait. Needless to say, I said no thanks! Who ever heard of a 2 hour wait to pick up an order for take out!

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Do not order food from this restaurant. We called for delivery and the food took 2 hours to get to our house. They kept saying that they were almost there.. Then when it arrived the soup was upside down and the food was destroyed. When we called they did not care. Worst service ever.

place_category: Mexican, Tacos, Restaurants
text: Great place to grab some tacos for a reasonable price and very quickly as well. I highly recommend trying RT out. I had the bbq cauliflower tacos, they were good.

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants
text: Very good burgers! Drinks are pretty good too. Lots of variety. The most fun time to go is during Quizzo :)

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment
text: Would you like salt with your steak / salad? Ordered the $26 steak it had so much salt I could not eat it. Manager took it off the bill. She got me a salad which had as much salt on it too. 2-Stars. Nov 2016

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Nightlife, Bars, Pubs
text: Review is for lunch when I ordered a burrito. There are a handful of Mexican style restaurants in the suburbs of Philadelphia and Los Sarapes is like most of them, average. Service is good, decor has a Central American vibe, flavors are okay, and parking lot seems really small.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Ordered a drink and ended up getting my order after the couple behind me because they had ordered tea and an espresso. I ordered a drink that required espresso and steamed milk, and when I asked why that happened, they said it was "quicker to get them out the door". I've come here a few times. The vibe is good. The coffee is mediocre. The service can be incredible one day and poor the next so it all depends on who is behind the counter, which is unfortunate.

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Salad, Restaurants, Burgers, Pizza, Sports Bars
text: Pizza was decent. A little undercooked but not terribly. $2.00 up-charge to put a minimal amount of diced jalapeños on 1/2 seemed a bit excessive. 3 stars because we had to send the onion rings and wings back. Both were inedible. The onion rings were an undercooked ball of dough and the wings were as hard as rock. Pluses: The beer was very cold and our waitress was terrific.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Delis, Cheesesteaks
text: Poor customer service!! Office ordered lunch today and we were missing several orders of fries. I called and politely asked about a refund for the fries and the shift leader argues with me about fries being in the bag.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Sushi Bars
text: I work at a salon in the Plymouth Meeting Mall, not a lot of delivery options, went to Sushi Lover and got dumplings which were fried to perfection but came with no dipping sauce. I got a garden salad with extra ginger dressing. The dressing taste nothing like ginger, it was gross. I have tried their spicy tuna rolls and they are just alright.

place_category: Restaurants, Spanish, Cuban
text: One of the most disappointing meals we've ever had. It was actually inedible. Very cheap ingredients and poorly cooked.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: Dear Stanley, if you are going to put a sign in the window for Best Rueben sandwich in New Orleans it better be. It's not. It's pretty good even though mine was a bit sloppy and fatty. After tax you'll be in for over 12 bucks with no side except a skinny pickle. I'm still searching for the Best Reuben.

place_name: Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant - Town & Country
place_category: Arts & Entertainment, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Wineries, Wine Bars, Desserts, Seafood, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Wine Tasting Room, Food, Soup
text: I was underwhelmed by all the hype that seems to surround Cooper's Hawk. The lobby is cool. It has a cool vibe, etc. The actual restaurant was lackluster, hot, and crowded. When I'm paying that much money for an entree and bottle of wine, I shouldn't be elbow to elbow with a perfect stranger. The food was fine but the decanter and wine glasses were covered in water spots and looked unclean, even thought I'm sure they were. All in all, I'm glad I went but don't feel an urge to go back.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Soup, Salad
