text: I tried this place one more time.....ok folks..I hit a milestone..this was the worst Italian meal I've ever had..period..!!warm salad...stale garlic bread..sauce that keeps repeating on you..o total bucket of vomit..how can you screw up spaghetti and meatballs..??!the barstaff..I think were the absolute worst..and so is the manager...who allows this restaurant to put out complete trash..!...lipstick on the wine glasses....dirty G lasses..were everywhere...will not be returning..

place_category: Grocery, Burgers, Food, Local Flavor, Restaurants, Salad, American (Traditional), Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: My ahi banh mi sandwich was filled stuffed with veggies and fish! It was great! Also the gluten-free bread met my high standards. I am not downtown much but when I am I will definitely keep Maynards in mind. The back patio was pleasant and the staff were friendly and efficient.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Not the worst food I've had, but basically bland & uninteresting. Sadly, this combined with very poor service, means I will not be returning to this restaurant. It's a pretty place - spacious, fairly comfortable.

place_category: Cuban, Restaurants
text: I have never been to this place but I gave it a try. The Cuban food was authentic. I tired a Cuban and some coffee and was pleased. If you are in the area give it a try.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Pizza, Italian, Sandwiches, Food Delivery Services
text: Best pizza in West Chester! Upside down pizza and Cali veg are very good. They also have awesome sandwiches!

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Excellent cheesesteaks. Bread is crispy outside and soft inside. Meat is savoury. The sandwiches are a bit saltier than most, and I like them that way. Park nearby so that you can be sheltered from the heat or cold while you devour.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Thai, Restaurants
text: This is absolutely my favorie Thai restaurant. My boyfriend and I go here about once every two weeks and it's been great for hosting parties as well. The service is always great, the food is fresh and comes out fast, and the presentation of the food and the restaurant decor is gorgeous. Great vegetarian options too, as any entree can be made with chicken, pork, beef, tofu, or veggies. I have no complaints about this restaurant!

place_category: Burgers, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Lounges
text: Without a doubt, 100% sure this is my favorite place in Nashville. I've probably been here about 50 times in the past couple years. I love breakfast, lunch, dinner, late night snacks, and drinks. It's basic American-style cuisine. If you're a total foodie looking for something unique, this isn't the place. But the food is great. It's consistent. The vibe is wonderful. I go here on dates, with my friends, and with family. LOVE LOVE LOVE.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners
text: The service was "you need us more than we need you," for some reason. Usually diners like this have better service. But if what you desire is massive portions and good value for the buck, then this is your jam. I chose an omelette for dinner, and was under-impressed. Admittedly, I'm used to the Northeast NJ diners in terms of quality, flavor, and execution.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Burgers, Nightlife, American (New), American (Traditional), Pubs, Gastropubs
text: We came here on a Saturday for dinner. The place seems popular as the tables were quite full both inside and outside. We started with the lobster bisque which was good, but quite heavy. Our entrees were french dip sandwich and sirloin steak. Both came out okay, nothing special. With so many choices on this street, I think we could have made a better choice.

place_category: Food, Bakeries
text: I tried ordering cookies using the chip app, when I got to checkout the screen displayed a message saying there was an error and the order could not be processed. But I was still charged for the cookies. Their posted hours say they are open until 2 am (it is currently 12:30 am) so I called the store and got a message that said I called after hours and then hangs up. So I got no cookies, couldn't get a hold of anyone at the store and was charged for my troubles... Not a great experience

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Mexican, American (New)
text: Ate here for lunch. One word to describe my food experience... "Confused". Had the chicken club and the husband had the Denver omelette. Two very common menu items but they were different. Service was good but not sure about the food. Just wasn't right for my taste buds. Lastly, if you're going to use the Axxess card, it is NOT buy one get one free! I only got $6.50 off. Think I will call Axxess to update them.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Bakeries
text: We visited Termini Bros as we toured Reading Market. The cannoli we ordered was very good. The pig ear pastry was bland, dry and hard to chew. A lot of other baked goods to choose from at Termini Bros. We would order the cannoli again but not the pig ear pastry.

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Salad, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Southern
text: Not impressed. First time there since the Splash influence. Food was well below expectations. Was better before. Won't be going back here...

place_category: Greek, Persian/Iranian, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Indian
text: When you first walk in the amazing smell of the food will knock you off your feet. Their nann is to die for and they have a decent selection of food. I loved everything about our experience there.

place_category: Food, Comfort Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Barbeque, American (New), Southern
text: We've tried this place several times and every time my food is cold when it comes to the table. I could chalk once or twice up to an off night but every time? There are definitely better places for bbq BUT the atmosphere and outdoor patio are basically outmatched by none. So if you're just planning on hanging with friends for drinks and convo a night on their patio by the fire place can't be beat.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Good food, pretty greasy, but surprisingly expensive. $16 for a standard cheeseburger fries and drink

place_category: Restaurants, Greek, Food, Desserts, Mediterranean, Salad
text: Normally we love this place! However...this time we ordered about 45 minutes before closing. I don't recommend. We got dried out/old fries. We got shorted pita in with my gyro plate. My side Caesar salad was super small. We are not pleased.

place_category: Irish Pub, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Irish, Pubs, Restaurants
text: Being in a hotel makes it hard to get to, and with almost no decent watering hole around it, it was almost a default for me after I was at the Convention Center this weekend. I enjoyed the craft beers they had on tap (with a major hop bias--unbalanced list, for sure), but the vibe was way to "bro" for me. Haven't tried the food yet.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Party & Event Planning, Event Planning & Services, Food, Desserts
text: My fiancé and I both tried the Salty Pimp. They put too much salt on my fiance's, his first bite was followed by coughs lol. So when they prepared mine I made sure to tell them when to stop with the salt. It tasted ok but it was alot, I couldn't eat it all and threw almost half of it away. I'm glad I tried it, I probably won't go back though.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Chinese, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Great food. Sucks otherwise, they don't give you chopsticks or any soy/duck/mustard sauce unless you ask. Who does that !? Also $20 card min

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: Wondering Santa Barbara downtown with my 2 Labrador dogs Friday evening I came up on a classy little Restaurant Basil's that had an open front patio. With superb service they provided fresh water and delicious garlic bread for us 3. I ordered the Angel Hair Pasta with fresh garlic, basil, and tomatoes and it was phenomenal! Ordered 2 draft IPA's too. I will spread the word to my hundreds of SB dog friends! 5 Stars no doubt

place_name: San Jose Mexican Restaurant Webster Groves
place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: We called in our order for curbside pick up and everything was ready when we pulled up 10 minutes later. Everything was hot and delicious. Our food was packed with care. We will be back soon for another order for pick up.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants
text: My go to Indian spot. The vindaloo is consistently fantastic, highly recommended. Really nice owner's and staff.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, Bars, Italian, Nightlife
text: I went twice, and I am overwhelmed how good the service is as well as the food! The first time I went I had the prime rib. It was juicy, Medium rare (just as I like it), and seasoned to perfection! I went yesterday (my second time) for a celebration of my year anniversary with my fiancé and I had the fish of the day. The dish was a butterflied rainbow trout with lumps of crab meat on top!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Tapas/Small Plates
text: ordered on groupon. nice platter combos and good for both lunch and dinner. amazing sushi & yaki udon! love the complimentary kimchi fries, the only thing bad was the mochi ice cream - the red beans ones were not soft.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: We had a party if 4 for a birthday. All adults. After we were seated all started well. Lighted menus were cool. One in our party had a piece of plastic in her water. Ok it happens. We ordered all different dishes recommend from our "server" we wind up sending back three of the dishes and one hors d'oeuvre. they credited the entire meal. all over cooked. NEVER AGAIN

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: I'm not exaggerating when I say this was the best pizza I've ever eaten (and that's saying something because I've had pizza in Rome and Florence). They are large slices and are thin with the "New York flop". It's not too greasy and they have a couple different types. I got the pesto/yellow tomato/mozzarella pizza and my husband had the pepperoni. I'm sad that I live out of state because if I was even remotely close, I would come here every other day.

place_category: Restaurants, Latin American, Cuban, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: Food is good but employees not following COVID-19 safety and health procedures whoever is in the shake station and drive-true without mask. Safety is responsibility of everybody. This place is open and there is many people inside business owners don't have control about the 6 feet distance and health safety control. I think the brainless quality needs to be checked from all the sides. Food is good bot there is not health and safety rules.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Fish & Chips, Restaurants, Cafes
text: I just thought I give them another chance!! So.. disappointed. My burger was all over the container, the bread was in a bath of oil. No flavor what so ever. Not the first time I ate there. Things changed with the new owners.. Last time I eat there..

place_category: Kitchen & Bath, Shopping, Restaurants, Furniture Stores, Nurseries & Gardening, Home Decor, Appliances, Home & Garden
text: I love Ikea's products but this store is a mess. I can't find anything that I'm looking for in this mess. I want to give you my money. Fix this. I hope no one pays to remove the review.

place_category: Delis, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Wraps
text: These sandwiches are massive! I had the corned beef and pastrami sandwich along with chips and drink. The food is good but it's not the best, plus it sorta took a while to get the order out to us. The place is small and there's no tvs. I wouldn't mind eating here again , but it ain't nothing I would "die " to eat .

place_category: Food, Pharmacy, Convenience Stores, Health & Medical, Shopping, Drugstores
text: Mainly I'm sick of waiting to get prescriptions. They've changed to 90 day prescriptions but there are less people working there now (my unofficial opinion). I'm going to look for another pharmacy. I had a good experience at Walgreens at Valley Forge and Main St but unfortunately my insurance doesn't like them. Too bad.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Salad, Restaurants
text: Very slow, one waitress and not friendly at all. Asked for three different kinds of beers and out of each finally fourth choice they had one. If you are in a hurry don't let the name express fool you, there is nothing express about this place.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Salad, Desserts, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Pubs, Food, Seafood, Bars, Fish & Chips
text: Maybe just an off night but leaving here disappointed. Service is slow. One of us got a burger (well done) and the other a patty melt (medium). But they mixed up the order so I got a dried out piece of meat. Took a loong time for them to recook the burger. Also had an exploding ketchup bottle. Ketchup everywhere. You'd think a manager would come over but no one in sight. One star. Can't imagine coming back.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Szechuan, Chinese, Seafood
text: After hearing great reviews from this restaurant we ordered take out and our experience was sub-par. We had the orange chicken and the chicken itself was dry and old, it had the texture of beef jerky. It was stringy and chewy. It was certainly old. Would not recommend.

place_name: The Blue Crab Restaurant & Oyster Bar
place_category: Seafood, Food, Salad, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Soup, American (Traditional)
text: The atmosphere here is great, but the service is very slow. It took us an hour to get our appetizer so that, by the time our main courses were ready, we were all full and had to take our food to go. So, needless to say, I can't really comment on the food because the only thing we had were the charbroiled oysters which were good, but a little oily

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Really disappointed. Pho broth was very bland, but had way too much cilantro. Could barely eat it because it was so overpowering. Also ordered a milk tea and the bottom had actual tea that hadn't been taken out all over the bottom and floating throughout so I couldn't even drink it. My infant had some of our noodles and both her and my husband were getting sick all night. Avoid if you want good Pho and milk tea.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: I was going to keep this to myself, because their lines are huge already, but what the hell. The place is amazing, everything is cooked fresh, the flavor is to die for, and sometimes the lines are insane. That is just a testament of how good the food is. Go try it.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Comfort Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Southern
text: Good food. Great prices. Has a little store you can shop in while you are waiting. Food seems a little healthier than just having a sandwich with fries.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: This is by far the best pizza in the area. Brick oven and very tasty. We love getting the special sodas there as a extra treat. Tony is so friendly. We usually get take out or delivery. I love this place!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: This place has a decent selection on the menu, and seems pretty good if you want Mexican and someone else doesn't, as they have burgers and the such. The salsa was very good, perfectly spicy. However I wasn't wowed by my entree. The beef tacos were bland and the enchilada was just not enjoyable at all. But it's a decent place to go if you can't get into Mi Nidito.

place_category: Lounges, Restaurants, Burgers, Bars, Vegetarian, Nightlife, Middle Eastern, Lebanese, Cocktail Bars, American (New)
text: Friends who live in the area love this restaurant and I have to agree. It was delicious. My lentil burger was outstanding as were the fries that came with it. My s'mores shake was ridiculous and I left feeling like I wanted to die (but in a good way... and I would have gone out happy).

place_category: Gastropubs, Cajun/Creole, Southern, Burgers, American (New), Restaurants
text: I am still in awe of my experience here. The hush puppies were absolutely amazing, I have never tasted anything like them before. The corn bread was the perfect texture, was delivered warm, and the honey melted right off the top. The burger had crispy bacon and a creamy sauce. The drinks were refreshing and the dessert with heavenly. I cannot wait to come back!

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Casinos, Hotels, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, Restaurants, Pet Services, Pets, Arts & Entertainment, Pet Sitting
text: I'm writing this review because I've been waiting to check in for more than 45 minutes and got bored. There's about 150 people waiting in line and only two employees doing the check in. What is management thinking here.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: I had a nice experience at Seahorse on the 4th of July weekend. My grouper sandwich was cooked to perfection and our waitress was a sweetheart. Unfortunately, the hostess wasn't the nicest. She told us we couldn't sit in a spot that was empty without any explanation. She was pretty rude about it. I'd visit the place again. Hopefully she won't be there.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Comfort Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Southern
text: Horrible! We have been to this Cracker Barrel before and the food WAS good but today the biscuits tasted like flour and the sawmill gravy was bland and cold. Never again !

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole
text: Had breakfast with a group of friends. While service might be described as a little slow we were not in a rush so it did not bother us. The food was excellent "home style" cooking. We are locals and we will definitely go back. They were setting up the weekend brunch buffet as we were leaving and we will absolutely go back for that.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Comfort Food, Diners
text: Great food here! The line to get in is SO LONG but it's definitely worth it. It sucks that it's cash only, but the eggs are cooked well and the ambiance of the restaurant makes it an awesome place to catch up with friends. I'm leaving this review short because I think this restaurant speaks for itself. If you're having a chill weekend and willing to enjoy some great food, this is a great place for you!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: We always have a pretty good experience coming here. I have noticed some recent reviewers have said otherwise. For us it's conveniently located and the food is pretty good. I do think there are better Mexican restaurants but for this area they do a good job. It is a small place but have a good amount of optio Hmmmm Kinda feeling a bit overcharged today.. $9 for this plain cheese quesadilla ..no rice no beans

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Horrible food and experience . The pizza was stale and burnt and the salad was obviously old. The delivery drivers vehicle was also dirty. I don't know how this place is in business

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Live/Raw Food, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: We went based on yelp reviews. My wife, daughter and I were not disappointed. Do not be discouraged by the strip mall location. I could easily have given Mt Fuji 5 stars because it was one of the best and most complete dining experiences I have had in a long time. By complete, I mean the high quality of the food, the excellence (and friendliness) of the service, and the value based on the cost. The dinner was a homerun on all three counts.

place_category: Salad, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Had lunch here today and it was A-OK. We all got the special (ind. Pizza, salads, and a drink). The pizzas were good and crispy. Like I said, it wasn't bad but it wasn't mind blowing pizza. I would stop by again if I lived in the area but I won't go out of my way to come here.

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Social Clubs, American (Traditional)
text: The Skyline Club definitely has one of the best views of the city. It showed promise with its interesting menu, but I was a little underwhelmed with what was presented to me. I think I am also a little spoiled by other places like The Capital Grille and Ruth's Chris. They did not lack in service however. Our waiters were very attentive and polite. Still worth a visit, especially if you're coming for Devour Downtown.

place_category: Bubble Tea, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Desserts
text: Good bubble tea spot! they also have a lot of other options. They have a green tea crêpe cake that looks really interesting. I ordered the taro bubble tea it was delicious and not too sweet but it could have used a more intense taro flavor

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food Trucks, Bars, Burgers, Nightlife, Chicken Wings, Chicken Shop, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Why? I ordered the Nachos from here before and they were delicious! I mean Bomb, thought I would treat myself again and what happened? I got the last of the tortilla chips for sure, didn't get the extra cheese I ordered. They were cold and the chicken was in large clumps. Everything was off. I am still forlorn because they were so good before. Yet they were so bad today that I threw them away. The disappointment was Real. Sorry Smoking Thighs but that was brutal. I don't think I will be back.

place_category: Nightlife, Mexican, Cocktail Bars, Food, Bars, Food Delivery Services, Tacos, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Service is so slow! But they one thing that will keep us coming back and possibly just to their walk up window is their bloody mary's are amazing! Also, their tacos are pretty big so the price tag of a taco can be alarming but they look like they seem to load them up. You can't be in a rush to go but grab a bloody and a taco to enjoy. The service will eventually make up for a star.

place_category: American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Terribly slow. Soooooo slow. I forgot that I waited for 20 minutes the last time we came through the drive through. That is, I forgot until our kids wanted the biscuits and after we ordered, we had to go park because they couldn't get it ready. My husband got tired of waiting and had to walk in to get it. Not really worth the wait.

place_category: French, Restaurants, Salad
text: Excellent small dining in this cozy little spot. The modern french fare was so good and its byob so it is good for the wallet. I will most definitely be back! So yummy and fresh. Great service as well. One waiter in the whole place and I never felt ignored great place. :)

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, Italian, Bars, Nightlife
text: Great food, decent service. Atmosphere is just ok but the food makes up for it. I think they're a little expensive for the quality you get but they're on par with other places like them. Menu is kind of limited but most dishes are tasty.

place_category: Brewpubs, Restaurants, Breweries, Beer Bar, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Pubs, Burgers, Pizza, Food
text: What a great place! This place was hoppin' on an early Saturday evening. Friendly and knowledgeable service staff, especially Chris, who really knows his beers and meads. Food arrived quickly and was very good. Lots of families were dining, and the bar was full. It is a loud and vibrant venue, which adds to the flare if this place. We will be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Diners
text: Maybe my expectations were too high after reading reviews. My husband got something with sausage gravy and eggs... he said the gravy didn't taste anything like sausage and the eggs slimy inside even though he asked for them well done. My eggs over medium were cooked well, home fries ok and toast drenched in margarine? French toast was decent and the kids liked the chicken fingers and fries. Our server was great. Probably won't be back though.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Southern, Comfort Food
text: The food is great and reasonably priced. There is always a wait which is good for them but just don't try to go there when you're in a rush. Definitely worth the wait though!

place_category: Chicken Wings, Fast Food, Restaurants, Chicken Shop
text: Went through the drive thru and ordered a famous bowl. The chicken was cold and cold unmelted cheese on top. Restaurant refuses to answer their phone to hear complaint. AVOID THIS LOCATION, CUSTOMER SERVICE IS PATHETIC!

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Mediterranean
text: I'm a regular, so this is a composite of several visits. The Pros: Fantastic build-out, great view of the pool and downtown waterfront, terrific fish tacos. Big selection of wines by the glass. The Cons: Side dining room can get REALLY loud, avoid sitting there if you can. Service is hit or miss, depending on staffing level and where you sit. Plastic glasswear is worn and foggy.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bagels, Cafes, Caterers, Coffee & Tea, Food, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants
text: I'm sitting in Caffeination as I type this. The whole purpose of this review was to comment on the rude baristas behind the counter...but it looks like that's already been covered. In any case it stands to be repeated...VERY BAD customer service. Gawd forbid you have a question about the menu here or else prepare yourself for an eye roll. Oh, also...I hope you like burnt toasted bagels and coffee. Cheers!

place_category: Burgers, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Seafood, Food
text: I grew up in New Orleans and now live in Seattle so don't get back often. Coming to Frankie and Johnny's is always on our to do list of places to eat at. Just had a dozen of their raw oysters and some boiled crawfish. Excellent. Oysters much better than those we had at Acme Oyster House. This is a traditional New Orleans neighborhood restaurant that still makes me glad I'm back in town.

place_category: Mexican, Fast Food, Restaurants, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: Run of the mill tex mex is about right. Did see a dead roach on the floor there once. Decent for what it is...the McDonalds of Tex Mex.

place_category: Cafes, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: My favorite brunch spot in Nashville! Black owned & has some awesome artwork! They change the art out frequently so every time you come it will be something new! The food is amazing!!! My absolute favorite is the strawberry pancakes but they're only available during summer months.

place_category: Restaurants, Pan Asian, Chinese, Asian Fusion, Nightlife, Bars
text: Stir crazy is a very nice Asian cuisine. Stir Crazy lives up to its name as an Asian restaurant while it is nothing extraordinary it is meant to just be an all you can eat serve yourself once not really all you can eat restaurant. While I can't say anything about their main courses I can say their sushi is amazing. Anyone who has a nut allergy I would be careful as a lot of their serve yourself stuff could be cross contaminated. (Make sure you avoid the shrimp)

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: Ehhh, I wanted it to be good since I was traveling for work and always try out new Thai places. The Pad Thai chicken barely had chicken and the noodles were super thick and chewy. I also got the fried rolls (can't remember if they were the spring ones or not, there are only two types of rolls and only one is fried) wayyyy to much cabbage in them for me to enjoy. Just my preference. Hope this helped!

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Nothing special. Good menu and some things are good, some are just ok. I'm not sure what other sushi options there are nearby but I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here. The atmosphere is quaint and it seems pretty clean. The service was 3 out of 5 stars. Oh, and keep in mind that its a byob.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Staff was super friendly, but it took 45 minutes to get overcooked eggs an oil soaked home fries.

place_category: American (New), Bars, Nightlife, Seafood, Burgers, American (Traditional), Steakhouses, Restaurants, Wine Bars
text: We tried FireBirds last night and I must say its a beautiful restaurant. We had a 70 minute wait so we sat at the bar and decided to try the wings based on other reviews. Probably some of the best wings we've ever had!!! The bartenders were great as well. I had the Blt salad with chicken and hubby had the salmon. The entrees were ok. Next time I think we'd try steak. If for nothing else, a great place to have drinks and apps!! Based on our experience, I'd give a solid 3.5.

place_category: Drugstores, Beauty & Spas, Cosmetics & Beauty Supply, Convenience Stores, Food, Shopping
text: I usually order my prints online come in and pick up but they are never ready at this location. Al ways an excuse.

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Fast Food, Burgers
text: Long ass line every time lol expect like a 20 minute wait at least. also they are skimpy on ingredients. Whether it's a blizzards or sundae, they barely put a tiny portion of ingredients with your dessert.

place_category: Bars, Music Venues, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (New), Karaoke, Arts & Entertainment
text: Fun time if you are looking for a date night. Something different and entertaining!

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Mexican
text: I came back here to have a goodbye dinner with a departing friend, and went back to my tried-and-true tuna ceviche. Though pricey, it was a significant portion and it definitely stood up to my experience from last time. Their complimentary chips and two salsas (one green, one red) are also fabulous and take the edge off the hangry pangs. Service was a bit on the slow side, but can't be too critical about that given that it was happy hour on a weekday.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Chicken Shop, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional)
text: I came here for breakfast one day and it wasn't my favorite. The chicken was heavily seasoned and it in my opinion it was a little plain. The tater tots were very good and the milkshakes were to die for. I wish I would have ordered something else other than the brunch chicken.

place_category: Sandwiches, Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: This is one of my favorite places to order from in Bristol area. The Brooklyn pizza is so good! Some other of my go tos are the white pizza with ricotta and the vodka rigatoni. Also, we get cannolis with every single order. Guilty pleasure. We've had some delicious paninis and steak sandwiches, and their waffle fries are really good. I highly recommend this place.

place_category: Bars, British, Pubs, Nightlife, Pizza, Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Don't get the eggs Benedict. It was so below average, not even worth the calories to eat it. The eggs were fried and not poached, no flavor, and very average it hurts. Wings are so goooooood though. So was the spinach artichoke dip and mushroom fries! Like the outdoor patio with umbrellas in the back and how there are sports playing inside. Friendly service and outside is good for groups. Could be tight inside for a lot of people.

place_category: Beer Bar, Nightlife, Wine Bars, Pizza, Restaurants, Bars, Pubs
text: We kept our order really basic - pepperoni pizza and some breadsticks. Atmosphere and service were fine, but my rating is based on the food. The pizza tasted like something I would buy frozen, not necessarily terrible...but definitely not restaurant quality. Breadsticks were lukewarm came with some nacho-ish cheese. Plenty of better pizza places in the area.

place_category: Mexican, New Mexican Cuisine, Restaurants
text: Perfectly serviceable Mexican food for the Indianapolis market, but nothing to write home about. The chips aren't homemade. The salsa is about a 6/10. The lunch menu is robust, and I ordered the Chori Pollo. The chicken wasn't very juicy but the chorizo helped the overall texture of the entree. The beans were pretty runny and they went pretty light on the pico. Rice was fine. Price was competitive to pretty much every other Mexican restaurant in the area.

place_category: Food, Brewpubs, Breweries
text: Awesome build out and great beer. Had a dry hopped blonde and a hefe that were completely on point. Have to get back for the dozen other beers I didn't get to try. Having food reliably on site is a nice touch, too.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: Great food every time, but the restrooms are always dirty and the wait staff is generally a little slow to refill drinks and check on us.

place_category: Street Vendors, Restaurants, Mexican, Food Trucks, Food, Seafood
text: This place blows doors on Tacobus, & all the other Mexican places I've been to here in Tampabay. Even better then places in Dover & Plant City. We are Mexican transplants from Monterey, Ca & has been hard to locate real Mexican not whitixican food

place_category: Pizza, Mediterranean, Desserts, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Italian, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Salad, Food
text: Gross! I have walked past this place several times and always wanted to give it a try. Well... 15 minutes ago I did. The pizza was SO greasy that the crust was just mush. I couldn't even hold it because it was sopping with grease. Even if I was able to get past this unappetizing sight, the taste was subpar. I had such high expectations, what a waste of $20. This is not how authentic pizza is made... I could have ordered Dominos and been happier.... THATS how bad it was...

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars
text: The beer selection is hit or miss. I wish the happy hour was half off drafts or something of that nature instead of just a select few beers. The servers are nice but the food service is slow. We got 2 flatbreads which were extremely small. We ordered the chicken pesto and flat iron steak sandwich which were both on soggy hoagie rolls both flavorless. Chimchurrie meatballs hard as a rock. Would come back for the drinks- but not the food.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: I wish I could give this a Zero, but i can't, it's literally the worst experience i ever had, I repeatedly have bad experiences with owner, I swear to god it's lucky that it's the only Baskin-Robin for miles or this place will actually be out of business.

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Brazilian, Restaurants
text: Partially disappointed. Reservation for 730, wasn't seated until after 8. Took 20 minutes to get a plate. Drinks were great, food was great, whenever it appeared. Service was really mediocre, kept getting the same server with the same selection over and over. Felt like we were invisible at times, almost to the point of waving our napkins to flag someone down. Might try to venture out to K of P from now on for Fogo.

place_category: Delis, Bagels, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches
text: Same menu as the original Bagel and Deli at Miami U in Oxford OH...the menu items are just named differently for the Central Indiana area. The food here is not well executed and definitely not as good as the original. Big departure from the quality customer service at the original as well. The young lady making the bagels was RUDE and was more interested in her phone than serving customers. Bad look all around. Yikes!

place_category: Bars, Seafood, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Fish and chips were kinda greasy. Nm better than a good Gordons fish stick dad said. The tap beer tasted skunky and warmish so we asked for a bottle of bud instead. gotta keep taps clean. The distributors know that but not always the people servicing the taps. Fingerprints on the window. Nice ambiance ig if you wanted to hangout for drinks with friends near the u of a.

place_category: Pizza, Bakeries, Food, Restaurants
text: Pizza is pretty tasty! Located in the farmers market. Everything is fresh, local and made-to-order. I liked being able to see them make it and pop it into the brick oven to see it come out 5-10 mins later. It is a very light pizza, sauce and cheese wise. A few more options would be nice to see!

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: I love Winn-Dixie and I use to love this location a lot. They have great deals and it's very convenient. However, today while checking out I seen a guy with his pet monkey. I've been told people bring there dogs in as well. I do not wish to shop in a grocery store with pets! I find it disgusting.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Comfort Food, Sandwiches, Chicken Shop, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: Chicken continues to be the best. Limited selection of sides at this location. Service was very friendly and helpful. The dining area is a bit dark as lighting canisters are limited and the configuration of the dining space is a bit tight too. Plenty of parking and the staff are friendly and efficient. Again, the chicken continues to be the whole reason for stopping. Fresh and tasty with the perfect balance of seasoning and rotisserie flavors in every bite.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Korean, Sushi Bars, Vietnamese
text: Sushi buffet is tighter than Mcdonalds with their chicken nuggets sauce. It is 5 orders maximum and then its like a 25 minute wait in between orders. Why even have a buffet option??!!

place_category: Seafood, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Mexican
text: I think that everybody in our group was for the most part satisfied but this definitely isn't anything spectacular. They did have live music but it was pretty packed and hard to maneuver around.

place_name: The Human Bean Garden City, W. State St
place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: They weren't open. I've had them before at another location and was very happy. I just don't understand why they were closed. I think there might be a sign posted, but I wasn't able to drive up, since they had a trash can blocking their drive thru.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Sandwiches, Bars, Nightlife
text: 77 degrees in there tonight. Was served warm beer to top it off. Enjoyed last time I was there but not so much tonight. Right now, don't think I will be back anytime soon.

place_category: Meat Shops, Food, Specialty Food
text: This place is the door south of Cartel Coffee on Broadway. It's hard to find your first time, but don't miss out on this place. The meat is excellent and the staff is great. I bought some dry aged steaks and sausages. I bought an American Wagyu dry aged and a dry aged steaks. These were expensive, but excellent steaks. The staff was super helpful and care about their craft. I checked out the dry aging area and it was a sight to see. If you're looking for great meat stop in.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Tapas/Small Plates, American (New), Restaurants, Vietnamese, Korean, Noodles, Ramen, Japanese
text: Our favorite date spot in the city, even if we are cramped together at the bar and slurping noodles. We've literally woken up in the middle of the night to plan our next Cheu date; that's how good the Ramen is here. We've tried most of the noodles on the menu and all were delightful, but I always go back to the standard miso. One of the few places in the city that deserves all of the hype and then some! Perfection.

place_category: Japanese, Vietnamese, Restaurants, Chinese
text: I've been going here for over ten years. I'm vietnamese so trust me when I say this is the best place to get pho in indy

place_category: Sandwiches, Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Vegan, Desserts
text: Mostly overpriced stuff. They do have good Banana Whips, but again overpriced. As a vegetarian I had hoped for a good meal option, but this is hard on my wallet and could definitely be cheaper for the amount.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Leonard, our barista, was awesome! Great service, big seating area and clean restrooms. This has plenty of parking off of De La Vina.

place_category: Breweries, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Every few years I go back to Sly Fox to try it again. This was the final straw, the food is fair and the beer is not even mediocre....I consider myself a beer connoisseur and I've never had a decent beer at Sly Fox. I have kept returning because I can't figure out how they've been able to remain open. Just pass on by and go to Victory if you want a good beer.

place_category: Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Italian, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food, Cafes
text: I don't get it .. place_category: American (New), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Burgers
text: My family and I were in the FQ needing a quick, no frills bite with our toddler, and desperately wanting to avoid all the tourist traps everywhere. The grill hit the spot- tasty, inexpensive. The servers were entertaining. Hit it up! They even hooked our son up with a chocolate milk shake we didn't ask for. It's a good thing we were on vacation or I would have sent it right back!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: It's ok. There are better options for vegan pizza in Tucson but this place is ok. They have Daiya cheese if you like that. I prefer no cheese (dairy or mock) on my vegan pizza. The crust is good, nice and crispy. There are a good amount of veggies to choose from too. The atmosphere isn't the greatest as in I wouldn't want to hang out there because it lacks ambiance entirely. The patio is nice if you want a quick bite and you are with your dogs.

place_category: Specialty Food, Seafood, Asian Fusion, Food, Sushi Bars, Soup, Nightlife, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Bars
text: I've eaten here four times. Sushi is pretty good but will break the bank. Other food ranges from OK to pretty good. It's nothing special and who do they think they are fooling on the prices. Way overpriced.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Salad, Chicken Wings
text: It baffles me as to how Rusty's gets "best pizza in santa barbara" every year by the independent. This pizza is average at best. Their salad bar is worse than sizzler. it looks like everything in their salad bar is canned. Their pizza is super greasy with canned toppings. I live about 2 blocks from Rusty's and I avoid it like the plague. I once had a torpedo sandwich and felt nauseous afterwords. I eat pretty healthy, so maybe if you eat a lot of fast food, you can handle the sandwich.

place_category: Japanese, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Ramen, Restaurants
text: Amazing food. Friendly staff. Food preparation time isn't long at all. Great music selection. Hip style. I can not get enough of this place! I recommend everyone try this place out!

place_category: Burgers, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional)

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food

The burger was a squashed mess and is nothing like what is represented on the adds for the establishment. The dining area and the restroom is dirty. This place needs management.

place_category: Pizza, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Burgers, Restaurants

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: Got off a cruise and headed straight here en route to airport with luggage and all. Ordered pho and spring rolls. Its pho and spring rolls.. tasted fine, just nothing special.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: I went to Four Rivers because someone told me they had excellent Pad Thai. I didn't think twice about how this is Thai dish and Four Rivers is in the heart of Chinatown. But I should have this it's not even on the menu. So instead of getting Pad Thai, I ordered the Eggplant with Black Mushroom & Bamboo Shoot. But my take-out order had Chinese Black Mushroom & Bok Choy instead. Since I really like Bok Choy, I didn't mind the change up. And the dish was very good.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Called ahead to check the wait on a Sunday and we decided to go. Walked 2 miles and when we got there an employee told us that their computers were down and they would seat us. We offered to pay cash including the tip and were told that wasn't possible. We offered to leave one of my credit cards and would come back later to pick up when their computers were up but we were still denied. People were eating there so I'm not sure what was going on.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: We went here on a weekend night. We did not have to wait for a table. Our server was excellent She did a great job. The restaurant is noisy. It is tight on seating and can get a bit loud. The wine was good. The pizza was delicious. The dessert was frozen in the middle. I don't think it was made in house.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Burgers, American (New), Restaurants
text: Nothing special here. Food is typical IHOP fare / quality which isn't very good, but it's tough to mess up a pancake. Place is new, but aging quickly due to the outdated corporate design. Servers are very pleasant and attentive. You know what you're going to get so set your expectations appropriately and you won't be disappointed.

place_category: American (New), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Bakeries, Coffee & Tea
text: We both ordered Benedicts - his: original with crispy bacon instead of Canadian bacon, hers: lobster - both came with a potato hash that was delicious. The lobster Benedict was buttery and flavorful and they didn't scrimp on the lobster. He ordered a dirty chai (we've had better) and I ordered a vanilla latte that was just the right amount of sweet. We both left full but not overly stuffed. Would absolutely recommend and visit again! Yum!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: I dined here for the first time on Friday. We had an excellent experience. Prices were a little higher than expected but the food and service were great. Different menu choices than our other local Mexican restaurants. I will definitely go here again.

place_category: Food, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Caterers, Smokehouse, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Being new to St. Louis, I wanted to try the best BBQ that St. Louis had to offer. Bogart's was recommended to me and it did not disappoint. The ribs were tender and falling off the bone with just the right amount of smoke. I didn't even add any sauce. I will definitely be back for more!!

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: We gave Yummy House South a 2nd chance. And we are glad we did! What a great meal my wife and I had. 1st time around the atmosphere seemed cold and we weren't prepared for them not having wine. This time we found a cozy corner spot and byob. The service was impeccable. We recommend the special wonton hot and sour soup with homemade wontons! Also the pork fried rice and Anything pepper and salt like the sizzling beef. There's enough to share and bring home to enjoy later.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: I'm a fan! First time here and I had an excellent experience. The fries and burger were delicious. The server was nice. Only reason I give it a four is it is not anything special. While I enjoyed it, I don't think I will ever CRAVE it. The fries were perfectly well done even though they do not appear to be.

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Event Planning & Services, Wine Bars, Bars, Gastropubs, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces

Service wasn't bad, took a bit longer to wait on us (table of 6) but food came out accordingly. The location in Boston is just as good.

The staff and management were phenomenal, Barbareno exceeded our expectations! Thanks Jesse for being a great host.

place_category: Nightlife, Tex-Mex, Bars, Restaurants, Mexican

text: Like other's have said it's McDonald's and not a five star experience. Having said that what they do excel at is fast relatively cheap food. They do however tend to be a bit slower than other fast food places in town. The food is the same we get at any McDonald's.

place_category: Restaurants, Soup, American (New), Seafood, Salad, Italian
text: I'd been looking forward to going here for quite some time. I was not impressed. The staff was ok, and the restaurant lovely, but the food was not worth the $180 the 3 of us paid. I don't get the hype.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Wine Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Restaurants, Southern, Cocktail Bars, Food Delivery Services, Seafood
text: This place is great. Their atmosphere is beautiful (best place to sit is out in the courtyard). Loved their creole french onion soup, their jumbo shrimp and the oysters. To top it off, they gave us a big discount when they found out we were evacuees from Hurricane Irma. The service was awesome.

text: First time here and asked the deli server which sandwich he would recommend, he suggested the popular Hot Italian Sandwich, amazing! Excellent balance of ingredients and the Nutella Tart was a delicious compliment.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Pizza
text: Consistently awful service. Here's just one example: called in for delivery, it took OVER an hour and 15 minutes. When we finally got our food, the order was wrong. I called once I noticed the missing food and asked that it be taken off our bill. The guy insisted we were never charged for those items. Not only did he mess up the order, the food was late, and he had the nerve to argue with me over the phone. Not once did he apologize! NEVER AGAIN. Avoid this place like the plague.

place_category: Breweries, Pubs, Bars, Restaurants, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Nightlife
text: Convenient to a couple hotels, but even then, there are other choices that will make you happier. Like other critical reviewers, I will echo that this place is not German-themed and not special in any other (good) way. Guinness was stale, pretzels and pizza were highly processed, previously frozen. And everything was expensive to boot. If it didn't have a nearly captive audience from the hotels, it wouldn't survive.

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Caribbean, Latin American, Bars
text: The ambiance at this restaurant is amazing. No expense was spared during construction. It appears that Paladar is trying make healthy Latina fare. The queso fundido was dry, not melted enough to place on chips. The black bean soup was also dry. The chicken empanadas were al horno instead of fried. They lacked flavor. Latina fare and healthy do not go well together..Latina fare is supposed to be bold and flavorful.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: So I normally do not like Chinese food. In San Diego, the meat is gelatin grossness. But this place uses chicken breast meat in its Yen Ching chicken and the ham fried rice was delish. Also, the crab Rangoon tasted like crab and not just sugary cream cheese like it does in California. St Louis Chinese food is where it's at...

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Delis, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Italian
text: I came in on a very quiet Saturday evening. It was just me and another table dining in. This is going to be a very brief review. we ordered: -stuffed jalapenos -chicken parmesean -seafood platter (my french fries came out cold though) It was a decent dinner. For the price you pay, the portions are very huge! We ate a little bit of everything and it still looked like we didn't touch our dishes. I don't find myself making my way to Metairie just to dine here though.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Whiskey Bars, Burgers, Restaurants, American (New)
text: By far the best value in Philly (in my opinion). The burgers are as good as it gets. The fries are always perfect. And you have all the Scotch and Whiskey you can handle. Oh yeah, the staff is always super friendly.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: This is on par with a chain. Server didn't clear our appetizer plates until asked twice. When our food came instead of setting out food down in front of us they handed it to the end of the table and made us pass it to each other. In a city of amazing food there is nothing special about this place

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Vegetarian
text: Amazing food!!!! I find myself describing the taste like a food critic. Ì you are in the area, you have to come here. Reservation is only accepted for parties of 5 or more. The missing star is due to the super tight sitting configuration. My husband kept getting hit by the wait staff.

place_category: Food, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Insanely delicious ice cream with fun seasonal flavor to try. I love to get the mini scoops of five to be able to taste a ton of different flavors. The staff is also super nice and helpful

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: We used to go to Las Palmas all the time. Recently we went and the menus completely changed. The food was smaller and service was not very good. Las Palmas has officially become too commercialized and has ruined its charm and great tasting food. Charging extra for some sauce to be on the side instead of on top of the food. We will be taking our monthly date nights to El Stuffed Pepper from now on.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Of course the view is awesome being right on the water and we did enjoy our lunch but our server was so overwhelmed with tables that it took entirely too long for everything. We had a party of four and overall the food was ok. the clam chowder were amazing and highly recommended. The prices were decent but I feel there are better choices along the boardwalk.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Service has always been good from day one, but the last few times we eaten here it seems as they are using the microwave to heat things. The burrito was bland and soupy. The chicken tacos were good though.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Desserts, Food, Hot Dogs, American (Traditional)
text: An overall good experience. A wide variety of burgers available to choose from. I have not had a bad burger there. That being said, you pay for the atmosphere and service. It is nice that they serve you and occasionally come by to help, but never enough to really be considered a waitress. If you have kids, the hand washing station is really cool (even if you don't have kids but are a kid at heart, it is pretty cool). I would recommend people to try it.

place_category: Italian, Cuban, Restaurants
text: I got a reservation on a whim. What a whim it was. This place is fantastic. We both ordered the tasting menu. Our server, Bill, kept delicious food coming with impeccable timing for roughly three hours. This place is expensive but if you have a few dollars to blow and want to have a superior dining experience, this could be one of the best across America! Thank you Vetri staff, our night was incredible.

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Breweries, Restaurants, American (New), Pizza
text: Just a generic experience all around. Nothing about going to BJ's feels like you're having any experience that is genuine. The food taste microwave and the ambience is very commercial. Just OK. I wish it was better. It's become very commercialized throughout the years.

place_category: Halal, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern
text: 10-21 stopped in for a late lunch. Lamb gyro platter and a small chicken platter . The gyro meat looked dark and old, but it tasted flavorful and savory- YUM. The chicken platter was similarly good and it was the small size. The portions were large and my wife and I both had leftovers. Service was friendly, expedient and the store is conveniently located right down the road. Great value!

place_category: Vegan, Cheesesteaks, Restaurants, Vegetarian, Sandwiches
text: If I could give negative stars to this place, I would. Ypu couldn't PAY,me to ever eat hete again.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Fast Food, Chicken Shop
