place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Wings are Awesome. Not kidding, the best I've had in years. Otherwise the food is fine. Lots of TVs and have been able to change it to whatever game we wanted all three times I 've been. The service was good the first two times, but the third was a bit annoying. One of the servers sat in the corner watching the Kardashians at a volume louder than the game that we were watching. Kids are welcome but sometimes smoke wafts over from the bar. Overall a good place.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: best cracklin in the GNO (though what is that really saying?). Nice, subdued drive-up location for seafood. I don't know what the address is actually listed as, because it's not where Yelp tells you to go. This is at the entrance to Mel Ott Park (you'll find it faster)

place_category: Burgers, Fast Food, American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, Tacos
text: Yuck! First and last time I'll ever eat here. Ordered the Buttery Jack burger. It was greasy and the cheese was hard. I ate most of it because it had been 8 hours since breakfast but I felt sick and queasy the rest of the evening.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife
text: THE BEST AND CHEAPEST RESTAURANT AROUND THATS FOR SUREE!!! They have really good cooks and big portions of food! If I could give them 10 stars I would never disappointed in this place!! I try to come at least once or twice every two weeks!!

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: My boyfriend and I ate here last friday night before a show. We were a little worried when we walked in at 7pm and we were the second customers in the room. Turned out to be delicious! The waiter was purely italian, singing along with the music as he sat down our food. Make sure to get there after 6:30pm or you can't park close :)

place_category: Food, Seafood Markets, Seafood, Specialty Food, Restaurants
text: Staff is not nearly as nice as the Midcity location. A little sassy when I asked how fresh the crawfish were/when the next batch would be coming out. This is something you want me to know, as I live two blocks away and will buy crawfish from you 1-2 times per week if you let me in on when I can get hot crawfish. Also no special daiquiris.

place_category: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Restaurants, Food
text: Slow!!!! One car in the drive through, expect a twenty minute wait. They will get something wrong in the order which is funny because McDonalds corporate should have systems in place by now (been in business almost 100 years) that prevent any human errors and speed things up. Parking lot looks trashy, weeds everywhere and overfilled trash cans. They should bulldoze it and put up a new store.

place_category: Food, Comfort Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Barbeque, American (New), Southern
text: Poor service is their downfall. The building is great! The chicken in a biscuit is good. They charge tourism prices. Great patio.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: The carne asada tacos were alright, but sadly they didn't stay warm in the takeout containers and the prices were a little steep for what we got. The tacos were slightly greasy but the additional veggies on the side were appreciated. It wasn't great, but it wasn't terrible.

place_category: Buffets, Seafood, Chinese, Restaurants
text: Adding a note. We went today, a Saturday. Lunch for two people was $32.00. It is the "weekend adult buffet" [seafood leftover from the week], not necessarily bad, just know what you are signing up for. We are very unlikely to come on a weekend again. Also I understand the possible language barrier, I don't speak any asian languages...smiles however, are universally translated.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Had lunch on Memorial Day. The meal was disappointing in all respects: the miso soup was tepid, the salad wilted and the chicken teriyaki was chewy and flavorless. The sauce served with the rice was so salty it was inedible. It is clear the management does not care about customer satisfaction. Avoid!

place_category: Salad, Coffee & Tea, Bagels, Food, Bakeries, Soup, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I like Panera. Their food is consistently good and their restaurants are always clean. However, I do not like that they are now VERBALLY asking customers if they want to tip the staff. This is a bit confusing, as the employees are not wait staff. Therefore, are they expecting a tip for simply doing their job?

place_category: French, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Cocktail Bars
text: If I could give 6 stars I would! Absolutely exquisite food and perfect service. My husband began with ceviche of hamachi which was sublime. Rabbit stew was over the top; rich with array of root vegetable. Cheese plate was yummy. This is the 2nd time we had Steve as our server and he is terrific. All the real foodies and regulars get the Chefs menu. That included scallop, hanger steak, foie Grois, and dessert. The next time we will do that!

place_category: Burgers, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Nicely remodeled restaurant with the usual Wendy's menu. The staff is polite enough and they show much less of that 'I don't give a flying f*@k' attitude that you might generally be used to in New Orleans fast food joints. One major problem, though: -they can't seem to(or, try to)keep out the homeless crowd. Each time I'm there the restroom is taken over by some bum changing, freshening up or just doing #2. Or, all of the above. Not good.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants, Bagels, Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches
text: My order was incorrect despite the receipt showing the correct order. There were several other customers waiting and complaining about the order process. We ordered ahead and was ignored for awhile while trying to pick up our order.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I was too hungry to cook, or think, or make any decisions and it was late--luckily, according to yelp Oscar's was open and according to my GPS it wasn't too far away. I picked the beef taco and a chicken enchilada, plus guacamole and salsa. It was great guacamole and salsa, and I loved the taco. The enchilada was good, but I should have ordered another taco (after all, it is a taco shop). Clean, cheap, and open late. Good stuff!

place_category: Food, Thrift Stores, Local Flavor, Antiques, Fashion, Shopping, Farmers Market
text: Stopped in thought it was a good old fashioned flea maker No way nothing but junk and knock offs booth after booth Dirty looking something's look as if they been there for years Food booths look dirty friend bought pretzel hard as a rock right in trash can Never ever again

place_category: Italian, Soup, Salad, Restaurants
text: Super nice people but food was okay but nothing to die for. We were referred here by a friend and had high hopes but were disappointed.. We had some minor concerns with sanitizing between clients. The restaurant had a cool Italian vibe and a cool vibe unfortunately the food was just average. I think they www hindered by the pandemic and hope they figure things out.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Mongolian
text: Ate there yesterday, over priced, they mixed up our meals. Do not recommend!! No choice in sauces.

place_category: Italian, Food, Nightlife, Pizza, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants
text: two visits here... still not a big fan of all the food items, though the pizzas are quite good. i like the atmosphere and the attentiveness of the staff, but it's not my first choice of places to take a date. next visit will probably be in the spring. they do have an excellent location with a view on the river...

place_category: Restaurants, Buffets, Southern
text: Great buffet of southern favorites. Green beans, collard greens, fried chicken, etc. great service.

place_category: Mexican, Tex-Mex, Restaurants
text: Love the shrimp fajita quesadillas they pile the shrimp on also the margaritas and chips and salsa are great anything you get fajita style is always tremendous

place_category: Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Dance Clubs, Bars, Music Venues, Mexican, Sports Bars
text: I love this place. It has always been one of my favorite ways to start off a night out. The drinks are great, although the service is often slow. The crowd is young and not quite as trashy as many other bars in sb. The atmosphere contributes to the pleasant vibes.

place_category: Italian, Soul Food, Sardinian, Calabrian, Restaurants, Southern
text: Do not get the seafood pasta. It was extremely fishy (even for Midwest seafood) and unappetizing. Service was very rushed, in a way that felt somewhat rude.

place_category: Desserts, Food, Coffee & Tea, Specialty Food
text: I really don't want to wait 5 minutes while 2 employees figure out how to clock in and 2 other employees chat waiting for nothing. Just rude!! It's an airport and people are usually in a hurry. Get you customer service ON!!! Just a big disappointment!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Acai Bowls, Food, Vegan, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Soup, Vegetarian
text: The people who work here are super lazy. I ordered a sandwich with no tomato to eat here. They handed me a sandwich out of the cooler that's been sitting there for who knows how long and it has tomatoes on it. How lazy can you be? Never coming back here again.

place_category: Restaurants, Hawaiian, Seafood, Barbeque
text: Good food, good service. But they were very stingy with the gravy on our roast pork and loco moco . Don't they know it's ALL about the gravy. We got it to go and didn't see how little gravy there was until we got home. That's soy sauce on the rice not gravy

place_category: Restaurants, Falafel, Fast Food, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Halal, Greek
text: Excellent HUGE gyros, and fantastic customer service. The owner was so personable and friendly.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Pizza, Restaurants, Dive Bars, Seafood
text: Nice upscale dive bar. Patrons are always a pleasure to talk to and are usually different people evrytime I have been there. Rare mix of bar food. Get everything a good pizza joint would offer PLUS some of the best seafood in the area. Excellent Juke Box with tons of great songs. Bar staff is always attentive and easy on the eyes;) Great place to kick back and just enjoy whatever the night brings you.

place_category: Sports Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: Your personal safety as well as financial safety are at risk when patronize this establishment. The bartender was asked to provide a detailed receipt for charges and she refused and became verbally aggressive. She proceeded to follow the group out of the bar and was threatening physical violence Someone else from inside the bar had to restrain her. This is all after the bill was paid( and she was tipped.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Lounges, Asian Fusion, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: A nice option for sushi in Midtown. The space is big, so very accommodating for large groups. I went with several friends and we all enjoyed the sushi rolls. I appreciate that the selection isn't overwhelming, but instead features a solid list of rolls that address everyone's sushi preferences. Service was friendly and attentive.

place_category: Music Venues, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Local Flavor, Bars, Cuban, American (Traditional), American (New)
text: Great brunch, great price and the champagne keeps coming! When I go I just go for the seafood and champagne and stay a few hours to ensure I'm getting my money's worth.

place_category: Restaurants, Bagels, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bubble Tea, Donuts
text: This place is definitely worth the 5 minute drive out of the downtown area. There are many different kinds of bagels/cream cheese and made to order breakfast sandwiches available and a ton of amazing donuts - all delicious! We will be returning here every time we are lucky enough to visit Santa Barbara. Thanks Joy!!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: I was so disappointed! I ordered the chicken special (some chicken and spicy mayo sauce on top of flatbread), and got a tiny open faced sandwich type of dish that was about the size of a small sub at Subway. It cost $18, which is absolutely outrageous for such a tiny dish! It tasted decent, but not amazing, which made it even worse.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Love this place! The feel: is almost like you're at home, there is a mix of furniture and there are books out for people to read. there is internet and I have seen people doing homework there. The experience: I have had the White and Black, iced Chai latte and sipped a friends coffee- all were tasty. They cover the hot to-go coffee lid openings with adorable little stickers so you won't spill. Also- they have a drive in! Love supporting local when I can and everyone there is super sweet.

place_category: Food Delivery Services, Burgers, Pizza, Food, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Great food most of the time. They are a little $$$ but over all I enjoyed there food. But the fries are not good. Would love some good fries and better cheese for the cheese fries. Try the meat ball grinder oh my god it's the best I ever had

place_category: Sandwiches, Barbeque, Restaurants, Food
text: First time customer, service was fast but pulled pork sandwich was lightly packed for 5.49... Little sauce on meat, sandwich was dry. Coleslaw was good and the roll was good. Portions need to be larger for prices charged. Disappointed don't think this place will last long if they dont step up the quality and quantity.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Tea Rooms, Bubble Tea
text: I like their milk tea, but their service is suck ! It takes forever to have a drink! They just leave it there even I order online 25' ahead of time.

place_category: Seafood, Poke, Food, Restaurants, Hawaiian
text: Fresh seafood Great and fast service Amazing bowls creation If you looking for a great poke bowl This is the place to go

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Pizza, Tapas/Small Plates, Bars
text: We had our first pizza from here and loved the Covid free pick up window. They have outside eating but it was full, looking forward to going back

place_category: Bagels, Food
text: Freshest whitefish, thin sliced nova & fabulous cream cheese on the best bagel ever. Perfect Birthday breakfast! Oh, and the staff is pretty nice too. Thanks for gracing Philly with your presence, Bart's Bagels!

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I came with my family and look so great this place, the food was so good! Only the American coffee that wasn't good. Maybe if they will have cortaditos or cafe con leche that's gonna be awesome! I recommend this place

place_category: Real Estate, Venues & Event Spaces, Food, Home Services, Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Specialty Food, Creperies, Shared Office Spaces, Wedding Planning
text: This location is *goals*. I love the brick. It gives a cozy but modern vibe to things. I love that it shares a space with Ash & Elm. As far as actual product, I was let down. I got a cold brew and it was very acidic, I didn't even drink the whole thing. The one thing I expect with cold brew is smoothness. My husband got a drip coffee and it was decent. It actually got better as time went on. I really want to try this place out again and try something new. It has such promise!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Nightlife, Asian Fusion, Bars, Restaurants, Lounges
text: Nice interior, good atmosphere and friendly knowledgeable staff. Sisters and I ordered 3 different martinis at happy hour...all different flavors but they seemed to taste very similar to one another. Sushi was decent but definitely overpriced. The sweet and spicy edamame was a favorite at our table over the ninja bacon. The filet kabob was nothing special at all for $15...no real flavor to it. In all I would return after I had exhausted other options.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Cafes
text: Love the space, very relaxing! Had a Costa Rican pour over, it was very smooth and tasty. Cheers!

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Good people, great food. This place is worth a visit. Sometimes they get busy but are usually very accommodating. The outside patio is awesome and the bar has a great feel. Million dollar burger is the bomb and they usually have 3 craft IPA's on tap.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Bars, Music Venues, Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: when calling to ask about calendar of events, girl on the phone was completely rude and unhelpful. she sounded drunk and came of lazy.... i now assume thats how all the employees will be and do not want to experience such people.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: We will not be going back food was bland and my hash browns tasted like fish. Don't even get me started about the so called pancake, that needed like 4 cups of sugar in the recipe. They also charge 6 dollars for a cup of orange juice.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Food is great but service needs to improve. Wait time is sometimes too long!

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Decent food, but really small portions for the money. Ordered grouper dinner and lobster tacos dinner, $19 each. Picture attached, food gone in 5 minutes, needed 2nd dinner.

place_category: Pizza, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Salad, Fast Food
text: Waited for 2 hours to get a online ordered pizza I could have done it in 10 mins if I stood in line The don't care about online orders as if they are giving it for free I highly recommended avoid this lazy workers place If you wanted to experience their lazy working style try their direct order not online orders Good Job Blazin

place_category: Burgers, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Pizza was good but 10.99 is a little high. We ordered wings (8 in an order) and they were very very small. 8.99 way to high. we ordered a side of fries $5 bucks. wont be back for a while.

place_category: Nightlife, Local Flavor, Food, Bars, Dive Bars, Pubs, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: OK I cant give this lower stars BC it meets all the criteria for a dive bar: kinda-rude & no f**KS given bartender (think Moe from Simpsons), heavy smoking, old-timer's who are regulars, cash-only, & cheap-ass beer. I can't complain BC I knew what I was getting into when I came in here.

place_category: Mediterranean, Restaurants, Greek
text: Tasty, delicious & reasonably priced Greek food. Went w/a group & we all thoroughly enjoyed the experience.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Italian, Restaurants, American (New)
text: food is way to expensive for this place. decor in main dining is grandmaish. its not the quality isnt good, i just dont think that they have found their niche for their type of restaurant. they mix too many flavors for meals that could be good; so it makes you not really want to pick anything. I would stick w/ simple appetizers or get the steak (the house steak sauce amazing). also drinks and customer service excellent.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes
text: Not bad for the price. Should get some nicer waitresses. Very good coffee. But the potatoes could do with less dusting. And wash those spudes. Had some on my last visit and had dirt on them. Not good! Watch they charge more on weekends. Not good. Same greasy food as during the week.

place_name: The Blue Crab Restaurant & Oyster Bar
place_category: Seafood, Food, Salad, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Soup, American (Traditional)
text: Aside from them forgetting to put our appetizer order in, it was really great food. We had stuff crab, home style fries, and jalapeño hush puppies, and the fish of the day: Red Snapper blackened with a lemon butter cream sauce, with boiled potatoes and corn. All of the food was cooked perfectly! The fish was A-Mazing!!! The corn and potatoes were super spicy. Regardless we will definitely come back! Oh and the drinks are super stiff!

place_category: Indian, Restaurants
text: DELICIOUS!! I went for dinner and went back the next day for lunch!! Soooo yummy!! I will definitely visit this place every chance I'm in Reno .. good service too! The owner and manager came out to ask me how was the delicious food! Omg their naan is amazingly good! I got the cheese & garlic naan, chicken tikka, and lamb saag

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, Nightlife, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Burgers
text: We ordered a cheeseburger and an Asian salad for Uber Eats delivery at 8:30. The restaurant is about a mile from our house. Estimated delivery time was 9:10 PM. I followed the progress of the order so I know it wasn't the driver's fault that the order didn't arrive until 9:30 PM. And the salad was mostly noodles and cabbage with very little lettuce. Very disappointing experience.

place_category: Food, Breweries
text: Amazing beers; meads, ciders, ales, saison, stouts, porters, IPA's. Food (not run by them) is awful. The used to have Italian and now it's dive bar food. Meat on nachos was so super salty and looked made by my kiddo. Location not great either.

place_category: Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Persian/Iranian
text: My wife and I returned to this place for another delicious meals. However, this time we were not so pleased with overall experience. My wife ordered kabobs with beef steak and chicken and she received both beef instead. I ordered Shereen Polo with Jasmine rice and mine came with orange and carrot rice instead. The service we received from Helia was just OK. She wasn't attentive and did not take the correct order from us or did not verify the meal we ordered.

place_category: American (New), Breweries, Food, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Gastropubs
text: I wish I could give it 5 stars because they do have fantastic beer! However, ordering food can be a bit inconsistent. Overall the food is good, but we've hit a few snags with over-cooked items or the kitchen taking forever (even before Covid). However we do love this location and the atmosphere and will keep returning! If you are a fan of pumpkin beer, they have one of the best I've ever had (only during fall).

place_category: Lounges, Burgers, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Sushi Bars
text: Drinks are bomb here. They are usually very good, unique, but also pricey. Every time I've had food here, it has been great. The service is extremely slow but at least they're friendly. The restaurant is EXTREMELY LOUD due to the blasting music. Like you have to scream with your table.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Buffets, Food, Sushi Bars
text: We ate here last week while in town for the Women's Final Four. Great variety in their rolls. Nice friendly staff - in fact I was given some jasmine tea to take home with me. Really liked the cucumber roll and roll with the strawberries. I've never had dessert sushi before. This place was worth the trip.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Pubs, American (New)
text: Here's the issues keeping Johnnys from Bering a 5*. Warm beers with an inexcusable inability to keep an updated tap list (literally every time you're there no one has a clue what's currently on tap), & wait times for food are 25 minutes on average even with an empty restaurant. Fix the small details & you've got a great place for Sunday football or a Friday night hire

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Dive Bars
text: I was told this is a secret place for a great cheesesteak in Philly...lunch is really crowded I've heard,dinner time isn't too bad. They have cool breakfast type sandwiches also. But I think we got charged like $10 apiece for a vodka & pineapple. And not gonna ask why they only accept cash. But the other thing is the bathrooms have kind of been looking rough for awhile. Aside from that things are pretty chill.

place_category: Restaurants, Bagels, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts
text: Amazing bagels , divine cream cheese, yummy home made cookies and great service ! They couldn't have been any nicer ! Will be back !

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food
text: The new renovations make this place (intentionally?) uninviting to those who wish to do some work there and it is an overall change for the worse. The new tables are tiny, so one could not use a laptop and book of notes at the same time (not even close). I miss the old tables. Maybe they wanted to get rid of the student crowd?

place_category: Tacos, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Mexican
text: Honestly, for all the fast food I don't eat, I don't mind the occasional Taco Bell. This location is refurbished and very clean - which is about as high a compliment as you're going to give a Taco Bell, aside from "No one here licked my taco shells."

place_category: Chinese, Japanese, Asian Fusion, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Got sick with food poisoning from the salmon sashimi. I ordered a tuna handroll, got a tuna roll with a side cucumber handroll... NOT what i ordered. The fish was so sour, i could only eat one bite of each. The check took forever to come. I LOVE sushi and i HATED the fish here... im still sick from it. HORRIBLE experience will NEVER go back! This place RUINED my trip to New Orleans.

place_category: Bars, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Nightlife
text: The food was great, the service was poor. It was a rainy not all busy Saturday. There were maybe three other tables of people. Our server was pleasant just not good at her job. She spent all lot of time chatting with the bartender and wasn't attentive to the tables, no refills etc. The drinks are always strong and delicious however! The one thing that definitely needs to be looked into is how slippery the floor is. I'm not sure how someone hasn't gotten hurt yet.

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants, Cheesesteaks
text: Good stuff "wiz wit" I left with a full belly and plan on coming back soon. Very efficient and COVID friendly

place_category: Tacos, Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Fast Food, Mexican
text: They have really good birria tacos. Sonoran dog was ok. Kids liked the bean burrito and burger.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: They have recently changed their rice and it's not good. Tried twice over the last couple months and both times was disappointed. Food was amazing and this was our go to spot but will not be back due to the rice

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Nightlife, Creperies, French, Bars, Gluten-Free, Desserts
text: The Creperie is a nice restaurant with great service. It was a little dark for my liking, and the hanging partitions kept banging around, but it wasn't too awful. Unfortunately, I did not get to eat anything from the regular menu, but a custom menu made for our large group (great accomadations for large groups, btw). My crepe contained chicken with barbeque sauce, which I did not find very exciting. I would definitely return to try something else.

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Chicken Wings, Sports Bars, Restaurants
text: Good servers, good deals and lots of sports, but the music is loud and crazy (do we really want to listen to screaming while we eat?), and the thermostat seems to be set at 40 degrees.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches
text: Coffee is questionable. The people behind the counter are really nice though- and they remember you and are good folks to converse with. The hangover hoagie is, surprisingly quite good and deserving of the status it has achieved. Like a gourmet version of a sandwich you get from a cart in center city.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Seafood, Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, American (Traditional), Bars, Tiki Bars
text: Server was great.... that's the only positive... food took over an hour after we placed our order....shrimp was WAY over cooked... lobster Mac n cheese was luke warm and more like soup. Will not be going back and will not recommend.

place_category: Wine Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Steakhouses, Seafood, Bars
text: Wayyyy overpriced, and service was horrible. Everything from drinks to apps & all was outrageously priced. Don't get the creme brûlée please.. it was an egg omelet.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Luzzara is a gem. Unlike most other places in town, you can expect an interesting conversation when you stop by here (although don't stop by expecting to get some work done like in other coffeeshops). It's a refreshing change from the impersonal, keep-to-yourself attitude in pretty much every other place in town. I feel like Luzzara could be the setting in some kind of Edmonton-based sitcom. And Sarah makes a mean hot chocolate too.

place_name: P J Whelihan's Pub + Restaurant - Medford Lakes
place_category: Pubs, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Burgers, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Gastropubs, American (New), Bars
text: After trying PJ's again, we will never be back. They have changed their crabcake sandwich, which I loved back in the early 2000's, and it is really small and crappy on a small cheap potato bun. My husband's French Dip was hard and served with "au jus" that seemed to be made with burger grease and gravy. It was truly disappointing.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: I think that I caught the restaurant on a bad night. They were short staffed and a party of 20 arrived just before we did. The serving staff maintained their composure and friendly nature. However, I can't say the same for the kitchen. Clam chowder arrived at the table luke warm and very thick. The fish and chips arrived at the table cold.

place_category: French, Restaurants
text: Buffet Breakfast in the Crystal ballroom during our hotel stay was $20 which includes all buffet food as well as drinks such as juice & coffee. There is a cook on a grill for egg omelets & scrambled options. There are shrimp, crawfish & other items available to include within your eggs. I didn't find that the buffet had much variety as the same items were served two days in a row. The service & wait staff is friendly. The food is good, average.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Vietnamese, Restaurants, French
text: Won't come back due to the horrible service from the lady bartender. Many times I came in to pick up my carry out, she always forget my sauce for my vermicelli bowls and rice platter. I have to consume my food plain. If I can give 0 stars I would.

place_category: Comfort Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Burgers
text: This place needs to get their act together. Time slots are for a reason. I ordered days in advance, came at my time slot and still had to wait. This is unacceptable in my opinion.

place_category: Latin American, Caribbean, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Love this place! It's the perfect spot for a chill mea with friends. I always grab one of the signature cocktails and their chips and guacamole are always good. Can't wait for my next visit!

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Soul Food, Restaurants
text: I love Tan's! These cupcakes are delicious (moist, not too sweet, flavorful) and just the right size. They take custom orders and have an incredible selection. It's a delight to have this small business attracting people to the area! A+

place_category: Shopping, Butcher, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food
text: Duck pastrami was superb and definitely a must. Pork belly was tender and delightfully flavorful without the fattyness. Morocco spiced lamb was also relish; so tender and moist.

place_category: American (Traditional), Pubs, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Gastropubs, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars

place_category: Sandwiches, Cafes, Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Short waits, strong drinks, great food. Service sets them apart. My bloody was damn good and damn strong. Eat here.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Food
text: Marginal breakfast food leaning on the processed side-but decent lunches. However the service is very fast and dependable-something of a novelty in Pinellas County. If you want fast service and just the basics this is the place.

place_category: Food Trucks, Food Delivery Services, Street Vendors, Desserts, Food Stands, Restaurants, Food, Cupcakes, Bakeries
text: The cupcakes were alright, but at $4.50 each they are a premium item and should be amazing. I ordered the chocolate ganache, carrot cake, pumpkin chocolate chip, and apple pie. The most interesting one was the apple pie. The cupcakes are small in size and lack anything that makes them truly stand out. Really into supporting local business but at this price point I would likely not return. Better off getting a premium treat at Carlos Bakery.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: My co workers and I love this place for a great sandwich! We have tried everything menu and Rae's doesn't make a bad soup, salad, or sandwich (cookie or brownie)!! Customer service is so friendly and warm... I love that he says "whatchu havin' baby" to almost everyone!! Makes me laugh! They also cater, but make sure you call it in before 11.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Chinese
text: Besides the fact it took them over an hour to deliver my food. The food itself was..... Meh..... The general tso chicken was way sweet. It was almost unbearable. They packed everything nice and neat though and the driver seemed nice. I'll probably give them another shot if I'm too lazy to drive to China King

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: I was really looking forward to trying this place and was truly disappointed once we got there. The service was horrible and I could have made better food at home. The words of my husband. They shredded cheddar cheese and American were the only options whereas even the local diners have feta cheese. I know I am being picky but the devil is in the details, options and creativity. The shrimp and grits were greasy, and the scramble eggs were overcooked. Very disappointing

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Excellent food, large portions, and very reasonable prices. Great Margaritas too! Highly recommended!

place_category: American (New), Steakhouses, Sports Bars, Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: I really wanted to like Barnfire, but I have to say I'm underwhelmed. We ordered the 12oz prime rib to split with a salad and baked potato with an extra salad so we both had a salad. The salads were both good as was the baked potato. However the prime rib was tough and not melt in your mouth tender as prime rib should be, plus it was a bit tasteless. The au ju was quite watered down and the bread they served was hard and close to stale. Oh well at least we tried.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants
text: It was my first time trying Indian food. I was indecisive on what to get. The service suggested the butter chicken for first timers. Service was good. We went about 30 minutes before closing. This cuisine was different to what I'm normally used to eating. My boyfriend had the lamb curry and he really enjoyed it.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Sneaky :) Hard times lead to cheapening out the customer. Won't recommend. Meat was switched from beef to pork, low quality/hard/fat ridden pieces, and missed a few paid items.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Food
text: Overpriced for the amount of food on the plate. Food was OK but not special enough to justify the price tag.

place_category: Spanish, Restaurants, Cuban
text: Don't let the location foul you, this location makes some of the best Hispanic (Cuban) food around. My personal favorite is their take on chicken parm ( pollo millanesa)! They have slacked a little on the quality the last two times that I visited but overall I would still recommend if you are craving Cuban food. It was definitely better a year or two ago but it's still alright. Prices are reasonable

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Pizza, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars
text: I had high hopes, but the food just isn't very good. Philly cheese steak, panini, burger, were all pretty average. We prefer Murphy's, they are superior in every way. We will not be going back to Ale Emporium. Too bad.

place_category: Restaurants, Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Coffee Roasteries, Coffee & Tea
text: I had a tasty latte and hubby's a hand brewed cup of Kona. He loved it, smooth, strong and less acidic than the big green mermaid's.

place_category: Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Bars
text: It was ok. Nice spot on the river. Food was ok. Smoke ruined it. Dogs not being allowed off of boats was a disappointment as well.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: If you are hungry this place is fine. I'm not sure what the chicken is exactly that they call "chicken". I know what REAL white breast meat chicken looks like and what the consistency should be like. Not sure but chicken is NOT rubbery and chewy unless it's old I would think. I ordered the garlic chicken. Crab Rangoon was good. Egg roll - too much cinnamon in it!! Steamed rice was ok

place_category: Bars, Chicken Wings, Sports Bars, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: Been going for many years. Love it. But lately it smells like mold and the restaurant needs a cleaning. Please clean it up!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food
text: It's not the Cafe du Monde (original location in the French Market) but then again what is? It is, however, as good if not better than the Cafe du Monde branch located in the Lakeside Mall. It does, however, have a couple of things going for it: (A) it's convenient if you find yourself in Metairie and need a beignet fix (B) you apply your own powder sugar (as much or as little as you like) and (C) it's open 24/7. In fact for the 'burbs I would say that it's pretty darn good!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: They have really great sushi and soups! It's a cute little sushi bar with a very friendly staff. We had some ramen noodle bowls and they were amazing as well as their firecracker roll! Definitely will be back to try more.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, French, Specialty Food, Seafood, Diners, Cajun/Creole, Seafood Markets, Event Planning & Services, Southern, Caterers, Salad
text: A great seafood experience. We got here three minutes before the kitchen closed and we're not disappointed. The oysters and shrimp were amazing and among the best I have had. Our servers were knowledgeable, quick and funny. A must go if you're in the French Quarter!

place_category: Restaurants, Food Delivery Services, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Food, Tapas Bars, Bars
text: Heat of Passion!! Yes please!!! Cute lounge with a creative menu. Love Milk and Honey

place_category: Imported Food, Food, Specialty Food, Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Great food. Quick service. Always very kind. I recommend the sticky buns, the gyoza, and the filet udon. Only gave 4 stars because the space is small and they only offer bottled drinks.

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Food, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Poke, Acai Bowls
text: A great little corner spot in Tampa. The setting is intimate to say the least. Meant for couples or double dates. The service was friendly and the window seat was great to make us feel less claustrophobic. We enjoyed the creative tales and the rolls were well worth the price of admission. We both decided to make a return visit and explore the other options. If you are in the area this little spot will satisfy.

place_category: Patisserie/Cake Shop, Food, Restaurants, Bakeries, Cafes, French
text: Love the dutchess. It's 3 times the size it used to be. We stop here whenever we're in Edmonton to get Florentines. So awesome.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: We were really hyped up about this after reading the reviews here, but unfortunately the food did not measure up to our expectations. We thought the food was edible and there were huge portions, but it could have used more flavor. There was more breading than chicken, and it was less crispy than we prefer. For anyone who hasn't eaten at our favorite Chinese restaurant in NW Ohio, this is probably really good. Unfortunately, we happen to be ruined for any other Chinese cuisine including this one.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: I love the Gia's Salad but they give you 2 approx. 1 oz servings of dressing for a really large salad. I need to ALWAYS REMEMBER to order more extra dressing. The extra dressing barely is enough to handle the salad. they charge for the extra 2, small 1 oz servings of dressing for $1 At that rate 128 oz (Gal. ) of dressing would cost $62 I really think you need to re-think this since it is a great salad but REALLY short on the dressing. May stop buying here. We will see.

place_category: Nightlife, Armenian, Irish, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Bars, Sports Bars, Pizza, Pubs
text: Literally THE BEST bread pudding ever! Also have good appetizers and everything is fresh! Your local dive bar :)

place_category: Japanese, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Ramen, Restaurants
text: Great place. Too long of a wait for Ramen noodles. It would be better if they would have more space to accommodate.

place_category: Restaurants, Vegetarian, Salad, Coffee & Tea, Tex-Mex, American (Traditional), Burgers, Food, Sandwiches, Mexican, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: I had the Steamed Veggies over brown rice and sauteed tofu. This dish was a pretty big portion but I think the taste overall could be improved. It was pretty bland and the vegetables were undercooked. BF got the grilled chicken pita sandwich and that was pretty delicious. Overall this place was fairly priced and a good atmosphere for a simple lunch. I would definitely come back to try other things on the menu but I don't think I'll order their veggies and rice dishes again.

place_category: Drugstores, Shopping, Grocery, Delis, Food, Bakeries, Restaurants
text: Decent option for grocery shopping. The prices and options are probably the best when stacked up against the local competition. That said, the experience can sometimes be unenjoyable as the aisles are slender and this store is generally always busy. The parking lot can also be a bit of a nightmare as it is poorly designed.

place_category: Pubs, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Dance Clubs, Bars, American (New), American (Traditional), Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: I was told this was a bank converted into a club. But when you go inside, you can tell it's more of a restaurant that tries to have a dance floor at night. The dining tables take up a lot of space and really inhibit you from moving around. The DJ was playing some good music when I went, but the clientele was so bro-ey. Be ready to be bombarded with drunk college kids dancing up a storm. The unisex bathroom line was also ridiculously long. I will say that the beer selection was superb.

place_category: Desserts, Coffee & Tea, Food, Gelato, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: OMG. Creamy goodness in every flavor your heart desires! So delicious I wish I didn't know about this place. Seems I'll be making a few extra laps around the gym just so I can indulge here ;)

place_category: Donuts, Restaurants, Food
text: Classic, even after all these years. I enjoy their buttermilk old fashion, it's my favorite. The prices are cheap, the staff is friendly and they offer an array of donuts. I've tried the glazed and the apple fritter which were just OK.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Service was decent - food was overpriced and super greasy. We had flautas and got taquitos. Sauces were too greasy for my taste.

place_category: American (Traditional), Chinese, Restaurants
text: The food was HORRIBLE! i feel so sick! I took a bite of my Lo Mein and it honestly tasted like a dirty trash can! Then i smelled the Lo Mein and it literally smelled like a dirty trash can ! The lady who was on the phone taking down the order was very sweet but the food is awful. Also wanted to charge me $2 just to not have broccoli in my food . I will never go back there i now feel awful !!

place_category: Pubs, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Desserts, Food, Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Italian, American (New)
text: My mother enjoyed her food. But my Turkey Pot Pie was not very good. The breading on top was sticky, the turkey was dry even with all that sauce. The waiter was rude and off putting. But I did quite enjoy the colonial grab. The food wasn't horrible but it was not good sub par at best. I would give it another try. Just not the pot pie.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Order from here quite often usually get the penne with vodka sauce or the shrimp scampi....sometimes the occasional Cheesesteak food is usually good...my only complaint is inconsistent service

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: 5 stars if you are between 18-21. 1 star if you are over 21. 3 stars is the compromise. It's all the kind of skeevy, strong drink fun with nasty dancing that you could ever want as a college student, but if you are beyond that......it's skeevy with bad-tasting drinks and nasty dancing from horny little boys.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Food, Bakeries
text: 2 things: 1-The coffee isn't that good so the name kind of makes me laugh. 2-The breakfast & food is badass. Big fan of the bagel sandwiches. Also the muffins are really good and portions are wild. I'd prob eat here more if they cared less about blue lives & more about serving customers faster : /

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Soul Food, Fast Food, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional)
text: This is standard run of the mill fried chicken. Essentially just for drunken tourists. In a city with so much good fried chicken there is no real reason to eat here unless you are just nearby and don't care. Comparable to KFC or Church's chicken

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: What don't they have here?? Well, they go light on the fruits and vegetables, but they do have the essentials. They have just about everything else you can think of, including a very high-class wine selection. My wine informant tells me that the prices were not that bad on the best bottles, either. Hot,steamed crawdads in a bag fir $2.99/pound. That and a six pack of Abita Boot will set you right up for lunch.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Bubble Tea, Taiwanese, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: I think this placed moved over two blocks. Lady is very friendly. I got green tea honey aloe bubble tea with a mix of extra pearls and popping bubbles. It was delicious. The best

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: My favorite pizza spot! They NEVER disappoint! A 40 min wait but the secret is to call and order and they will give you a time for pickup. Everyone there is super sweet and always friendly no matter how hectic it is. I love that!

place_category: American (Traditional), Lounges, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, Gay Bars, Bars
text: Attractive gays here and nice cocktails for under $10. Line for the bathroom is no fun.

place_category: Restaurants, Greek, Salad, Mediterranean
text: I loved it because the food was just Greek enough, just American enough. Very tasty. Be careful not to fill up on their bread & olive oil before your entree comes! Wait staff was definitely on the ball, even though it got really busy toward the end of our meal. Did't have wine, but looked like they had a good varied selection of beers and wines, and of course other cocktails. Will definitely make this a regular spot when we hit Tampa Ave again.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Salad, Burgers
text: The 6 of us enjoyed our lunch... meatloaf croissant, burger, wrap, French fries, all were a hit. The waiters are very accommodating as well when it comes to menu substitutions (even though the menu is pretty big already). Tasty desserts - the vanilla sea salt caramel cake portions were huge! It's very reasonably priced as well.

place_category: Sandwiches, Chicken Shop, Restaurants, Salad, Chicken Wings
text: Food was amazing as told. Chicken sandwich was awesome staff was great. service was fast. And specially the man reason I tried there chicken it was halal . I'll be there regular customer.

place_category: Burgers, Food, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: i wanted a burger in the worst way,ordered a double cheeseburger for about 6 dollars,looked awesome,tasted like a cooked piece of cardboard absolutly no flavor.will never ever ever eat at a wendys again

place_category: French, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Amazing experience. I recommend having reservations. Food was delicious. Will definitely be coming back next trip.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Lounges, Seafood, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Italian, Tapas Bars
text: Amazing seafood and great service! We've been here several times over the years and it never disappoints. This week was no different. The layout of the dining area gives window views to most tables and you feel like you're in a smaller, less noisy dining room. The fish is always very fresh and perfectly prepared. If you're not a seafood lover, this place might change your mind!

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Chinese
text: Why have a large size restaurant when you are clearly understaffed? We waited for 1 hour and 20 minutes just for our food to arrive. We all ordered pho, and one rice plate -- which they got wrong but proceeded to charge us for the fish we never got. They're unapologetic and customer service was terrible. Won't be going to this place next time.

place_category: Restaurants, Hot Dogs
text: first time here I had the chili cheese dog(good portions) and the Chicago dog, both were good, the the price is reasonable. Next time I went I had a polish Chicago dog and that was even better. I wish they had french fries(potato chips only).

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Latin American, Bars, Mexican, Breakfast & Brunch, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: Pretty bland non-Mexican Mexican food. I tried the more unusual stuff like the cauliflower tacos, which were tasty, and the sweet potato tacquitos (sp?). Not much heat in the salsa served and the chips didn't seem to me regular corn tortillas. I think you will find better Mexican food on south 4th or south 12th. avenues.

place_category: Japanese, Poke, Asian Fusion, Food, Restaurants
text: I am always looking to try new places around me and today was a try for takumi sushi hibachi and I wasn't disappointed. I really enjoyed the service and the food. Food was very fresh and very affordable. I got to try some fried sushi and it was delicious. The hibachi was served in a plastic plate and portion was fair. I recommend this place for sure.

place_category: Bakeries, Chinese, Restaurants, Food
text: I wasn't super impressed. But, the were open on Easter. The food tasted good, but I felt like asking, "Why do I do this to myself?" after I ate it. The food doesn't feel healthy at all. But it tasted good. I say if you must eat here, go on a detox for a month afterwards.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Vegetarian, American (New)
text: 4 stars because my husband REALLY LIKED his pork belly po'boy. I got the shrimp, and being my first meal in NOLA, I was a bit shocked by how salty the Gulf shrimp naturally are. Still, the flavours are unique and work well. Service was fantastic and quick. But we didn't feel rushed at all. A great little place that's known well to some, but not to others. Give this place a shot if you're in the area!

place_category: Tex-Mex, Salad, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Restaurants, Mexican
text: We just ordered from here and not one thing was good. We got the grande nachos which were so over cooked you couldn't even break the nachos off because of how hard the cheese was. Everything was dry and needed either sour cream added to it or taco sauce which we luckily on hand. I could not even finish my burrito because the BBO pork was so dry to the point of being inedible. I will never order from here again.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Italian
text: Not the best pizza in town and delivery took way to long. I would not recommend this pizza place. They have so called gourmet pizza with gourmet prices. Not worth your money!

place_category: Specialty Food, Asian Fusion, Mexican, Poke, Tacos, Food, Restaurants, Health Markets
text: This is a great addition to downtown. Amazing tacos, quesadillas and queso dip. Great outdoor seating area as well.Anthony was very polite and helpful. I would definitely recommend and will be returning soon!!!!

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Music Venues, Food, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Breweries
text: Brew Brothers is awesome! Loved hanging out here with my sisters! Bartender was the best, didnt get his name. We had bloody marys and he made them perfectly spicy. Fabulous after our great sushi dinner next door.

place_category: Lounges, Restaurants, Tiki Bars, Dive Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Caribbean, Hawaiian, American (Traditional)
text: 9/3/11 - stopped here on my way home from work. I ordered shrimp manuu with steamed rice, house salad, banana nut bread, and water. Large chocolate chip cookie for dessert, which was yummy. Good service, average food. I found the manuu to be unappetizing - bland, way too many water chestnuts, too much sauce, pasty rice. Ginger would also help this dish. Some nice tapa cloths, although the decor generally looks kind of tired.

place_category: American (New), Barbeque, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Sports Bars
text: I had two items that fell at opposite ends. First, no matter what you have to get the smoked wings, they were a 10/10. However, the pulled pork was dry, and the house BBQ sauce bordered on disgusting. It was like BBQ sauce mixed with maple syrup.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries
text: After waiting days to go because of the ridiculously long line (over a block long) it was finally a delicious meal I was able to enjoy. However, service was so cold and inhospitable. Almost keeps me from returning again, but the waffle I ate was just too delicious.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Food, Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Cajun/Creole, Breweries, Dive Bars, Bars, Sports Bars
text: Funky layout. So, so crowded. Those milk shakes are GROSS. But good beer and good people.

place_category: Korean, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Thai, Japanese
text: I had the Korean bolgoki, it had some vegetables and chicken(whichever topping you ask for) and s side of rice. All in all it was pretty good, the chicken was good but the vegetables were bland. My family likes the gok bok ki as an appetizer. It's spicy rice cakes topped with mushrooms, onions and red peppers. I also really like their oishi spicy soup. It's moderately spicy. Would really recommend this place! It's pretty good!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Bakeries
text: Was really excited to try this bakery because of all the rave reviews, but very disappointed:( The cake was decorated beautifully, but it was SO dry & crumbly. I will probably give them another chance & try their other baked goods, but definitely not another cake.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Sushi Bars
text: In short: the salmon that we had was not of the great quality in terms of freshness and cut - one of the peaces had a bone in it and the meat get hard and a bit smelly. The price range at this place is the same as at Arigato but more than half lower in quality. Maybe it was just a bad day but it was what it was

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Bakeries, Pizza
text: Stopped in randomly- and picked up my kids 2 cupcakes. You know when something is old and has been sitting in a refrigerator... That's what these tasted like. I was bummed bc this place was so cute- the people were super nice. The pizza looked great... But the cupcakes were gross. When an 8 year old takes a bite and opts out of eating it- that's saying a lot.

place_category: Tapas Bars, Wine Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: What a wonderful experience! They have a great selection of wines; fun way to taste them AND a wonderful mixologist that was both entertaining plus made delicious drinks! We will definitely go back next time we are in town.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: We were staying at The Best Western plus along Nugget Ave & this was an option for delivery. It took about 45+ minutes but it was still warm when it got to us. Flavor & price were on point. Just did smalls- would have wished for utensils & plates since it was a Grub-hub order but I tore off the top of one box & used it as a plate

place_category: Jazz & Blues, Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Wine Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: We came here on a tuesday night and the place was packed. The garden seating was filled so we had to sit at the upstair indoors bar area. I tried the seared beef tongue and the leafy green salad which was good but not amazing. One person in our group had their meal lost in limbo and took quite some time for them to figure it out. Great place to just drink wine and enjoy the music, not necessarily eat. Nice laid back atmosphere.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: I was completely disappointed with my order, I had 2 orders of sesame chicken and one order of general tsos chicken. The food looked great just wished it contained some actual chicken. I had maybe 2 or 3 bites of actual chicken amongst all these meals and was instead served what appeared deep fried breading tossed in sauce. Ended up throwing most the food away after paying over 40 dollars for it. Will not be back here to say the least.

place_category: Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Southern, Desserts, Cafes, American (New)
text: Absolutely delicious! Biscuit was light, slightly crispy, flakey.... so good! Coffee was hot and tasty! My daughter-in-law had turmeric and ginger latte which was quite good! Sausage gravy was indescribably so good! Can I say enough about this place? Oh and the decor was very cool!! Loved the light fixtures over the bar. Restroom clean and spacious..... 'cause I love a clean restroom! Don't miss Wills Jean in downtown New Orleans!

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Food tastes great! The breads and nuts are unlimited. However the crowds are not that great. Mostly racist caucasians. The trump supporter ones.

place_category: Restaurants, Indian

text: My wife and I were looking for authentic Chinese food. Thank God we found it here. The food was excellent and it's always good to see locals of Asian descent eating here. You know the food is good.

text: I asked for sprinkles on the top and bottom of my gelati. They charged me and extra $1.44 because "I asked for sprinkles on the top and bottom, so it's double". I always get this same order at Rita's and have NEVER been charged for sprinkles, little alone been charged double sprinkles. When I got to the bottom of the gelati, there was literally like an INCH of sprinkles at the bottom.

Its way too expensive for what it is and at those prices to serve chips and tasteless pickles is not cool. :(

The quality if the food is hit or miss...some days it's excellent but usually it is burnt, over greased and just overall subpar. It's still better than the cafeteria and delivery is usually on time.

place_category: Jazz & Blues, Restaurants, Caribbean, Food Court, Soul Food, Food Delivery Services, Food, Arts & Entertainment, Chicken Wings, Bars, Nightlife
text: This is usually one of my go to places, but I was very disappointed in the food this time. I ordered the Jerk shrimp to go. I only received 7 shrimp, and they were covered in way too much sauce. Wish it would have been on the side like it is when dining in. I'll stick with the chicken dishes in the future.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Italian, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: Great food...great ambiance...and most importantly, good wine! Definitely recommend! The lamb chops were definitely the best dish. Cooked to perfection with just the right amount of seasoning. We didn't get a chance to check out the water view as it was 20 degrees, but we'll be back for sure!

place_category: Nightlife, Venues & Event Spaces, Indian, Bars, Buffets, Restaurants, Lounges, Soup, Event Planning & Services, Salad
text: The service staff was terrible; it was hard to tell who was service staff and who wasn't. And, when you found service staff, they were very slow to get what needed. I had the lunch buffet. The buffet was sparse, bland and WAY overpriced.

place_category: Mexican, New Mexican Cuisine, Restaurants
text: We went here on a Saturday night.It was busy, but not super crowded. The staff was very friendly. We sat at the bar and they gave us samples of some of their speciality drinks. They were delicious. The food was ok. I was very disappointed by the taste of the food. The sour cream enchiladas and steak con carne were subpar at best. This could be a great place if the food was better.

place_category: Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: I waited 20 minutes for a Diet Coke and a medium tater tots. I think they're short staffed but the communication was also poor. I didn't know why I was waiting for so long.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Pizza, Cocktail Bars, Food, Gelato, Italian
text: We ordered a pizza and Crepe Florentine. The pizza was less greasy than typical American version, which is good. However, just like many mediocre pizza restaurants, they burned the bottom (1/4). It is very easy to guess that the pizza chef simply put the pizza into the stone oven from start to end without any effort in turning it for even cook in between. Also, be prepared your clothes will get very smelly afterwards due to their kitchen.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Cocktail Bars
text: We had a late lunch here today. We had chips and salsa, cheese dip, 4 tacos and 3 margaritas. I'd say the shrimp taco and margaritas were the highlight. We liked the food but it didn't seem like it was worth the $55 bill before tip.

place_category: Greek, Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Mediterranean
text: The food here is absolutely outstanding. We started with the fried goat cheese. It was honestly the best I've ever had. Following that was dinner salads. The house was very good and I love the dressing! Next was the pizza. Again, absolutely outstanding!!! The decor and ambience was very nice. I will definitely be back for more!!!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: The caldo de queso was disgusting and made with American grated cheese and it tasted like water. Will never go again.

place_category: Kebab, Mediterranean, Greek, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: I liked my service. It was quick and the food was fresh. I'm not sure if Mediterranean food is for me because I didn't like the falafel. I always wanted to try it because so much people rave about it in New York. I ordered this lamb with yellow rice but my favorite thing was the pita break and tzatziki sauce. If I ever visit this place again I'll try chicken or the Greek orzo soup.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Get the pizza it's good. Everything else is.... sometimes great some times not so great. It's fun and in the heart of South Philly. I have been eating here for 50 plus years. I still go fairly often. It fun and good. Prices are very reasonable and it's a family run place. I love the lasagna so it's a safe bet. Always fun for an authentic 9th street experience.

place_category: Food Delivery Services, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, American (New), Barbeque
text: My favorite spot to eat at in Isla Vista. Honestly this place has really tasty bbq dishes, and AMAZING mac n cheese. Every other restaurant in IV is pretty bad, but this one is really damn good. 5 stars in IV for sure.

place_category: Fast Food, Chinese, Restaurants
text: My fortune cookie fortune foretold that I'd be released from past burdens. What it didn't tell me is that I was soon to suffer a horrendous case of food poisoning. I know it was Panda that poisoned me because the other food I had that day was stuff I eat all the time at home and well within expiration date. I generally avoid fast food but made an exception for Panda. That won't happen again. I was awake in a lot of pain the entire night.

place_category: Tapas/Small Plates, Restaurants, Burgers, Barbeque
text: I was at McClures in the New Orleans Brewing company. I didn't come here to eat as to partake in some craft beers by NOLA brewery. After looking around the brewery most people were EATING not drinking! This made a statement! I had just eaten but decided to try the collard greens with molasses! Wow! Amazing! $3.50. The plates were heaping full too. My next trip to Nola will included a full meal at McClures with these amazing collard green coming back to Tampa Bay with me!

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Mexican, Tapas Bars, Nightlife
text: This place is way over priced. Ordered 2 tacos for $14, and got 2 TINY tacos.I don't mind paying too dollar but this was a rip off. Hopefully they do something about this. I love supporting local companies, but this was just ridiculous.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Chinese, Bubble Tea, Taiwanese

place_category: Nightlife, Pizza, Bars, Restaurants

place_category: Indian, Restaurants

place_category: Asian Fusion, Noodles, Restaurants, Pan Asian, Soup

place_category: Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)

place_category: Farmers Market, Meat Shops, Specialty Food, Food

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Bars, Lounges, Restaurants, Nightlife

place_category: Nightlife, Seafood, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars

I'm just saying, microwave??

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Bars, Steakhouses

text: Got a gift certificate for my birthday to this spa. I loved using the different lounges. The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming. My Swedish massage was great! I loved the flavored water that was placed around the spa. I thoroughly enjoyed my spa experience here.

I happened to be sitting at the bar next to the owner. The bar tender is her son. He was really nice.

place_category: Vegan, Restaurants

They are a BYOB, no booze is served here and they have many daily specials. It's very close to home and we plan to return regularly.

place_category: Italian, Burgers, Restaurants, Pizza
text: You can always count on "Smoky's" on a hot summer evening; the patio is as cool as you can be outdoors and the local musicians add to the mood. Indoors in the winter, the old-bungalow construction is homey and familiar. I always get the black bean ravioli and I'm glad that they offer carry out (and delivery) so that if I have a craving I can order it on the fly. Service can be relaxed but always friendly.

place_category: Food, Burgers, Restaurants
text: I really like the PRIME Burger, which is a grass fed burger. I used to eat their regular burgers but when they got this one, I tried it and it is t he only one I will eat there now. I can definitely taste the difference in the beef (I only buy free range, organic, grass fed at home). That alone I think is worth the price.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee Roasteries, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bakeries, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Desserts, Restaurants, Donuts
text: I *LOVE* this cafe for their great service and they have some delicious drinks. I love that it's well lit, opens early, and there are lots of seating options. I'd come here a lot more if they'd offer gluten-free options (they have pretty much nothing atm). Even if they just had gluten free bread for their sandwiches it would make a huge difference. That said, before I recognized the extent of my gluten allergy, I found their biscuits to be ridiculously delicious.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Vegetarian, Cafes, American (New), Food, Diners, American (Traditional)

Hard to believe that whoever put this together has ever eaten real chilaquiles from Mexico. Won't be back.

text: Wanted so much to love this place. Baked goods were very yummy, but POS system was down, which meant cash only; wanted waffles, but "the waffle maker has been out for quite a while"; and breakfast was served cold. And this place isn't inexpensive. $11 for pancakes.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: This place is one of those cute little dinners with good food and great staff and friendly locals.. I had biscuits and gravy sausage and eggs.. All cooked spot on.. Don't be afraid to stop here and try it I am sure glad I did..

place_category: Malaysian, Nightlife, Bars, Salad, Cocktail Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Japanese, Restaurants, Ramen, Filipino, Pan Asian, Chinese, Asian Fusion
text: Ok food. Ramen noodles were undercooked in two separate bowls and the broth was nothing to write home about. Wok-fried lettuce was his but a little over-salted. Fish tacos, five spice green beans, and ginger cheesecake were all just so so. Coupled with inattentive service, I wouldn't recommend this place to a friend.

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, American (New), Brewpubs, Food
text: The food was good, well prepared. The beer....meh. The service was lousy, absolutely unmistakeably lousy.

place_category: Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea
text: For a place that has the word "bagel" printed on the building front I was extremely disappointed to find the bagel was sitting in a display case wrapped in saran wrap. It was nothing special I could have bought a better bagel from rouses to toast in my own kitchen. After my first visit I was disappointed and went on to find better breakfast options (which New Orleans is in no short supply!)

place_category: American (New), Cocktail Bars, Bartenders, Nightlife, Bars, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants
text: I came to Mad Rex on a Thursday night to celebrate my boyfriend's birthday. The environment is different, my dinner and service was good. Unfortunately the virtual reality game room had closed an hour and 30 min before closing time. It would of been nice to be warned that it was closing early for whatever reason. I made a reservation for dinner and to experience the virtual reality portion. I left very disappointed and spent a lot of money just to have a regular dining experience.

place_category: Restaurants, Vegan, Vegetarian
text: Gianna's is a great place to find vegan guilty pleasures. The hoagies & sandwiches are ridiculously huge, and kind of make your stomach hurt (in a good way). The pizza also hits the mark, though I've been less satisfied with the cakes. If you're looking for vegan philly cheesesteak, this is it, and your omni friends can get whatever they want too.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Music Venues, Steakhouses, Seafood, American (New), Nightlife, Cafes
text: Cute little boutique restaurant. It is located just off the main street in a little house. Our waiter was really nice and even brought us a little taste of their soup from the kitchen. The whole place was comfortable and charming with good food. I would recommend it and go back.

place_category: Southern, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: Obsessed! The food was exquisite, our server was delightful and the atmosphere is beautiful! The array of candles create a lovely look pre sunset but post surest the warehouse design gives you a mid-evil feel. I can't wait to go back again and try one of the decadent cocktails. Go tapas style if you're up for trying several things!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Gastropubs, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Lounges, Bars
text: Totally cool spot. Really cool vibe i get from it with food that isn't too badly priced. Only went for drinks on Wednesdays happy hour but would recommend as they have buy one get one free on a good selection of stuff including wine beer and mixed drinks and the most expensive you can get is $10.50 which isn't to bad for 2 drinks. Overall would recommend and go back again for the happy hour.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I tried to go here on a tuesday 10 to 8am so couldn't actually go inside. I guess they didn't feel like making money today.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Food, Salad, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Pizza, Breweries
text: I tried it again and my opinion remains unchanged...It's very mediocre. The bread and the pizza crust are nondescript. Sandwiches are kind of dull and very inferior to a place like Beyond Bread. It's not particularly inexpensive. I don't really see the virtue of the place aside from that they have a fairly large collection of beers on tap.

place_category: German, Restaurants, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, French, Brasseries, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I have been here for lunch and dinner. Very casual. Small winelist, but lots of good stuff. Try the daily specials. The redfish and brisket specials are fantastic. Located in the Hilton which requires they are open 365. Also try the crab salad and stuffed shrimp with orange hollandaise. Amazing sandwiches at lunch. My wife had a softshell crab blt that was enormous. This place is slipping. Service has gotten slow.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Fish & Chips, Nightlife, Seafood, Restaurants, Bars
text: +1 because the manager contacted me. The garlic clams were still amazing. I suggest ordering a bunch of the appetizers instead of entrees. Service was much better this time around.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Nightlife, Asian Fusion, Bars, Restaurants, Lounges
text: Best sushi in Nashville! If you want a cool vibe with amazing sushi, you should go to Virago. Great bar area and outside patio on cool evenings. They also have a sake bar that is hidden in the back. A must try.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Burgers, Fast Food
text: No one gave a shit. Service was poor, no one was at the counter to take order, half of the people preparing food didn't have gloves on. Lots of people just standing around at the back. Food also took awhile to come out. I understand this is McDonalds, but still, this is new low.

place_category: Restaurants, Buffets, Southern
text: YUM YUM YUM!!! Best friend chicken I have ever had!!! The skin is crispy and delicious, I wish I could just have a plate of that. Lol. The mashed potatoes are wonderful. Banana pudding & sweet tea are perfect for your sweet tooth! I take any visitor from out of town to Fred's!

place_category: Sandwiches, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Barbeque, Bars, Cafeteria, Restaurants
text: The short ribs and BBQ were salty, burnt, cold, and dried out, overall horrible. The experience put a bad taste in your mouth and very disappointing. The waiter was pleasant is the only positive thing that can be said about this place.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Szechuan
text: Ordered takeout. The braised beef noodle soup was very very oily. It's not sitting well with me with. Very disappointed after reading many reviews that said this was an authentic Chinese place and was delish. Nope.
