text: Not as good as I hoped it would be. Food is too dry. Customer service is good Ordered the papaya salad and curry chicken. Salad was big and curry was not up to the Thai standards of cooking. Wouldn't go again.

place_category: Southern, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: Bar service was great. Table service was great. Quail was delicious. Fried green tomatoes were good. Pork tenderloin was good, but salty. Duck was a complete disappointment. No flavor. Not convinced if it was bacon or prosciutto with it, but it was cold!!!!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Seafood, Nightlife, Bars
text: My friend and I went to here tonight. We had the Shrimp fajitas with green peppers and onions with avocados. The staff were very friendly and the food was delicious. This was my second time at this location so I knew the food was Great! Check them out the next time you are in U- City!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Salad
text: Two words: YAS. BRUNCH. Brunch at the Garden Table is absolutely superb. The food is great. The service is great. Above all...the cocktails are great.

place_category: Delis, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Sandwiches
text: If you go during off peak times the lines are more manageable. The food is great and be prepared to over indulge in sandwich heaven! The owner and staff are great and care about giving you a good meal and a great experience.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Mass Media, Cajun/Creole
text: My boyfriend and I come here all the time when we want great food and a fun atmosphere. The blueberry mojito is refreshing and not too sweet! I even ask the server sometimes to make it with very light simple syrup and it always comes out delicious. The fish tacos are a hit and my boyfriend loves their steak and pork burritos.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Kombucha, Bars, Food, Nightlife, Restaurants, Wine Bars
text: Disappointed that they excessively charged for their coffee, then charged credit card twice when they tried to fix. I left several messages for their management but no one returned the call to resolve.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: Came here on a day trip to Philly. BF, who lived in Philly in a former life, recommended Jim's for cheese steak (within walking distance of where we were). Had to say we were all mildly disappointed. The bread was good, but the thing overall was bland as could be. In all fairness, we had the provolone and not the cheez wiz. But still, if this is how a Philly cheese steak is supposed to taste, then what's all the fuss about?

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: Food was OK - the service was OK - the only thing really that stands out is the grilled oysters. We had to ask for clean plates and the server was hard to find...

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Italian
text: If I could eat here everyday I would.. Never mind for two was phenomenal all the sides drinks and especially the service. Wonderful place to spend Christmas Eve

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, American (Traditional), Mexican, American (New), Bars
text: Just ordered take out. My husband ordered a well done burger and it is soggy and pink. We ordered an appetizer platter and the chicken is wet. The dipping sauces were all wrong.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Great place. I recommend any of the curries they are consistently awesome with a great level of heat, if you want really hot just be ready to cry (assuming you ordered it right). Always fast and fresh!

place_category: Convenience Stores, Delis, Restaurants, Bakeries, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Grocery, Food
text: I love the low prices here I bought a few things and I definitely doing my grocery shopping here for now on. I'm on a tight budget and this place will help stretch my grocery bill when it comes to customer service they help me but when i needed a shoprite bonus card it took ten annoying minutes to get it cashiers don't have the app he had to get it lol

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: Do not go here for breakfast ever ! Drinks were wrong , food over cooked ( eggs and bacon) , per the wait staff all the bacon for the day is cooked first thing in the morning and used all day . Service was poor. May be good for lunch or dinner but stay away from breakfast .......

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Specialty Food, Restaurants, French, Delis, Food
text: Tried this place for Sunday Brunch with 4 others. It was pretty busy. I ordered Steak and Eggs, medium rare, and they came well done. I didn't send them back however. I was pretty hungry considering it was a late lunch and a bit of a wait. Despite this, the steak had good flavor. My friend had the Croissant French toast which was pretty amazing. Service was average . Over-all a good experience.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Salad, Sushi Bars
text: Good quality at reasonable prices. The staff was very friendly and the manager/owner/chef made a point to introduce himself and make sure everything was going well. The quality of the fish is pretty good and the specialty roll I had was quite tasty. This is definitely one of the better sushi joints in center city and if you live nearby, definitely stop by or order take out.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: I got my pizza in 10 minutes from my call! Wow quickest pizza delivery ever. It was exactly what I ordered and tasted great. Thanks!

place_category: Food, Coffee Roasteries, Coffee & Tea
text: Great bike and car parking with a nice big lot. Cool modern atmosphere with black steel, exposed brick and reclaimed wood. Great outdoor seating options with bar stools and couches inside. One size only coffee. Reasonable prices. Small selection of pastries. Decaf Anericano was a little too tangy for my taste.

place_category: American (Traditional), Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, American (New), Steakhouses, Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars
text: Nothing remarkable. The food is passable, including the Sunday brunch, which offers a wide selection of passable salads, seafood, breakfast meats, fruits, omelettes, and sundries. The beer selection is paltry and uninspired. This is good for meeting friends for after work happy hour, but make reservations or arrive early as it can get crowded.

place_category: Photography Stores & Services, Beauty & Spas, Drugstores, Convenience Stores, Food, Shopping, Cosmetics & Beauty Supply
text: Made an appointment online for my flu shot. There were a few people waiting for the same when I arrived. Note that I arrived early for my appointment. I was disappointed because it seemed like it didn't matter if I had an appointment or not as walk ins were seen ahead of me. There was a 20 - 30 min wait. Otherwise, all was well. Got my shot and was done with it.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: First timers. We ordered the extra large Boardwalk pizza with pepperoni. Good crust. Just the right amount of sauce, cheese and pepperoni. Good balance. Fast delivery. Pizza arrived nice and hot. We will definitely order again.

place_category: Chinese, Thai, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Seafood, Indian
text: Use frozen chicken that tastes like cardboard for general two's chicken. Horrible. Steam dumpling appetizer was great.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Tacos
text: This place is AMAZING! Legit tacos, quesadillas, and margaritas. The rock tacos are perfect with so much flavor. The prickly pear margarita is a must. Their salsa bar is all individually portioned and gloves and provided so that you can put up items safely. So many accoutrements from radishes to limes in the salsa bar as well. This place is set up for dine-in or carry-out. You must go!

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants
text: Hands down, best vegetarian hoagie. Sometimes I really want a fancy vegetarian sandwich a la Paesano's in Philly, but when I'm really just craving a good old fashioned hoagie, Capriotti's is my place. They have this amazing soy turkey. Go ahead and laugh, but this stuff is seriously addictive! I like mine with provolone and as many veggies as they can throw on there. Gotta go...a craving just hit.

place_category: Nightlife, Lounges, Restaurants, Bars
text: las vegas lounge- ok but nothing special. Big screen was faded and (let's face it) no one is into soccer. Service was fine, the waitress was fine everything was just ...fine. The pool tables were commandeered early on and we didn't get a chance to play *sad face*. Would I go back? probably not..

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: First stop when we get to New Orleans is "bag of beer". I'm not buying food or ambiance or anything else. I'm buying beer in a bag. Tradition says this is our go to place the first couple of days. Iced down beers with pretty good selection. There is a prepared food section but I'm not even checking that out lol. Nice selection of snacks for the little kids.

place_category: Mexican, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars
text: We went there tonight for the first time and will not be back. The only good thing was the service but the food was the worst of any restaurant that we have ever ate at. The chips were awful (which should have been a sign to get up and leave). The kids drinks (milk was sour) and they only had enough for 1/2 a glass. The meals were dry, lacked taste and tasted like the food was prepared days ago. Again, service was good but the food was terrible. We won't return.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Bars, Sports Bars, American (New), Food, Beer Bar, Music Venues, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment
text: Great Food. Awesome Service. The selection of beer on tap is crazy. Best suprise of my time in tucson.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Mexican
text: Average tasting food with a standard variety of menu options to choose from. Waitstaff was friendly but too noticeable when not needed and absent when needed.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Sandwiches, Burgers
text: Just because it's a burger place doesn't mean you veggie lovers can't join your friends for a delicious meal. Last time I had the veggie burger (plus avocado, please) and substituted a cucumber salad for the fries. It was awesome, and I'm not even vegan.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese
text: Good food but not a pleasant surprise in my salad 2 hairs lost my appetite they took care of me and offer another plate I'm hesitant to take it now

place_category: Bakeries, Halal, Mediterranean, Afghan, Restaurants, Food
text: Ordered Lam Shish-kebab, got bones and tendons. Employees were ignorant about the issue.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Great coffee, love that they serve whole French presses, but awful wait, even if you call ahead, and completely average food. Good selection and variety but only average culinary experience. Over priced.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Bubble Tea
text: Skip the milk tea and boba here -- too mushy and no consistency or flavor. IV/SB lacks good boba in general, but they do an "okay" job. I would however recommend the Oreo and horchata blended drinks, the only things I would pick up here.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Salad
text: This is the best pizza in the area. The veggies are never too overcooked. Always cooked to perfection. They have an axxess deal.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Yuck, nasty, sick, gross!! The chicken in the enchiladas was nothing but gristle, and hopefully it was dark meat because it was grey. Instantly things starting shifting in my stomach and not in a good way. We won't even give it to our dog to eat. Will NEVER go there again.

place_category: Butcher, Meat Shops, Food, Specialty Food
text: Very small, we were on a mission for some sweet italian sausages- These were what they had, they smelled better than they tasted too much fennel for me, it overpowers the sausage the grind is great nice and course but (I think) it was the fennel just over powered it for me we tested them before putting in our sauce and I don't think they are worthy of our Christmas Sauce.

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants, Cheesesteaks
text: There aren't too many different ways to cook chopped steak on a flat grill, cover it in cheese, and put it on a Amoroso roll. I don't get the hype. They all taste the same to me.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: AMAZING food. I would give this place 5 stars but almost exactly 24 hours after splitting the steak tarare, my boyfriend and I were fighting over the bathroom... It was still kind of worth it.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: My wife and I were going to Pho & Beyond last week but unfortunately they were closed for vacation so we used Yelp to find this place. We were pleasantly surprised how good it was. The Pho was rich and flavorful and the Ban Mi was very good. I would definitely recommend this Restaurant

place_category: Ethnic Food, Pizza, Restaurants, Food, Specialty Food
text: Ya know, I always judge a local pizza joint by their house special fries. You know the ones: cheese, bacon, etc? Stadium Pizza's megafries are only okay, sadly. It would've been nice if they put the bacon on top of the cheese, but a little handiwork fixed that situation. Still, it was edible and satisfied my craving. I'm sure this place has better food, like pizza and stuff, so consider this review an asterisk for update later once I've had a good sample of the menu.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Food, Salad, Seafood
text: Fun atmosphere. Food was just ok. We ordered the char-grilled oysters which were good but had sand in quite a few of the oysters. The rest of the food was nothing special. Will not be back again.

place_category: Burgers, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Comfort Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (Traditional), Cocktail Bars
text: Went last night to watch the football game. Got the lobster Mac n cheese and it was EXCELLENT! I will make this one of my regular haunts. I hope they will keep the Mac n cheese on the menu

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: Let's begin with the fact that their DJ literally walked out mid-set because the racist owner said there were "too many black people" in the crowd. Not to mention some of the dirtiest restrooms I've ever seen in my life. This place is a dump with watered down drinks and a sad excuse for a dance floor. Please don't waste your time or money at this establishment. There are far better bars WITHOUT racist owners that would be happy to have your patronage in Nashville.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Pizza, Gluten-Free
text: Pretty good pizza, was surprised. Great atmosphere and employees have a smile on their face. Two issues I have, crust is left out and prices a little steep, especially for only getting a 9" pizza.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers
text: Horrible service, rude staff that needs to be trained better on how to keep customers. I will not be returning, worst first experience ever.

place_name: Saint Louis Halal Meat, Grocery & Foods - Baba's Restaurant
place_category: Specialty Food, Indian, Ethnic Food, Food, Meat Shops, Halal, Pakistani, Restaurants
text: Hole-in-the-wall Pakistani halal restaurant. Dhaba style. Limited menu, but great options. Really enjoyed the goat keema the most! Good halwa puri, as well!

place_category: Burgers, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Bars, Restaurants, Seafood
text: We ordered Togo and the lady who spoke on the phone was very abrasive and did not make us feel like she really valued our service. When we got home the food wasn't prepared to the order we requested and were missing a lot of components. The food was mediocre. I got the fried seafood platter but it was pretty salty. Will be willing to try it again with a dine-in experience but as of right now I was disappointed

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional)
text: If you want to be anonymous while drinking and dancing with someone that you require beer goggles to drink and dance with .... then by all means go to the Boot.. if you're looking for hotties dancing then you would be much better off going to F and M's.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: My thoughts on this place... ugh... just don't go! Unless you are a college kid looking for a quick bite or you were just begging on the off ramp for money... just don't! This "taco shop" has horrible and I mean horrible tacos. My husband got the carne asada burrito which I read people LOVE! In my opinion it was salty beef covered by WAY too much guac! It's cheap yes but, there are far better tacos and burritos in Reno with a hell of a lot more parking!

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Donuts, Bagels, Restaurants
text: I think I've been spoiled by Portland, OR when it comes to donuts. This place was nice enough and the donut was good there just wasn't much variety. I'll save my donut eating for Saturdays at the Franklin Farmer's Market.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners
text: Typical diner food nothing spectacular. Food was over cooked and a bit dry. Service was very good.

place_category: Desserts, Salad, Cajun/Creole, Food, Restaurants
text: Have dinner there with some fellow coworkers. You get ice cold beer in huge glasses. Had alligator tacos, little meat though and disappointed. But the others had dishes that looked very good. I will go again and try other Cajun dishes

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Fast Food, Restaurants, Food
text: This Dairy Queen needs some serious help. Waited in drive thru 19 minutes just for some fries and a strawberry smoothie. This is by far the worst experience in a drive thru I have experienced. The fries were cold and the smoothie taste horrible. I would not recommend this location at all. A refund is what I need from this establishment.

place_name: Bar Louie - Streets of St. Charles
place_category: Nightlife, American (New), Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Gastropubs, Sports Bars
text: The roasted vegetable flat bread pizza was a solid 4 stars- would have made 5 stars has the crust been cooked another two minutes. The Philly burger was a two; overcooked, dry and flavorless. The best thing on the menu was the drinks - good selection. Kelly, our server, was very nice. Music was a bit too loud. Overall - I would go back for a large group, but not impressed.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: People aren't friendly and food is cold and comes out thrown together. Cheese always halfway on burger. They don't care.

place_category: American (New), Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Very chi chi poo poo. Has anyone noticed that this restaurant has gone from a bustling, every table full, destination to a mostly empty table eatery? There is a reason.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Chicken Shop, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Came here on a saturday night with a party of 5 at 9pm. We had never been there and it looked like a fun place! The restaurant was maybe half full. The hostess sat us and we sat for 15 minutes unnoticed.... so we got up and walked out. Also unnoticed.

text: It's not terrible I guess. It's more of a huge cliche with slightly below average food. The wait staff is largely friendly and the typical diner is a tourist or a huge tool who doesn't realize there are at least 2-3 great restaurants they could take their match.com dates to within one block that will increase their chances of going out with them again (yes we witnessed a very awkward internet date while we were there).
