text: Don't ask if the burgers are fresh cause they must have thought I meant as in weeks old, cause I was told yes and when they didn't ask me how I wanted it cooked I knew right then and there it was issue, yes burger was frozen and taste like soy.. not good at all if ur looking for a "fresh" not frozen burger Rest of the my parties food looked great

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants
text: Not good at all. We ordered our food THREE times but the employees didn't say anything when they missed the first two orders. They got one of our drinks wrong, we missed a burger the first time they brought out our order, and the other burger we ordered without ketchup and mustard but got both. If you want good service, go to the McDonalds a mile from here.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Kosher, Burgers, Tapas/Small Plates, American (Traditional), Vegan, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Vegetarian
text: Amazing original cocktails and exceptional vegan food. The food is delicious, satisfying and approachable by non-vegans / vegetarians as well. The atmosphere is like stepping into an old-time 1930s movie scene, whilst remaining hip and trendy. This is a must visit bar and is sure to be one of the hottest spots in the city.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: The restaurant was beautiful upon entering. My family and I brought our own wine which was the catalyst for a great conversation until... A roach crawled up the wall. We were compensated for our food and given dessert as a "Sorry" token. The food was blahhh. But the desserts were great.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Amy was completely rude to me and the lady in front of me. If I didnt live so close I wouldnt come back. Other ladies were nice except Amy.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Music Venues, Dance Clubs, Coffee & Tea, Arts & Entertainment, Lounges, Nightlife, Food, Dive Bars
text: Not welcoming or friendly. Horrible customer service Way better options on 4th Avenue.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Bars, Nightlife, Wine Bars, Mediterranean
text: Nice ambiance, good food, but a bit pricey. There is nothing I did not like specifically, I just can not recommend this place. The mussels were good but not awesome, the red snapper was tasty. The chocolate fondue was good but not worth the price.

place_category: Restaurants, Vegetarian, Salad, Coffee & Tea, Tex-Mex, American (Traditional), Burgers, Food, Sandwiches, Mexican, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: A nice break from all of the indulging I did earlier in the weekend. Vegetarian options galore. Although its not die hard eco-correct, you don't feel judged if you use 2 napkins instead of 1. The service was sort of slow and we watched our waitress carry around our food for like 10 minutes before she found us (it was kind of entertaining). The food was pretty good though. I would go back.

place_category: Singaporean, Malaysian, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Thai, Asian Fusion
text: We've been to other Banana Leaf and the foods were outstanding; however, the foods here is horrible. Not only the foods were bad but the waitresses are the worst. Stay away this place!!

place_category: Italian, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Cool place. Ordered the pepperoni pizza, it was decent. However, it was extremely salty. It left that burning sensation on my lips after eating a slice. Others at my table ordered different dishes and thought it was very salty as well.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Tea Rooms, Herbs & Spices, Specialty Food, Event Planning & Services, Food, Venues & Event Spaces
text: I choose Hoitea Toitea for a bridal shower after reading great reviews. Sadly, I was disappointed in the service we received. Our food and Teas were out 30 minutes after shower started. I was informed we would receive 30 minutes to clean up instead we were pushed out so the next shower could set up. I will not be recommending to my colleagues.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Salad
text: While in Philly we stopped at Bareburger yesterday. Order the American Burger plus a burger with the brisket. We also ordered the tater tots and onion rings. The burger with the brisket with the Smoke Barbecue sauce was unbelievable the tater tots and onion rings were very good as well. We had no problem with the service the atmosphere was very nice. We will definitely be back. The only thing that I did not like where the sauces they gave us for the onion rings.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: This Ruby Tuesday is in a strip mall off US-30 Business. There is an ample parking lot. I'm not sure what happens during peak hours as I went to this restaurant on a night when it was quiet. I really just go to Ruby Tuesday for the salad bar. I've not been enthusiastic about their burgers, although the turkey minis I had were decent.

place_category: Southern, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: my favorite restaurant in Nashville now! atmosphere is great... portioning size is very good for the price in my opinion. 1st time i went with 2 friends and we got 4 appetizers and 1 drink each for a total of 75 dollars. not bad at all...and we were FULL. my favorites: sausage and biscuits the dips (which they didn't have the second time i went)= boiled peanut dip to die for! onion tart bacon wrapped quail chicken and dumplings were different than I'm used to but pretty good

place_category: Drugstores, Food, Shopping, Photography Stores & Services, Beauty & Spas, Convenience Stores, Cosmetics & Beauty Supply
text: Talked to Pharmacist today at 4:50pm. Put on hold for 10 minutes and call recycled. Waited another 5 minutes and call was dropped. Called back only to find they did not have my prescription and "no Walgreens in the area does either." I was on auto fill!!! No excuse. Terrible pharmacy service at this Walgreens.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Mediterranean, Specialty Food, Food, Ethnic Food
text: The food is excellent. BUT! The service is awful! It took 25 minutes for us to get our salad and then another 35 minutes for our entrees to arrive. We asked for the check... it took 10 minutes to get that. And did I mention there was only two of us?

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Event Planning & Services, Wine Bars, Bars, Gastropubs, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces
text: Food was perfectly seasoned and yummy! The Brussel sprouts were our fave! John was friendly and knowledgeable and made our experience even better! He was very attentive and went above and beyond! Great service and food!

place_category: Food, Desserts, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Coffee & Tea, Bagels, Bakeries, Internet Cafes, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The culinary delights at Eatery On Main are only exceeded by the excellent service and friendly staff. A European style Café right in the heart of North Wales. Try their pastries or gluten-free items for breakfast or lunch and their famous smoothies. Ask for their Life Changing Bar" for a burst of energy or their generous portions of oatmeal, all served with a smile.

place_name: Wine Tasting Designated Drivers of Santa Barbara
place_category: Food, Limos, Bars, Wineries, Tours, Wine Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Breweries, Hotels & Travel, Wine Tours, Transportation, Taxis, Nightlife
text: As we were planning our wine tasting adventure we were discouraged at the limo prices for a group of 4. After a lucky google search his name came up and we thought we'd give it a shot. We are so happy we did! Not only was Chris reliable and friendly, he was very knowledgable of the wineries and scenic lunch spots. I have his number for future trips, and have even recommended him to other friends!!

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: It was ok. Got two dishes, the ginger chicken and drunken noodles. Ginger chicken was great, very flavorful. Drunken noodle was just ok. Service was really good and the ambiance is nice. Fresh rolls were also decent. I'd come back if I was really hungry and not sure where else to go.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Burgers
text: Ordered takeout and went to pickup my order. There were no customers in restaurant and one other takeout order. Worse meal I have had since coming to Boise. Ice cold dinners (I picked up at appointed time) and taste was just terrible. We dumped both in disposal, won't be back. Gravy actually tasted like the stuff in a jar.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Salad, Food, Bars, Nightlife
text: I am here in Tampa visiting from Las Vegas. And I can say this was pretty amazing food and the service was above. I have a 2 year old and they brought him fruit at the beginning just because. Our server Sheila was very very impressive. I would recommend this place to anyone. Side note I lived in Charlotte NC for the past 2 years (before i.moved back to Vegas) and their Mexican food sucks compared to this place.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: On our way to the airport our plane was delayed. My sister suggested stopping in for breakfast since she had heard some good reviews about the establishment. Between the four of us we had pancakes, eggs your way, fish and grits, beef and turkey sausage. Everything was tasty and looking forward to my next visit. FYI- they are a little pricey from the initial view of the menu (larger platters) but you can order smaller portions.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Not bad pizza, but I would pickup vs delivery, as our pizza was luke warm at best. Price was ok, quality was about 2 1/2 stars, but price brought the rating up slightly.

place_category: Mediterranean, Breakfast & Brunch, Bagels, Restaurants, Food, Bakeries, Greek
text: The hype is worth the hype. Everything tasted fresh, authentic and full of flavor. I cannot wait to come back. From the cocktails to the baklava, all delicious. The restaurant is also super cute and love the indoor/outdoor seating options. Exceptional service as well!

place_name: Sook Hee's Produce & Squeeze Juice Bar
place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Grocery, Fruits & Veggies, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: A quaint market in the bottom of the comcast building with a juice bar on the side. They have the most amazing smoothies and yes you can get them dairy-free (vegans, this place is for you). This place is awesome because they use fresh fruit, not frozen fruit like the place in Liberty place (yuck). Their smoothies are a bit pricey but they're worth it! The market also has a great selection of fresh produce and other specialty items.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Food
text: What can you say fried donuts and coffee. I mean it's good and they are very filling and worth a visit if you are in New Orleans. However, if there's a huge line I'm not sure it's worth the wait but I went on a day that wasn't too busy and I actually had a chance to sit and enjoy the food and the street performers were playing jazz music.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Acai Bowls
text: We love Yo Mommas!!! Great selection of yogurt, fresh and yummy toppings. It's always clean and they host weekly character visits for the kids. It's a wonderful business to have in the area and our families favorite yogurt shop.

place_category: American (New), Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Two stars because our waitress was really delightful, otherwise a 1 star review. Our family went to Captain Bill's based on other Yelp reviews. Although I agree with other reviewers- the prices are reasonable - we were really disappointed in our food. I'm hoping it was just a bad night in the kitchen, but we won't be going back.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Soup, Sandwiches, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Barbeque, Pubs
text: Love the place love the food love the beer, get your butts down here for the best customer service ever!

place_category: Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Bakeries, Cafes
text: it's the best bakery in philadelphia ... I'm French and it is like I'm in Paris! Très bonne boulangerie mention spéciale pour la tartelette au chocolat

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian, Nightlife, Gluten-Free, Bars, Cocktail Bars
text: I've been in and out since the opening in mid November and the service has always been impeccable. The bartenders Madyson and Val have been so so so sweet to me and any guests I bring with me. They played Bright Eyes and Two Door Cinema Club and I will always come back for some good emo. Also their specialty drinks are great and you can even ask madyson to whip you up her own specialty drinks that don't disappoint.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Pizza, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars
text: The Ale Emporium did not disappoint. I'd recommend this place for a range of people. Good for family dinners, social gatherings and anything in between. I had the black jack burger which has Cajun spices and pepper jack cheese (on national burger day). Delicious. One in my party had their custom Hermanaki wings and thought those were great as well. Good service at a busy time. Friendly staff. Great selection of beer.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Bubble Tea, Taiwanese, Food
text: This place was definitely one that was very hyped up. I came in with high expectations but the food was mediocre. I ordered two appetizers (the Taiwanese chicken and calamari) which both lacked flavor and the sushi was average. The staff was very friendly but the service was extremely slow.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: An okay burger served with a cold bun and burnt coffee. Given the other reviews a surprisingly ordinary place. My partner's scrambled egg were only okay too. Girl at front desk was perfunctory if not plain rude. Waitress was fine.

place_category: Pizza, Fast Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Burgers
text: This location is convenient because I'm on the road in the wee hours and they are open 24 hours. The service is very slow overnight, but it's not a problem for me because I can work in the car while I wait. It might be something to consider if you are in a hurry.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: The happy hour prices are great and so are the tacos. The margarita's are really good and reasonably priced. Alexis is amazing and truly cares about her job and her customers. Keep up the great work and the yummy food!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Live/Raw Food
text: Set up is cool, food is good, drinks are good IF you can get one on a busy night. Bartender is so busy being elegant and graceful, he's not listening to drink orders... do better

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Seafood, Bars, Steakhouses, Nightlife
text: Amazing food and ambiance. Lobster tails are huge. Rib Eye bone in is very good. Wine pairing excellent. Duck horn wines worth the the tasting price. Rose was amazing. Our 43 Anniversary and they out did themselves . Thanks for a great dinner experience.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Fast Food
text: Store was packed, I waited in line. The menu board wasn't working and their was soda on the floor from the soda machine. Customers were patient so we just laughed it off. The manager gave me an extra breast for waiting which was nice. The breasts weren't as juicy as I'm used to, looks like they had plenty of chicken cooked in advance from what I could see. That might have affected how juicy the chick was. Mine was dry.

place_category: Restaurants, Pakistani, Indian
text: I had the "Kadai Chicken" for $8.25. This comes with rice, mango chutney, raita, mint chutney, and pickles, as well as a "chef accompaniment of the day"...Very spicy, but so good. Also had some Rosemary Naan for an all out carb explosion...Plump juicy chicken. Mmmm... Etka was just what the doctor ordered...I had it delivered and it comes with the plastic containers labeled, so there's no messing stuff up with big orders. If you like Tiffin, you'll most likely dig this place.

place_category: Delis, Restaurants, Fast Food, Food, Sandwiches, Food Delivery Services
text: Seriously awesome. What's better than JJ's delivery and Mach 4 speed? Eating in their restaurant and having it quicker! A+++ guys and gals!

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: The food here is very good, however last time I was here the service was so bad I gave them a 2. My recent experience here was much better. The food was still excellent AND the service was very good too. The waitress was very attentive and pleasant. I'm so glad things have changed here!

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Sandwiches, Salad, Seafood
text: Great atmosphere in evening. Glorified bar food. My son liked the lobster tacos. The app toasted pita w shrimp wasnt toasted. Tip to "didi" dont rill your eyes when my 12 year old politely orders condiments on side. Otherwise, you seemed to recover and service was decent.

place_category: Laotian, Vietnamese, Thai, Restaurants
text: Thai Esane is all right. The drunken noodles are not top notch and it was kind of wet. The ambience is nice though and the environment is pretty formal. The only thing is that the food is average and I wouldn't even say the Thai is not top 5 in Nashville.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: The famous Robb Report magazine voted Super Rica one of the top 150 restaurants in the world...and the number one that serves on paper plates. I've been going here regularly since 1984. This is absolutely a 5-star Mexican taqueria!! If you don't think so...good. More for us. If you've never been, GO!! Super rica is a legend. The standard by which all the other taquerias in town are measured. I've eaten at almost all of them. Super Rica "IS" the very best. I give it my highest recommendation!!

place_category: Bars, Lounges, Nightlife, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services
text: Brunch at Seven in belleville, il. Waited one hour for cold poached eggs, cold potatoes, cold biscuit and bacon. I guess the warm gravy should have been enough ... Never again

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Mexican, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Got three tacos--two steak, one carne asada. Bland flour tortillas, skimpy on the meat, and even skimpier on the cilantro and onions. In short, you'll be disappointed if you're from somewhere with a large Mexican population. Most of the crappy taquerias in Chicago or CA would run circles around this joint at half the price. Curt service to boot. Props to them for gratis chips and salsa. Boo for no free refills on soda fountain drinks.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: yes, the iced coffee was good...except one thing was missing: SOYMILK! (or any non-dairy beverage). seriously, in a city that has a fair number of vegans/vegetarians, why no dairy alternative? p.s. the bathroom is pretty nasty.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Sandwiches, Chicken Shop, Caribbean, Fast Food, Latin American
text: everything was dry, ordered through doordash and my sauces were missing. Rice and beans weren't even edible ..

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Customer service was great. Food was not. Pork pad see ew was not good at all. It was bitter, small portion, dried out meat, and overcooked noodles. The crispy spring rolls and Thai butterflies were both super disappointing. All of the sauces were watery. Food is overpriced also.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Soup, Sushi Bars, Salad
text: Not horrible. Nice decor inside. Service at the bar was terribly slow and it was very quiet on a monday night. The manager came over a couple times and helped us. The rolls didn't really appeal to me. I didn't find it very creative compared to other places. I love mango and there were no rolls with mango. Once we got the rolls it was pretty basic. No sauce even. For the price, I was a bit disappointed. No interest in returning with so many better options.

place_category: Bars, Mexican, Seafood, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Seriously the best quest. EVER! We love getting to dine here in date nights. Chips, salsa and all the great authentic eats! I typically go tacos or fajitas and my wife goes for the burrito or nachos. You won't be disappointed and you won't leave hungry!

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: Great local Dairy Queen with character - been there since the 50s. Your normal Dairy Queen fair, but you get the added benefit of thinking of all the people that have been through these doors over so many years to enjoy this great American ice cream (now offically a "dairy dessert"). Not the nicest or cleanest place, but that is what you get at an old DQ in a small town. I will be back again, but I also live here.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, German, Gastropubs, Restaurants, American (New)
text: I came for dinner on a Saturday night with my husband. The wait was an hour and thirty minutes. The open kitchen and fire were all very impressive. However, I feel kind of underwhelmed by the food itself, especially for the price. The best thing in my opinion was the roasted brussels sprouts.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Breakfast & Brunch, Brazilian, Restaurants, Food, Salad, Acai Bowls
text: Love the food but can't be in a hurry going here. Service generally pretty slow. I love the Chile sauce! House made, delicious and spicy.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Nightlife, British, American (Traditional), American (New), Chicken Wings, Bars, Pubs
text: Great fish and chips. Some of the best I've ever had. Half-order is more than enough for a normal person. Full order is probably enough for two. Saying amongst my friend and I that they have the most mediocre nachos you'll ever have. Atmosphere is nice. Decent beer list.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Burgers, Sandwiches, Desserts, Food
text: Love that they offer a vegetarian burger! Burger was a little overcooked/burnt but overall still good flavor (even though they failed to add the cheese I requested). Fries were too sweet for me, I prefer more savory flavor. I would go again for a social outing, but probably won't go out of my way to eat there again. It was just okay for me.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Pizza
text: The pizza is very good here! You get to pick the ingredints you want including extra sauce! The spicy Italian is very good! Try the roasted red peppers! The mega dough is great! The salad is also pick your ingredints also!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Specialty Food, Food, Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Nightlife, American (New), Cocktail Bars
text: Service was subpar and the food was unacceptable. We are very open-minded diners and we were more than dissatisfied and disappointed. We will NOT be back and we will definitely share our experience. We gave 1 star because the bacon chips and guacamole was good.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: My hands down fave place in town! I could drink their house salad dressing!! Its just SO good! I love their order online additions they've done. Makes getting lunch super quick and easy! The employees are so friendly!

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Tacos, Fast Food, Mexican, Burgers
text: Never again will I go there again. messed up my son's order and he's lactose intolerant! every time I go they screw up the order and don't give a receipt, called 4 times no answer. I hope less people go there. from now on I'll drive across town to a different jack in the box and the wait in the drive thru was over 20 minutes. food was cold by the time I got it.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Servers were very nice and attentive. Food was out quick and very good. Great diner spot if you are passing trough town!

place_category: Asian Fusion, Japanese, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Went to Express for happy hour. $1 for the sushi on the little boats. Not the best selection. Kind of sketchy cleanliness. Very small space. Lots of waiting people outside. Ended up ordering a sashimi plate from the full restaurant next door. Now that was amazing. Cut perfectly. This is not the best sushi place in the world but the people are friendly and it is a downtown institution.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Our go-to place for the best deep dish pizza; tonight we ordered thin crust and it was just as delicious. Prepared very quickly and service was, as always, friendly and efficient. We were pleased with attention given to safety protocols; limited seating with patrons spaced apart, masks when not eating. We have not been dining in restaurants since COVID hit - but happy to support this local favorite that provides excellent food and service while maintaining a safe environment. Thanks Pi.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Bars, Lounges, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: If I could rate it 0 starts I would. I made reservations for Sunday Brunch for 11am the time they open. We arrived on time and the place looked closed and the door was locked. About 2 minutes later a man came and told us to wait and we would get in a couple of minutes. After watching him on the phone for the next 10 minutes and not caring how long we waited we went across to the Vous and had a great brunch. Very rude and disrespectful

place_category: Grocery, Food
text: Their Kielbasa is awesome. Born and raised in Bridesburg. Now live in Ohio. Have a friend ship us 20lb several times a year.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Tapas/Small Plates
text: Great service from Nicolette - will be back! Great wine service even with a shorter list. Chicken sandwich was also killer.

place_category: Cafes, Food, Soup, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Videos & Video Game Rental, Shopping, Books, Mags, Music & Video
text: Best juice in town..wasn't able to yelp the last time I was in the area but I can today!!

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Burgers
text: This is a great hole in the wall place to eat and have a beer. The wings are really good and I have heard the burgers are great also. Been there three times when in town for travel and will eat here whenever I'm in town.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Steakhouses, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Diners, Food
text: Been to so many diners and have to say this place is awesome the food is great and service is great, coffee is the best I ever had and love Nicole and Marisol I must try dinner menu I hear is great as well can't wait to try

place_category: American (New), Southern, Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, Bars
text: Unfortunately, the service here is terrible. Every few months we try again because the food is yummy but the service is ROUGH. The servers are standing around, not attentive. Our drinks came at the end of our meal and then the sprite didn't have syrup in it. We couldn't get anyone's attention and the manager was nice but not super helpful. It takes FOREVER to get anything. Just skip it and head to Waffle House.

place_category: American (Traditional), Barbeque, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Food was excellent - service was good - loved the specials. Will visit again Loved the pickles Bread was fresh and warm

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Waited 2 and 1/2 hours to be served farm raised shrimp. There are a lot of other restaurants in the area far better!!

place_category: Sandwiches, Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: Solid Cuban Sandwich and super friendly staff! Ordered said Cuban and an Empanada Ordering is quick and easy The staff is great, outgoing The empanada wasn't great, the meat wasn't really seasoned and the dough was just so so The sandwich was very good, not the best Cuban I have ever had but certainly not the worst. The meat portion is generous, layered neatly and toasted nicely. One sandwich an empanada was around $15

place_category: Restaurants, Pan Asian, Bars, Asian Fusion, Chinese, Cocktail Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Nightlife
text: Went here for the first time today per a friend's recommendation, and loved the hip atmosphere and great service. Menu has an array of tasty options, both food and drink (sake menu is awesome). Would definitely go back!

place_category: Lounges, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Seafood, American (Traditional), Soup
text: Good for big groups and they have an amazing Happy Hour Menu! Best Seared Ahi Poke Tuna of my life!!!! I would definitely go back for Happy Hour!

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Cajun/Creole
text: I've been here several times and had decent service and food... but not today. The wait staff was all over the place! It took forever to be acknowledged, the food wasn't quality, and when I tried to get assistance, my waitress was short with me. Disappointing....

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Soup, Sandwiches, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Barbeque, Pubs
text: Rude rude rude...Flowing Tide original better. Staff got stuck up their butt..I get they busy...but not same..go to other FT...this not the one, food even not as good.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Beer Bar, Pubs, Nightlife, Bars
text: i would give the restaurant four stars but the chicken pot pie was very small.it tasted ok but too small a portion.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Wonderful food, incredibly flaky service. I've had their croissants, chicken salad, chicken vincenza pannini, and a nice poached eggs on toast with roast peppers, all of which were delicious. However, perhaps it is just being understaffed or under- trained or underpaid, but the people working there screwed up something about my order every time! I love the food and will keep going back, but you have to go in with a sense of humor and a lot of patience.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Korean, Gluten-Free, Comfort Food, Vegetarian, Vegan, Chicken Wings
text: Who doesn't love Bab?! I had the japchae appetizer (must do these slightly sweet glass noodles with meat) and the classic bab with beef. Fresh, healthy, and delicious! service was friendly. Location is in a revitalizing area. So happy to have a place like bab!

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Definitely my favorite ice cream spot in Tampa. Their flavors are delicious, the people that work there are very nice and the place is clean and cute. Scoops are huge so bring that Lactaid pill babes

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Burgers, Sports Bars, Nightlife
text: We were in town for a volleyball tournament and came here with about 15 people. Place was pretty busy but we were sat right away. Overall the food and service was pretty good but a little pricey. For 3 people, We had 2 big orders of nachos 2 draft beers and 2 mixed drinks and our bill was about $82. Good food but not worth the price.

place_category: German, Restaurants, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, French, Brasseries, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The cocktails were fantastic. I'd have drank many more French 75's if only I could have. The food was good, but it didn't knock my socks off. I'd come again for lunch, but it probably wouldn't be my first choice. I would come again for drinks any time.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Tapas/Small Plates
text: Food 4 Stars service 2 thus average 3 Went for Mother's Day and did the chefs tasting menu and thought the food was excellent, however after the first drink order we were a dry table would of ordered a few parings but our waitress was no where to be found. They need to fix service, no matter how good the food is doesn't make up for the lack of french services

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Have tried their hoagies three times. All three times the rolls were extremely dry, seemed like they had tossed the rolls in into the oven I could see having "a bad day" once, maybe even twice, but when it happened the third time, decided never again.

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: My favorite Thai place in new olreans! I love the seafood pad Thai, fried tilapia ginger, and beef salad!! Every dish is delicious! Don't forget to try the jasmine tea over ice, it's GREAT!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Decent service with a fairly good atmosphere. Unfortunately, the food is nothing special; neither great nor bad.

place_name: Z E N Thai & Japanese Cuisine
place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Thai, Japanese
text: Had veggie tempura and salmon teriyaki which was over cooked for my taste for take out. Fairly mediocre- felt it was overpriced for what it was.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: While I always enjoyed Papa Johns pizza, this store serves THE WORST I have ever had!! Will never order their food again!! Largo store is awesome! Dont order from PARK BLVD, unless you want to end up throwing your guts up!! However, on a positive note; they were very friendly and returned my money.

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Piano Bars
text: Cool atmosphere. Both indoor and outdoor seating with flaming fountains. Average food at reasonable prices. Friendly staff. I had the blackened chicken sandwich and gumbo which were both done very well. More so of a drinking establishment than restaurant

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Diners
text: Best breakfast that I've found in Boise. Very comfortable atmosphere. Be careful of the portions, you'll usually get far more than you can handle. Small parking lot, so this is a great location to ride your bike to on a morning ride. Only negative is the lack of credit acceptance... cash only here.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Unhygienic food . Not feel like eating at the place . Found hair in food . Ordered veggie dishes Tofu was really hard

place_category: Food, Specialty Food, Butcher, Meat Shops
text: I was given a gift certificate for my birthday and was all excited about it and then I went on the web sight and couldn't believe the prices! they're outrageous! Im going to say this in the nicest possible way. they triple the price of things and act like theyre doing you a favor by giving you sweet deals. In all honesty,its nothing special and shop around.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: My husband and I both ended up throwing our food away. We both had a breakfast burrito and flan. Not impressed with the food at this restaurant at all. Giving it 2 stars instead of 1 only because the cashier had excellent customer service.

place_category: Grocery, Organic Stores, Food, Farmers Market, Specialty Food, Health Markets
text: Amazing. I shop here at least once a week, so much food, options, and their prices are great! It's similar to Trader Joes but better in my opinion. Such a cute and unique grocery store.

place_category: Coffee Roasteries, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Horrific service. I ordered simple peanut butter and toast. Guess what? I got dry toast. Three times in a row with the simplest orders have been crazy mixed up! And this is at different times of the day and different days of the week. I also feel it's overpriced, crowded, and way too over-the-top.

place_category: Patisserie/Cake Shop, Food, Restaurants, Bakeries, Cafes, French
text: All four of these stars are for their meringues.they are the best things I've ever had in my mouth. Squishy and rich and amazing. Get them. Get the large or get the smaller bagged options. To die.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, American (New), Bars
text: I'll say that I'm not a big fan of the seafood but with them I really have to change my statement cause even their hamburgers are amazing.

place_category: Bagels, Food, Restaurants, Delis, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Proper bagel is expensive and nothing special. Parking is awful. I ordered a sourdough bagel with butter and fig jam with tea. After I paid, then they told me they didn't have any sourdough bagel left. The didn't offer my cancel my order a suggested an egg bagel. My tea came out and it was brewed in a coffee pot, taste nasty. My bagel was ok. Butter wasn't salted. No salt in the bagel. Over all I am not going back. Just underwhelming.

place_category: Mexican, Tacos, Tex-Mex, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Went there one night and got a shredded chicken burrito and Cinnabon Delights among other things. When I got home the burrito tasted weird and I felt like I would get sick eating it. And they forgot my Cinnabon's! My disappointment was immeasurable and my day was ruined.

place_category: Diners, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: This place came under new ownership about a year or so ago and I've had the chance to go a couple times for a late night meal. The service has been excellent and the food is good too. Its open 24/7 which is incredibly convenient and a much needed addition to that area of South Philly. I've had the Reuben Sandwich there and the Steak - would go back for both. Worth a visit if you are looking for a spot late night.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Tacos
text: I wasn't impressed by the food; the chicken burrito was bland and texture-wise it was very mushy. The taco salad with steak was also bland and overall lacking in flavor. The taco shell was oily (both in texture & flavor; the steak was well seasons and cooked though. I also tried the brussel sprouts, they weren't anything to write about really. Overpowered by the chorizo, which was really oily.

place_category: Fast Food, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caterers, Mexican
text: The staff is usually friendly, but the food is just OK. For as many ingredients that are in a burrito, it just isn't very flavorful. The location is in a convenient location being close to the IUPUI campus.

place_category: American (Traditional), Barbeque, Restaurants, Comfort Food
text: I have used Dave's prior for large catering events and have done well. I recently used for job for 850 and they not only failed but failed miserably. They were late, sent only 3 people, no paper plates. Have no idea what they were thinking. Then they took no responsibility of there lack of execution. All they said sorry. We actually had to help them serve. My event was over and they were still serving. Would not recommend for any type of catering. You have been warned.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Seafood, Dim Sum
text: Don't even bother if you're Non-Asian. We are experienced Chinese restaurant eaters, we know what we're ordering, but the waitress would not let us order certain items on the menu, like ox tripe, and tried to force sweet and sour pork and Gen tso chicken on us. We wasted a big chunk of change on NOT WHAT WE WANTED. They shouldn't even offer a menu in English. I'm really pissed.

place_category: German, Restaurants, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, French, Brasseries, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch
text: My wife and I had dinner here on August the 10th. Our waiter was "Richie Rich". He was Excellent!!! It was "Coolinary" month with a nice selection of food. I had the pork schnitzel which was cooked perfectly. We started with brussel sprouts and the serving was HUGE. Overall an enjoyable experience and LUKE is definitely one of our "top tier" restaurants in NOLA. Signed....PappaGeorgio

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Chicken Shop, Chicken Wings
text: Worst service ever. Two customers walked in, nobody acknowledged us. Waited five minutes then left. Went to Chik-Fil-A.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services
text: Didn't enjoy my vegetarian tacos. At all. Ordered salad and got rice and beans instead, which I didn't want to complain about. The rice and beans were actually the best part. Sangria was good!! Service was good.

place_category: Buffets, Seafood, Chinese, Restaurants
text: Horrible service, not many workers speak English. The air inside is terrible, no exhaust. You come out & clothes smell like smoke. Food was OK, $12 for dinner is not bad. Most people who reviewed must not know real Chinese food. Huge variety, but seems like most dishes are just thrown together!

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New)
text: TJ Smith's had great food. And lots of gluten free options which I always appreciate. I had the ribs and they were literally fall-off-the-bone tender and had great flavor. My husband had the crab ravioli which he said were amazing. We were in town for a wedding and this restaurant was right across from our hotel. We even went back a second night to grab a to-go order. I had the Aztec salad the second night and it was super tasty. I wish there was a TJ Smith's in Colorado.

place_category: Seafood, Pizza, Restaurants, Greek, Mediterranean, Italian
text: Our group of 5 had a variety that included chicken parm, veal, chicken pesto, grilled chicken Greek salad and grilled lamb with veggies. Everything was well seasoned and delicious. Service was good but server was not very personable...that's fine. Outdoor dining area is fun and has a nice view. A nice gentleman, I assume is the owner, visits every table and is very attentive. Love this place and will be back!

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Cafes
text: What a wonderful find on Yelp while traveling for work. Cute cafe with cozy decor, outstanding menu, delicious food, & fantastic service! I can't wait to come back!

place_category: Asian Fusion, Korean, Barbeque, Restaurants, Soup
text: Summary: Terrible service and food for both times I have been here. We came here for the buffet which was quite disappointing. The steak (limited to 2 requests) was a cheap cut and chewy. The ribs were pre-cooked and seemed previously frozen. The pork belly was paper thin and unflavored. The servers forgot to provide bowls and spoons for the soup.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: They must do something right with that line to get in. Surf and turf po boy was amazing. Stick to po boys. Red beans and rice with pork chop was OK to slightly below average. Cash only

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Donuts
text: Staff @ Drive Thru was extremely rude. Very difficult to understand this individual and I'm quite certain she new this and purposely made herself sound difficult to understand. Our coupon was flat out refused. I will never return to this location. My advise, find another location.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Mexican restaurants are always hard for me to review but when your 18 year old niece wants a burrito you go to one... this spot is conveniently located close to my house so we tried it out. Easy parking lots of seating and the staff is super friendly almost flirty lol so that's fun. Food is what you expect at a semi americanized Mexican restaurant. Decent nothing over the top wow factor but wasn't crap either. A good go to place for your craving of a burrito.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Burgers, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: This place could not be any sloooower if they tried. What a nightmare, being locked in line with 2 screaming toddlers for 20 minutes, just for fries and drinks. I'll wait until I get to Hamilton Town area next time.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Bakeries, Bagels, Food
text: Do not get the matcha. Easily worst matcha I've ever had. They mentioned that they got new powder, but whatever it is, it's not matcha. So bad I had to throw it away. On top of that, it was $7.56.

place_category: Bars, Burgers, American (New), American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants
text: I want to love this place. I've been some two dozen times. The location is great and the patio is nice. The reason I cannot like this place is the consistency in bad service and mediocre food. Plus they raised their food prices but that's not my issue. It's just tiring being ignored and unappreciated.

place_category: Food, Fast Food, Buffets, Indian, Restaurants, Desserts
text: Ordinary affair. The food is really greasy. But if you're a vegetarian, this is probably the only restaurant in the area that offers an all vegetarian buffet for a reasonable price of $9.99.

place_category: Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Patisserie/Cake Shop
text: Great French pastries. So glad I don't live close by. They are killers!!! Buttery, flaky, and sweet. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu.

place_category: Delis, Cheesesteaks, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: They make a good cheesesteak in this spot. They carry beer, soda, snacks, and hot and cold food. You can play the lottery here also. It's a small seating area to sit and eat your food. The salmon and rice is pretty good too! Stop in if you're around!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Total disaster of a low class pizza joint Rude staff and lousy food. Avoid at all costs

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: Food is pretty mediocre. You can get much better sushi and ramen noodles from other Japanese restaurants with the same price plus with good service and good ambience. This is a self service restaurant. Door is also broken and there's no sign anywhere to inform people. Feel bad for other people who walked away because they thought the restaurant is closed.

place_category: Diners, American (New), Restaurants, Fast Food, American (Traditional), Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch
text: This place is good, so much better than 96th street. We go to Steak'n Shake after working all night at about 1am and always great service. Especially tonight, I believe her name was Jessica, she was so nice and courteous. Definitely give her a 5/5 one of the best ones there. She went out of her way to get me a discount. If your going to Steak'n Shake after work the one in Fishers right off 116th is the place to go.

place_category: Cafes, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caterers, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: great espresso! it's super cute and could see myself getting some work done here. it's a little bit hidden, apple maps will take you to the back of the place you have to drive or walk around to the entrance. they have oat milk witch is awesome! i had an oat milk latte which was great and a chocolate croissant. it was a little bit slow but there was only one person working, so understandable.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Donuts
text: The coffee is standard, very similar to Dunkin Donuts's. Also, I'm generally not a big donut fan to begin with, but when the plain donuts from Krispy Kreme are freshly made (hot!) they're pretty freakin' good.

place_category: Seafood, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: This place has seriously gone down hill. The food while always too expensive which I expected was greasy and tasteless. While waiting for our food our waitress was sitting right next to use with some friends of hers at the other table and not tending to her tables. After eating a small portion of our food I had to hurry and pay for my meal which literally made me sick. This is such a shame I used to love Red Lobster. This location is really slacked. South County Mo is much better.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: Been here a few times and always had excellent service and cuisine. Unfortunately my last experience was not as pleasurable. While service was excellent the food was extremely salty....to the point where it was nearly inedible. I had the pork, and my wife, the cod. Equally bad. I also had pasta with a pork ragu. It must have been cooked in a dirty pan as it tasted like squid ink...another restaurant offering.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Fair at best, go if hungry and see no other options to eat. Have had a couple burritos from here. Nothing mind blowing but it cures hunger. Definitely are better Mexican options out there. Since my last visit I rarely ever see anyone in there, honestly I'm surprised it's still open.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Greek
text: It's ok. Food is not as great as the other locations! Went here for my bday had a reserved table and the rudest waitress. I wouldn't recommend this location

place_category: Restaurants, Greek, Mediterranean
text: I thoroughly enjoyed their food. By no means can I be a judge of whether it's authentic greek food or not, but I really enjoyed my dining experience. I got the greek salad and an entree. Both were super filling and very good. I would recommend this place.

place_category: Tacos, Restaurants, Mexican
text: This place used to be good. Just now got my favorite a torta and the meat was all burnt and very little meat. Hopefully they fix this. Also the new employees have a strange vibe. Not sure what's up with that.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Burgers, Sandwiches, Soup, Pubs
text: Solid on the service and atmosphere (old tap room feel). I had the fish tacos and my buddy had the grilled cheese. Both were tasty. Tossed back few coronas and tequila shots. Watched some football and headed out for a show.

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: Excellent location right at the end of Stearns Wharf. A little pricey, yes. But we really enjoyed our clam chowder and the steamed California King Crab that we devoured. Sitting outside and enjoying the fresh ocean air, eating fresh seafood - what a great lunch!

place_category: Caterers, Greek, Event Planning & Services, Steakhouses, Mediterranean, Restaurants, Kebab, Sandwiches
text: my first time here and it is INSANE! SO. GOOD. I got the normal greek salad and it comes served upon a bed of red skinned potatoes!!! SO FREAKING GOOD. only complaint...MORE POTATOES!

place_category: Food, Vegetarian, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food Delivery Services, Gluten-Free, Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Vegan
text: I'm not a vegan but met a vegan friend here. This coffee was decent and the mushroom flatbread was delicious

place_category: Burgers, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Seafood, Food
text: pretty good and much cleaner than it used to be. food was over salted making it not as enjoyable as it could have been. Service was fantastic and plenty of parking

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: The food is foul. If you want real BBQ, go to the Khyber Pass Pub in Old City. PLEASE.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Jazz & Blues, Bars, Sandwiches, Music Venues
text: We spent a lot of and were not overly impressed. To say your food was edible is not the same as saying it was good. The pork in the sandwich tasted very old and was dry. The mac and cheese could have been from a box with riplets on top -- nothing special. The oil and vinegar slaw was good, but a small portion of cabbage for over four dollars is ridiculous. For the cost, I doubt we will be back for another try.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Mediterranean, Breakfast & Brunch, Middle Eastern, Restaurants, Lebanese, Coffee & Tea, Halal
text: Good food. Pita and flat bread is worth dealing with the poor service. One item was ready 15 minutes sooner than the other and the employees just kept saying 3 more minutes.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: While traveling around New Orleans I found this restaurant. I had the red beans and rice with sausage, it was good but nothing special. The restaurant and the service was nice. Food came out a little cold though.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Active Life, Golf
text: This would be a fun course if inconsistent green speeds are your thing (some greens were playing ~12 stimp and others were playing ~8) and diseased, bumpy greens are another thing that tickles your fancy. As others have said: Greens are pathetic. Greenskeeper should be fired. Management should be ASHAMED for trying to promote this course. Views are spectacular.

place_category: American (New), Food, Specialty Food, Restaurants
text: Bombass bread bowls. Be sure to ask for a side of their pesto!!! I personally always go for their clam chowder and it slaps everytime. It's 4/5 because I still think it's overpriced

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: We got a table after 20 minutes of waiting in line. Receptionist wasn't very happy, maybe they are too busy. Our waiter was very nice and courteous toward us. We ordered seafood gumbo and combination plate of jambalaya. Bread was free. Food was decent. Portion is small and the price is slightly high. There wasn't a lot of seafood in our orders which was a surprise for us since we ordered 2 seafood dishes. Parking was horrible in french quarter so we had used uber/lift to come here.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Food and drinks are very good. I suggest making reservations. Since we didn't the service was poor. No utensils, and a drink was forgotten. I'll visit again to give them another shot.

place_category: Food, Breweries
text: "The IPAs are very sessional and excellent pop corn. Stop by the blood bank next door to take advantage of the Give a pint take a pint offer" As said by local patron Ken S.

place_name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Tampa Downtown Convention Center
place_category: Cafes, Hotels & Travel, Hotels, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services
text: This Embassy Suites really needs some TLC. Staff VERY friendly however having to wait over an hour for your room after 4pm check-in time is unacceptable. We always prefer ES (we are HH members) and this one was a big disappointment. Management did give us free dinner and drinks for our inconvenience (dinner was good). Room was lacking a good scrub down. Breakfast was awful... major salty potatoes and omelet had a gritty peanut oil taste to it. Best part of breakfast were the orange slices.

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Seafood, Bars
text: Terrible service! Server not at all attentive never received my meal after 2 requests then was given the check without asking if I was satisfied. Never again!

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: I saw this place off of the interstate near Opry Mills. Good food and great atmosphere. I'd go again.

place_category: Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Food, Gas Stations, Automotive, Restaurants, Convenience Stores
text: This has to be the most crowded Wawa I have ever seen in my life. Seriously think about it. It borders both Gay street and Market street. Most Wawa's are packed but I don't think i've ever seen one with so much traffic. I mean even 8pm on a Sunday there's a constant flow of people in there.

place_category: Burgers, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Bars, Restaurants, Seafood
text: This place has the worst waiting times ever. Waited over 140 minutes for a table for 2 when they had open seating everywhere. I'm here on vacation. I tried calling ahead of time and no one answers the phone.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Tapas Bars, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Latin American
text: Food was amazing, but the service kind of ruined our experience :( we had an awful waitress. But some others were wonderful from what we could see!

place_category: American (Traditional), Greek, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: A diner fit for Haddonfield-a little more expensive than most diners and a step up in the menu (in other words, the perfect fit for downtown Haddonfield.) The menu-lots of burgers, salads, club sandwiches, and wraps. The crab portabello melt was good and the French onion soup was decent. Come here expecting a okay meal and you will be fine.

place_category: Fast Food, Burgers, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea
text: Absolutely the worst, open 24/7 and they're out of Big Macs at 11:30? It McDonalds isn't the Big Mac a staple item? Out of baskets of fries as well? Sounds like lazy workers that simply don't want to work but still want $15/hr, it's absolutely ridiculous!!! Who's running this store anyway?? Thanks

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Asian Fusion, Fast Food
text: By far the worst Chinese food I have ever swallowed. I feel like this place serves rat food. The rice is dark brown and nasty and the chicken is dripping with fat. Honestly I took one bite and had to throw it all away. Was a complete waste of money. Don't be fooled. This place has super bad food. Trust me.

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Peruvian, Seafood
text: Excellent! Stumbled onto this gem when just looking for something different than the norm in the Citrus Park area. Great staff, great wine selection and food was very tasty. Never had Peruvian food and the wait-staff was able to describe what-was-what and made a great recommendation. WORTH looking for and getting a meal.

place_category: Nightlife, Seafood, Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Meh. Everyone always raves about these crab fries (old bay fries), so i got them. They were VERY disappointing. Very small amount of old bay seasoning on top and the fries were greasy and mushy. There is nothing else on the menu besides regular bar food. Basically average burgers with overrated fries. In addition, the ambience of the restaurant is dark and dreary. Felt like i was in a friend's garage. The service was slow and we repeatedly had to search for our server.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Most of the time I get the hot sausage on bun. Its pretty good. I also have had the seafood, which was good as well. The fish and shrimp combination was $8.95 and you get a large piece of catfish, some popcorn shrimp, fries, salad, and two pieces of buttered french bread. I honestly don't think that's a bad price at all.

place_category: Middle Eastern, Halal, Restaurants
text: Best kept secret in Bensalem!!! This may be my favorite take out in the area. Must try the chicken over rice or chicken lamb combo over rice.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional)
text: So, so good. I had the burger, which was delicious, but the bun was soggy (which takes it down a star...I'm sure there's something they can do to fix that). The fries are sooooo good. Topped it off with a baked Alaska that was the stuff really good dreams are made of. My water glass was never empty, even after they brought out the check. I'm definitely eating here again.

place_category: Sandwiches, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Lounges, Beer Bar, Burgers
text: Read the mixed reviews online but still thought I'd give this place a try. It was a waste of both time and money. Service was incredibly slow in spite of only three other tables seated in the restaurant. Food was average at best flavor wise, did not come out hot enough and both the food and drinks were way over priced. I definitely will not go back. Much better service and food in the area.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, American (Traditional), Pizza, Comfort Food, Sandwiches
text: Hard to really put what I like about the Mill, as everything there is spectacular. Parking can be a pain, but its well worth it. Rush hour especially, it can be tough, but their take out is also excellent.

place_category: Beer Gardens, Restaurants, Food, Breweries, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Gastropubs, Nightlife
text: Honestly, I have tried again and again to give this place a chance, but every visit ends up so-so. The service is slow and there is alway a long wait for food. I also attended the location for an event and the room was cramped for the amount of people attending. However, the style and the decor of the restaurant is very neat.

place_category: Sports Bars, American (New), American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants
text: The food was actually pretty good here I couldn't believe it. A lot more flavorful than I thought it would be. But it did taste extremely processed. Our service was excellent and the scenery was great as well. But I don't want to come back... but I get why guys go there lol not mad at yeah

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants, Cheesesteaks
text: Hands down the best cheese steak in Philly.. fresh, moist & flavorful! A must to visit when your in Philly!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Ramen
text: Was really great, for Vegan we ordered the eggplant buns, but you must tell them your vegan, they put spicy mayo and something else as a condiment on it and you need to omit that and egg..Tasted wonderful! We also recommend the ramen with the soy sauce wasabi broth. Order a large each because it's not overly big.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, American (New), Fast Food
text: This place went downhill ..... never going back.. burgers just are not what they use to be... it's just another McDs quality now. not very safe for Covid times either.

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Music Venues, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Just came for a beer at 1 am on a Saturday night, so I can't speak for the overall quality, but if you're looking for a chill place to just grab a drink and visit with friends, this is perfect. The booths are comfortable and plentiful, the decor is welcoming in a divey but not dirty sort of way, and the prices are cheap cheap. That's real cheap people.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: Cool atmosphere, good service, average food. Not worth the price, but the fish tanks are fun to see.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: During my year of school I've been here a half dozen times. Lunch special options are decent... Food isn't anything special and the wait/ service is really hit or miss. The only "plus side" is that the food is freshly prepared so that means you're guaranteed a bit of a wait.

place_category: Cafes, Waffles, Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea
text: It was ok. My husband liked the waffles and my chia tea was good. We did come in on a Sunday about an hour before closing. The kitchen was already starting to shut down and we had to take everything to go, which is fine. If you're in the area try it out. I just wouldn't make a special trip, but they have a great location.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: They need to invest in two iPads and speed up the ordering process. My last visit was when their air conditioning wasn't working. Long lines-slow service but great food

place_category: Dive Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, American (New), American (Traditional), Bars, Sports Bars
text: For smokers mainly. Not sure how they get around the state law against smoking in restaurants. Read the reviews about the great bar food and wanted to try them but the smoke was too obnoxious. Pass.

place_category: Fast Food, Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: I love Chipolte but this location is the worst!! Slowest service ever, the counter they make the food on disgustingly sloppy, and I don't think anyone there can actually wrap a burrito. If your in the area, just go to Qdoba and don't let this Chipolte ruin your opinion of all other Chipolte locations.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Seafood, Bars, Nightlife, Gastropubs, Restaurants, Pubs, American (New)
text: This is not your average bar food. Their attention to detail is different than most bars, they had a nice beer draft selection and the service was friendly. We will definitely return. We had mussels, oysters, tacos, devil eggs, a chicken sandwich and all was delicious!!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Cafes, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Vegan, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Beer Gardens
text: Front Street has become my new favorite brunch spot in Fishtown! The atmosphere of the outdoor garden area is gorgeous and so peaceful. Every meal I've had there has been great and the servers have been really sweet. Also bottomless coffee for $3!

place_category: Sandwiches, Gluten-Free, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: The hostess was not very personable. Asked for a booth and even though there was a booth empty and just needed to be cleaned she told us there was none available currently. Bad sign. Decor is modern and had an open seating plan. We had the Hoosier Bennie and the chicken and waffles. Both meats were overcooked and dry. The biscuits on the Bennie seemed stale and hard to cut into. Good sized portions but didnt make up for the substandard food. It will be a while if I come in again for brunch.

place_category: Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Mexican, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Had a decent burrito, or so I though... Minutes after turning on to Gandy my wife and I had to stop at CVS to destroy their toilets. Instant and violent diarrhea

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food
text: A teacher's BFF! So yummy and good for you!! The energy bomb gives you so much energy!

place_category: Local Flavor, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: One of the best stops in STL. Very worth it. Very cheap. Left from here to go to Grants Farm close by.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Custom Cakes, Desserts, Caterers
text: Small little storefront on Samson street. Establishment is very clean. Classic Ben and Jerry's flavors. Friendly staff. They also have a wide selection of pints and ice cream cakes for your enjoyment. I would definitely check it out again given they have great hours. Enjoy!

place_category: Food, Donuts, Burgers, American (Traditional), Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Their donuts are overrated. I always think they are dry. However, they do have a fried chicken biscuit that is wonderful. My SO likes that they have chocolate milk on tap.

place_category: Vietnamese, Sandwiches, Specialty Food, Food, Delis, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Ethnic Food, Restaurants
text: Great PHO & vietnamese as well as americanized sandwiches tucked into a Fred Meyer shopping mall. An unexpected treat.

place_category: Nightlife, Mexican, Bars, Restaurants
text: This is a really good Mexican place! We went during happy hour so we got some of the 2 dollar tacos. The day we went the 2 dollar tacos were the shredded meat ones on their menu. Delicious! Their special taco of the day ($3.25) was a pastor, my favorite! Marinated and grilled pork with pineapple. We also tried their queso and guacamole. My fiancé commented that the guacamole was the best he ever had. In an area where the restaurant prices are pretty high, this was a good value during happy hour.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Bakeries, Ethnic Food, Specialty Food, Food
text: Came here to escape the newly cold days - there's no seating and they have a minimum for card, just FYI! We got the pineapple bun and an egg tart. The pineapple bun was disappointing - the crust was good but the bun felt too big, and as a result, too dry for me. The tart had a great flaky crust but the custard was too sweet and I found the egg flavor lacking. I will say it is good pricing for the pastries though and perhaps we just needed to try some of the other pastries.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Good in a pinch. Over priced. Not the best sushi in town. Staff is always friendly and informative. But I won't frequent.

text: I give them 3 stars because their place is nice, but they don't know Asian food. I ordered this Korean bbq dish with ribs that came with Kim Chee. Kim Chee is served chilled unless it's stir fried into something. Disappointing! Also I'm Asian and offended.

place_category: Tacos, Restaurants, Mexican
text: The rasuraudo (sp?) was delicious. The carne asada was not. Overall not a restaurant I would visit for dining in. Uncomfortable seating and very loud music made me take my order to go. Still on the hunt for good carne asada tacos in Tucson.

place_category: Burgers, Seafood, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Had the three enchiladas meal for lunch. The food came out in a timely fashion and it was all pretty good. The flavor was fairly authentic it seemed to me. I don't eat a lot of Mexican food these days, but I'd go back.

text: On a busy Tuesday, in a well populated part of town, this place as closed for lunch. Raise prices if you need to attract more staff. And we should all tell the politicians who are ruining the supply chain and the labor pool to stop meddling and allow businesses to operate as they did before.

text: Can't touch SOHO Pizza which is right around the corner. In direct comparison to SOHO, the ingredients aren't as fresh tasting, and the dough just doesn't stack up. So this place getting 4 stars is only appropriate b/c we're in Philly.

text: This place is pretty good and has a great location. The food cake fast and the staff was attentive. The price is a little high. The chips salsa and quac were good, but I wish you got more. I got a chicken sandwhich and it was extremely small but had a good taste and a great bun.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Pizza

place_category: Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Awesome quick service. Very friendly workers. The food is consistently good and reasonably priced. I live a few blocks away and order here pretty often. Very happy this place came to town!

text: Disappointing on many levels. Far too expensive for the quality and quantity of food they serve. Basics like salsa and guacamole were severely underseasoned and tasteless. text: We went at night and it wasn't busy at all. I got samples of the Pumpkin Pie and Chocolate Del Fuego. Both really good. Ended up getting a cone of each, and they were pretty big scoops. The thing I didn't like was the diaper/bathroom smell that hit me as soon as I walked in. It was gross...

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: This is definitely the slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. I got to watch many drive-through drinks go out and finally after a solid 15 minutes I received mine. I wish 222 Artisan was closer I would never step foot in this place.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Fast Food

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Greek, Restaurants, Soup
text: There are many options for authentic Greek restaurants in Tarpon Springs and Hellas is definitely at the top of the list. Don't forget to visit the bakery!

text: I love breakfast food, and Uncle Bill's does it well. Portions are great for the price(even though breakfast food is nearly always overpriced), and the service is pretty good. While it seems like a senior living center at times, and a hammered-haven at others, every St. Louisan needs to visit Uncle Bill. My Advice: GO! You'll feel welcomed if you: Need some food after a night of double-fisting. Are Starving. Love Breakfast. Breathe.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife
text: Food is typically over-seasoned and much too salty. Our office manager would regularly pick this place for office lunches/birthdays, so I've been a number of times. place_category: Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Salad
text: The 30th Street Cosi doesn't feature anything special that sets it apart from any of the other Cosi locations in the city (say, Rittenhouse or 36th and Walnut), but it works for when I'm en route to the train and craving a hot drink or something to munch on and a WiFi friendly spot if I have time to kill. My usual if I'm sitting in for a meal is the pesto chicken melt or a chicken margherita flatbread pizza, but it's highly unlikely that will happen at this Cosi. Only if I miss my train....

I found it extremely inconvenient that they decided tell us this news until we sat down. I was extremely unsatisfied and decided to have dinner elsewhere. Needless to say I'm never going back.

place_category: Restaurants, Donuts, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: They totally helped me discover coffee. I love the staff here, they are so nice and accommodating! Oh, and the best part is they are knowledgeable about coffee, hence they helped me find my favorite drink. I never feel like they are in a rush even though the lines are CRAZY! Don't worry they knock em out quick; one girls even asks for your order while you are in line to have it ready faster. I really can't say enough about the people who work here. Obviously Dunkin Donuts trains well.

The drinks were meh. Portions and food was good but the service depending on who you get is meh at best.

And my wife ordered the grilled cheese and tomato soup. For dessert we all shared a piece of the yummy bread pudding. Great place to take the family and it's reasonably priced.

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Strolling up to town from the delightful river front area in downtown Reno we stumbled upon this bohemian little street with this small and friendly place to eat. Pot Pies and local beers. Really good meal that is all about home and hearth. Staff was very nice.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Vegetarian
text: They charged $2.50 for a 12 oz CAN of Diet Coke and the carne asada was kinda chewy...

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood

We ended up asking for two more orders of bread just for the sauce. So amazing!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Diners
