place_category: Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Bars, Food, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Burgers
text: Had the veggie burger, and it was good. The outdoor seating was nice. The deserts were amazing, especially the bread pudding.

place_category: Automotive, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Burgers, Beer Bar, Sports Bars, Breakfast & Brunch
text: We were in town from Austin for just a few days -- loved Nashville, especially since the folks we've had the pleasure of meeting are NOTHING like the staff at the ML Rose -- the rudest, most unprofessional bunch of beer slingers we've ever encountered... there are many good beer establishments in Nashville; namely, The Eastland Cafe where you not only get good food & excellent beer, but you have a good time and leave with a smile on your face!

place_category: Sports Bars, Lounges, Nightlife, Pizza, Italian, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants
text: Waited an hour and a half for a pizza even though we live 5 minutes down the street. Driver claims he was sent out of his area and ownership claims they were down a driver. Both signs of poor management. Not the first time. When you anger the locals at a place that lives off of locals, you have problems.

place_category: Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Bars, Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: We came here because there was no wait. We soon found out why. The service here is ridiculously slow. Not worth coming in and waiting forever for subpar food.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Karaoke, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Pretty bland and limited menu but their selection of beer is good. The tacos are small and not worth the $2 you pay for them.

place_category: Restaurants, Dance Clubs, Italian, Nightlife
text: Anti Military establishment- More guys than gals, Police show up at the end to harass everyone

place_category: Southern, Lounges, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole
text: I like the idea of the food but it is so poorly executed. Same goes for the drinks (bartenders range in quality and friendliness). The entertainment is fine. Enjoy the drag show but haven't seen it in a while and the space is too cramped.

place_category: Sandwiches, Vegetarian, Caribbean, Salad, Restaurants
text: Calypso Cafe is always our first stop when we visit Smashville for a Predators game! We love the black bean nachos, bbq chicken sandwiches and boija muffins!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: Very cute ambience (once you can actually find the restaurant) but the very small menu is unexciting and bland. The execution is no better. I'd stop in for a drink again if I was in the neighborhood, but I'd save my money for dinner somewhere else.

place_category: Shopping, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Nightlife, Pubs, Beer Bar, Bars, Wine Bars
text: The Tucson beer scene just quadrupled in coolness. Awesome selection in both bottles and on draft. There is even a thoughtful selection for the wine drinkers in bottles and on draft. Beautiful spot, well executed, what a gift for our community.

place_category: Tacos, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Soup, Beer Bar, Food, Mexican
text: I hate doing this but I'm demoting this place to 3 stars. The entrees are nice, the service is mostly good. The salsas are just weird. The tacos are hit or miss. Some of them are divine, almost all of them are at least ok. But about 50% of them have soaked through the bottom of the taco by the time it gets to me, and the damn thing just falls apart. That's REALLY annoying. I should have like a 5 minute grace period before my taco self destructs.

place_category: Bubble Tea, Coffee & Tea, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Shaved Ice
text: Seriously, some of these one reviewers seem sketchy to me.. Probably the owner or workers writing some of these so that they get a higher rating. Lame. Anyway, RUDE customer service coming from the owner himself!! How the eff do you TRY and turn down a 5 year old to use the bathroom after paying for drinks?! Get real! To hell with this owner and this place!

place_category: Southern, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Family owned. Super nice staff/owners. We tried the gumbo and shrimp poboys. Gumbo was good, the poboys were great!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: First time here. Not as good as I hoped it would be. Service was so so. The waitress seemed bothered. Like we we made her work. I got the steak burrito no seasoning at all. Chips and salsa were good.

place_category: Food, Convenience Stores
text: They are convenient and you can pay bills too, but when the cashier doesnt want to operate the machine he ñies and tell you the "system" is down.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers
text: As ihop goes......maybe you shouldn't put one in an old fazolis. The place is cramped and the staff simply can't keep up. It took awhile to be seated and when we were it took another 20 minutes to get our coffee and orange juice. When our food was delivered it took forever to get utensils. Plus my pancakes arrived about 15 minutes before my eggs and bacon. Really the only reason for the second star is the food was actually pretty tasty.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: So this is my first time to Philly. Me and my wife came here on a recommendation from my friend who is from Philly. Setting all my expectations aside I must say that the meat was tasteless at best. The bun was decent. A little high priced and I don't think I'll be bragging about this place. The staff was awesome and were very nice people. If it came with more cheese and maybe some seasoning I would say 5 stars.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: Food was great, and every member of our party was happy with their order. Serveice was prompt at noon on Sunday, an our waitress was friendly and attentive. Only the hostess seemed disengaged. Good meal.

place_name: Al's Corner Deli and Catering Services
place_category: Food, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Delis, Restaurants
text: I used to love anAl's but recently their service has sucked. The employees are rude and the wait is forever. If u know someone behind the counter then there is no wait but for everyone else the wait is around 20-30 minutes, which is ridiculous. The staff is very unfriendly too which they never used to be.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Pizza, Restaurants, Delis
text: Larry's is a good late night option for dining in. Other than that, there are better places. In that particular area though I'm not sure. My steak was about as good as any other "like" establishment. My gripe with Larry's was the bathroom. It was so bad I was hoping that the people that worked there actually had there own separate bathroom. They have a couple of flat screens in there which is a nice touch and an ATM. It's not a bad spot. Their cheese pizza was pretty good too.

place_category: Delis, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Bit of a greasy spoon but decent. The cheese is the Kraft kind that you can supposedly get substituted for real cheese if you ask. The servers were very helpful and friendly. The proximity to the water is quite nice though there is a large parking lot in between. As far as the general feel it is pretty typical deli style.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Nightlife, Caterers, Italian, Bars
text: On our most recent trip to Santa Barbara we stumbled upon this amazing little Italian restaurant. The second we walked in we were greeted with such kindness and an overall welcoming vibe. We sat at the bar and the martinis were on point. We ordered a Cesar salad and I asked if I could buy dressing to take home it was that good!! The service was outstanding the entire time and the food was beyond amazing. It was such a great atmosphere, I highly recommend!

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Food Trucks, Food
text: The mobile truck is currently in Whitehouse, Readington,NJ. I was excited to try the food and was not disappointed with the taste and quality. The service was trash! The women on the truck are so rude and nasty. They then have the audacity to ask you to make a selection on the iPad for a tip ranging from 15-25%. My biggest complaint-I paid $17.00 for a Connecticut lobster roll and it just did not have enough lobster for the price.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Gelato, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: I've always like the gelato here - i stop by the 13th Street location. However, have you noticed the cups have gotten much smaller! It is now $5 for a small which is barely a full scoop of normal dessert. Very sneaky...

place_category: Food, Hawaiian, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Came to try the Thai Shrimp Burger, made it a combo with fries and a drink for $10. The fries were nicely seasoned, crisp, and plentiful, but the burger was really unappetizing. The shrimp patty tasted like batter and had almost no flavor, the bread bun was soggy and not at all crisp/toasted, and the only real flavor in the burger that stood out was the slice of pineapple. It was like eating a soggy pineapple sandwich. Quite disappointed since this rather pricy menu item was recommended too.

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Cajun/Creole
text: Was in Nashville for business from Jersey, but I liked the vibe of the five points area from the last time I was in town visiting for fun. I checked the menu online and was stoked to have some peppadew deviled eggs. VOM. The eggs were SO gross. Like rubber. Chicken and waffles were decent, but I'll skip this place next time I'm in town. Service was good, waitress seemed nice and friendly. I imagine they've tried to improve in that area based on the past reviews I read about bad service.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food
text: Fast and friendly service with drive though on both sides of building . Buy local and support this amazing coffee shop !

place_category: Chicken Wings, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: I downloaded this app for the sole purpose of leaving this review. This place smelled like they wiped the tables with dirty mop water. The food came out at least 30 minutes after ordering and the plates arrived 10 minutes apart. I understand being understaffed but this was a wild experience. I've included a picture of some of the uncooked wings we received. Not sure how such a large chain can think this is acceptable. It is always like this. I will say they are friendly though.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: its cheap and quick pho on the vanderbilt campus. kind of hard to f ind and get to. But the pho is so simple man i mean they literally scoop up broth and vegetables and meat. it is pretty questionable

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: I was introduced to Pho Quyen by a Vietnamese friend and have always been impressed. It's basic, no frills, food, but it is consistent and fresh. Ordering is a breeze and prices are reasonable. For take-out, I've found it most convenient to call in an order and pick it up, even though the wait isn't very long (about 15 minutes).

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Nightlife, Sandwiches, American (New), Bars, French, Cocktail Bars
text: Stopped last weekend after Tumamoc. Staff was very uppity and made us feel like we did not belong. Food was okay, but not worth the disrespect from the staff. Will never go back.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Brazilian, American (New), French, Asian Fusion
text: I've never been here for dinner, but I've been to Lacroix's brunch several times. THE BEST brunch in the city, hands down. Better than the 4 seasons, by far! You cannot beat it. The $50-$60/per person price seems steep, but after you feast your eyes on the brunch selection, you will understand why it holds that price tag. It's a foodie's dream come true. Everything from an oyster raw bar, to foie gras mousse, to pork belly. It's worth every penny, a must try for all.

place_category: American (New), Food Trucks, Food, Street Vendors, Restaurants
text: Pulled pork sandwich to go with slaw was okay - but as a southern bbq sandwich snob, make the slaw SLAW. Don't shred cabbage and call it slaw. The pork itself was good, but the bottom part of my bun was so drenched in vinegar when I got it home it was inedible. At $8 for a sandwich, I want my entire bun. The tots are oddly teeny and sweet. The truck competition is so fierce that I might pass these guys up at the next round-up.

place_category: American (New), Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: stopped in today for a big bufford and a shake, they used to be a value added chain now they are as expensive as arby's or fudruckers, they totally screwed up the burger order and could only eat 1/2 of it because the mayo & bbq sauce were fighting eachother so much it just tasted horrid, thank god I got a milkshake to make sure no heartburn set in, called into corporate and let them know, I doubt i'll stop here again

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Was craving an awesome big burrito. Upon entering for our first time, was not very impressed. Nobody else was in there. But that's ok, that didn't stop my husband and I. Upon sitting, noticed the dirty dingy carpet. I wanted to wash my hands before eating as we had been out and about running errands all day, so I went to the restroom. Was not clean and was very uninviting. Returned back to our table and told my husband "Let's get out of here!" We left. We will never return.

place_category: Burgers, Comfort Food, Diners, Food, Restaurants, Bakeries, American (Traditional)
text: This place is just ok. In typical diner style, they make up for low quality with large quantities. They do have a decent salad bar, which pushes them from 2 stars to 3. Wait staff pleasant and professional.

place_category: Desserts, Cocktail Bars, German, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Pubs, Nightlife, Food, Beer Gardens
text: This has become a favorite breakfast/brunch spot of ours. The food has improved dramatically from a year ago or so. The restaurant section is very appropriate for kids, but sometimes they use the bierkeller for overflow and we are happy there too. They have a kids menu and crayons. I often get the traveler's delight - classic egg, seasoned potatoes (pan, not deep fried), and breakfast meat.. My husband loves their omelets. They also have a german-style breakfast with wurst that is good.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Sushi Bars
text: Decided to try this place since most sushi places are closed due to the pandemic. Ordered kani salad, gyoza and a shrimp tempura roll. Wanted to get more but they are a bit pricy. Kani salad was ok, was a bit on the dry side needed more spicy mayo in it. Gyoza was good can't really mess up fried dumplings. And the shrimp tempura was standard. Not sure if I'd try it again based on prices. I'm more of a fan of Samurai.

place_category: Food, Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Bakeries, American (Traditional), American (New)
text: Kids eat free 4 to 10pm. 7 for 7$ menu. The chicken crusted in tater tots were awesome tasting

place_category: German, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Nightlife, Bars, Beer Gardens
text: Great place to see local music and awesome German foods. I'm drinking not eating tonight watching the heartbreakers jam sessions on the Wednesday before an epic weekend of Phish at Ruoff MC. On Michigan street close to mass Avenue, Murat Theatre and within walking distance to all the good foodie joints. Beers, tacos, pizza, Irish fare and more.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood, Burgers, Tacos, Sandwiches, Mexican, Bars, Food, Beer Bar, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Nightlife
text: Great atmosphere for a relaxed lunch, but beware the bathroom line is at least 10-15 minutes long because there is only 1 for men and 1 for women. They really need to set up portable toilets for the kids because they can't wait that long and there are TONS of kids there. Because of that I probably won't be back with my family. The kids were miserable and so were the adults that had to go. Also, burgers are good but both Cobb salads that were ordered with my party were flavorless.

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood
text: We came for the char grilled oysters we have heard so much about ... They were awesome!! Fun place in the French Market, they close at 6 so don't be late like we were the first night we tried.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood
text: The restaurant was nice inside. I was disappointed when I realized they no longer offer crab or potato soup on the menu. I settled for the fish and chips it was ok, the wife had her heart set on crab so she settled for a lobster flat bread, that option was not satisfying, it was food. Most likely will not be back unless they start to offer crab again.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Large place. Was not very busy. Food was okay...nothing special really. TVs are small for that kind of sq footage. Service was fine. Lights above the tables were a bit too bright for my liking. Prices are a little higher than they should be , but that is what they are nowadays. Not a bad time, but not spectacular either. Parking lot is good..spacious!

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: This place makes one of the pizza pies I've ever had in my life! As a bonus, it's right around of where I live. But it always a really long wait, however the fact that it's always nice and it serves more than pizza makes up for it. Give this place a shot and I swear you won't regret it.

place_category: Restaurants, Mediterranean, Greek
text: Looked promising; a big meaty mass spinning in front of my eyes, cheap combos ($7 for a combo platter (chicken/gyro meat, rice, salad), cool air conditioning... all that was left was a person to serve me. Drove all the way out here to try there greek food but I waited 5 minutes for some sort of service but I saw no one. Were they in the toilet, were they playing dice in the back who know's... I'm not coming back to find out.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: The Burger was ok, not bad but I had tried some place better for that. The meat is not juicy and not as fresh, the lettuce is not fresh and they way they cut it, didn't make the burger to come out as good. The fries is normal but with their ranch, it taste pretty good This restaurant i will recommend if you are really hungry and really want to eat cheese burger at that moment and near that location (that is what happen to me) otherwise find something else

place_category: Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Wineries, American (New), Wine Tasting Room, Gluten-Free, Arts & Entertainment, Party & Event Planning, Wine Bars, Food, Seafood
text: Good spot which my wife and I love to have lunch at on the weekends. We joined the wine club to enjoy the monthly wine and the perks that come with being a member. We typically sit in bar room or the outside patio which feels more casual.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Japanese, Bars
text: Lunch special Maki is great weekend deal if your in the mood for fresh sushi and unique Japanese style brew. Tidal Wave and Super Asparagus Maki Rolls are my personal go to. Tidal Wave roll is my favorite in the menu. The honey wasabi is delish!! Crab Ragoons and Coconut Crab Soup are a must try. Sit back and enjoy!

place_category: Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Thai, Restaurants
text: The portion is small and not very tasteful for their prices. Just another Asian restaurant getting away with overpriced and average food.

place_category: Beer Gardens, Restaurants, Food, Breweries, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Gastropubs, Nightlife
text: WINGS WINGS WINGS!! Wow, these are the biggest and juiciest wings I've ever had. I live in Detroit and will drive 5 hours just for these. Their beer is great and priced right--$5-$6 pint is what you'd expect from any Brewery. I will definitely return

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Delis, Food
text: Imagine walking into a convenient store and all the employees are smiling, working hard and eager to assist you. The customers are patient, content and make you have faith in humanity.....This Wawa will crush that dream and make you want to dust off the 9mm and forget your own existence.

place_name: Jake's & Cooper's Wine Bar & Wine Shop
place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Pizza, Tapas Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Nightlife, Food, Bars
text: We went during a "restaurant week" special and still felt it was overpriced for the quality. Something was "missing" even thought they were nice enough. We won't go again but we wish them well.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Juice Bars & Smoothies, American (New), Diners, Restaurants, Food
text: Such a great, welcoming space! Service wasn't the absolute best, but I cannot complain too much: it really just feeds into the atmosphere. The unlimited soda fountain is what drew me to dine here, and it did not disappoint! Went with the Bubble Gum soda first and it was fantastic. Every flavor imaginable! Also played mini golf after dining - very fun. Excellent location for breakfast, family outing, or a date! Highly recommend :)

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Salad
text: The Garden Table is one of my favorite Indianapolis brunch spots. Perfect spot to grab brunch solo at the open seating bar area, or to take friends or family. The food is fresh, and in my experience always comes out just as it should be. The atmosphere is cute, modern, and trendy. The smoked Salmon Toast is my all time favorite 10/10

place_category: Vietnamese, Chinese, Food, Restaurants
text: My pho didn't taste bad, but it was bland. There were some things in the pho that I'd never had in pho before like fried onion. There wasn't enough fried onion to really make a difference though. The service was decent. I probably won't come back.

place_category: Desserts, Bakeries, Food, Restaurants
text: a leisurely walk around old city always includes a stop by tartes to pick up some treats. i've tried their lemon bars, key lime tarts, and chocolate chip cookies - all of which were delightful and appeared to be baked on premises inside an approximately 200 square feet shop. i hope tartes will be around for years to come, because they are a mom and pop shop that adds to old city's charm and small business owner street cred.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Cafes, Creperies, Coffee & Tea
text: Yikes I have been wanting to try this place for a long time! I went today super excited and walked about a couple minutes later There was an awful smell that was just too much to bear. The place was cute, the guy working the front was incredibly kind and welcoming but I just couldn't get over the smell and couldn't imagine eating anything that smelled like the smell . It was like really warm egg? Or old meat? Not sure but it was uncomfortable. So I left. I'll try again some other time.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: LOVE the food and the atmosphere at this place and of course the coffee. I have been to 2 of the locations and it doesn't disappoint! Will be my go to for breakfast or brunch every visit.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Casinos, Diners, American (Traditional)
text: I really wanted to like this place, I did. But the food is awful. Ordered a triple Hawaiian burger for my first meal back from playa, and it was mostly inedible. I'm 6'6"and 230#, and was returning from a week in the desert. If I don't want to eat your burger under those circumstances, there's a good chance no one will.

place_category: Southern, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Live/Raw Food, Hotels & Travel, Hotels
text: We just stopped here for drinks. The Ramos GIn Fizz was spectacular. We got that early in the evening and the bar staff seemed less then thrilled with having bar customers. He lightened up after about a half hour but it made me choose 3 stars over 4.

place_category: Tacos, Food, Restaurants, Mexican, Food Stands, Food Trucks
text: Best tacos in Tampa! If you want affordable authentic food you need to check this place out!!

place_category: Hot Dogs, Burgers, Restaurants
text: Very rude. They refused to give me a cup of tap water and told me they did not have any bottled water for sale. They told me if I wanted a cup of TAP WATER it would be $3.00.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: the portions are small and this was the most average food I've ever had. Tourist trap. Better gumbo and better value elsewhere.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Sandwiches, Chicken Shop, Caribbean, Fast Food, Latin American
text: I was excited to see what this place had to offer, I ordered 2 piece chicken with mac n' cheese and green beans. The wife had a chicken sandwich. First, our order was missing fries and the server acted as if we were bothering her with our order but finally got our fries that were ice cold, the chicken has a wonderful flavor but was dry and chewy. Very disappointed and won't go back.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants
text: We came for the lunch buffet and found the food extremely underseasoned (perhaps toned down for an American audience?). On offer that day: chicken tikka, chicken madras, tandoori chicken, aloo gobi (cauliflower and potato), aloo manchurian (Indian-Chinese potato wedges), rice, daal (lentils), etc. The best thing was the tandoori chicken (and that really was good). The naan was decent. If you focused on those two items, you can definitely get your $9.95 worth. Service was excellent.

place_category: Middle Eastern, Halal, Restaurants
text: It took me a while to try this place but once I did I ate it everyday probably for about a month!! If you haven't tried it yet make sure you do!!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Hot Dogs, Burgers, Seafood, American (Traditional)
text: Realize you are there for the beach, Little Pricey but a fun place to watch the sunset and dance, tip a cold one or grab a bite. Parking available most of the time.

place_category: Pubs, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, British, Sandwiches, American (Traditional), Burgers
text: Very average. Nothing horrible, but nothing exciting. I've been several times, always to meet friends, and usually get right in without a wait. Pub food is pretty traditional with no real standouts that I've discovered yet. I do appreciate they are open late for a late night french fry craving. The interior is spacious. Beer list is strong. Pretty boring, though, so I would come again at a friend's request, but not for any other reason.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: This place is closed. It went down hill after new owners bought it. They appear of have gone out of business.

place_category: Candy Stores, Specialty Food, Books, Mags, Music & Video, Food, Bookstores, Shopping, Local Flavor, Souvenir Shops
text: Pretty cute knick knacks and souvenirs! Also really cool to see the pralines being made. The praline itself was extremely sweet. We got the original and split it between 4 people and my friend still couldn't finish her quarter LOL. If you like sweet things, you will love these!

place_category: Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: I have been coming to this overpriced lemonade stand for way tooo long. Today I ordered my standard vegiterian burrito and came home to bite into a mouthful of chicken. If this wasnt bad enough, when I went to return it, the art history major slinging the burritos took exception to my request and told me he was feeling emotional upset at the whole exchange. VEGETARIANS STAY AWAY!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

place_name: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers and Brews
place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants
text: Used to be a great place even though a tad over priced. Waited over 1/2 an hr All burgers had stale buns that broke apart as soon as you touched them My burger was burnt The kids burger was burnt and a hockey puck ... he ate my wife's No manager to talk to We are local and this used to be a great place to take kids. We will not be back. We've had better hamburgers at Dairy Queen.

place_category: Nightlife, Sushi Bars, Bars, Lounges, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Japanese
text: I was a bit disappointed in this place. I felt that the food was overpriced for what you got and it wasn't that good (I know it's at the ballpark, but it was more the quantity that was the problem). Salmon sashimi was good, the tuna was quite chewey, and the Edamame I had was so undercooked much was not edible. The service was very friendly and fast though.

place_category: Buffets, Seafood, Chinese, Restaurants
text: Decent food for when you're a bottomless pit. Price range is a little more than I would like to pay. Being 12 dollars per adult.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Wine Bars, Lounges, American (New), Nightlife
text: Really a quaint place for dinner. Cocktails and wine were excellently paired with small bites and main course. Maincourse was outstanding however for $40 I would've expected more than 2 ounces of steak. My only complaint is it is a little bit more pricey then it should end it could be. Other than that a great experience.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Burgers
text: Decent food but it is over priced, no parking, pretty interior but no vibe. Mediocre service. Sub par drink for $15. Doesn't offer masks at the door?? Inconvenient considering My party was inside seated and I dropped my mask somewhere on the 5 minute walk to where parking was available: Maybe it's because they are struggling for business and can't afford a once cent mask. Won't be back. This made my list of places to avoid.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Restaurants, Sandwiches, American (Traditional)
text: Says it was open online, and on Google and even on the holiday hours they posted they should be open at 6pm on Tuesday Dec 28th however they are closed. Sucks for trust in the accuracy of the businesses.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Food, Cajun/Creole, Specialty Food, Comfort Food, Restaurants
text: It was our first time in Louisiana and my husband wanted a good place for gumbo. Well thanks to Yelp and the good reviews we decided to try this place. It did not disappoint at all. It is a very small place and we were skeptic at first, but everything went away as soon as we walked in. It has a 5 star service and the food is A-MA-ZING!!!

place_name: Desi Vega's Prime Burgers and Shakes
place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Salad, Steakhouses
text: Good not great. Fried pickles and wings are your typical frozen food. Burgers were ok, not much flavor. Chocolate shake was also bland.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: I had to try their cheestake one more time just can't get enough of it and of course their mash potato truffle yumm! text: Ambience at the dock great. Decent fish (about $24). Sides of chowder and coleslaw average.

place_category: Wine Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Italian, Bars, Nightlife
text: This place is awesome. The service is professional and attentive, and the food is amazing. One of my favorite restaurants in St. Louis.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Comfort Food, Diners
text: Boring bland food hardly a step up from a Denny's. I waited 2 hours on a Saturday for brunch here because some idiot told me this was the best brunch in Philadelphia, but it just turned out to be another disneyland hipster spot with far below average food.

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Comfort Food, American (New), Sandwiches, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch
text: We stopped in for breakfast on our way out of Tucson and shared the breakfast sandwich and a cronut (or was it a doughsant?). Food was Delian, coffee was good and strong, and despite the strip mall location, the patio was lovely for dining al fresco.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Active Life, Golf Lessons, Golf, Barbeque, Fitness & Instruction, Hotels, Restaurants, Hotels & Travel, Golf Cart Rentals
text: Read a prior bad review so I was apprehensive about playing here. Employees today were very friendly and easy to talk too. They were courteous and very informative about the course and amenities. Cart lady came by five times during our round! Five times! Greens and fairways were in excellent condition! Lots of OB's though! But I'm not one who cares about what I score! LoL!

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Seafood, Specialty Food, Food
text: I go here on Wednesday nights for their oyster special. Although this is a GREAT deal it is crazy packed. This wouldn't be so bad if one could just get a drink at the bar while your waiting for a table. One bartender named Nikki with an attitude: It's not the customer's fault that your boss has you working as the only bartender on the busiest night. Servers have been great once seated.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: Super quick service, really good food, had the California burger. People where pleasant, environment feels like a local mom and pops not a franchise.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Absolutely the worst service. Six of us walked into this dump and stood starring at the bartender while she walked past us several times not even acknowledging us. Then she is on her cell phone walking around aimlessly. Needless to say we all walked out.......

place_category: Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Barbeque, Caterers, American (Traditional)
text: My husband and I couldn't decide what to order so we split the City Sampler and got the corn pudding and hush puppies as our sides. It was more than enough food for two people and fairly priced. The sausage and brisket were our favorites. However, we wish the food would have been warmer and there wasn't anything over-the-top special about the sides.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: The literal best Italian in Nashville. Every employee work so hard to get orders out fast and on time. Sometimes the line looks long but it moves so quickly. Do not sleep on this place!! I always bring my out of town guests here and they rave about it!

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Sandwiches, Cocktail Bars
text: Best place for brunch in Nashville. Cheap Uber from anywhere near the city. Great staff and AMAZING food and mimosas. Fun, hip place for any occasion!! JJ the manager was incredibly down to earth and helpful.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Just visited this location for the first time tonight. Although the food was excellent as always, I probably won't return for one reason only: the size of the place. There seemed to be literally an inch between the tables. Everyone in Indiana is so polite so all I heard all night was "excuse me... Sorry... The tables are so close together... My apologies...etc". I felt like a sardine in a tin can (well, a beautifully appointed Keystone Fashion Mall inspired tin can).

place_category: Food, Health Markets, Vegetarian, Specialty Food, Salad, Restaurants
text: I love that the calories are posted, you can pick your own protein, vegetarian friendly. Every day while visiting get as the hospital I would order A rice bowl and a salad to go. This is one of the only healthy fast food places to eat near the hospital or university. Price is 12-14.50$ Meals are pre measured so there is little flexibility in removal of any ingredients, I was able to remove cheese. They also have frozen yogurt on the menu.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Sports Bars
text: I am very disappointed in this place. I used to come here a lot when my friend was the waitress and since she left I never really came back. Well after being here today I will never come back! There was a group of 4 outside and there were 3 people in the restaurant. They couldn't ir any football but local games (probably the reason no one was there). The waitress and bartender were difficult to find and food was ok.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Food, Grocery, Pubs, Nightlife, Bars, Salad
text: I'm sorry to say that I walked in to have a late lunch at 3:30pm and the tables were dirty, floors dirty, windows dirty and generally very dirty place and on top of that absent service... I own multiple restaurants else where and having a clean establishment is the most basic fundamental that customers experience first hand.. It made me only think about the cleanliness of the kitchen area and the food quality.. Again I'm sorry to have to review this but the owner needs to know..

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Food, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Poke, Acai Bowls
text: I've been once and was pretty disappointed with the sushi... It just wasn't that great, especially for the price. The flavors were a little off... I'm not sure exactly how to describe it. The place was completely empty. I only went because I had a coupon and prob won't be back.

place_name: Molly Maguire's Irish Restaurant And Pub
place_category: Sandwiches, Pubs, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Irish Pub, Restaurants, Irish, Salad
text: Average Irish themed bar with live music playing. Food ok.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers, Coffee & Tea
text: This mcdonald's is terrible. they are so mean and disrespectful, never putting the customer first. Me and my mother were just going through the drive through and when we were taking a second to respond, got rudely yelled at by the drive through worker. once we got our food the person didn't say anything to us and just shut the drive through window. once we got out of the line, my mom started crying

place_category: Malaysian, Nightlife, Bars, Salad, Cocktail Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Japanese, Restaurants, Ramen, Filipino, Pan Asian, Chinese, Asian Fusion
text: The drinks are too small and expensive, but the food is great!

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Breweries, Restaurants, American (New), Pizza
text: I'm not a big fan of these type of places, but I have to say I was pleasantly surprised. I had the Power Bowl and it was very good, fresh and flavorful. importantly they take covid seriously. Distancing was appropriate, menus were paper or on an app, and the staff kept on their masks. i felt very safe and thank them for good food, and a safe place to be.

place_category: Seafood, Chicken Shop, Restaurants, Chinese
text: Food was overpriced. Grumpy old man waited our table and gave attitude. Probably the fortune cookies were the best part of my meal. Food was garbage

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: very little taste: Expensive food that has very little taste, located near the Univ which caters to naive hungry students. I ordered some dish which I could not recognize apart that it was layered in 'grease juice' & lacked chicken. Ambiance is muted & even dirty at times.

place_category: Specialty Food, Herbs & Spices, Tours, Food, Hotels & Travel, Shopping, Candy Stores
text: Aunt Sally's has some delicious pralines, as well as a good variety of other New Orleans-y items. The staff here are very friendly and helpful. But the prices just seem ridiculously high to me. I can easily make pralines for less than half of what they charge. Some nice things though are the coffee and pastry deals in the morning. $1-2 depending on the size of your coffee. They also do a weekly business card drawing for free pralines, which I did win when they first opened, so that was nice.

place_category: Waffles, Creperies, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Great place for breakfast. Fast friendly service all was great but could use a little more effort on the breakfast potatoes. A place like this should make their own homefries.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: If you've ever had your doctor tell you that you need to cut down on salt, this is not the place fir you. They have so much salt in their food that every bite literally burns. Big disappointment.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Burgers, Sports Bars, Seafood
text: The food is good but the service is so poor! I am staying in the Hyatt, and it is conveniently located. Music is good, lots of sports, but the service is so inconsistent and so slow, that you are better off to just hit the streets and walk toward the French Quarter.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Italian, Food, Restaurants, Desserts
text: Food was very good. Had an 830 reservation and did not get food until 10pm. Our server was very busy and did not have the time. Once we complained, service was on point.

place_category: Burgers, Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Sports Bars
text: Meh is right. If you're looking for the bare minimum, Eddie's is the place for you. The food is average at best, the dining room is nearly clean, the game room mostly functions properly and is almost maintained. If you're looking for a forgettable experience, look no further.

place_category: Breweries, Bars, Nightlife, Barbeque, Restaurants, Food
text: Food was great, but the staff not so much... Everyone that worked there acted like you should know how the place worked, not friendly, and honestly looked as though they did not want to be there...

place_category: Restaurants, Soul Food, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Burgers, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: Good BBQ at a college establishment. The wings and sauce were good. The Macnow sandwich was also quite good, as was the cornbread. It has a strong college feel, but that's to be expected. Friendly staff as well.

place_category: Seafood, Food, Restaurants, Desserts, Italian
text: The pasta really was incredible, but food was over priced. The staff seemed really awkward (they wanted to be high class, but came off as a little kid playing dress up). The atmosphere was nice enough. We ordered a bottle of wine and got the wrong one (higher price same type) and didn't realize until we got the check. All and all it was good, but i've had better.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: I ordered the "Old John" single cheeseburger (no onion, please) ... and wow! Tasty, just-right juicy, good-sized, and liberal with the toppings. Price was just right. I will be back! A couple weeks earlier, I'd went to try a single hamburger at a new fast-food place near the Sun King Brewery/Fishers Test Kitchen, which is where One Trick Pony is located. That other place's burger was the same price, but small and had a much more conservative amount of toppings.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: The quality is the same as every other Starbucks and staff are friendly but the wait time was way more than typical! It was a good 10 to 15 minutes waiting in the drive-through lane... only a few cars in front of me

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Great food Sometimes the service is a little slow (based on the kitchen) during the lunch hour. Conveniently in southgate centre Meals come with 2 sides! (Sort of like original joes) Recently had the poke bowl -spicy tuna.. it was pretty spicy and i can handle spicy..so if you dont like spicy dont try it.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Seafood, Greek
text: This is the worst place I have ever eaten. Service was horrible, good was like eating dog food. Dont waist your money.

place_category: Peruvian, Restaurants
text: Mmmmm.. yucca. Great variety of Peruvian dishes but stick to the seafood entrees you will thank me later. Food: 5/5 Location: 4/5 Service: 3/5

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Pizza
text: Went here because it was closed to the IMAX... Turned out to be a great choice. The customer service is spot on and amazing. The manager and our waiter, Eddie were very attentive. The food was fabulous. I would definitely come here again.

place_category: Seafood, Salad, Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Lets get real, the restaurant business is a tough one! Everyone has different taste buds too. As far as my experience with this place in the many times we been there with family and friends, it's been a five star for all of us! They go out of the box and have a great variety to choose from. Their fresh off the menu Margaritas are fantastic without the over sweetness. No complaints so far!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Bars, Tex-Mex, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Nightlife
text: Redwood rotisserie & grill gets a B. The food is good. The prices are on the high side. The staff is friendly. The atmosphere is nice. I sat in the bar. Like the use of wood.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I walked pass the restaurant many times and always saw people casually drinking coffee at the tables outside. It does make you feel you were in Europe! This time, I finally walked in and had a quick lunch here. Very classy decor and the food was amazingly pleasant. The bread basket offers a lot of great options, and I love the slightly sweet raisin bread. I was surprised to finish my entire chicken paillard salad, as it is on a very large plate.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Local Flavor, Desserts
text: I don't like ice cream and I will eat Ted Drewes any day. A perfect place for tourists or locals. Parking can take time and the lines can be long but it moves quick and it's worth the wait!

place_category: Food, Sandwiches, Desserts, Delis, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Caterers
text: We have the cold sandwiches delivery to us several times for our Students, however I wish their bread were fresher, instead of old and very dry, If their specialties are sandwiches, they should make an effort to buy fresher bread. There are so many local bakeries is St. Louis, that they can get fresh bread from.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: I was in town for a few weeks a few years back on a business trip. My family visited me one week while down there and we stopped in here for lunch as we wanted some Chinese food. Mot was not good at all. We had bad service and the food made us all sick. Was my worst experience with food on the donelson and Nashville area during my 6 week stay.

place_category: Nightlife, British, Pubs, Bars, Indian, Restaurants
text: Always love everything at MUW. Try the curry and chicken, you won't be disappointed :-)

place_category: Vegetarian, Fast Food, Mexican, Restaurants, Tex-Mex
text: Your average chipotle. I wish that they would give a bit more rice and beans when I ask for extra but that is the only complaint I have. Fast service, typical of what you would expect from chipotle n

place_name: The Red Cedar Grill and Cocktails
place_category: American (Traditional), Seafood, Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Isabel was our waitress and she is literally why we would return- I loved the flat ironed steak but really adored the care and professionalism shown by our waitress

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: Had a burger and fries there yesterday. Everything was very fresh-- my second visit and the menu seemed much more limited than last time. Burger was juicy and quite good even though it was over cooked -- ordered medium rare -- got medium well. Fries were pretty good , too. Service was friendly and prompt. Burger was very reasonably priced for the quality. $5 . Nice clean facility. Would probably return if I were in the area.

place_category: Restaurants, Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Steakhouses, Local Flavor
text: I'm usually pretty forgiving when it comes to yelp reviews but this was one of the worst cheesesteaks I've ever had. The cheese fries were pretty good but the steak was terrible.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches
text: Fantastic pizza, great clean atmosphere, friendly staff. Don't forget the cheese cake!!!

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: Meh! Ok salads. Small portions. Very noisy. And no low carb options. Better than a high end bar.

place_category: Restaurants, Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Salad
text: Located in the downtown Reading Terminal Market, I had a mini version of their cheesesteak that had onions, cream cheese, and white American. I forgot the name they had for it, but it was tasty and I would order it again. My only comment was I thought they sorta skimped on the meat of the sandwich.

place_category: American (New), Chicken Shop, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: The food was actually quite good and the servers were terrific: Funny, friendly and energetic. The problems were twofold. First, it took over 30 minutes for our lunch to be served. Not good. Secondly, the proprietor did not do his or her homework and simply imported the Miami prices for drinks into this St Pete establishment. Again not good. The drinks were two to three times the price for drinks on Central Avenue. So the pricing definitely needs some adjusting.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Burgers, Seafood, Sports Bars
text: Here for the wings. Prettiest Hooters girls compared to what works in the Hooters in NYC and NJ. Clean good food

place_category: Tex-Mex, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Tacos
text: Best Baja taco ever! I was so pleasantly surprised by how good the food was (tin roof taco, Baja taco and brisket taco) and how friendly the staff was. I would recommend the Baja taco and the queso dip. I'd definitely go back!

place_category: Cafes, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries
text: Golden milk, yum! Avocado toast, yum! Tropical matcha and vegan PB protein bars, double yum! This is in a gorgeous location and there's also tables outside facing the courtyard. This is cute, hip coffeehouse. The only things I don't love are that it's kinda musty indoors and there's only one bathroom. Everything else is great and beautiful and I go when I'm on this side of town.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Salad, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Don't bother calling ahead or getting your place in line on line. Mismanaged from what I could see. Spilt milk at large table as you walk in. Nobody cleans it. Customer did her best with a few napkins. Employees walked by with no acknowledgment. Nothing speacial worth waiting an hour for. Servers use rags to carry out hot plates. How about using a napkin. Out of a drink that we ordered but still on bill for $21 . I won't be back. There are too manygood places around.

place_category: Salad, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Nightlife, Seafood
text: The manager had me sit at the bar for dinner, which was fine except he was rude about it. What was particularly creepy was the all-white staff and clientele in a city that's 38% Hispanic. Had I been treated better, I would have ordered a more expensive entree.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Home & Garden, Christmas Trees, Shopping
text: People are nice and it's a staple in our little town but I find it way too sweet. Very popular local establishment.

place_category: Vegan, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Tapas/Small Plates, Breakfast & Brunch, Korean, Vegetarian, Asian Fusion
text: Was excited to try this for my sons birthday but was disappointed. The ramen was overpowered by the ginger. The pork tacos were dry and after paying an extra $1 for avocado was in disbelief that they forgot it. We picked it up to go as my son was not feeling well. Will not be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Salad
text: Generally friendly staff and fresh food. I thought the prices are somewhat high however staff were pretty patient and explained menu items clearly. There are a number of places in the market to get the same type of food and I wish to have tried more of them. I would be back after exploring all other options.

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Ok at best. Definitely expected a lot more. Service was spotty at best and the food was merely ok. The dishes and glasses that came out of the back were dirty. Dirty so much that it was very off putting and gross. The coffee mugs on the table were dirty too. Get a new dishwasher folks. Not worth a visit

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New)
text: The various different flavors of Mac and cheese here are creative and fun. I always underestimate how full I get after eating here. Even though the container may look small, because you're eating a bowl of cheesy carbs, it fills you up pretty well. I do wish the prices were a little better. Paying over $10 for a small bowl of Mac and cheese seems a little excessive to me, but when you get that craving, it's a pretty good call.

place_category: Food, Breweries
text: Head to toe, might be the most pretentious beer place I have been to. The know-it-all bartender was a real turn off. Good beer but not worth the price or hassle.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Can you say MUY DELICIOUSO! Not only are the burritos cheap, but they are DELICIOUS!!!!! YUMMO! :)

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Breweries, Restaurants, American (New), Pizza
text: Came here because the pictures of the deep dish pizza look pretty good. The lettuce in the Caesar salad was old and kind of soggy. The anchovies on the Caesar salad weren't that fresh. The deep dish pizza I got was cold. Undercooked. Real disappointment I won't be back.

place_category: Donuts, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Came in on a Sunday morning with the husband to get some breakfast! Long line, but it went by fast. Pretty good donuts, but not much to choose from. Great customer service, all three men working this morning was friendly and patient with each customer. Parking lot is decent size and it's shared with other businesses.

place_category: Fast Food, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: I come here a lot because it's fairly close to my house and work. The last two times, however, they have forgotten multiple items in my order. I will not be returning to this location because I don't want to be charged for food I'm not getting, which is unfortunate because of how often I eat Cane's. They also have not been reciting the order back and I have worked at a Cane's before and I know this is a crucial step to get a correct order which they have been skipping.

place_category: Food, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, American (Traditional), Cafes, Restaurants, British, Tea Rooms
text: I went here with my family for a day out. Most of us ordered the full afternoon tea selection. The scones were good and the lemon curd was amazing. The sandwiches are made with bread that is just too thick. The fillings are hard to enjoy with so much bread.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Thai
text: Totally dead for Friday lunch. I should have left. Ordered the tom kha coconut soup. Prob the worst ive ever had anywhere. The chicken tasted funky so i never finished my meal at all. Basically the food wasnt edible. I had a few bites and asked for my check. They still made me pay. Horrible experience.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: This place has amazing ice cream, really good artisan cheese and the farm is a gorgeous place to see, support small business

place_category: Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Beer Bar
text: Had the best time here laughing and joking with the bar tenders and the clientele was most entertaining as well. Very fun place to hang out and the wings are excellent

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Tapas/Small Plates
text: I dined outside here during COVID. The sushi was phenomenal and they have so many vegetarian options rather than just a cucumber avocado roll. I also got the miso soup which was yummy. It's BYOB and they were very accommodating even when my friends and I brought a giant bag of wine.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Bars, Salad, Tapas/Small Plates, Nightlife
text: First time here and it was fantastic. Service was top notch. Our server was super attentive, knowledgeable and friendly. The owner came by to ask if everything was ok. Food was outstanding. Had the Panko crusted Hogfish and the blackened grouper both of which were excellent. Would highly recommend Mystic Fish.

place_category: Gastropubs, Nightlife, American (New), Sports Bars, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Beer Bar, German, Restaurants, Modern European
text: Never realized 30 was too old to come to a bar. Came here and got denied for being too old. By the 19 year old manager.

place_category: Gastropubs, Bars, Burgers, Pizza, Restaurants, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Cocktail Bars
text: No beer on tap. The food was good. Large portions. Good service. ... but no beer on tap.

place_category: Food, American (New), Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bagels, Cafes, Caterers, Coffee & Tea, Food, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants
text: First of all, service was extremely unfriendly which is a huge red flag considering the amount of coffee competition in this part of the city. Inside is stale and uncomfortable. Coffee was OK. Smoothie was ALL SUGAR? I didn't see a single piece of fruit put into it. Not going back.

place_category: Diners, American (New), Restaurants, Fast Food, American (Traditional), Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Horrendous service. 25 min wait in drive through and food still wasn't ready when I got to window

place_category: Steakhouses, Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: The food was good. However, they charged us a service fee %18 of the invoice total (for any party of 6 or more counting our toddler and infant!!). I wish if they clarified this once we got there, they never mentioned anything about the service fees!! I guess that doesn't include the waitress tip. We paid her extra amount. There sushi is too expensive compared to other places!!

text: This place was a little corny - decor is a little too catalog-ordered and the coffee wasn't great. Ordered a ginger marcarpone pastry that was tasty, but I just didn't feel 100% comfortable eating here.

place_category: Malaysian, Asian Fusion, Cambodian, Chinese, Restaurants, Thai
text: Good location Good help on service All workers speak Cantonese Food is good but not (Super) Restroom is 80 % clean They need put the carpet on the upper dinner area because when next table moving the chair you feel like the earth quake ! Bad set up !! I hope the owner can see this review ! Thanks !

place_category: Restaurants, Thai, Laotian, Asian Fusion
text: My group came from cali for our chruch mission trip. After successful prayer time in independence hall and liberty bell we were hoping for delicious and excellent service thai restaurant. We chose this place because yelp say its a 4-stars resto. Well unfortunately I only can give 2 stars. One star for the ambiance of the restaurant and one more star for the cleanliness of the restroom. Thats all folks. Hope this can be helpful for everyone who wants to come visit this restaurant.

place_category: Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bakeries, Food, Diners, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers
text: This place is cute and everything seemed made in-house rather than out of a freezer like franchise diners. Our waitress was friendly and attentive. I had a patty melt, fries, and a chocolate Coke for $13 including the tip. I would rate it higher but it was a little pricey and my patty melt was very dry. We will probably go back and keep trying things to see what we like best!

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Bakeries, Food, Sandwiches, Soup, Salad, Bagels, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Just your run of the mill Panera Bread. It was clean and busy but I had no issues getting served in a timely fashion. Surprisingly they had both loaves of bread I wanted. Plenty of parking and it's located in a little strip mall along a main road. Not much else to say about this location. Panera's are really a hit or miss but this one so far has been okay.

I have decided not to visit this restaurant a third time due to their ability to walk by a partly disabled customer three times & not even ask what they want to drink or provide the endless lunch menu!

I asked to talk to the manager about it, and after waiting in vain for some time for him to show up, I gave up and left. Never returning again.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Diners
text: We were lucky to get patio seating. A little hiccup in the beginning where no one knew who our server was. After about 15 mins of waiting we asked and had a good experience after that. The breakfast salad was refreshing, avocado toast so yummy! And the vegetable hash was wonderful. The Bloody Mary was delicious. I was really happy we found this place!

place_category: Food, Bubble Tea, Restaurants, Ramen, Japanese
text: Always amazing for takeout!! Can't wait to dine in! I always get the spicy miso with extra spicy oil and extra bok choy. Pro tip is to save the broth and get extra noodles for $3.50- that way you can make two meals out of one.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: A slice of pizza is tiny, and it's pretty expensive if you want to leave feeling full. I wasn't a fan of the thin crust, and because of the rectangular pizza, I feel that there's less crust per slice, but the crust is my favorite part. Not bad, but not somewhere I'd visit again.

place_category: Shopping, Discount Store, Food, Fashion, Home & Garden, Department Stores, Grocery, Furniture Stores, Electronics
text: LaShay's demeanor and attitude was condescending and rude. She seem to have no problem with the other customers and was quite friendly to them, but I can't help but notice her terse attitude towards me. Aside from that, all other employees were excellent.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: They always take tooooooo long. Two stars because I still like asian food and there isn't much in IV

place_category: Japanese, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Ramen, Restaurants
text: This place is small and and dose not have a huge menu. But what they offer is unique and flavorful! Some of the best ramen I have had! They have a few vegetarian options as well. I will definitely be coming back next time I am in town!

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Dined there and all our dishes were over cooked. Cooking fish is not rocket science. The water tasted like the smell of an old sour dish rag.

place_category: Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, American (New), Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Food
text: I love BBW but this location just doesn't do it for me. It's something with the staff. The most recent visit was good. Our waitress was attentive but the overall vibe is different. I'll probably check out the Elmwood location soon to see how it compares.

place_category: Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: They all seem to have an attitude. The only nice people are the people cleaning the tables. The servers need to learn proper customer service etiquette.

place_category: Sandwiches, Hot Dogs, Restaurants, Salad, Burgers
text: Went with a group and everyone appeared to enjoy their meals, especially the desserts. My dining companion and I split the Portobello Mushroom sandwich and the Grilled Tuna sandwich but we both got an order of Onion Rings. While I combined my two half sandwiches into one very tasty Portobello & Grilled Tuna sandwich, he ate his separately and we both enjoyed them. The onion rings are nice and crispy and we were glad we each got our own order rather than sharing them.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Small portions for the price. Menu items sound good but plating left me feeling like I wanted to ask for more. One slice of toast with my omlette, approx. 1/3 cup of roasted potatoes. Rather drive to Mavern and have breakfast at the King Steet Grill.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners, Fast Food, American (New), Juice Bars & Smoothies, Breakfast & Brunch, Steakhouses, Food, Burgers, American (Traditional)
text: I don't know what happened to this Steak N-Shake. Two years ago it was my favorite place to eat and then they served me food that was so disgusting I haven't been able to even drive past the restaurant without getting an upset stomach. They forgot the shake one visit and gave it to me at the end when we were paying to leave. They put so much mustard on a hamburger it was dripping off. Blargh!

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Hot Dogs, Food, Burgers, Chicken Shop, Salad
text: 3 stars for the staff not the food, we were there few minutes b4 close and they were very happy to take our order didnt act all grumpy. The burgers however were extremely greasy to the point that we cudnt finish half of the sandwich. It was a little too much grease, fries were great tho

place_category: Sushi Bars, Seafood, Restaurants
text: First time here and the service was amazing ! Our server Hannah took care of us really well . She made us feel very welcome ! Definitely a spot to check out!

place_category: Pakistani, Indian, Restaurants, Food, Food Delivery Services, Vegetarian
text: I was just there. We ordered Gobi Manchurian, Samosa, Chicken Tikka Masala, Saag Paneer and Chloe. Gobi appetizer and Chloe was great but the cream used in Chicken Tikka Masala and Saag Paneer was disgusting and expired. We took three bites and paid the bill at the counter and left everything on the table. The service was great but some of the food was disgusting.

place_category: Nightlife, Chicken Wings, Bars, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Restaurants

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Donuts, Bagels, Food

place_category: Singaporean, Malaysian, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Thai, Asian Fusion
text: A friend and I went here for dinner, she actually recommended it. We ordered vegetable egg rolls and shrimp pad Thai. The spring rolls were ok, but the shrimp pad Thai was just awful. place_category: Burgers, American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Late night stop for an after-concert bite to eat. Friendly staff, even though it was an hour to closing. Had a burger - rare- as requested. Juicy and tasty with bacon and cheese. Fries were crispy and fresh. Nice selection of tap beer. For a chain and location, it was good.

place_category: Food Delivery Services, Food, Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: solid contributor to the relief effort during domestic famines its a decent pizza, at a decent price, delivered at a decent time. its a pizza joint, stick to the pizzas. Their appetizer game is weak.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Specialty Food, Food, Health Markets, Grocery, Caterers, Organic Stores
text: Whole Food being right across from the museum made it an easy an inexpensive place to grab a light bite for lunch. Not the best Whole Foods I've been to though. The salad bar did not have that great a selection although I made it work. As expected, a not to big salad still cost close to $10.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: Pleasant and friendly staff, average price for Main Line area. The only thing that brings their rating down is their relatively narrow selection.

place_category: Latin American, Caribbean, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Great service and food! I love coming here for a girls night out. I love their drink menu and appreciate the complimentary soup before the meal. The space here is chic with a Latin American flair. I would definitely recommend this place for a more upscale dining experience for those who are leaning towards culinary diversity.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Comfort Food
text: Dissapointed. We had a reservation for 20. So they knew to expect a large party but we were all served at different times. Food was cold, under cooked. Nothing to brag about.

place_category: Fast Food, Coffee & Tea, Burgers, Restaurants, Food
text: This McDonald's is fine. We went, and it's clean, comfortable seating, etc. We had Chicken McNuggets and a McFlurry for the kids. All fine. place_category: American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Arts & Entertainment, Burgers, American (New), Music Venues, Nightlife, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants

I do like this place however so I will be back.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Noodles, Vegetarian
text: I love the food here. I always get the crab fried rice, and I CRAVE it all the time.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: For an airport restaurant I was pretty impressed. The waitress was fantastic. I had the prime rib sandwich and it was very tasty. Had a nice beer selection as well. I would definitely eat here while at the airport.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, Bars, Italian, Nightlife
text: It's been a while, but still 5 stars. The food all around our table was excellent, and the service was too. I really don't need to adjust my previous review, just say that the quality is still the same.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, American (New), Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, American (Traditional)
text: Stopped by for our favorites. Spicy Crispy Chicken Sandwich for me and Lorenza got her Usual Frisco melt. Coupons for free soft drink for me and a milkshake for her. place_category: Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Seafood, Buffets, American (New), Resorts, Hotels & Travel, Sushi Bars, Breakfast & Brunch

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Comfort Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits

place_category: Chinese, Soup, Restaurants, Noodles

place_category: Ethnic Food, Italian, Wine Bars, Bars, Food, Restaurants, Pizza, Specialty Food, Nightlife, Gluten-Free
text: Gluten free fantasyland! my daughter and i have to eat gluten free, so we heard about Mangia and were excited to give it a try. We were not disappointed! My family of four dined there on a Monday night, and had the absolute best service. The food was incredible, we were thoroughly impressed. so very nice to be able to eat "normal" italian food that was gluten free! we will be back many times for sure!! don't miss dessert!!

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
