place_category: Food, Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Desserts
text: Best Lemon Bar I have ever had! No lies here. The cupcakes are good as well but the Lemon Bar stole the show. I am not a fan of deserts but this place helps me lean closer to changing that. the entrees are also good here, but don't expect the food to be simple. the eclectic flavors of each dish will keep your taste buds excited.

place_category: Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Bagels
text: I'm sorry but what kind of coffee shop opens at 9am on weekdays and 10am on weekends. Coffee EVI used to be my go-to spot but now I never go because they aren't open when most people (at least people who work) want to get coffee. Certainly not catering to your client base, that's for sure

place_category: Seafood, Chicken Wings, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Soul Food
text: Unseasoned, soggy fried even the juices were bad worse $45 I ever spent.... Hold up the greens were good that's for one star

place_name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Tampa Airport Westshore
place_category: Hotels & Travel, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Hotels
text: I wouldn't even give this 1 star!!! From asking for towels for showering MULTIPLE times, not having housekeeping for over 3 days even when we requested it, and not having any toilet paper, and not to mention the big black hair ball on the tile floor upon arrival- I am thoroughly disgusted with the filthy stained carpeting as well and the incompetence of the management on duty, Ariance. He couldn't be more unprofessional.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Wraps, Food, Italian, Bakeries, Local Flavor, Restaurants
text: The food is amazing and always tastes fresh. We usually call in the order on our way to work and pick it up 10 minutes later. Staff is always friendly and their desserts are epic! Great place to get a big sandwich. Their Turkey Avacado panini is our favorite.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Seafood, Diners, Sushi Bars
text: Best sushi place around! Pricey but worth it. My friend and I easily spent $90 including tip for just the two of us. But the rolls were AMAZING. If you have a little money to splurge, go spoil yourself with this delicious sushi.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: Origami Sushi promises years of family-owned business experience and highly competitive prices that allows anyone who is either a Sushi Novice, a Sashimi expert or a Sake connisseuer a mature and pleasant experience for an extremely fair price. The lunch specials are unbeatable, the atmosphere very hospitable. This hole in the wall sandwiched between a Pool shop and a Walgreens has wonderful potential.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Italian, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Came here for dinner and drinks with friends. Food was paced awkwardly and two of the four entrees were not hot at all. I had potato leek soup and a risotto situation with pumpkin. My food was completely fine but I was not super impressed. One thing I did like were the beer cocktails they had available. I tried the "Gentleman and Scholar," with Yards Love Stout, Gentleman Jack and Cola. If I lived anywhere near here I may frequent it, but for now its one then done.

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Bars, Restaurants, Pubs, Beer Bar, American (New), Nightlife
text: Nice place to hang out and drink different types of beer! Weekends, if not early, usually you're standing. Service is ok too.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Ramen
text: Solid ramen place. Broth had good flavor, quality Of the pork belly is only ok. Nice and cheap, fast service. Decor is bland.

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, Food, Bars, Burgers, Pubs, Brewpubs, Nightlife
text: I stopped in here a couple of times the past few weeks and I find the beer and service just so so. It is worth a stop by for a beer if you are walking down Washington Street but there are some other better choices nearby.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Yuuuukkkk! Soggy french fries, chicken had watered down sauce. The other person with me had the upgrade of the loaded french fries - they tasted horrible. I have been to other Wing Stops in other states and this was down right disgusting! We didn't even ask for our money back - that's how disgusted we were. And later that night we were both hit with horrible indegestion, heart burn, were those fries old? Don't waste your time or money here.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Pizza, Salad
text: Food, beer selection and service all get 5 stars! We ordered the bruschetta and a supreme pizza, both were delicious. They have a great selection of local brews and they are family friendly. This place is a great addition to Fountain square and we will definitely be back!

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Mexican, Pubs, Sushi Bars, Sandwiches, Nightlife
text: One of my favorite places to go on the north side! Met up with a group of work friends for drinks and dinner. I love the environment and it's a great place if you have a large group. You must try their Crab Rangoon sushi roll. It is absolutely amazing. I've also been to almost every sushi restaurant in Indy and I've never came across a crab rangoon roll.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Burgers, Sandwiches
text: Wonderful service and food. A bit on the salty side, but tasty nonetheless. The waffle fries were fried to perfection, and zia-ing them added a nice touch. The wings were delicious, although I wish they had been a tad bit crispier. Very messy to eat, but they provided wipes which was nice. Then the main event. I love a good pretzel bun, and suffice to say, I was satisfied. The burger was cooked beautifully and was dripping juices upon consumption. Well done!

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Great Service. Work close by and eat here occasionally. Sandwiches are good, wouldn't say the best but like supporting this place. Sometimes have to wait 10 mins but usually that's a good sign for any restaurant. Don't care for the tuna sandwich though, it's not what I expected at all. Food is a little spicy and had cheese sauce on most items. Bread is my only complaint as its too crunchy.

place_category: Mobile Phones, Grocery, Shopping, Department Stores, Fashion, Electronics, Food
text: First just let me say you should be able to give a negative rating, at least a 0. I got to the store at 9:25 pm, store closes at 10. I asked repeatedly for help but by the time I got help I had to leave because they were closing. On top of that I was treated with ignorance. I'll NEVER be back to WalMart again. Your employees suck and act like they're hanging on the corner.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Server was fantastic. Food was good. Adult beverages wee a great price for happy hour. Shut the damn doors and let the A.C. work. Too warm to enjoy the company.

place_category: Cafes, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Blackberry French Toast (a special) was e'special'ly stupendous. 1.5 hour wait was not too fun after 1 hour was advertised. Logistics for getting people into the restaurant was clearly wanting, HOWEVER, once seated, the experience from begining to end was seamless- with the chef coming over to check on us. Looks like a place with alot of promise.

place_category: Food, American (New), Restaurants, Bars, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Coffee & Tea
text: Very nice looking cafe, I ordered a coffee, oatmeal with berries, and a coconut macaroon. The coffee was very good, however the oatmeal was not hot at all. The macaroon was very good. Overall I'm willing to return to try other items, but they have to be diligent in checking food temperatures before serving the customer.

place_category: Bars, Mexican, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: get the los agaves enchiladas with halibut and shrimp! AMAZING! Had these enchiladas 3 years ago and still remember it. Quality at this location is just as good as the others. I got to go back a few weeks ago and it was the same as I remembered. Also, love their salsa bar. Salsa bars seem to be a big thing in Santa Barbara

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Italian, Restaurants, American (New)
text: this was the worst meal ive ever had. my girlfriend ordered a hot dog that was cold and had to be sent back. i ordered the cubano and it was just awful. loaded with mustard, terrible ham and pork....i would not recommend this place to anyone

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants, Soup, Salad, Food
text: Went here today for lunch with a big group of friends. Great place for lunch! It's very clean and the service was quick. I got #11 Chicken and Roasted Red Pepper on focaccia bread, which was amazing! Loved the honey mustard. The honey mustard is more honey than mustard but still has the mustard-y kick. The basil was really fresh as well and added a lot to the taste. My friend had the Curry Chicken Salad and liked it as well!

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Italian
text: I placed a carry out order of the things I ordered was a Caesar salad. The salad was TINY (significantly smaller than a typical side salad) and absolutely not worth the $13. A salad this size should be $3-5. This was extremely frustrating and I will likely not place a carry out order again. This does not align with the experiences I've had dining in and I am extremely disappointed. However, everything did still taste good!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, American (New), Southern, Restaurants
text: Decent tasting food (fairly unoriginal flavors and lacking salt/pepper) with fairly high prices for what it is. Nice ambience and really great service. Recommend buttermilk fried chicken with snap peas for dinner and banana pudding cake with vanilla wafers for dessert. Skip the BBQ shrimp and Nola Caesar salad. As a side note, bathrooms are really dirty and unkempt...doesn't fit with level of rest of the place.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: Came here with one goal in mind, to drink margaritas,and that I did. I would say the guava was definitely the best flavored margarita, but I wish it was slightly stronger and that there was an option for frozen. For dinner I got the Korean rib tacos, while good I don't think that the pear salsa was on the tacos. I also got the spicy tuna guacamole, which was delicious, but I hoped for a larger serving beings it was $15. Overall the food was good but hoping for bigger portions for the prices.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Burgers, Nightlife, Bars, Gastropubs, Pubs, Sports Bars
text: Went there tonite. Had an awesome experience as always. Great food and even better service. Karlie was the most knowledgeable and best bartender we have ever had. She taught us about drinks and was very helpful in letting us know what was the best choice. I would recommend this place to anyone who is in tampa

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Delis, Burgers, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Local Flavor
text: Just had a cheesesteak at Sonny's for the first time. Very good. A lot of steak, good crusty bread and of course 'whiz. Not the same "experience" as Gino's or Pat's but the steak is very good.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: The food's got big portion pho sho but the quality is meh. The noodles kind of broke into small pieces. The other add-ons are good. Not too expensive compare to other restaurants in center city. The Vietnamese ice coffee is good, just a bit too sweet.

place_category: Pubs, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Desserts, Food, Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Italian, American (New)
text: A true historic restaurannt with authentic atmosphere, good service and food.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, Sandwiches
text: My husband and I grabbed a quick lunch here, and it was a solidly decent lunch. I would give it 3 and 1/2 stars if that was an option. The meat mixture for each sandwich was pretty tasty. I found the meat-to-bread ratio seemed a bit off; the bread was too thick. The meat mixture could also have used a little more veggies (onions, mushrooms, peppers). We got onion rings that were not bad as well. Over all, a filling meal that was quick and tasty.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Japanese
text: The reef was down by the river, the view was nice,. I really love Sushi especially when it is fresh and when it's very cold hot fish is not good unless it fried, at the reef it was at times a little warn, it was still good and the service was fine, Reggie was great quick on his feet. It's a little different from what I'm use to.

place_category: American (New), Indian, Event Planning & Services, Pakistani, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Caterers
text: Mediocre quality food and service. They can do much better with the quality with a teeny bit off effort

place_category: Ramen, Restaurants, Japanese
text: The food was mediocre at best. I'm not sure if it was just an off day or what, but nothing we ordered was any better than just ok.

place_category: American (New), Food, Specialty Food, Restaurants
text: This place is awesome! I'm a fan of soup bread bowls so this hit the spot. You get so much food and for a good price, and you can make it however you want. Good, quick service, and very unique idea. Got the Hangover which was soo so good, highly recommend. I'll be back.

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Barbeque, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: There are no options for vegetarians in the menu for entree, but they will always make vegetarian pasta with angel hair pasta, which is pretty good. Food is usually good, but it's way better over the weekends. The profiteroles and bread pudding are excellent choices for dessert and they have $2 martinis on weekdays.

place_category: Restaurants, Cantonese, Soup, Noodles, Chinese
text: Have been there many of times with no problem. I called in order and the lady that was working asked me how long before I come to pick it up. I said I right around the corner. I was working and not 15 minutes later she calls me to tell me to come get the food. Never had a restaurant call me only after 15 minutes to see if I was till coming. Basically I felt like she didn't trust me possibly because of my race. Never going back, sorry Chef Ma, she ruined it!

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Asian Fusion, Sandwiches, Seafood, Steakhouses
text: Service was ok. Oysters were ok besides the part where I was constantly chewing on shells and the mussels were also not cleaned.. I'm giving it a three because they did try to correct it...

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Delis
text: **WHY 3 STARS?** I'm a froyo snob. I can be picky about everything, even frozen yogurt. I happen to come from the land where the trend originated where there's frozen yogurt served around every corner. The yogurt here is not bad, but it's like every other self-serve place I've tried. Lots of toppings and flavor selections, but I'll still have my Pinkberry any day. **Recommend?** Sure, why not? I wouldn't go out of my way to come here though.

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, Steakhouses

place_category: Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Specialty Food, Restaurants, Health Markets, Cafes, American (New), Coffee & Tea
text: Ugh. I don't know how this non-dining experience could have been worse. Hostess sat us at the bar on very uncomfortable stools. After 15 minutes, she sat us at an uncomfortable booth that had been empty the whole time. She boasted a photographic memory, so I guess she remembered that no wait staff came for another 15 minutes. Menu looked interesting but we couldn't get service. Finished a beverage and left. Oh yes, they had only one kind of light beer. I just didn't like those people.

place_category: Soup, Cafes, Sandwiches, Salad, Restaurants
text: The food was fine, but it took over half an hour to receive our food. Perhaps after a few months this location will figure out how to function more effectively, but until then plan to spend at least an hour if you come here.

place_category: Food, Local Flavor, Breweries
text: I consider this place a "Carmel dive bar"!! It's a small but enjoyable place!! You see a lot of colorful people there!! When it's nice out they have an outdoor area with 2 fire pits, and tons of seating!! They usually have live music. You can bring your dogs (outside only)!! They don't have a huge selection of beers but I have never had a bad beer there!! This is a great place to just chill with friends and enjoy a good beer and the nice weather!!

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Barbeque, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: I was a little disappointed. I went here for their Sunday jazz brunch. The soft shell crab sliders were not very good. They had a VERY fishy flavor....not a normal flavor for soft shell crabs. My boyfriend had some sort of sausage hash. He liked it, but said it was nothing special. Overall, the jazzy atmosphere was great, but the food wasn't worth the price. If you like bread pudding you should order it for dessert; just beware, it's filled with raisins, so you better like raisins.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Mexican
text: Love this place, used to be incredibly consistent even with covid and always great food. Sadly the past few visits have been lack luster, chicken has become extremely oily and over cooked, beans and rice still good, salsa hasn't been consistent either. Some days it lacks spice and heat, other days it really packs a good punch but the quality has definitely gone down, which is a shame.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Ramen, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Love this place! The rolls are great one of the best is the beach roll. They also have a good spicy beef ramen. It can get a bit pricey but definitely worth it.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Fast Food, Food
text: Me being a vegetarian makes it difficult to eat in food courts, but when I saw chipotle I figured I could make something I'd like. The lady who had been working the register came to me with great energy wanting to help me. I was so happy with her suggestions and kindness and it was a delicious tofu bowl I really enjoyed. I had a great experience and I'm glad I can stop by here when I'm nearby. Seemed to me to be a great place, and would recommend this to friends.

place_category: Thai, Food, Fast Food, Asian Fusion, Specialty Food, Ethnic Food, Chinese, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Love this place. This is my usual go-to spot if I don't feel like cooking after working late. Quality has been very consistent. Tons of options to choose from, ranging from soup noodles, to fried noodles to rice dishes. I have trouble deciding every time while lining up. One of my favorite options in my hood when it comes to quick eatery

place_name: Catch 22 Craft Kitchen and Tap House - Mt Juliet
place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Gastropubs, Pubs, Nightlife, American (New)
text: The pork rinds were really good. The double burger was two small hamburger lumps thats was ok but very small and again just ok. The fish was good and so was the grilled cheese but it was super heavy. The tomato soup was good. i guess it all wasn't bad but i wouldnt travel out of my way for it. but if u like pork rinds that are fresh made there is none better.

text: 3 star rating due to the fact we had a server that actually gave my dirty used fork to another person at my table- and when I brought to his attention - he brushed me off. The food was great- otherwise staff was helpful. Kristen the manager took us on a tour- and she was so personable and took her time with us even though the restaurant was busy. Food was solid.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food

text: I really wanted some gumbo and boiled shrimp but I am highly disappointed, the gumbo is burnt, the rice is hard as hell and the shrimp are beyond over cooked

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: This place has so much potential if they'd do some quality control. Stale bread and old (not in a good way) wine (at $15 a glass).. not to mention using some sort of oil blend for dipping sauce instead of pure evoo. With prices like theirs, they shouldn't be skimping on something as simple as dipping sauce. Makes you wonder where else they're skimping.

place_category: Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Shaved Ice, Food
text: This area needed an ice cream spot since having ribs takes a lot out of you up the street. Its menu offerings are pretty extensive - ice cream, funnel cakes, snocones. Sadly they show they are still a new store and getting things to flow well from ordering to executing. I hope they get the kinks worked out because the ladies there are really nice. So stick with the ice cream till they get their quality control worked out.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Vegetarian, Tex-Mex, Gluten-Free
text: The service was really slow (took almost 2 hours for lunch) and then they got my order wrong. The food was just ok. We came as a group from a conference and they wouldn't let us split up the bill even though we all needed receipts to expense the meal. Would not recommend this restaurant when there so many better ones around.

place_category: Mexican, Latin American, Historical Tours, Bars, Seafood, Tours, Restaurants, Hotels & Travel, Nightlife
text: This place is amazing. The food is top notch and best quality Mexican cuisine within a 20 mile radius. It gets very busy so plan your meal wisely. I would recommend the Chicken Fajitas or Enchiladas Suizas.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Fish & Chips
text: I'll keep this breif.. prices went up. Quality down. And portions less. Kinda gross they leave the hot sauce out till it's almost empty. The tops are all crusted and bottles have old fingerprints and hand stains of old food. How cheap can you be. Throw away a bottle with less than a inch in the bottle. Way past the half empty vs half full question. For 13 bucks I'll go elsewhere. Trident down the road is the same price and fish and chips are fantastic

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Seafood, American (New), Steakhouses, Lounges
text: Excellent service~ nice environment and good margarita, the food are small portions, and steak and salad are too salty

place_category: Sandwiches, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: I agree with Bill C. about Arby's-E'ville. For years, we've used it an inexpensive and quick dining option for large groups. The food is good, including salads and market-fresh sandwiches. There's a web menu optimized for mobile browsing, w/nutritional info when I want to know about calories or fat content. Some days, however, there's nothing quite as satisfying as the original RB, extra horsey sauce on mine.

place_category: Steakhouses, Sushi Bars, Buffets, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Good tender prime rib, while the rest of the food is just blah. But since there aren't really any other better options around, this place is pretty decent. Furthermore, just eating a plate of beef alone is worth the buck! Okay, maybe their crepe bar is good too. But that is all.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: The last couple times I've visited, I was struck by how much I feel like whoever is running the kitchen is bored and apathetic. I found multiple yucky lettuce leaves in my salad, and a fish sandwich had 3 times as much bread as fish. That added to the fact that the hostess was engrossed in a conversation with another staffer when we walked in and it took her a couple minutes to look up and say hello and seat us... I'm not going to rush back anytime soon.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Bagels, Breakfast & Brunch, Food
text: The bagels are, I think, really pretty good when they're fresh, and they're usually fresh. The people who run it really work hard to keep the line moving, but the experience can be a bit hectic as a result. It's not their fault that they're understaffed.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: I don't normally leave bad reviews, but longest wait in a drive thru for only 2 cars in front of us. The reason why I'm even leaving a review is the customer service was just flat. The lady taking care of us should have a least smiles or something. We didn't get an apology or anything.

place_category: Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Restaurants, Bars
text: We ate BBQ at three top recommended places in Nashville. We both agree this was the biggest disappointment. Where's the flavor? Ribs were dry and the rub left a fake, stale flavor. The green beans and baked beans tasted straight from the can and the coleslaw had no personality. However, as everywhere in Nashville, the staff was very nice. I'd vote Jack's BBQ my favorite because I really enjoyed their sides and variety of sauces and my hubby votes Martin's for the juicy brisket.

place_category: Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Seafood, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Cocktail Bars
text: I went to dinner last night and frankly was disappointed! I had a pork chop that was too tough, was served with polenta that was too salty and Brussels sprouts that were not fully cooked! My wife was happy with the She Crab bisque and the lobster appetizer!

place_category: Buffets, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: I was pleasantly surprised by this Golden Corral!!! All the food was hot. Soup was was very tasty!! Salads were icy cold. Wait staff was excellent!! This is not gourmet food but I think it beats the Chinese buffets by a long shot. This is comfort food......ham in your string beans country good!!! I loved the chocolate fondue :)

place_category: Cafes, American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Another Break Egg is my home away from home. Living so close I come here at least once a month. The bartender Michael is always so accommodating and friendly. The staff is so welcoming. A true southern charm in this place. Hands down the shrimp and grits are AMAZING. Highly recommend to anyone who enjoys brunch as much as this gal!

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Hot Dogs, Desserts, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Food
text: It's so great having a nice clean burger joint like this nearby. Although the burgers are a bit pricey the quality is second to none. I've been three times now and I'll come back for a fourth.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Living in Philadelphia, I don't get the chance to stop in Media very often, but when I do I make sure to get a roast beef here. This place is the BOMB, much better than the coveted Nick's Roast Beef.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Nightlife, Burgers, Food, Restaurants
text: Went in for breakfast. I had shrimp and grits, it looked great when served. 4 out of the 6 or so shrimp were mushy and raw. The grits were good. My husband's biscuit was very dry. Too many good places in this city, so we won't go back.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza, Burgers
text: Defiantly a diamond in the rough... I would normally never think to go here but decided to try it one day with my boyfriend. Everything I have had is wonderful. The bread is so fresh you won't believe it. Fries are great, sauce selection is great and so is the service. Only downside is the sandwich does fall apart because there so much sauce and thin bread. Definitely become a fork and knife thing. Which is ok with my because I defiantly ate it up.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Food was great! Service was good until i left my leftovers and they threw it out. I left, drove around the corner came right back less then 5min and they threw it in the trash! Not cool!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Food, Sandwiches
text: So we actually found this place on the internet as we were traveling. We stopped in for late breakfast. We were immediately greeted and welcomed. The food was absolutely amazing. It is difficult to find great gluten free but this place has it. I would recommend to anyone passing by. Had the pleasure of meeting the owner and can say the customer service was great.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Italian
text: Unlike the Upper Darby location, the West Chester location does not offer a lunch menu. $15 for a sandwich, fries and tea? With tax, tip and/or ordering one of the more expensive sandwiches can easily run $20 tab ... for lunch!! And why does tea cost more than soda or coffee? No thank you. I might be back for dinner but not lunch.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Perhaps I have high expectations of BBQ or I just went on a bad night. I wasn't overly impressed. I think it would be great for take out with lots of sauce. On a bun with some toppings.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Chicken Wings
text: Love this place...close to the house and decent wait I time for delivery orders. But every time I call to place an order I have to scream into the phone at them bc their phone / the background noise to "too loud" as they say. I understand, it's a restaurant / bar. But maybe you should think about moving the phone or getting a new one if needed so you don't have make your customers scream at you every time they call.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza

place_category: American (New), Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breweries
text: I went there this weekend... the food was barely cooked we had to send it back. The bar tenders were nice but seemed like they were more interested in speaking to each other rather than serving alcohol.. it took us 30 mins to get our check and we had to ask for it twice. It was not that busy in there I would not waste my money to go back again

place_category: Comfort Food, Diners, Restaurants
text: Unique albeit very small old time dining car. Fun, nostalgic atmosphere. Good solid diner food. It very popular so there is often a significant wait for a table or even a seat at the counter. If you have time it's worth the wait.

place_category: Brewpubs, Food, Breweries

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Greek, Restaurants
text: Omg I order here at least once a week! I was worried I wouldn't be able to find my 'go-to' pizza place when I moved here from the city, but this is it! Delicious. Fast. CHEAP!

place_category: Jazz & Blues, Nightlife, Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Lounges, Restaurants, Seafood, Steakhouses
text: We started off with crab cakes and bruschetta. The bruschetta was fresh and delicious. The crab cake on the other hand was absolutely disgusting. It was cold and had a funky taste. My first course was the lobster and shrimp bisque. Not terrible but nothing to write home about. I didn't finish it and I would not order it again. The filet was decent, not anything better than Texas Roadhouse.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Perfect place to grab a slice and hang out the patio. Service was great and the food was too! Looking forward to visiting again.

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants

text: Good beer selection and good happy hour prices but the service is just horrible. place_category: Food, Chinese, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Diners, Salad, Food Delivery Services

text: While I think it's absolutely stupid to give this place two stars because the food is "a big wad of fat and salt," I do agree with Javier that the pastrami is good, but not the best. And $13 for one of these sandwiches is rather expensive for what it is. I recommend going here if you crave or love pastrami, but it's not the best pastrami. There are better fries and other places to eat in Santa Barbara. The complimentary dish of homemade pickles was 5 stars on its own.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Desserts, Bakeries, Food, Food Delivery Services
text: Incomparable cookies. Absolutely amazing. But they messed up my order 3 times consecutively... missing cookies, wrong cookies etc. They gave me a lot of free cookies ~thank you~ but in order to even take advantage of this I have to spend a minimum of $6. Overall great but :/

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: I found hairs in my food wayyyyy too many times here. And yet...I still went back. Late night drive through on the way back from hitting the bars downtown. Yeah.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer Gardens, Italian, Pizza
text: 3 is for the service, not for the food. The food and beverage is very worth it! The service, as well as an unkept restroom, is what forced my group to give them a 3 star rating. The meals were not as big as we'd hoped but their quality certainly overshadowed this.

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, American (New), Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars
text: I got here early and was the only one seated. The hostess was great. I ordered a "virgin bloody Mary" (which was just clamato juice) and the clams in white wine sauce. The clams were lovely and tender but the "sauce" seemed to be water with red pepper flakes. Then it started raining and the place filled up. I've been waiting for my check (yes, I asked for it) for about 20 minutes. Can you say 10% tip?

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Chinese
text: It's takeout food so if you go in with those expectations you won't be disappointed otherwise you'll be singing the blues at heartbreak hotel.

place_category: Restaurants, Hot Pot, Dim Sum, Szechuan, Chinese
text: I ordered sesame chicken, trying to play it safe with Chinese food in Nashville. It was bad. I thought I was eating deep fried bread bites rather than sesame chicken. Little to no meat in any bite. I suppose I'm till in search of a good Chinese place down here.

place_category: Indian, Vegetarian, Vegan, Restaurants
text: If you like authentic tasty food try it. The true negative reviews that others left have all been corrected it seems - real bowls for soup, crispy naan and dosas for lunch buffett, nice enough staff, tasty not bland food. Def recommend trying. It is vegetarian which we prefer and spicy but not overwhelming- the flavor is still great. To the manager - please don't dumb it down for bland tastes. Its good to be different than all the other meat heavy fatty and bland Indian buffets

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Vietnamese

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Gelato, Donuts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Coffee & Tea
text: Nice quiet and quaint place with impeccable desserts. I had the Smores Brownie and there was enough to take home for leftovers the next day.

text: I don't know where does this place get all the good ratings from! The only edible thing they have is Baba ganoush! That's it.. The girls were sweet, the food was disgusting! place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Lounges
text: Meh... Mediocre Food for Premiere price. My husband and I went last night. We had spinach dip, wings, a caprese sandwich and a prime rib burger. The food wasn't terrible, it just wasn't anything to rave about. Very forgettable. Service was sub-par. There were 2 servers and only 2-3 tables filled in the restaurant - no one at the bar. Both waitresses seemed to be pissy. Not social or bubbly. The whole experience was a bit dreary. We most likely won't be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Indian
text: This is not the same Nirvana from Conshohocken. The food is sub par. The service is very good, but we don't go to restaurant just to have good service. I tried the buffet and dinner. Both very disappointing. I guess all the 5 stars must be from friends and family.

place_category: Caterers, Restaurants, Pakistani, Vegetarian, Buffets, Indian, Event Planning & Services
text: I keep meaning to review this place but the fact that i know very little about indian food has been intimidating me. That aside I have very much enjoyed my experiences here. Even when they are not having a buffet they still have some great platters for sampling. I have been a vegetarian for ten years so going into a restaurant where I can order absolutely anything off the menu is somewhat of a novelty.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: We went to this pretty restaurant for dinner. It was very nice inside, but I think I would prefer it for lunch. It was very expensive for what it was. The food was good, although I had difficulty finding something that really appealed to me on the menu. I would try it again for lunch, but probably not for dinner.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, American (New), Pubs
text: Unless you're coming here for the happy hour special, it's not worth the full price for drinks/food in my opinion. Slow service seems to be inevitable here whether it's busy or not and they could be a little more welcoming to new customers. It's not the worse bar around, but it could use a lot of improvements.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, Italian, Gluten-Free
text: My team and another team ordered a lot of food from this place. We spoke to the Manager about sending people to pick up the large order. What a blessing this place! place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Barbeque
text: Stopped here after a trip to Cahokia Mounds and the Catsup bottle in Collinsville. Food was good and waitress was very attentive and personable. Enjoyed the spicy sauce - it wasn't spicy but it had good flavor.

text: Nice little spot in Montecito with great people watching...They have about 7 or 8 beers on tap and good quality food. The staff is very friendly and are accomadating. I like sitting outside and hanging out with a nice brewski :)

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch

Over an hour spent in the restaurant just to leave hungry and distraught. Note: Have attended multiple other First Watch locations with pleasant experiences.

place_category: Burgers, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Fast Food

place_category: Asian Fusion, Food, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: I finally had a chance to order the jumbo lump crab cake entree here... and it is to die for! It is definitely 100% crab meat, no fillers or other funny stuff. Apparently, this entree is a special and is not located on the menu. If you love crab cakes, I suggest you go for it. It will not disappoint.

place_category: Sandwiches, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Barbeque, Bars, Cafeteria, Restaurants
text: The food and drinks are delicious and the live music creates such a fun, upbeat vibe. I've been here 3+ times and look forward to coming back!

text: The food is not great if you are NOT a vegetarian/vegan. If you are, this place is perfect as their menu caters to those food choices. The service usually just okay, not extremely rude not extremely friendly. Smoothies are very delicious though. If this place was open earlier during the week, I'd probably stop in on my way to work for a smoothie or coffee.
