place_category: Food, Bagels, Donuts, Coffee & Tea
text: I'm so disappointed in this establishment. They gave me a half empty drink with no flavor and it wasn't even close to what I ordered, it seemed like someone left it to sit out for an hour before they give it to me bc the drink is literally just watered down ice and whip cream. If I could give 0 stars I would.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Being within walking distance to this spot is one of the main reasons why I miss living in Bella Vista/Hawthorne. Perfectly designed space, baristas that are the opposite of a lot of Philly douchebag baristas, excellent coffee, and a ton of charm.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: The pizza was...ok-ish. Fine, it was bad. The crust had zero flavor. Nothing special about the toppings either. The salad was topped with what looked like sandwich meat that was cut up and not that well cut up either. The drinks were good though, the huckleberry vodka was tasty. I'd go again to drink but skip the food.

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Barbeque, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: Came here just for the BBQ shrimp. It was the bomb - definitely the best shrimp I've ever eaten. My companion's meal wasn't quite as memorable, but I'd give my meal 7 stars if I could, so it averages out to five anyway. There was a long wait to get in - make reservations for dinner.

place_category: Specialty Food, Seafood Markets, Restaurants, Food, Seafood
text: Seafood didn't taste fresh...The fried oysters weren't the best

place_category: Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Tapas/Small Plates
text: This is a nice restaurant with great food and great service. They have really good lunch special with a variety of choices to choose from. I definitely coming back in the future.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Southern, Comfort Food
text: Been here twice and that was enough. We ordered spinach dip and it was cold the first time we sent it back and it came out hot on the outside and cold in the middle. I ordered steak and it was overcooked both times. Jist not good.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Beer Bar, Bars
text: Went here for an early dinner. I have been passing this place for a couple years now but never went inside. Had to wait over 45 minutes before an actual server came with our drinks/etc. Food was abysmal, received bad service and an even worse response from management. Would not recommend.

place_category: Chinese, Asian Fusion, Restaurants
text: Was a great place to eat. Last I checked it was closed due to fire damage, a couple of little shops are gone as well.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Delis, Burgers, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Local Flavor
text: I'm just leaving a review based on service. My family and I didn't come into the restaurant to get yelled at. My husband was pushing my daughter in a stroller and the people there yelled at him to not get seated until we ordered. So he came next to me and they yelled at him to go behind me. After I ordered these people seemed to be annoyed that he's waiting in line but not ordering. What do you want us to do? We didn't feel welcomed there. Not coming back again.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (Traditional), Bars, Pubs, Nightlife
text: Would NOT recommend mahi here unless you are ok with a smidgen with the apportioned broccoli and salad filling the plate. Admittedly this place is designed for perhaps more unhealthy fare. Atmosphere is nice but service left us feeling rushed actually. Waitress would abruptly interrupt us while we were conversing. Will not be searching out this chain again. Our first exposure up in Philadelphia area for a lunch was good.

place_category: Greek, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Restaurants, Italian, Pizza
text: This place was okay. Portions were huge and prices were low. Everything was pretty good, although the homefries could have used quite a bit more seasoning and a bit more frying. The staff kept our coffee full and hot, which is always a plus!

place_category: Seafood, American (New), Steakhouses, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Interesting restaurant but okay food. The cocktails were delicious. The food was average. We got the turkey sandwich and the french dip. It was interesting the dip came with french onion soup instead if au jus. Au jus would have been better. The turkey sandwich came with a ton of meat on it which might be hard to eat for some people. Server was super nice. Two stalls in the women's bathroom were out of order. We were on floor four.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Vegan, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Food, Bagels, Wraps
text: They have some good vegan food, some fun and tasty options, cool place to hang out as well

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Food, Restaurants, Bars, Burgers, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: AMAZING!! The secret sauce is delicious and my favorite burger is the cowboy! I have yet to have anything I didn't like though. Plus they are dog friendly!!

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: The folks here are always super nice, and it is one of the best places to get vegetarian Pho. It's usually packed full of veggies, and comes out promptly even when the place is busy. Service has always been so friendly and attentive.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: Worst service. Waited over an hour for my family's meal. Had to ask and was not even in the process of being cooked. What a joke of establishment. Short order cooking does not take an hour to make. Its eggs.

place_category: Tacos, Restaurants, Southern, Mexican
text: Food was mediocre at best. The chips and salsa were the best part, but that's not hard to put together. The tacos were bland and fell apart. The bowl was colorful but yet again lacking in flavor. I'd have to pass on this place next time.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Cafes
text: Food was excellent, but it took over 40 min for our food. Orange juice is watered down, would not recommend wasting your money on the juice.

place_category: Chinese, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Average Chinese food but the prices are more reasonable then Seasame House and they will deliver.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: We order from here once a week. We love the food. The service is fast too. I usually order 7-10 items and it's ready within 15 minutes. You must try the salt and pepper calamari *drool* it's delicious. Love the decor too, very modern. Check it out next time you're nearby. Dim sum does end at 2:30 there.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Specialty Food, Restaurants, French, Delis, Food
text: Perhaps I hit this spot on a bad day. Or perhaps it's just not my taste (it seemed a bit uppity to me). But I was unimpressed. Our waitress was short and not very attentive. And the food certainly did not justify the price. We got an omelet, salad, and oatmeal, and none was notable. We didn't finish any of them. Next time, I'll just stay home, make my own breakfast, and save $20.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New)
text: I first had their mac last year from their food truck at a beer fest, and I have been absolutely smitten ever since! I've only had probably 3 or 4 different kinds of their mac (all delicious) but I would say each kind they offer is probably amazing and worth it. Then they opened the store front and now I can't stay away!

place_category: Malaysian, Asian Fusion, Cambodian, Chinese, Restaurants, Thai
text: Beware. If you want a Korean sports bar, this is your place. Don't expect good service, food or any concern at all about your experience.

place_category: Drugstores, Grocery, Bakeries, Food, Flowers & Gifts, Delis, Restaurants, Florists, Shopping
text: I love Schnucks, nearly all of them. Please avoid this one, just keep driving about 2 miles and a better one will appear. This place is just like the Brentwood Wal-Mart... unprofessional employees that are more interested in making comments to each other about how bad their job is than acknowledging you as a customer. Note: I only review after multiple bad or multiple good experiences.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Fish & Chips, Nightlife, Seafood, Restaurants, Bars
text: Always having to wait for some minuties but it was worth it. Seafoods are fresh while the price is reasonable. The seafood pasta, somehow sour and light is under my expectation. What the most delicious maybe the soup, served in cups. The table s are crowded but the whole atmosphere was great.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: I had the mixed fajita plate and my beef fajita tasted horrible. I was disappointed in my meal as I have read reviews post experience and I'm thinking I should have tried a different plate. However, New Orleans houses so many restaurants that I doubt I will be back. Service was great and the chips and salsa were good as well.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Lounges, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Went for Thanksgiving dinner, they were very busy but even without a reservation we were able to get a table after a short wait. The salad bar is nice and fresh items to choose, enjoyed the serve yourself salad. The entrees were good, but servers were busy since it was holiday, so hard to really judge on the service. No room for dessert, sorry have no pics on the sweet stuff.

place_name: Tomo Japanese Steakhouse and Sushi Bar
place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: Yeah, not sure why the rave reviews. My friend loves the habatchi grill. I have had on the 1st visit California roll - not bad 2nd visit Tempura shrimp - blah no flavor 3rd visit Filet Mignon Tetiyaki - blah no flavor wait staff was very friendly, food was hot and came out in a timely manner. Just doesn't do it for me.

place_category: Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Event Planning & Services, Musicians, Food, Pubs, Jazz & Blues, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: May be my favorite bar in town. I kept gravitating towards it my whole vacation! The ambiance inside and outside in the courtyard was just beautiful! The live music was unlike anything else!

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers, Food, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Bars, Restaurants
text: Make the burgers bigger or lower the price....and please dont charge for the sauces, cmon! But...I like this place regardless.

place_category: Acai Bowls, Restaurants, American (New), Food, Gelato, Street Vendors, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Desserts, Specialty Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: I love these tasty little treats. Whatever Pops are locally made with tasty fruit and fruit bits of whatever inside of them. There are no preservatives or fake-ass dyes in these frozen bars of fun. I recently went on a popsicle binge with trying a coconut lime, strawberry mango and watermelon citrus. My subsequent brain freeze was totally worth it! Pick up one at the new Duckweed Urban Market or at your nearest food truck rally.

place_category: Bars, Hotels, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Hotels & Travel, Seafood, Nightlife, Event Planning & Services, Wine Bars
text: We had dinner at Rodneys since it was in the hotel and it was convenient. The place was nice but the food was not. We ordered calamari, hamburger and duck and all of them were cold and very salty. we couldn't even finish our food due to bad taste and salty.

place_category: Food Stands, Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Mexican
text: Went on quest to find sonora hot dog tonight. Ordered a couple with everything. They were pretty good but seemed to lack some ladting flavor. My overall thoughts are better than the fast food chains but there are better hot dog stands in Tucson.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: We got take out from here the other night and each of us were blown away by how great it was. I had the cheese hoagie, my husband has the cheesesteak and my friend had the meatball sandwich. Plus the guy who rang us out had the nicest eyeballs i have ever seen. Like....I wish i took a picture of him so i could show you but i guess you will have to just go get food and look for yourself. Here's my hoagie pic instead.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Comfort Food, Chicken Shop, Sandwiches
text: Waited about 10 minutes for a chicken avocado club sandwich, there was nobody in front of me. My sandwich wasn't even hot. Very little chicken. Half my sandwich had no chicken in it. I literally had to take it home and add my own meat to it. S

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: My cappuccino was pretty good! The pastry is hardly worth it though. I like the place's neighborhood atmosphere.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, American (New), Restaurants
text: Really not our restaurant in any way, shape, or form. We tried it a couple times two years ago and never came back. Thought we'd try again. It's still really loud inside and not warm in the least. It just feels harsh. What's more, it's very, very pricey for what it is. The quality is just not that high and the drinks truly suck. I'm frankly thinking that folks leaving 5 star reviews here need to get out more. My God it's New Orleans! BTW, did I say it was LOUD!

place_category: Candy Stores, Shopping, Wholesale Stores, Food, Specialty Food
text: Neat place to see, but very small with very few items to choose from. I liked it because my husband and his cousin got matching hats which was a fun souviner. The candy was not that different from other places, but still a neat novelty to check out. They also are generous on the free samples of one or two of the items but the others you cant try.

place_category: Department Stores, Fashion, Home & Garden, Shopping, Food, Grocery, Electronics, Furniture Stores
text: This Target store is always immaculate. The bathrooms are the same. I am so impressed by this store and will always return because I can always find what I need and it is just an inviting place to shop. Keep up the great work!

place_category: Nightlife, Food, American (New), Pizza, Pubs, Bars, Breweries, Restaurants
text: The best dish here is definitely the Banh Mi sandwich. The bread is perfectly crispy and the pork belly is right on point. The only downside to this place is the food is a little overpriced. The banh mi here is 16 while it's like 8 dollars at Pho Palace on Bustleton. Quality is just about the same. There is also no lunch menu here as well which makes lunch here a little pricey. The sangria here and the sweet potato ale are AMAZING.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Asian Fusion
text: Completely over priced for poor quality sushi. The menu is priced like Nobu, but doesn't even compare to their dining atmosphere or quality of food and drinks. You'll leave here wanting a cheeseburger. Also good luck getting a table. All of the LA tourists fill up the seats. This place is the definition of a tourist trap. Plenty of better options in town.

place_category: Vegetarian, Chinese, Restaurants
text: (+) great vegetarian veggie meat selections, fast & friendly service, perfect for quick takeout (-) pretty standard menu/flavors

place_category: Tex-Mex, Dive Bars, Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (New), Restaurants, Gastropubs, Nightlife, Southern, American (Traditional), Beer Bar, Food
text: Fantastic brunch! Great drink specials and lots of awesome brunch foods to choose from! I got the Farmhouse flatbread which was very good! I recommend the OC Blaster its a nice little twist from a regular mimosa

place_name: Bertha Miranda's Mexican Food Restaurant and Cantina
place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Been here at least 1000 times and never done a review from here. This place is always so good. Never in all the times that i have been here have I EVER had a bad meal. Coming in here you can understand what truly good Mexican food is all about. The staff is always super friendly and on top the refills and the service. I will always know that there is a true taste of family and great Mexican food in Reno and thats at Bertha Miranda's...

place_category: Gluten-Free, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Cantonese, Chinese, Sushi Bars, Comfort Food
text: ABSOLUTELY EXCELLENT!!!! My mom, beautiful partner & aunts visited this restaurant for a brunch-birthday celebration and boy did they deliver and then some. Two of us were vegan and our wonderful server knew EXACTLY what could be made vegan. The food came out quick, hot and exceptionally seasoned. The atmosphere was upscale and and the servers were attentive. She took pictorial memories of our wonderful experience and made us feel so special. KUDOS. We're definitely coming back. Thanks.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Caterers, Restaurants, Salad, Food, Comfort Food, Desserts, Breakfast & Brunch, Southern
text: Waited an hour to be seated for a table of 5, hostess forgot about us. When questioned on the status of our table, was told they are clearing a table. 15 minutes later no follow up. During all of this watched the entirety of the other waiting parties seated, which lined the exterior of the restaurant.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Not good BBQ. Fattiest brisket I have ever had and I specifically asked them if the brisket was fatty and told them I did not want a lot of fat in the brisket. The meat look like they put it through a grinder. The ribs were boiled way too long you could tell by the discoloration of the meat. Through over half of it in the trash because it was so fatty we couldn't eat it. Waste of $40

place_category: Cafes, Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: The food was spot on as usual, however, our server seemed rushed & she didn't seem like she really cared about having our business. Then, towards the end of the evening this other couple walked in ( around 8:20pm, they close at 8:30pm) and while they were being brought to their table she stops the guy in his tracks & says we're closed. Very rude! If I were that couple I would have turned around & walked & never return. Very sad.

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Server was great in explaining the ins and outs of the menu. The hot wings were hot and flavorful but the ranch was a little runny. We specifically came to try the Sonoran dog. It did not dissappoint. The frozen drinks melted fast and my tastebubs were not happy. Kids loved their meals - thank you for having fresh fruit as a part of their meal.

place_category: Vegan, Vegetarian, Restaurants
text: I had been in search of some quality vegan restaurants, and I certainly found one with Sprig & Vine. My mom and I came for lunch and I have been dreaming of going back ever since! Mainly because of their BBQ Tempeh Sandwich . It was probably the best sandwich I've ever had, both vegan and not vegan. I have been thinking about it since that day it was that good. I am 100% positive that my dad, who's a die hard meat eater, would love it just as much as I did. Sprig & Vine does it right!

place_category: Chinese, Soup, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: We love the the sushi train. We usually order off the all you can eat menu and eat off the train as well. It's definitely a good value when you have growing teens. We bought the deal off Groupon. Very affordable.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Diners
text: This place is amazing. The food is so good and they were able to accommodate all of my food allergies. The service is top notch. Our waitress Priscilla, went above and beyond to make sure we were taken care of with our food restrictions. The manager, Sabrena was soooo nice! She came by and checked on us multiple times throughout our dinner. We even got to see them dance! It looked like everyone was having a great time working! We will definitely be back!!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Ordered food two hours ago... Food was expected to get to us at 9:50. Called they said it was gonna take another 30 mins. Well over an hour later and Still haven't received the food, place is now closed. Never again.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Spanish, Cuban
text: Nothing about this place stands out. It's not great good, nor is it bad. The bartenders pour a decent and very average cocktail. Good stop for a quick lunch, skip it for anything more substantial than that.

place_category: Italian, Southern, Restaurants
text: I had read a number of good reviews about this restaurant and was quite disappointed when it failed to deliver. This is a very casual place (definitely not fine-dining) where the staff wears t-shirts and describes one particular appetizer as "an Italian style bologna-on-a-stick" (the server's actual description). I must admit that their pizza and desserts were on the level, but otherwise this restaurant did not to live up to expectations.

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Bar and drinks are fine, the happy hour here is also a good deal. Reason for the 3 stars is for the food, especially the terrible excuse of the cheese and charcuterie plates. I expected a lot more than a poor cheese "variety" crumbled on a plate and under whelming cuts, especially from a wine bar. Poor quality and poor presentation. The burger we ordered was also 80% bun.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, American (New), Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Food was good, and came out rather quick... server was a bit sketchy though and kinda missed the mark. Chowder is a meal unto itself if you order a bowl and the shrimp basket is a little over priced for the number of shrimp you get. Aside from that they do a good job and the place is always packed... so if you can't get into that "other place across the parking lot" this makes for a fine meal as well... or put your names in at both and just wait it out... :-)

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: It's the only grocery in pleasant view, the people are nice and when we request things they try and get them. Wish they had more organic produce and healthy foods available.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Burgers
text: The bagel breakfast sandwich was good once I finally received it. I sat for a while waiting for the sandwich while the cooking staff had very lengthy conversations at the grill. The best thing about this morning was the pleasant wait staff behind the bar. She was personable and conversational which helped the time pass by. Again the food was good so I would stop again but only if I have as much time as I did, otherwise, I might be late for my flight.

place_category: Salad, Nightlife, Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, Vegan, Bars, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Best place in town, if you like creative gourmet opposed to the traditional New York style. The service is slow but that's part of the experience... Definitely don't come here in a rush. Two thumbs up for the drink menu. Kids are better off somewhere else, the menu is for adventurous and experienced taste buds !

place_category: American (New), Fast Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: The food here is so much better than a place that I just wrote a 2 star review for... Anyway, the staff is very friendly and the food is always fresh and tastes good. Seems to be consistent at the various locations around town. This location is being remodeled so the dining room is kind of wack right now. The daily specials are a good value and if it's fast Mexican food you want this is a pretty good option.

place_category: Tours, Local Flavor, Hotels & Travel, Arts & Entertainment, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Music Venues, Barbeque, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces
text: Atmosphere great, service not. Caitlin was our bartender and we did not get one smile from her during the 10+ drinks we ordered. No hi how are you, thank you. She ruined the whole experience for us as we were having fun on the dance floor but as soon as we had to order a drink we dreaded it. Hope we won't get her again.

place_category: Home & Garden, Fashion, Grocery, Food, Department Stores, Shopping, Drugstores, Electronics, Furniture Stores
text: I only have a few words to describe this place, is located in the Springfield mall. This place is turning out to be more & more like a "Walmart." And I'm not talking about the products. I'm taking about the employees. Enough said! Thank you!

place_category: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Food, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Deserves no stars. Horrible customer service. The staff is rude and will report to corporate.

place_category: Cafes, Restaurants, Vegan, Food, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I'm a little slow with the news but the Electric Blue Elephant menu is available now and ask I can say is WooHoo!!! I love, love, love their bowls. Really happy I don't have to fight the food truck Friday crowd to get my yum on.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Thai
text: We have ordered take out from here several times and have really enjoyed it. Delicious Hung Ray, Larb and spring rolls. Very fresh and the quality is good as well. Our favorite Thai take out in Nashville currently. Have not dined in.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: I'm torn on how to rate this. The food was good. The portions could feed a small army. Or maybe two teen boys. The staff was friendly. However no staff had masks. They were not limiting seating. In fact it was packed. I take full responsibility for not walking out when I saw what I was walking into. Almost (but not quite) no safety precautions were being taken and it was very obviously deliberate. I won't be back during Covid.

place_name: Ameristar Casino Resort Spa St. Charles
place_category: Resorts, Hotels, American (New), Casinos, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Nightlife, Hotels & Travel, Arts & Entertainment
text: great place to spend an evening out. Pros include: Free parking, affordable dinning, low stakes gambling, and complimentary coffee, tea, lemonade, and soft drinks on the casino floor. Biggest complaint is the second hand cigaret smoke. It really gets to you after a while.

place_category: Restaurants, Gluten-Free, American (Traditional), Pizza
text: Menu is overwhelming with something for everybody. Lots of booths which I like. Serrvice was friendly w manager opening the door to welcome us in out of cold. The waitress was nice but just not on top of things such as water refills. When the other girl delivered the food she was alittle brusque but perhaps she was in a hurry?? The food was good but slightly over cooked so not making me come running back. Salads fresh n nice. Overall: Nice but not great.

place_category: Noodles, Seafood, Restaurants, Chinese
text: Never order Chinese food (chicken with garlic sauce) and had to pay extra to get rice with it. Also no vegetables added in dish. Just chicken in garlic sauce for $14.00. Disappointed. Who eat just chicken on plate with no rice, no vegetables. Did not like. No wonder few customers in here. Waiter stated I should have ask for vegs in dish...who knew you prepare dish without????? Lousy.

place_category: Seafood, Japanese, Nightlife, Dance Clubs, Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Henry and Keith are both spectacular servers!!! Friendly but not familiar, energetic, thoughtful, available and knowledgeable! Can not say enough about these two! Henry's wine knowledge is also excellent!!! If it were just service this would be a 5star rating. But food dropped to a 3. No seafood in the seafood chowder that was served cool. No broth in the dried out French onion soup. Our NY Strip was overpriced and poorest quality meat a restaurant could serve.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Pizza, Food, Specialty Food, Delis, Sandwiches
text: The service is always kind and genuine. The selection is large considering the size of the shop. Great seasonal selections as well. This is the only place I could find an Easter panettone bread that I make my easter bread pudding from.

place_category: Flowers & Gifts, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bakeries, Cooking Schools, Education, Shopping, Drugstores, Grocery, Food, Specialty Schools
text: I came here mainly because it was close by. Their produce was only ok and their butcher is decent enough: they have sales on Ribeye and Porterhouse steaks quite often, so that was always a plus. Their prepared foods section is massive. I think that's what all the people at the old folks' home go for. This is also a location with the cooking school.

place_category: Pizza, Fast Food, Food Delivery Services, Restaurants, Food
text: The order was late and when we called were told if we ordered it, it's on its way then got hung up on. When the pizza arrived it was luke warm. Worst customer service and pizza I've had in a very long time. Won't eat here again.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: I went to this place for her first time and I was pretty annoyed. I ordered extra spicy General tso dinner with extra rice instead of soup. Their general tso chicken is unlike any I've rever had. It's literally an extremely small amount of very dry chicken inside of a very thick piece of fried dough. Some pieces didn't even have chicken inside. The rice was okay, but was rather dry. I very basic and all I order is General tso, so I won't be going back here.

place_category: Food Trucks, Mexican, Korean, Food, Restaurants, Food Stands
text: Maybe my favorite food truck at Penn. I typically get the lemongrass pork over rice, which is flavorful and filling. The only complaint I have is that they give a lot of rice in comparison to the rest of the meal. For seven bucks, I would say is it's well worth the price!

place_category: Steakhouses, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: The food was amazing but the service was horrible! They only had 2 chefs and all the tepan tables were packed with people! We had to wait 50 minutes before a chef could come to our section. All the waiters and waitresses looked miserable. Get more chefs!!!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Terrible service do not eat here. We were rushed out did not even have time to finish our food. This was the absolute worst service I have had ever.

place_category: Food, Burgers, Fast Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: I waited over a half hour for to go food as I watched the drive thru be served first and door dash, multiple people waiti for over 45 minutes for fast food, asked for a refund and manager gave me attitude like it was my fault they were slow, there is a major problem at this McDonald's, this is not my first bad experience, manager should have tried to make me happy not blame me for the slow service, I am giving no stars at all, had to pick 1 star but I would give 0 if I could

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Lounges, Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food
text: This place has been fun before but every time I have gone in I'm always waiting on the bartenders to notice you to get a drink, even after the first round if you tip them well they could care less, opening a tab same thing. If you want to go there and have a sober conversation with your own group of people then this is your place.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, American (New), Pizza
text: Delicious pizza and friendly staff. We enjoy eating at the bar and the bartenders are simply great. It's our date night spot. Perfect atmosphere, busy but fun. 5 stars!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: I used to love this place years ago when it first opened. However, on my last visit I ordered a salad that included chicken. The quality of the chicken was not as good as before. It seemed like lunchmeat quality or just not real, fresh chicken. Tijuana Flats is by far a better choice.

place_category: American (Traditional), American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Seafood, Cafes
text: the thing about paradise cafe is that no one ever plans to go here. no one ever says "lets go to Paradise Cafe this Friday" because they lack an identity. the food is great but it fails to leave an impression on me to the point i need to come back. if i had to choose two noteable items, it would be the fried calamari and the calamari sandwich.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New), Burgers
text: Dirty. Wait staff was slow and had poor attitudes. Disappointed to see the management not be able to raise the experience up to the rest of IHOP standards in other locations.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: I've been eating this brisket breakfast sandwich (only a special for a few days so sorry to those who miss out) for the last 20 minutes. I'm trying to savor every single bite because it's that fucking good. To be honest though, I'm not surprised. Everything these people whip up is top notch. Thank you for existing Slow Hand. Damnit.....I just finished the sandwich. Time to Postmates a second one over.

place_category: Restaurants, Beer Bar, Salad, Burgers, Bars, Nightlife
text: Great food and good atmosphere. Servers were attentive. I really don't have anything negative to say other than we had a reservation and still had to wait awhile until a table was available. That in itself is ok, but I wish there was more seating available for those waiting to dine.

place_category: American (New), Bars, Barbeque, Seafood, Restaurants, Nightlife, Salad, American (Traditional)
text: The food was good. Decently priced. For 2 people it was 42 with drinks and one alcoholic drink. We got fried belly which was AMAZING. The service was extremely slow. Took almost 10 minutes after we sat down for someone to come to our table since we sat ourselves. We might go back if the service was better. Well give it another shot in the spring/summer and hopefully it's better.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Delis, Burgers, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Local Flavor
text: After being educated by the locals on where to get a good cheese steak and to order a "whiz with", we headed over to Sonny's. I have to say the service was terrible, but the cheese steaks were phenomenal. So if you don't mind bad service and you're not sure where to go, then Sonny's Famous Steaks is your spot. Just be prepared to get your hands dirty, because their cheese steaks are dripping with flavor.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Italian, Food, Pizza, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Ate here our last visit. My pastrami was all burned. Girls salad just OK. I am good without coming back!

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Their breakfast sandwiches and home fries are ON POINT. I always get the bacon, egg, and cheese on a bagel. Absolutely delicious. The staff is friendly, but service is slow.

place_category: American (Traditional), Barbeque, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: I food is when they cook it the right way and I miss the peanuts seems like it's always busy there

place_category: Restaurants, Gastropubs, American (New)
text: Lovely atmosphere and fantastic service!! Appetizer octopus was great but the pear & fennel salad was just ok, nothing special. Parm fries were incredibly disappointing. Our steaks were ridiculously undercooked for what we requested and we did tell our waiter, who brought us 2 free desserts, which I'm sorry to say, were just not that great. The steaks were also not seasoned. For the money you'd pay to eat here, I'd say choose some place else or just get appetizers and drinks.

place_category: Burgers, Bars, Adult Entertainment, Restaurants, Cabaret, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife
text: Great fun for bingo. Some vegetarian options. Great opportunity to support a local charity

place_category: Salad, Chicken Wings, Pizza, Restaurants
text: Why 3 stars? Because this is your average pizza experience. --- --- --- This establishment reminds me of its neighbor, Daily Eats, because it's the quintessential definition of middle-ground. I don't have any negative things about this 'za, but I don't feel like anything about it necessarily stands out. Seems like such a cop-out review, but when you have nothing to add, what's to say? The people are friendly, I wish them continued success, prosperity, and the ability to love.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: I've been eating at various locations of Royal Pizza my entire life. The food is consistently good, as is the service. The atmosphere is friendly and relaxed. I love the pizza, but there's a great variety of other meal items as well, if you're just not in the mood for pizza.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: We're regulars here and it's one of the better Chinese places around. Good Mongolian Beef.

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Dive Bars
text: The Rivershack was indeed a grocery once upon a time, maybe in the 1940s. But it's always been a bar in my lifetime. It's a solid neighborhood bar with decent food (expanded beyond the typical bar menu). They only get 3 stars because the decor is too self-conscious, with it's ashtray collection and funky barstools. They just need to take a deep breath.

place_category: Southern, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Live/Raw Food, Hotels & Travel, Hotels
text: The oysters were small and not flavorful. The shrimp tasted as if the was spoiled. Not sure if they were or if it was the way they were supposed to taste. The view was fun, we were able to people watch everyone on Burbon st

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Vegetarian, Pizza
text: I like that they have unusual toppings, and the pizza's good. But I took a star off for the terrible breaded chicken topping - it's almost grey. They also have left toppings off twice - when I called back the second time, they told me I'd get a free topping on my next order. That wasn't honored when I called for my next order. So, I'm glad there's a MidCity pizza delivery place, but I'm annoyed at the lack of service and the low-quality chicken.

place_name: California Pizza Kitchen at International Plaza
place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Pizza, Salad, American (Traditional)
text: Definitely NOT fast food. You could grow a beard waiting. My app came with my meal to boot. I ordered it became i wanted something now! The app was a corn guacamole and chips. Pretty tasteless. The Cobb salad was better, and it took me half way through to figure out that the mystery ingredient was basil! It wasn't bad, but it wasn't good, and the prices are high. Don't go there in a hurry either.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Italian, Salad, Pizza
text: I had the Buffalo chicken wrap, my sister had the meatballs pizza on cauliflower crust and mom had the simple burger. All very good! The staff was very friendly and the place has a nice casual atmosphere.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, Vegetarian, Italian, Chicken Wings, Salad
text: Nothing special or memorable. Good enough in a pinch. Nothing I'd go out of my way for. I had a plain cheese (Margherita) pizza. Just okay. Crust wasn't crispy, which is what I was looking for. Maybe that's just their style.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Barbeque, Bars, Music Venues, American (Traditional)
text: I walked into this bar with friends hoping for some shots of tequila to soothe the soul, enhance our night out, and quench our thirst. However, I am 100% positive what we were given was not tequila, and honestly, I am now convinced it was close to, it not, rubbing alcohol. We are not tequila snobs by any means, and consider well spirits a close friend. Best of luck to anyone else that goes down this route. Have fun friend.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Food, Cajun/Creole, Specialty Food, Comfort Food, Restaurants
text: Simply amazing! Mumbo yumbo gumbo was INCREDIBLE! Highly recommend this place. It is small inside but well worth the wait!

place_category: French, Event Planning & Services, Seafood, Salad, Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Caterers, Restaurants, Modern European, Barbeque, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: If you have a complaint stick it up your ass, no one gives a shit about your stupid opinion. This place has the dankest food and the servers know whats up. If its too loud go eat a frozen dinner at your house lame ass.

place_category: Delis, Seafood, Cheesesteaks, Convenience Stores, Sandwiches, Food, Restaurants
text: Best place in West Chester for sandwiches. This place is awesome and not too pricey either. I would highly recommend.

place_category: Restaurants, Pubs, Food, Bars, American (New), Nightlife
text: $17 fried chicken was bad. It's two dark meat drumsticks and a thigh because they're too cheap to give you a good breast. Also it has paper thin breading rather than a good crunchy fry.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Bars, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Restaurants
text: This place hit the spot after a swamp tour and daiquiri to start off the morning . The place is simple . You got your po' boys, gumbo, jambalaya , red beans and rice. The shrimp po' boy was nicely seasoned, grilled ( not fried) shrimp and on a nicely toasted roll. The gumbo , although not gourmet, it was tasty and filling . Service definitely wasn't with a smile but it was prompt. You get what you paid for and I was satisfied with that .

place_category: Restaurants, Tiki Bars, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Burgers, Food, Local Flavor, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Tex-Mex, American (New), Music Venues, Caribbean, Pubs, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Nice atmosphere, good service, but the food was rough. I got the pork shank special and it was stone cold on the inside. THey asked me if I wanted a new one or just heat up this one. I switched out for the burger,and it wasn't berry good.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Food Trucks, Korean
text: The food is always good here. Especially my favorite, the potstickers! Amazing. I ordered the potstickers and a bowl of ramen. My potstickers never came and they told me that I didn't order any. The lady who took my order didn't hear me apparently.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Beer Bar
text: We've heard great things about this place. Unfortunately we weren't down for the 25 minute wait while there were so many empty tables and 5 staff members at the reception desk. For a Sunday evening we expected more. Hopefully they can work out the kinks and we can give them a try another time. Luckily Panera was just a parking lot away... their southwest chicken soup was amazing!!

place_category: Burgers, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Restaurants, Salad, Soup, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Got the Ahi Tuna Salad for the second time but it was drenched in dressing. Their pastas are 'okay'. Nothing too special here but is one of the the healthier choices in IV.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: It's not BYOB anymore, they'll charge a $10 corking fee for regular bottles and $20 for megas. The service is good, the food is good and somewhat varied (foie gras, scallops, rabbit, etc) and dessert was only ok. The atmosphere is excellent, except the tables are a little cramped together. Great place to bring a casual date here.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Soup, Sandwiches, American (Traditional)
text: Ordered at 9am for an 11:30 am delivery. Did not arrive until 12:10pm. Paid $15.00 including tip for my salad and they brought the wrong dressing! You could and should be better than this Baggins.

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Bars, Steakhouses
text: Good service. Good steak. So so spicy veggie soup. Now I know you don't go to a steak place for french fries but........ How can you screw up fries? These were the worst fries I have every eaten. Even frozen french fries bought in a supermarket are better. My wife's comment was that McDonalds fries were better. These fries, however, were soggy and tasteless. I can only attribute this to laziness.

place_category: Food, Desserts, Restaurants, Food Delivery Services, Greek, Local Flavor, American (Traditional)
text: Great Gyro! I tried this place today because a friend of mine mentioned this place. I ordered the traditional lamb/beef gyro with french fries. The gyro was well seasoned and the fries were crisp and hot. The owner was friendly. I definitely will come back in the future.

place_category: Food, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Empanadas, Latin American, Restaurants, Mexican, Tacos
text: Love the upstairs patio. The drinks are delicious and the view from the rooftop area is really nice. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a relaxing date night or gal pal evening! TRY THE SANGRIA

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Barista this morning doesn't know how to fill the cup. $4.00 for coffee, it should be full. In a hurry and no time to wait. Thanks guys! Happy Monday.

place_category: Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Bagels
text: I really don't like South Street bagels. Granted, I haven't eaten one since 2012, so their recipe/method may have changed. One thing I know for sure: Chestnut Street bagels is a vast improvement from their sister store, and it's been pretty horrible for my waistline. Get the jalapeño cream cheese and you won't be sorry.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Cafes
text: Wonderful food and coffee, exceptional customer service. I love the burritos and the horchata latte. I take everyone I know here :)

place_category: Laotian, Restaurants, Thai, Vietnamese
text: Tom Yum soup horrible and from can concentrate. Thai curry is acceptable with fresh vegetables.

place_category: Restaurants, Pubs, Music Venues, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Arts & Entertainment
text: This was my first time at this location. I really like the raised stage above the bar. The patio is as small as the Dale Mabry location. I do like the fact that this location hasn't started serving food yet. You can order and have it delivered from an area restaurant.

place_category: Shopping, Butcher, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food
text: It's alright I guess... got confused with Cochon and Cochon Butcher! No option for us chickenatarions. The muffelata was mediocre at best. The macaroni and cheese was bad.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Chicken Wings, American (New), Italian
text: Sorry to see that the Calle Real location in Goleta has closed. I liked this place. Gods pizza. Convenient location. Lots of parking. Fast service.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: To be truthful I have only been there once and the place appeared to be dirty . I should have Walked out then because if I get it in my head they are dirty nothing would have pleased me . The food was horrible I threw it away .

place_category: Restaurants, Mongolian, Chinese
text: Terrible service. We've been seated for half hour but without being served! Even they forget to server water. Will not come again. If I can give them a negative star u will def do.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: We always eat here, my family & i love dining in and they deliver!!! i love it. They make us feel welcome and take good care of us. Since we are almost there eating or ordering out the owner knows when we order. Crazy! Their service is wonderful & their food is of very good! my son LOVES the wonton soup & the egg drop soup. Bottom line is.....its GOOD FOOD!

place_category: Lounges, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bar Crawl
text: We had a great night at No Vacancy. Our waitress Theryn was so much fun, had great recommendations and was quick! The atmosphere is very old Florida and festive. Good music but not too loud. We love the outdoor dining and games. Very reasonable prices and delicious food.

place_name: Grillshack Fries and Burgers - East Nashville
place_category: American (New), Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Best burger in Nashville so far and we've had many! Love the quality and the fries were so yummy. Good price too.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Poke, Restaurants, Hawaiian, Asian Fusion, Food
text: The restaurant smelled like old socks. I got a bowl spicy tuna and spicy salmon. Toppings were seaweed salad and diakon salad. Something was rancid. I don't know what but took to bites and threw it away. Very disappointed.

place_category: Restaurants, Vegan, Vegetarian, Live/Raw Food
text: Wonderful raw vegan food! Amazed by the raw gnocchi (very flavorful and great texture with jicama and cashew with a delicious mushroom sauce) And great "mini tacos." Appreciated the fabulous service and helpful friendly staff. Easy parking spots on the beach. I highly recommend Vida De Cafe.

place_category: Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Desserts, Diners
text: I would give no stars if possible. We tried to have breakfast two different times. Walked in and dining room closed, no seats at bar or booths. No staff acknowledges presence or tries to assist. We won't ever be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Don't see the hype about this place. Burritos are all over $10 with nothing super special about them. I didn't hate it but I feel there have got to be better burritos in town. On the market side things seemed good. Lots of choices of different meats at decent prices and a variety of rice, chilies, spices, and beans. Maybe a place to buy stuff to make burritos but not a strong recommendation on buying your burrito here.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Barbeque, Food, Sandwiches, Wine Bars, Diners, Bars, Specialty Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: Had the best dinner at the bar. The grilled avocado and tri tip were delicious. The bread is homemade. The service and atmosphere are on point Thanks to Lenka for recommendations and thoughtful wine selections. We'll definitely be back - this was a treat!

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Delis, Burgers, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Local Flavor
text: Authentic and filling. This place is always busy but I wasn't crazy about the fires. The onion rings were a little over cooked but it was for a good price.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Sandwiches, Delis, Caterers, Restaurants
text: One of the worst sandwiches I've ever had. Ordered the 'chicken supreme' sandwich. When I got back to the office and opened it up I was shocked. The chicken was burnt black. It was cinders. I broke the chicken opened and it was in cinders. I was in my work uniform so I couldn't go back there because I was pissed. I would have lost it. For any deli to give out a product this bad is unfathomable. You will want to avoid this toilet at all cost. This place should get negative stars.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Food, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Sandwiches
text: Jimmy G's was a great experience. The building appears to be new and the inside is extremely clean. The service was good, very friendly. We got the cheesesteak with American cheese. If anything, it could've used a little more meat but it was so reasonably priced that we didn't mind. Can't wait to come back in the summer when the patio opens up!

place_category: Middle Eastern, Mediterranean, Restaurants, Greek
text: These gyros are amazing! I have never had a pita that was so soft and delicious. Ok, so maybe we'd had a few drinks before we shoveled this ethnic delight into our mouths but I like to think I still had my discerning tastes about me. Hubs agreed so two people can't be wrong. If you're in the mood for eating on the cheap and something other than the typical NOLA fare, I highly recommend this establishment- conveniently located in the French Quarter!

place_category: Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Sandwiches
text: This place is pretty good, not great. The bread, as stated, is excellent. I guess I don't understand why you do very regional specific hot dogs, and then skimp on the things that make those regional dogs good. An "Arizona" with basically Pace Picante sauce is bad, and a quality dog and bun can't overcome it.

place_category: Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Desserts, Food, Restaurants
text: Clementines came so highly recommended by a friend whose gourmet sense I respect. I want to say that my New York Teriyaki cut was great. The sides were a bit lackluster and the service more so. My wife got a Prime Rib which was pretty basic, nothing special. The waitress was much less than doting and i doubt i will travel the two blocks off the 101 fwy to have a meal there again. You are not my darling Clemintines.

place_category: Steakhouses, Barbeque, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Steak was pretty tough and food was cold from sitting so long. Use to have awesome steaks. The waitress messed our order up because she couldn't hear over the music which is way too loud to even be enjoyable. Never had these issues at the other locations.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Good food, nothing amazing. Staff is friendly and very convenient to midtown/downtown

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Diners, Restaurants
text: Being new to the area I wanted to check out some local eateries. We went here for lunch and ordered the turkey croquettes. They were served with either a soup or salad, mashed potatoes with gravy a side item and a fountain beverage for $8.99. All 3 in my party ordered this for lunch and we had to ask for take-out cartons since it was so much food. Two of us ordered the chicken rice soup with the meal and it was fabulous. We even got an order of soup to go since it was so good.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional)
text: Came here for restaurant week and between the 5 of us, we ordered everything on the menu. We also ordered extra from the raw bar. Food was delicious. My filet mignon supposedly rare, was overcooked. The desserts were good, not too sweet. Our final bill was also reasonable. The place used to be a bank, so the decoration was neat. I would try it again after I make my way to Barclay Prime.

place_category: Restaurants, Ethnic Food, Noodles, Food, Dim Sum, Specialty Food, Chinese
text: I ordered the stewed vegetables and tofu in coconut curry broth, and it was good. The portions were large, and this dish was super spicy (enjoyed it nonetheless). The sesame chicken is well breaded and not drowning in sauce (definitely a plus), and the congee is, well, plain congee (don't get it). It was packed when I came at 9PM on a Wednesday night, but the servers are friendly and quick!

place_category: Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Lucky's has a great, cheap breakfast. Best breakfast in the area so far. The atmosphere is fun -- they have circle tables for large groups. The menu has a sense of humor and the staff is friendly. There's typically a wait, but it's worth it. I wouldn't go for lunch/dinner...unless, of course, you plan on having breakfast for dinner ... which I'm a huge fan of. You can walk out of there w/ coffee, eggs, toast, and side of meat for under $8.00. Good deal, if you ask me!

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: It's OK. Just OK. I grabbed a quick low-fat banana berry muffin ($2.00 including tax) and the lady heated it up in the microwave for me. With so many other goodies in RTM - this might be OK if you need BREAD - but for sammies or treats I'd go elsewhere (Like Flying Monkey for treats or Olympia Gyro). But I guess that's not an apples to apples comparisson. It may be intangible, but I was never thrilled with le Bus. Very 1989.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Soup, Sushi Bars
text: roll of the house: SUMMER ROLL We had a reservation coming into this restaurant for a friend's birthday so service is not something I can really judge on. The waiters were helpful as we had a cake set aside for dessert for the end of our night. Our waiter was nice though aside from what others say. The rolls are overall great but not mindblowing. Its a great place to grab dinner especially with a group a friends. Its the middle of many venues and part of Ybor's nightlife which is also a plus.

place_category: Nightlife, Seafood, Beer Bar, Bars, Restaurants, Party & Event Planning, Event Planning & Services, Steakhouses
text: Great happy hour specials on food and drinks. The food is very tasty and the atmosphere is great. They have music on the weekends. I have had some poor service there but when I called, the manager made it better.

place_category: Sandwiches, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood
text: Wonderful food, beautiful place to eat right on the beach. Service was a bit slow, it was also a bit crowded.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Seafood Markets, Caterers, Specialty Food, Cajun/Creole
text: This restaurant very very bad service I went to the restaurant today and server he is very bad.. food is was okay..and we went with friends 8 people and we know that's the tip is already including and we're paid by credit card...but they're double charge the tip more $31 ...but they're already changed tip &19.20 total bill is $106.80 and they're charge more $31 so,,total bill is $146.52 ...what is that???so,,you can't do that..it's mean you shit on me..

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New)
text: Don't ever go here unless you want the staff to screw up your to go order. And I was the only one in the restaurant at the time. Sure they refunded my money, but only after I walked back up there.

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Decent cheesesteak, nothing special. Got it with cheese whiz just because. Bread was good. Sort of a thing you're supposed to do when you go to Philly and that's really the only good reason to stand in line here. For what it's worth, the line does move pretty quickly. I have heard they can be pretty harsh about people not having orders ready or struggling with English but I saw none of that sitting right next to the window.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Nightlife, Bars, Pubs
text: We stop in a few times a year. Good food and nice ambience. They don't do complimentary chips and salsa, which is kind of disappointing. I also suspect that portion sizes have shrunk in the past year or two. I do like their frozen margaritas, and we typically leave pretty happy.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, American (New), Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: The service was great, and the drinks were good, but the whipped topping was coolwhip, not whipped cream. The food was okay, but seemed mostly frozen. It's a fun vibe with super friendly bartenders but food is not worth the price.

place_category: Drugstores, Shopping, Restaurants, Grocery, Delis, Sandwiches, Florists, Flowers & Gifts, Pharmacy, Food, Health & Medical
text: Only 5 checkout lanes in the whole store (not including self- checkout), only 2 of them open on a normal Saturday afternoon, neither of them a 15 items or less lane, only 3 of the 4 self- checkout lanes working, lines waiting to check out 10 - 15 people long, no staff attempting to alleviate the very obvious backlog. I'd say this is rare here, but it's par for the course. Hopefully by writing this down, I'll remember and never come here again!

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Awful service and botched to-go order - again (second time)! I am NOT impressed and definitely not going back.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, Peruvian, Seafood
text: Authentic as it comes! Love this place! The chef's wife is amazing! Only problem was the food was over salted for me as well as the others I was with!

place_category: Food Delivery Services, Restaurants, Pizza, Food
text: Aside from having the best cheesesteaks in our area!!...... I went in today (sat) and there were two guys and a woman there. These folks, employees of Emiliano's, were incredibly polite, pleasant and friendly!! I officially love this place. ( tell the boys there that I'm the guy that came in on a motorcycle today)

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: This is the 2nd best but only because it's further way out of the 3. This is a super nice Costco right next to a nice Kroger marketplace. Worth the membership

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Sandwiches, Burgers
text: It's a cool, hip spot in 12S, but nothing out of your ordinary burger you can find anywhere else in town. The host could care less about her job which made our first impression a bit salty to start. We were seated at the small bar to the window even though there were a ton of tables empty. This made it a bit uncomfortable when the door kept swinging open when customers came and went - temperature outside was around 45. I loved the honey mustard the most!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Burgers, Southern
text: One of my spots to eat! The food is great but the employees are even better! There's both inside and outside sitting area and the atmosphere is great. One of my favorite dessert has to be the bread pudding!

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: Horrible hostess last night. Said they weren't serving food at the bar. They were. Took an hour to get a Caesar salad and half rack of ribs. Manager ignored us every time he entered the bar area. Won't be going back until it's something new.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers
text: Employees are always friendly here. Blizzards are good. Time in drive thru is fast. Overall a very nice place.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: One of my favorites when I come to visit family for the holidays. Doesn't matter what location .... Kahwa is some of the best. They offer oat milk as well!

place_category: Breweries, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Food, Bars
text: Didn't have food- just beer. At bar. We are ( SoCal award-winning) homebrewers and their beer is AWESOME! Best is CaliLove. Bar service is attentive and fun and friendly. If we decide to eat here tomorrow, I'll update review with food. But seriously, if you are a zymurgist, you don't go to a brewery for food. In fact, you probably live on beer, not food.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Brasseries, Breweries, Distilleries, Gastropubs
text: Cool place (old train depot) in Reno, we were there for Street Vibrations. I had the tacos, and my wife enjoyed her wrap.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea

The people all interacted well with each other. The bartender, Jennifer went ABOVE AND BEYOND to make drinks that were very specialized for me!! She was great. The Live Band was great, they sounded great and had a wide variety of Music they played. It was a fantastic night out!!

place_category: Greek, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Turkish
text: Fabulous decor. Super friendly and attentive staff. And the food is fabulous! Sat on the patio and enjoyed a lovely brunch. So sad we didn't try it years ago. We will most definitely add it to the regular rotation. The waiters were fabulous, made the meal that more enjoyable.

place_category: Breweries, Nightlife, Meat Shops, Specialty Food, Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Delis, Pubs, Food
text: Try the carnita fries. I would murder my friends for these!!! The venue is nice, spacious and relaxed. The beer is good but not the best in indy.

text: Why oh why doesn't your register accept a credit card with a chip reader? The cashier made me enter my card number manually. Absolutely ridiculous!!

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: This place is decent but is an overrated tourist trap. I found the gumbo to be on the salty side, nice ambiance, and good service.

place_category: Noodles, Chinese, Szechuan, Restaurants
text: I was pretty disappointed in this restaurant. We ordered orange chicken, beef lo mein, noodles and two types of dumplings. The only thIng we liked was the orange chicken. I am not at all a picky eater and will try everything and anything but after eating the steamed dumplings I couldn't anymore. Our waitress was nice though. Won't be going back!

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: Saw their billboard on I80. The picture is nothing like the real thing. If their burger was as good as their marketing, they might have a chance. Went a second time a couple weeks later because I was just in one of those moods for a non-gourmet basic mushroom swiss burger. Hmm... the first time was better. If I'm in the neighborhood and happen to feel like giving them another try, maybe, but I sure won't be making any more special trips over there.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Tapas Bars, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Latin American
text: it's place good for drink, not for dinner. Food is good but absolutely over prize. All dishes are tapas portion (very small) but priced as a normal portions. Very disappointed. We spent 400$ in 5 and we tried few plates, at the end we couldn't share because portion were really ridicules. I would recommend only for cocktail. No even sangria which is to much sweet.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Italian, Restaurants, American (New)
text: I've been here a few times and every time I am a bit more disappointed with the food. Their bar menu is a typical bar menu ranging from wings to burgers... Nothing special. Their regular menu is a bit overpriced. Happy Hour specials aren't too bad when you want to sit outside and have a couple drinks.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: A step above Taco Bell. No even close to real Mexican food. Big disappointment. This area need an authentic Mexican restaurant. Their chip are from a bag. Pretty sure the same for the salsa. And I kept hearing the microwave beeper going off. Not the most appealing.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Pizza, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars
text: The three stars are for the food, and I'd give a -1 to the atmosphere. Nondescript loud bar, but the real issue is the lack of a seating system. No reservations, no list - just stand around bothering people trying to enjoy their meal. Waaaaaaay tired of being asked, "Can we have your table?"

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Buffets, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Love this buffet every time we visit Reno we always stop there it's a must ! The bakery is the best by far and the warm crab legs are great as well ! The price isn't that bad either and the service was great. Hostess and waitress were very nice and helpful , We will definitely be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, American (Traditional)
text: Asked for a cup of coffee at 8.30 on a Saturday night I was informed they didn't have any apparently it was dumped . Well I'm a server and work in a very busy restaurant number one we would never tell a customer we don't have any coffee made . We'd go make it . Worst start ever I can only imagine how the rest of this is going to go

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Comfort Food, American (New), Sandwiches, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Like eating here, tried wait list through yelp, it did not work so our group ended up going to Cheesecake Factory instead with no wait. Thought restaurant needed to know. Plus we are in OV part of town, system will not let you book early if you are more than 10 miles out. Tried booking early by driving closer, still no go.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: When I visited today the staff rushed orders. Portions of the food was skimpier than usual.. my chicken and cheese quesadilla was missing chicken on half the quesadilla. When I asked for a side of guac I noticed that it looked less than fresh. When I questioned staff regarding it I was given unnecessary attitude from staff that made my visit unpleasant...

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: The drinks were good, the pitchers of whatever they are were fruity and tasty and kick wasn't noticed till we stood up... yum and fun! With every plate placed on the table the people at the table commented "Ohh, I should have got that" or "Damn that looks good". End result, we were trading plates and trying everything, that was awesome! I'm coming back here when in Florida because the fish was great, the atmosphere upstairs as well as the view were amazing.

place_category: Food, Hot Dogs, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Desserts, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants
text: The ice cream was good. Same as you'll get at a thousand other places. I ordered a chocolate/vanilla twist cone and two chili cheese hotdogs. My total was nearly $16. $16 for two hotdogs and an ice cream cone! The ice cream cone was $3 which mean each of those dogs were $6+ each.....what in the world! That's beyond highway robbery. I'm flabbergasted.

place_name: The Gas Lamp Restaurant and Bar
place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (New), Bars
text: Totally mixed on this place. Pros- - our waiter was great; service overall was top notch - parking- small lot but there is also street parking - prices were reasonable - piano player - very homey ambiance Cons- - I honestly didn't think my food was that good; didn't have a lot of flavor IMO - drink was watery - limited menu I would go again to get something different because the ambiance and the service was that good.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: True Mexican street tacos. I ordered Carne Asada, Adobada and Tongue. Adobada is the best and full of flavor. The other two were okay. 4 Stars for Adobada 2 Stars for Carne Asada and Tongue Enjoy the two condiment stations.

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, Tacos
text: Don't come here for your lunch break. Drive thru is down with no signage and there's two people working the whole place

place_category: Fast Food, Burgers, American (New), Restaurants

text: I ordered corned beef and cabbage over the phone and picked it up to take it home. I was told that it was their specialty for tonight (St. Patrick's Day). The corned beef was average and the cabbage was almost raw. One would think that it would be properly cooked.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Pretty good...nothing spectacular. I've had better at Lucy's in Austin where the ingredients are of better quality I guess. One thing is for sure- if you are squeamish or expect clean places you should go elsewhere...I've eaten at taco trucks in Mexico that were straight up scary but this place is FUNKY.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Gave me food poisoning never eat there again it was good at first but bad in the end don't know why they are still open need to be shut down and they have dogs on the inside of the business so I don't trust them at all bad for business if I must add but go and eat what they have to offer and see you in the hospital

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: I do not expect a lot from a fast food place but I do expect accuracy and cleanliness. The staff was not friendly and looked disheveled. Half our order came out while we waited for the other half which is ridiculous. The dining area needed tables wiped down and trash emptied. The food itself was fine. They do offer the soda machines that have a huge amount of selections like Powerades and Dasani waters. The drive thru may be a better option if we ever come back.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Delis, Pizza, Sandwiches
text: I work at St Thomas Midtown & the driver couldn't find me, even after explaining how to find where I was in detail. The delivery guy wanted me to come to him to pick up my food. I thought that was why I way paying a delivery fee. When I got my food it was cold & hard. Never again.

place_category: Restaurants, Indian
text: Great restaurant! Excellent food! Superb service!! Trust me you won't be disappointed.

place_category: Ramen, Restaurants, Japanese, Noodles, Chinese
text: Everything about our experience was exceptional from the service, the apps and the ramen! Highly recommend!! Eat local!

place_category: Restaurants, Soup, Bagels, Food, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches
text: Was Five stars first time I go, but disappoints more and more each time. Stayed a consistent three starred rating until the last time they poured water I. The broccoli cheddar soup. It was more of a drink than a soup.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: A nice little cafe for breakfast or lunch. Very small so seating is a premium, but the food was good. The coffee wasn't the best but a nice little find.
