text: I've never been to smoothie king before but I stopped by since it's near to the supertarget. Pros My berry blast was pretty good. Cons A medium was 6.50 . Slightly expensive Also the line was long and slow. The employees were working fast but maybe another person would be helpful.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Bars, Tex-Mex, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Nightlife
text: Presence on Yelp looked solid and it has potential but just didn't measure up. Had the ribs, tips and rotisserie chicken and it was average. The chicken was definitely the highlight of the dish. Sides were not memorable. Decent service and the environment was fine but the place was just missing something. We had a large group of people and everyone was basically "meh" about their meals.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Pizza
text: Best American breakfast/brunch food in Nashville. I always stop in whenever I am in town since I live 550 miles away.

place_category: Nightlife, American (New), Restaurants, Bars, Chicken Wings, Sports Bars
text: Well i came back to the Winghouse on Ulmerton. Said i would never put myself through this again but he i am. Service has improved. .. food is always good it was just getting it. Bar staff has gotten a lot better at least fit this visit. Hopefully it lasts. I probably will come back so watch for next review. Joined the Kerr's club. Says you get a free appetizer. Well that didn't happen.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Diners, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I tried the Fit Breakfast, and it is exactly what you need after an early morning workout. The restaurant was clean, and order was correct, waitress had a pleasant attitude. Good spot for a decent breakfast, especially if you are an early morning gym rat. Will be going back for post workout breakfast.

place_category: Fast Food, Southern, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings
text: As expected the line was long and the service was slow. The sandwich came hot and the chicken portion was large. The chicken was stringy but the sandwich was still pretty tasty. The bun was like a Hawaiian roll and was delicious, so I added one start.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food
text: Slowwwww. Anytime during the day they take 10-15 minutes to get you your food. They always forget my frosty. Have to remind them when they hand me my food. Good people that work in there but not motivated

place_category: Spanish, Cafes, Cuban, Latin American, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Cafe con leche was good, atmosphere nice and playing Spanish music. Frita sandwich however was NOT bUEño. Took one bite and Yep, raw. I would of never thought that- good presentation and took about 10-15 min to get sandwich. A manager never came to address but waitress did her best to try and salvage. I opted for meatless apology and Got rice and beans. We do not plan on returning.

place_category: Nightlife, Cafes, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Bars, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Salad
text: Love this place. I have been going here for years and the food, the wait staff and the bartenders have always been top notch. Love the food, quick service even though they are always busy and everyone is so friendly and don't make you feel rushed. Go, go, go, you will not be disappointed!!!!!! And, they are right on the Delaware River and plenty of parking

place_category: Coffee & Tea, New Mexican Cuisine, Restaurants, Tacos, Acai Bowls, Food, Nightlife, Mexican, Bars, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: Simply a perfect Mexican cantina. Friendly staff, wonderful atmosphere, and INCREDIBLE food. The street tacos and corn r exquisite. Try this place, but go at off times

place_category: Soup, Salad, Vegan, Restaurants, Vegetarian
text: This Sweetgreen location is simply awesome. The salad ingredients are the freshest and highest quality of any salad restaurant I've ever tried. Love the Spicy Szabsi and the Kale Caesar. And I can't say enough about the crew who works here. Same gang since opening day and they are as efficient and friendly as can be. I hope they are well compensated as they truly deserve it. Service is outstanding. I don't know how the Saladworks around the corner will ever survive now that this is here.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Delicious latte. Polite service And today the latte is possibly the worst ever. It tastes burnt. They do no have vanilla syrup, natural sugar, or chai tea even though there is a box of it behind the shelf. :(

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I have never been there but when I called today, they told me that the Magnolia Cafe name is no longer used but that they serve appetizers and drinks on Wednesday night at 5 p. M. For the Jazz crawl.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Gastropubs, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Lounges, Bars
text: Maybe I didn't order the right thing. The ham and brie omelette I had was just fine with nothing stood out. The white trash hash, however, was good. There was a big crowd waiting for tables around 12 pm, so make sure that you arrive 10 or 10:30ish to avoid the wait.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Food, Salad, Desserts
text: Thin crust, hand made with love and drizzled in deliciousness. This place has the best way pizza in NJ. The buffalo chx and their classic tomato pies are our favorite. BYOB too!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Italian, Restaurants, American (New)
text: London Grill is nothing spectacular - food is ok, although overpriced....definitely nothing to rush back for Drink menu is extensive. Service was helpful and friendlyduring my visit.

place_category: Restaurants, Korean
text: It used to be one of my favorite place to eat Korean but the owners are not nice people. They are not customer friendly!

place_category: Diners, Restaurants
text: Nothing bad here. Nice staff, impressive menu and reasonable prices. I had the spinach roll and Italian sausage soup. Very yummy! Next time I'll be getting the beef tips and noodles. They were on special that night but I wasn't too hungry at the time. Couple other customers ordered it though and it looked yummy. Also, it's so close to home that carry out is viable and saw a few patrons get take out so def shall return...dine in or take out!

place_category: Seafood, Vegetarian, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Chinese, Japanese
text: The Garlic Shrimp was tasty. The fried rice seem like white rice with peas added was not impressed. I would give it second chance.

place_category: Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Vegan, Restaurants, Acai Bowls
text: ERose makes my absolute favorite smoothie: "Dark magic"! All of their smoothies and açaí bowls are delicious. The staff are always friendly and the shop is always clean! I've been to their downtown location as well and it's equally as good!

place_category: Nightlife, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Restaurants, Bars
text: Took an additional 30 minutes on top of a 45 minute wait to get our pick up order. When we did finally get it, it was incorrect and cold. I called to speak to a manager for a refund. The girl that originally answered the phone was rude and hung up on me. Even told me there was 4 other people on the line waiting to complain and speak to a manager. Took over 20 minutes to get a manager and my refund. Awful place. Awful staff. Awful food.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: I'm in from Detroit and staying at Ameristar for a few days. I love sushi! I fFound this local sushi place in a strip plaza. Reasonable attempt at sushi. But unfortunately they do not use rice wine vinegar in the rice for the sushi plus the soy sauce tasted spoiled. Limited menu choices.

place_category: Mediterranean, Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Persian/Iranian
text: I have been here several times but not regularly. My visits were spread apart. I finally realized that this restaurant has gone through several owners. That is why sometimes it is good and sometimes it is bad. I gave it 3 stars since it is "hit or miss" depending on the owner. If you want consistent Middle Eastern food go to Sis kabob House. Same owner since the beginning!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: This restaurant does not even deserve one star. They got our order wrong, when we called to tell them they missed our chicken, they said it was in another container. When I checked it wasn't there. They said they would bring it and it's been 40 Minutes and no chicken. Shame on them

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Restaurants, Hotels & Travel, American (New), Hotels, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional)
text: Checked into hotel, assigned a bell man whether you need one or not. Takes us to our room, I tip him 10 dollars and he leaves. Going to dinner later and can't find the room key. After much looking I go to front desk and they smile and hand me the keys saying the bellman forgot to give them to me. No phone call, text or room call. All the staff seem nice, and smile but fail to perform. Management seems absent.

place_category: Specialty Food, Bars, Candy Stores, Desserts, Cocktail Bars, Lounges, American (New), Chocolatiers & Shops, Restaurants, Nightlife, Food
text: I just didn't find anything that makes their menu standout from any other desert menu at any mediocre restaurant.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Food, Cajun/Creole, Specialty Food, Comfort Food, Restaurants
text: This is horrible gumbo. After I came back from New Orleans I made chicken shrimp and beef sausage gumbo 10 times better than this place. I'm uncertain if these reviews are fake or if everyone who comes here are tourist from Northern states who don't know any better. Don't get me wrong I have had lack luster gumbo in New Orleans before but it was never declared as award winning. SMH Falsities.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants
text: We had breakfast here 2 times during our stay. The waitress we had was so friendly and accommodating. Best eggs and bacon we've tasted. The biscuits were a little hard but the rest of food was great.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: whatever, its a chain blah blah, im not really here to beat a dead horse on that one, but what happened to the free chips and salsa?!?!?! its GONE and honestly it was the most edible thing they had.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Tacos, Mexican, Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Fast Food

place_category: Donuts, Food, Bakeries, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Desserts
text: The employees at this location are worthless and unfriendly. They are NEVER open 24 hours like they say they are. The door is locked and someone is probably sleeping in the back. Aside from decent fast food, and good donuts, everything else is lacking. They really need new employees and new management. I honestly don't even like breathing the same air as the employees that work there as their stupidity might be contagious.

place_category: Soul Food, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Caribbean
text: Worst customer service the little ugly lady in the front have an attitude will never go back there again.

place_category: Indian, Desserts, Cafes, Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea, Nightlife, Lounges, Bars
text: Decent coffee, drinks, shakes and ethnic food. But in my opinion, over-priced for the portion.

place_category: Hot Dogs, Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food
text: I have been trapped in this drive through for over 30 minutes!! And then when I finally get to the window, they tell me they have to cook the vegan meat and that will be an additional wait. I never eat burgers but this has been a complete turn off! They are completely discombobulated and seem to be inefficient. This certainly is NOT fast food and I would encourage you to go elsewhere. I've literally been waiting for nearly 45 minutes and am tempted to take this as an L and go elsewhere.

place_category: Delis, Restaurants
text: My favorite pizza by far!!! It's all handmade including dough and sauce. You can buy it by the slice as well. The sandwiches are excellent too. The Manhattan Nightmare is piled high with cornbeef, coleslaw and Russian dressing. It's well worth the $9.00 since its big enough for two meals.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: While waiting for the bus, the bus station food didn't really appeal so I went across the street to this place with an extensive menu. It was hot in there, but I managed to get my order and get back to the station in plenty of time. I got a huge grilled chicken salad for only $4.99, kid got two pieces of fried chicken and fries, husband got a a Philly Cheese Steak. They were out of ranch dressing and the bathroom was broken that day.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers
text: The worker Anthony definitely deserves employee of the month. He provided the best service and made sure that I was completely satisfied with my order. Best employee out there. And their food is pretty good. I recommend the nuggets but the sriracha could be a bit better.

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, American (New), Seafood
text: New restaurant, visit New Orleans a few times a year. Had the Election Day dinner. Fantastic everything. Highly recommend

place_category: Desserts, Bubble Tea, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: I came here and ordered two vietnamese ice coffee with bubbles. Now there's only so little you can do to mess up an jce coffee, and I'm not sure what went wrong but the coffee was not drinkabe, we had to toss both of them away. It was really strong and condensed.

place_category: Mediterranean, Restaurants
text: Best food restaurant for Turkish kebabs and salads. Try the eggplant!! The food is fresh and amazing. Great service. Beautiful decor and atmosphere!

place_name: M.L.Rose Craft Beer & Burgers - Sylvan Park
place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Bars, Beer Bar, Nightlife, Pubs
text: Thank you for your response. We came in around 1pm. Yes, I agree the menu had a great variety that children would like however I would have been charged the full adult price. Neither of the waitresses offered any suggestions. We'll keep you in mind for our date nights when our son is not with us.

place_category: Specialty Food, Restaurants, Korean, Ethnic Food, Food, Barbeque
text: A bit on the pricey side compared to other Korean restaurants around the area but worth it. The service and food were both great!

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Noodles, Seafood
text: On our way through Tucson and looking for a quick lunch and came across Senae...amazing Thai food! We had Pad Thai (oh so good!) beef with Brussels sprouts, Tomka soup. Then topped off with the most fabulous mango sticky rice! This is a gem in in the desert . "T" was a very good server.

place_category: Middle Eastern, American (New), Restaurants, Mediterranean, Southern
text: The fried avocado sandwich was good! No wi-fi , and slow to serve the coffee. But, they were able to seat 12 of us for brunch!

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: A nostalgia throwback, these place is old school and is run with efficiency gained after that many years in busy. A big line but it moves quick so don't be scared off. Basically everyone gets the cheesesteak, however I also got a hoagie. The hoagie was huge and quick nice. The cheesesteak was good but nothing to go out of your way for. Decent spot, but I've checked the cheesesteak box with no need to return.

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Japanese, Sushi Bars
text: This is by far the worst sushi I have ever had in my life. Worse than Chinese buffets. Worse than grocery store. Literally do not waste your money. Not fresh, don't know how to roll, their sauces are all wrong, and there wasn't a single good thing out of everything I tried. Wish I could give 0 stars and can't understand how anyone gave them more than a 1.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: I loved the decor in here and had a great time with my Bro. The food was good but I felt like it could have had a "fresher" look to lettuce and salsa to make me say 4 star. The wait staff were quick and excellent. It was busy but staff seemed unstressed due to having an appropriate number of them to handle it. I'd go again for there were other menu items I'd like to try. Excellent soutwest/mexican music overhead.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: Best, unassuming oyster house in NOLA. Ridiculously good grilled oysters with a guy at the bar who is more than willing to teach you how to shuck. Fabulous!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Sushi Bars
text: I will never go back there. The appetizers came at different times. The entrees came 15 minutes after each other and the waiter was rude. The food was not good enough to overcome the lackluster service on what should have been an easy Tuesday night. The Katsu Don was tasteless. It was memorable - a bad memory I hope to soon forget. They are coasting and have no concern for their customers.

place_category: Irish, Nightlife, Restaurants, Pubs, Bars, Irish Pub
text: If you're looking for a place to go to after work or to go for a few relaxed drinks with friends, this is your place to go. The set up inside is absolutely beautiful and the prices are great. Everyday they have specials for pints and pitchers. The one let down I found about this place was the wings. Overall I had a good experience and definitely is a place I would return to.

place_category: American (Traditional), Southern, Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Great find. The food and atmosphere was very homey and delicious. The staff was amazing!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Burgers, Fast Food, Steakhouses
text: Our family had high hopes, as this was our first visit, but food wasn't that good and it's pricey. Burger was way undercooked, and overall restaurant lacked cleanliness. With the kitchen so close to the dining, it's loud and hot. We wouldn't be likely to go back, better options nearby.

place_category: Patisserie/Cake Shop, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bakeries
text: The almond croissant was too sweet for me but the kid loved it. The gruyere felt over buttery. Garlic loaf was decent but maybe I should have chosen the olive loaf instead. It's a lovely setting and pretty busy in there. I might try it again.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Mexican
text: We got two tequila based cocktails. They were both too sugary. My wife couldn't finish hers because of the sweetness, I had to add a shot of lime juice to mine to make it palatable. Very disappointing. Maybe the endless list of cocktails should have been warned us off. Most places just list their best or unique or most popular cocktails. They should change their name to sugary or something.

place_category: Restaurants, Irish
text: Great new place! We sat on the restaurant side, right in front of a huge TV and watched the Cardinals game. The Irish Croquettes were amazing - one of the best appetizers I've ever had. I ordered the Dubliner Waffle which was different, but very good. My husband loved his Rueben sandwich. We will be back for sure!

place_category: Restaurants, Ramen, Japanese
text: Great food at an unbeatable price - Need I say more? Ok, I guess I have a little more to say. First, location: Right next to Lee Lee's, tucked into the strip mall. We need more great places like this on the north side. Food: I wish they served ramen all the time, but everything I've had is wonderful! Gyoza hit the spot, spicy tuna was out of this world, and the beef was awesome. I will be back again and again!

place_category: Breweries, Food, Bars, Beer Bar, Nightlife, Brewpubs
text: Absolutely love Miel. Not only their beers but their space. It's always so chill and fun. They do the most amazing job at keeping their IG up to date with weekly events and pop up's at the brewery. They have daily food truck and pops up of all types of cuisines. They also host craft nights and other types of events like Christmas mini photo shoots! They truly embody the spirit of New Orleans in let's celebrate all its makers.

text: I rarely make reviews and picky on food, since I used to work for over 10 years in Banquet at luxury resort , this is a Hidden Gem. Stayed in Reno for two days. Ate most of the time at Buffets. On our way home from Legend Outlets, me and wife looking for a place to eat. Found this Authentic Filipino food, and me and my wife agreed best food we actually had on our two days in Reno. This is a real Hidden Gem for people wanna try or eat Authentic Filipino Dishes.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Salad, Bars, Burgers
text: I always order based on pictures of previous posts because that's what looks good! Nothing the day I went looks like what it did on other orders, it was cold, very fatty, and no flavor at all. So depressing. Everyone in our party was disappointed for many reasons let's hope it's just because it's covid but even if it is covid if that's my first experience I wouldn't go again

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Fast Food
text: Tried it for the first time yesterday. Had soft tacos with carnitas. Meat was great. They put rice on my tacos and it wasn't cooked all the way. Also expected corn tortillas and they were flour. My son got a steak burrito and the meat was gristly.

place_category: American (New), Breweries, Nightlife, Food, Bars, Pizza, Restaurants
text: Not really sure if it's a brewery or a brew house, meaning they don't brew on site. There are too many great breweries in the Tampa Bay Area to put BJ's in the same conversations. The beer is mediocre at best. The food was good, I had the Pepperoni Extreme, which is a flat bread pepperoni pizza. It was really good, and not too filling. I would definitely go back, for the food, but not for the beer.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: I wonder how many barbecue commenters here have ever had REAL ribs. Real barbecue, as in from Memphis, NC, or Texas. Fall off the bone, succulent, juicy and tender meat cooked in a smoker for days. With amazing BBQ sauce. This is nothing like the BBQ I enjoyed living in the South. This is not even tender. And ditto on the Mac n cheese. It was pretty good, but not worth the price for a few measly mouthfuls. Ah... if only Philly would get ONE decent BBQ place. Meh...not impressed.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: I have been going there for years and now they will not give you a cup for water. I think when a customer orders $30 of food and drinks and then asks for one cup for water is not too much to ask. The guy said we could buy a bottle of water. No thanks. Over the years the employees and owners of this place have gotten more and more rude. That was our last visit there. If you can not give a repeat customer a cup for water then have just lost that cistumer.

place_category: Donuts, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: It's nothing more than you expect...so don't set that bar too high. You'll get your coffee for cheaper than starbucks and have change to spare for a donut if you don't mind the sugar crash later on the plane. Not the friendliest service in the world but it was early in the morning. Grab your drinks at the side before the girl behind you yells at you to move.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: This place is awesome!!!! The best burger I have had throughout all of St.Pete. Prices were extremely low and the quality of food was top notch . Also I highly recommend the "blackened" boneless wings. You will not be disappointed. A+ !!!

place_category: Food, Organic Stores, Specialty Food, Health Markets, Grocery
text: Without a doubt my favorite store in this area. Everyone is very friendly and makes you feel awesome as they go the extra mile to ensure full satisfaction. Great food and wonderful quality. The staff makes every effort to ensure you feel 100% safe during these uncertain times - I just simply love this store!

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Latin American, Tex-Mex, Mexican
text: After an initial 4 star rating for freshness and service, a year later many things indicate this restaurant has recently changed hands (October 2015). Good food and service are a thing of the past. Rice overdone, fail to melt topping cheese on enchiladas, chips from a bag, salsa from a jar, pico inedible. It's better than taco bell, but I'm sure you can do better without going far.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: This Starbucks is normally on point but a couple of days ago I went to get a drink and waited in the line of the drive through for 25 minutes before I got up to the window to get my order. I was so frustrated that I didn't realize that my order was wrong before I pulled off. I tried to go back so that they could fix it but they had already closed 10 minutes early. Online it says they close at 1030pm but the door says that they close at 1000pm.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food
text: It's a nice burger but probably not worth the drive for me. I'll try the other burger places in town to have a backup or something closer. The service is unbeatable though.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bakeries
text: Come on Busch Gardens, do a little cleaning before you open. The place still had dead bug and crumbs on the window sill at 11:30am. I mean the park is clean, but some of the eateries need just a little sweeping and dusting. The food in this place is limited, but it didn't taste stale. I still enjoy Busch Gardens as a whole, but I'll eat before and after I visit.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood Markets, Specialty Food, Seafood, Sandwiches, Food
text: Great hometown spot!! My cousin took us here when we landed in New Orleans and it was a great first meal. The chargrilled oysters were the best. Whole crab was flavorful and meat was so tender. The jambalaya grits were not good and gator bites were more like hush puppies.

place_category: Cafes, Food, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Coffee Roasteries, Restaurants
text: Great cafe. Free wifi. Love the atmosphere. Teas so good I had to track down their supplier (Premium Steap nearby). I would definitely come back here if I ever come back to Philly.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Salad
text: My family and I went here for the first time and were impressed. The staff were very helpful and the ambiance is nice. 10/10 would recommend.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Southern, Restaurants, Comfort Food, Cafes
text: On the advice of yelp! We checked this place out. We were very pleased with the food. Even though it's a fast food atmosphere (the reason for the 4 stars and not 5) the food was great!! I would recommend anyone to stop by and try it out.

place_category: Cafes, Food, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Coffee Roasteries, Restaurants
text: Just got here for a quick coffee but got much more than I anticipated. Had a really diverse menu, ended up ordering their signature drink "The Elixr" it really surprised me, its quite excellent. Soon after ordering Ben started a coffee tasting going over the cultivatiin, local & flavor profiles of 5 diff beans. Really nice surroundings, excellent vibe and cool people behind the bar/counter. I strongly suggest checking this place out.

place_category: American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Restaurants
text: Drove clear across town after calling to verify the hours. Showed Up 30 minutes before they said they closed... found the for picked and they answer the phone saying "thank you for calling Frankie's on Campbell we are not accepting orders" I ask if they are closed and they said yes..... don't believe why they say if you have to drive far

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: I used to love this place until they changed it to cafeteria style eating. I went at lunch, ordered at the cash register, was given a number to place at my table. Water is self serve and so are the sodas. It took them 50 minutes to serve my meal! There was no one to complain to because there is no service provided whatsoever. I will never waste my money there again!

place_category: Breweries, Pizza, American (New), Nightlife, Food, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants
text: This place has a nice interior and vibe to it. Great beer selection including local craft beers. The place boasted about their deep dish pizza. Being a Chicago native I had low expectations, but this pizza was just terrible! I'm not sure why they call it deep dish as it's nothing like real deep dish pizza. If anything it is more like a pan pizza. Go for the beer but not the pizza

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Terrible service terrible cook don't waste your hard earned money server drops food not seen again till the check was dropped off

place_category: Food, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Caterers, Smokehouse, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Unfortunately we were not satisfied. We're spoiled by the ribs in Nashville. The rib meat didn't fall off the bone, the sides were ok. The sauces they have are yummy. Felt safe for Covid. This place was recommended by a local but for visiting this city, weren't too impressed.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Sushi Bars, Soup, Japanese
text: Thiis place has great sushi and its cheap. Cant wait to try more stuff like the hibachi. $10 lunch for all you can eat that isn't a buffet is awsome.

place_category: Halal, Restaurants, Mexican, Steakhouses
text: Seems like this restaurant doesn't care that there is a pandemic going on. I went to pick up my order and no one was wearing a mask. There were at least 6 people in there. There were also 2 people sitting and eating inside. That's against PA COVID19 rules. When I asked where their masks were, they said it wasn't a law. They were also nasty and combative. One guy laughed at me when I asked where his mask was. I used to love this place and I will never go back.

place_category: Sandwiches, Burgers, Food, Restaurants, American (New), Fast Food
text: I love 5 guys and the chain never fails to deliver the best fast food. Buns are the what makes them different. But I was disappointed in this location because this is First wave of openings with COVID and only 2 workers wore a mask out of 8-10 people. One of those didn't count because he wore his under his nose, then under his chin. Doesn't work unless you wear it right. I'm really shocked. Other 5guys locations wear masks. Fyi

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Candy Stores, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants, Soul Food, Specialty Food
text: Decent food but more of a late night diner spot.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Soul Food, Southern
text: Second time here was as good as the first! Everything was fresh and delicious. Only sad that I couldnt finish all of it in 1 sitting! Had kids chicken strips, fries, 1 piece catfish, hushpuppies, fried okra, cornbread, brisket bbq sandwich with hot bbq sauce, coleslaw and chips. (I promise I didnt try to eat all of it myself, but I did try everything).

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Restaurants
text: Look people, if youz think your gonna get the best cheese steak in Philly at Terminal F, then you deserve to be in Terminal F. Just appreciate that if youz was too stoopid to find a good cheesesteak among the million or so places OUTSIDE the airport, you can still pretend.

place_category: Cantonese, Restaurants, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Asian Fusion, Seafood, Chinese, Bars, Wine Bars
text: Calamari salt and pepper was perfect!! The tofu salt and pepper came well over cooked. Not even close to the picture, and missing all of that the flavor the calamari presented. Terribly overpriced crab fried rice. It was a nice dish, but average at best, and the udon wasn't anything to write home about. Nice place, great service, but more pricey for lunch then is appropriate.

place_category: Salad, Gay Bars, Desserts, Bars, Burgers, Food, Restaurants, Nightlife, Pubs
text: Great beer selection, top notch bar food. Only downside is that you have to yell to talk to the person across the table from you. People trying to talk over excessively loud music gets tiring.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Sports Bars
text: I've eaten at this location twice with my family since it opened. The service and food have been great! I expected some hiccups due to them being newly opened but none have been experienced. The biggest suprise was the Pretzel appetizer. Most places you only receive a few pretzels or they are hard. The ones at Glory Days are amazing and the sauces they give with it are equally as amazing. I would highly recommend eating here.

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, Food Trucks, American (New), Food
text: Got to be the worst place on the Broadway strip! They were out of everything! Took forever and the food was cold when we got it like it was sitting for some time. Service was hands down the worst we have ever had anywhere!!

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional)
text: Service was impeccable, Food was amazing. My new "go to" restaurant anytime I am in Philly. Sets the benchmark for all great steakhouses to aspire to.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Vegan, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Cute little breakfast/brunch spot, but definitely appeals to a specific type of crowd. But, we got to see some of the Krewe of NYX on the day of their parade, so that was cool!

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, American (New), Art Galleries, Shopping, Cocktail Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Nightlife, Chocolatiers & Shops, Specialty Food, Bars
text: YUM!! Visited this place with family prior to an event at the Fox Theatre. Everyone had a great time and the food was beyond delicious. Service was also on point. The atmosphere was also really awake some to experience. Loved the vintage and historical vibe of the establishment. Will definitely be back. Keep up the great work!!

place_category: Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Food, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Pubs, Bars, Mexican
text: Modern Mexican with a great atmosphere in Center City. Room is small but feels spacious even when packed. Food is pretty good, not amazing but does hit the spot. Service was both attentive and fast, would come again.

place_category: Breweries, Food, Brewpubs
text: Cool place with neat decor. If you don't have you Vax card, you can only sit outside, there is a small order window you can order from. They don't have flights but you can try some small samples. We ordered the Sommerbock which was a very good summer beer, very light and easy to drink. They do have some sandwiches you can order as well from a separate business. Everything is through a QR code for the menu. Some street parking nearby.

place_category: Restaurants, Tapas Bars, Food, Nightlife, Bars, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Seafood, American (New), Desserts, Venues & Event Spaces, Tapas/Small Plates, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: Always great service, great food and great drinks. This place has a great ambiance, super friendly employees and great food! It may be our favorite restaurant in Clearwater!!

place_category: Delis, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Sandwiches
text: By far my favorite sandwich is the aporkalypse. Seriously, stop what you are doing and get one. Why are you still reading? Go get one

place_name: San Jose Mexican Restaurant Webster Groves
place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: Consistently the best Mexican food I have eaten anywhere, including Mexico (will try harder next time). Highlights: Tender pork carnitas and chili verde. My personal favorite salsa in the area, can always tell it has fresh cilantro and just the right amount of heat. Cuco's margaritas Excellent and friendly service, our frequent go to for family get togethers.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Buffets, Comfort Food
text: Not to bad foodwise,but for the price expected better.

place_category: Restaurants, Pakistani, Indian
text: This is $14 worth of Tandoori Chicken. It arrived an hour later, cold, and SKIMP as fk. It usually comes with larger pieces of chicken, mixed peppers and onions. Y'all see what we got. UPDATE: We got dry leftovers. The basmati rice was awful. The naan was tough and cold. It's upsetting bc we order from there every week and this was the worst service we've ever had.

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Peruvian, Seafood
text: This place is not authentic Peruvian food and there is no space between the tables. It's a very small hole in the wall. The hostess is very rude and the food prices are redickulous. I would not recommend this place.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Hotels, Event Planning & Services
text: Just stopped in for a beer and an appetizer since I had a Hilton Honors coupon. The buffalo wings were very good. Service was friendly. A bit pricey for Tucson. Seems like just a regular glass of beer was around $6. I would have expected around $3 to be reasonable even for a hotel bar/restaurant. Considering the fact that this Hilton is a bit long in the tooth, they should try coming up with a better menu and prices to offset.

place_category: Southern, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Steakhouses, Breakfast & Brunch, Buffets, American (New)
text: Service was excellent. The wait staff, food cooks, and musicians provided an enjoyable time for my family and I. I brought out of town guest who had never been before and they had a great time. Raved about the broccoli salad, loved the variety of buffet options, and head over heals for the pomegranate martini.

place_category: Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Restaurants, Bars
text: This place is great. All the meats are smoked in house and we ordered some of everything. Go hungry and be ready for some great smoked meats.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Food Delivery Services, Italian, Diners, Greek, Food
text: I doubt that they got the recipe for the Meatballs from any Royalty. The two men behind the counter didn't even notice me leave. They were to busy getting ready to go home. They blocked the entrance at 8:45 and a customer was turned away. In today's society customer service should be a high priority. The waitress was great but the others should take lessons from her!

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Sushi Bars
text: Great sushi spot with really interesting roll combinations. It's BYOB so make sure you bring a bottle especially after on Wednesdays after center city sips cause it's a popular spot for some drunk eats as its around the corner from Marathon.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Very nice family place with really good food! Stopped in on a whim and was pleasantly surprised. Very clean restaurant. Great Sicilian and regular pizza. Excellent crab and asparagus salad-very fresh! Will definitely be back! Encourage others to support these mom and pop businesses so we don't lose them to the big chains.

place_category: Specialty Food, Delis, Coffee Roasteries, Butcher, Meat Shops, Food, Restaurants, Grocery, Italian
text: Busy, chaotic, full of people - everything you would expect from an authentic Italian market. Be prepared to stand in line and if it is your first visit, plan for time to look around before making any decision. Great selection!

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Salad
text: If you want normal pizza don't go here. Long rectangle box lol. What the hell is this Edit: it tastes like it looks. Garbage

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Donuts
text: Stopped for an afternoon coffee. Used the drive thru. The young man taking our order was nice and knowledgeable. I ordered an ice coffee with cream. It was very light, mostly cream which I didn't order extra cream. I tried one of the sugar free flavors-Carmel. It was good, but a little light!

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: This place is one of our favorites! Always great food and the best service! I don't believe you could find better service than what you get here, friendly wait staff, keeps your glass full! Try the Bar B Q Chicken Nachos for starters. Definitely will keep coming back! Reasonably priced too!

place_category: Restaurants
text: I have been to this cosi twice now.. Although not the cleanest cosi it's location is convenient. During my last visit I ordered the steak salad. The first time I received it, there was a big hair on it staring at me, after an apology from the staff they made me another one. This time there was a random grape in the salad and the steak was not good at all. I must say the panera steak salad is superior by far.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Wanted to try this place out. But they were out of basically everything at 6pm. Ended up leaving restaurant due to horribly rude staff that were put out by asking simple questions.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Donuts, Bagels, Restaurants
text: Fox's donuts are good. However, their maple donuts sell out by 7 AM regularly. That seems a little early to be running out of what's clearly your best donut.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Seafood
text: The place was clean and the service was great. The food was not good. I was very disappointed with the overly oily and salted food. My food did not taste fresh either.

place_category: Fast Food, Food, Desserts, Restaurants, Burgers, Hot Dogs, Sandwiches
text: Big menu, even bigger milkshake menu. Good enough to satisfy. Not gourmet burgers, but close to gourmet prices. We had 2 - 1/2 pound burgers, 1 regular order fries, 1 same size order of fries w/chili, and 2 - 20oz milkshakes = $28.54 Except for the chili, I could have had the same at McDonalds and walked out equally satisfied with at least $10 more in my pocket.

place_category: Barbeque, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Southern, Breakfast & Brunch, Comfort Food, Nightlife, Music Venues, Restaurants, Food, Grocery
text: Ate breakfast there in July. Awesome. Having to write suck a long explanation for my review is what gets me.

place_category: American (Traditional), Gluten-Free, Steakhouses, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Seafood
text: I wish I could give it more stars because I am sick of the abundance of national chains. However, the food was moderate and it just did not seem overly clean. For example, my menu had a piece of food on it and water stains on the printed area. We were there a year ago and it seemed much better.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Delis, Sandwiches, Event Planning & Services, Cheesesteaks, American (New), Caterers
text: The first time I went to Jake's I tried the Pig sandwich and wasn't blown away. The second time I had the Garlic Bomb and again thought it was nothing special. Both times I felt the meat was a bit dry. The third time however seemed to be the charm after eating the Village Turkey. The black cherry spread is amazing and is perfect on this sandwich. I've gone back repeated times and have never been disappointed in this selection.

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Nightlife, Burgers, Steakhouses
text: Had not been to Applebee's in a while so thought I would try it and boy did I regret it! Got sick as soon as I got home. I called the store and spoke with the manager who did apologize and said I would be contacted from corporate. Month later still no call. I will never go to a Applebee's again! Beware!

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Cupcakes, Italian, Cheesesteaks, American (Traditional), Delis
text: Milk shakes are killer delicious! Sandwiches were mixed. 1 awesome. 1 good. 1 bad. Will try again...

place_category: Local Flavor, Food, Grocery, Specialty Food, Fruits & Veggies
text: This place sucks. Stood at deli 4 five minutes & 4 workers behind the counter & no service. Last time i was here walked out because of the same thing. Wont b back.

place_category: Grocery, Organic Stores, Food, Farmers Market, Specialty Food, Health Markets
text: This is a nice addition to the neighborhood, but nothing over the top. I found the selection to be ok, but nothing special. It is very convenient and had free parking the day I was there.

place_category: Bars, Coffee & Tea, Food, Nightlife, Wine Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Always love coming to this place for brunch! Their seating is really cute especially if you get their booths! Located in downtown St. Louis, parking can at times be challenging but paid parking is always an option. My favourite sandwich of theirs is the 'sunshine unlimited' but no matter what I will always get a popover with their sweet spreads! So delicious!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Salad, Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Bakeries, Diners
text: My husband and I have eaten at the Eagle for years. We have consently had good reasonable meals. The mini meal can't be beat. The soups are always delicious and the salad bar is excellent. If you are looking for gourmet food, this is not your place. If you want good comfort food and decent prices this is the place. I do not understand the negative reviews unless they are very very pickey, after all this is a neighborhood diner not a four star restaurant. Marge, Warminster Pa.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Salad
text: Loved the root beer float, the beats, and everything about the margarita pizza! Tasty cheese, sauce, and crust. Loved by both 31 year old and 10 year old.

place_category: Creperies, Vietnamese, Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Noodles, Chinese, Food
text: The only thing it is saving this from a one-star is the fact the staff is nice.. I was here several years ago and was very impressed and happy however when I went just now the portions were lackluster and the food was tasteless.. half of a standard takeout size container

place_name: The Rudder At Anchor High Marina
place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Seafood, Nightlife, Music Venues
text: Mothers Day! Drove 45 minutes by boat, $50 in gas to get there. Arrived and was happy to see a half empty restaurant and many outdoor tables. Hostess said it would be 1 1/2 hour wait. I said the place is half empty. She said a grill was down and they were short staff due to call ins. If your staff is that unreliable, it's time to make some changes. Will not take my chance wasting money to drive to the furthest point on the western lake to deal with poor management. Go to Fishtales or Awdaddys.

place_category: Bars, Pubs, Irish Pub, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Amazing garlic fries and service. Burger was ok and people were super drunk at 4pm Friday afternoon. Perhaps I was not in the mood but hey.. it was still 4pm def worth dropping by...

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: This place has excellent service. Food comes pretty quick and very good. The place is clean and very well decorated. Would definitely recommend this to those who want to try 100% authentic mexican food.

place_category: Fast Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Delis
text: The most disgusting and dirty Subway I ever seen. Walked in the other day noticed roaches crawling on the floor under a table where people were eating, the whole place looked unclean and dirty. I turned around and walked out, health dept needs to pay a visit here

place_category: Mexican, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: I got the worst food poisoning Here put me out of work for a few weeks it was the Carne Asada.

place_category: French, Patisserie/Cake Shop, Fast Food, Mexican, Food, Brazilian, Modern European, Restaurants
text: The food tastes delicious, I love the shrimp and chicken stew and for dessert the flan is perfect! They have fresh squeezed juices that is a plus! No bottles juices! They have a beautiful decoration, super cozy!

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Internet Cafes, Restaurants
text: Positives: Delicious fro-yo, coffee is good, a ridiculous amount of computer hardware for people to use, nice big windows they swing open, nice tables and lots of space and tons of people. I'm glad to live RIGHT next to it. Negatives: it's a chain, there are no "for here" cups for many of their drinks (why can't chains wash a few ceramic mugs?) Overall, I'm for it!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Had the shrimp po boy. Bread was stale, shrimp were not cleaned and sauce was too spicy to taste the flavor. Sat us near the kitchen which was a mistake because when the doors opened could see it was very dirty. Server was very polite and the onion rings were quite good. My friend did have the moufelatta and said it was very good, if not for that I would have given it one star.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Pizza
text: This was a letdown, which as unfortunate since we waited fifty minutes for brunch. First I got a green smoothie which was tasty and well blended albeit expensive. I got a protein bowl which was mostly bland and my friend got a mushroom omelette which had some egg shells in it ! We didn't get our coffee and latte until after our food and we had to eat outside. I wish they had a heater out there but they did not.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Italian, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Food, American (Traditional)
text: I had some fine service here. Bar is where to go! Was spending the night not far from Jefferson expansion memorial, and this place was open late and near by. Not bad, not great. Pizza was good. Better leftover, which is really good. Drinks could be stronger OR cheaper. Nice neighborhood, open late.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Barbeque, Bars, Music Venues, American (Traditional)
text: Awful. I had a chicken flavored salt sandwich. Baked beans were okay, maybe 2 stars. My wife wasn't really hungry so she ordered a pb&j. It was actually a smuckers uncrustable slathered in butter and warmed on the griddle. Beer selection is pretty poor. Tourist hell.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: We went on a cooler night thinking it would be a quick trip with not much of a line. There was one group ahead of us and it took 10 minutes to get our 2 ice creams. I got a Reese's hurricane that was pretty much just vanilla ice cream, couldn't find any chocolate pieces in it. Ice cream was good but service was not good.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: Great wings but they moved to Desire Street . I went there. It is deep in a bad residential area. It was closed. I saw two new food trucks. Would not recommend going to the new place because of crime.

place_category: Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Falafel
text: This is a decent place for the quick meal. Overall this place is small, seems like a family run business. The owners are really nice and friendly, anyways I ordered the Buffalo Chicken Sub, which was really good, the sub was fresh, the chicken was cooked to refection, the only negative I would say is that a little more flavor would have made it great, the flavor was mild for my taste. Besides that the restaurant was clean, the price was reasonable and the staff was really friendly.

place_category: Steakhouses, Barbeque, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: I went on a ridiculously busy Friday night so I'm betting on a normal night (without the rush on service and food) it would be a solid 4 stars. The fresh baked bread is amazing of course. Steak was good, ribs were gross (dried out beyond tasting like meat), seasoned rice was not tasty. Kids mac and cheese seemed to be out of a box. To me it has a very similar menu and pricing to Outback. It's better reviewed on Yelp than Outback but for me they'd have to do a little better to earn it.

I always get the "original", fruit and mochi. This place is easy, get cup, fill cup with yogurt type(s), add your toppings. Weigh and pay. I am giving it only 3 stars because I wish they had TARO flavor and that the mochi was soft (and not hard).

text: Long's has the greatest yeast donuts. They have been around for many many years. Don't forget to ask them for the WARM yeast donuts from the back :)

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Salad
text: Great atmosphere, friendly staff and ownership. Incredibly fast, very reasonable prices, FANTASTIC pizza! Create your own pizza with up to 6 toppings for $7? Can't beat that. Quality and flavor is through the roof. Exact same concept as Blaze Pizza, but higher quality ingredients found at Slimms! Quality dipping sauces, great variety to select from. Awesome place, highly recommend. **Also, got in during the first hour of opening today and got free breadsticks!**

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Fish & Chips, Nightlife, Seafood, Restaurants, Bars
text: Probably the best place in the area. A great find. Excellent food and great service. Spectacular views. I recommend a seat at the bar that overlooks the marina and beautiful coastal mountains.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Mexican
text: The server was very nice and friendly. I enjoyed the atmosphere, family oriented and chill. I ordered a chicken quesadilla and my husband ordered a chicken bowl, the food was extremely salty. I will say that I will give them a second chance, I'm thinking the cook was having a bad day.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Bars, Nightlife
text: Haven't been here in a few years but recently moved back to the neighborhood and came here for dinner tonight. I won't be coming back, got the app sampler, my wings were raw, like bleeding raw. Also the chicken fingers were unseasoned and basically one big tendon. Rice was dry and lacked flavor. My quesadilla was ok but you can't screw that up. Beer was solid of course.

place_category: Soul Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Southern, Restaurants, Salad
text: I went to Warmdaddy's on a Sunday evening to celebrate a friend's birthday. It was everyone's first time and we all left very satisfied and pleased. All dishes were flavorful and plentiful. The corn bread was the best I've ever had. The music was good and the waitresses were great. Its a small little place so I could see it easily getting crowded when the bands are playing so I'd recommend checking it out on a low key Sunday.

place_category: French, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Want to feel like royalty for an hour? Be sure to check out this restaurant! We visited with a group of girls for a bachelorette party and it couldn't have been more perfect for the occasion. The food was great (pretty affordable) and so was the service! The staff was very professional and super friendly. I would highly recommend making a visit if you are in New Orleans!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: The food is average, and I (as well as many others) really just come here for the margarita specials and convenient location near Penn. The margaritas are above average, nothing mind blowing, but good value during happy hour.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, Tacos, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Fast Food
text: Probably the worst service I have ever experienced at a Taco Bell. First, the women at the register couldn't find 5 out of the 8 items I ordered on the screen. Secondly, it took 25+ minutes to get our food and they still forgot an item. Please go out of your way to visit another Taco Bell in their area, this one is worthless.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Local favorite! The lines typically out the door- but that means it's bomb! The service is quick, I only waited 5 minutes for 10 tacos to go. They have Jarritos and bottled Coke which are my favorite. I kept it simple- Asada and Chicken. The chicken was my personal favorite! Loaded with veggies on top it's delish! There is about 20 parking spots out front... Check them out!

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries, Food, Colombian
text: Sooooooo good !!! I can't explain to you how delicious it was !! I Recommend !!!And it's a dollar for each empanadas how cheap can it get !

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (New), Sushi Bars, Bars
text: Need a beer? Need a burger? Need yuppie love looking for redneck fun? Look no further. Drake's is an eclectic scene with a pretty good vibe. If you need to catch a game, there are lots of TVs in the outer bar and there's a good chance your favorite bartender will turn one of them to anything except The Bachelor. Check this place out!

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, American (New)

Drinks are always on point, as is the food. Sometimes tough to get a seat at the bar, as it's busy, but worth the wait. Friday nights have live music and very nice addition. Must have app is the shishito peppers, or meatballs, or beef tips and polenta, or.....you get the point. All the food here is on point!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, American (Traditional)

Food was fast and delicious, with no room for dessert. They made sure the kids food came out first and our glasses never ran dry. Will go back again!

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries, Food

I do not recommend!

I will return to try something else in the future, but it may be a while.

No complaints, just satisfied and happy. Can't wait to come back!

place_category: Latin American, Cuban, Seafood, Restaurants

text: I have been to this location twice, and while the food is edible and doesn't taste bad, they never actually give me what I order. But I feel pretty ripped off paying $7 for a sandwich where half the stuff that's supposed to be on it is missing.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Japanese
text: Good sushi (I mostly ate nigiri), very fresh and the rice was consistent. It is sad to say that my service here was awful; terribly inattentive wait staff. I waited at least 10 minutes for a drink order and waited almost the same amount of time to receive my check after asking twice.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza

place_category: Bars, Seafood, Nightlife, Lounges, Restaurants

I mean, the food is good, but they should really throw in some chips with the sandwhiches at least!!

I found the meat at this place generally better then Fette Sau, although Fette Sau has superb pork belly.

I did call to complain - but was given the excuse that they KNEW the order was wrong - yet no one came after me... and they did not seem apologetic when I called to complain

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Ralphs is the best! Any of you who don't think so don't know what your talkin about. Now that I live in philly this is where I go when I miss my ma's food. The chicken parm is the best.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Asian Fusion
text: The rolls we ordered were super yummy! However, the awful service left sucha bad taste in my mouth that it kind of negated the entire reason of going out to have a "enjoyable experience". Aside from the awful service, the food was to standard, and the establishment was clean.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Soup, Chinese
text: Every thing here was over cooked. Nothing had a good flavor to it. The fried shrimp was mostly bread batter with a tiny shrimp in the center. Chicken teriyaki was seriously over cooked and was like eating jerky. I would not recommend this place.

place_category: Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Burgers, Fast Food
text: Food is good. But sad they are so stingy with their onions. Asked for them in the first place, and had to ask again. I got the wrong items on my plate, which, I gave back. I asked for extra pickles in my daughters cheeseburger, And had to go back up. They gave me no pickles, and extra ketchup. SMH.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Food, Karaoke, American (Traditional), Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Music Venues

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: It was acceptable but didn't knock my socks off. The sashimi was really good, but the rolls left something to be desired. My caveat is that I don't like fried anything in a sushi place, so the fact that most of their rolls had either cream cheese or fried something in them was off-putting. I also had to scrape the mayo off the top of the roll. I never saw mayo once in Japan, and especially not at a sushi place, so i don't really understand why American sushi places have such love for it. Yuck.

place_category: Desserts, Bakeries, Donuts, Food
text: they were out of crawfish but trust and believe this shrimp bowl was the truth. Fresh dough rolled biscuit with grape jelly..... Lord have mercy. I bet the biscuit lady name Mrs. Mary Lee......something sweet and old. New Orleans has the BEST food on Earth.

text: Just ok Not impressed Friends suggested going -definitely chain food quality.Drink margarita just ok!Had Paella -Seemed like a large portion which seemed good but the mussels were dry as was the rest of the dish very !wings were ok coconut shrimp ok Again nothing special.Not worth the money!!!!

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: This is not a bad place to grab a quick bite to eat. The food is well prepared and certainly blows places like T.G.I. Friday's and Applebee's out of the water. I usually eat a light lunch here--French onion soup (which is really good!) and a salad (which is on the high-side of mediocre). The food comes quickly, and the waitstaff has always quickly refilled my $2.39 Diet Coke. I have no real complaints.

place_category: Japanese, Chinese, Ramen, Noodles, Restaurants, Asian Fusion
text: This is some of the best chinese noodles in Tucson I've had. I ordered the Dan Dan noodles and it was full of flavor. I will be back to try their other dishes!

place_category: Chicken Wings, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: 1 star for poor drink service on a rather slow evening. Refills were not. Wait staff seems distant and inexperienced. Wings were cold.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Donuts, Bagels, Restaurants
text: We went there on a Sunday after seeing it was open, only to see a sign on the door saying it was closed early that weekend. Came back the next morning and although there was a lot of donut variety, they were very mundane and not extravagant. If you like plain donuts, this is the place to go. Their Cherry fritter was the best of the lot we got, but I couldn't taste the cherry at all.

place_category: Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Seafood, American (New), Adult Entertainment, Nightlife, Burgers, Bars, Restaurants
text: Visited this place on a recent beach trip I took with some friends. We stopped by early in the evening to have some drinks and a quick bite and ended up here again later in the evening to have a few drinks. Pretty decent food for a beach bar and you can't beat the location right on the beach. They have a full bar so the sky's the limit on whatever kind of cocktail you desire. Met some interesting locals here as well on our adventures later in the evening as well.

place_category: Lounges, Restaurants, Burgers, Bars, Vegetarian, Nightlife, Middle Eastern, Lebanese, Cocktail Bars, American (New)
text: Stopped by with the wife on a hot summer afternoon and was not disappointed. The Wilford Brimley was one of the BEST burgers I've had in my life. My wife ordered The Reaper and said the same. The stuffed falafel with date jam was a great way to start the meal. 2 beers, an appetizer, a shake, 2 burgers (w/sides) and a dessert for around $70. Not bad at all! Went on a Saturday afternoon and place was busy but not packed. Easy parking on the street or side streets. We will definitely be back!

place_category: Food, Fast Food, Buffets, Indian, Restaurants, Desserts
text: I don't have the option of not giving a star. We came here for buffet and the food is horrible. It is either overcooked or not cooked at all. Some of the dishes served were cold, dosa was like hard cardboard. Their sweets smell as if they were cooked a week ago. Highly unsatisfied food and service altogether..please avoid this place if you can.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, American (New), Chinese, Buffets, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Asian Fusion, Desserts, Mongolian
text: Nothing like being charged $6 extra for your dinner because you built your bowl backwards on your first time here. How about have the sign facing where you build your bowl so people will see it? Total waste. Won't be back. Manager was a total jerk about it too. I've spent many years working in the service industry, that was inexcusable.

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants, Cheesesteaks
text: The steak is precooked in a large pile lending it to be dried out. The bread is excellent as are the onions and mushrooms and additions. However this place is not equipped or staffed to deal with tourist trade serves local community well... recommend another venue for out-of-town guests.

place_name: M.L.Rose Craft Beer & Burgers - Sylvan Park
place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Bars, Beer Bar, Nightlife, Pubs
text: The Nashvegas is one of my favorite burgers in Nashville. But what happened here? Not only was the bun smashed paper thin, the burger was well done (not medium as ordered), and there was barely any BBQ sauce. I usually go to the one on 8th, guess I'll stick to that one from now on. This was to go, or I would have sent it back. Which I've only done once in my life.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Latin American
text: My family and I eat here all the time and have never had a bad meal. They make the best guacamole and all of their dishes have been the best tasting Mexican cuisine that we have ever tasted. I highly recommend this place!

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Food was tasty but the portions were very small. My wrap and fries left me hungry. Great iced tea and I love the flavored ketchup options.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Restaurant lied about what we said on the phone and never delivered our order. The employee was extremely rude when we called and hung up on us.

place_category: American (New), Sandwiches, Salad, Restaurants, Vegetarian, Soup, American (Traditional)
text: My wife and I approached the small Salad works across from the Regals theatre, we were greeted kindly, and as the lady began to take our order we noticed she wasn't wearing gloves, my wife was immediately disgusted, the food was still splendid overall, I highly recommend the Caesar Salad, with a side of tortilla soup. 7/10 service.

place_category: Food, Donuts, Burgers, American (Traditional), Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: The pork belly, avocado and egg taco was so delicious. My beautiful wifey ordered the cinnamon bun, I had a taste and it was soooo good. We also ordered two hot latte's that were super. Our waitress helped out with my taco and put the cilantro on the side....because cilantro is evil. We will be back SOON!

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Fast Food, Food, Burgers, Restaurants
text: This place sucks. It's always a 20+ minute wait to get my order. And when I placed a mobile order it's no better. Poorly trained staff and an incompetent manager. Very disappointing every time.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: This place is a 4 star for apps and drinks while watching the game. Nachos, wings, and beer selection is always good! The bartender (downstairs) is always happy and will change the channel to watch a different game. Sadly, I give it a 2 star rating for lunch/dinner. I always want it to be a good place to grab a casual dinner but have never been happy with the quality of food. I have tried a couple salads and sandwiches that were sad.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants

text: The ice cream is delicious, the food is good, too. The atmosphere is a bit "dark" instead of "moody" like I think they were going to. If you're young, like maybe 20ish, I think it could be cool, especially because the vintage decor is pretty neat. But for me, it was more on the depressing side. Not a place I'd like to spend time sitting and chatting at. Service was okay, nothing spectacular. Prices are.. meh. About what you'd expect.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: "Can I please try the..." Ha! Don't even bother. Seriously, what ice cream shop doesn't let you try a flavor before buying. Still, I stupidly bought one and it was meh. I know they make crap and have to deal with the aging hipsters of that area, but smart ass comments will gain no one sympathy.

I just reheat them in my air fryer at home since all I ever order is takeout. This location on the other hand does lack in customer service. But seriously, what do you expect from a fast food joint.

text: I just read a review that said " the tofu hoagie made my dick hard." If I had a dick, I am sure the tofu hoagie would have the same effect on me . Also- they carry both green tea and red bean ice cream by the pint which is impossible to find as well as a TON on vegan ice creams. I love you Fu-wah!

place_category: Korean, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Thai, Japanese
text: Overpriced and subpar. I was very disappointed with the food quality. Ordered an eel and crab rice dish and there was no crab. When telling the waitress she brought 2 pieces of artificial crab meat to suppliment the meal. At $26 a dish?! They got the money from me once, I will never go back to that OVERRATED restaurant.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners, American (Traditional), American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Great place for a fast, inexpensive breakfast. Quick service and free parking at the restaurant. Great value for what you get!

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Cajun/Creole
text: This place is a must-stop in NOLA! People in here, staff, management, and customers, are all wonderful, friendly, and down-to-Earth Judy makes THE gumbo...best ive ever had! The Po Boys are delicious as well (we had the alligator, not what we expected, but awesome!). Definitely make this a spot to drop into anytime youre in New Orleans, well for sure be making multi-trips here on our vacation

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Desserts
text: This place is soooo cute ! the owner is super nice and helpful but seriously the cookie dough if too good ! you gotta check out this little gem !

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Wonderful Mexican food! Great atmosphere! Best new restaurant in Indianapolis. Well worth a try.

place_category: Food, Soup, Coffee & Tea, Salad, Restaurants, Bakeries, Bagels, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Worst Panera we have ever been to. Went during breakfast menu. Asked for them to refill the half and half and I waited as they kept just telling the next person to do it. I gave up and used skim milk. Breakfast sandwich Luke warm at best. Ordered cream cheese but had to again ask for it when bagel was delivered. Only thing open in the area at 10am on Sunday so if your hungry go othwrwise wait until 11 and go somewhere else.

place_category: Sandwiches, American (New), Lounges, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Food was ok and so was the service. My wife and I both had the chicken soup and salad. Nothing to special but it hit the spot. Beat pry of this restaurant was the view, seeing the cars go by and the old buildings is worth it enough for me to come back.

place_category: Restaurants, Soul Food, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Burgers, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: Good-sized portions, and delicious meats. Cornbread yummy. The hush puppies would have been better in cleaner oil. Beer selection was good. It's clearly a popular place for families and locals.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Breweries, American (Traditional), Brewpubs
text: From out of town looking for a local experience. Beer was warm, food decent, bathrooms smelled absolutely terrible. Service was good. Needs some TLC to get it where it needs to be.

place_category: French, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Me and my husband was visiting from san Francisco. We were very excited about this place. Unfortunately Nothing was great and nothing was bad. Services wasnt great and wasnt bad. The food was good but nothing special. The best thing we had was the strawberry shortcake but not enough for us to go back. Definitely over rated. I guess the restaurant was beautiful.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: Great location, quick service, nice tables by the open windows. Food was average though and the server was pleasant but busy with many tables. It is a bistro style restaurant so quick and standard fare for a fill-up between French Quarter activities are what you get.

place_category: Seafood, Southern, Food, Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Desserts, Local Flavor
text: It was a-ok. Went to lunch and got the burger with an upgrade to the veggie of the day rather than the fries. Good service and the veggies were good. The waiter told us that the only thing that isnt made with fresh ingredients are the french fries. Service was good but the food was ok - wish we had gone to a more original restaurant. However, if you are in the mood for quick decent food this is a good place.

place_category: Fashion, Drugstores, Electronics, Grocery, Discount Store, Mobile Phones, Sporting Goods, Food, Department Stores, Shopping
text: Oh my god can you believe it I'm at Walmart waiting to get ham 45 minutes I'm still waiting.The young men to help me out had an attitude problem to . This Walmart sucks.I even ask a supervisor or a manager about the situation and nothing ever happened they said they'll try to get someone there

place_name: On The Border Mexican Grill & Cantina
place_category: Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Mexican
text: My girlfriend and I ate here for the first time and it honestly a sub-par experience. From the food to the service, everything lacked quality. We both enjoy Mexican food and decided to give this place a try since Red Lobster was packed. Some folks like the food but there are definitely better options out here. I suggest you look at different places for Mexican food before settling for "On The Border".

place_category: Restaurants, Greek, Salad, Mediterranean
text: I had the pleasure of eating at a amazing little restaurant in Tarpon springs. The food was absolutely amazing. Everything was flavorful in such a way unlike any Greek Restaurant. They put a new twist on everything I have eaten there. I had a lovely server, Nicole was amazing! Service was impeccable and the food was brought in a timely fashion. Overall if I could give this restaurant more than 5 stars I surely would.

place_category: Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Party & Event Planning
text: This used to be a great cafeteria-style restaurant, but not anymore. The big building is now closed and the big line with yummy home-style cooking has been reduced to "the more intimate setting next door." That meant far fewer choices, cold, overpriced, and oversalted food, and uncomfortable tables crammed into what used to be the bakery. Do yourself a favor and miss this.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants
text: It was an okay breakfast. I ordered the tall pancakes with strawberries. When the order came out I had 3 plain pancakes with no powdered sugar like the other pancakes. I had ONE strawberry on my plate sliced in small pieces. It was poor presentation. The wait was decent. It was a 30 minute wait. The waitress was great. The orange juice came in a small plastic cup although they charged $4 for it.

place_category: Salad, Mexican, Tex-Mex, Restaurants
text: I love this place. Not just for the wonderful food but for the engaging employees. They're so kind, hard-working, and really try hard to get things right the first time. The food is always fresh and the dining room always looks tidied up. I love the salsa bar and the great Coke machine. I love all of the options available to you to add to your tacos or dish. Fresh veggies and guacamole and great meat choices set Moe's apart!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: You would think after 3 months of pandemic takeout they would get it right. Here are my optics, 9 people working preparing food and one person on register. Problem is the one person on register is ALSO answering the busy phone!!! So you wait and wait and wait. I ordered online at 5:47, pickup pizza at 6:30, and it was cold. Shame food is good, there are too many pizza places to go to for them to not figure out how to keep a customer happy and returning.

place_category: Pizza, Nightlife, Salad, Bars, Wine Bars, Italian, Restaurants
text: Don't order to go from them unless you go through everything and make sure they aren't ripping you off. I ordered the classic Caesar salad with chicken. This is a $15 salad and is supposed to come with black olives, red onions, and Roma tomato. It is in a side salad box no bigger than my hand. No olives, tomato, or onion. Such a joke for $15. Every time I order here it is always wrong. Not sure why it's so difficult to read a receipt and give your customers what they are already overpaying for.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: I've been to other Ruby Tuesday Restaurants in other cities and I found the quality of food in other places to be better. The food here was "ok" but nothing to write home about. The service on the other hand, was stellar. My waiter, Jared, was really friendly and courteous. I enjoyed the experience overall, but as I said, the food could be better. They don't have many vegetarian options anymore and the salad bar suited my needs I suppose.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: We regularly get takeout from here during the week. It is too busy during the weekends. The kitchen seems clean as you can see right into it behind the counter. The family owners are always there, are hardworking and very friendly. Our favorites are Singapore Mei Fun Noodles., Chicken Curry, Happy Family Chef Special and the House Special Lo Mein.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Pizza
text: Pizza is Always excellent & beer is ice cold, but draft prices are getting pricey. $6.00 now for a draft.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Hot and fresh every time! Their food is amazing and I love all of the nice workers. If you want the best Chinese food in St. Louis, go to Lemay Wok!!!
