place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Sports Bars
text: Impossible to get anyones attention there for help. 15 minutes after I arrive I finally get someone to tell me that they deleted my online order. I left without getting any food and wasted my time. Even the hot girls walking around wasn't enough for me to change my mind about this terrible service.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces, Restaurants, Hotels, Event Planning & Services
text: We attended a large fancy wedding at the Westin. The food was horrible. All of the food was served cold. The mushroom soup with foie gras was not even warm. The filet mignon was over cooked, totally brown and room temperature. Nothing on the plate was appropriately hot or even warm. It was the worst banquet food I've ever experienced and I would never hold a reception there.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Burgers
text: The restaurant is in an old Don Pablos building. Actually without the name you'd think it was still Don Pablos. We like going here on Wednesdays because of the $1.25 specials; $1.25 tacos, margaritas, and draft beer when you pay with cash. Not a bad deal! The food is decent, very average mexican food. I do think their salsa is good and the service is friendly.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: What a chance find traveling home. An out of the way spot in a small strip mall on York Rd. Food was freshly made and delicious to boot. I had tonights special pappardelle with shrimp and Italian sausage with tomato sauce. They adjusted the vodka cream sauce for my lactose allergy. Wait staff may have been new but did a great job. This restaurant has potential for greatness.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Chinese, Restaurants, Food
text: I was in China town so I looked to yelp to guide me, reviews were very good for Ray's Cafe, and they weren't wrong. It's a very small place, good menu, lots of choices, I got the dumpling sampler with wonton soup and shrimp spring roll, everything was fantastic! The soup was rich and delicious, the spring rolls were crunchy, fresh and flavorful, the dumplings were so good, I didn't want to use the dipping sauce.... well done Ray's, I'll be back!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Macarons, Patisserie/Cake Shop, Custom Cakes, Specialty Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Cupcakes
text: Stopped in today to get a chocolate treat for a coworker's birthday. They told me the total had to be more than $5 in order to use a card, so I decided to treat everyone else with some cookies, so I ordered a dozen chocolate chewys. These cookies, however, are anything but chewy. Hard as a rock, and at a closer look once the box was opened, looked to be several days old. My mistake to not ask to look at them closely before purchasing. Certainly won't make that mistake again.

place_category: Vegetarian, Asian Fusion, Thai, Restaurants
text: Inconsistent. The last two times I got tofu pad thai (no egg, no fish sauce), it tasted funny. I couldn't put my finger on it. A friend kindly tried it and described it as "burnt and bland." Oh well.

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Shopping, Cafes, Food, Coffee & Tea, Delis, Sandwiches, Arts & Entertainment, Art Galleries, Wine Bars, Paint & Sip, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: The quality and amount of food is not worth its price. Not only was my croissant extremely dry (as if it was old) I opened it up and there's only ONE SLICE OF BACON? Sloppy and unpresentable.

place_name: The Original French Market Restaurant and Bar
place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Specialty Food, Restaurants, French
text: I heard so much great things about crawfish in New Orleans, but I have to say I am very disappointed. For market price menu listed. It was not fresh crawfish at all, I believe that these crawfish were frozen. On top of this, we got a bottle of white wine on a sunny day (80 degrees )She did not chill it with ice in the bucket.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Burgers, Nightlife, Bars
text: The food here is HORRIBLE!!! Worst TGIF I've ever had! It was 8 of us and no one enjoyed their meal!!! There was 10 people in the entire restaurant and it took forever to get our food!!!!! Our server Nyat was exceptional!

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Southern, Comfort Food
text: So I went here not knowing anything about it and left happy. The food is so inexpensive for the portions (my chicken sandwich was only $6.99 with fries). I would shy away from the margaritas if you plan on driving after- they are extremely strong. The inside is pretty cool. Just really your average restaurant. I prefer Applebee's in all honesty

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Seafood, Italian
text: Very rude hostess. When our group did not want to be seated next to the bathroom door,she decided to punish us. She seated many guests while we waited. Our reservation meant nothing. Walk ins were seated as they walked through the door. She enjoyed our frustration. We left without ever being seated.

place_category: Meat Shops, Food, Butcher, Specialty Food
text: Nice little place along the path with the other shops and store fronts. The owner is very nice. We have been here a few times and he always has samples of different things you may be unsure of. Crickets anyone? They have those too.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Cocktail Bars
text: Very cute setting. But food and service weren't as great. Our server took a long time to do anything and we had to ask for refills. French onion soup was not good at all. No flavor at all. Chicken & Portobello was good. Quail and Waffles was also good. But not impressive.

place_category: American (New), Food, Specialty Food, Restaurants
text: I am not really sure if i like this place. The food was really heavy/unhealthy. I got Mac and cheese to be safe and it had WAY too much pepper in it. I cant believe it. There is definitely no healthy food there. Good place to go to when you are hungry.

place_category: Korean, Barbeque, Restaurants, Asian Fusion
text: Korean food + tacos. What's not to love. Really fun fusion restaurant in the area and honestly wish we had more food fusion places like this. The tacos are my favorite but the bowls are pretty good as well. So if you've never had Korean and looking for a way to ease into it, this is the perfect place to start! Or if you're someone who enjoys novelty fusion foods like me, come by this place immediately.

place_name: Taqueria y Birrieria Aqui es Jalisco
place_category: Tacos, Mexican, Restaurants
text: The food wasn't as good as I thought it would be. There was a hair in my sister's food, and It's way to expensive!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: We have lunch here whenever we are in the area. People are friendly and the agua of whatever flavor is great. Every plate you order is very good. I had chicken in mole sauce. Oh... you have to walk to the back of the grocery store.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Pizza
text: Called in and placed an order for delivery . He said it would not be a problem to deliver to our address. ten mintues after they call back apologizing, they cant deliver that far. Makes no sense to me. Why do you hire people who are unsure on how to cater to the customers? We had to drive down to the store and pick up our order at 1 in the night. Way to go dominos!!

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: 11/15/2013 We had our son and daughter-n-laws' "Fabulous French Quarter, Wedding Rehearsal, Po-boy Party! here at the Royal House and it was fabulous! Jared was wonderful in creating our special "po-boy" menu and sitting upstairs with the french doors open to the wrap-around balcony at 5 in the evening, listening to the music swirling up from Royal Street was just another perfect French Quarter moments! The oysters were outstanding as usual and the service truly NOLA.

place_category: French, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Food, Restaurants
text: I have had brunch here twice and am starting to like this place a little more with each visit. While not my first choice for French I would go back.The escargot is very good, they have it in a little pastry puff.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Tapas/Small Plates
text: More than a meal, it's a culinary adventure! So grateful St. Louis has a restaurant like this! If you go do the 12 course, you might as well. :) This is a special place and will be an experience to remember. I just hope there's enough support in this city to keep them around, I sure hope so! This place is special

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), American (New), Desserts, Bakeries, Restaurants
text: Nice place to stop for a leisurely lunch because there's usually a bit of a wait. Most of the sandwiches, burgers, and salads are pretty good. The entrees are hit or miss for the most part. The staff are pretty friendly and efficient. The cheesecake is pretty good too. Always ask for a booth. The noise level is pretty high and you'll thank me later when you can hear your dining companion.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, American (New), Food, Desserts, Burgers, Nightlife
text: Ordered a burger , wings and fries and drinks. Total of 54.00. The burger was nasty and the fries isn't fresh. My wings tasted like regular wings that I could buy from mom and pop shops for half of price. Overall, experience were not good for being a restaurant whose a popular tv host who criticizes food. Multiple complaints which prompted me to with a manager too. I don't think they will last if they continued to ignore yelp feedbacks.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Happy hour specials online are not what they serve. Website not updated in 3y. I'm offended.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Hot Dogs
text: Very good Texas Wieners, very cheap prices and you kind of get that local feel when you walk in they usually remember your order if you go in there enough. But they do give you big portions for cheap prices. my only complaints for the place no open late enough and not open on the weekends!

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, French, Specialty Food, Seafood, Diners, Cajun/Creole, Seafood Markets, Event Planning & Services, Southern, Caterers, Salad
text: I wasn't impressed. I had their étouffée ($18) one time and the time before that I had the platter. For the wait (both times I waited 30+ minutes) and the taste of the food, I wasn't impressed! Especially for the price. The potatoes were off the chain! I loved them and could have ate those for my meal.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces, American (New), Food, Restaurants
text: I wish I could've liked this place because the scenery and venue were promising. Sadly, the food left much to be desired. The options weren't all that great to begin with, half our table opted for items at the express cafe down the hall. The food came over 40 minutes past when we ordered it and the burgers weren't cooked how we specified. I might be back, but it'll be for the actual museum, definitely not for this restaurant.

place_category: Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Southern, Restaurants
text: Nothing special about this place. Decent food. Average service. No military discount and no special treat for a kid's birthday. And if you come with kids, expect to sit in the back corner with all the other kid groups. No reason to come back.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Tea Rooms, Food, Diners, Restaurants
text: If you want a simple and quick meal head here. They seem to be a little over priced but good stuff nonetheless. Very casual experience.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Cupcakes, Custom Cakes
text: Best cupcakes ever! I will definitely be back when I come back to Tennessee. Her cupcakes are moist and taste delicious. A great variety also. I'm from Southern California and I feel like we don't have good cupcake shops in our area. It was the best cupcake I've had in a while.

place_category: Restaurants, Hot Pot, Dim Sum, Szechuan, Chinese
text: Being from California, I'm quite particular about my Asian food, and Nashville's pathetic offering of any eastern cuisines. THANK GOODNESS FOR THIS GEM! On top of good food, the owners are as pleasant as can be and are eager to serve you with grace and efficient.

place_category: Italian, Nightlife, Bars, Steakhouses, Greek, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Seafood
text: The service is outstanding! It definitely could keep you coming back. I had the Cajun chicken in the creamy Alfredo sauce on a baked potato....while it was greasy it was also really good. The rest of menu seemed kind of bland but the Cajun chicken was good.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Delis, Burgers, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Local Flavor
text: I was in the area and hungry and saw a huge line coming out the door . The place I was at local recommended it. . So I got a wiz without and a fry . I guess it was a bit overhyped or I've been living in the area too damn long because there is so many better places inside the city for Cheesesteaks . Steak was not bad but just average in my opinion . (Guess I'm spoiled by all the great steak shops locally and have became a steak snob by default )

place_category: Pizza, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Nightlife, American (New), Italian, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Disappointing experience. The food was not good. Had the pulled pork tacos. Absolutely no seasoning. Extremely bland. The pizza easily had 1/2 a bag of arugula thrown on top. Best dish was the buffalo chic dip. There are a ton of places in that area that would be a better option. This place is overrated and over priced. Save yourself time and money and go somewhere else.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Delis, Burgers, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Local Flavor
text: This is our 2nd time here and I am still not overly impressed. The steaks are good but I find them bland. We ordered chicken fingers for my son and I found them better. Tiny spot with outdoor seating. Nothing fancy. It's on an awesome street and that's the best part!

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Teppanyaki
text: Food was pretty good service could use a bit of work I happened to visit this place with a party of five and we could not figure out how the how good was being prepared faster than the orders of sushi . Being that I happened to be seated adjacent to the sushi bar I noticed the same sushi sitting there on top of the bar for appx. 30 minutes ...I was not impressed

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: Owner is huge Ahole and berates his customers. Was there last week and he yelled at this little disabled girl to wait in line when she just simply asked where the containers lids were. The girls Grandpa told him to pipe down and he gets in his face wanting to fight him! Holy smokes Rocco, under 5 and over 75 yer really tough! Unreal that this guy runs a buisness.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Best Mexican restaurant in Conshohocken. We've been to some of the other places in Conshy, so we were hesitant to try this place as the other 2 are less than par. Has a great outdoor seating area, great food and great drinks. Wife got a margarita that was delightful. We will definitely come back.

place_category: Dim Sum, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Chinese, Bars, Nightlife
text: After many years, last night was my final meal here. The food ran right through me - bacteria, bad seafood, who knows. Never again.

place_category: Nightlife, Gastropubs, American (Traditional), Pubs, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Bars, Food, American (New)
text: Amazing food and good company Great beer selection and even better atmosphere. Fried chicken sandwich was massive and delicious, and jalapeño Mac and cheese was something else. We appreciate you!

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Hostesses weren't that friendly. Super slow service! Took at least 15 mins for server to even greet us and get a drink order. Appetizer came out literally a minute before our food did. Food was good, but nothing extraordinary.

place_category: Home & Garden, Shopping, Appliances, Burgers, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood, Italian
text: The food is fine, nothing particularly special, but the service and speed are AWFUL. I mean, this might be the slowest service I've ever had, period. Excellent beer, but even with that I'll be hard pressed to come back unless I know I won't need to eat for a couple of hours.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Huevos Rancheros Grit Bowl was outstanding. Very tasty with just enough heat! My only complaint about BBB is their coffee. Very weak. A self proclaimed breakfast restaurant must serve a good cup of coffee to survive. They need to get this issue fixed quickly! Service, food and cleanliness were excellent.

place_category: American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Restaurants, Diners, Food
text: sorry but only the east coast can claim good diner food. they don't even have mozzarella sticks on their menu! one plus: they make chocolate shakes with real chocolate ice cream, not vanilla with chocolate syrup. we had good service there once or twice. the other times were painfully slow and once our waitress was drunk and/or high and totally out of her mind. this place is tolerable if nothing else is open.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, French, American (New), Bars
text: We sat at a table, ordered our food, and received our food before we could get tap water without mysterious black flakes of stuff in it. Took 3 tries to get clean water - it would have been faster for me to bring my own Brita from home. Food was meh. Having one waiter and one bartender for the whole floor for Sunday brunch seems like a poor choice.

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Piano Bars
text: I mean, when in New Orleans, come to Pat O'Briens and spend too much money on a crappy drink in a souvenir glass... you gotta do it! Very nice bartender and thank GOD for your AC!!!!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Thai, Restaurants
text: Worst Thai food ever. From the initial sound of the woman on the phone you could tell they wanted no part of preparing another order. Pretty sure they wanted to get out of the restaurant with 15 min left until close and wanted to throw some stuff together. Chicken was dry, rice was the consistency of pudding, dumplings were cold. No condiments and no silverware provided which I believe is pretty standard for a To-Go order.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Salad
text: One of my all time favorite restaurants. The calzones are to die for and I love the environment. I love that the games are always playing on the TVs. My one complaint is how long it takes between ordering and actually getting your food. This last time I was there, I had to run out while waiting just to feed the meter. If they sped that up, I would no doubt give 5 stars. Again, the food is outstanding and everyone has to go.

place_category: American (New), Gastropubs, Restaurants
text: Ambiance was great and service was really good. Decent variety of drinks from beer to wine. Food menu looks interesting, but the ones we had that evening we went there were hit and miss. My pork belly cuban sandwich needed more pork belly in it. The wife though enjoyed her salad and curried cauliflower soup. I thought the pierogi was on the oily side and the beer cheese pretzel was just so-so. We'd still go back though and try the other food items.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Every time I go here I try something new. I really love the pork fried rice. The crab ragoons are great. A must try.

place_category: American (Traditional), Gluten-Free, Pizza, Restaurants
text: The manager did contact me and was interested in getting my business again which really means a lot to me and took my concern seriously so I will give them 3 stars for trying to make a customer happy :) I will one day go to Modesto and try it out.

place_category: Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea
text: Awesome food and coffee with friendly staff. Definitely recommend if you're looking for a quick bite and caffeine!

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Amazing lobster roll and clam chowder! My husband and I were staying across the street and wondered into this amazing place. Justin took amazing care of us. Told us the shark tank story and recommend the perfect wine to accommodate. Why aren't you on your way? You should be?

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese, Asian Fusion
text: Spring roll was very simple but freshly wrapped with fresh ingredients. The peanut sauce was not very good, too diluted. The pho broth was flavorful, light, and not oily. We also liked the variety of condiments available for the pho, especially the chili oil.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Burgers, Restaurants, Food, Fast Food
text: Disgustingly rude supervisor (female 08/14/2021) never going back--she was randomly insulting and aggressive

place_category: Burgers, Seafood, American (Traditional), Salad, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Tried this restaurant today, because it is close by us. It is probably the most "Gringo" Mexican restaurant we have ever been to. The food had no flavor or spice. Even my husband, who does not like his food too spicy, thought the food was tasteless and bland. It is also very expensive for Mexican cuisine. Our lunch was about $30 with no drinks or dessert. We will not be going back.

place_category: Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: if you want good customer service and your food out quick, dont even bother coming here. I have never received good service while coming here, every single worker acts like they hate being here. it takes ten years to get my food. I wrote this entire review while waiting for 4 mozzarella sticks and 1 corn dog. i've been at the window now for 7 minutes.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Worst food ever ..chili Reno burrito and a thin cut of chili Reno..over cooked eggs and barley any cheese.cross contamination of food the burritos had a fish taste.cabbage on tacos was wilted.waste of my money.

place_category: Appliances, Sandwiches, Chicken Wings, Home & Garden, Appliances & Repair, Local Services, Restaurants, Shopping, Pizza
text: I have had no issues with this store until they made a mistake on an order. When I asked for a corrected pizza they promised free toppings. When I ordered another pizza I was told the discount had been applied in their system. I asked for a print out receipt that showed the applied discount but they were not able to produce it. Going forward I think I am going to make my own pizzas.

place_category: Seafood, Nightlife, Piano Bars, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Cajun/Creole, Bars, Sandwiches
text: Went there on Fat Tuesday for a good meal and it was the worst service in the area. Small menu terrible employees. Food was ok but not worth the price. Channing Tatum needs to rethink and revamp his idea of a restaurant. I wish I could give a negative star rating that's how bad it was.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: The Red Velvet is amazing. Cute place. They source local ingredients. Very good quality ice cream.

place_category: Salad, American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New)
text: If it is the only place to eat....but its New Orleans. Soup special came out cool and crusty on the top. Fried catfish lacked flavor. I was hungry and needed a place walking distance from where I was staying. Beer was good.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: The server didn't talk to us for the first ten minutes. She then took our order but had to come back another ten minutes later because she threw away our ticket. Finally she brought the wrong food out and then we had to wait for her to eventually bring out the correct dishes. Also she never filled our water and never brought us butter for our bread. The food was not that good and I was disappointed given what I had heard.

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood
text: Extra star for being on Jackson Square, but the good was just ok. We had breakfast, so dinner might be better. We went here because it was a shorter wait than other higher rated places. Almost wish we ha waited, but the table we had was right by the square. Most staff seem disinterested in people. Look burnt out. Oh well.

place_category: Seafood, American (New), American (Traditional), Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: I ordered a chicken sandwich with a baked potato with butter and sour cream. What I got was grilled chicken on a bun there was no bacon, Swiss, lettuce,tomato, onion and pickle like it was described on the menu. And the potato only came with sour cream. No utensils even though I asked for them and my drink was not given to the Uber driver. Lame lame lame no one can read apparently or checks the orders. Never ordering from them again!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: I had my husband's surprise 50th at Tatantella this evening and I couldn't have been happier. The food was delicious, the staff was pleasant and accommodating, and the private room in the back was perfect. Thank you for making my husband's surprise party one he will never forget!

place_category: Bakeries, Coffee & Tea, Bars, Donuts, Beer Bar, Food, Bubble Tea, Restaurants, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Gluten-Free, Vegan, Cafes, Acai Bowls
text: I wanted to enjoy this place after reading all the reviews , I ordered two cappuccinos and the quiche. The coffees were tiny and cold. The quiche as well was very small. Not sure on the other pastries but there was nothing impressive about this place.

place_category: Bars, Italian, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Beer Bar, American (New), Pizza
text: Extremely upset with our lunch Friday. I had the Hawaiian chicken so soggy. Covered in grease. Blah. My guest had a club like sandwich. Wasn't impressed. Service wasn't good as well. It didn't seem to be too busy but our drinks were always empty, staff seemed disorganized and quality food lacked.

place_category: Food, Delis, Restaurants, Grocery, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: I attempted to use manufacturer's coupons at the Raleys store on Caughlin and Cashill and got rude remarks from the checker Wei. These are sent to promote their products and should be redeemed without question or comment. Who needs rudeness at this store.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Vietnamese, Chinese
text: I didn't try the pho because I can't eat raw meat right now. I had the shrimp and scallops with vegetables and it wasn't too fresh. My husband had the tofu with curry and it was just ok. We also had the crispy spring vegetables which again were not that impressive.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Pubs, Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), American (New)
text: We are almost regulars here. Truly a "family" sports bar. This is a place you really can feel comfortable bringing your kids after practice, after the game, or just to watch the game with them.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: The spring rolls were a bit greasier than others I have had. I had the chicken corn soup that was OK, egg drop soup base. For my entrée, I had cashew chicken and it was pretty damn tasty. Little bland, but the broccoli was tender and wonderful, and the chicken was good. Good delivery service.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: What a great find during our visit to Nashville. I lived in Texas for 30 years before recently moving to Atlanta. and these Kolaches are just as good, if not better than all the Kolaches I had back in Texas. We had the cinnamon apple, cream cheese, and traditional sausage Kolaches, all were fantastic. They have other yummy pastries such as cinnamon rolls if you are not in a Kolache mood. We Will definitely be back next time we are in Nashville.

place_category: Sandwiches, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Great food, clean establishment, and quick service. The store has been turned around for sure. The manager Breanna is doing a great job.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: I just stopped in today for the first time. I got an iced tea and they brew each individual cup fresh. I had peppermint green tea but there were so many other teas thatit was hard to chioose. Delicious. The owner was really nice and I found out she bakes the muffins and cupcakes on the premises. I will be back to try the food soon!

place_category: German, Beer Bar, Food, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Beer Gardens
text: I wasn't impressed with this place or the staff. I'm not a beer lover and clearly this is the place for that. The inside is very trendy and this is a great place for crowds.

place_category: Southern, Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Excellent BBQ. Found this place on yelp on my phone on the drive home to St. Louis from Atlanta. They have a drive through, which was perfect (though the massive pulled pork sandwich was hard to eat in the car). Spicy BBQ sauce was great too. Cole slaw on the sandwich was a new thing for me. But very good. Don't knock it till you try it.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: Such a great atmosphere and it has unique waffles I would have never thought of . The bleu ox is one of the best things on the menu. And there smoothies are delicious too!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Same experience here as well. Had to walk downstairs to receive the food. In addition I would recommend people who are ordering pizza to consider ordering one size larger than they think they will need. Portions are on the small side. Phone operator however was extremely friendly and pizza was yummy.

place_name: West Ave Grille Jenkintown Restaurant and Food Truck
place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Caterers, American (New), Comfort Food, Food Trucks, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Food
text: The food is good & the wait staff are friendly. It's a good place to go for lunch. Love the avocado fries & the sweet potato fries.

place_category: Restaurants, Latin American, Peruvian, Seafood
text: Steak and seafood (octopus) was very hard, not easy to eat. Tostones were so hard and over cooked. Was not impressed nor will repeat.

place_category: Nightlife, Seafood, Bars, Restaurants, Tiki Bars, American (Traditional)
text: My husband comes here when he travels for work. I was able to accompany him this time and I am so glad I did! We shared the seafood gumbo to start (delicious and not stingy with the seafood). My husband ordered the jambalaya and I got the grouper po' boy. Absolutely amazing!!!! Very fresh food, absolutely amazing taste, hush puppies were some of the best I have ever had. Our waitress Tereza was fantastic: friendly, attentive and provided a great experience!

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: The guy waiting on us was rude and very short with his answers. We were the only ones in line. Both of us ordered the cheesesteak. I live near Chicago and was excited to try the original. My wife and I agreed it was the worst sandwich I ever ate. The bread was good, soft chewy. The steak even had a pretty good seasoning but the cheese topping was like nacho cheese, thick and gross. I look forward to Maxwell Street philly steak for a great sandwich.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners
text: Good breakfast but not a real nice place. I like the Paul Bunyan breakfast but that's about it.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Wineries, American (New), Wine Tasting Room, Gluten-Free, Arts & Entertainment, Party & Event Planning, Wine Bars, Food, Seafood
text: Over all its been a good experience.. wine was 10/10 food 6/10. Meat was overcooked and a little burned/ bitter.. Risotto short rib was good , taste was amazing. Calamari appetizer was overcooked .. tasted reheated. Surf n turf we order the NY Ginger steak and grouper and the steak was bitter, grouper was just ok, french fries were cold and a little reheated... service was really good 5/5

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches
text: Returned because my wife and I wanted some gooey topped thin crust pizza. Braved the noise, and this place can get loud, but it was worth it. The toppings were quite good, especially the sausage. Also had some mild wings and butternut squash soup. All excellent. One problem, the floor is slippery and the place is crowded so not easy to maneuver. On the other hand, the wait staff get around just fine and the food comes out fast. Chicago is served well by this pizza dive.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Cajun/Creole, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, American (New)
text: This place has it all: friendly, competent service, delicious, inventive food, and a terrific ambience in a well designed space, right on St. Charles, next to Lafayette Park. I highly recommend it!

place_category: Mexican, Food Trucks, American (New), Salad, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Restaurants
text: Good, a little better than fast food, enjoyed my burrito.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Tex-Mex
text: My follow up visit was pretty good. I know what works for me and order accordingly. The beef and chicken enchiladas are very good. I have yet to try a burrito. I think the colorful booths are a nice touch. Lunch or dinner I always receive good service. Worth checking out if you are in the area.

place_category: French, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Truly a special dining experience. Five star quality food and service. My boyfriend and I ordered the six course Chef's Playground with wine pairing and were treated to an amazing culinary adventure. My only critique would be the portion sizes on two of the courses--a little too big for my taste. Highly recommended whether you are a local or a visitor to the city.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Bakeries, Food, Internet Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I really need a 3.5 rating on this one. I'm torn in my star rating, just not quite a 4. I think mostly because the consistency of the baked eggs still has me baffled. The croissant sandwich all together was fine and good flavor, it's just that egg consistency... I love the layout of the place and enjoy that you have a birds eye view of the bakery area. I purchased some brownie bites for my work team, of which they absolutely loved them!

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: This place had terrible service and mediocre food. My mom ordered stir fry noodles which was overpriced and a small portion. Her dish had very little shrimp and beef! My pho was very bland and the portion was also very small. There are many other more enjoyable restaurants on the same block!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Good place to go for home cooked breakfast Husband and Wife team split the duties of front and back and their banter is priceless. The place is outfitted with a bee theme. Bee's everywhere!

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Barbeque
text: Took 9 mins to see a waitress she seemed disconnected. Weren't that busy said 15 mins For 11 oz sirloin steak over cooked Next trip 6 oz sirloin over cooked again Baked potato so dry it crumbled Sweet tea not sweet at all They ended up comp. Meal App and a dessert It would be nice to eat here without seeing a manager ever time

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Chocolatiers & Shops, Coffee & Tea, Macarons
text: No yogurt here. Only high priced gelato. They did have one that was sugar free so I'll give them an xtra star. My Wife had the pineapple passion fruit and didn't finish it. Said it wasn't good. As most of New Orleans you have to be a magician to find parking. Music toooooo loud which makes you have to scream to be heard. Back to Yogurt Mountain.

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Event Planning & Services, Wine Bars, Bars, Gastropubs, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces
text: New favorite place! My husband and I stopped in last night before a concert at the Arena. Great wine, amazing food, awesome service. Ask for JP! We loved all of his recommendations. Already planning our next visit!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caterers, Sandwiches, Delis
text: This is the place to go if you are with a group of people and everyone wants something different....it has a very extensive menu with everything you can think of including liver and even beef tongue. The sandwiches are ok, the chili is thick and it has a good dessert selection....overall it's a good place for a quick bite.

place_category: Convenience Stores, Shopping, Food, Photography Stores & Services, Drugstores, Cosmetics & Beauty Supply, Beauty & Spas
text: Worst managed pharmacy I have ever seen. 8 employees behind the counter cannot clear a few people in line. Don't bother calling in ahead because they do not seem to fill it anyways. Every person in line is having the same issue.

place_category: Gluten-Free, Desserts, Vegan, Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Food
text: Very casual. Everything we got was delish. (And vegan!) loved the very berry smoothy. Loved the salad special of the day! The mocha chocolate cake was just perfect. The decor is fun and full of colorful murals. The seats are surprisingly comfortable for being hard chairs. The outdoor seating is heated and warm even in winter, and lovely. Someone had their puppy with them on the patio which was adorable.

place_category: Desserts, Salad, Cajun/Creole, Food, Restaurants
text: To-go order for a roast beef poboy was prepared quickly and absolutely delicious. The flavor was on point and the serving size was generous. I cannot wait to return.

place_category: Grocery, Shopping, Restaurants, Drugstores, Bakeries, Delis, Food
text: We go here once a week and today was the worst service we have had in the sandwich line. I've talked to the store manager on a separate occasion because of slow service. Line was long and no one came over to help make sandwiches, the ASSISTANT STORE MANAGER (the tall blonde) came over to delegate tasks but what she needed to do was help out with the hot table and sandwiches. What a joke today was! Our co-worker didn't even get his Mac n cheese , he tried twice. Tighten up Publix !

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Decided to try this place. Nice vibes and nice stuff. Full house on Mother's Day. Service was a bit slow and main courses came before the appetizers. We were comped for that. My son ordered meat dish and loved it. I wish they would add more items without meat in the menu. It's heavy on the meat side when a lot of people choose to limit or not eat it. My favorite things were the fried green tomatoes ( No pic) and the whisky cake.

place_category: Pizza, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Salad
text: The Sicilian or square pizza was amazing. However, the antipasto salad was overpriced at 13.50 and underwhelming in antipasto. Delosas in Johns Pass can give a lesson in the salads.

place_category: Drugstores, Convenience Stores, Shopping, Food
text: Pathetic. You can be sure to wait 10-15 minutes for the privilege of paying for the things you want, because regardless of how many people are in line, and how many items they have, only ONE out of the five cash registers gets use outside of Mardi Gras. And even during Mardi Gras, they will make even the most honest people in the world feel like petty criminal shoplifters. Nothing about how this store is managed shows any hint of respect for their customers or their time.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Soup, Chinese
text: Get the General Tso's chicken, chicken lo mein, crab romgoon, and a huge egg roll! The best Chinese food I've ever had! It's definitely a dive, but the food is scrumptious, with huge portions for a steal!

place_category: Korean, Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Speaking as a Korean, I can say for sure that this is authentic Korean food and everything tastes great! The service was great - was great meeting the family who own the restaurant and serve the customers. Great service, great food - what more can you ask for? I hope that this place becomes very popular and stays around for a long time. I highly recommend it!

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Coffee & Tea
text: Meh. $7 for a small mocha to go? I thought they gave me the wrong size but they said, rather snooty I may add, "We only have one size"...for $7 it better be a large! Damn I don't even spend $7 for a large mocha at my favorite mom n pop coffee on the beach in SoCal. And it wasn't as good as I remembered, nor was the customer service. And parking sucks.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese, Food, Cafes, Bubble Tea
text: The Say Gon cafe is a bowl of smiles 2 old hens who's faces shown miles The pho is a testament to where this will go A Slurp of the soup and it's off to the poopie den The decor is offending even if you're not spending A kings ransom to pay The bygone cafe

place_category: Malaysian, Asian Fusion, Cambodian, Chinese, Restaurants, Thai
text: I ordered the Pad Thai and a side of brown rice, figuring that the Pad Thai wouldn't be enough for dinner. I was wrong. The Pad Thai was quite filling and very good. Penang is a great take out option if you are staying at a Chinatown area hotel.

place_category: Wine Bars, Seafood, Food, Nightlife, Restaurants, Italian, Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Pick up order just in time. I had the mezzaluna raviolis (good), the lentils soup (also good) and the meatballs which had a tasty tomato sauce with creamy ricotta,we were surprised with that dish,really good.Nice service,they put all the elements for you to fix the complementary bread at home.

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: Good Food! Weird Pricing for additional shrimp. Amazing clam chowder. Long wait for food, but it is seafood. Fish and chips, fries, wings =DELICIOUS. Would come back

place_category: Vietnamese, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Best Pho and best Miss Saigon in Tucson! Quick, friendly service and spot on Vietnamese food. I'm very happy they opened a location here it's not as crowded as the Campbell location and service is better too.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Cocktail Bars, Bowling, Active Life, Venues & Event Spaces, Bars, American (Traditional), American (New), Lounges
text: Location is great, lanes are alright, foods good. But the figure holes in the balls could be a little bigger.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants, Bubble Tea, Indian, Food, Sandwiches
text: I REALLY like this place. Compared to a few other banh mi's I've had in South Philly, I prefer this one. I really liked the bbq chicken banh mi but it looks like they replaced it with a bbq pork which..should be better but the meat was chewy. The flavor is there though. The boba is also really delicious.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, French
text: I have eaten frequently at the Link restaurants, Cochon, Peche, and Herbsaint. None of these restaurants will take separate checks. It's not a matter of an outdated system, rather they don't believe they have to take the time to provide this courtesy. If you go with a group, remember this is the policy.

place_category: Buffets, Restaurants
text: Eh..typical buffet place with a lot of the elderly there. The food is really off and on, sometimes it is all fresh and the food tastes pretty good (for a buffet) and then other times the food seems kind of stale. The prices are very reasonable, all you can eat for like $5-8 dollars depending on adult, senior, etc and lunch or dinner. Overall a good place to go if you are very very hungry and wants some southern/country cooking.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Nightlife
text: This is not about the food, as I didn't get to have any The restaurant was packed inside We wanted to sit on the patio, where there lots of open tables The host told us the manager wasn't seating out there because it may rain I checked the forecast, no rain for hours We went across the street and ate, enjoying the patio Thanks for not letting a potential customer eat where the choose We came on Sunday, 15 July @ 11:30-40 a.m

place_category: Japanese, Ramen, Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Local Flavor, Food, Specialty Food
text: Love the ice cream mochi and the curry there. Service is great and they definitely need more space to compensate for how much business they actually get. Be on a lookout for a waitress named Renee, one of the nicest people you will ever meet and seems to always be ready to help because she's so energetic!

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Mexican, Sandwiches, Latin American
text: This place is disgusting!!! Plates of the complimentary chips and salsa (old tomatoes and wilted greens) were stacked on top of each other with no shame on the way to the bathroom. Food is mediocre at best. Definitely not authentic. Tables were sticky and gross. Never going back. Take the drive to Cantina Feliz in Fort Washington for a much better experience.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Food, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants
text: They have a great selection of wines and I loved their salad. Service is just ok. Always open til 3am except mondays.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Mediterranean, Greek, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Came to the Yunk to look for a place to eat, came across this place and boom! Now addicted!

place_category: Nightlife, Mexican, Bars, Restaurants
text: Hard to decide on a rating for Casita. Their tacos are really tasty, salsa is good too. BUT if you are celiac or gluten-free please proceed with ultimate caution - their corn tortillas are dusted with flour so they don't stick together. Casita does not advertise themselves as a gluten free establishment, but knowing that tacos with corn tortillas are usually really really safe for anyone with gluten sensitivities, this was a huge disappointment. This is a huge missed opportunity on their part.

place_category: Breweries, Restaurants, Food, American (New)
text: This place is in an old Woolworth. That in itself is pretty neat. Used to stop in here when I had friends living in the area, but then they decided to move across the country. The beer is pretty solid. The burgers and pizza are also very good. I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to drink beer in a Woolworth! The Pig Iron Porter and the Ironbound Ale are my favorites here.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: The sushi here is a little pricey, but its good sushi. The drinks are really strong, gotta love that sake. The staff is really friendly and helpful. Its a nice environment, you can see the river and the water fountains easily. I just really like the Opryland hotel.

place_category: Southern, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Sandwiches
text: We went here for a late lunch today. I ordered a veggie omelette with well done hash browns. 99% of the places I order this from get it wrong. They did a great job with meeting my expectations. My husband ordered the ham & cheese. He thought there was too much bread and not a lot of ham & cheese. Our waitress was very friendly & attentive.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Wine Bars, Soup, Restaurants, American (New)
text: The best way to describe our last visit to Sydney Street is tired. The menu items are tired, our server recommended pierogis as something to "push your boundaries"- pierogis to push food boundaries? The lobster turnovers were average, steak wasabi met my expectations but the seemingly unseasoned tempura veggies fell very short. Best item at our table was my hubby's beef cheek with fermented potato pancake- may be the best item on the menu.

place_category: Do-It-Yourself Food, Farmers Market, Food
text: Went there to get pumpkins and was pleasantly surprised that their pumpkins are not priced per lb. They're priced by which wagon they're on and the most expensive ones were $8.99. The cheaper ones ($5.99) were almost the same exact size as the more expensive ones so you do get a large pumpkin for a good price compared to many other farm stands. Most farm stands have odd shaped pumpkins or small ones that are really overpriced.

place_category: Soul Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Southern, Restaurants, Salad
text: i like this place. i came here with some family and really enjoyed sunday brunch. they had a live jazz band that was absolutely rockin. the food was buffet style but they also had chefs preparing fresh omelets and anything else you wanted. the buffet food was good too. they kept it fresh and brought out new food throughout the entire brunch. service was decent.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Great tasting cheesesteaks quickly, even with long lines. I work down the street at another restaurant and when we are working long hours I will sometimes pick up some cheeseteaks for lunch. They taste great and they're quick!!

place_category: Shopping, Butcher, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food
text: MEH. Finally Cochon has joined the Link standard of restaurants; overpriced and underwhelming, a true marketing project. My last visit in April '17 closed the book for me. What was once a bustling sandwich shop now try's to provide an elevated experience- without improving its fare. Most of the meats are dried out and overseasoned. I have discovered Verdi Mart in the quarter without expectations of grandeur.

place_category: Shopping, Butcher, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food
text: This is a must visit every time I got to NOLA. The Le Pig Mac is my favorite. Amazing quality food at an affordable price.

place_category: Food, Do-It-Yourself Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Had breakfast there last Sunday. Nothing stood out. Prices are very good and would return for the pancakes and bacon. Hash browns tasted funny; kind of watery.

place_category: Sandwiches, Irish Pub, Restaurants, Pubs, Burgers, Bars, Nightlife
text: I love the atmosphere here, the happy hour, the food and the prices. My constant complaint about the place is the service. It's always, always slow. Tonight my party arrived at 6. By 6:40 we still had not even been asked for drinks. We eventually abandoned ship and left. It's a shame because I like this place but there are always issues with the service.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Hotels & Travel, Hotels, Restaurants, Bed & Breakfast
text: A lovely hotel right in the middle of the action. Out one door - It's Bourbon Street with all its crazyness, Out the other - Bamm, your in the the French Quarter. Love, love, love the location. Expensive but the rooms are very nice and I think it's worth it.

place_category: Puerto Rican, Dominican, Restaurants, Cuban, Caribbean
text: Really good food. Especially the fried pork and plantains. I've had the buffet and the menu listed dinners. Everything I've tried has been great. I highly recommend this gem

place_category: Pizza, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Vegan, Fast Food
text: Good pizza and fast. Thin crust fans will love this pizza. We agree with another review, that said it was like "Subway" for pizza. It is very busy, noisy and crowded. We suggest going at an off time. They ran out of some ingredients, two hours near the end of their day, but there were plenty of others to choose from. Fun to be able to choose your own ingredients for a real custom made meal. 11.5 in pizza was about $8.95 and very filling.

place_category: Bagels, Food, Donuts
text: Best donuts!!! Can't beat breakfast special! Super nice staff. Highly recommend cinnamon crunch donut!!

place_category: Bars, Coffee & Tea, Food, Nightlife, Wine Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: We just ate here and had absolutely terrible service. Our food took over an hour to be served and only two people at a time. The first plate and last plate were served over 20 minutes apart. The waitstaff was unapologetic and on top of that the food was very mediocre. The soup was salty, one of the orders came out incorrectly. Our waters were never refilled. I would much rather be informed to expect a delay and wait for our food to arrive at the same time.

place_category: Salad, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bagels, Soup, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: This location is horrible! I normally never write reviews, but from the food product to the rude and negative staff, I couldn't resist warning others. The product of the food is one thing, but the staff is extremely rude and unprofessional. Save your dollars and hungry tummy from this disaster!

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners
text: I walked in for breakfast and the waiters were sitting in the booths...with their feet ON the tables. Not my thing. I couldn't sit the booths anyway, the oddly low and long shelves caused me to crouch over the table. Maybe I'm too tall? Still...not comfortable. I'm sure it would make a great dive bar, but, for breakfast? No thank you.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Creperies
text: This place was OK...but only OK. The crepes were so underfilled....I honestly think I got one tiny piece of olive in my vegetarian crepe. The best one was the nutella and strawberry crepe....and it's pretty hard to screw that up. As other reviewers said, there was no A/C. The service was OK...the waiter wasn't overly friendly nor did he refill our water glasses more than once, but he wasn't mean and our crepes came out pretty quickly. Wouldn't go back...

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Dive Bars, Nightlife, Sports Bars
text: Decent atmosphere. HORRIBLE service. Group of 6. Super slow and not all of us got our fodod. Said kitchen missed order. Skip it.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Nightlife, Burgers, Food, Restaurants
text: Neat look and creative menu..but took 45 minutes to be served, after waiting for beverages for 10. They weren't crowded. ..i think just unorganized? Once the food arrived it was good ( we had cobb salad) and nice portion size. Dressing on the side was small little plastic cup..kind of funny with such a good sized salad. All in all i would go back if i was not in a hurry to be anywhere afterwards.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Pubs, Venues & Event Spaces, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Excellent beer selection. Food was good as well. Bartender was very friendly and kept up nicely. Not a whole lot to choose from in this area but this was a pleasant surprise. Would go back again.

place_category: Seafood, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Cajun/Creole, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Omg the good was horrible. I believe it was frozen clams and crab cake. The chowder was canned... I just know it. Never again if it wasn't for the server and manager being so nice we would've left lot sooner. Don't wasted you money or time. Even McDonald's is better

place_category: Food, Cajun/Creole, Seafood Markets, Seafood, Specialty Food, Restaurants, French
text: This place is a seafood market/restaurant so don't expect any cozy decor. Ordered the seafood platter ....it was more than enough for two people. Very good seasoning and fried just right, not too hard. Also got a lb of the crawfish, the sign said hot/spicy, I should have known New Orleans spicy would be hotter than the norm. I could only eat a few before my eyes started watering..too hot for my taste. Service was OK. If you want good seafood to take back to your hotel, this is your place.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: The place is very dark and has a bad smell. It took a while to be greeted at the table. The server was short at the beginning but did get slightly better. We were given a hard time about our restaurant.com certificate (like other reviews have mentioned they claim the regular menu combination plates are a special) so we asked to speak to the manager. After a long time he arrived and said 'so what's the problem? '. The sushi tasted good so maybe go with take out - -

place_category: Active Life, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Bowling, Restaurants, American (New), Gastropubs
text: Loved this place, a true dining experience. Great ambience, fantastic service and amazing food. This was a hit all the way around! Fav of the night: cod, Tuna avocado salad, Brussels and scallops. Can't wait to go back to try other dishes. The decor is great... down to the way the waitstaff dresses. Very prohibition style.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Pizza, Burgers, Nightlife, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Great patty melt. Enjoyed the hot French fries. I'll definitely be back. Service was excellent and everything was very clean.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: I am not and have not been a fan of this place but sometimes they are the only place I can find what I'm looking for. The service is a take it or leave it type of attitude. I did order shrimp, turkey necks, and a yakamein from the location. The shrimp is ordered by the pound and turkey by quantity, and both were very tasty but the yakamein tasted like water. The location on Claiborne always looks like it can still uses good mopping. The bathroom didn't seem to lock properly.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: Salmon was better than out of a can, but not by much. Stoli rocks was a short pour, and the bartender wasn't much better than the Salmon. No reason to stop again now that the Aristocrat is back.

place_category: American (New), Public Services & Government, Landmarks & Historical Buildings, Diners, Salad, Bars, Burgers, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Steakhouses, Seafood, Breakfast & Brunch, Cocktail Bars
text: Great food and atmosphere. Make reservations, it's not a place you can just show up and get a table.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Food and drinks were good, but extremely slow. Margarita prices are high for this quality restaurant.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Diners, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Breweries, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Brewpubs
text: Our favorite restaurant in the KoP area! I loved the blackened chicken pizza, but I think they may have gotten rid of it. Bring it back!! The tzatziki is also very good. The beers are pretty good with the IPA being the best (great great IPA).

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Really nice variety of options. Staff was super friendly and polite. Can't beat the prices.

place_category: Bars, Mediterranean, Nightlife, Burgers, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Sandwiches
text: This place is good. The prices are good and the food and beer are delicious. Their happy hour is fantastic and definitely worth trying out. The only thing I would fix about this place is their servers, some of them seem to have the attitude of "just here to collect a pay check".

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: It's all about the sides and my Mac and cheese was recommended as their best side but not so much for this Southern girl! Pulled pork was very good and super fresh and light bun. Sauces are a religious preference and this was not my fav. I will say the pork was so good it didn't need sauce and the slaw was delicious!

place_category: Cafes, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea
text: Been here close to an hour and still waiting on soup and a sandwich. One of the people with me ordered at the same time and is almost finished with her meal. My Ham & Swiss Melt arrived with no Swiss. The chicken tortilla soup is pretty good. My husband said the Club sandwich is good. Giving two stars for waiting so long for soup, salad & sandwiches.

place_category: Restaurants, Specialty Food, Grocery, Food, Italian, Delis, Seafood Markets, Bakeries, Sandwiches
text: I love coming here and getting the tomato pie it has to be the best I have ever had honestly. They have the best beef with gravy that they make and they give it to you in containers for going home and making roast beef sandwiches. Everything there is so fresh and the cookies they have are to die for. Everything is so amazing here. Including the people who work there.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Plenty of parking. Clean. Friendly. Great prices great food. There were many servers. I had cheeseburger . So many fries I could not finish

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Chicken Wings, Latin American, Caterers, Restaurants, Mexican, Tacos, New Mexican Cuisine, Seafood, Salad
text: Good lunch spot. I have had lunch here several times. The service has been good, though sometimes faster than others. Staff has always been very courteous and try their best. They serve a variety of dishes, menu is very similar to other Mexican restaurants in the area. If you are looking for a filling lunch this is your place. The prices are pretty inexpensive given the amount of food you are served. Enjoy the authentic Mexican music. Buen provecho!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: $20 for a shrimp poboy-drink and fry. Shrimp was cold and very few. Cash only and very few seats. Bread makes a sandwich and their's was average at beat. Recommend you find another place for a poboy!

place_category: Tapas/Small Plates, Event Planning & Services, Specialty Food, Caterers, Food, Venues & Event Spaces, Cocktail Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Italian, Pizza, Nightlife, American (New), Restaurants, Wine Bars, Bars
text: Food and Service were extraordinary, Gnocchi is to die for! The bee sting pizza is a nice combination of sweet and spicy. When deciding what to get from the bar the bartender actually made a special house made drink when we were indecesive about what to get. The waitress/waiter were both very friendly and accommodating making sure every questions we asked had an answer and giving some great recommendations! If you're in the area I would 100% recommend stopping by and getting something!

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Salad, Sandwiches, Food, Soup, Bagels
text: Service is shaky, closest Panera to me so I have come here quite a bit. Employees are not always professional but it's a sign of the times unfortunately. To be honest I try not to come here much anymore and take the extra time and gas to drive ro another location.

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: We found the reviews on Yelp...walked over from the JW Marriott. The server was friendly, gave me a taste of a wine he liked. Food was good; Curry not too hot, just right, pad tai a bit sweet. My only slight negative was the chicken was a bit overdone. Would return when I am in Indianapolis. Love restaurants that are small and individually owned.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, American (New)
text: Have tried First Watch twice. While the menu looks good, the execution is mediocre. Omelettes are under-filled and rubbery. Pancakes are oversized and caky. Sandwiches are small and stingy, filling-wise. Due to a front-of-the-house/back-of-the-house system, food is delivered by a person unempowered to get you anything else you need, leaving you searching for your server. Good coffee, however, served in a personal pot, which is always a plus.

place_category: Nightlife, Steakhouses, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: The bartenders were very nice and handled things well but the "wife of the owner" was moving the rug and pulled it from under our feet.. I get it I used to be a bartender but if asked politely I would have moved but as never asked to move just got the rubber piece moved from under me..

place_category: American (Traditional), Vegan, Restaurants
text: Great ambience, courteous service and well priced food. Good spot for dates, classy bar for friends or clients. You will fully appreciate the restaurant only if you are vegetarian. I enjoyed the Risotto but not the Pad Thai. The apple cobbler with Coconut ice-cream was great.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bagels
text: Their costumer service is terrible. They sent me my confirmation for pick up and when I went it wasn't ready, the bagels hadn't been made yet. The woman working the register was so rude and not helpful at all. She didn't help me or offer any solutions. When I told her I had received a confirmation email she said she had not sent me one, even after I showed her the picture. I will not be going back.

place_category: New Mexican Cuisine, Mexican, Restaurants, Tacos
text: What an awesome restaurant. Great food, the best margaritas, and inexpensive shots. The bartender and server were so sweet and patient as we asked too many questions about what to order. :) I'm not from St. Louis but they made us feel right at home. Highly recommend.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Seafood, Chinese, Dim Sum
text: Came in 30 minutes before they closed. You would have thought we were trying to rob the place. Food not very special. Fried rice. chicken with black bean sauce

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Buffets, Japanese
text: The buffet was mediocre at best. Desserts were all those cheap store bought cakes. The website description of pastries including cream puffs and eclairs is incorrect - there were none. Super disappointing. Do not recommend.

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: Food was below average and the man who took my order hung up because i called to complain that my pizza was cold (store is less than 5 minutes away from my hotel room) and didn't look like what i was expecting for a meat lovers. I would rather buy my pizza from the frozen isle.

place_category: Italian, Salad, Bars, Wine Bars, Soup, Nightlife, Restaurants, Israeli
text: My parents love the place, but I find the food barely okay.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Noodles, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Food, Salad, Vegetarian, Vegan
text: Great food great people, but my bowl was barely filled and I ordered beef and pork, barely any noodles, thanks for the $13.20 before tax rip off, I love feeling taken advantage of

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Restaurants, Greek, Salad
text: Love the food, but they are consistently short-staffed for lunch on weekdays. While it hasn't stopped us from coming back, but today marks the third time we've left after waiting over 15 minutes and no one acknowledged us.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Wait was incredibly long for a restaurant that's much like first watch. Many of our cups were dirty, drinks didn't come out until close to the time food came, and food came and our skillets (we ordered 3) were cold. Wouldn't go back if I'm Nashville.

place_category: Caterers, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Barbeque
text: The food here is very good and the guys in my lunch group like this place. I got the quarter chicken and a couple of side salads. The service was good but something here is missing. Maybe it's just me but everything was a little too polished and clean. It just doesn't seem to fit my ideal of a Barbecue joint. I go for more of the small, local places that have been honing their craft for generations.

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, Tacos
text: Overall worst fast food service I've ever seen! Sometimes the drive through isn't working. Sometimes the dining room isn't working. Orders take way too long. It's so bad I no longer go to this Taco Bell.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: What makes the Minh Bi sandwich extra special is the freshly baked French baguette, BUT the bread on that sandwich was nothing better than an enriched flour hogie from Kroger. Huge disappointment. Not worth twice the price of a quality Minh Bi elsewhere.

place_category: Sandwiches, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood
text: Bad drinks and food! First of all, outdoor seating but NO dog allowed, unbelievable. From the host to servers were unfriendly. We ordered mixed drinks, and we were told they were all sweet after we got them. The plastic cup I used for hot water was very beat. The food we ordered, especially Grouper walnut salad looked unappealing and didn't taste fresh. We took only 2 bites, but they refused to take off from the bill. If I were the chef, I would not serve food like that.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Great location right off of the Greenway! You can walk and bike their easily. They have a really large porch and inside so great for finding a place to get work done. They have all the same quality drinks as their other locations. The staff was friendly and I got my drink quickly.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Italian, Salad
text: Fresh. Delicious. This place has great food. Yet to dine in but looking forward it. Their sandwich/hoagies are a great lunch choice if you work nearby. Prepared very carefully. Thanks.

place_category: French, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Bars
text: There are better places to go in NOLA. The food and service are good but not spectacular. Very popular with the tourist crowd. The last time we went was two years ago. We took family who were visiting us over the Christmas holidays. Prior to going we told our guests this was THE PLACE TO GO in NOLA. I remember both my wife and I were so disappointed after the meal that we apologized to our guests because the food and service were just not up to a ***** rating.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: They definitely have one of the best oysters in NOLA but besides that everytime I tried something else it doesn't taste good

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Tapas Bars, Mexican, Latin American, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The food: delicious and so good. Clearly great ingredients. The service: mediocre at best. Slow. Not attentive. And they claimed a computer issue in splitting our cash/credit bill. I'll be back, hope none of the servers are.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Japanese
text: This is a great place for a birthday. Nice dinner with entertainment. The cooks try to make you laugh, putting on a show while they cook the food. The rice was buttery and seasoned heavenly. If you are minding your calories, this place is not for you. The food is cooked to perfection, and quite generous with the portions. The service was friendly and professional.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, American (New), Seafood, American (Traditional), Desserts, Salad
text: I know people have their issues about chain restaurants. This Cheesecake Factory bar is awesome. It's clean, bartender is super nice, laid back ambience. I like to frequent places after work solo and it's definitely somewhere where you can catch up on email and just sit and relax from the day. Their menu is the longest in the world so really they would have anything you could want. Consistently great.

place_category: Latin American, Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: A little bland for me personally, but really good freshly made authentic Mexican food. Salsa was incredibly bland. They had a sign up saying they're closing and moving to Ft. Lowell.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: good for breakfast and lunch. food is fresh and tasty. the waiters are a little flamey but that is half the fun LOL.

place_category: Malaysian, Nightlife, Bars, Salad, Cocktail Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Japanese, Restaurants, Ramen, Filipino, Pan Asian, Chinese, Asian Fusion
text: Wasn't bad but could be improved upon. Tried the bao roast duck bun appetizers, which were nice, rich with flavor. But the Hong Kong wonton noodle soup was bland. It could have used some infusion of lemongrass, soy sauce and Thai basil. The service was attentive but rush. It took a while to be served the food, although we just ordered 3 items including a drink. Will come back to try other items. Hopefully, they will have a more flavorful punch.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: A world of yogurt. Give it a try next time you think you want to go to Sweet CeCe's.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Cheap pizza. When you're in college, it's perfect. Otherwise, it's inedible cardboard.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Sandwiches
text: I like traditional hashbrowns seems everyone is doing chopped up with peppers and onions and I'm getting tired of it.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Very good food and the servers are really nice. Quick service even if we get carry out. Some places use crappy oil to cook with but this place does not. We have never had any issues. We eat there often

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Chinese
text: Everything I've ever had at Red's has been phenomenal. The General's chicken is my favorite flavor profile on the planet, and the pork belly buns are so, so good. Their cocktails are amazing, too. I love dining on their patio and have only received awesome service from all their wait staff. Some of the menu items tend toward too salty (specifically the eggplant) but it was still enjoyable. This is one of my favorite restaurants in the city.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Desserts, Food, Patisserie/Cake Shop
text: The pastries are fresh and have lots of variety... but they're very overpriced. I'd recommend skipping the shaved ice. They are really small in size ( I think I got like three of the little gummy rice cakes or dduk) and basically melted by the time they come out.

place_category: Italian, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Comfort Food, Sandwiches, Bakeries, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Nice location with a good ambiance. The food is good, though I was told I couldn't substitute a substitute the bagel on my Benedict for a different bread.. odd. I'm not a bagel fan, but whatever. The server, middle aged dude, was sucky at best.. the lady, who may have been the owner seemed like much better server. Menu is a bit strange, I understand trying to differentiate yourself, but a few more 'normal' options, with some flair, would be nice. Great OJ and zeppoles we're excellent.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: This is my go to Starbucks and it's open at 5 AM.Great customer service, fast and accurate.Also they listen to your special request and actually get them right. Shelby is one of my favorite baristas, I'm always so happy to see her because she's excellent at her job and has such a contagious positive personality (awesome customer service)and that's exactly how you should be if you work in any business otherwise work in a funeral home where you don't have to be so upbeat.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Great spring summer café spot. The outdoor ambience adds to the average food. It's good just not great. Nothing stands out as exceptional. Great place to stop for a cocktail ....good bar spot, however, dining room is very loud to open large feels like a cafeteria but with nicer décor.

place_category: Italian, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I've been here more than a handful of times and every time has been better than the last. You need to get the risotto balls. Trust me. I've brought family, friends and more to this place because the food is something you need to try at least once.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, French, Salad, Sandwiches, Desserts, Bakeries, Food
text: horrible customer service. messed up our order twice. also 3 pieces of fruits for a fruit cup? pathetic. just get the almond croissant and leave. not worth anything else.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Delivery took 40 minutes and this place is 0.4 miles away... Hot and sour soup is actually one of the better ones I've had Broccoli with shrimp and garlic sauce was just OK. Also had quite the trip in the bathroom later that day... can't point fingers but I'm assuming...

place_category: Food, Donuts, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Very good donuts. Loved them. This place may be sometimes too slow, but overall looks good.

place_name: Hilton Garden Inn Tampa Suncoast Parkway
place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Restaurants
text: Comfortable beds!! Clean rooms and friendly staff. What more could I want? Sheets were soft and not itchy. Pillows were a mix of different stuffing so I could customize my comfort. The hotel food was solid too!

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Super old-school, white table cloth restaurant, but my husband and I had a nice dinner here. Menu prices are a little bit high, but the views are fabulous. We loved the clam chowder but there's no need to order it in the bread bowl here- they bring out fresh, hot sourdough bread for the table, and this was a MUCH better dipper for the soup than the bread bowl.

place_category: Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Nightlife
