place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Nightlife, Caterers, Italian, Bars
text: I used to love coming here. Not sure what happened 6 months ago to now but this food should have never set in front of me. I had a friend out of town and this is what they put in front of us. What a colossal disappointment.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Seafood, Latin American, Laotian, Caribbean, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Honestly, I came in here with low expectations. But their menu was AWESOME!! Tons of healthy, paleo-friendly meals. Great music. Service was excellent. Wish I could have tried their drinks.

place_category: Restaurants, Indian, Nightlife, Bars, Food, Cocktail Bars, Desserts
text: Really liked the atmosphere here and they have an amazing mango lassi. I have had much better Indian food though. The food was just not that flavorful and missing the taste I crave and get from most other Indian restaurants even with the exact same dish. Definitely not a bad place, but not my first choice for Indian. I will give them another try sometime though!

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Pubs, Irish
text: Pretty good pub food, has really weird hours and are a little pricey. I'd still hit this place up though.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Some of the rolls weren't done tight enough. If you picked one roll slice up with your chopsticks, they would fall apart. Lack of tea variety was left to be desired. I couldn't believe that they didn't have chrysanthemum tea, but then again not many Asian restaurants have that tea. The sushi wasn't bad. Great service. Decor & ambience was awesome.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: I'm a Burger King fan...usually. This one doesn't seem to have the friendliness I've found elsewhere. Also, I was told they NEVER have decaf coffee. First time I've run into that. Guess if you don't want the caffeine they figure you're either too stressed or too old to bother with.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Gelato, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: I don't get the hype. I've had way better gelato, ice cream, water ice, you name it elsewhere in the city..

place_category: Seafood, Greek, Food, Music Venues, American (New), Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Burgers, Gastropubs
text: Hipster heaven with good beers and better music. Definitely a fun spot on a friday night!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Crazy taco special!!! Where else can you get handmade tortilla tacos for a buck? This is as authentic as it gets in these parts!!

place_category: Automotive, Coffee & Tea, Food, Convenience Stores, Gas Stations
text: I went on a Friday night first time ever it was busy but it was still fully stocked with anything you could want I was in and out of there!

place_category: Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Seafood, American (New), Adult Entertainment, Nightlife, Burgers, Bars, Restaurants
text: If your from Chicago like I am,forget the pizza. Burgers are big but not a big deal. They do have a very good beer menu. The beach bar on Friday and Saturday night is a joke,forget about getting fast - good service on those days. The restaurant is in the Howard Johnson hotel and if you have a young family do not stay here on the weekends. I've never seen so many drunk young adults, not to mention the 40-60 yr old range also. Never again.

place_category: Italian, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Pizza
text: I got an email with an offer for a 1 topping pizza for 5.50. I placed the order online and never received and confirmation from the website. I had to call the store to figure out fi the order had gone through. I picked up the pizza. Thin crust still is cardboard like and the sauce has a bitter taste to it. The sausage is ok and reasonably distributed on the pizza. That said while it was cheap I am not sure I am going to rush back any time soon.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Seafood
text: YUM. This is a place I want to go back to. We've been twice, and both times were impressed. Definitely try one of their signature cocktails - very refreshing, different, and delicious. The orange ginger salmon was amazing; I don't know if I'll be able to branch out and try anything else on the menu next time.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Great food! We ordered the waffle and the chillaquiles, which wee both really good. Definitely worth the wait!

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Bars, Steakhouses
text: i'm not sure what people like about this place. the meet is not high quality, and not well seasoned or prepared. we didn't finish our food and neither did the table next to us. the waiter was kind enough to box all of it up for my dog - who did like it. our waiter was friendly, but not very knowledgeable about the wine list, or the food in general - maybe he was new? i wouldn't go back at half the price

place_category: Nightlife, American (New), Restaurants, Bars, Gastropubs, Cocktail Bars
text: So everything was just OK the fried ribs tasted freezer burnt. The Brussels sprout salad was just OK. Now the big pig was very good. The poutine was good. The house burger was good. For the most part I won't be rushing back again. The service was struggling she spent more time chatting to other servers than getting what we needed

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Pizza
text: They are so amazing and they have the best pizza in town!! The staff is so kind. You can collect points for free pizza! They serve amazing natural sodas that my kids love. I love everything about this place!!

place_category: Sports Bars, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: This place was interesting to say the least. The bartenders were dressed in lingerie which threw me for a loop. We stayed and had a couple of cocktails after realizing that aside from the bartenders, I was the only woman in the building. Me & my husband enjoyed the drinks though. reasonably priced. I'd go back again and see what's going on.

place_category: Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Brandon bww has the worst lunch time service ever.went there 4 times for lunch obviously .food is good if you have alot of time to wait..or retired

place_category: Greek, Mediterranean, Delis, Restaurants
text: This is the kind of place that makes me love yelp. I would never have seen it on vacation without looking at the app. Wonderful fresh produce on the sandwiches and salads. Tabouleh salad was perfect, gyros was very flavorful and the homemade tzatziki sauce was the perfect compliment. Greek salad had a freshly made vinaigrette. Prices were very reasonable. Great selection of fresh produce and imported Mediterranean foodstuffs for sale as well. Ended up eating here two days in a row.

place_category: Sandwiches, Seafood, Restaurants
text: I had the lobster roll and it was great. Today I got the Trio and it was out of this world. Three little sammies - one with lobster, the others with crab and shrimp. The food is incredibly fresh and you can taste it. The only downside is that Trio was over $20 which makes this place a treat spot and not an everyday choice. (but I will be back for more).

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New), Food
text: Love this brunch spot! Amazing food ! Only issues where with the slowish service. Will return for sure.

place_category: Bakeries, Florists, Flowers & Gifts, Food, Shopping
text: Becky's is amazing! She nailed my daughter's birthday cake and has helped us with last minute cookies!! They define customer service.

place_category: Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Mediterranean, Falafel, Food, Desserts
text: very salty grape leaves. stingy lamb kebab. sweet dressing on the salad. the platter was not a good value.

place_category: Mexican, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Probably one of my favorite tacos in Tucson. So much flavor!!! And you get free chips and salsa with a minimum of $5 purchase. (chips are not so good though). Got the chicken tacos and got to put all my own toppings as well. Went with a few friends and everyone loved theirs as well! Fish tacos, pork tacos, and the bowl. It was so good, we went back the next day for lunch. Only con is the parking downtown.. I can also see this place get pretty packed if you go at a busy time.

place_category: Kitchen & Bath, Shopping, Restaurants, Furniture Stores, Nurseries & Gardening, Home Decor, Appliances, Home & Garden
text: To bitch directly at Ikea and avoid the 800 number: Call Direct Line 215-551-4532. I hit 1111 then 0 to get to a human receptionist. Also try extensions 1452 or 1930 to get a live person. I'm pretty pissed off at Ikea right now. Hopefully this will help you avoid getting any more pissed off by trying to call the 888 number on the website.

place_category: Bars, Pubs, Nightlife, Desserts, French, Belgian, Restaurants, Food, Breweries
text: The food was no better than you get in a corner pub. I've had frites in Belgium many times. I assumed the frites would be authentic, but they were just fresh cut fries...soggy and limp. The French bread however, is among the best bread I've ever had. We paid $40 for a couple sandwiches and a kids crepe...which was undercooked and doughy. I don't mind paying higher prices if the food is good but this was not.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: I was visiting my friend and she she said "I'm going to take you to my favorite Mexican restaurant " I am not sure how it's her favorite but that's all good. The salsa was good and I liked the multi colored chips. My meal however was honestly not the worst I've ever had but not great at all. Maybe I need to give it another try

place_category: Bed & Breakfast, Salad, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Hotels & Travel
text: This used to be a good place. Not so great the last few times I've had 5$ soup in a tiny container.. shocker noodle had half an inch of grease on top, no broth and way over bloated noodles. No veggies.... my crackers were even stale???!! Cole slaw is expired or left out too long because it was bad. Their burger wasn't bad.

place_category: Wine Bars, Desserts, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Italian, Food, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza
text: Not sure why this costs $14. The potatoes were burnt, dry and flavorless. The eggs were also over cooked. My husband's French toast was soggy. Nope.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese, Food, Cafes, Bubble Tea
text: This place is very good, with even better prices. The bun bo Hue, pho, boba, etc are delicious and the portions are huge. Easily rivals some of the best Viet places in Orlando and Tampa.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Best Mexican food I have had in Tampa so far! Horchata wasn't amazing but its not a necessity for me. The Taco Salad Bowl was OUTSTANDING. I got it with Pibil and every part was just so fresh. Mu Husband got the fish taco #1 Special of the day and the platter serving was generous and the price? unbeatable. We will be back asap.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Pizza
text: Food ice cold, pizza wasn't cut and gross never again I'll never order from here again

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Food Trucks, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: Donuts are fresh with unique/creative flavours. However, it isnt possible to try any flavour you want unless you commit to boxes of four. So there is a long list of donuts you can't have. In-store, we decided to order a cronut, but were told these (only?) need to be ordered on-line. So, went to my phone to place my order & although they were "available" for purchase it was a half hour wait for pickup? We left without purchasing as there were just too many obstacles to get what we wanted.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Chinese
text: Often times during the lunch hour they have run out of several items and you have to wait. For the most part the staff is nice however don't ask any questions about the food, they don't seem to know. I am glad that they are starting to have healthier choices available. The brown rice is pretty good and so is they teriyaki chicken breast.

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Barbeque, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: Busy and noisy restaurant packed with people, have to yell at each other when you talk :) But the food is so good!! My BBQ shrimp is the best, huge shrimp with amazing BBQ sauce - I had to eat more bread than I wanted to finish the sauce in the dish!

place_category: Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Bars, Burgers, Steakhouses, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Saturday we were five for lunch. Service and food were good but the nickle and diming was ridiculous. Stop charging for every little thing and allow substitutions of veggies instead of charging and give crackers with the soup instead of charging for a bread stick! We won't return.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Salad, Sandwiches
text: Took forever to get through the drive through. Santa Barbara Char was pretty good. Chicken club was pretty good. Hardly gave any fries and they were over cooked.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Lounges, American (New), Restaurants, Nightlife, Music Venues
text: Quite possibly the most cleanest lounge/bar during this Covid era. Bar tops meticulously disinfected, staff wear masks with gloves and patrons mask wearing is enforced. A+! I have challenged bartenders Vanessa, Tia and Kagen to make me certain types of drinks. True craft conjurers. From classic old-school concoctions, to tiki drinks or just special liquors from their carnival of high-end liquor selections. Always a treat!

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Food is tasty, a meat & three kind of place. A little on the expensive side, however, the quality is there. Nice to have options in Mt. Juliet other than Cracker Barrel. Chicken, pork & brisket all good flavor - plus sauces to sweeten or spice things up.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: Would have gave another star but my soup was borderline warm at best. Really disappointing. On a positive note, the Hawaiian Roll was excellent. Staff was friendly and wait on a Friday night was above average. Sat at the bar and was sat immediately. Overall, nice atmosphere but lacking attention on quality of product served.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Mediterranean, Greek, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Seriously one of the most pleasant dining experiences I have had in a while. Smiley himself is a true gem and the food was DELICIOUS. Had so much that I am eating it for lunch again today - and I can't wait! Please recommend to everyone you know in Manayunk, don't want to lose this place!

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Burgers, Chicken Wings
text: The food is really good if you find in, but there's always a wait. I've done takeout several times only for my food to be cold or to find out afterf the fact that i didn't receive sauces or sides I had asked for or paid for.

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: Pj Clarke's misses the mark w/ it's avocado BLT poorly constructed as a open face sandwich. The turkey burger was the highlight seasoned well w/ the perfect amount of char. Drinks were mediocre ( old fashioned & Paloma) and the Caesar salad just say no !

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese, Soup, Noodles
text: I've been coming to Saigon Bowl for years. It is by far the best Vietnamese restaurant in the Tampa Bay Area and top 3 in the country. Absolutely amazing Pho and the best fried rice I've ever had. I haven't had anything on the menu that didn't love. Keep it up!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Bakeries
text: The pastries always look much better than they taste. A recent purchase of their tiramisu cannoli tasted a bit sour. We have tried Cosmis multiple times, usually as a matter of convenience and have never been blown away. The service is cordial at best. There are much better bakeries in South Philly.

place_category: Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Food, Restaurants, Donuts
text: Great live music band, but the food is terrible. We ordered po boy sandwich, and a croissant deli meat sandwich. All sandwiches come with the meat, but no sauce, no nothing extra that would enhance the flavors. Food was very bland. To enjoy the live music and get a table, you must order food, so order wisely.

place_category: Internet Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Food, Restaurants
text: Fantastic coffee most of the time - depends on the barista. Cozy atmospere - very much a neighborhood hotspot. Frequently busy, get there early for a seat. Only downside - need new furniture in the "lounge" area. Literally falling apart and unusable in the back section. Place on Mt. Rose could use a scrub down for sure - seems like they are letting it go a bit.

place_category: Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Relocating changed up alot of the things about the restaurant. But it should not change the taste and turnout of the food. Very very very disappointed in the presentation and taste of what was suppose to be gumbo.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Sandwiches, Seafood, Restaurants
text: I was here a few weeks ago and I am going to start with the good. The service was friendly and the seafood was delicious. The bread and salad wasn't that great. The tap water is disgusting. The other members in our party wasn't impressed with the bread either and some didn't like the food as much either.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Coffee & Tea
text: Cool Euro atmosphere. Great frozen yogurt. I would not call it a coffee shop, nor does it have a cozy atmisphere for getting work or studying done. Nevertheless, coffee drinks are decently done and good for to go orders.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Subpar sushi small rolls. We got 4 rolls, but I don't think they were right. Miso soup and salad were disappointments as well.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Amazing food. Excellent service. Being at to see the owner day is amazing. A must try for new comers to Reno 5 stars hands down. Best bloody Mary's in midtown.

place_category: Bars, Burgers, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Irish
text: Terrible service. When the bar was pretty empty but we still weren't seen for a min of 30 mins. I said excuse me to the bartender and asked for checks. She yelled at me and said I'm not your waitress. I responded with well we haven't seen one in a long time.

place_category: Gastropubs, Cajun/Creole, Southern, Burgers, American (New), Restaurants
text: Popped into this little hipster, live music gastropub while visit Tucson. They have a limited menu after 10pm, so we had only a few things to choose from. The frog legs looked interesting, but they were all out of those. So we got crawfish hush puppies instead. There were just ok. Kind of on the dry side. We got burgers and those were really tasty!! Our server was the only one working and it was busy so it took quite some time to get our drinks, food and bill.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: Great atmosphere, great food and great service! Everything I like when stepping out for a bite!

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Pubs, Bars, Restaurants
text: At Henry's pub in carmel with my fav daughter. Always enjoy the peanut butter burger. However something has changed. The burger size is much smaller! About a 60 /40 ratio to the bun! If you're going to shrink the burger it would be best find an appropriate size bun to match! Guess the bright side is after trimming away the excess bun I induced less carbs.

place_category: Barbeque, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: We had our daughter in laws birthday tonight. And the food wasn't great. We were very disappointed. But my husband talked with the owner and he was very willing to listen and he was very apologetic.

place_category: Canadian (New), Cocktail Bars, Bars, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife
text: Love that you can get wine by the ounce, and the share plates are great. Staff were very kind and attentive, but didn't know much about the menu.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Food, Salad, Seafood
text: This is my favorite restaurant in New Orleans everything is wonderful from the charbroiled oysters to the fish tacos to the seafood pasta. Everything is amazing.

place_category: Pizza, Food, Arts & Entertainment, Southern, Nightlife, Music Venues, Event Planning & Services, Musicians, Jazz & Blues, Restaurants, Soul Food
text: Great pizza, and even better music. Came here on a Saturday night during a bachelor trip to Nashville, I would return every trip through the area. Saturday night was a blast here.

place_category: Greek, Fast Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Mediterranean, Salad
text: An someone who works around the corner, I've been coming here for years. They started out with five stars, but after their recent expansion service has suffered. While the food is still great and the dine in experience hasn't changed, their delivery service has gotten very slack. So, word to the wise, make sure to clarify your order if you're getting delivery service, or you might be missing an essential element to your meal.

place_category: Food Stands, Tacos, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Phenomenal food! Great fresh flavor and large portions! We ordered the Birria quesadilla, carnitas tacos, tacos de lengua, carne asada, fried plantains, and churros. This is my new favorite spot now!

place_category: Spanish, Cafes, Cuban, Latin American, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: I love this place! My very favorite Cuban sandwich in all of Tampa Bay, plus the sweet plantains are always delicious. The fresh sodas are super refreshing, too. I highly recommend this spot!

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries
text: Worst airport food ever! Stay away from that place. The egg sandwich is containing a highly chemical egg patty that will cause you to be sick! 7.99 for a piece of chemical egg patty. One slice chemical cheese and a chemical bagel. Yuck!

place_category: Specialty Food, Meat Shops, Food
text: Yikes! Do they think they're in The Hamptons or Beverly Hills!? The prices are outrageously high and all the meat is FROZEN! I spent 15 minutes looking over everything. The more I looked, the more I lost my appetite. Go see for yourself. If you want to pay triple the price of Publix FRESH meat, knock yourself out! Bob F

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: food was good however they need some staffing help. Only one server during lunch. Barely able to sneak in lunch in time.

place_category: Pakistani, Indian, Restaurants, Food, Food Delivery Services, Vegetarian
text: Acceptable. Good ingredients, nice presentation, reasonable prices and nice dining room for BYOB nights. The servers seem to mess up my order half the time, I mean they actually bring me the wrong dish. The cooks never make my food spicy enough. Nice for a first date or hanging out with a friend who wants to go out somewhere. If you've got the option to stay at home, get your takeout from Sahara. It's only two blocks up Girard.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Food, Cajun/Creole, Specialty Food, Comfort Food, Restaurants
text: My colleague brought me here for lunch while we were visiting New Orleans. I loved the food. The mumbo gumbo was fantastic. For a "hole in the wall" place, it was clean and well-maintained. The prices are very reasonable and the portion sizes are huge.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Mexican, Latin American
text: This restaurant was incredible.... I almost have no more words but that. Except - MAKE A RESERVATION! The owner took pity on us and got us in, but we were fortunate. There were 5 of us at a table for 4! But it was perfect. There chefs surprise plate was the most Amazing dish I've ever had, seriously! I couldn't even have dessert which I bet I missed out on some deliciousness! Check this place out! And have the Chefs Surprise Plate! You won't be sorry!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (Traditional), Bars, Pubs, Nightlife
text: Not impressed. I read the menu online before I went and was super excited about all the offerings, but wasn't impressed by the food. I looked for the nutritional info before we went so I could calorie check, but it's not available. I emailed them, and 2 days after I already ate there, they emailed me asking what dish I would like the info for. I just have nothing nice to say, so ill end my review now.

place_name: Arugula Ristorante at Cold Point Village
place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services
text: This place is fabulous. It has a lovely indoor dinning room with an adjacent outdoor patio for both indoor and outdoor dinning options. It's a little on the fancier side but not too fancy. The food is excellent both in options and taste. Everyone is friendly and attentive (without being annoying). The prices are really reasonable and its BYOB. Looking forward to future trips.

place_category: Waffles, Creperies, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: There was a really huge cockroach on the floor, it was taken care of right away. Food was amazing as well as the service (middle aged Hispanic women was really nice). Would recommend.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Cheesesteaks, Food Trucks, Burgers
text: Ordered pick up a few days ago. While the toppings sounded interesting, the burgers themselves were pretty flavorless. I had the spot burger and it was falling apart from all of the wet components, which just made for a messy, tasteless, soggy burger. However, I don't want to write them off just yet since pickups usually aren't the best versions anyways. Willing to try again

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants, Diners, Bakeries
text: I made the mistake of coming into the Restaurant 30 minutes before they closed...cup of soup, tasted great, however ice cold. I asked for something not on the menu, grilled ham & cheese and they complied. Thin slice of ham and thin slice of cheese. Bread was good, water was good,service was very good.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: **REAL REVIEW** Seriously underwhelming. Trendy and okay drinks but served by waaaay subpar servers. We went here for a pre-wedding dinner and they actually forgot the groom's entree. Spoke to the "owner" whom let us know that she didn't see anything really wrong and wouldn't do anything to account for this oversight. Amazing. Honestly, this place is not worth it. Staff is kind of arrogant and the food and drinks are not worth it. Waste your time and money and see for yourself.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Pizza
text: Just moved to area and have found our new fave pizza place! Everything tastes great! Crust is perfect - not too thick, not too thin. They will add toppings and customize as requested. Only complaint - the delivery time!! Called 10 minutes after they opened, and it was a 75 minute delivery time. Wow!!

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Donuts
text: I have never been to a slower drive thru in my entire life. If I didn't have my kids in the car I would have gone in but I used the drive thru and sat for no lie 30 minutes for my order. Absolutely ridiculous. I would have loved to just pull out of line but there was no way to get out once I was in!

place_category: American (New), Food, Restaurants
text: Went by today, looked like they were shut down. Sign on the door from the city shows practicing without a valid license.

place_category: Delis, Bagels, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches
text: The service was very fast. On a Sunday morning that can sometimes be a lot to ask for! The bagel was good but the toppings on the bagel not so much. My BLT bagel was piled high with mayo, and the lettuce on it seemed soggy. Not sure if I would try this one again!

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Comfort Food, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Canadian (New)
text: It's been a while. They still have the best clam chowder, but they got rid of some mainstays like the blackened cheddar chicken sandwich. My Caesar salad was soggy with dressing and one of our soup bowls was only half full. Our server was pleasant. No automatic tipping here yet. Just in Calgary I guess.

place_category: Japanese, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Ramen, Restaurants
text: Amazing food and the venue is super modern and the service is great. This restaurant looks like Chicago or NYC restaurants i love it.

place_category: Noodles, Restaurants, Thai, Salad
text: Excellent authentic Thai food out in the suburbs! My favorites are the pad Thai and drunken noodles. I like how they give us the chili flakes and fish sauce on the side. I order here regularly

place_category: Restaurants, French
text: I was with friends and had a good time but as far as the food in concerned, it was a disappointment. Nothing stuck out overwhelmingly positively. My chicken dish was buttery, undercooked, and bland, even for southern French. Service was average, and we were the only ones there on a Wednesday night! Blah. Underwhelming. Avoid. I might return for their happy hour. The decor is cool and casual, with an open space in the bar area. Beware of the jacked up prices though.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: We have eaten here a bunch of times. Nice quick local place to go. Atmosphere is average. It is located in a strip center. This time I had the pork chop. It was ok, A bit fatty. We went with friends that wanted to go here. Not our first choice for Italian.

place_category: Chicken Shop, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Soul Food, American (New), Cajun/Creole
text: Our first time here and the lady who took our order was awful she was rude and unhelpful. However the food was absolutely delicious.I suggest the food!

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Cajun/Creole, Seafood
text: Let me just say if your a garlic lover. Get the garlic fries. Fried green tomatoes and any burger of your choice oh and onion rings. Jesus, Lord, Savior, Holy Spirit, God. You know what you did to give them there gifts in cooking and combination of food. Also 7 different types of hot sauces. You will not be disappointed!!!!! Going when I go back and a few other places as well

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants
text: Mmmm.... HASHBROWNS... (what else can I say?) The food here was really good, it's a tasty breakfast / lunch place. I was impressed with this little cafe, had pancakes that were so buttery and light, but those hashbrowns are killer (garlicy or something). We also ordered a spinach omlette that was really good.

place_category: Jazz & Blues, Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Wine Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: We returned to this lovely establishment because we enjoyed our first visit so much. However, we showed up at 4:45 PM only to greet a very grumpy bartender who advised four people, two which were traveling from abroad, that he could not serve us until 5 PM. We could understand if we were ordering food, however, the four of us simply wanted cocktails.he was behind the bar doing absolutely nothing! very disappointing! I was embarrassed to say that New Orleans was my home.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Doesn't look like much, smells bad inside. Chicken was chewy, asked for spicy General tso, was told it away no problem but food was not spicy. Rice was ok, crab ragoon was salty and noT crabby in the least. Won't return can't see me being this desperate for chinese take out again.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: terrible service. no ac. poorly made sushi. super thin slices of meat. over priced and no hot drops! my only hi light was people watching everyone on state street.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: This place is overrated. The food is good. The location is great. A bit pricey but once again look at its location. French cuisine always means small portions. Have deep pockets.

place_category: Restaurants, Lounges, Bars, Mexican, Nightlife, Tex-Mex, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Comfy seating. Delicious tortillas. Guacamole could have used a little more seasoning. Ordered the Chalupas, they were sweeter than expected. Did not expect the pineapple. Good staff. Good music. Was offered a mango flan which is sacrilegious but otherwise good lunch.

place_category: Convenience Stores, Gas Stations, Automotive, Food
text: One heck of a scam on everyone, they refuse to give back small change, I guess you know where that money goes, this place is too lazy to fix the lock on the female restroom. Just pay more money and get better help.

place_name: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers and Brews
place_category: Burgers, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Went here for dinner before a movie I was OK with what I ordered which was an appetizer zucchini sicks and fried clams, my husband ordered a veggie Burger and loved it but over all it's an OK place lots over all I would come back and give it another try my husband loves the endless fries he loves French fries.

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Ethnic Food, Mexican, Restaurants

place_category: Greek, American (Traditional), Restaurants

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: The salsa and friendly bartenders are what keeps us going back! The food is very good, but the service is incredible.

place_category: Food, Pretzels, Bakeries, Hot Dogs, Restaurants
text: Bought the new mini cheesesteak bites, and they were raw inside. Actually stretchy, raw, not fully cooked, pretzel dough. I threw them out because I didn't feel like risking food poisoning. Not really planning on going back anytime soon.

place_category: Bakeries, Donuts, Food, Delis, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea
text: The best! They made our wedding cake with flowers around the cake. Always fabulous donuts and pastries!!

place_name: Legal Sea Foods - King of Prussia
place_category: Gluten-Free, Seafood, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Very well appointed classy/quiet dining room with great chairs. Steamer clams bucket, fried fisherman platter, and classic clam chowder were all rock star. The fish they used on the platter was haddock - such a first class move. Service was super friendly and my diet coke was always filled.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, New Mexican Cuisine, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Was expecting to come and have some Latin flare but I got here and the menu has changed to New Orleans cuisine. Wtf? They just changed the menu the Monday before Jazz Fest. Well since I am here I may as well try some food!!! It's tasty!! I had a few of their starters which were all very good. Entrees are a little pricey.

place_category: Sandwiches, Desserts, Salad, Restaurants, Food, Delis
text: My office orders Uber Eats from this place every so often. There is about 8 of us. They label our packages & give each of us our own individual bag. Our orders are never missing items. Cudos to you McAllisters Deli employees. Always on point! Lunch today was delish

place_category: Seafood, Venues & Event Spaces, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Bars, American (New)
text: Love the lobster :D great view and good vibes. New favorite spot in Santa Barbara ! Ask for the roof top view

place_category: Food, Grocery, Fruits & Veggies, Meat Shops, Specialty Food, Seafood Markets, Ethnic Food
text: Grocery store, fruit stand, sandwhich shop and gift shop????? - YES please! All in this huge shopping store. Place was clean, employees were friendly and if you like Viet food, there's a banh mi shop toward the side if the grocery store. Prices were very reasonable with banh cuon (a tray was only $9.99). Banh mi ranges from $3 to $3.50.....buy 10 get one free. Love that they had Viet dessert.....I was in heaven.....

place_category: Greek, Fast Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Mediterranean, Salad
text: Ordered today. Order was at least not late but again the order was wrong. Plain cheesesteak with nothing on it came loaded with nearly every possible topping plus mayo. Coke delivered instead of Pepsi. Moving, so I wasn't going back here anyway, but seriously Greek Lady you are throwing money away by giving out unordered toppings.

place_category: Bagels, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food
text: I love breuggers but recently when I went I got the smoked salmon bagel & as I was eating it there was a huge fish bone in it. It was really gross, I had to throw the whole bagel away bc I was so disgusted

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Brazilian, American (New), French, Asian Fusion
text: Meh, if you want French food go to fork in old city. The food here is extremely over priced. the food was not anything special. 400 for the Valentine's Day menu and one drink wasn't worth it. On a positive note the waiter was great... but like so many places they rely ambiance to warrant its high prices.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, Food
text: Great food, great people, great experience! I had an overall great experience at this sonic. Very up to date, clean, and a very friendly cast. I will definitely will return! I only wish there were more Sonics in the Trinity area. I used to visit the location on little rd in the publix parking lot frequently back in the day and it stinks that location has closed. THIS! Is how YOU Sonic!!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Sushi Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Japanese, Bars
text: You cannot beat the atmosphere if you eat outside! Its in a great location! I saw that there is 1/2 price sushi on Sundays so we might go back to try the sushi. We shared several dishes and will not go back based on those. but perhaps the sushi is where its at so we will give it one more try. :)

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Bakeries, Food Stands
text: You go here to satisfy your cravings for beignets as you leaving New Orleans. This is not anywhere close to Cafe Du Monde, but gets the job done with sugared up fried dough. Only eat here on your way of the city. If you arriving just wait till getting to Cafe Du Monde. I didn't even bother with the coffee here.

place_category: German, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Nightlife, Bars, Beer Gardens
text: Eher durchschnitlich. Schnitzel wurde nicht geklopft. Geschmack ok. Sauce sehr dunkel aber frische Pilzen. Rotkohl wahrscheinlich Dosenware. Spaetzle komische Orangenfarbe (Karotten drin?) und Salz gefehlt. Frischgezapfte Weihenstephaner war lecker.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Hot Dogs, Burgers, Seafood, American (Traditional)
text: Tried this place on a busy day, so maybe a slower time is better. Waited 48 minutes for food and it was just friend shrimp and fries. Overpriced and isn't a place that I would recommend to other tourists in the area.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: This is more like college eat-out where you just chill, chat up over some food and get a little tipsy. Philly cheese steak is alright but their Spanish fries IS THE BOMB. Just get some food, tonna fries and get drunk on their margaritas. Will go back just for their Spanish fries!

place_category: Food, American (New), Restaurants, Breweries, Nightlife
text: Excellent food, great service. Pretty busy on weekend nights. Make a reservation.

place_category: Mediterranean, Italian, Turkish, Restaurants
text: The service is fine, the food is okay. I don't understand the raves about the food. Chicken tortellini was fine (3/5) and lobster ravioli was not good (fishy.) The sauce for both pastas was overly thick. We will not be returning.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, Hotels, Resorts
text: I don't know if it is my skin color that doesn't get me service or the fact that I'm in my twenty's but everytime i come here it's at least 30 min before I'm greeted and my waitress /waiter always seems like she/he doesn't want to wait on me , i work hard and deserve good service when i come out

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Not worth the money! Grilled veggies were gross and the sandwhich I ordered cut the roof of my mouth. And how do they get off charging $7 for a small glass of wine. Not going back. They must give paid to be featured on DDD.

place_category: Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Greek, Restaurants
text: This food is absolutely fantastic. The quality for the price is unbelievable and the service is out of this world. I cannot emphasize how friendly the employees are. We got the saganaki, I go the gyro plate and my wife got the lamb/chicken schawarma we loved every bit of it. Saganaki is like a pan fried cheese. I highly recommend it and the sugar cane juice.

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Overpriced, mediocre food. Another fail from the El Charro family. I really tried to like this place. I have been here few times and have tried different things from the menu and nothing is really good. Everything I have had from apps to tacos have just been meh...barely. Nothing to make me want to revisit. Sorry gotta pass on the the "taco garage". Won't be back.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood, Gluten-Free
text: What a disappointment! Staff was OK But, food, crab awful. After talking to manager, crab comes from Sysco, And not fresh. No effort was made to correct, and handed , a $74.00 bill., for very bad crab, from a place called Joe's Crab Shack. Catching crabs the old fashioned way is better then this place, and there is an ointment that will help.

place_category: Food, Herbs & Spices, Event Planning & Services, Specialty Food, Caterers
text: Clint and his team did a fantastic job! They catered 3 meals in 24 hours during our wedding weekend and worked their tails off. the food was fantastic and the service was great. Clint was very good and very patient in helping us plan, especially since this was our first time planning meals for so many people. I cannot imagine better food at such a reasonable price. I hope I get to have another event in the area so I can hire Clint and his team at Great Thyme again!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Great place to take the five/six year old...don't expect to love the food. (Was great when it opened, but has gone down in quality.)

place_category: Food, Breweries
text: Decent, intimate atmosphere. I got a flight, and wasn't disappointed in any of the selections at all. The only odd thing is that my growler fill up was $20.00. I've never run into such a price on a 64oz growler fill. Overall decent experience, just not sure of the benefits of having a growler. Bummer!

place_category: Chicken Wings, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Food always tastes amazing but if your placing a to-go order, make sure to monitor it like a hawk. They always get something wrong. Wrong item, for get the ranch, etc Besides that, we love BWW's!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Waited 10 minutes even though tables were available - front desk person not very welcoming . We were 2 and she explain that the table (for 4) was for a bigger parties. We hesitate to drive all the way to Germán town because of the poor service related reviews - The reviews were right. We left and found CAKE - what an amazing place!

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Mexican, Hot Dogs, Breakfast & Brunch, Steakhouses

place_category: Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Food
text: Great easy going place. No frills. Friendly sraff. Plenty of beer choices and staff is knowledgeable. Music is a good mix. Patrons are very friendly too, gotta love Nashville. Place is laid back great vibe and good price value for beers. I be back any chance I get.

place_category: Buffets, Noodles, Restaurants, Chinese
text: Despite the piece of porcelain in my spring roll, and the eggshell in my friends fried rice, this place is pretty ok. The waitress was friendly and the food average. Have eaten there before and will again because it's near the theatre. Deserving of 3 stars.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Fast Food
text: After waiting for over an hour my luke warm food had a special treat. I'm starving and my dinner is now in the trash. I would call but they're closed. Would be nice to have a refund.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Delis, Burgers, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Local Flavor
text: Was in Philly for work so thought I'd try my first cheesesteak. All 4 of us that are there now have severe food poisoning. Be careful

place_category: Grocery, Restaurants, Seafood, Food, Convenience Stores
text: Gumbo rocks. Do not be intimidated, just plow on in and get some of the best gumbo I've ever had. The only drawback is that it's all to go, there's no place to sit and eat, but I don't let minor issues like that deter me from having great food.

place_category: Vegetarian, Vietnamese, Restaurants, Noodles
text: Haven't experienced Pho since the old San Diego days. Wow, this place really worked for me in Tucson! Our waiter's name was "Tony". Something tells me that's not what they called him in Vietnam, but who cares? He was efficient, friendly, on top of things, etc. The food was wonderful. I am full, fat and happy! Yeah, buddy!

place_category: Food, Japanese, Sushi Bars, Do-It-Yourself Food, Restaurants
text: Fast, clean, delicious and easy to make good healthy choices. The new location is great! 134 E Canon Perdido St

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Vegetarian, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: We went there this morning after not having gone for a while, and it was just subpar. The pancakes are way smaller than they used to be, don't know if that's where they're going to cut costs that. The server we had seemed less than happy to be there, which is abnormal for this place. Maybe it was just a bad day there for everyone, I sure hope so!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Visited for dinner on a Friday night, it's nothing fancy but we had a great experience. Loved the salsa, food was very good as well.

place_category: Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Bars
text: Food is horrible but if your only going to haves drinks on the river its good. They totally need to change up there menu.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Jazz & Blues, Fast Food, American (Traditional)

place_category: Bars, Pool Halls, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Tapas Bars
text: I wasn't too big of a fan this time going to Lure. They had five dollar sushi rolls but there was very little fish in them. The atmosphere was really nice-I love that they have outside seating. Their drink tiki prices are a great deal for happy hour-instead of twelve dollars it is six. I got the painkiller and it was very tasty. The service was quite slow but friendly. Overall about 3.5/5 stars because the drink was so good!!

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants, Seafood
text: The food here is ok, but I've literally never recieved good service in my four visits. Taco Tuesday is pretty good, eat about four tacos and you'll get your money worth. The burritos are ok, they tend to be a bit light on the meat and heavy on the beans. The food is basically mediocre, and the service terrible. I'm pretty sure the location is what is keeping this place in the green.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Contrary to the other reviews, this restaurant was excellent. It's very small but very quaint. The service was amazing, though it wasn't very crowded so they could pay attention to us. The food was amazing. The grilled calamari and mussels were well done with great flavors. Find a good bottle of wine, this place is definitely worth a visit.

place_category: Restaurants, Waffles, Food, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Make sure you have all day if you come here. It's definitely not a fast process at Twisted Waffles. The Waffle Bowl was decent, I got it with bacon and the bacon was slightly undercooked for my liking but still edible. I'm sure there is much better in the area.

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: Good, not great food. Everything is an added cost. Want cheese on your burger? Add a buck! Fries instead of potato chips? Add $3.49. I got burger, fries, soda, and a cup of chili for $19.75. Ouch! For watching a game not a bad seat
