text: Sorry to rain on the parade, but I just don't get the hoopla about Superica. Sure, it's quaint, but there is better Mexican food in SB.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, French, Specialty Food, Seafood, Diners, Cajun/Creole, Seafood Markets, Event Planning & Services, Southern, Caterers, Salad
text: Ate at the bar, had crawfish platter. Hush puppy things were liquid in the middle. Fried tails were ok. Cheese dish wasn't very good. Beers were good. Won't be back.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Whiskey Bars, Burgers, Restaurants, American (New)
text: if you're trying to lose weight, don't eat here. the burger is great. the fries are awesome.

place_category: Vegetarian, Gluten-Free, Pizza, Caterers, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services
text: Where the pizza tasted great, the delivery was an epic fail. We all joked and called this the "folded" pizza. When it arrived we took the pizzas to the table, opened up the boxes and every single one was pretty much destroyed. I'm not sure if the delivery driver hit the gas Mach speed or just didn't understand the concept of gravity. The photos speak for themselves. We will order again as one last try but lord help us if the same driver has our order. Half the pizza was just destroyed.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bagels, Salad, Soup, Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Got to watch them make my toasted sandwich and clear out my entire order. Waited 20 minutes for them to ask me what I was waiting on. They didn't ask if I wanted my sandwich reheated or make me a new one that wasn't ice cold. Very cool.

place_category: Restaurants, Lounges, Bars, Mexican, Nightlife, Tex-Mex, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Do yourself a favor & stop in to this easily missed spot. Solid Mexican food menu with a great selection of tequila and mezcal. Outstanding for brunch. Looking forward to dinner here.

place_category: Food, Cajun/Creole, Seafood Markets, Seafood, Specialty Food, Restaurants, French
text: I rarely give bad reviews for restaurants but this one is truly bad. I came here out of high expecation for tasting some good original cajun food bit was totally disappointed. The food is not fresh, they use de-frozen crawfish, it tastes like crap. The shrimp is not fresh either. All the food are cold. And the casher os very indifferent. This is truly one of my worst dinning experience. DO NOT COME HERE！

place_category: Wine Bars, Desserts, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Italian, Food, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza
text: WHOOPS! Good food, but, other than pizza, served a la carte. I would have enjoyed the experience more if the food was cooked to order. Service was very quick. In fact, too quick, which took a lot of romance out of an otherwise enjoyable date night. Ava might be a better lunch place instead of a dinner night out place. I understand they also do lunch.

place_category: Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Southern, Desserts, Cafes, American (New)
text: I wasn't super enthused with this place. The chicken sandwich made me get super ill and the cookie was one of the worst I've ever tasted- however the corn bread was awesome and the service and ambience were great. Would probably be better for breakfast than dinner.

place_category: Bars, Burgers, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Irish
text: Went here before going to a show next door at the Forrest Theatre. Definitely recommend reservations if you are dining before a show time as it gets quite busy. Pretty good beer selection. Mostly pub food, not much by way of stuff for a vegetarian. Wouldn't go out of my way to eat here again, but wouldn't avoid it. It is what it is, a pub.

place_category: Greek, Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Mediterranean
text: I'm really into this place. They have a handful of things without meat, which is great. They even have fried pickles as an appetizer, which comes with tzatziki, yum! Good place to take parents or friends. Will be back.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: Stopped in late night and we were able to still order the full menu. We ordered burgers and they were fantastic and arrived very quickly. Unfortunately for such a cool little place the bartenders are very inattentive and just kinda slow and careless. I'll definitely go back again for another burger. Best I've found on the beach.

place_category: Food, Breweries
text: This is a great place to go if you'd just like a great beer. All the beer here is draft. They do not serve beer from bottles or cans. You can get your growler filled here. (Please clean your growler before you bring it in.)

place_category: Mexican, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Tex-Mex, Restaurants
text: I enjoyed the empanadas. They were hot and crispy. The guacamole was good. My son ordered pollo Cancun. It had Chicken and shrimp and he really liked it. My daughter and I shared the steak fajitas. The meat was pretty sparse and did not have much taste. The rice was cold. The beans were good. The atmosphere is very nice. And the restaurant is so clean. Dogs welcome on the patio!! Brooke was a very good server.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: It was okay. I had Kobe beef app. It's not that good for the price. The blue fin tuna sushi was good. I had two pieces of that. I also got the Russian dream roll. I actually didn't like that. However the sushi chef made me a roll on the house which I was though was nice but it had eel on top and I don't really like eel. I probably wouldn't go back to this spot. There are a bunch of other sushi places to try.

place_category: Desserts, Japanese, Restaurants, Waffles, Food, Sushi Bars
text: I ordered chop chop burrito and tuna sashimi. Burrito was kinda small and they charged same price as poke bowl which is not very well priced. Sashimi was not fresh. I guess there isn't any cheap sashimi in Alberta. The pickled ginger was literally smell like dirty wash cloth. I almost throw up my meal. Not returning.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers, Food, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Bars, Restaurants
text: While visiting St. Louis we asked hotel staff about restaurant recommendations. Baileys' was a top recommendation. Upon arriving the atmosphere was open and friendly. I ordered Dave's chop house burger; comes with their bacon jam. Overall the burger had great flavors but was disappointed when my what should have been medium well burger, was cold and raw in the middle. The fries were very good which made up for the raw burger. Crispy and well seasoned, with their beer cheese sauce on the side.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Easily one of the best pizzas in STL. The pepperonis are delicious (Where do they get these? These are no typical 'ronis!). Cheese was ample and tasty. Crust had lots of flavor and the right thickness to be called NY style (though not as chewy as NY style). I have been craving it since I've had it. If I lived closer to Tower Grove I'd easily be there multiple times a week. Do yourself a favor and GO. NOW.

place_category: Caribbean, Restaurants
text: I tried Christa-Bell's for the first time today and it was a bit of a let down. All I ordered was rice & pea, cabbage and plantains which totaled $7. Not bad price wise. The rice & pea is standard but the cabbage...bland. No flavor or smell. I was concerned when I opened the bag and I didn't really smell anything. Maybe today was an off day or maybe the cook/owner will see this and make a change.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Food Trucks, Fish & Chips, Sushi Bars, Food, Seafood
text: If you set your standards at 2 stars, then it's a 5 star establishment. Food was mediocre at best. Service was lacking. Our table was dirty. The area is sketchy.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Internet Cafes, Food, Coffee Roasteries, Bakeries
text: I visited The Well for the first time today and was very pleased with my choice! It is a cozy little cafe and they had many fun special holiday drinks. I chose the orange and chocolate drink, very reminiscent of those fun breakable chocolate oranges you'd get as a kid. The latte was beautiful as well and the staff were kind. I'll def be back!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Chicken Shop, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: I just want to say here that anyone rating this place below BK or MacDo has to be nuts from both a health & quality standpoint. C'mon get real !!! This is good quality fast food.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: So I know it's called "sushi" shop, but I've never had their sushi. This place is a fast food restaurant, so I wouldn't expect the sushi to be any good. What I do come here for is the Chicken Mango bowl with brown rice. It's under $12 and I feel the portion is great, and they are not skimpy on the chicken. It's delicious and healthy-ish for having to eat out. I have tried the popcorn shrimp, but it is incredibly bland. So basically - 3 stars for the chicken mango bowl.

place_category: Diners, Restaurants, Food, Cafes, American (Traditional), Soup, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts
text: Even for a holiday weekend there was no long wait or rush to finish your meal. Super good corn beef and hash breakfast but the meal was way too big. Next time will order but split it with my mate. Coffee is strong and hot. Joy. Waiter Anthony was wonderful. Real attentive.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Food, Grocery, Pubs, Nightlife, Bars, Salad
text: I love their pizza...but so grossed out after seeing this in the women's restroom today. Yuck. Isn't this a health code violation or something?!?!! Why are they not cleaning their restrooms and toilets?!?!!

place_category: Bars, Food, Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Diners, Bakeries
text: This is by far the best "Diner" you will ever find. A mainstay in town for years, we've since moved to Delaware, but we return every chance we can. The food is amazing and they also have a better bakery than you'll find anywhere. I only get my cakes and cookies here. The servers are all professional and the owners are always on site. You can't have a bad meal here!!

place_category: Grocery, Food, Specialty Food
text: Joe makes the most awseome breakfast sandwiches around! The pork roll is the best I've had anywhere - sliced perfectly thin. The great eats are always accompanied by service with a smile. If you have never been there, get there tomorrow morning for a sandwich! Oh by the way, don't try to order something that isnt on the menu; it just doesn't work that way. :-)

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Japanese, Buffets
text: Wouldnt exactly come here for sushi only. Not a lot of fish but tons of rice. No sushi. Mainly rolls. All food is pretty sub par. Ok for lunch but wouldnt come here again

place_category: Bars, Caribbean, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: I went here on a wednesday for the 1/2 price daquiris- before then I thought a daquiri was a blended drink made with strawberries; turns out I was completely wrong. A daquiri is more like a margherita except with rum instead of tequila. I tried the passionfruit and the spiced honey daquiris (between 4 and 6 dollars with the discount) both were delicious. The food menu is limited, a bit pricey for the portion, but everything we tried was very good.

place_category: Japanese, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Ramen, Restaurants
text: Great noodles good vibes would recommend if you like noodles . Good music selection service was quick and food was amazing

place_category: American (New), Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: If I could break down my rating it would be five stars for food and service and one star for value. Prices are too high for what you receive. Took my friend and his two kids here and some how the bill came to $155 with tip. Yikes. Maybe we'll go back again, but bring money--lots of it.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Burgers, Sandwiches, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Decent burgers, sufficient milkshakes. Completely agree with the other posters: the service leaves something to be desired. The restaurant logistics were also poorly planned. After you order your food - you have to loop back towards the front door for fountain drinks. Pro tip: Get your order "to go" during peak hours, or just wait to go during non-peak hours. Limited parking spots (even for street parking) and limited seating.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Gluten-Free, Food, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: HUGE portions. More for the money than you'll get anywhere else in the area. Super friendly owner and employees. A1 customer service. Ice cream is good but not spectacular. Closer to restaurant ice cream than specialty shop ice cream.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Salad, Beer Bar, American (New), Restaurants
text: Quaint place with great ambience, food and service. I had the Shrimp Po Boy. It was delicious. The fries and cole slaw were perfect side dishes. This was my first visit. Definitely not my last.

place_category: Thai, Pop-Up Restaurants, Food Court, Restaurants
text: This eatery is location inside of a food hall market located by warehouse district. Me and my sister couldn't decide on a place to eat so we ended up here. There dishes are reasonably priced and fairly decent size . The curry chicken dish we ordered was definitely full of flavor and very hearty. Only thing was it lacked presentation, it would have been nicer with small pieces of chicken and if the rind was removed from the squash used in. Other than that it was delicious.

place_category: Automotive, Food, Convenience Stores, Fast Food, Gas Stations, Restaurants
text: Very friendly staff! Tried the brisket taco and was very bland and won't be purchasing again. Hot dogs are always good and coffee is cheap.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: This place is great! Footlong steak and cheese for $10. I got the provolone with onions. The need is really good quality, not too greasy. The sun roll is great too. We were able to find a seat upstairs and they had hot sauce and other condiments up there. On a Saturday at 2pm on the freezing cold the line took us 15 minutes to get through.

place_category: Wine Bars, Restaurants, Indian, Australian, Bars, American (New), Nightlife
text: Went in for the uni biryani which did not disappoint! Service was good and the atmosphere very ambient and relaxing.

place_category: Desserts, Bakeries, Event Planning & Services, Shopping, Gift Shops, Flowers & Gifts, Grocery, Food, Party Supplies
text: Very disappointed! The cookie bouquet was delivered with 4 of the 7 cookies broken. The delivery fee was $23. They would not refund delivery fee and would only provide me with a credit towards a future order - of which I will now not be placing! Had they provided a refund for at least the delivery fee, I would not be as upset BUT in my opinion that was very poor customer service . I do not recommend

place_name: Bertha Miranda's Mexican Food Restaurant and Cantina
place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Service was great. Just thought was a bit bland. I had ground beef enchiladas with green sauce. There was no heat fron sauce. Meat was just so bland. I may give it another shot since they were so nice.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: The renovation is very nice but the tables are packed in as tightly as they ever were. I have a bit of a history with this restaurant so what might be a four star to others is five stars to me. The service is always warm and efficient. The carne asada is as good as it ever was - meaning fantastic!!

place_category: Diners, Restaurants
text: Went for lunch once. It was just standard. Nothing special. Great location near SLU and all the theaters.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Fish & Chips, Nightlife, Seafood, Restaurants, Bars
text: Good food, very small space, crowded and very, very, loud.Tables jammed together. To beat some of the noise try to sit outside. Steep steps to get into the place but a good location at the wharf/marina. Prices are pretty average for Santa Barbara. I would give it 4 stars in the space was a bit more comfortable.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Local Flavor
text: This hidden gem in the Oro Valley area has delicious hamburgers (reason enough for my parents to go out when they're in town) and savory salmon. Don't miss the blueberry lemonade (adult drink) with a balanced flavor between sweet and tangy. The staff is prompt and friendly, although Every once in a while there has been one that rushes you to order. Desserts are worth trying, my favorite? Flourless chocolate cake. Why? If you like chocolate, just try it and you'll know.

place_name: Chef Johnny Bravo's Surf N Turf
place_category: Food Trucks, Street Vendors, Sandwiches, Seafood, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Food
text: The baja taco I had was not good at all.... They put the "taco" on a hard, stale, whole wheat wrap and barely put anything in it. I also ordered a side of coleslaw which was extremely watery and sweet. I will not waste my money here again.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: As one who comes from the land of coffee, the home of Starbucks, this is an ok place for coffee. We're here visiting on vacation and must have our coffee so Starbucks is a must stop.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Asian Fusion
text: Like others have mentioned on here the prices are too high for the portions. The food is very good but I was still hungry after my meal. The high ratings are for people who can afford it and buy a lot of food and/or do not know about good sushi. I will not go here again.

place_category: Kitchen & Bath, Shopping, Kitchen Supplies, Home & Garden, Food, Tableware, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: We loved this shop and we recently visited Davis Cookware only to find out that Mr Davis had passed away last December. We were saddened by the news and our condolences go out to his sons. The shop has changed from the quaint and unique taste of America past. Evidently the shop had been scooped up and is in a modernization process. Progress is sometimes painful. A year ago this would rate five stars.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Super salty and we waited for over an hour. The waiter was new and totally forgot about us. My girlfriend has been here before and the food was not as bad, maybe we were there on an off night. I'm just giving this review based on the horrible service, and the food that was so salty I couldn't finish any part of it.

place_category: Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Arcades, Music Venues, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Gastropubs, Bars
text: Came on a Friday for lunch with some friends, the place was very busy but a gentleman helped us to find a table quickly and he was very professional. Took our drinks order and send us a server within minutes. The food was great, we got a chicken wrap, salads and some tacos.

place_category: Salad, Cajun/Creole, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Seafood, Nightlife, Bars
text: I purchased the combo A boil . Seafood was tasty but the portion size didn't seem like i was getting what i was paying for . I even ordered 1/2 of mussels and received like 5 in my boil. A little disappointing . My husband also got the catfish combo . He ordered extra catfish and the extra pieces ended up being more than the original combo . He didn't like the taste to much , and the fish seemed a little raw . 80$ spent and wasn't to happy. Needless to say , probably won't be going back .

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole
text: Meh... Came in for a late lunch. Ordered a shrimp Po Boy sandwich and it was just ok. It was a little bland. I thought the gumbo was pretty good. Our server was nice. The place was busy so I guess they are doing something right. The locals seem to love it here! It was good for a quick lunch fix but I wouldn't go out of my way for Mandina's.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Worst service ever. News flash when you opened your restaurant you weren't the only one. There are like 2 more down the street. It doesn't pay to be an asshole. And hard working people such as myself will not spend their money at your business if you can't grasp the concept of customer service. These assholes need an etiquette class along with an English course.

place_category: Restaurants, Caterers, Italian, Hot Dogs, Pizza, Event Planning & Services, Sandwiches
text: My wife and I visited for the first time. We got our menus and waited for 10+ minutes and nobody ever came to take our drink order. Other people that came in after us were being helped. Really bad impression for our first visit.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Specialty Food, Indian, Ethnic Food
text: My first time visiting I enjoyed all of dishes. Had the butter chicken and a bison "bold" masala curry. Bison was chewy but the rest of the dish had a ton of flavour. Coconut curry and plain naan on the side. Items are offered a spice level 1-5. Love spicy food although a 5 was on the brink of my limit (no complaints! Loved the butter chicken so spicy!) Friendly service.

place_category: Mexican, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: I like this place a bunch. It's low budget, decent food and just half-block from work. I only go after 1:30/2p, too crowded otherwise. My favorites are the Macho Nachos (loaded w/jalapenos) and the Blazin' Buffalo Chicken burrito. Not a meal to bring a date, but definitely for an good, quick, inexpensive meal.

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Disappointing.. small portions and food took a long time to come out. My girlfriends steak was warm, not hot.. meaning it just sat there waiting to be brought to us. Served by multiple people, some were good others were awkward. The food was decent but nothing exciting. They were out of several things despite only being open for 30 minutes. I will definitely not be back....

place_category: Italian, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: This is obviously a very solid business. The management needs to freshen up the place. New paint and a deep cleaning would make this an more attractive venue.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: A great selection of flavors and toppings, sizeable portions, and a lovely staff. They also have a pickup window at the moment which is great!

place_category: Restaurants, Wine Bars, Italian, Food, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Breweries, Bars, Pizza
text: One of my favorite restaurants for take out. Excellent chicken parmesan! Generous portion and very tasty. Comes with side salad, pasta & bread sticks. If you're craving chicken parm, try this place!

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Noodles
text: Good food. First time here. Liked the Lava Tempura app, good amount of heat and a nice sweet dipping sauce to complement it. I also had Tom Yun with pork. Very good, mild spice (they ask when you order how hot you want it) with juicy pork, a few meatballs, lots of noodles and fresh baby bok choy. I'll be back to try more menu items.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Cafes
text: They are now a ghost town as the shopping center is being renovated. Parking is horrific, if the entrance is even open. Combined with my experiences here I've pretty much decided even though it's convenient and I like the drinks I'm not going back.

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Comfort Food, American (New), Sandwiches, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Excellent service and food was great! ( we tried the Duck Hash, what's up doc omlet, strawberry French toast, smores French toast, and relleno)

place_category: Nightlife, Salad, Bars, Restaurants, Caterers, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Event Planning & Services, Pizza, Italian
text: The food is good, it's New York style pizza. If you looking for something other than the usual delivery brand pizza its a good choice

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: My family and I LOVE this place! They make you feel welcomed every time, the owner Rick is such a wonderful person, his staff is amazing and the food is delicious. Highly recommend them!!

place_category: British, Restaurants, American (New)
text: I had a 50th, well, 51st, birthday party for my husband Dan at Yeoman's. They totally knocked it out of the park. Connie and Bondo were wonderful in helping us plan. The food was GREAT, and of course the beer was fabulous. It's our "Cheers" and we wouldn't have it any other way.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Thanks. Slipped a little over the years as it's become more popular- not so much in the quality but in the rush to move tables. Food still rocks.

place_category: American (New), Cocktail Bars, Bars, Wine Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: My husband and I have been here twice; most recently, we went for their New Years Eve prix fixe dinner. It's one of our favorite restaurants in Indianapolis and consider it one of the more sophisticated ones. We don't like going to pricey restaurants and being served mediocre food (like some other joints around town), but this place is legitimately delicious.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Mexican, Latin American
text: YUMMMMMMMMMM!!!!!!!!!! Don't expect traditional Mexican food at this place. It is delicious but expect to be surprised. The menu items that have sounded like least appetizing to me are usually the best ones. Also, word to the wise...choose the plate where the chef picks 3 creations. You will NOT be disappointed!

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Pubs, Dive Bars, Bars
text: I have eaten here several times and enjoy the flat burgers. The burgers are always fresh and hot. The wait staff is not the friendly type all business but very effective. The price is good for the quality of the sandwich. Will be back when I have a craving for a good burger.

place_category: Specialty Food, Cheese Shops, Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Sandwiches, Food, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Bars, Nightlife
text: Tasty cheese shop with a well-curated selection. The staff knows their cheeses. The samples really help us decide when trying out new cheeses. Another place that provides a great picnic for eating at the courthouse gardens. The prices are on the expensive side, but the cheeses speak (and taste) for themselves.

place_category: Sports Bars, Breweries, Food, Bars, American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: Decent food....not great but plenty of variety and excellent for large groups. I certainly recommend trying the "Rocky Mountain Potato" for dessert.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese
text: This is a nice sushi place, lots of dark-lit ambiance, etc. Spacious. Pretty good food, although a little pricey. I got the lobster ceviche, which was delicious, but which was very tiny for the price ($16, appetizer). The rolls I got were good and weren't too expensive. Had great sake. Not the best sushi on earth, but definitely worth the trip if you're looking for a hip, non-kitschy sushi joint where you can also throw back a few cocktails.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: I'm having only two things from the grab and go section: an avocado shake and tofu lettuce wraps. Avocado shake: A+! Wow. Really good. Really simple. Only three ingredients it seems. Delicious. And not too sweet. Just right. Tofu lettuce wraps: A. Very good. Nice interior. Good air conditioned. My only complaint is the millennial pop music. But I guess I can live with it BECAUSE THE FOOD IS SO FOOD!

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Pubs, Irish
text: My bartender was Fitsy and he was the best bartender ever! He was really friendly as was his counter part Sam. The two of them made me right at home like it was my corner bar back in Ireland. Love them both and I'll def be back!

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: We are very glad we found this little gem not far from the Walnut Street Theatre. The food was very good along with the service. It is a BYOB and cash only. Definitely worth it.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Seafood, American (New)
text: Bypassed the New Port Richey location because of poor reviews. Went to Spring Hill. Delightful server Kathy. She gave me a birthday card. Friendly, courteous, staff. Seated immediately, promptly took order, food came soon after. Food fair. Smaller portions which is good but so much butter masked the flavor. Can't wait to see my cholesterol results.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Whiskey Bars, Burgers, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Stopped in for a business lunch. The Village burger with added cheddar and smoked bacon was delicious. Make sure you get the duck fat fries, nice outdoor al fresco dining. Good for groups and couples.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: Delicious huge po' boys and kicking Hurricaines. Perfect lunch to start the party.

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: Came her with my wife for lunch. The outside patio area was recently remodeled and is nice. For the price, the food was disappointing. I ordered Thai Basil Leaf beef. The dish was subpar and tasted more Chinese than Thai. My wife ordered Pad See Yeow and it was the only good thing I tasted. The Fresh Spring Rolls were average.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Cocktail Bars
text: Whoa maybe I will try this at some point but not right now sitting is weird and uncomfortable music loud as hell who could ever hear anyone talk no food uninformed bartenders bottle works better get it together or we won't be back. No signs she can get into the bar very strange the whole set up

place_category: Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Southern, Restaurants
text: We were disappointed with our meal today! Cona was an excellent server but my entree was Dijon Chicken with mushroom. The chicken was undercooked and pink inside. My baked potato was shriveled and burnt with pieces of bacon so over cooked as to be inedible. My husband's baked potato was also charred and hard on the bottom. Normally we love this place.

place_category: Bagels, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries, Food
text: Their bagels are just okay, but they always forget to add bacon to a BEC. The wait takes forever. Not worth a long wait for them to not give you what you want. Wouldn't recommend this place.... plus all the flies they have inside don't know how they pass inspection

place_category: Tours, Local Flavor, Hotels & Travel, Arts & Entertainment, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Music Venues, Barbeque, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces
text: $6 cover charge for this place on a Monday night. Really now? Every other bar is free! This location is definitely huge and great for live performances, but when there is no one inside, you can't ask for a cover. If you like line dancing, then this is the place you should go to b/c of the big dance floor. Southerners apparently like their line dancing. We city folk don't get it.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Unfortunately, this was my least favorite restaurant during our visit to NOLA. There was nothing special about the gumbo and was lukewarm when served to us. Glad I was able to try it but don't think I'd be coming back.
