text: Meh. Everything is pretty average. Nothing has very much flavor. Below average service. Not someplace I intend to return to.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Soul Food, Fast Food, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional)
text: Hey it was great! I was walking by at 2 am and the smell of fried chicken got me and I gave it a try. It was piping hot and very juicy. Not overly breaded at all and had great flavors without being greasy. Only downside it was packed at 2 am and you have to share tables

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole
text: Good place, but not as great as everyone says. I appreciate the unlimited side items. You can find a better po boy at B's Po Boys.

place_category: Mexican, Latin American, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I'm a microbiologist and not even a microscope could I find the cheese on my nachos. A cardinal sin. Otherwise good was good quality and bounteous.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), Arts & Entertainment, Event Planning & Services, Southern, Venues & Event Spaces
text: Good location for people on vacation looking for entertainment with a meal. Non-stop live music. I only had a burger that was just ok so I can't speak for the rest of the food on the menu. Not a good place for conversation as the music was constant and very loud. The service was very good.

place_category: Barbeque, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Southern, Breakfast & Brunch, Comfort Food, Nightlife, Music Venues, Restaurants, Food, Grocery
text: Been looking forward to this one for a while but left sort of disappointed in the experience. They were out of my first two choices and it was only 6PM so not that late. The Nashville hot chicken was really bland and unimpressive. Was saving room for a dessert only to find out both the brownie and the chocolate cobbler were gone. Server was friendly but won't be back.

place_category: Soul Food, Restaurants
text: Will be a frequent customer here. Owner seems lovely, and always looking to support local businesses, so was very happy that the meal was worth raving about. The food was excellent and incredible portions. Mac and cheese, boneless fried chicken breasts and yams. Perfection. Felt that the cornbread was just a bit dry and not as flavorful as I was expecting, but would probably still eat it again too :) Absolutely check this spot out!

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Sandwiches, Salad, Seafood
text: Been coming here for years Every trip to Clearwater This visit was disappointing Every request was met with Sir we can't do that We are too busy When I expressed disappointment the attitude was too bad

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Caribbean, Latin American, Bars
text: A little overpriced. Seems like a good bar atmosphere. Food was consistent and salsa was fresh. Mango(or similar) salsa was too fruity. Portions were too small. Chips were creative...meaning they offered a few varieties. Location is great...in the middle of the new cookie cutter town center. Surprisingly good selection of draft beer. Mixes looked apealing (mixes = drinks) - did not try.

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Good value for $15.99 AYCE. Sushi was typical Florida attempt at good, which means if you are used to California sushi, you'll be disappointed. Easy to fill up and worth going back to. It would get 4 stars if the sushi rocked, but it was not. Would get 5 stars if they included sashimi in the AYCE price like Saki in Clearwater does. Overall, way better than the chinese buffets that litter Tampa and say they have sushi, but nowhere close to a Japanese owned and operated sushi bar.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: It's like a semi fast food semi restaurant. I only had a cheeseburger and milkshake which was really good but I'm only giving them 3 stars because I keep comparing their cheeseburgers with New Orleans hamburger and Seafood co who makes the best cheeseburgers. It's still good but i would stop at the other place too :/

place_category: Hot Dogs, Restaurants
text: Barf!!!!! These dogs are terrible. And the person working the cashier is a teenager who is blatantly high!

place_category: American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: Maybe an off day, but we waited over an hour for our food. Other tables that had been waited on after us got their food before us. Sorry, won't be back.

place_category: Health Markets, Coffee & Tea, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, American (New), Specialty Food
text: love love love the service! love that the employees are happy to make each bowl customized! I appreciate when a place makes substitutions! It actually keeps me coming back almost everyday! Its also ridiculously good! So yummy, healthy and fresh! Thanks for making "substitutions" you guys are the best best best!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Gelato, Coffee & Tea, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: All of the Capogiro locations are excellent -- the best Gelato you can get this side of the Atlantic. But THIS Capogiro has a big space, free wifi, and a liquor license. Highly recommended. You should order an Affogato: gelato with a shot of espresso on top, served in a coffee cup.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, Mexican, Seafood
text: Our favorite Mexican place in Boise and we've tried most of them. Not sure about the music played on the weekend nights but the food and drinks make up for it. Sometimes it can be slow with the wait staff but again the food....WORTH it. So have a drink and chill. Order something you wouldn't normally and enjoy.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Our daughter took my husband and I here for my birthday. It kind of reminded me of a small town restaurant appearance with a very friendly staff too. Each of us ordered something different and each thing was so incredibly delicious. We were hard pressed to figure out what to bring home to our son. We will have to go back next time we are in Tucson. Thank you everyone for such a great experience.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Seafood
text: Very classy and spacious establishment. Bar seating even is great. Lots of parking. Tends to get a little loud when crowded. Great service friendly staff. Really liked the rhubarb mojito! But it was so strong one was enough for my might:)

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, German, Pubs, Restaurants
text: Thanksgiving 2017. It took 1.5 hours to get our meal. The staff seemed very nonchalant about the service and the fact that people were waiting and waiting and waiting. The food was tasty enough, but was lukewarm. I would never recommend this place to anyone for a holiday. We had a reservation, but it did us no good. We decided against dessert, and paid cash in order to avoid any more time spent in an atmosphere that seemed to care very little about customer service.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Meh. I'm not a chain restaurant guy & this is an example of why. I'm sure when this was a small operation with just a few restaurants that it was great. Service was polite & friendly, restaurant was very slow so it was quiet & easy. The food was just there - very bland, not at all special. Try Roosters in Frankin, Judge Beans in Brentwood or Martins in Nolensville.

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Busy Monday night but short wait time - We were helped by Jasmine and Mike, delicious food and great all around service. Bread pudding well worth it (absolutely decadent) drinks are on the pricier end but delightful and artfully crafted with love (good splurge). Wonderful ambience for a get together or date night

place_category: Fast Food, Chicken Shop, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caterers
text: This particular Chick-FIl-A is run like a well-oiled machine and the attention to detail with customer service is unmatched. You expect the more experienced employees to be stellar, but even the young high-school-age employees they have are great. It's a great experience every time I've been there, which is quite a bit. You know you're going to be treated well if you come here, along with getting delicious food.

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Sports Bars, Bars, Restaurants
text: This place is horrible. We were on the complete opposite end of the restaurant from the bar. The people at the bar are elbow to elbow. Literally touching each other no masks. As she approaches the table she starts up with masks up masks up until your food comes. We were 20 feet away from anyone. You must pull your masks up to order. Bye bye I will never eat at a Bully's again. We came in wearing our masks and kept them on til we were ready to order.

place_category: Burgers, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Southern
text: It's O'Charley's! You know what to expect from them. I haven't dined in, in awhile. One experience inside made me leave them for awhile. But if anything... Just get the rolls!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Soooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo good! The house dressing on the salad is amazing. Great burnt ends, kielbasa and pulled pork. Unique BBQ sauces. Really love the tortillas served as an accompaniment. We've eaten in and taken out. Great service.

place_category: Food, Breweries, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Brewpubs
text: Burger was good.....but the fries were cold. The pecan ice cream was pretty good. (Didn't really taste the alcohol infused in the ice cream). Would certainly get it again

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Overall this place did not impress me. The service was not great, both the hostess and the waitress were not attentive and a little dismissive. The food was also not impressive, the burger was very dry and a little tasteless. The French onion soup was all cheese and no soup. And the escargots were mostly butter and mushroom without actual escargot.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Mexican
text: I went to don Pablo's not expecting much to begin with. Our waiter was fine. It took him almost 15 minutes to come back with drinks, which was all good. He said the bartenders take forever. We ordered and he brought our food promptly. When he came to check on us he realized we hadn't eaten any of our food. He asked if we liked our food, we told him no. He told us the food wouldn't be any better next time. We gave him a good tip because we felt bad but I would never go back!

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Horrible. Out of food. All display cases were nearly empty and looked bombed out. Counter person unintelligible. Lots of empty Cardboard boxes in the seating area. Got drink wrong. Got the last food item available and wasn't what they said. Obviously no management attention here.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: This place is amazing! The food is excellent and the service is top notch. A special thanks to Reanna, she brightens up my day every time I stop in. Keep up the great work guys

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces, Cupcakes, Coffee Roasteries, Italian, Food, Bakeries, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Not a lot of seating, not too many options for snacks/small bites to eat...tables and chairs are uncomfortable, and the wifi is slow as well.

place_category: Jazz & Blues, Music Venues, Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Bars
text: Perhaps good blues for STL. Its more like listening to your buddies at the frat house pretend to be musicians. Not worth the cover for the music.

place_category: Greek, Restaurants, Mediterranean
text: Great when I have a craving for lamb. It's real lamb not giro. I love real Greek food.

place_category: Desserts, Specialty Food, Food, Macarons, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: I found this place on Yelp when I was searching for desserts and I'm so glad I tried it! The pictures of the cookies reminded me of Levain bakery which is why I had to get one! It definitely measures up to Levain in my opinion and the man who helped me (I guess the owner) was so friendly! I'll definitely be back to try what else they have!

place_category: Restaurants, Vegetarian, Middle Eastern, Kebab, Vegan, Breakfast & Brunch, Greek, Kosher, Mediterranean
text: Was in the area and searched up a kosher place. Hey Hummus was my first and only choice, had the Falafel with Hummus and a Cold Coke = perfect combo . Tasted amazing and I highly recommend. Sophia was very nice and courteous. Sammy A.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers
text: City Barbecue is much better. The food and service are much better quality at City Barbecue. Bagger Dave's is not worth it in my opinion.

place_category: Arabic, Lebanese, Mediterranean, Restaurants, Middle Eastern
text: Delicious food that was always consistent. Their mint lemonade smoothie was always refreshing especially during the hot summer months. You can't go wrong with this place!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Event Planning & Services, Party & Event Planning, Bars, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces
text: Pat o briens was amazing, and the bartender Ashton was the most professional, generous, handsome bartender we have met on our trip! We will return for Ashton alone bc he was amazing!!!!

place_category: Mexican, American (New), Seafood, Bars, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Been stopping in here for the last few years on an annual spring training baseball trip. Great food and amazing happy hour specials. The bartenders are always great as well. We were in Clearwater for 3 days this year and I think we stopped in for drinks or food at least 5 times. Oh, and they had miller 64 for my dad! Overall a clean, fun spot to hangout or grab food. We were fortunate to make it down early March this year, before they stopped baseball.

place_name: On The Border Mexican Grill & Cantina
place_category: Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Mexican
text: The food wasn't that great I ordered a burrito and the tortilla got so soggy I just couldn't finish.

place_category: Seafood, Thai, Sushi Bars, Salad, Restaurants
text: The food was pretty good, but the service is a train wreck. They staff could care less for our party of 10. We asked several times for drinks, condiments, napkins, etc. They just gave us nasty looks and ignored us. We will never go back. Save your money and just drive into Nashville.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Cafes, Bakeries
text: Not very good. Limited menu and they were out of half of it when we were there. Pita is store bought and wrap was a tortilla. Humnmus was good so got 2 stars. Not really interested in trying again.

place_category: Pizza, Nightlife, Food, Restaurants, Breweries, Bars
text: I had high expectations for this place after reading yelp reviews but it did not quite meet them unfortunately. They have a great, extensive beer menu as well as many great sounding pizza flavor pizza combinations. Unfortunately I think our pizza was a bit overcooked because it was just way too crispy. The wood smoked chicken on the pizza had a really great flavor, but It was almost like eating chicken on a cracker. Love the outdoor patio though!

place_category: Middle Eastern, Nightlife, Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars
text: Great to have something other than American/Southern type of food in Nashville. Cute space, not too loud and you can find street parking. The highlights are the pita bread and the hummus - both fantastic. I wanted to love the other food, but it just missed the mark. We went with a large group so I got to try everything and it was all just decent, nothing blew me away.

place_category: Nightlife, British, Pubs, Bars, Indian, Restaurants
text: Hands down my favorite restaurant in St. Pete. I suggest ordering something different every time you go - so many dishes to try that you won't want to miss out on.

place_category: American (Traditional), Music Venues, Arts & Entertainment, Pizza, Caterers, Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Italian, Bars, Gluten-Free, Event Planning & Services, Sports Bars
text: Stopped in for lunch and the menu is quite large so wasn't sure how the food would be with all those selections. The French Onion Soup was very good. The Rueben came with fries and the corned beef was ok, but not really juicy. The Chicken BLT was good, but a little on the dry side. Service was very good and everything was ok, but outside of the onion soup nothing stood out.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Steakhouses
text: For me, nothing stood out as fantastic in the taste department. Everything was just ok all around. I had the pot roast and I felt it had the texture of a poor piece of roast with a lot of fat. I was hopeing the flavor could make it worth it but it was mediocre. No one else in my party had complaints. I felt it was just a little pricey for just ok. I would be willing to try it again with a different meal if someone wanted to go but I wouldn't go out of my way to suggest it.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: They have a small, but decent, Asian market.. probably the only place that sells Asian items in the area. But of course, they are known for their cakes and desserts which are very good. But I only wen their for their Asian dishes which is the reason for my rating.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Hotels & Travel, Hotels, Restaurants, Bed & Breakfast
text: It's 1:15 in the morning and a maintenance man is trying to fix our door. The lock has been broken since we arrived to check in. When we arrived to check in our room was not ready at 3:00 the check-in time. We had to get ready for a wedding at 4:00. We were able to change in a friend's room but two solid strikes on a high end hotel makes the Royal Sonesta a bad deal.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Party & Event Planning, Event Planning & Services, Food, Desserts
text: Service is good. Ice cream nothing special. It is soft serve. I got a vanilla cone dipped in chocolate. Ice cream was not that good and chocolate on thin side. DQ is better. If I was walking by and wanted ice cream, then I would go in, but I would not make a special trip here.

place_category: Peruvian, Restaurants, Latin American
text: I love this place. We get a whole chicken and three sides (cilantro rice, spicy beans, and plantains). The friend yuca is super good. The spicy yuca appetizer is amazing. The liquados are also very good. The service is always great. It's a family friendly restaurant. We get the food for carry out once a month.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, American (New), Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: The wait staff was very nice and respectful but food wasn't that great. I wouldn't have a craving to go back but the staff was great.

place_category: Fast Food, Burgers, American (New), Restaurants
text: Heart surgeons must love this place, much like the ones that own Corky's. A group of Jewish cardiologists. "Heaven in a brown paper bag!"- I think not....

place_category: American (New), Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Local Flavor, Yelp Events, Sports Bars
text: Good place for cheap beers. $2 millers. Never have had any good food from here BESIDES wings. Terrible infused tequilas. So so place. I just wish they would quit with the Saturday DJs and terrible Christmas lights on our building or move out. EARTH TO YOU: WE ALL HAVE TO LIVE HERE!

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood, Burgers, Tacos, Sandwiches, Mexican, Bars, Food, Beer Bar, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Nightlife
text: Came for dinner on a slow night. Manager gal was super rude. Just not friendly at all and seemed put out to answer some questions. Once home we both had horrible stomach aches. Location is beautiful but the meal and service not so good...

place_category: Burgers, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Vegan
text: Great place to grab lunch! LOVE that the buns/rolls are whole grain. Would love to see less fake meat and more bean/vegetable based offerings. The sauces and flavors are spot on, service is quick and friendly and the sweet potato fries are perfection!

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: I enjoyed my java caramel Greek frozen yogurt. They let you try samples of everything. It obviously isn't the gelatto place down the street, but on a nice day on Beach Drive this was a decent option.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Seafood, American (New), Steakhouses, Lounges
text: For starters there caeser salad was good but it needed more flavor,the crab cake was awesome but the mac and cheese was kind of bland and it had mushrooms.But overall it was good

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Korean, Asian Fusion, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Comfort Food
text: We found this place just a couple of blocks from our hotel and liked it so much we ate here twice during our 3 night stay. Everything was prepared fresh, portions were good sized and price was reasonable. If I lived here, I would frequent this place!

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Good not great. They cut breasts in half and sell them as two pieces. They also cook the back and count that as a piece. The breasts tasted good but were dry. The young cashier was a sweetheart, very nice. The chicken livers were good too.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Tex-Mex
text: I really wanted this to be good. But it was maybe the worst burrito I've ever had. I don't think the steak was seasoned. Cute atmosphere tho. Although no table service or clean up.

place_category: Cafes, Restaurants
text: Yelp's listing is inaccurate. They close five hours earlier than the hours shown and the folks at the restaurant say they can't do anything about it, presumably because Yelp requires them to join/pay some sort of fee. Yelp shouldn't be allowed to misrepresent businesses. Fix this.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Nice place to go for a long breakfast or lunch and sit and enjoy the city and you get a Really nice view of the park. Food is good and light not too many options but a variety. Dessert was great. The only negative I would say is the service, our waters were always getting refilled and drinks, bread, and food were brought at a decent time but our waitress never did a check back when our entrees came and never really showed any interest in us or to do her job well.

place_category: Thai, Cafes, Vegan, Laotian, Vegetarian, Seafood, Restaurants, Salad, Soup
text: Food is great and the service is spot on. They recently renovated and added some yummy items to their menu. This is the only Thai restaurant I order from. My husband likes their red curry with chicken. I enjoy the cashew nut noodles or Khao Soi.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment
text: Bad food, GREAT margaritas... Excellent ambiance, like you are on vacation in the tropics, and they had live music all afternoon. I had a blast when we were here. I will definately come back to this one next trip

place_category: Nightlife, American (New), Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Jazz & Blues, Music Venues
text: We got sucked in by the jazz and our grumbling stomachs. It was the worst move we made on our trip to NOLA. Super average food for high prices so if you like that feeling of wasting your money and time, go here!* Also poor service (waitress messed up my girlfriend's order, she didn't notice we were both missing silverware, etc) and decor that makes you go zzzzzz.. *This is strictly based on the restaurant and not the music venue.

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Food
text: Wow! The sunset and oh yes the food. The location is absolutely stunning. The burgers are crazy good and you get The Ritz Carlton service. We were blown away by it all. The views and the food!!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Salad
text: The portions and prices were very good .. The main entrees were tasty .. However we thought the service could have been more organized .. The server kept forgetting about us and we felt rushed .. Even for water we had to ask several times .. They totally forgot about the bread until we asked about it when the entrees came out ...

place_category: Barbeque, Korean, Soup, Restaurants
text: Great tasting food! I loved everything about it. My friend didn't like the frozen and fatty brisket so much, but I enjoyed it! The all you can eat is worth it if you have two or more people. The bulgogi is better in flavor compared to the unseasoned brisket. The brisket would be good if you ask for an egg and eat it like sukiyaki or some kind of hot soup based. Everything else tasted great! The bill for two all you can eats was only $60 including tip.

place_category: Greek, Mediterranean, Sandwiches, Vegetarian, Restaurants
text: I like Pita Pit because I like to pretend I'm healthy and eat a meal that is mostly veggies. I get a nice full stomach without feeling like I ate a brick. A little too pricey for what it is.

place_category: Lounges, Restaurants, Burgers, Bars, Vegetarian, Nightlife, Middle Eastern, Lebanese, Cocktail Bars, American (New)
text: Delicious burgers! Food & drink both a plus AND they have their own parking lot which is rare for the area.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese
text: I ate here February 1st and had a bento box. In the chicken teriyaki there was black grill scrapings in the food. After seeing this I nearly got sick to my stomach. Also the Russian man that took the order and kept clicking his pen. He also ignored me for ten minutes while I was asking him a question. All the tables are dirty here and I was served food on a dirty tray.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Food Delivery Services, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Delis, Salad
text: Found a huge animal in my salad and they didn't even offer to replace the salad or refund me. It's disgusting the way this restaurant handled the situation, since they laughed in my face rather than comforting me. Never eating here again and I really reccomend you don't either. Nasty and disturbing.

place_category: Department Stores, Mobile Phones, Fashion, Shopping, Food, Grocery, Discount Store, Drugstores, Electronics
text: I want to thank the managers at the return desk. I returned an item that could have very easily been refused by them, but I was honest and explained my situation and they chose to be understanding and believe me. Hopefully they see this and remember who I am. Thank you again

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Nightlife, British, American (Traditional), American (New), Chicken Wings, Bars, Pubs
text: Chicken wings were excellent. Spicy steak salad, not so much. Avoid the liquid hot sauce! You'd be much better off searing the steak with cracked pepper seasoning.

place_category: Convenience Stores, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: It was my first and last stop there. No purse??? Are you kidding me. If you treat all your clients as thieves and criminals how are you planning to stay in business. ABC will never do something so demeaning and disrespectful. The owner should be aware the employees need serious customer service training. This explains why many business can't make it!

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches
text: OK, I ordered their supreme pizza with a thin crust. If this is thin, I would hate to see their regular crust. There is nothing thin about it. The crust is quite similar to Papa Johns, a location that I have boycotted for years. The toppings are nothing special. Will not be returning and do not recommend. Go the NYPD (New York Pizza Department) or Broadway Pizza if you want good pizza.

place_category: Delis, Restaurants
text: Neli's gets another star because now that I'm back in school we've been eating from here at least twice a week. My husband is hooked on their Italian & turkey hoagies. We love the pasta and potato salads. I really enjoy all varieties of turkey here. They use great rolls. Food is always fresh and calling in to takeout is always a breeze. Great food and they make my life easier? Got to love it.

place_name: Mr. An's Teppan Steak & Seafood Sushi Bar
place_category: Teppanyaki, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Seafood, Japanese, Bars, Nightlife, Sushi Bars, Sports Bars
text: The staff is wonderful, fast and helpful. The food, on the other hand is really not worth it. Spaghetti in an Asian meal is a big no no.

place_category: American (Traditional), Gluten-Free, Food, Venues & Event Spaces, Mexican, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Hawaiian, Event Planning & Services
text: Had the Crack chicken and it was delicious. My boyfriend got a waffle and it was delicious.friendly service as well. Hidden gem.

place_category: Acai Bowls, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Organic Stores
text: Smoothies are delicious and organic. Staff is friendly. Trendy and hot new spot for Tampa

place_category: Lounges, American (New), Burgers, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Fun bar, lots of tv's and games to keep you busy. The bartender was very good and very friendly. I'll be coming back. Plus they have a jukebox, so play whatever you want.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Tacos
text: Not very user friendly for large orders. The tacos were SMALL! Very little meat, mostly onion. The met was dry too. Stingy with the hot sauce. Overall meh. Probably won't be back

place_category: Seafood, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Tiki Bars, Bars, Chinese
text: Very cheap lunch specials that are generously sized. I would recommend getting the wonton soup as the side; it is literally packed with wontons. Plus they are very fast with delivery. Food wise, it is your typical Americanized Chinese but is made with less msg than most other places in the area.

place_category: Cafes, Burgers, American (Traditional), Tacos, Seafood, Restaurants, Mexican
text: We were recommended to come here for the fish tacos. We had been told they were well-known for the Baja tacos. We were less than impressed. They give you 3-4 tortillas, but the meat is only worthy of one and half. And, the taste was mediocre. The service was great as were the views.

place_name: Sheraton Indianapolis Hotel at Keystone Crossing
place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Hotels, Restaurants, Hotels & Travel, Event Planning & Services
text: As a long term platinum of Starwoods, I have to say this hotel is Not worthy of the brand. From the time I registered where I was greeted by a grumpy registration hostess, to a room that had flying bugs (yes!) there was really little that is worthy of the Starwoods brand. Sorry folks, but this is not a hotel I would ever stay at again.

place_category: Food, Specialty Food, Desserts, Popcorn Shops
text: I'm pretty boring when it comes to popcorn I just like butter and salt and this place is expensive if you just want movie theater style popcorn like it's basically movie theater prices now for some crazy combo you can't find anywhere else that's fine but it's not worth it. When it's good it's good but often it's stale smh I've gone back to nuts to you which is healthy air popped and stick to actual movie theaters for the buttery variety

place_category: Dive Bars, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Food, Tapas Bars, Specialty Food
text: Best staff, lovely atmosphere, delicious food, and the best selection of cocktails! I am addicted to their fries - the best in town - in my opinion.

place_category: Food, Desserts, Event Planning & Services, Vegan, Caterers, Vegetarian, Gluten-Free, Food Delivery Services, Restaurants, Shopping, Arts & Crafts, Salad, Cooking Classes
text: I was just passing through town and saw this vegan option close to my hotel. When I called they were so helpful and was available for carry out. The location and building is beautiful. I love the mural! The food was fantastic. I wish there was a restaurant like this back home where I live. I'm going to want to stop here every time I come through Tucson.

place_name: The Continental Restaurant and Martini Bar
place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Lounges, Nightlife, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch
text: i'm a starr girl. big fan of his. this is a great diner, with a warm feeling to it. the martini olive lighting gives it a chichi, posh look of an older era. great drink concoctions and the food speaks for itself. this isn't a burger and fries type of diner. starr puts a twist on the definition of diner here. btw, i would pay for the thai beef salad to be put back on the menu. *drool*

place_category: Ramen, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Had the Veggie Ramen. A bit over priced for 2 pieces of tofu and a few broccoli stalks. It was ok but nothing to write home about. Service was good and atmosphere nice. Other than that, not truly impressed.

place_category: Nightlife, Breweries, Pubs, Bars, Food, American (New), Restaurants
text: It I was rating this place just on beer it would be 5-star, however service is a consideration. We were told to leave at 1:50 am. Server "we are closed get out". Me "But you just sold me a beer during last call?" Server "and?" Me "Thanks for the hospitality" Mind you my buddy and I had just gotten out of a movie and these were our 2nd beers of the night. We were not rude, drunk or nasty. With so many options in Philly. I will not be back.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Ptini was really yummy, and grilled till the bun was crunchy and delicious. the fries were great and my husbands french dip was very good. I feel the kids chicken fingers left something to be desired. Just your run on the mill frozen and chopped up breaded cutlet. The service was lovely and friendly. This was my second time here and I will be going back next time I am in Hatboro.

place_category: Food, American (New), Restaurants, Desserts, Italian
text: Very friendly service. Waitress was great. Food, however wasn't that great. Really wanted it to be good, but the food was kinda bland. And for some reason it took forever to get our food and they weren't busy. Don't know what happened.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Bars, Sandwiches, Chicken Wings, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Burgers
text: Good place for beers after work, typical bar food, the fried macaroni and cheese is amazing! And of course, what would a visit be without fried pickles. Reasonable prices for food and beer. Lots of weekly specials are available!

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Mexican
text: This chipotle is the worst one I've been to. Employees are rude, have trouble understanding simple English when you order and give you a third of the standard portion of guacamole. Would not recommend coming here.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Went for an event which a friend had an open bar and it was incredible!!! Loved the service and the pizza wasn't exactly my style (I prefer greasy floppy pizza) but it was still absolutely delicious. I loved the decor with the collection of bottle openers on the wall!

place_category: American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Mediterranean, French
text: Love the cocktails - popcorn appetizers is a must to share if you have to. The Strawberry Chocolate Salad is a must bowl lickin good. The bar tender & French waiter just made the evening even better.

place_category: Delis, Restaurants, Convenience Stores, Grocery, Food
text: Delicious! Fresh ingredients. Have never had a disappointing sandwich, salad,wrap. Specialty sandwiches great too. Nice menu.

place_category: Food Trucks, Restaurants, Street Vendors, Food, Mexican
text: I went there for the first time yesterday and I got guc and that was so plain, it had no lemon or lime and no salt or pepper. The chips were horrible my first chip I bit into was stale so I picked up another and the same. The red sauce sorry my bad that was salsa at lease that's what they called it . It was the worst 29 dollars I ve ever spent. I don't want to talk about the mushroom tacos because I had to eat something. Simply put the food lack of substance.

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Coffee Roasteries, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Cafes
text: The Bean Tree Café is a good place to grab breakfast, brunch, or lunch. The food is good, but could be better. That being said I don't think this place is trying to be a five star restaurant, they just want to put out good food, and I think they are doing that. I had the stuffed Hawaiian French Toast and that was good, the hashbrowns were nothing special. The place is very clean and well decorated. It's definitely worth a visit if you are in the Waterloo area.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: First time I have been here. The owner is rude and short with his customers. Do everyone a favor and do not support an individual like this.

place_category: Nightlife, Breweries, Bars, Food, Pubs, Restaurants, Brewpubs
text: The beer was really good and we love the flights! The food was mediocre though. It could be better but we did go for the beer. The service was also okay. It was kind of busy but we felt rushed.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Seafood, Dim Sum
text: Went here at noon on a Sunday. Was seated upstairs. They barely had anyone pushing carts upstairs as opposed to downstairs. They got our tea order wrong twice, and it was pilfered with leaves. The dim sum we had was flavorless and the waitstaff was very lazy and didn't feel like working that day lol... We would have to ask them to come over and clean up our empty dim sum containers

place_category: Greek, Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Mediterranean
text: I had the Dolmathes, which is Grape leaves stuffed with ground beef, lamb and rice made in house. Which was featured on the food network show diners, drive-ins & dives. HOLYCRAP was that thing amazing. I was impressed the with food quality, service and flawless food. A+ all the way. Cant wait to bring my wife here. Kudos to management doing things right.

place_category: Food, Candy Stores, Popcorn Shops, Specialty Food
text: This popcorn store is located inside of the airport. You can only access it after you have gone through the gates and security to get onto your flight. I grabbed a mixture of Caramell and sharp cheddar popcorn. The prices are a little high but that is expected in an airport. Overall the popcorn was very good. I wish they had more samples of the unique flavors and I would have probably bought more to bring home but I wasn't sure without trying them.

place_category: American (New), Bars, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Lounges
text: Good appetizers...good salad. Tuna waaaaaaay over cooked ( our table had 4 and all were same) and service less than ideal. Would try something else next time

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Nightlife
text: The service in this place is the worst. When we arrived there was hardly anyone in the place. We ordered food and it took them 15 minutes to tell me they were out of the soup. It is now 30 minutes since we ordered our food and we still don't have it. There are plenty of other restaurants to choose from. I suggest you do that.

place_category: Restaurants, Hot Pot, Dim Sum, Szechuan, Chinese
text: The dim sum is great. DO NOT come for dinner. This is the third time we've come and it's been at least an hour before the food comes out. The server is apologizing for the tardiness of the kitchen, but it's not her place. Only do dim sum. The dim sum is great. The food is great, really, but the management needs to be better about managing the kitchen. Tonight, one person's food came out 20 minutes before the rest of the party of four. That is unacceptable

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion
text: We had a nice casual Pan Asian dinner here last Sunday. We sat on the patio, a lot of traffic both on foot and vehicular on Jefferson Avenue however this did not detract from the experience. Both food and service were good would recommend and will return.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries
text: Good pancakes, but nothing special. Not worth going out of your way for.

place_category: American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants, Lounges, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Chocolatiers & Shops, Food, Specialty Food, Desserts, Bars, Fondue
text: I went to dinner at The Chocolate Bar and the food was really good. I first ordered a main entree and then had the chocolate fondue after for dessert. The fondue was delicious!! The next time I go I will just be ordering dessert. The food was good, but the desserts are even better!! Also the atmosphere is really pretty and is a fun place to go for a night out.

place_category: Sandwiches, Pizza, Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: My pizza wasn't docked right nor was it cut right and it was burnt and flimsy. Not what I was expecting in the slightest. Please refer to the pictures below

place_category: Asian Fusion, Japanese, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: Probably the best pan-Asian buffet on the South side. You've got your typical American Chinese food selection, which I would recommend over their odd foods (more specifically their "philly cheesesteak" roll-type things, which are pretty disgusting). The hibachi grill isn't bad, and the sushi is pretty decent. One major plus is that it is always very clean and well-kept. I never see children by themselves, playing in the food, which is comforting. The food is also fresh, even during off-hours.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Food, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Salad, Italian, Soup
text: The pizza had great flavor, unfortunately the delivery made it extremely dry like cardboard.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Wow orderd take out and after driving there and driving home the order was wrong. Called the restaurant and they would do nothing for giving us the wrong order.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New)
text: Great food, great space and really attentive servers. The menu is on the smaller side but really well planned out and everything I've had has been really good. Try the lobster roll. a friend and I both tried each and (there are two different styles) shared half of each and both were incredibly good, lots of lobster and the roll it's on it melts in your mouth. It's market price but well work it. Great addition to the neighborhood. Good luck John and Cathy I wish you all the success to you guys.

place_category: Food, Brewpubs, Breweries
text: Excellent beer with friendly service! Must stop if checking out breweries in Tampa! Slushees were delicious as well! Beautiful inside! Definitely a hidden gem!

place_category: Japanese, Korean, Asian Fusion, Tacos, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Yum yum. Very friendly helpful staff. Great seasoning and wonderful lettuce wraps&tacos. Also, great portions

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Sandwiches, Italian, Pizza
text: The pastas were excellent, we had the clam linguine and the fettuccine with mushrooms and leek loved both. The arugula and potato salad was ok as was the pesto dip but rounded out the meal. Downside was that the service was sloooow. Took a long time to order and our food to come out and our server while very sweet was forgetful and we'd have to make the same request more than once (e.g. more bread to go with the dip). I'd come again but definitely not when I'm in a rush.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: The two times I have given this restaurant a chance, I have had a bad experience. The food is undercooked and doesn't taste all that great. I would much rather spend my money elsewhere, even if it means less convenience and more money. The dim sum was bad and the boba has a weird consistency and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Vegetarian, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: i love this place!!!!!!!!!!! i come here at least once a week sometimes three times a week and eat the huevos racheros and sometimes a pancake the best breakfast spot in tucson delicious food low prices

place_category: Bars, Pubs, Restaurants, Pizza, Nightlife
text: To hell with this place. We ordered one of the specials from them off of grub hub. They called us back forty minutes after we ordered and said there is an error in the menu and they weren't going to honor the order that we had already payed for. The manager was incredibly rude and refused to cancel our order. We finally did get it cancelled but it still managed to throw off our diner plans, never again! AVOID!!

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Food, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Poke, Acai Bowls
text: The food is great but the service SUCKS! Monday night, 7:20. The only business they had was a table of three. It was sweltering heat and I had a seat, out of the way but air-conditioned. They kicked me outside. They also won't jump orders if they have food waiting, for others who have not yet arrived, which tells me they don't give a flying frog about freshness. Time to find a more customer friendly place!

place_category: Vegetarian, Gluten-Free, Pizza, Caterers, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services
text: Woodstock's makes okay pizza. It's rather soft and doughy for my personal taste, though the folded in crust is a unique concept. It's my preferred dining-in option for pizza in IV. My favorite dish here is the cinnabread, which is similar to a Cinnabon, but less soft and gooey. I think it's cool they have Trivia Night here for the students, though I haven't participated yet.

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: Terrible...dry old chicken. Broken noodles and it took forever. The chicken tasted like it was from yesterday or the day before. The server asked how my meal was I said the chicken was terrible and he just walked away.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Hotels & Travel, Hotels, Restaurants, Bed & Breakfast
text: Celebrated my 70th birthday, was not able to sleep on the Bourbon St side, asked to have my room moved, and they were more then accommodating, also, my sister, was given a room right across the hall from us, as we requested....The room was perfect, sheets clean and comfortable, absolutely no complaints....VERY Pleased with our stay...

place_category: Food, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Empanadas, Latin American, Restaurants, Mexican, Tacos
text: The menu is great but unfortunately they are inconsistent with food prep. I've had great food, then cold food, then undercooked food all for the exact same dish.

place_category: Fast Food, Salad, Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: This location has single-handedly turned me off of Zaxby's entirely. Incredibly slow service given with I don't give a rip attitude.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants
text: I ordered one of the poached egg dishes and had to flag another waiter down to send back the dish as our waitress never checked on us. Dish was cold, sloppy plate and the eggs were cooked through not poached. Terrible service. Will not be back.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Kosher, Burgers, Tapas/Small Plates, American (Traditional), Vegan, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Vegetarian
text: I'm not vegan or even vegetarian but I was very curious about this place. I was pleasantly surprised by the food. I really loved the chic pea fries. The cocktails were a bit sweet for me but that is to be expected when using natural juices. Although at $12 a pop, they are a bit steep. Here was my issue. We came on a Thursday and happen to get the table up front by the window. I felt like we were being rushed out of there the entire time. It was annoying me so we left.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Delis, Burgers, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Local Flavor
text: If your from the south like me make sure ask for cheese wiz! Smothered is the way! ordered all the way, Wished the onions and peppers were sautéed a little more but this place...Open until 3am is sure to give you some Philadelphia culture " all the way" "with" or skipping the steaks and grabbing a burger, add a drink and this place is sure to satisfy your philly needs. Tip: if you're not alone grab a table while in line.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Mass Media, Cajun/Creole
text: Oh, so close to a 4 star review! Food was fantastic, though the service was a little slow and unresponsive. I think they might have been slipping away from time to time to finish their full body tattoos. Also, in a really cool neighborhood. Lots of million $ mansions scattered amongst the homes where us regular folks live...

place_category: Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Not a great diner. Not only does the food take awhile but it will be shocking if you are served the right thing. Additionally, it is not a clean establishment. I don't know about you, but I can't build up an appetite when my surroundings are filthy. Most of the food is also just from a freezer, it's painfully obvious. May the force be with you if you choose to eat here.

place_category: Nightlife, Mexican, Bars, Restaurants, Food Trucks, Vegetarian, Tacos, Food
text: This location is better than the Downtown Tampa location but not better than the Hillsborough location. If you want delicious real deal Taco Bus you have to go to Hillsborough.

place_category: Grocery, Food
text: This store's deli is the worst!!! If you like chicken don't come here. They never have any ready and when you call it in they give you one of the old ones.

place_category: American (New), Sandwiches, Restaurants, Pizza
text: In the Treme now, but still so amazing! The pizza is incredible, and the delivery is painless and swift. Very personable place with some great food and cool peoples. I ordered a pizza around midnight and they got a little lost, but were diligent about keeping me updated on there location via cell phone. It was very much so worth the wait and I'll definitely be ordering again soon!

place_category: Wraps, Sandwiches, Specialty Food, Food, American (New), Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caterers
text: The food is delicious. All I got was a cup of French onion soup and the house salad with goat cheese. Such a simple lunch but the food was so fresh. It's an interesting set up to get used to at first, but it's cute, very "kitchen-esque".

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: I don't care what else you read. I eat here often. The owners are friendly. Food is great and is made quickly. Don't let them push the pineapple Fanta on you. It's good though lol.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, Peruvian, Seafood
text: Had a very enjoyable meal again. We weren't so sure about the Salchipapas because we thought pretty basic BUT looked it up and it's truly what they serve in Peru! I had the Lomo Saltaldo and it was extremely tasty! My husband had the steak and said very good too!

place_category: Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, Bars, Cafes, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Hated coming to this place growing up, it seemed like a place that old people came to talk about the old days, the food reflected that in taste....and appearance. I don't know, the cafeteria set up and old decor just didn't do anything for me. Glad this place was shut down then turned into a Buffalo Wild Wings

place_category: Food, Mexican, Restaurants, Desserts
text: Haven't been there since early jan. 2010. working at GSK. Food was great, service was slow. I don't think they take credit cars.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Bakeries
text: Looks different post makeover two years ago. Modern and hip vs old school and original. I used to love the cannoli. But it is so hit and miss. At $4 twice the price of a cannoli in brooklyn my, its not worth it. Today the shell was too hard. Over fried. Last time the filling was spoiled. The other Italian pastry is respectable. For tourists and locals its probably the best in Philly. The staff is never friendly. WIGB? For a taste every now and then

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Mexican, Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Caterers
text: Salsa is definitely not good. Someone said it taste like ketchup. I would agree with that statement. Tasted like a tube of tomato paste. I had a chimi which was decent but the prices were a kind of high for the quality. It was OK. A bit under seasoned. I'd go there again but not my first choice.

place_category: Grocery, Food, Food Delivery Services
text: I just received a sales call. I politely refused but the sales pitch went on and on. I let the person know I was researching as he was talking. THANK YOU YELP MEMBERS!! I can shop better at Mariano's. I'm not a big meat eater anyway. Low stars because couldn't take "no thank you" for an answer.

place_category: Burgers, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: this place is great! I work across the street, and not a day goes by that I don't stare at this place and drool. as a veggie burger lover I was so pleasantly surprised on my first bite to discover BEETS! servers are super friendly. the place is adorable. they have coca cola in bottles. love it.

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: On our first visit to Boise this was the first restaurant we ate at and it did not disappoint. From the moment we walked in, the hostess , the vibe and our waiter was A+. The food was delicious and the dessert was even better. Will visit again.

place_category: Specialty Food, Restaurants, Korean, Ethnic Food, Food, Barbeque
text: This place has been around for ages. I remember coming here as a kid once and I stepped out to listen to the radio for mike schmidts 500th home run. Yes that long ago! It was the place to be then but as the years went by and the changes of ownership through the years it's just not the same. Quality of meat has gone down and definitely the portions. BUT they still use charcoal so I'll give them props for that.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Long wait in line to find out that they are out of an item that I was just told was available. Don't go past 6 on the weekend. They will be out of most things. I was there at 7:15 and the menu board was almost empty. I left without ordering anything and won't be going back any time soon

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Seafood, Caribbean
text: Giving this place one star for the view and location. It's nice if your visiting the pier to just walk here and eat however, the food is comparable to Chili's in my opinion. Nothing special. Seafood is terrible. Had family in from New Orleans they said worst oysters they have ever had. Best bet, walk a little bit and go to Frescos. It's worth the wait and walk. This is more of a tourist trap but if your going just for apps and drinks it will do.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Pubs, Restaurants, Nightlife, Belgian
text: I only stopped in for some beer after lunch and the selection was right on. The Phils were on and ahead by 5 so the awesome bartender tuned between the Tour de France and the game. They had some craft beers from California which I tried and was impressed by. I hope I can return to get some food some time soon, but for now the staff was super friendly, the atmosphere relaxed and it seemed to be a good, chill spot.

place_name: St. James Cheese Company | Warehouse District
place_category: Specialty Food, Cheese Shops, Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: I had been wanting to visit here for a while and finally made it for lunch. Not at all impressed. The flavor in the food was so faint and the "salad" was just leaves and cheese pretty much. There was no dressings to choose from. The mimosa has the weirdest taste. I love the presentation of the food but if you like flavor, you won't enjoy this place.

place_category: Soup, Seafood, Salad, Cuban, Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Went with husband, daughter,her daughter and her friend. They couldn't have been nicer, or more friendly. The meals were GREAT! The steamed shrimp out of this world. It is a must visit.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Bars, Pubs
text: I hadn't come here in a couple years and I will never come back - at least not to eat. I used to love their mussels, but when I recently ordered them they were not good quality at all. The shells kept braking (never happened to me before...) and the mussels themselves tasted "dry", I'm really not sure how to even describe them. Overall not good. Not sure what changed, but it's a shame.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Specialty Food, Food, Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Nightlife, American (New), Cocktail Bars
text: I came too Nook during my Whole 30 diet because they have many different options! I ordered chicken and waffles with sweet potato fries, my friend ordered fish and chips. BY FAR the absolute worst food I have ever eaten. They were out of bacon chips and guacamole and all desserts. Really bad timing because it's devour downtown. Terrible experience and terrible food do not recommend. Hopefully the kitchen was just 'off' because I do not see how they could keep any repeat customers.

place_category: Restaurants, Creperies, Cafes, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: The coffee is above average. The food is not great, considering what it pretends to be (and what they charge). The service regularly flirts between good and excellent. Without a neighborhood Starbucks to compete with, what are you going to do. Keep going.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Macarons, Food, Gelato, Bakeries, Specialty Food, Custom Cakes, Desserts
text: Very average coffee and the pastries didn't look very appealing today. The restaurant area looked amazing and smelled good though.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Vegetarian, American (New)
text: Decent location. A good amount of seating. I tried the vegan cauliflower poboy. The taste isn't worth the price at all. Would not recommend, will not return.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Burgers, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Steakhouses, American (Traditional), Diners
text: This location is a disaster. The service is always terrible. Soooo slooooow. Does Steak n Shake not employ managers? As we sat there for 1.5 hrs. We watched 3 parties leave without paying because no one came to the register after waiting for 20 minutes. Saw 4 parties leave because no one came to their tables.

place_category: Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Pizza, Italian
text: Take food takes forever to come. And the prices are outrageous. I don't recommend coming here if you don't have time, good food it's just takes WAY to long even when they aren't busy

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: I have never tried pho soup before. Been meaning to forever. Stopped in and got takeout of their special beef pho soup. Wow! This may be the best soup I've ever had! Meat, vegetables, cilantro, noodles, even a small container of sriracha! It was absolutely delicious. Staff was very nice and friendly. The place is nicely decorated. I can't say anything but good about them. I will definitely be back!

place_name: Diamond Buffet at Desert Diamond Casino Sahuarita
place_category: Do-It-Yourself Food, Food, Restaurants, American (New), Buffets
text: They need to redo this buffet completely. I had been years ago and swore I would never go back...but I had a family member in town who wanted to try the Seafood night. You know it is bad when the best part of the buffet was not the Seafood, it was the prime rib and the soft serve ice cream.

place_category: Dance Clubs, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Bars, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: Stopped after a visit to the Glassboro Glass Museum. Nice selection of local, domestic, and imported beer. We had the Glassboro Bonesaw Brewery Swoosh; excellent. The menu has a nice sselection of food that is very tasty. Would come back.

place_category: Korean, Barbeque, Restaurants, Asian Fusion
text: I would eat here again if they give you more food. The food here is good, but reviewing for competition. This place price is high, quantity is low, quality is fair. Flavor is good.

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Seafood, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: Expensive sushi for an average taste. Tried their Hot and a spicy dumpling soup and that was so much better than the rest. It's in a huge shopping outlet so the price is obvious to be on the pricier side. Don't think it was worth the $$ for such average sushi.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Irish, Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: We have been coming to The Drake since they opened. This is the 1st time I have ever been charged $1.00 for rocks???? WTH??? What if I wanted the ice in my drink? Will you still charge me? This is a joke!

place_category: American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Food Trucks, Food Delivery Services, Food, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Barbeque, Caterers
text: Pros: - Food was reasonably priced - Restaurant was clean - Customer service was good. - They offered the kids full size coloring books and crayons to use while their food was being prepared. - Food came out FAST. - good sauces for the food Cons: - Food is VERY bland - very limited menu - no desserts - no kids menu or kid friendly options (they did have Mac n cheese) - baked beans were obviously canned - only bread options were toast or a bun. No corn bread, hush puppies or corn sticks.

place_category: Southern, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Live/Raw Food, Hotels & Travel, Hotels
text: Tried Desire for the second time despite a similar previous experience and because we love Royal Sonesta. Food was mediocre at best. My husband's chargrilled oysters were sandy and had shells. Sticky chicken sandwich was a few tenders, unbreaded, on a bun with a little sauce. Friend ordered steak and enjoyed it, but his wife's jambalaya was underwhelming mush. Not worth the hype, sadly.

place_category: Vegan, Restaurants
text: I just tried Lulu's for the first time and had to immediately write my review because it was THAT good. I got the Loaded Nacho Crunch Wrap and I kept staring at it as I ate it because I was convinced there was no way it was vegan! I can't wait to go back and try every other item on their menu. Their prices are very right, the restaurant is inviting and adorable, and it's so great to have amazing tasting vegan food!

place_category: German, Nightlife, Pubs, Beer Bar, Bars, Restaurants
text: Wow, this place is a gem! Tried the bratwurst sampler and sipped a couple beers by bartender recommendation. Brad is the man, if he's working ask for his recommendations, he knows the German beers more than the bartenders in Munich! This spot is a go-to if you want good German food and brews in Boise.

place_category: Japanese, Food, Tapas/Small Plates, Restaurants
