place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Food, Ethnic Food, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian, Specialty Food, Israeli, Restaurants
text: We had a fantastic dinner tonight. The service was impeccable. The food flavorful and abundant.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: I've had ice cream at Bo's several times during my life, mostly when I was younger, but a few times in my adult years, and I've got to say that there ain't nothing special about their treats. Haven't been back in years, and probably won't. I'd have to be pretty hard up for some soft serve!

place_category: Cafes, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Have never been disappointed. Can be crowded at times but it's family owned and worth the wait.

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches, Cafes
text: The Chicken Carbonara was so darn good I will definitely be back to try something else. The broccoli cheese soup was ok, it tasted like it had a velveeta type cheese not a real cheddar. I had my eye on the steak and cheese panini that the man sitting next to me was eating, it looked so good & he was sure enjoying it.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Sandwiches
text: Great little sandwich shop that I frequent for lunch with my coworkers. I usually get the brown bag special: an American hoagie, bag of chips, and can of soda for $7.25. You really cannot beat that anywhere. The sandwich is top notch - always having fresh meat and the bread is delicious. I've had the Italian Stallion once and it was just so delicious, I was inspired to get the pepperoncini aioli on all of my sandwiches from now on. It is a must have!

place_category: French, Event Planning & Services, Seafood, Salad, Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Caterers, Restaurants, Modern European, Barbeque, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: The food and the ambiance are definitely 4 to 5 star worthy but the service is unfortunately holding them back. They overcharged us, said they had a sea bass special for $18 and charged me $25. Also they disappeared after our food was served, I had to physically go find the server to close out. I called to discuss my issues with a Manager or Owner but no one returned my call. Hopefully they get it together.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners
text: Conveniently located in the heart of Lansdowne, I'm glad this place has re-opened. They're small but hopefully will be able to do well in this area.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Bistros, American (New), Food, Pizza
text: Their buffalo chicken pizza is the absolute best! :) My fiancé loves it with a side of melted blue cheese. We've been here a few times now and would definitely recommend it.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Had the crabcake sandwich and it was delish as well. This place just keeps getting better. Also, they extended their hours till 9 pm- thank God!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Very nice place lots of servers however there were many issues with the food temperature. My steak was cold along with the app the person with me had. Dessert was amazing but while eating we overheard other tables complaing over food issues as well. I'm sure I caught them on a bad day but for $35 who wants a cold steak.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian, Sandwiches
text: This is the 2nd time I ordered the seafood florentine soup & the 2nd time it came with barely any seafood. The rigatoni & crabmeat had frozen crabmeat. Dirty flowers in dirty water is a pet peeve of mine. Stick w/the pizza.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: I love this place. Excellent food and customer service. Collin was the best server/manager ever. I will be returning and bringing guests with me

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Cafes, Sandwiches
text: Great location. However the price is slightly high for the quality of the product and service. I would compare the pastries, iced coffee and service to one of those airport grab and go stops.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza, Southern, Italian, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: This is a late post. It's been about 2 weeks since we were there. Food was really good but everyone is packed in with tables very close to each other and with everyone talking the noise level was crazy. It has an industrial decor with cement floors and metal, wood & glass fixtures so sounds travel. We picked up a carry out menu as we live fairly close. We will order from there but bring it home were we can hear each other.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: I have yet to find a really good Chinese place in Indy. This place is ok. I can say the pork egg roll is very good, and the hot & sour soup is one of the better versions I've had. As for entrees, I think the Roast Pork with Chinese Vegetables is really tasty. The chicken dishes I've had have not been memorable. Service is fast and friendly. Price point is good. When you gotta have your Chinese fix, you can do a lot worse.

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Fast Food
text: Overall looks like a fun and happening place. Very colorful. Carnival like atmosphere. I've try it a few times and the food is good, just not great. I try something new every time thinking I'm missing something. I will say the people that work there are very friendly and happy your there. I've tryed a few burgers and tots and fries and all were good. What am I missing? Should I be trying something different?

place_category: Barbeque, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Restaurants, Local Flavor
text: The food from here is great. You have to get there earlier in the day before they run out of food. I particularly like their jerk chicken and sweet potatoes.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Salad
text: On Monday I went to Sauce on the Side for the very first time. I ordered the meat me in St. Louis and my world was changed. On Tuesday I brought my leftovers (because these calzones are HUGE) to work for lunch. On Wednesday I convinced a friend that he just had to try it! On Thursday I again, brought my leftovers for lunch. And on Friday.... I ate my friends leftovers. 5 days in a row and I am STILL craving it . Great job!!!

place_category: American (New), Bars, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Event Planning & Services, Hotels & Travel, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Hotels
text: an institution. love the cup, love the bloddy mary bar in the lobby on sundays (make your own with TONS of amazing ingredients). love club congress for optimist club on thursdays.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Cafes
text: Coffee and food was ok, but Internet was really spotty the entire day and made it difficult to get anything done, despite having a dedicated study space upstairs.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian
text: My first taste of Joe's Pizza yesterday. Pretty good pizza. Will definitely be going back again. The owners also have some pretty good pizza specials in Monday & Tuesday. I love a good pizza

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Asian Fusion, Chicken Wings, Korean
text: Ordered some chicken wings and the takoyaki, alongside a few Sapporos. Overall, everything was tasty and inexpensive. I would definitely recommend coming here for a few drinks and greasy, fried food to get your fix. I didn't really like the huge, and blindingly bright TV screens all over the place, but they did provide some K-Pop entertainment for us during our meal.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: Stopped in after 6 on a weeknight, place was packed as usual. No roast beef,1 person cooking, and few choices available.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Gastropubs, Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Caterers, Seafood, Event Planning & Services, Beer Bar
text: Charged me $3 for a different sauce with a piece of chicken and the service has been awful lately. Had to find the waitress for more water, didn't bring the sauce originally that we ordered with the food, and took about twenty minutes with empty plates to get the check. Much better options nearby for less money and better food.

place_category: Nightlife, Sports Bars, Bars, Breweries, Pubs, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food
text: Driving home last night, I decided I needed a beer. Thanks to an earlier yelp mentioning Barrio I decided I needed to check it out again. It had been a few months since I was there last and I now I'm starting to wonder why I waited so long before I went back. There was a great crowd, great service, and good food/beer. So, if your near downtown or the university and want to try something great keep the Barrio in mind!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Salad, Food, Bars, Nightlife
text: Worst food! Taco shells are not hand made. The pork tasteless. The chicken drowning in cheese. The tamales were half done piles of mush. The guacamole was good. My fault, should nt have expected anything from a mall restaurant. It's about as genuine as pizza hut. The service was excellent, though. Great staff.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: This place is massively overrated. The meat is completely tasteless, the bread is soggy and it will set you back almost $10. I've tried steaks with both provolone and wiz and neither are good. My stomach also feels terrible the next day. Pat's and Geno's are way better if you're going to go for a traditional Philly cheese steak.

place_category: Food, Donuts, Coffee & Tea
text: I've given this place 3 chances and I'm done. They are incredibly slow! It's one thing if the staff was busting their butt..... then perhaps it would be on the manager to hire more people; however, they seem to take their sweet time. Not to mention....running out of coffee at 8:30a during the week.....really?!!?...Pretty unacceptable if you are a flipping coffee shop?!?

place_name: The Cake Bake Shop by Gwendolyn Rogers-Broad Ripple Village
place_category: Restaurants, Bakeries, Desserts, Patisserie/Cake Shop, American (Traditional), Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Cupcakes, French, Sandwiches, Food, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: I know I'm in the minority here but I find this place OVER priced for a piece of dry, average tasting cake. Yes they are beautiful to look at but not extraordinary in any way. I've never had a piece (and I've had 5 now) that wasn't dry and just not special for how much was spent. Sorry folks, but there are so many more places in town to get an extraordinary dessert.

place_category: Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Greek, Restaurants
text: The food is pretty average for mediterranean, but my real complaint has to do with the atmosphere. The dining room is super awkward. It's so quiet, the room echoes when you speak. It has a cafeteria feel and needs to be filled in more with eclectic furniture.

place_category: Pizza, Sandwiches, Italian, Restaurants
text: Pizza was very good. Sweet flavorful sauce and neapolitan cheese. They serve slices ($2.00 + $0.50 per topping). Accept credit/debit over $5.00 *Tuesday special - Large (16") plain - $6.99 - Can't beat it!

place_category: Mexican, Food, Restaurants
text: Heard great things about this restaurant. Ordered a DoorDash order, missing items and the two chicken soft tacos that did show up were not very good. The chicken was hard as a rock and when I showed my husband he thought I was joking and had handed him a piece of dog food. Disappointed because I was starving after working all day. Not sure what went wrong here.

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Italian, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Party & Event Planning, Seafood, Caterers
text: Great service, great food! Our party arrived right at closing time and the gracious waiters still allowed us to dine there. The food came quickly and it was absolutely delicious! The waiters ended up staying there an hour later for us. I would definitely go back and recommend this place anytime!

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, American (New), Pop-Up Restaurants, Asian Fusion
text: Fairly standard Thai food. Entree prices around $11-12. Nightly specials on the wall. The spicing is on the mild side. Generous servings. The Poorman's noodles has much meat as large flat noodles. Beer prices are a bargain. Service is friendly and faultless. The decor is very pleasant and creative.

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife
text: One of the hidden gem buffets for lunch. Nice setting sufficient for customers, interviews and just a quality sit down. Chef makes your own pasta in front of you and the buffet changes daily. Price is reasonable and you get a discount if you are an airport employee. If I am on this side of town during lunch it is a first choice.

place_category: Seafood, Party & Event Planning, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Mexican
text: I love Miguel's. It isn't perfect but there are many great things, starting with the cinnamony sangria, yum! The outside looks dated but inside is intimate and cozy, a beautiful bar and outside area. I like the rellenos and the enchiladas. The only thing I don't like? The tamales. Maybe it's a question of taste. They should also take the references to Kobe beef off the menu. Please! Miguel's is good to great Mexican food in a fun atmosphere for a reasonable price.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Soup, Salad, Bars, Nightlife, Wine Bars
text: Today I placed an order for pick-up. I ordered 1 pint of alfredo sauce and salad since I had previously made some pasta. I can't believe I paid $8 for 1 pint of sauce that was half way full. We will now need to figure out a way to ration the sauce in order to have enough for everyone to eat. I will never order from Olive Garden for pick-up again!!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian, Fast Food, Chicken Wings
text: Ordered a medium pizza thin crust pizza-went to pick it up $14. I ask about the 2 medium pizza special posted in front of me and I was told "oh yeah that would have been a better deal." I said why didn't someone tell me about your specials when I called the order in? Humm no response. Seemed very disorganized in there!!

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: Cozy environment and friendly staff. Food wasn't very flavorful, there is no where to stand when you're waiting-- and it gets busy so the wait can be kind of long-- it can also be kind of pricey for the amount of food served. Overall decent restaurant!

place_category: Italian, Southern, Restaurants
text: I called this place a week before coming to the city and they said that reservations weren't being taken at that time and not needed. We arrived and there was an hour wait. They should really think about adding some way to make a reservation for their guests. We stayed at the bar for a bit to have a drink and come up with a new game plan. I hope the next review I write is about the food more.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Breakfast & Brunch
text: We've visited several times and each time we receive slow service. Today the restaurant was mostly empty and it still took 15 minutes for a sandwich. Not to mention we had to flag down a server for refills, a to-go box, and our bill. The staff is friendly but it's not quick service.

place_category: Tapas/Small Plates, Desserts, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Tacos, Mexican, Food, Restaurants, Salad
text: The chicken mole was excellent. They do a great mole sauce. Loved the atmosphere as well!

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Comfort Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Tried my first ever po boy and would definitely get it again! The shrimp was fried to perfection and they are very generous with the shrimp. The only thing that was lacking in my opinion was the sauce - there wasn't enough mayo on the sandwich, which did not make it as flavorful as it could have been. There was a constant line going (about a 20 minute wait), but the food came out relatively quick. Overall, I would definitely check out this local spot and it's also nestled in a cute neighborhood.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: Great spot. Great Sunday Brunch love the space and ambiance chicken and waffles are wonderful

place_category: Burgers, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: The burgers are cheap and good. There are lots of options for toppings, and I love that they have chocolate mint milkshakes. This is a great place to have in the neighborhood to satisfy a quick burger craving. I've been here three times since we tried it a couple months ago.

place_category: Cafes, Waffles, Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea
text: Coffee was great.. however the waffle biscuits were dry with barely a filling ..and I never did find the cheese !... once you get over the novelty of everything in a waffle shape, there's not much flavor at all...would not go back

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Best quality tea & coffee in Philadelphia! Lots of organic tea too. Family owned. Experienced baristas, fun specialty drinks and great snacks. Fantastic atmosphere & music in here. There's extra room in the back for reading or games or a small gathering. Sit outside when the weather is great. Good corner spot, dog friendly. It's worth a stop and has great prices.

place_name: Bertha Miranda's Mexican Food Restaurant and Cantina
place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: I mean...service is ok. Food is always pretty darn good, but is it special? Not really. Do I keep showing up here? Yes. Why? Early 80's ambiance and great margaritas.

place_category: Restaurants, Soup, Thai, Food, Desserts
text: Server Sally very attentive. Chicken rice soup better than expected it to be. Black pepper garlic w beef and rice was grainy & tasty. The bathrooms were super clean . The presentation was sharp, it seems to charming place 2 go listen to the local students play jazz which was happening later in the evening.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, American (Traditional), American (New), Seafood, Food, Desserts
text: Love the cheesecake which is really amazing and the interior of the restaurant looks so fancy. The only thing that I complained about just the service. The food came out way too long which took about 40 minutes. Overall is okay.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Used to be one of my favorite place to go pho, but recently they increased the price by adding tax but also make the portion smaller. Usually I won't be able to finish the whole pho but now I still feel hungry after eating the whole thing. The taste is good and the food come out quick. Updated: I was there 10/26/19 and 11/16/19 during lunch time

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Delicious food, great service. We got the hot pot, it was magical and very spicy. Yelp requires this to be longer so I'll say I wish they had a basic general tso chicken but I get that this is not a typical Chinese joint and that's a good thing!

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food
text: This one has limitations when it comes to the menu. Better to go up the street to County Line.

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Was in town for he weekend of he 4th and at a tip from Roadside America I hit up Geno's and Pat's. We decided to get a sandwich from each place and eat half of each. Geno's was pretty good, but Pat's won by a slim margin. Mostly the roll and the steak at Geno's was the issue, it was chewy and tough to bite into which really detracted from the texture consistency. The meat from Geno's was also a little less flavorful. To it's credit, Geno's has the far more interesting decor.

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: Great food! Good prices, and tons of Brazilian Grocery Items and drinks and other nic nacks

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Delis, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Purebread's are not all created equal. Today I ordered a breeders combo with salad and sandwich and had to pull out several wilted greens from the cobb salad. The sandwich had very little turkey and way too much mustard in ratio to the baguette it was served on. Maybe that'll teach me just to stick with their soups. The order was made fairly fast which was nice as it looked like they were coming up on a bit of a lunch rush.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: Went here for dinner and got a pasta dish that was delicious and custard for dessert. Really liked the pasta dish and would give that five stars. Dessert was just ok same with service and atmosphere. Sat upstairs which was a less liveky than downstairs. I'll probably go back to try again since main dish was so good.

place_category: Laotian, American (Traditional), Asian Fusion, Salad, Pan Asian, Sushi Bars, Food Trucks, Food, Noodles, Restaurants, Thai
text: Had gotten the Pad see eew in the past and did not like the taste of the pad see eew, so decided to give it another shot... Got a few different things this time, hoping to like something and soup as back up, just in casd. The pad thai tasted like straight ketchup, the pad woon soon was super dry and flavorless and the the clear chicken soup tasted like chicken noodle soup, not traditional asian soup. Very disappointed.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza, Southern, Italian, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: I've taken so many visitors and clients here. Great food and drinks, excellent staff and a must-see for anyone visiting St. Pete.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Real Italian pizza ! Congratulations to Paola and her staff ; I ate a fabulous Napolitan pizza that I never ate in US.

place_category: Greek, Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Mediterranean
text: Build your own pitas! Aside from the meat sitting in a pot and not freshly shaven off, the dryness outweighed the extra tsasiki sauce! :-( The cucumbers were a good addition and the pita pocket was stuffed with meat! The fries reheated well too, the next day! Ha! Put those bad boys in foil, and in the oven, preheated on 400° for about 5 - success! Will return because of flavor and ask for even more cucumber sauce!

place_category: Nightlife, Salad, Bars, Restaurants, Caterers, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Event Planning & Services, Pizza, Italian
text: Love this place. Great pizza and Aaron and his crew are awesome. Authentic NY style pizza.

place_category: Seafood Markets, Specialty Food, Food
text: Fresh & seasoned to perfection. Friendly service on top, what a delightful experience. Not sure what other bad reviews were talking about. Great portions & amazing value. Their garlic butter sauce is a must have & an incredible compliment to everything on their platter!!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: San Gerrano PIZZA. The peppers with the sausage mixed with their sauce and crust is amazing. I ordered takeout and it was perfect with a glass of red wine. I've never dined in but love this pizza and will probably dream about it tonight. It's a MUST TRY.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Very nice place and just off the main thoroughfare, parking was in short supply but only had to walk half a block. I had the Peach Cortado, very nice! Sat outside on their deck and enjoyed the weather.

place_category: Food, Sandwiches, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Comfort Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, Desserts
text: I came here on 2/17/19 to grab a cup of coffee. However, I never actually gotten any as I was essentially ignored by the staff for a good 3-4 minutes as I stood in front of counter, while the barista at the time was busy walking between ice cream units and coffee dispensers without glancing up a single time or saying any words. For those on a budget and looking for a traditional American brunch/dinner experience within the area, there are other places that are much more amiable.

place_category: Steakhouses, Food, Desserts, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Sandwiches
text: Fun place! Nice location and theme. Great fun! People are friendly. Service is good. Food is average to maybe below average. Ordered rib eye. Not too much flavor. They need better knives. Had to tear the meat to get a bite. Potato was good and beans were ok! I have not been here in a long time because the meat cuts were not good the previous time.

place_name: The Red Cedar Grill and Cocktails
place_category: American (Traditional), Seafood, Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: This is a hard one to describe. The menu options are awesome and the food was good but the service was lacking that extra something that you would expect from this type of restaurant. I guess because the menu is a little different ( center city like) , you expect that better greeter and server. They seemed a little scattered and missing the owners presence. I'm going to give it another try just because the dinner was good.

place_category: Cuban, Food, Delis, Convenience Stores, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Loved Shorty's. Had a great Cuban sandwich and the service was friendly for Sunday lunch. During the week, I ordered at the counter and had another yummy sandwich. Excellent bottled wine selection. So great.

place_category: Restaurants, Dim Sum, Chinese, Cantonese, Noodles, Taiwanese, Szechuan
text: More like 3.5. Decided to try the beef noodle this time. Medium heat was good as was the taste of the beef. However the broth was way, way, way too salty. Shame. Also the green tea was horribly weak. And it was made with what appeared to be a Lipton tea bag.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Bars, Mexican, Tapas Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Tacos
text: Absolutely awesome place to go. Food was superb and wait staff super super friendly. Such a fun atmosphere! I love that they didn't JUST have beer. They had it all! Also got to go on a cruise that left from the brewery. Highly highly recommend if you're in St Pete's!

place_category: Sandwiches, Vegetarian, Caribbean, Salad, Restaurants
text: I ordered a 1/4 chicken all dark, with Jamaican curry sauce on the side, with rice and black beans. This place is normally very good, and still was despite the fact that all but my chicken was served cold. : ( The rice had the distinct texture of rice that had been cooled and then nuked and gone cold again. The black beans were tasty but cool. The chicken was warm. Hoping for better next time.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Vegetarian, Cafes, American (New), Food, Diners, American (Traditional)
text: Good place for the weekend brunch. But the french toast is a bit too sweet for me.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Best Chinese take out! ALWAYS nice, fast and friendly. Been eating here since they opened, and we have NEVER had a bad experience. When I want Chinease this is the place to go! =-)

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Pre-Katrina this place was an outstanding corner restaurant. My last visit in June of 2010, had me re-think my review. The locals warned me that is was overpriced but my memories persisted and I had to give it a try. A $10 cheeseburger was on a 4.5 inch bun but the burger was the size of small meatball that took up about half the bun. Very disappointing. $35 bucks for two burgers & two beers is a bit pricey for me.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Convenient location sometimes just makes all the difference. This place is right by my office and I really wanted some Chinese food. Its the standard Chinese food menu, no surprises to be seen but the food was very fresh and pretty tasty. The hot and sour soup was good, a little sweet which was ok but not my preferred way of having it. General Tso was sweet and spicy without swimming in sauce. The price cant be beat either $6.00 for lunch combo and soda

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers
text: I am at this Sonic right now just trying to order a snack and drink for the ride home, I pressed the button ten minutes ago and I'm still waiting for them to take my order.

place_category: American (New), Pizza, Restaurants
text: This is a review by a vegetarian Thank goodness there is a decent restaurant around here that is not on 130. Pizza crust is excellent. House made chips are crispy and not too greasy. Service is friendly. DCs enjoyed soup and sandwiches as well. Possible 5-star upgrade depending on what pies are like come summer when seasonal ingredients become available.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Mediterranean
text: Meh. It was just ok. Thought it would be more, based on other reviews. It wasn't bad; just not amazing.

place_category: Salad, Soup, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Been going here since it first opened and it's sad how bad the customer service has changed we sat in the parking lot for over 45 minutes for a table we got a call to head in the manager then tells us he doesn't have a table only the bar we told them we wanted a table then the manger said it wasn't he problem but let 5 guests ahead of us. Definitely not going back!

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: The food was excellent but they sold out of ALOT of things namely the cannoli which was very disappointing. Over all experience was nice good food fresh ingredients

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Nice little place with hard-working people. $13.25 after taxes for a 16-inch cheesesteak.I would rather a 12 inch roll with the meat pack in then the same amount of meat spread across a 16-inch roll. My rider really like the Abruzzi. The Pizza and specials looked good. Good overall experience.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Vegan, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food
text: Amazing egg white omelette I have been for lunch( bad cat) and breakfast( good cat). The food was perfect both times. The service impeccable. Everyone friendly and happy. Iced coconut coffee a new must have. Find the cat stamp on the coffee cups. Are you a good cat or a bad cat?

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: The view is great and that's about it. The $18 mahi mahi fish tacos were very disappointing. They had crappy ice berg lettuce instead of cabbage, the fish was in little pieces like popcorn fish, and the salsa was salty as hell. I can make better fish tacos with frozen fish sticks at home. Service was a tad slow too.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food
text: I waited 20 minutes out side the only person in line at 1100 pm what a joke of a chain for the people that work here and start over what a joke and the food sucks

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Diners
text: First time in a waffle house... Few seats in this location, but luckily not many people there so we were able to sit right down. Menu on table so quick to order... Waitress & other girls there were super nice. Food came in about 10 seconds and like most meals post surgery, I eat too fast get full off 3 bites & then cannot eat anymore. Got the biggest meal ever (still have fat girl eyes) Everything was good, Kids loved everything. Peanut Butter Waffles, IMAGINE!?

And, the oil in which they fried my food seemed fresh. The worst thing is that the food lacks seasoning: BLAH. At least the service is fast and the parking easy.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: With multiple seafood options around....not sure this one fits the bill Oysters were fresh but nothing special for 3$ per. The old fashioned was way off and the blue crab bisque had more spices than actual crab . Great fish tank for kids but otherwise complete disappointment

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Soup, Seafood
text: Quicker thank I thought! My order looked delicious but it wasn't all right, but still delicious.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: 3.5 stars Liked: Free appetizer with Yelp check in Shrimp and grits (but not as good as Luke or Pierre Maspero) Chargrilled oysters (but not as good as Acme) Crab claw (almost as good as Palace Cafe) They let you go on the balcony to throw beads Service Okay: Fried fish po-boy Royal oysters Rockefeller oysters Not so great: Waiting time for our food was a bit long and my fries were cold Still a very solid choice but there are better.

place_category: American (New), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Bakeries, Coffee & Tea
text: I come here regularly because it is on my way to the office. The food is always good, the staff is friendly, it is conveniently located. I would give this place 5 stars if they did one thing: refilled my coffee. Seriously, the servers don't ever bring a coffee pot around. Never. If I want a refill I have to wait in what is usually a long line and ask the counter person. That can't be right.

place_category: Buffets, Pakistani, Restaurants, Indian, Vegan, Vegetarian
text: The food was OK but the people there tried to shoo us out when we were eating the buffet. He kept asking "are you finished" when we were eating the buffet. I wouldn't come here again for the buffet because of that.

place_category: Specialty Food, Seafood Markets, Seafood, Food, Restaurants
text: Do not get the "Soon To Be Famous" crab cakes. They will NEVER be famous. I am scarred from that experience. Do however get the UCon roll - lobster roll with melted butter. If I hadn't had the crab cake experience this would be 3 stars, maybe. The potato salad is sweet and the coleslaw has pineapple in it - meh. Keep the pineapple on the upside down cake.

place_category: Caribbean, Comfort Food, Southern, Restaurants
text: The location, atmosphere, and owner/employees was great but unfortunately the food wasn't. Definitely not worth the price you pay. Needless to say we didn't even finish our food because it wasn't good in our opinion. The Ginger Beer was good! Lol

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Burgers, Food
text: Pros: Somewhat clean, friendly staff , solid location if you are by campus, most importantly eating 60 chicken nuggets in one sitting didn't kill me. Cons: long lines, people outside can be suspect depending on what time of the day.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers
text: I just finished the driest most overcooked Wendys chicken sandwich ever. I was also charged an additional $0.30 for my lemonade (isnt that supposed to come w the combo?). Did not believe the other reviews but i do now.

place_category: Tours, Local Flavor, Hotels & Travel, Arts & Entertainment, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Music Venues, Barbeque, Bars, Venues & Event Spaces
text: So much fun! The line dancing lessons were fun. The live band was really good!! The food was excellent. The only downside to this place was ordering food & drinks. You have to order from the bar. The line to order took 30 min at one point.

place_category: Specialty Food, Korean, Vietnamese, Grocery, Imported Food, International Grocery, Food, Restaurants, Ethnic Food, Japanese
text: They have a very large selection. It's extremely clean and organized. I think the owners really go out of their way to help a customer find an item. Even when there are language barriers. The owners really want to help. I think this is a great store. Some good fresh items and prepackaged too.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Sandwiches, American (Traditional), Hot Dogs
text: I hope all the locations don't change to the new menu. The combination of the original fries and delicious burgers was one of all time favorite in Tampa. These new fries have no taste and remind me of flattened steak fries. Even the new lettuce that is being used on the burgers is worse. Won't be coming to this locations anymore. Burger Monger please bring back the fries!!!

place_category: Food, Irish Pub, Pubs, Music Venues, Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Irish, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: This place is just fine. The small town girl in me thinks the drinks are a bit pricey, but our server made 'em strong. For a Friday night, the place was busy but not overly packed. Not too loud, plenty of space even for a larger group. O, and some good looking bartenders. Hey, gotta appreciate a little eye candy right?

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: I just finished my take out order from this restaurant. I waited 30 minutes for my order and I live 3 miles from the restaurant. The pork fried rice, ordered with no onions should have been steaming hot, instead their were cold spots in the rice. The chicken was warm but not hot. This place is very close to my house but I would rather drive further and get hot food.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: This location is very small but they are quick to get the drink orders done. Every now and again parking can be a pain in the butt because there are quite a few businesses in there. They've got a decent sized outside seating area for the size of the location.

place_name: Guido's Original New York Style Pizza Downtown
place_category: Italian, Salad, Pizza, Restaurants
text: If you're having an unstoppable craving for New York style pizza in Idaho, of all places, Guido's is about the best you'll be able to do. Expect thin crust pizza sold by the slice (about $1.50) with sauce on the sweet side and not too much cheese. You can also order soda, wine or beer from servers who are in a perpetual NY-style hurry. Keep an eye out for the totally random NY-sports-team themed wall decorations.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Italian
text: my husband & his organization go for their Xmas dinner. myself, hubby & other family members love the food. we made reservations for Easter dinner. everyone likes the food. I love the prime rib.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Fish & Chips, Nightlife, Seafood, Restaurants, Bars
text: My husband's mahi mahi sandwich was bland, it didn't have flavor. My cioppino was okay, but it had like 4 small pieces of fish and the amount of shells was good, the flavor was okay too, it could be better. The service was good and the location is excellent.

place_name: M.L.Rose Craft Beer & Burgers - Sylvan Park
place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Bars, Beer Bar, Nightlife, Pubs
text: This place has fallen off. Literally just went and sat at the bar and wasn't greeted nor acknowledged after 10 minutes so simply I left. Menu is the same stuff that it's always been. place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Comfort Food, New Mexican Cuisine, Food, Tacos
text: Family owned and operated this place is not expensive and the food portions are great. Food is amazing every time we go and it may be crowded but it's the best for drink specials and meal deals all well long. Two buildings and a outdoor seating keeps the seating open and the desserts are good for lite eaters as well.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: I like this place. It honestly has everything I would ever want in a coffee spot: great location, fantastic ambiance, good background music, well lit, warm, great drink and food selection, adequate work space, various seating options(couch,chair,stool) enough outlets to manage, games, community announcements, and fun art on the wall.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants, Halal
text: The 3 curries we ordered were decent (8/10) however the Naan bread was thin and crispy (more like a popadom) and while they quoted 45 minutes for pick up, it wasn't ready until 1 hr 15 minutes after order. I have no problem waiting for good food, but please don't overpromise and underdeliver.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Burgers, Sandwiches, Soup, Pubs
text: Small space, and the menu is a little more eclectic than one world expect. The burger they're known for is good, but if cooked to well the cheese inside will melt and squirt all over.

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, American (New), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Seafood, Bars
text: Great drinks and food options here! I'm kinda sad they didn't have the smoked fish dip like in Florida but the food selection was great. The waitress was friendly and the place was clean. The have lots of specials each night of the week and the desserts looked as amazing as Floridas!

place_category: Burgers, Pizza, Restaurants
text: just got a meal from them. I never write reviews but this food is so bad I cant eat anymore. I got a hamburger and it doesn't taste like any meat I have ever had. it is awful. place_category: Pubs, American (New), Restaurants, Bars, Breweries, Food, Nightlife, Italian
text: This place is under new management, but you'd never know it. The menu is the same and they still have a very nice and varied beer selection. I do miss the Muffuletta pizza and wish they would bring it back on the menu.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Cocktail Bars
text: Convenient late night happy hour location for $2 tacos (must eat at restaurant) and $2 tequila shots. The shrimp tacos are soft with battered shrimp, guacamole, another sauce, and mango and corn. Bar service is prompt and friendly. Love the fresh squeezed pineapple juice and the Michelada! Beware long lines and wait times...put your name on the list using the yelp app.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: The burgers are good, plus they have good drink specials. The service wasn't so good and we were backed in behind another large table and it made it difficult to go to the bathroom and get up.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Yummy! Everything we had was delicious! Biscuits and gravy, buttermilk pancakes, chocolate chip pancakes, eggs, bacon, sausage, home fries, and a breakfast burrito! Friendly service, and we only waited 5-10 minutes for a table!

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Burgers
text: Service is great - fast and courteous. Food is ok. Had a Cobb salad, everything was fresh, but not the most flavorful high end ingredients.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Pubs, American (Traditional), Restaurants

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: Eh what can you say, its Rally's. While it is not the worst fast food burger joint in the world. It is certainly not the best either. If you do drive thru you should not have that many problems. In short cheap fast food but this one is not located in the best of neighborhoods.

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Brazilian, Restaurants
text: Yum yum!!!! That's all I can say. The meat was perfectly cooked and the sides were delicious!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Szechuan, Noodles
text: They have added a few new dishes. Duck, different sausages & you can ala carte the different proteins on rice, noodles & tofu. I love their tofu dishes & soup!

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: My first taste of Philly cheesesteak was good, but slightly disappointing. I don't like the cheez wiz, so that may affect my opinion. And without it the sandwich is dry. I just don't understand the hype. And with Geno's being one of the oldest cheesesteak establishments I had high expectations.

place_category: Singaporean, Malaysian, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Thai, Asian Fusion
text: Delicious! We ordered 2 appetizers, two entrees and a tea and the bill was only $40! Roti canai is delicious, as was the fried squid. I'll definitely be back because they have a huge menu. Service was quick and friendly too.

place_category: Restaurants, Delis, Pizza, Italian
text: Not good at all I would have to say little ceasers would out do this place save yourself the trouble and drive the extra mile and go to Marcos if you want a good pizza at the same price the only reason I give 2 stars is the customer service was good

place_category: Restaurants, Tapas/Small Plates, Wraps, American (New), Burgers

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Cheese Shops, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Excellent selection of spirits, wine, and beer and gourmet foods. I enjoy being a repeat customer. Tom and Jenny are always nice to deal with and always have good recommendations when I need it, usually for wine for gifts.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Mexican, Latin American
text: Unbelievable! I'm never compelled to write a review mid meal. The freshest, most unique menu. Purely authentic food prepared perfectly with excellent presentation. The price is very fair, the amount of food you get will leave you satisfied. Just when I didn't think it could be better dessert came out. You'll never regret eating here. Family friendly as well.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Coffee Roasteries, Food
text: I absolutely LOVE the French Press. I am thrilled to find out they have another location! This coffee is the most fresh and delicious I have had in Santa Barbara. The staff is ALWAYS on top of their game, friendly and fast and the location is perfect for downtown! I especially love the outside patio seating and the mountain view!

place_category: Poke, Breakfast & Brunch, Parks, Mexican, Soup, Nightlife, Food, American (New), Restaurants, Bars, Music Venues, Active Life, Sandwiches, Tiki Bars, Hawaiian, Seafood, Arts & Entertainment, Dog Parks, Tex-Mex, Salad

place_category: Food Trucks, Restaurants, Street Vendors, Food, Mexican
text: I love TB, don't get me wrong, but lately they've been unable to fill my orders correctly. I ask for sides (refried beans and rice etc) and I always have to check my bags, get back in line and ask them to complete my order. I love love love the food and will always return for more, but I miss the days of the 4am TB run and getting my order correct.

place_category: Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Italian, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food, Cafes
text: My favorite local brunch spot, much better menu then The Turning Point which is not too far away. The specials menu changes very often which keeps me coming back for more! They recently did some decor changes which makes the place cuter then before (didn't think this was possible). Great staff and great food! Usually a wait on Sundays but they offer free coffee and water outside as you wait.

place_category: Nightlife, Food, Bars, Breweries, Pizza, Brewpubs, Pubs, Restaurants
text: I travel to Indianapolis on a regular basis, and visit the Upland Carmel Tap House almost every time. The food is always well prepared, especially like the Buffalo and Black Bean Chili, also the Bad Elmers Chicken is very good. Great selection of beers and Jason the bartender does a great job. Great environment to relax after work.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Nightlife, Restaurants, Dance Clubs, Lounges, Bars
text: Went to Pearl for an after-party and wish I had just gone home. As a nightclub, it's a little scary. Got there around 10pm and there wasn't really anyone in there yet...then, within an hour there were so many people I was scared. The scene freaked me out! I couldn't get outside without someone trying to feel me up or fight me. Plus, the drinks are CRAZY expensive ($7.50 for a bottle beer and a water). I'd rather put 6 gallons of gas into my car and drive home. Plus I got glass in my shoe. Ouch.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Steakhouses
text: Absolutely delicious! Staff were all fantastic and the setting was perfect. Great date night, thank you!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Bad service. Was served to go never asked for togo, as I was waiting on a friend at the hospital, and they gave me no plastic ware, had to ask a second time for the drink i ordered. Had a hair stuck to the inside of the togo lid was told that it was the condensation. Yea no it was a black curly hair. There was also a guy coughing behind the counter not even trying to cover his mouth. Thanks for wasting my time.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Nightlife
text: What a great reuse of an old industrial building on the Delaware! The views here, both inside and out, are great. We had burgers and drinks. The Cupcake Sauvignon Blanc was crisp and cold. Yum. The ginger pear martinis are light and refreshing. The cheeseburgers were mediocre at best. Large but not much flavor. Fries were floppy and little flavor. The tomato that came with the burger was inedible. Come for the drinks, live music and the views. Skip the burger.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Gastropubs, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Lounges, Bars
text: I really want to like Tavern, but I've given it three chances and still think it's overpriced and not all that good. It gets three stars because of its location and the BOGO drink tokens, but the food ranges from reasonably tasty to utterly tasteless depending on the day.

place_category: Cafes, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), American (New), Desserts, Bakeries, Restaurants
text: Came here for dinner with my fiance tonight. Our waiter was very nice and friendly. We got the fried mac and cheese balls which was out of this world. My fiance got the spaghetti and meatballs which he said was good however my Alfredo pasta with chicken was very bland, there was no flavor to it at all. It was not worth the 20 dollars. If we decided to come back I might just stick with appetizers and their cheesecakes.

place_category: Local Flavor, Food, Brewpubs, Breweries, Restaurants, Pizza, American (Traditional), American (New)
text: My husband is a beer fan so we go once in awhile. The food for me is just ok, and over priced.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Nightlife, Asian Fusion, Bars, Restaurants, Lounges
text: Rather disappointed. We had a party of three with an out the door price of $170+/-. The good: The wait staff were wonderful. They were attentive and very polite. The bad: the food was below average. I suspect the prep a week ahead and reheat a majority of their meats. The chicken in their stir fry was almost inedible. Their scallops wrapped in bacon were like rubber... Overall - go for the decor... But, stay away if you want good food.

place_category: Bakeries, Food, Restaurants
text: Awesome and Very Cool Bakery. Love the smell of all the fresh baked goods and breads being made. Great variety of goodies and the staff was very helpful and friendly. Only negative is that it's not on my side of town but I highly recommend checking this place out.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch

place_category: Shopping, Food, Grocery, Shopping Centers
text: I go to this supermarket often because it's very close to where I live. Never had a problem with bringing it inside. Today, as I walked in, a man, I guess the store manager, said I couldn't bring it inside. I said ok and I turned back home. Not buying here anymore.

place_category: Food, Donuts, Burgers, American (Traditional), Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Best donuts I've ever had!! I so glad we found this place!! Great environment, incredible food, unique coffee (we got the Shakerado and the Vietnamese Iced Coffee), and friendly staff!

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Mediterranean
text: This restaurant is located in the Vinoy renaissance St Petersburg. I had a good lunch. It was not crowded, easy in and out. Fair selection of moderately priced seafood and other things. Comfortable and relaxing. Great for a lunch after a morning at the pool.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Chinese

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Acai Bowls, Coffee & Tea
text: Love this place so much. Last time I went I got the nutty bowl with extra peanut butter and it was fantastic!

place_category: Bagels, Restaurants, Food
text: These are literally the best bagels in town. I used to grab a dozen and take them to work and they were still warm after a 30 months drive. The owner keeps them in a warmer. They're insanely fresh. The prices are really good too. I love their bagels.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Diners

Overall, the food was average. I'd visit again if just for the ambiance.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries

place_category: Mexican, Gluten-Free, Vegetarian, Restaurants

place_category: Sushi Bars, Seafood, Japanese, Restaurants

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Desserts, Bakeries

place_category: Restaurants, Soul Food, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Burgers, Caterers, Event Planning & Services

place_category: Food, Farmers Market, Local Flavor
text: I love the farmers market in TG. Today was my first Tuesday going and it's more laid back and chill. They set up drink holders and blankets which is a nice touch . place_category: Gluten-Free, American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Salad, Steakhouses, Delis, American (Traditional)

place_category: American (Traditional), Southern, Barbeque, Restaurants

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea

place_category: Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Cafes, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea

place_category: Bars, Active Life, Restaurants, Nightlife, Golf, American (New), Sports Bars, Food

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, Chicken Wings
text: After moving to maple shade and everyone raving about this place I decided to try it. First time got mozzarella sticks and cheesesteaks. Not good. So disappointed in this place.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: The food was good. Decor, service and location were excellent. The sound level was deafening, however. 95 decibels constant (equivalent to a jackhammer at 50' or a subway train at 200') with occasional forays into 100 decibels (snowmobile, motorcycle - a level at which sustained exposure may result in hearing loss). Making something fresh actually takes a minute.

The interior of the place is very nice and looks way fancier than your typical pizza place.
