We had to move 3 times due to wobbly table, chair or both. Just not our cup of tea (coffee) lol.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Salad, Tapas/Small Plates, Cocktail Bars, American (New)
text: Very good wine selection. Service was great. Food so-so. The menu is pretty good, just not executed well.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Local Flavor
text: I absolutely love "Harvest". Stopped by here the 2nd time this wk., this time for dinner. Pork medallions, garlic, sundried tomatoes and Artichokes! It was so tasty and the service w/ Amanda; couldn't ask for more... Came here 2 wks. ago w/ company from Colorado. Again, food and service w/ Kaylie was so good! Have yet to have had room for dessert, But there's always a next time; right?!!

place_category: American (New), Southern, Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, Bars
text: What a terrific place. Our second time eating at this establishment in two different states. The service and food were terrific. Highly recommend that people give them a chance as they won't disappoint. Thank you Tupelo Honey staff........

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Kombucha, Bars, Food, Nightlife, Restaurants, Wine Bars
text: They drew me in with the 'coffee flight' option, yet it seemed I came at a busy time, so with no tables, I opted for a togo coffee. Prices are about what to expect for coffee from a non-chain coffee shop nowadays. Coffee options are pretty decent, with some other non-coffee drinks offered as well. Friendly and helpful staff, who give you suggestions if you are unsure. Parking can be easily filled.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Food, Hot Dogs, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: The food is ok but the snoballs are seriously lacking compared to the New Orleans standards set by pandora and plum street.

place_category: Food, Acai Bowls, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: Matt, Carl, Rhi, and Dylan were all extremely nice and helpful. I have never had a better smoothie, considering I always get a custom smoothie, I was truly impressed.

place_category: Nightlife, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional)
text: We've been here several times for business lunches. The food is decent, but not spectacular. the buffalo chicken sandwich includes 2 chicken strips and enough bread for an extra sandwich. We've also been here to watch Blues games in the bar, and were not too impressed with the service.

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood
text: Poor service! Stopped in for brunch and sat at the bar! Ordered a Sprite and paid $2.50 for it. It came in a small plastic cup. I asked for a refill and was told that there are no refills at the bar and that I'd have to ask a server for a refill!! So I had to get up and walk around the restaurant to find a server to ask for a refill while sitting at the bar... Unacceptable!!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: They had so much promise. Great food, cheap, ect. But the employees. They look down on everyone. It's really horrible. seems like the classic example of a great restaurant idea that suffered from lack of attention to detail. Wish the owner would get on this employee attitude problem, 2 years ago i went there all the time; then the "troubles," I haven't been there in a year.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Buffets
text: Food was an hour late on top of their already insane 80 minute window (delivery)..called and spoke to someone when it was 20 min late, was told it would be another 20, and that to was incorrect (also didn't seem to care)..FINALLY got it and it was cold..can't believe we paid for this..and it's too bad because my wife and I love round table..will be going to lamppost from here on out

place_category: Sushi Bars, Nightlife, Asian Fusion, Bars, Restaurants, Lounges
text: Absolutely delicious! Highly recommend! Good atmosphere, great food, awesome sushi/sashimi! A definite place to visit!

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, Tacos, Tex-Mex
text: Warning, Taco Bell Springfield, TN has an employee not returning credit cards thru the drive up. Then going across the street at Walmart making changes until account in drained. Management was advised Three hours after it happened wouldn't look at video to try and catch employee. Management didn't care are help.

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Event Planning & Services, Wine Bars, Bars, Gastropubs, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces
text: This is my new favorite place for happy hour! Half off all tap wine! By the glass, carafe, or bottle. The atmosphere is wonderful and open. The food is to die for! A MUST order is the mushroom pasta, just wow. Side note, if you're lucky enough to get Chance as a server, makes the experience that much better.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Cocktail Bars, American (New), Food, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: I visited Steadfast for their soft opening. I had egg sandwich (#1) on brioche, and it was nothing short of miraculous. I also enjoyed a brulee latte. If you value quality then this is your place. You have a lot of choices in Nashville when it comes to coffee, but it seems to me like most places are in the business of pushing you out the door as fast as possible. Steadfast is a place I actually want to sit and stay a while. How refreshing.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Sushi Bars, Soup, Japanese
text: The sushi is alright but the HIBACHI has to be my favorite there. It's super delicious! I love to eat the shrimp and steak.

place_category: Fish & Chips, Burgers, Seafood, Restaurants
text: A huge helping of food. Definitely try the oyster bar. We loved the service and the food was great. A must try if you visit the 'Big Easy'

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: I just left from having lunch and had a very bad experience . My waitress was extremely rude . There were two of us who ordered the exact same drink and food item so we could not have been easier. The food was ok nothing special . Our plates never got cleared after we were finished. While we were leaving the waitress walked by us with a rude look on her face . I wish I would have walked back and crossed out her tip . Will not be returning.

place_category: Italian, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Had dinner here on a recent Friday evening. Every aspect of the experience was top notch. Papardelle and pistachio ravioli were amazing, risotto balls were unique and delicious, and the cannoli were a great new twist on an old favorite. Come with a group and share tastes so that you can sample even more delicious dishes.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Salad, Sandwiches, Food Delivery Services, Food
text: Good food, terrible and unreliable delivery. Waited over two hours for an order that never arrived.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: If you need quick Mexican, this is your place. Nothing terribly special though. Classic menu as you would expect with decent chips and salsa. A decent choice for when you live a place without a ton of dining options terribly close (hey hey Whitestown). Had chicken enchiladas with a green sauce. The sauce was decent but the chicken was dry and almost tough. I enjoyed the rice and beans though.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Chicken Shop, Fast Food
text: It really saddens me to see how the food chain restaurants just don't care anymore. This place is very clean I must say but my food was warm not hot. I sent it back and the young man was very nice and apologetic. He got me another sandwich right away.

place_category: Dive Bars, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Russian
text: I just had my 30th birthday party at Propaganda, and it was truly phenomenal. The owner and manager were so amazing and accommodating, and - as always - the food, music, cocktails, and general vibe were top notch! Literally all of my guests commented on what a great bar I selected. A great place for a party or a casual evening - definitely recommend checking it out.

place_category: Local Flavor, Food, Brewpubs, Breweries, Restaurants, Pizza, American (Traditional), American (New)
text: Reliably good beer. Nothing especially innovative but they have nice variety. I like their coffee stout and pumpkin stout the best and the Christmas Ale, which had too much spice flavor, the least. Almost all beers are $5. I only stopped in for a few beers so cannot comment on their food but the menu looks fairly standard (e.g., sandwiches, pizza). The building is huge and they do a good job of separating the dinning, bar, and outside areas so you can have either a quiet or loud environment.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers
text: I don't get all hype surrounding In N Out Burgers. Was all excited to finally be eating at an In N Out and boy was I disappointed. The service was good. We ate in. Didn't wait wait long for the food. The food wasn't bad at all. It just wasn't great like the hype you read and hear about. I went. I ate. That's was that. Have zero desire to return to an In N out.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Seafood, American (New)
text: Went last night. There was a wait but about 15 empty tables. Service was okay, food was good. Wasn't surprised.

place_category: Southern, Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Stopped in for lunch on the way back from Georgia. Great service. The ribs were falling off the bone and sweet potatoes were cooked perfect. Tried the sampler that chefs recommended. The ribs were great. The pork and the briskit were ok. I've had better. Will definitely stop on the way back for more...

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: Location and convenience is all that Great Scot has going for them. I'm guilty of using them just because I'm too lazy to go anywhere else. 12.99 for Aleve? Dealing with rude employees and snooty people that are also shopping there? No, thanks. My husband and I bought a pack of ground beef with an expiration date of two days from the date we bought it on. When we tried to cook it the next day it was brown and rotten. Gross. I'll stick to Fresh Direct or Whole Foods from now on.

place_category: Donuts, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food
text: They refused to fill my travel mug. They said they only use their own disposable mugs. The manager was rude and the place was nasty. Hit up the one on broad instead...

place_category: Greek, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Gyros. Gyros. Gyros. Possibly the best in the city. "So why only three stars" you ask? This place has possibly the worst bar I've ever seen. Overpriced booze + under experienced bartender = regret. Come here for dinner, then hi-tale it to a place with a better selection and drink specials. seriously though, come her for the gyros.

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Performing Arts, Arts & Entertainment, Hotels & Travel, Food, Convenience Stores, American (New), Beauty & Spas, Restaurants, Museums, Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Cinema, Resorts, Day Spas
text: Greed has an address, and it's here. Arriving by car? $23 per day to park (this is Nashville, not Oslo). Wifi? That'll cost ya. Even a Pepsi in a machine is $3. If Marriott and Hyatt can crack the code on providing great amenities at a reasonable cost why can't this place? At least they don't have a coin meter on the toilets (yet). Oh, but beautiful facility. It really is.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: My husband and I finally tried this place after hearing about it for years. The staff were very nice and helpful but I was not all that impressed with the fried chicken. It as kind of bland in my opinion. I like the cole slaw and my husband really like the chicken.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food
text: I've been to this coffeehouse many times. Usually I have a good experience--the barista I typically is friendly and cheerfully makes my drink. This evening the barista did not even speak to me, but just stared blankly at me as I approached the counter. I wasn't even sure if I should order because I felt so out of place. He made my drink while another employee rung me up. She was nice. It was such an odd and out of ordinary experience for me at Rue. I usually find this place peaceful and quaint.

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Expensive drinks $15. Mediocre food. Thet were out of 2 entrees I ordered. The view is beautiful. Had the lobster Mac n cheese, the chicken sloppy nachos and the French dip.Nachos had very little cheese or sour cream and the Aus jus for French dip was bland. All the food was pretty terrible.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers
text: Fun place with interesting menu of "you should try this once". Service was good - great attitude from all the staff. Enjoyed breakfast before checking out the Jonny Cash museum.

place_category: Mexican, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Tuesday at 2:00. On my burrito young man gave me very good portions and the young women Who rocked my burrito did such a good job wrapping it, itjust feels so good my hand. Jobs so I thought compelled to write a review. keep up the great work thanks .

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries, Food
text: Been wanting to try Our Daily Bread since it appeared on a nearby corner. Was disappointed with my first visit. Terrible place to sit on the corner of De la Vina and Alamar. The food was a bit overpriced and it took 25 minutes to get an omlet. There was no service. Cute orange chairs though and a good local brand.

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Soup, Food, Bagels, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Bakeries
text: I wasn't allowed to put my initial reaction to Panera without Yelp prompting me to clarify if I was reviewing in German or Dutch, but here it is: EW!!!! Unappealing, smelly, devastatingly highly caloric food. For the love of all that is holy, please roll down to Wegman's, make yourself a nice salad with veggies and light dressing. This place is absurd. Or go to Cosi...the TBM light is like 350 calories...much less terrifying in my opinion.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Great concept, subpar execution. I brought my Mexican parents here and they laughed at the food. My American husband thought the food was fine. If you know what authentic Mexican food is and are looking for it, look elsewhere. If you don't fall into that category, you might think this place is the bomb.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Soul Food, Fast Food, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional)
text: Just here over the weekend, and I can NOT stop thinking about it!!!!!!!! The best food ever!!!!!!! Chicken tenders, biscuits and red beans & rice were to die for! I am totally baffled by the negative reviews. A must try, and I will be back on my next trip!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Burgers, Fast Food
text: We stopped for milk shakes. Service seems to be slow. On the other hand, it is Saturday afternoon. The cashier wasn't too nice either.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries
text: I arrived around 9:30am on a Monday and was seated right away. My waitress was happy and helpful and recommended the sweet potato pancakes with cinnamon syrup. I ordered those and a side of hash browns. The order came with five medium sized pancakes, which were indeed very good, but the hash browns were pretty bland. I'd probably come back for the cinnamon syrup, and the service.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Event Planning & Services, Specialty Food, Food, Caterers, Cheesesteaks
text: Classic Philly cheesesteak was a 10/10. Bread crunchy on outside and soft inside. Served in legit 2 min during lunch time on a Tuesday. Would eat again... and again

place_category: Seafood, American (New), Steakhouses, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Got the hot chicken biscuits and they were incredibly dry. Nothing to rave about. Service was bleh. This is just a very mediocre place and it's overpriced.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars
text: My fiancé and I decided to try this place for the 1st time Friday night. Between the wood decor, TVs and people talking it was very loud in there. Service was slow and the waitress screwed up my order. Maybe she didn't hear what I exactly ordered due to the noise level. My fiancé order chicken wings with celery. They charged $1 for the celery and at one of the pieces was brown like it was going bad. Not a place we plan on going back to.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Hot Dogs, American (Traditional)
text: Burgers are delicious with homemade chips! Even did curbside during this pandemic and drove 30 mins home and still great!

place_category: Comfort Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Chicken Shop, Sandwiches
text: Good place to go for "home cooked" meals (Get it to go and fool your friends and family into thinking you whipped it up yourself!). Casual atmosphere. "Home style fast food" is how I'd describe it. friendly employees. A tab overpriced, but I really like their meatloaf . Kid's meal available, and self serve refills. My only gripe is the decor. Dining area needs serious remodeling. Ugly avocado-green uncomfortable upolstery for the booths. And awful music; thank goodness the volume isn't max.

place_category: Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Tacos, Mexican, Seafood
text: Nope! Not a fan at all. The food is moderate at best! Although it seems to be a major happy hour place and maybe that's why it was pretty busy when we went there. It's just not good. If you want Mexican food go anywhere but here. If you want happy hour drinks go here. Not a fan, probably not gonna be going back anytime soon.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: I love the Vanilla bean Frappe which my friend Jeremiah introduced me to. Friendly staff and clean store. I love the smell of coffee but I don't drink it

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Went here the other day and was underwhelmed. The burgers were pretty salty, and the flavor was okay, but nothing to make me want to go out of my way to order again. The fries were decent, and the food came out pretty quickly, but It isn't anything special. If you're hungry, it will work to satisfy you, but if you want something special, I'd try elsewhere.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Barbeque, Pizza, Chicken Wings, Burgers
text: If you want a delicious, huge salad, this is your spot!!!! I get the salad with a tuna or salmon. The tuna steak is cooked to perfection and the salad ingredients are crisp and fresh. I have read other reviews stating that the customer service" was subpar, I completely don't agree. They are friendly and the food is always ready for pickup when I get to Wingers.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Cafes, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Vegan, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Beer Gardens
text: I've loved the food here each time I've came with my partner for breakfast/brunch... however the service is weak at best. The first time we went we had a bartender/waitress who was cordial, inviting and genuinely polite and engaging. The other times we haven't had her and have been disappointed.. I have to scratch and claw for a coffee refill every time. The waitress at the bar just kinda goes through the motions. Still enjoy the breakfast, but think we'll try somewhere else from now on.

place_category: Caterers, Venues & Event Spaces, Breakfast & Brunch, Gastropubs, American (New), Restaurants, Food, Event Planning & Services, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: Food was very bland. And service took forever. Kitchen didn't seem to communicate with the servers.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Food, Women's Clothing, Shopping, Accessories, Men's Clothing, Arts & Entertainment, Arcades, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Venues & Event Spaces, Specialty Food, Waffles, Restaurants, Fashion, Clothing Rental, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Such a fun place! Free video games and old fashioned ice cream sodas with a updated twist. We loved our milkshakes, though I couldn't finish mine! I forget what they were named, but I had the reeses cup mix and the man had the oreo cookie one. Both were super delicious, but very rich. The space is so cool -- lots of old school video games and even a nintendo upstairs. We had a great time!

place_category: Sandwiches, Delis, Restaurants, Soup, Salad, Food
text: Absolutely egregious sandwich. I ordered some sort of vegetarian sandwich on focaccia bread to go. Upon opening it up at home, I found one thick slice of molding cheddar, a slice of tomato, and a few pieces of lettuce between the bread. And that for $11. Terrible, terrible experience. Enough to scare me off for the foreseeable future.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Fast Food, Italian, Chicken Wings
text: This is the second time I've had a horrible experience here. The workers are rude and unfriendly. They take your money and then tell you that there is a 15 min wait. Why not tell us that before and suggest something else? We asked them this today and the worker said "yep" and slammed the window in our face. That was terribly rude and the owner needs to fix it here because apparently I'm not the only one.

place_name: Karma Juice Bar & Eatery - Saint Petersburg
place_category: Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Acai Bowls, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Breakfast & Brunch, Vegetarian
text: Best place for Vegans in St Pete. All their options are fresh and the staff is amazing!

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Restaurants, Hotels, Event Planning & Services
text: This is a great hotel/casino restaurant. The service was perfect both times. The food was great. If they still have it, try to get the 'early ' 2 for 1 dinner. What a deal if you don't have comps already! And they didn't treat us any different than on the full price night. Worth a try!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: As a thick crust lover, obviously I wasn't blown away, but I was definitely impressed with the selection of pizzas. I don't think I'll be back, but it's a cute little place if you're headed through Newtown.

place_category: French, Restaurants
text: Exceptional service, bright, clean, and inviting atmosphere with delicious food. I would love to give it 4.5 stars only because I thought the warm potato salad with the pork schnitzel could have had a touch more flavour but the pork schnitzel itself was very delicious. I would 100% recommend the Marc and think it's well work what I paid. Thank you everyone!

place_category: Bubble Tea, Vietnamese, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches
text: Banh mi nasty I saw a post from the newspaper that this place is one of the best in st Pete obviously people here have no idea what good is

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Burgers, Food
text: So everytime I get off work I decide if I want to go get food and I like to be able to go in and eat I can't do that at this restraunt because even though there lobby hour are from open to close which is 11 pm more often than not they close there doors 1030 or sooner which means long lines at drivethru . Probably just gonna take my business else where for now on. I get that they get really busy but that's why you hire accordingly especially on weekends.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Italian
text: Went to Magiano's with my mother on her b-day. The sandwich I had ordered was WET at the bottom and cold as if it was taken out of refrigerator. The waitress never refilled my drink and showed up only once to collect our payment. The whole experience was very bad. I am not going there again.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: The atmosphere is very beautiful! On Sundays they have brunch from 11am - 4pm with a live DJ. However the brunch menu could improve. I think the brunch menu is very scarce and they were out of a lot of the food (French toast, potatoes)on the brunch menu. Please improve the menu and add more brunch items to the menu. The Common is way too nice to not have an excellent menu.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Bars, Pubs
text: Got the grilled chicken wrap with cheddar and added bacon. Delish! Everything is chopped which makes it easy to eat. Good size portion!

place_category: American (New), Steakhouses, Seafood, Restaurants
text: JAlexanders on White Bridge Road disappoints. The food, service and ambiance are consistently excellent.

place_category: American (New), Southern, Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, Bars
text: I want to like this place (any location) but after 4 visits I have to throw in the towel. Consistently service is always slow. Now the biscuits have been reduced in size by half and aren't good anymore. It is so overpriced ($4 for a side of sausage that is one patty that is burnt). Vibe is great and is is clean but is just not worth the time and money. If you want breakfast better worth it to go to First Watch (better food and much quicker service)

place_category: Food, Burgers, Restaurants
text: Its an acceptable burger but it doesn't give me that post burger eating period of happiness. It felt almost healthy which I never want with a burger. Their regular fries were nothing interesting... in fact I don't even remember them. The milk shake is good though. The real rouge burger (at $19) is really good though. I was hoping for something more like that (what was I thinking!?).

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Soup, Restaurants, Cafes, Sandwiches, Bakeries, Salad
text: Horrible customer service. Ordered two drinks on their app for curbside pick up. Waited 15 minutes and gave up. Left without our drinks.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Chinese
text: We even paid for rice and they didn't send any with the delivery. Such a bummer. Otherwise, I would have been pretty happy.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Not sure why this was rated so high, maybe because the fancy artwork on the walls? Anyway, I drove out of my way to try this place and the food isn't really that bad, but it could use a little more something. Also, the limes they give out for the tacos are teeny tiny, and drop out more lime seeds than juice. Nothing is more fun than using your fingers to dig seed out of your taco, right? No sexual innuendo was intended in that last sentence. Ok maybe a little.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Best Fahitas love this place! Will I be back absolutely. Friendly servers. The place is always clean pay them A visit. They will not disappoint. Great food!!!! My children love this place. If you live in Collinsville keep them in business.

place_category: American (New), Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Atmosphere decadent, food tasty, but seemed to take longer than expected to arrive. We had chicken and a dish of beef tips and gnocchi.

place_category: Food, Mexican, Restaurants, Seafood, Desserts
text: One of my favorite places in SB. Got a lot more hype after it was featured on Diners, Drive ins, and Dives, which I was very happy for them. My parents it here once a week and its a family that runs it so they really make you feel like you are part of the family. This is the one place my father will go for his menudo so if you are a fan defnitley try this spot out. Can't go wrong with any of their burritos and the spanish rice is phenomenal.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Soul Food, Nightlife, Food, Desserts, Bars, Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: The service was amazing, atmosphere was beautiful, and most important of all the food was beyond description of amazing flavors. Definitely a great choice.

place_category: Restaurants, Thai, Taiwanese, Japanese
text: Fantastic. Great hole in the wall type of place, with a neighborhood vibe. Fresh summer rolls are very tasty. Panang Curry is actually spicy, flavorful and a great portion. And the tom yum soup was delicious. Will definitely eat here again! Basil Leaf has practically everything you could ask for in a thai / japanese restaurant.

place_category: Soup, Restaurants, Vietnamese, Vegetarian
text: Love this place! The rice bun sliders are fantastic. It's super clean, and the staff is amazing. Go eat there!

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Coffee & Tea, Cocktail Bars
text: Nice place but the barista had a really nasty attitude. Would rate higher if they were nicer

place_category: Salad, Italian, Restaurants, Wraps
text: Excellent flavor well prepared food. It resembles a Italian flavor Qudoba. I had the Chef's favorite Piada with calamari. It was preferred perfectly. The only negative is that they can get back logged preparing the food. This place is definitely some place to go back to.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Very average. Not much more to report. I ordered beef and broccoli and it was just okay. Served fresh

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Not the best place for breakfast but in a pinch it worked for me a few weeks ago when the place I planned to meet for an appointment was closed. It's clean and the price is right for a meal. Polite staff, but they have the appeal of a midnight truck stop.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Mexican
text: i've been here six times, and the food, service and amazing cocktails have always been very good. the sangria is second to none, but at $25 per pitcher you may not be ordering too many. my favorite is the baby octopus appetizer and the free salsa verde and chips you get upon your arrival. perhaps my favorite Mexican cantina in Philly.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Unique brunch items wit a hippy feel. Staff were very friendly and food was tasty. The original baby Dutch pancake with ham was delicious and huge! Exceeded my expectations!

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Cafes, Comfort Food, Vegetarian, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Never disappoints!! Love their breakfast options! Highly recommend for those lazy days when you don't feel like making breakfast! They're stuffed French toast is out of this world! And their tatter tots are to die for!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Hands down worst waitress I've ever had. No plates or utensils. No refills. Hassled us to order. While we were still eating, she asked if we needed a box and brought us the check. Came back several times to see if we paid. Then, she stood by the table and looked at us while we were getting the money ready. She needs to find a new job because she sucks at her current one.

place_category: Desserts, Food Trucks, Cupcakes, Food, Bakeries
text: I also had a baffling experience with the older gentleman who works there, so I think that it is hilarious that others have mentioned him. His gruff and unfriendly manner was not what one would expect at a quaint cupcake store. I even tried to joke him out of his chronic bad mood, but he clearly does not lighten up easily. If he ever has a day off, these cupcakes are pretty awesome...although I'm one of those people who want the piece of birthday cake with the icing rose.

place_category: Fast Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Hot Dogs
text: It's worth the trip to another Wendy's. Easily the worst fast food restaurant in the greater New Orleans area. Routinely out of everything (tonight it was EVERY salad). Employees are almost always new and are asking their supervisors basic questions (tonight it was 'how do you mark it no tomatoes?'). Almost always have long wait times for simple orders (tonight the woman ahead of me got 2 value meals with no special instructions & received her food 20 mins later).

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife
text: $4.99! I come here in remembrance of my parents. Service is great and you cannot complain about an entire meal for under $5.00! This is an old faithful to fill your tummy. Good and nostalgic!

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Comfort Food, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Diners, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Don't go expecting an American traditional diner. This is the hipster-foodie version. Your cravings for the authentic cup of joe with a side of town gossip will be left wanting. If you go expecting the new age millennial version of Waffle House, well you might have met your match.

place_category: Delis, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Sandwiches
text: Great place, awesome staff and a great place to enjoy a meal. One of the best delis to enjoy a meal that I've ever been.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Gastropubs, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Lounges, Bars
text: We ordered the nachos, mussels, fish tacos, bazooka toast, Tuscan kale salad (with a side of tuna) and the trail mix salad (with a side of chicken). The only thing that was good were the mussels (which came with a nice big side of baguette bread with garlic butter). Everything else was mediocre (nachos that didn't come with guacamole or sour cream) or actually bad (trail mix salad). I'm sure there are better options in the area. 4 stars is way too high for this place.

place_category: Grocery, Food, Drugstores, Shopping
text: This particular acme seriously lacks good customer service. Everyone is miserable there and have no problem showing it to their customers. Not a nice place to shop

place_category: Restaurants, Diners
text: I would give it a -0 if I could!! My friend ordered a salmon salad,it had 2 small pieces of fish with mostly chopped romaine lettuce. I'm sorry but $18 for a salad and they had the nerve to charge $2.50 for some garlic bread which had no taste!! I ordered a bowl of homemade chilli which was canned bs.chilli. I sent that back!!!I regret going to the charcoal pit down the road which is AWESOME!!! AVOID THIS PLACE SERIOUSLY!!!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: A decent place to get sushi in Northwest Reno. The menu has all the standard rolls of sushi you'll find on any all you can eat sushi menu. There are misspellings all over the menu. The rolls themselves had a lot of rice and not so much fish. Service is just okay, both for the servers and the sushi chef. I would go here again if I need a quick fix for sushi, because their prices are reasonable.

place_category: Afghan, Restaurants, Halal
text: Was looking forward to this place. I had a $5 off $10 certificate from restaurant.com to use to try it out. Went in and ordered $13 worth, presented the certificate and was told "Oh sorry we don't take that, we told them to take it off the site." What? I printed it two weeks ago, and as of today, they're still offered on the site. Good job guys, you not only lost a customer, but got a bad review, all for the low price of $5!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Fast Food, Burgers, Coffee & Tea
text: Smallest McDonalds in the world? Anyways, if they made up in other things it wouldn't of been so bad. But it was not the case. Not only are their prices super high, the food was not fresh. The fries tasted like they were re-fried, and the lettuce all wilted. And they don't even give refills on the drinks! This place is probably only in business because it's the only fast-food restaurant in Clearwater Beach.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Specialty Food, Food, Mexican, Restaurants
text: The restaurant is a bit "chain-y" and not quite authentic, but they deliver a nice, fresh meal. Healthy options are available (which isn't always the case with Mexican restaurants) and they are willing to work with dietary restrictions. Nice happy hour. Good for weeknight Mexican when we don't feel like driving to Los Amigos in Dunedin.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, American (New), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: I am a fan, but some days... Waitresses need to learn to mix drinks - please. love the prices, but shouldn't have to tell you how to mix them. Need to keep menu items on stock. sometimes have to make due with what they have available. Always good food though. Friendly staff! My kids loved this place!

place_category: Dive Bars, Bars, Seafood, Nightlife, Restaurants, Mexican, Lounges
text: A charming little local spot. Mostly bar, part restaurant, part dance floor, part community center, this is a place where locals come to be. They catfish was great. It's nothing fancy, but it's a place for honest folk.

place_category: Restaurants, Gelato, Coffee & Tea, Food, Italian, Bakeries
text: I ordered takeout and only got 1 out of 2 items. I ordered the caneloni pesce and gran panna cotta and didn't get the panna cotta :( the caneloni was packed in a thin plastic container and bag so it arrived sad and cold. Maybe it's better for in person dinning..

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Event Planning & Services, Party & Event Planning, Bars, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces
text: It's one of "those" places you have to go if you visit NOLA. I can see why the locals avoid it, however. The hurricanes taste like kool-aid, rum, and more sugar. Overly sweet, but they sure pack a punch! The piano players the night we went were pretty lame as well, as was the service. Perhaps it was an off night...three stars for giving me a buzz and having a beautiful courtyard.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Music Venues, Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Food, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Nightlife
text: Food is decent. Nachos are great!! If you're from out of town and are a Florida Gator football fan, You must come here to watch the game. King Gator is unlike any other. He hypes the crowd during the game with his microphone, does Trivia and raffle tickets. I'm not even a Gator fan and I was rooting for them. This is the definition of Saturday's in the South. Food is good, beer is cold and you can't beat the view.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Service was warm and attentive. The gumbo was very flavorful but better with the addition of the house hot sauce. Best flavor was the etouffee and shrimp creole. The wine list includes a nice reasonably priced Malbec that complements the strong flavors. Unfortunately the jambalaya was very dry and the pecan pie had been heated in the microwave, a food crime confirmed by the waitress.

place_category: Food Stands, Salad, Event Planning & Services, Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Caterers
text: Tried this place out tonight; my fiancé and I love that's it walking distance from our place! The 2011 salad and Hot Mama pizza were both awesome. I thought the breadsticks we ordered were kinda plain (just dough, not seasoned) but the red sauce that came with them was tasty. Awesome little patio too!

place_category: Wine Bars, Salad, Restaurants, Nightlife, Soup, Italian, Bars
text: Waited 20minutes just to get our initial drinks. Was walked by and not even acknowledged by at members of the staff numerous times. Food was ok, but I was also pretty hungry.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Latin American, Tex-Mex, Mexican
text: Food was not good!!!!!.. I will not come back meet is dry and looks like its been sitting for hours no flavor.. Chicken doesn't even look like chicken.. Ask a question and get no response from staff.. Save your time and money go somewhere else...

place_category: Bakeries, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Restaurants, Food
text: A busy place on the weekend. The wait wasn't too long and the service was good. The breakfast comes in every form imaginable. Tried the pot roast for a change of pace. It was very good except for the rice which should never have been served, definitely not fresh. The bakery is excellent and the prices are reasonable.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: This place was awful. It is WAY overpriced- like $5 or more for any plate compared to other Thai restaurants. Also, my plate of food was absolutely tiny. When we asked why it was so small (for $15!) the man told us that everything is pre made and sized. There's no way. And it was so salty! Even my boyfriend, who likes salt, though so.

place_category: Szechuan, Bars, Lounges, Nightlife, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Chinese, Karaoke
text: Really nice for wheelchair access. They havea large room downstairs you should request if you are unable to climb a flight if stairs.

place_category: Wraps, American (New), Vegan, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: We ordered the Casa Mexicana Bowl and Asian Salmon bowls. They were fine, not great. We've for sure had better bowls in Tampa. However, the salmon was a big portion so they definitely didn't skimp on that. There is a neat general store which was cool and unique. It'd give it a try but temper your expectations on the food.

place_category: Restaurants, Mediterranean, Greek, Kebab, Steakhouses, Sandwiches
text: A 11:17 am on August 23rd, My granddaughter and I walked in and a Girl yelled from the counter that they couldn't serve us cause they were too busy with online orders! She then told us to come back later! Food is normally good but NEVER going back there again! I usually eat they about 4-5 times a month. ($24 x5)x12=$1440 a year... plus that's if I don't have family with me . No way to treat a customer!

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: Not a bad place to grab some Mexican bar food and drink a margarita...had a few nights here that I remember walking in and not walking out. Definitely not anything special, but maybe that is why I like this place. Solid beer list as well. Overall a two-story low key bar to drink with friends. I would say this is an ideal pre-game bar/happy hour bar. I would consider myself a fan.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Great Mexican restaurant. Lots of authenticity in the preparation of the food as well as top ingredients. Good lunch crowd and the double fajitas were plenty for two. This is a gem of a find and we will be back many times. Food was served quick and hot and our server was excellent.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: We went to Etc often for Sunday brunch when we lived in Nashville and wanted to leave a 5 star review! The food and service were exceptional, it truly is a little hidden gem in Green Hills!

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Seafood, American (New), Steakhouses, Lounges
text: Made reservations here for our Anniversary. The staff were very friendly and attentive. Ribeye steak, scallops, and bacon bread were delicious! We also received complimentary champagne, which was nice. Entree sides and calamari appetizer were just okay. We took leftovers home for later and found a piece of plastic in one of the hashbrown patties that came with the scallop entree. If it weren't for the plastic, I would give 4 stars.

place_category: Barbeque, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: I had the fire grill t bone steak , salad and baked potato. Medium well cooked perfectly and tasted good. My waitress was pleasant and the place was clean. I will be back!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Hotels & Travel, Hotels, Restaurants, Bed & Breakfast
text: Will never stay at this hotel again! It's right on Bourbon st. We decided to stay because of the reviews. We stayed 4 nights and two of the four mornings there was construction right outside our room. I called to complain and they said they were sorry. Are you kidding me ! Finally after calling twice they offered a breakfast. I will never stay here and I will never recommend this place ever! We travel for our business and have stayed a lot of places. This is a first and a last!

place_category: Mexican, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Nightlife, Restaurants, Soup, Salad, Vegetarian, Sports Bars, Tex-Mex, Bars
text: We stopped into the Adobe Cafe for drinks and karaoke, and the place was near empty at 9pm, though completely packed by 11pm. The selection was decent, but lacking in updates, and several of the karaoke videos did not contain some key lyrics, which we didn't know until we got up there. Nothing's worse than freezing in front of that many people! My Ketel/soda was pretty strong, and the beer pitchers were plentiful. If they had a better karaoke system, I would have rated it higher.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Pasta Shops, Italian, Specialty Food
text: I agree with the previous poster that this is one of the best Pasta House locations. Our waitress, Erica, is always nice and on top of making sure our drinks are topped off before we even ask. The food is always very good. The only drawback is the prices, which for the chicken parm. I like is $18. If it was a little bit cheaper, I would give 5 stars. I do have to say that the portions are large and I always leave full.

place_category: Diners, Indian, Food, Shopping, Personal Shopping, Food Delivery Services, Restaurants
text: Skip it. Have eaten here several times over the past couple of years. The proteins are dried out and completely blackened. The appetizers tasted like leftovers from last week. Seriously, don't pay attention to the good reviews. Total waste of money.

place_category: Vegan, Restaurants, Food, Vegetarian, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: I'll start by saying I'm not vegan. I'm not even a vegetarian. But, this place does it right. The good is great. There is always a generous portion. I've never seen one wilted veggie and the presentation is always pretty. I've always been full afterwards with a happy belly. It's a place I would recommend to atleast try. I think people who aren't vegan/vegetarian might be pleasantly surprised with how much they like it.

place_category: Food, Italian, Restaurants
text: We were looking forward to a nice dinner at Tre Lune for our Anniversary. Unfortunately we were very disappointed. Our waitperson was very cold and abrupt with our service. There was simply zero interaction. If this was a diner I would overlook this but not a restaurant serving a community such as Montecito.

place_category: German, Restaurants, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, French, Brasseries, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The staff was very friendly and knowledgeable. I had the Shrimp and Grits...these were by far the greatest Shrimp and Grits I have ever eaten. I would highly recommend everyone try this place, you will not be disappointed. This was my favorite meal in NOLA, and we had some good ones, until this greatness.

place_category: Buffets, Middle Eastern, Halal, Restaurants, Indian
text: Its ok. Ordered Naan & Paneer Tikka Masala and they were fine. I was disappointed but had high expectations after reading the reviews. I will say, I order mild in Indian food and discern indian restaurants by which are able to offer a lot of flavor without the heat. This food had some flavor but I've had better in the area.

place_category: American (New), Automotive, Caterers, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Comfort Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Parking, Sandwiches, Beer Bar, Vegetarian, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: Their strawberry lemonade is AMAZING. But their food is average. We ordered chipotle pork (dish not sandwich) and steak and egg sandwich. Both of them were really basic, nothing special. It was like it was missing something and food was lukewarm. I would come back for the lemonade but not for food.

place_category: Bagels, Food, Sandwiches, Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Love everything bagel!!! Bagels are fresh well made and taste amazing. Cream cheese is very rich and the staff is always friendly

place_category: Grocery, Restaurants, International, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Ethnic Food, Food, Specialty Food
text: Caution, the spaces in the parking lot are *very* narrow so it might be smart to park farther out from the store if you want to be able to open your car door and get in when you are done shopping. My car isn't that big but I got boxed in and could not open my door until the next-door car's owner came out.

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), American (New), Desserts, Bakeries, Restaurants
text: Took my favorite meal off the menu (Thai Salmon) said it wasn't popular. It was hard to find on the menu. Don't think I'll be going there as often. So disappointed!

place_category: Food, Desserts, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Greek, Italian
text: Very good food, reasonable price, friendlyish service. Not over enthusiastic review, but truly worth your time. Go and enjoy.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Very good gourmet sandwich shop. The prices are a little more than you will pay at any of the chains, but the sandwiches are fantastic and probably big enough for a couple of meals. I finished mine, but felt like I needed a nap afterwords.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Ala carte menu, nothing extraordinary, just good, decent food. Had a cod sandwich with citrus marinade and a side of jasmine rice. Portion sizes were reasonable. Would go back to try a few other items on menu.

place_category: Grocery, Delis, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Specialty Food, Food
text: Ordered 1/2 sandwich for lunch, had to purchase the whole roll to get it. Did not much enjoy the sarcasm when told why. Good food, but over priced.

place_category: Restaurants, Irish, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, Irish Pub, Pubs
text: I saw a roach and mouse under one of the tables in bar area! I know this a city bar but that is unacceptable.

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, Pizza, Chicken Wings
text: Thank you to the wonderful people at pizza baron we have been ordering weekly from them we love there pizza expensive and super fast

place_category: Food, Grocery

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Seafood, Bars, Nightlife, Pubs, Caribbean
text: We love their Fish Tacos. I tried shrimp taco which was also great. The service is always friendly and pleasant.

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Cocktail Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, Bars, Comfort Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: My first time here, after we were seated at our table took a very long time for somebody to come and actually take our drink order. The fried pickles were good just not very many. Then it took forever to get our food I actually had to ask if it was ever coming and when the waitress came back with it she said oh yes it was sitting in the window my fries were cold but my burger was excellent. I will probably give them another shot because the burger was good.

text: Half-price cans on Wednesdays is the best, especially now that they have the entire Sly Fox product line. Small, can get crowded, especially happy hour. Good burgers..

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Delis, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Event Planning & Services, Coffee & Tea, Food, Caterers, Restaurants
text: Ordered through Uber eats and Moxies forgot part of my order. I called to inform them and they were very dismissive and rude and told me to handle the issue through Uber. Their apology was very insincere. Aside from the rudeness, the bagel sandwich I ordered was soggy and not toasted.

place_category: Malaysian, Nightlife, Bars, Salad, Cocktail Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Japanese, Restaurants, Ramen, Filipino, Pan Asian, Chinese, Asian Fusion
text: We love hawkers, but it always takes so long for our server to see us when we sit down. It took 10 minutes our last visit to even have a staff member see us at our table.

place_category: Burgers, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Lounges
text: This place is successful because of its location in Hillsboro village within walking distance of Vanderbilt. Otherwise, the food is pretty good to mediocre. The mushroom spinach wrap and salad were decent, great for a business lunch or a casual late-night bite with drinks with friends, but not a place worth traveling across town to. There's an outdoor section, as well as a bar. Pretty standard American place.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Nightlife, Bars
text: This location is on Par with most other Bonefish Grills. The service was very good and so was the food.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Delicious food, horrible service. It took us 3+ hours for 4 adults ad 4 teens to eat. It took 30 minutes to get our check after we finished dessert and asked for it! It was almost like our waiter decided we weren't going to tip and forgot us. We were a table with 4 former waiters so we are generally big tippers. We also felt pressure to order extra appetisers and desserts. We won't be back.

place_category: Food Trucks, Restaurants, Street Vendors, Food, Mexican
text: Make sure you get an itemized receipt. The cashier threw an extra couple dollars on my bill. My quesadilla 6.99 and drink 1.79 and my bill 11.54???? I didn't want to cause a scene but I don't plan on going back.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Korean
text: Today I was there alone for lunch. I walked in. Waited 2 minutes before deciding to seat myself because the host wasn't at the front. Three other Korean guests walked in after me. As I waited for the little dishes, I see the short hair waitress serve the korean men across from me then she proceeded to bring another tray out and walked passed me to serve the other Korean guests. I was served last to say the least and I'm pregnant! I know I'm not overthinking it but that's just rude and ignorant.

place_category: Electronics, Drugstores, Discount Store, Food, Department Stores, Grocery, Shopping, Fashion
text: This store is horrible. Every time I go into the store and grab what I need, I spend more time standing in line to checkout then I do actually getting what I need. They have 25 registers and two employees working them. The line to checkout is always wrapped around the store. Hire more employees and use the registers you have.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Fish & Chips, Nightlife, Seafood, Restaurants, Bars
text: its seafood about as interesting as the color of oatmeal. everything here is alright. the wait is alright for the alright view, the prices are alright for the alright clams, alright clam chowder, alright fish, and alright steak. As average as a 1999 Chevrolet Impala.

place_category: Japanese, Food, Restaurants, Salad, Sushi Bars, Desserts
text: Great shrimp shumai, portions of hibachi are large with lots of zucchini ,a few pieces of other veggies, and short on the more expensive part of the meal the entree. Sushi was good, not great. Pineapple dessert is canned.

place_name: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers and Brews
place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants
text: We try this place every once in awhile and are never impressed. Takeout has been less reliable sometimes we don't get exactly what we ordered. Today the food was so tasteless I didn't even think it was possible. I have no idea where they source their ingredients but they are not good quality. I don't expect to go back.

place_category: Delis, Restaurants, Grocery, American (New), Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: we've have been coming here for years and really looking forward to their bagels with fresh salmon. I think it's called The Garden bagel. They happen to be out of salmon and unfortunately their bagels were not nearly as good as what we had in the past. We usually like our bagels with the jalapeno cheese and these were just terrible the ground up jalapenos and dried out cheese. I think we'll be looking for another place for breakfast unfortunately

place_category: Nightlife, Cafes, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Bars, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Salad
text: This place is great bar in NE philly that has a great beer menu with a lot of good events. Went there last spring and won WMMR BBQ tickets at event. I recommend the chicken quesadillas with whatever beverage your want. I recommend always using beer menu to see what the rotating taps are.. nice outdoor seating too.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (New), Bars
text: Nice place and nice beer selection. Staff is distantly friendly and polite and efficient. The food was not very good though. The calamari was overcooked and the nachos had barely any cheese. I am still tasting the bean concoction they put all over the otherwise crunchy possibly homemade tortilla chips. Pleasant time but should have eaten somewhere else.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I'm a sucker for outdoor seating, so when I saw this place I immediately pulled my friend over to have lunch with me. Bad choice. This place is extremely overpriced for the amount and quality of food you get. I ended up ordering just a glass of wine and taking a couple of bites of her food. Everything I posted pictures of, plus glass of cheap house wine.. cost over $80 with tip.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Nightlife, Burgers, Bars
text: Food was descent. Ordered a margarita and felt like I drank a glass of orange juice. The price you pay for the drink and the taste I might as well of just ordered a fountain drink. Ask to add a little bit more alcohol to at least taste like an alcoholic beverage and they won't and then they want to charge $6.99 to add. First place Ive ever been to that would not take what I ordered back to help the situation.

place_name: Z E N Thai & Japanese Cuisine
place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Thai, Japanese
text: My pineapple fried rice was excellent! My kids said their sushi and soup were "okay". The service was very bland, but attentive. I would give them a second try. Don't let the outside fool you...give it a try for yourself!

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, French, Nightlife, Bars, Southern
text: I really liked the atmosphere of this place. It supposedly has great fried chicken, although I did not order any. Instead, I had the cajun burger. Yum. It was spicey and all around yummy. The interior was dark and a bit gloomy, but I still liked it because it had character. The service was excellent. More of a mom-and-pop than a touristy spot and that's the way I like it.

place_category: Latin American, Bars, Restaurants, Mexican, Nightlife
text: Really disappointing. The salsa was fermenting. I haven't seen that before. Bought chips. How can you not make your own. The entrees were ok at best. I had the mixed Mexican plate and my age had the tacos. It seems much more Mexican than Asian Fusion. Oh well.

place_category: Wraps, Chicken Wings, Cheesesteaks, Restaurants, Pizza, Salad
text: Love this place but... they always run out of my favorite pizza and they are so busy they take the phone off the hook for hours so I end up ordering from somewhere else which is frustrating because It's hard to find a good pizza place in this area...

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Noodles
text: インター入り口のガススタンド脇にある中華料理屋です。 ガソリンスタンドまで車を入れないとお店を見つけるのが難しい場所です。 Combo plateは2itemで、$6.25。 麺類は$6.75。 両方とも安くてボリュームはありますが味は微妙な感じです。

place_category: Food, Thai, Restaurants, Desserts
text: Wow! This place is freaking AMAZING! Ordered the flower dumplings & vegetable spring roll appetizers, then entrees were the Seafood pasta Special - includes scallops, mussels, shrimp & salmon, pad see you (they spell it that way) with tofu, & pineapple fried rice with beef. Everything was ridiculously delicious. I'm visiting from California & this place beats some spots I've been to in LA. Alao, the Thai iced tea & thai iced coffee were great. Definitely recommend

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: The service from the phone to paying and waiting was terrible. The pizza was fine that is what pushed them up to 2 stars. This place has gone downhill, I don't know if it is new ownership or management, but I was terribly annoyed by the service and couldn't wait to get out of there and that was just on a call ahead to go order.

place_category: American (New), Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Good and comfortable. I would recommend based on my first visit. Look forward to trying more if their seafood.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: So sorry to have to do this, but this gyro was the worst I have EVER had. The gyro sandwich was a combination of onion, warm tomato, lamb and SOUR CREAM!!! Seriously, no tzatziki sauce or lettuce?! They honestly thought I couldn't tell the difference between sour cream and true tzatziki sauce?! Wow. All I can say is that I will NOT be returning.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: I consider myself a bit of a Pho fanatic. I just moved back home to New Orleans from Houston. I immediately wanted to find my go to comfort food. After reading reviews here, I gave Ba Mien a shot. And I don't regret it. The broth is AMAZING. And their to-go containers are genius. You just add the broth to the meat and noodles. The bowl is the perfect size, and it's reusable.

place_category: Casinos, American (Traditional), Pizza, Arts & Entertainment, Sports Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: The ideal sports bar. My wife and I stopped in here and loved it. Damn good food, lots of drink options, plenty of TVs with the games on and fast service. We ended up going two days in a row because it was so convenient to everything else in Fishers. I'd recommend the fried chicken sandwich with cheese curds on the side- can't beat it. We make our way through Indy a few times a year and will keep coming back here.

I ordered the steak yaki udon which was pretty bland. I wouldn't get it again :(. Fiancé ordered the hibachi shrimp dinner. He really enjoyed it, and I tried some of the fried rice which was good. Maybe I just need to order something different next time? I do think it is a little overpriced though... To be determined on if I'll be making a trip back here!

place_category: Restaurants, Gay Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Mediterranean, Hookah Bars, Middle Eastern
text: Yes, yes, and yes!!! This was the sweetest little gem nestled just off of Mass Ave, and I loved it. To start, service was great! And the prices were even better! But the icing on ttbe cake??? A fire dancer!!!! Yes.... dancing... with fire!!!! The entertainment simply added to the experience and the flavor of our fruity hookah. We sat outside, enjoyed the sounds of the city, and inhaled the lovely aromas of citrus! I'll definitely go back.

text: What can I say. The meat keeps on coming and coming and its delicious :-)

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Seafood, Buffets
text: While the food is good, I felt as if the price is not really worth it. The number of strange rolls outweigh the amount of nigiri sushi which can be disappointing at times, and the hot dish buffet seems quote mediocre (although most people will probably go for the sushi anyway). If you're craving sushi, go for it. I was impressed to see a plethora of exotic pieces as well such as ikura and uni, but I think this place is really meant for fusion roll fans.

text: Might be the best Cheesesteaks in the world. Excellent little dive, playful funny wise ass service. Be careful parking, hidden handicapped parking sign snags many folks and they are quick to tow. Happened to me and is happening now to this poor guy.

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Lounges, Modern European, Nightlife, Bars
text: Absolute favorite restaurant. The service is always fantastic in the restaurant or the bar, and the food is consistently great. The plates are well thought out and creative, and the serving sizes are larger than most upscale restaurants, so the locals won't be disappointed. Great date place with good drinks and atmosphere. The ahi tuna twists are a must, as are the pizookie and creme brulee, which is the best in the city in my opinion.

The other times I've been, usually the staff is slow and doesn't look at you at all during conversation. They don't even give you a water cup here! It's astonishing how poorly this location is run.

They offer almond milk in addition to soy here & I love that.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants

place_category: Food Trucks, Restaurants, Street Vendors, Food, Mexican

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: This seems to be the place my friends and I always end up after Mardi Gras. It's really not as good as IHOP, however, and I protest every time but end up getting outvoted. You get a big stack of pancakes, but really there isn't much flavor to them. You'll fill up on them, but not necessarily in a satisfying way. Service is mediocre; you usually have to ask if you want something.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: I am a fan of frozen yogurt and the pay by weight model. This was my first time in a Yogulatte. The man that was behind the counter was very nice and helpful. I thought the place was okay, the actual yogurt selection seems a bit limited compared to other places I have been. I think they counter this by providing many flavors for smoothies and drinks via Monin syrups. I ended up getting a pumpkin spiced Yogulatte which I thought was pretty good, although a bit pricey.

place_category: Cuban, Caribbean, Cafes, Restaurants, Latin American, Spanish
text: Didn't want to fight for parking or the crowds downtown so I looked for something on the outskirts of Tampa. Very glad I found this. The cuban sandwich is very good and very filling, pressed cuban bread as an appetizer hit the spot. Well worth the short jaunt off the interstate.

place_category: Mexican, Pizza, Restaurants
text: Fish tacos were great, as well as the happy hour shrimp ..guac was brownish and bland, salsa seemed to be mostly water, would have not minded except for the fact that it cost $10 +. I dont mind paying for a decent taco, but gouge me on mediocre chips and dip? Foooor shammeeee!

text: Atmosphere was very very nice. Dress code enforced which made it more enjoyable and a fun experience. Please please be prepared to spend $100 MINIMUM per plate. The starters are tiny but delicious. 3 scallops for $25 or so. But tastes amazing. The show was nice. Had a horrible experience at the bar next door. Magic show was very fun. Management was helpful when valet took off with my keys till 5am. Horrid experience there but HOC itself was nice.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Buffets, Japanese
text: This buffet is pricey compared to all the other one's. We paid $84 for two people. Maybe the reason was because it was seafood Friday. All you can eat crab, shrimp, etc. We definitely ate our monies worth! They had a great selection of food choices from Mexican, American, Seafood, Indian, and more. They catered to almost everyone's taste preferences. They open at 430p, but make sure you get there early to line up, because the line gets long by 345p.

place_category: Burgers, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: We decided to come and give the impossible whopper a try. So we went to the drive through and We ordered a medium meal with a large water and the drink that came with the meal was a sprite. The whopper was good but not great, it didn't have much flavor but a nice alternative to beef. The food was hot and well prepared but the sprite didn't have any syrup so it was carbonation water so we had to throw it away. But other than that the meal was fine

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Restaurants, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Burgers, Event Planning & Services, Bars, Nightlife

Thanks JP and girl with glasses!

The decor was super nice and the service was great!

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: I have had many fun nights here! The drink and food prices can't be beat! If you feel like trying a new beer or mixed drink to see if you like it, this is a great place to experiment. The bar is large and nice, though it is usually packed on the weekends. The food is your typical restaurant fare but they do it both well and cheaply! The cheesesteaks are one of my faves here! The staff is friendly and it's a great place to people watch! Expect a wait if you go on the weekend-it's a popular spot!

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Coffee & Tea, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Cute little restaurant and bar a bit off the heavy touristy areas. My boyfriend and I found them on yelp and headed over after a night walkling tour. The place was mostly empty (on a Friday night no less) but we had a seat at the bar. The good was good and freshly made, the drinks were good too. It was a refreshing change after the noise and crowds of the rest of the day. The crawfish egg rolls were particularly good and we upgraded his fries with gravy and fried cheese curds.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Bakeries, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food
text: Typically great. Love the food. We all finished our breakfast and no toast or scones or bisquits yet. Same for whole restaurant. Food coming out slow, and it appears that the kitchen is having major issues. Sad as I love this place.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Nightlife, Food

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Bars, Nightlife
text: The food was OK, nothing special. The staff were very nice. We won't be going back because while we were eating a customer, whom I would guess is a regular, came into the bar area from the patio. He grabbed for a glass from the stack on the bar accidentally taking two and put one back on the stack. He opened the ice freezer, not located behind the bar, picked up the scoop and put ice in the glass, all while chatting with the bartender. Don't waste your time on this place.

place_category: Food, Convenience Stores, Coffee & Tea
text: Don't go here! I'm a student at Temple University. I would've given them less stars if I could. The owner kept on being racist towards me the entire time I was in the store. From the time I entered the building to when I finally left, he kept on trying to speak to me in an accent and bowed towards me, then refused to give me a bag. The staff usually close the store for a few hours of the night to 'restock' and are rude towards customers. Please don't subject yourself to these people.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: I've been coming here for years. When Sake House first opened, it was visually and culinarily unimpressive, and I wrote them off. I started coming back around 2010, and they've really upped their game. Their servers are friendly - their English isn't always perfect, but their fantastic smiles and great service more than make up for it. Great food at a great price!

text: a FIVE DOLLAR Kombucha?? And a delicious breakfast burrito. Enough said.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Being of Italian extraction and from New York, I judge an Italian restaurant initially by the quality of the bread and then the tomato sauce. Both stink at this place. Buy the bread at Publix, for goodness sake. The sauce tastes like thick, sour tomato paste. Dark dungeon atmosphere. Wouldn't go back.

place_category: Shopping, Grocery, Fashion, Food, Department Stores, Discount Store
text: Sadist behind counter sadist behind the counter indeed. want to be treated like crap? come shop here.

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: There's a minimum you have to order to eat here. No problem. The food was average. No problem. At least give me freaking hot bowl of pho or a bigger bowl dammit; the broth was bland. The spring roll could use a lot of work. My first impression wasn't great, and I don't intend to come back. Back across the street...(I was nice enough to leave 3 stars --- punk)

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Burgers, Fast Food, Coffee & Tea

place_category: Fast Food, Mexican, Tacos, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Burgers
text: Perks-open drive thru 24/7! A lot better than where I live in Philly... Cons on this visit - feel that we were rushed for no reason, and also the large fries were only half full. Still pleased overall, and glad this addition came to the area :)

place_category: Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Pubs, Breweries, Food, Local Flavor
text: One of our favorite chill brew places in Nola. Check out their record collection. Beers were excellent. The tasting room is small but nicely done and there is a big open area outside to enjoy. Some people bring their own chairs. No food but there is a food truck on site. Great weekend getaway.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Awesome customer service! Just passing through land needed a coffee fix! Beautiful scenic drive off the beaten path of Interstate 40.

place_category: Food, Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Mexican, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Not nearly as good as other options in Nashville. Most people that I know that rave about this place mainly go there to drink. First of all cold flour tortillas do not a taco make. Not that they happened to be cold, this is their intention - blah. Also, the ingredients don't seem fresh at all. Tried the brisket once and I couldn't even chew the meat. I've never left a Mexican or tex mex place without finishing my food, but I have here at least twice.

place_category: Specialty Food, Active Life, Hotels & Travel, Car Rental, Sporting Goods, Day Spas, Trainers, Pilates, Food, Beauty & Spas, Health Markets, Gyms, Fitness & Instruction, Massage, Shopping
text: This place has been stealing my money for the past 4 months. I have repeatedly walked in to talk to management about discontinuing my membership and they always seem to be on a "lunch break" or out of the office. Very rude employees I constantly hear profanity and inappropriate talk for the work place around there customers. I would highly recommend staying away from this place.

place_category: American (Traditional), Greek, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The crab bread is always a 11/10, but other items are pretty hit or miss. Same with service, but this picturesque neighborhood spot is definitely not a bad place to go for a simple night out.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Salad, Seafood, Bars, Nightlife
text: Just moved to Oro Valley and have tried a few places, but all came up lacking. Until we went to La Hacienda. The food is absolutely wonderful. The service is exceptional. Prices are reasonable, but the best things is that the food is very good. So, even if you think the price is high, it's worth it. In addition to some wonderful food you get a beautiful view of Santa Catalina Mountains. We will be back!

place_category: Sandwiches, Salad, Restaurants, Delis
text: Went on a Sunday at 1:30 and the place was hopping. They handled all the orders quickly and our food arrived quickly. Good food.

place_category: Pizza, Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Italian, Restaurants, Cheesesteaks, Food Delivery Services, Cocktail Bars, Sports Bars, Food, Bars
text: Ordered fresh made pie, not reheated slices. Some of the best pizza I've had in philly, because of the tasteful and crunchy crust and good amount of toppings. Had a Cowboy steak with no BBQ sauce and couldn't stop myself at two slices. Got the same pizza again with bbq sauce and it was just as good so now I do half and half.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Thai
text: The food was not authentic and not very good. I shared the plate with my kid and i still couldnt finish my plate bc it was soo dry. I ordered the spicy noodles by the way. Would i come back? No. Fried rice was ok and pho was ok. Just ok but not delicious.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Food, Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Breweries, Bars, Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces, Pubs, Brewpubs
text: A nice spot for a New Orleans lunch. The balcony is a great way to get up above the crowd and see a bit of the riverfront. Fresh oysters are shucked at the bar. Beers are freshly brewed. The Weiss is a nice light way get a midday refresher.

place_category: Diners, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Mexican
text: Had the one pound T-bone steak, cooked on point but lacked seasoning. Service was mediocre nothing to get excited about. Drinks were good, overall the price is not worth it. I've had so much better for less...On a positive note there are many other eateries and bars nearby within walking distance.

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Comfort Food, Sandwiches, Canadian (New), Coffee & Tea, Diners, Restaurants, Desserts, Vegetarian, Vegan, Breakfast & Brunch, Gluten-Free
text: I really want to love this place. Which is why I keep going back. And it's fine. You get decent food. But I always leave somewhat disappointed - whether I come for breakfast lunch or dinner. It's fine, but I keep expecting it to be great. And it simply never is great. Just fine. The decor is fabulously funky, and the service is really good. But the food? It's fine.

place_category: Diners, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: Who doesn't like Denny's? We end up here when we can't decide where to get lunch. It's totally good enough. Artery clogging goodness. It's like hugging an old friend. You know just what to expect.

place_category: Bars, Italian, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Pizza, Restaurants
text: Great food and ambiance at this hip bar in Rock Hill. Décor is more upscale and it has a nice patio. Just feels a little out of place in a larger strip mall area. Lots of beer selections, albeit a little over priced. Long bar takes up a lot of space and the bartender takes a while to walk end to end. Pizzas are great, with a lot of interesting combinations with fresh ingredients. Happy Hour was recently changed to 3:00pm to 5:00pm so not really a happy thing for those of us working until 5:00pm.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Great waterfront view. Eat downstairs and outside for best views. Same food downstairs as in dining room. Okay seafood. No real veggie choices as either a side or entree. Good fried food on the water is what this is

place_category: Food, Bubble Tea, Chinese, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Hot Pot
text: Really great food, good service, but if you've never had hot pot, bring somebody who has and they can teach you.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Brazilian, Salad, Steakhouses, Venues & Event Spaces, Gluten-Free
text: We came here for my birthday for lunch and the meat had a disgusting flavor that made me instantly nauseous. I tried a bite of every type of meat and didn't like any of it. Such a waste of $30 for just eating salad and sides. The cream of jalapeño soup was actually really good though. Other than that, I was very disappointed, Fogo is way better.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Diners, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Venues & Event Spaces
text: Nice happy your specials along with great drink deals. I recommend the tuna . Or try 1 of there house pizza's . Good crowd . Worth a try.

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), American (Traditional), Bars, Event Planning & Services, Beer Bar
