text: Now I hate to be a pub snob but being from Philly where amazing gastro pubs are a dime s dozen it's very hard to rate a sub par bar but here goes...Good beers on tap, very average bar food and it gets way to crowded on the weekends since its basically the only game in town. Its the next step up for UD grads who are now total yuppies looking to get drunk and shovel some quesadillas or greasy burgers into your head...

place_category: Chinese, Soup, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Seafood
text: I'm giving this place a 3 because the food is good but I tried to order online and the refused to deliver my food .. because I like 4.3 (I gpsed it ) and the delivery range is 4 miles unfortune they miss put off like 900 potential family's that live in the towers

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Make sure to Clairify you want it to go or you'll end up with a soggy waffle bowl and rude customer service.

place_category: Cafes, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Hookah Bars, Middle Eastern, Mediterranean
text: Great place with some good music. Nice place to smoke some hookah and have a drink before going out. Deff will come back next time I come to Nashvegas

place_category: Desserts, Bubble Tea, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: $4.75, cash only, got me a standard taro smoothie with boba. The boba was extra sweet and the taro was average. This place pales in comparison with other bambus. Minus one star cuz average, minus another because it doesn't live up to the name.

place_category: American (Traditional), American (New), Burgers, Food, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Stopped at the 'top for a quick lunch. Grabbed the chefs special. Patti melt and fries. Shake. Really good. Frostop is largely overlooked but it actually value for price. Staff was great and very attentive. I don't get by often but I did enjoy my experience today.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Pubs, Restaurants, Nightlife, Belgian
text: Mussels good, beer warm, bread super disappointing (wanted a crispy piece of bread, got a dried roll), flies everywhere couldn't eat my fries because flies landed on them. Even moved my seat to try to avoid them. Service bad and they gave me the incorrect change (to their favor) and didn't give a care when I told them.

place_category: Salad, Soup, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Comfort Food, Burgers
text: Incredible food and great service. Had a late dinner and was surprised to learn that the restaurant is open until midnight. The food was fresh and hot.

place_category: Candy Stores, Specialty Food, Books, Mags, Music & Video, Food, Bookstores, Shopping, Local Flavor, Souvenir Shops
text: You've got to try the chewy pralines. I didn't see them for sale anywhere else, and they're bomb. The prices are a tad high; it's a definite tourist trap, but they offer a nice selection. Many different flavors of praline, and plenty of samples.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: The restaurant definitely has good services and ambience. It was located in the center of French Quarters with the local vibes. Unfortunately, the food was unpleasant and overcooked. The rices in the gumbo and jambalaya were dried and hard as it was old and left on the stove. The baked oysters were burned and heavily garnished with seasonings.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Really cheap, and this is the biggest advantage of this restaurant. But the food tasted...not that good. We ordered chicken noodle soup, fried beed dish and wonton soup, and both of us think that they are not delicious enough. But considered the price... it worths.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Fast Food, Caterers, Mexican, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants
text: I always enjoy the food here. I did notice that the staff member cooking the chicken had long hair and facial hair and no hair net. As a matter of fact, none of the staff handling food had on a hair net. I ordered the burrito bowl with cilantro rice, black beans and tequila lime chicken. I topped it with queso, roasted chili corn, salsa verde, shredded cheese and guacamole. I scanned my app and scored some points for free food. It was a to go order.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Nightlife, Salad, Bars, Food, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Gastropubs
text: Short rib tots are amazing! So is the shrimp appetizer! Great food and great ambiance! Will be back!

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Geno's... Oh you mean the giant bug light and mess at 9th & Passayunk? Skip it there are much better cheesesteaks in the city. The locals don't go to Pat's or Geno's but if your going to go... I vote Pat's!

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers
text: Would include a picture of my burger, but I ate it too fast, haha. Great quality food, great quality service. High quality soft buns, perfectly cooked patty, good proportion of toppings and sauces. The sweet potato fries are clearly homemade and are really good too. It's a bit of a trek from where I live but I'll definitely be coming back.

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Dive Bars, Restaurants, Food, Nightlife, Chicken Wings, Sports Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Pubs
text: awesome place for bands !!! the staff is awesome and the food is awesome too !! the girls there are very friendly and awesome....stop in and have lunch...they will treat you right !!!!

place_category: Mediterranean, Delis, Restaurants, Hot Dogs
text: This place has definitely gone down hill. I used to think they had the best gyros around but the one I had today was borderline awful. The pita was soggy, it was drowning in tzatziki sauce and was impossible to eat. Wont be going back anytime soon.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: A friend and I went to see the drag show on Tuesday. They asked for our I.D. and my friend is not 21, but said she was just there to watch to the show. We were still denied even though the week previous on Tuesday myself, the same friend, and entire group of underage people were allowed in to watch the show. The lady asking for our I.D.s said no one is ever allowed under 21 after 9 pm which is apparently untrue or last week someone wasn't doing their job.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Definitely not coming back here. Awful environment and overpriced even for the portions. It took forever to get our food. Tacky and overwhelming decor. The menu was limited and the dishes were mediocre. The one positive thing about our experience was our waitress, Lexi, who was very nice and personable.

place_category: Health Markets, Grocery, Specialty Food, Food, Farmers Market, Shopping, Vitamins & Supplements
text: I drove 25 minutes because of a recommendation from a friend. I needed 10 lbs of asparagus for a party and when I arrived and saw what they had, I was upset I had wasted my time. They were thinner than pencils, dried up bottoms and seeding heads, completely inedible. The produce manager needs to look at product before accepting it.

place_category: Spanish, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Tapas Bars, Iberian
text: I love how high end this place is! We came for brunch one weekend when we were staying in the neighborhood which opens late at 11 even though it says 11:30 on yelp. We were hungry but we decided to walk around only to be told we needed a reservation when we returned. We got a nice bar table so that's wasn't bad. The plates are mostly tapas style so small but delicious and great service.

place_category: Sandwiches, Food, Restaurants, Donuts, Coffee & Tea
text: There is not much to say that hasn't been said before, it's an institution. I will comment on this location though. For some reason unknown to me this I the local biker hang out in the summer. So if you have a bike like me and want to meet some fellow riders this is where they hang out. No drive through but 2 tills that are pretty quick.

place_category: Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Delis, Restaurants, American (New), Food, Cafes, Desserts, Coffee & Tea
text: Just getting to this, 01.22.18. It was my first visit to the cafe, told the guy at the counter that as well. He seemed put off and offered no welcome or explanation of how their process works. It is not a typical setup and the menu is hard to read. The barista that made my coffee was pleasant, the food was decent and reasonably priced. Maybe the crewcut guy with glasses was just having a bad day, but he shouldn't greet customers, as first impressions do count. Not sure if I would go back.

place_category: Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Irish Pub, Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Irish, Music Venues, Restaurants, Pubs
text: The "Pub" Burger with pesto and roasted red peppers was amazing! Blackened chicken sandwich with blue cheese was also good. Skip the Irish Nachos because they have liquid cheese (ew) and the chips that come with sandwiches are tasteless.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Very friendly staff and homey place. Food was very good and even got a huge cinnimon roll for first visit

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Spanish, Cuban
text: It's good but don't expect any mouth-gasms from this menu. I had the grouper bites with lemon zest aioli. I'm a bit iffy as to whether it's worth $11.90, though the grouper is the most expensive appetizer. Service was on the slower side of reasonable at 2pm on a Saturday.

place_category: Specialty Food, Delis, Coffee Roasteries, Butcher, Meat Shops, Food, Restaurants, Grocery, Italian
text: Wonderful assortment and quality. Just plain fun if you love food,

place_category: Delis, Restaurants, Salad, Sandwiches
text: Paid $13.73 for half sandwich with "premium" meat, cup of soup, and iced tea. Got a large plate with two tiny sandwich quarters and barely any meat or veggies. It was like having two small finger sandwiches at a wedding or funeral. Too pricey and unsatisfying. Won't come back.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Cajun/Creole, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Southern, Seafood, Dive Bars, Barbeque, Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, Music Venues, Bars
text: Went here for dinner the other night. Food was bland and over cooked. When I complained about it to the manager, bill, he was very disrespectful. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Burgers, Fast Food, Restaurants, Food
text: Stopped in for a quick breakfast, apparently that is somewhat lost on this place! No one at the counter ever! They just look at you and ignore you! Finally used the kiosk, which I don't mind but why not hang a sign saying to do so instead of people looking around and waiting. Food was good and order was correct.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Caribbean, Music Venues, Bars, Pubs, Lounges
text: At times my home away from home... Love the mosaic so much I decorated my house after my favorite hangout... the art..music..food..and people.. Love-em all. Most unique club in St. Louis!!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, Sandwiches, Salad, Seafood
text: The food here is really good. We went to eat dinner there Sunday, April 17th, 2016. The hostess was extremely rude to us! We walked away and went to a different restaurant. The food's not that good that I'd put up with ignorance.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Pizzas awful reminded me of chuck e chees pizza, super thick sauce is dry. Wings were under cooked had to put them in the oven

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Salad, Sushi Bars
text: The sushi was yummy and the staff was very nice. I came with a group and everyone was very happy with the sushi they ordered.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Cajun/Creole, Seafood
text: I cannot complain about one thing I ate. Everything was great. The drinks were potent (in a good way) and the food was flavorful and hot when brought to the table!

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Now this is really good food from people who CARE. Does anyone realize how important CARING is when it comes to making food. You know why home cooking tastes to good? Because the person making it (usually Mom or G-Mom) cares. It's made with love and this food is made with love.

place_category: Sandwiches, Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Nightlife, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Salad
text: Why doesn't this nearly brand new place have more craft beer options?! Fingers crossed that there will be more the next time around. With us visiting during SEC time, I understood the craziness and the major lack of seat options. And the fact that everything seemed to be tossed around. Hopefully during my next visit I'll have an all around better experience. :) And I'm sure I will. It just honestly wasn't very "ohh ahhhh" for it being listed as hot and new. So .... to be continued!

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: Service is ridiculously slow! Waited over 30 minutes to get an order of wings. The place needs a good scrub down. Floors are slick with grease and grime and there isn't a trash can around. A table wasn't cleaned the entire time there. Wings were ok. Definitely not worth the wait and they forgot our celery.

place_category: Indonesian, Singaporean, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Specialty Food, Food, Ethnic Food
text: I brought home fish and their beef curry and both were a big disappointment. The fish smelled so bad that we had to throw it away... what a waste of money...

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: If you have lived in sparks for a while you know this place has been consistently great. The service has always been great and quick and the quality of ingredients is great. It's on the thinner side for crust but not too crispy with the options of rojos as a side really makes an oddly great combination. I've been going here for over 15 years and I hope it stays around longer than that

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, Food, Bars, Burgers, Pubs, Brewpubs, Nightlife
text: I had a 1/2 nachos for lunch but it was really big still. Why not a separate lunch menu? Empty growlers on the table, so tempting. Nice pizza oven, and a full sized computer cabinet in the dining room. COol.

place_category: Pubs, Dive Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Burgers
text: I used to come to this place years ago when it was the fatted calf. Now all I read was about how great the burgers were. When I was entering the door, two guys told me that I had to get the Peanut Butter and Bacon Burger, so I did. I have to say that meat and peanut butter do not mix well. I was very disappointed. Service, mac n cheese, and beer were all great.

place_category: Restaurants, Tiki Bars, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Burgers, Food, Local Flavor, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Tex-Mex, American (New), Music Venues, Caribbean, Pubs, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: I guess I should have known better than to come to a beach and order a steak being that I'm from Illinois. I would have loved if the server asked me if I wanted something else but she was quick to drop our check and take payment even though my plate was completely full and so was my mixed drink.... just totally dissatisfied. My dinner and mixed drink should have been taken off the check.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Burgers, Food
text: RUDE EMPLOYEES! There are some very sweet employees but most of them are rude. To the nice employees who make it enjoyable to come to McDonald's thank you. But to the rude employees that work there go find a different job to where you don't have to deal with people because your people skills are not great.

place_category: Burgers, Hot Dogs, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Restaurants
text: This is a very cool date night idea. It is iconic and the ice cream is great. Because of covid there wasn't the line they normally have so we pulled over. I got the chocolate swirl and my boyfriend got the dip. They were both great. The line moved fast and we could easily socially distance from each other. There was plenty of parking. I'll be back.

place_category: Southern, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: I had really high hopes based on other reviews. It was okay. The most disappointing part was that our food was served cool. My husband had the biscuit with sausage gravy, which is not appetizing when it's cold. And the gravy itself isn't that good. Cheese grits were also cool. I understand preparing food beforehand to deal with a busy crowd, but at least heat it up thoroughly. The chai tea latte was really good.

place_category: Gluten-Free, Barbeque, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Hawaiian, Sandwiches, Bars, Nightlife, Vegan
text: Solid food. The sauce was underwhelming....tasted all the same. Wait staff was amazing....and definitely a fan of the slaw and cornbread.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food
text: OVERPRICED and not worth it!! The only thing they have worth eating is the carrot cake pancakes but the rest is just small portions and way overpriced.I had the eggs benedict and that was not even passable with hardly any sauce and they put greens on it ?? Sorry but not a fan Ill go to wolfs den around the corner and have a great breakfast x the size for alot less

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Hot Dogs, Burgers
text: Always been a fan of Burger Monger. I can't believe they stopped making the fresh French fries and gone to frozen ones. Definitely a let down.

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole
text: Best fried chicken I've ever had. We easily got a seat on a Sunday morning at 9:30am and felt welcome like family. We will absolutely return!!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Fast Food, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Saw this while walking the mall and figured let's check it out! Haven't been to a sushi place like this since Japan. We had some plum wine - delicious - and a few plates of sushi that were good. Would like to go back and try some other dishes.

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Specialty Food, Bagels
text: A treasure. Best bagels ANYWHERE. Not just in Philly, best ANYWHERE. New York, meh, Montreal, feh, Elkins Park! EPFL! Crunchy-crusted bagels with moist, airy interior. Cloudlike Challah. Perfect cookies and other little treats, and never a doubt about their commitment to their craft and community. Just about the greatest bakery ever.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Wine Bars
text: Found this restaurant using Yelp and was not disappointed. Started with the truffle fries which were to die for. We followed with the beet salad-delicious. The main course was the broad noodle with chicken-perfection. Dessert was a glazed donut bread pudding with toasted coconut topping and a pile of real whipped cream. This was one of the best meals I have had a in long time. The waitress was very attentive. I definitely recommend this as a must try!!

place_category: Noodles, Restaurants, Chinese, Asian Fusion
text: THE BEST in Reno. If you haven't eaten here, you're missing out on the freshest, most delicious fine Asian cuisine around. Great service too. Run... don't walk to get here!

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Kosher, Burgers, Tapas/Small Plates, American (Traditional), Vegan, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Vegetarian
text: Great ambience. Grumpy waitress. I'm GF and there aren't any protein options for me there. And when we asked she was like. Nope. That's our menu. Which is code for tough shit.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Great Chinese food and American food. Tiki bowls are boozy and delicious for a great price. Love the lunch and dinner buffet, very affordable and filling. The steak and lobster dinner is fantastic.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Coffee & Tea, Burgers
text: Decent coffee for Tucson. They have quite a few options and a drive thru! I enjoy stopping by here when I am in the area. They are friendly enough and seem to have quite a few choices. Glad to see another coffee option in Tucson.

place_category: American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants
text: I just sat at the bar for the last 2 hours & SARAH waited on me & she was DELIGHTFULL. We talked like we were old girlfriends. I highly recommend sliding up to the bar & striking up a conversation with her.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: 74 dollars for a grilled fish that is not deboned at the table by staff? And when I appeared incredulous that the fish would not be deboned, the staff just ignored me. That sums it up. Don't get me wrong, the food is solidly good. Not outrageous by any means. But to make guests pick out bones from a 74 dollar fish is just outrageous.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: This is a no. Had high hopes, but not one of the many things we tried was good. Done were not edible. The tamales were microwaved with hard spots (like you get when you microwave). The tacos tortillas smelled faintly like cleaning fluid when you put them close to your nose on the way into your mouth. Not very appetizing. Lengua (beef tongue) was tough. This is a one and done.

place_category: Soup, Chinese, Restaurants, Seafood
text: I'm still searching for the best Chinese take out in the Greenwood area, but this isn't it. The food was pretty standard - good selection on the menu, but nothing really sets it apart. My noodles were too salty. The rice was average. I did like that they put corn, peas and carrots in the rice. Usually don't see corn in Chinese rice. I may go back, but will try other places first.

place_category: American (New), Nightlife, Chicken Wings, Bars, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Took my boys for a little family dinner. Oh boy was that a mistake! The only interaction we had with the staff was while we were being seated. We waited at our table for 15 minutes for someone to come get our drink order or even food order or even to acknowledge us as customers in their restaurant nope didn't happen so finally I got up complained to a manager and walked out. No way was I gonna spend money at a place that can't even provide a friendly smile or atmosphere.

place_category: Greek, Persian/Iranian, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Indian
text: Came in a weekday afternoon and well it took a while to get the server's attention. The naan was good but had better hummus. The server was actually cooking the food himself. It was an ok meal, had better Mediterranean food maybe caught them on off day, may try again in a weekend maybe when the chef is there?

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, American (New), Cajun/Creole, Bars, Caterers, Breakfast & Brunch, Seafood, Nightlife
text: Came here bc they said no wait, yet waited over 45 min for mediocre food. They don't bake their bacon but deep fry it in rancid oil. Only good thing we're the grits. We we're ignored by our server the entire time she even had in AirPods so was probably listening to music. Hash browns weren't even cooked.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Burgers, Italian
text: Messed up the order, tried to get me to buy a large when I asked for a small. The pizza came way under cooked and about 50% crust.

place_category: Food Delivery Services, Restaurants, Italian, Pizza, Food
text: Disappointed they wouldn't accept my groupon electronically. When inquiring with the manager, he was rude and refused to do anything. This place needs a better attitude.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: Nice atmosphere. Decent service. Large but Pricey wine list. $20 for spaghetti and meatballs. It was ok not special. Meatballs were good but small. Need to put some more pasta on the plate too. Good thing we ordered an appetizer. Better value and Italian nearby.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Donuts
text: The doughnuts were good, but they weren't great. Granted, I didn't get there until almost 11. They probably tasted even better earlier in the day. Would try again. Of the ones we'd sampled, the sour cream were my favorite. The Guy didn't seem impressed by any of them. (We tried the Nutella, Sour Cream, and some kind of Peanut Butter one with PB chips)

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: If you are looking for St Louis style pizza in the CWE, this is it (for better or worse). Pros- Can order online fast and easy pickup. Cons- Doesn't deliver.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers
text: Avoid this place if you can! I ate here and then went to use the restroom and had an employee come in there when I was in there and didn't even wash his hands before leaving. He then went right behind the counter, put on some gloves and starting making some burgers! Disgusting! Will never come here again!

place_category: Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers, Food, American (Traditional), Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Came here for our daughters school fundraiser. We have need eaten here in years and we won't be back for another couple of years. We walk in and the first thing I hear is that the kitchen was backed up. The food was ok but I could have making it "tastier" at home. It looked like it was just thrown together. The ice cream took forever to bring out. You would have thought that they were making it homemade. The bill was very high considering what we got.

place_category: Greek, Persian/Iranian, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Indian
text: This restaurant is a little gem of Reno! The food was absolutely fantastic and the chef even stopped by post meal to make sure we were happy with our experience. I ordered the Rack of Lamb that was on special as well as the Baklava and could not have been happier with my meal choice.

place_category: Bars, Pizza, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Italian, Restaurants
text: My wife and I went to Brio and were disappointed with the 45 minute wait for our dinner since they had many take out orders. My wife ordered a chicken limon dish that tasted like an omelette with an egg smell that was less than appetizing. Would not recommend. I also find wine prices outrageous with a 9oz glass on some costing 19 bucks.

place_category: German, Restaurants, Bakeries, Beer Gardens, Food, Nightlife
text: Unacceptably long wait today, and since you pay when you order, nothing to do but sit through it. Place was reasonably full, but for 2 sausages and 1 doner kebab we waited about 1 hour. Doner kebab could've used a little more meat to fill the admittedly very tasty bread it came on. It was slower than usual and not as crowded as during celebrations. We would have left if not for the payment.

place_category: Italian, Seafood, Restaurants
text: It was mediocre. I think they might have change the chef since we have been there about six months ago. We came here for our anniversary dinner, we had to wait almost an hour for some oysters. When the food came, it was just disappointing. Wait staff and bartender were nice but I probably will not come back here.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: The service was great and the waiters were very nice and accommodating when it began to rain and we needed to move inside. Although, the food was just alright since it was just plain Italian food you can get anywhere.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Having a boozy late lunch there, sitting under the sun in their large outdoor patio, a frozen margarita in one hand ... very relaxing and enjoyable even if the food is so-so. Coming back in a rainy evening in a packed loud room, waiting for drinks and food from poor service is frustrating. Only book on sunny days

place_category: Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Burgers, Nightlife, Bars, Gastropubs, Pubs, Sports Bars
text: From the cooks to the managers this place was amazing . Everyone who I met treated me so sweet and kind . The food is very good and the drinks are a plus . I will definitely be returning a lot

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Nightlife, Sandwiches, American (New), Bars, French, Cocktail Bars
text: Beautiful yet simple. The food was exceed you don't mind your entree being served at the same time as your starter. I mind.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Creperies, Bakeries, Cafes
text: Excellent selection of gluten-free desserts like cake pops, cupcakes,and macaroons. A cupcake is $4 so it's not cheap but everything I've ever had has been delicious. My pumpkin spice cupcake from yesterday was fall personified. Perfect combination of icing and cake. The whole menu is actually gluten-free. They also have options for breakfast like eggs and crepes and options for lunch like salads.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Comfort Food
text: This restaurant was great in a pinch when you are traveling with your boss. We did not want to dine at a chain we could go to at home. The service was ok, the beer specials were awesome, and I had the New Orleans Pasta with a side salad. I loved that they did not skimp on the amount of sausage and shrimp in the dish, and the peppers were very fresh! Definitely seemed like a popular restaurant, even for a weeknight!

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Nightlife, Food, Bars, American (Traditional), American (New)
text: This place is a hit and miss for us. We ordered couple of times, food is not consistently good. Bar area is good and they have decent beer collection. Overall, not the best food in this area but definitely not the worst either

place_category: Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Venues & Event Spaces, Food, Breweries
text: We held a company function at the brewery and it was a great event. The planning staff was very helpful, the staff on hand for our event was professional and personable. Dishes selected for our event were delicious and portions were generous and at a good price point. I would highly recommend hosting an event here.

place_category: Restaurants, Southern, Cajun/Creole
text: Too loud, too crammed. Cool retro set up! and wtf no ketchup?

place_category: Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Lounges, Tapas/Small Plates, Mediterranean, Food, Nightlife
text: Been twice, both times it stunk of cigar smoke. Great décor, good atmosphere, better outside than inside.

place_category: Restaurants, Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Beer Bar, Burgers
text: Mediocre and overpriced food, got food poisoning. Crack fries overrated. Also there was a giant spiderweb hanging above our table.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Good food. They need to open one up on the northside of indy

place_category: Bakeries, Breakfast & Brunch, Delis, Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Desserts
text: I'm so glad this place lived up to the reviews! Every one on the staff was very friendly and helpful. Free appetizers, free cookie dessert. Huge sandwiches and desserts. We only spent 36 bucks for two people, we were both so full and had to get our apple crumb dessert togo. Awesome place!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Delis, Food, Sandwiches, Specialty Food, Restaurants, Caterers, Meat Shops
text: This place straight up lied! I called the store to reserve turkey and ham for Christmas dinner and was told it was not necessary, they had plenty, just walk in. So, when I did as instructed, drove an hour to get there and was then told "we are only serving reserved orders" Are you kidding me!!?!?!?? I called to do just that and was told otherwise! They are liars!!!! And have ruined my family's Christmas dinner! Do Not shop this place ever!!! Zero stars rating! The absolute worst!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Nightlife, Pizza, Bars
text: Great menu and beer selection. We haven't had a bad meal or service there yet. Since this property has changed hands MANY times over the years we hope this time they succeed. By far, the current owners are doing the best job we've seen for a long time! The pizzas are good, but our favorites have to be the Tuna Tartare, house made breaded mozzarella, shrimp cocktail, garlic parmesan wings and arugula salad. So far though, I have to say you can't go wrong with anything.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Fast Food, Mexican, Tacos, Tex-Mex
text: Got the new double steak nachos (see picture)...i managed to count 4 pieces of grey looking steak and not even big pieces. Employee said that's just how it comes. Then no bags so i had to haul nachos and 2 combos in by hand. They did away with the green sauce (yes i know it was corporate). Very very slow service the guy behind me actually honked cause they were handing me one thing at a time and i guess he figured i should be done.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: This Starbucks is so terrible. The service is beyond slow. Even when you mobile order. And 3 employees will literally walk past you and not take your order because they are doing other tasks like loading chips. And the drinks are always terrible. I try to order stuff that is little effort but they even mess that up. Most of the drinks have no taste, or or too sugary. I only go here when desperate or getting something that is already made.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Cuban
text: Visited there on a Thursday night. Service was very slow when we were there. Sat at the bar and it took forever. Also, and this is probably the worst part, we don't know Spanish and when we went in there was nobody working there who spoke English well at all. Won't return, which sucks because we had high expectations as we live nearby.

place_category: Bakeries, Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches
text: Village Bakehouse is a bakery with a nice homey, local feel. There's a large covered patio and seating inside as well. They have a coffeee bar and breakfast/lunch menu--which I haven't tried anything from yet--but I can say that I have been made into a fan of their desserts and pastries. All taste homemade and made with care. I am not a big fan of key lime or macaroons, but their key lime macaroons are my absolute favorite of their baked treats so far!

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Restaurants
text: I wasn't real impressed. This was the second time I got a sandwich here just so I could make sure it wasn't a fluke. The employees have no pep in their step and sure take their time. Both times the wiz seemed watered down or something. The color just wasn't right and the sandwich seemed wet. Probably won't throw down the money again when there are other places to go.

place_category: Caterers, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants, Barbeque, Soup, Sandwiches, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Burgers
text: Honey and I had lunch there the other day. Split a sandwich (plenty of food for two). The chopped pork sandwich was amazing! Not greasy. Great fries. And I am an iced tea aficionado! This was strong and dark and fresh, just as it should be. Reasonably priced. Place was cute. Come on Eagle, eat out tonight!

place_category: Pizza, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Italian
text: 5 reasons for 5 starts 1. Lazo is the man. 2. His pizza is great. 3. Soccer on the TV, always. 4. Lazo will make you a custom slice if you are friendly. 5. His pizza is great The menu has about 4,000 things on it but I've only ever ordered pizza.

place_category: Indian, Restaurants
text: Flavorful but not wowed. Thought had lunch buffet but they do not. Thought would be larger portion. If i had paid full menu price instead of vegetarian Tuesday special, i would probably have been disappointed. But clean facility, friendly people, quick service.

place_category: Greek, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Pizza
text: Same crappy place from before under a new name! See the Yelp link below to read about its awful service and health code violations. http://www.yelp.com/biz/sabal-cafe-tampa

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars
text: Very lively atmosphere and great food! There was a musician playing there when I visited which was very entertaining! Everyone I was with loved their meals and drinks!

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sports Bars
text: Had dinner and drinks here tonight. Shrimp cocktail is amazing. Large prawns and the cocktail sauce is delicious. Audrey was our server and she was excellent. Busy night but she made sure to make time for everything we needed. Plus some conversation and witty banter!!! Great service. Great food! Thanks Flowing Tide. I'll definitely be back tomorrow.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Thai, Asian Fusion
text: Ordered takeout which was promptly ready in 25 minutes. Oversized rolls so we split 4 rolls and a few apps which ended up being plenty for us. It's still sushi so we weren't "stuffed" but certainly satisfied. Would order from here again. Crab Rangoon: 4/5 Seaweed Salad: 4/5 Red Dragon Roll: 4/5 Spicy Salmon Roll: 4/5 Eastern Peak Roll: 4/5 Hawaii Roll: 4/5

place_name: Uncle Dave's Homemade Ice Cream, LLC
place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Ok. Nothing really fabulous about the ice cream. It was good, not great. I'l probably go back and try it again. Service was great. Setting was clean and spacious.

place_category: Salad, Bars, Nightlife, Italian, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Soup
text: Where do I start. One word.. NASTY. salad too salty. Bread sticks too salty. Father got meatball spaghetti.... Barely no sauce... He had to go home and add sauce. Told waitress... Salad to salty take it away..... I order chicken Marsala.... Mash potatoes.... NASTY.. appetizers NASTY. next time...I'll save my money and go to Wendy's. Just was not happy... Waitress was nice. Food was NASTY.

place_category: Desserts, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bubble Tea
text: Called in this afternoon to try the newest tea house in the area. Super cute interior, incredibly helpful and happy staff. Great recommendations from our server. Got the vanilla milk tea with crystal boba... really delicious. Will definitely be back!!! Great addition to the Blenman area!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Fast and friendly service. My grandson said the chicken quesadilla was a 10. I had the chicken fajitas. Nice sized portion, but the chicken was way over cooked. The rice and beans were very good. Margarita was a little watery. All in all average. Prices are a little high.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: As someone who always fights to enlighten people on how underrated hHungry Howie's is, I feel embarrassed by this location. We received a pizza and breadsticks and could literally taste the residue that was left in the pan. Nothing more to say, RUN from this place.

place_category: Seafood, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Sat here for 15mins.. bartender came over very bothered he had to help me.. asked for drink and a menu.. he just bout dropped menu and walked away.. there were 12... yes I counted 12 people here.. (I'm writing while waiting for him which has been 10mins now after he walked away to cash me out so I can leave)... then he just meh me like ok what ever... not coming back here that's for sure..

place_category: Food Stands, Restaurants, Local Flavor
text: Oh Night Market. I want to love it, but the lines make it unbearable sometimes. That being said, go early or go late and it's not so bad. The vendors are great and if you live in the burbs and can't get to these lunch trucks on any ol' day, it's a great venue to see it all and try and eat it all! Wish they had more booze available!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Seafood, Dim Sum
text: I was first introduced to this restaurant by a Chinese friend when I first moved to Philadelphia. Their entrees used to be very good, but I feel their quality has degraded in recent years. Their dimsum service on weekends is nothing to write home about either. Since they don't even provide free parking stamps for the parking lot across the street, my motivation to go back there has been reduced even further....

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Best steakhouse in Philly. The wagyu cheesesteak is out of this world.. everything from the bread to the steaks to the seafood to the dessert.

place_category: Specialty Food, Desserts, Event Planning & Services, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Party & Event Planning
text: Yum! Yum! Yum! Ices at under $2 that taste delicious? Yes. Please! They have a fantastic flavor selection. The staff was very friendly. The line was long, but on a hot day that's pretty standard. The staff was efficient, and I got my ices quick. Overall, it was fabulous, and I will be going back!

place_category: Active Life, Beer Gardens, Grocery, Middle Eastern, Specialty Food, American (New), Parks, Cafes, Food, Nightlife, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Lebanese
text: Wow what an amazing dining experience! My partner was able to snag us a spot on a Monday: we were able to sit inside and we had a whole little space to ourselves, it was super romantic. The food was amazing and the service was perfect too! The draft rose and the grape leaves are a huge go to

place_category: Burgers, Nightlife, Lounges, Bars, Restaurants
text: No stars. Horrible service. This woman was such an asshole. Unbelievable. She didn't even greet when we walked in. Nothing. Just unbelievable wow.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: I ordered the Tom Yum soup w/ veggies and tofu and it was great. I also had the veggie Pad Thai and it was great. The portion sizes are nice for the price. The server was very responsive.

place_category: Bagels, Salad, Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Soup, Sandwiches
text: First visit to this particular location. The restaurant was very clean with plenty of seating. Food is a little pricey yet good. The only problem that I experienced was with the pager that I was given for my order. It never went off so my food set out on the counter for quite sometime. Luckily I didn't order anything hot. Otherwise it was okay.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Mexican, Restaurants
text: The food is very mediocre Mexican inspired dishes. The real star here are those frozen concoction makers behind the bar. There is a reason you might mistake them for a daq shop when you see them lined up. Happy hour is key! Get your money's worth. I don't do the alternative flavors I get the house, frozen, no salt. Simple.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Nice out door atmosphere... Service was less than satisfactory (better service at a chick-fil-a), expensive for bland food. We had 5 adults in our party and they gave us only one basket of stale chips and never asked if we wanted more. Oh and good luck finding a parking spot! This is a one and done place for sure!

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Bars, Nightlife, Mexican
text: I used to live the next block over from this place. We would stand on our roof and see how long the wait was before going in. $1 tacos are great. Waits are not. Drinks are decent. Prices are alright. Service is usually decent. Pez tacos and witty signs around the restaurant are great. Make a mean Al Pastor taco. Brunch meals are alright. Not taking cash is never my favorite but I handle it. Let's end this with a positive. Get the Kensington Nachos.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Mexican
text: We were told that this is THE place to eat for Mexican/Tex-Mex food in O'fallon. Wrong. The food wasn't gross, which saves this business from a 1-star, but it was far from flavor or interesting. The buffet we heard rave reviews about was pretty lame and didn't offer much choice. Perhaps I'm skewed by being told how awesome it was, but this was definitely one of the poorer experiences I've had at any restaurant, especially a themed one.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches
text: I've only been here three time and the third time will prob be my last. We waited for about 40 mins with reservations when there was a table open and rather than just pull a chair over to make it for 6 , it just remained open. When we finally were Sat, they gave us a bench to sit on which was wobble and uncomfortable. The food was mediocre at best.

place_category: Fast Food, Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Burgers
text: Doesn't deserve one star we waited 30 mins for our food. They let people sit inside without ordering. There were people in there drugged up falling asleep. Do not go here.

place_category: Bars, Desserts, Italian, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Food, Nightlife, Wine Bars
text: Went there the night of the 16th, the night before I was to have surgery - a last meal. The food was wonderful, the atmosphere was fine, the service stank. The place was almost empty. It took forever to place our order, get bread, and then finally get our meal. A larger party came in after we did and were in out before we were half way done with out meal.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Sushi Bars
text: Quiet and very low key restaurant with great food. Their sushi selection is good and they have great prices and specials! Its a good local sushi spot when I cant get to Philly. If you're in the area stop by for lunch

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Mexican
text: Everything here was on point. We had fajitas and a special of garlic shrimp and quinoa. They were excellent. We also had pineapple bacon guacamole which was amazing. Their house baked chips are dope. We drank a pitcher of seasonal margaritas which went down but was a little sweet for my taste. Good background music. Fun atmosphere with a ton of space. Good service.

place_category: Specialty Food, Mediterranean, Restaurants, Italian, Food
text: Enjoyed a fabulous dinner, with great service. There were 4 of us, and 2 had Hawaiian Butterfish and 2 had Bronzini. Both were wonderful. The Bronzini came with risotto, and the butterfish was served over spinach. We have been to Florentino's several times and I highly recommend it.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Just FYI this is pizza by the slice (5$ a slice). It was good but for family of 5 we were just looking for large pizza to take back to the room.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Tacos, Breakfast & Brunch, Tex-Mex, Fast Food
text: What is with skimping on the sauce? Every time I ask for a crap ton or 20 packets and then get 4 to go with a full meal. Come on!

place_category: Italian, Southern, Restaurants
text: My favorite restaurant in Nashville. Eclectic menu, very original dishes, the gourmet cocktails are fantastic, outstanding service. Great, unique ambiance. Love this place.

place_category: Chinese, Asian Fusion, Restaurants
text: If you like a quick, hot, and tasty asian meal then this is the place. Good choice of entres to choose from and all at a great price. Not a great date place but staff is friendly and food is GOOD!

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Looks cooler than what it really is. Food is just...eeehhhh. Not expecting 5 star meal, just be good at what you do & this place doesn't even do that correctly.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Mehhhh. Nothing special. If all you want is a nice terrace, come here but if you want authentic flavorful Mexican food, go somewhere else. For the price you pay I was expecting muuuch better!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: We've ordered food from here about 15 times and have noticed that the food is significantly better on days other then Friday. We really enjoy the pizza here when it's done the way it should be. On Friday's it seems rushed due to the higher volume of orders. The slices are cut very unevenly and it is undercooked, slightly doughy. The owner and staff are very friendly and personable. I wish the quality was a bit more consistent. If the Friday pizzas were better of give them another star.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: I had a craving for some Chinese food. This place is right down the street a from my house. I decided to give it a try. I ordered house lo mien and general tso's chicken. There was nothing nasty about the taste. The quality of the food just wasn't great. The chicken wasn't crispy it was rubbery. It has the same quality of supper market from bag to oven chicken. Noodles were over cooked. Chicken in noodles were great, but shrimp was rubbery. The flavor is all really good, just not the quality.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Sullivan's used to be a great go to place for lite bites and good cocktails with a fab staff. They all work at Union now, the food last time I went was lackluster and uninspired and the cocktails haven't changed in a while. I do like the atmosphere though, in that it's pretty fancy pants for Tucson and offers up a lounge-y vibe not found frequently in the OP. But I'd rather hit up somewhere more local, tastier and with all the folks that took care of me who again, now work at Union.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: I love it that it's open 24-7. That is the best part about this place.

place_category: Ramen, Japanese, Restaurants
text: If you're not a frequent ramen goer then this place would be good. As for Me I eat ramen frequently. There are plenty of places better. Terakawa, nom nom, @ramen etc. their broth is not bad , their noodles are great consistency. Good if you're in the area but worth it far more to head 10 minutes down the road to china town and get some real ramen ‍

place_category: Department Stores, Electronics, Drugstores, Fashion, Grocery, Food, Shopping, Discount Store
text: What can I say, it's a Walmart. I was looking for some Pine Bark Nuggets and they didn't have any. This one is in a decent location and right next to my favorite WAWA! The store seemed cleaner than some of the other Walmart stores I've been to. Hopefully it will stay that way.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Italian
text: Outstanding little brunch place! The food was incredible and our waiter was extremely nice. He explained everything on the menu and specials in detail. He was attentive and kind. The food was stellar. We had the cinnamon bun French toast special and the chillaquiles rojos! Cinnamon bun was not overly sweet but the perfect decadent brunch. The chillaquiles were flavorful and delicious. We will absolutely be back to try more!

place_category: Delis, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants
text: My mom and I stopped in last week. Her salad looked like hospital food and my honey mustard chicken sandwich had one of those frozen, formed-into-a-chickenesque patty, which was unappealing and bland. The meal was plain unappetizing. I don't recommend it.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Cheesesteaks, Burgers, Pizza, Sandwiches
text: I love a good cheesesteak. Not with that cheese whiz mess on it. Ishkabibbles had great cheesesteaks. If you like yours cheesy like me, ask for extra provolone.

place_category: Nightlife, Burgers, Music Venues, American (New), Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Food, Cafes, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional)
text: Overall, I am disappointed in the hard rock. There is a lot of competition in the area which makes it even more important to perform. Unfortunately, my Sazerac was terrible. The chips and salsa were not good either because the chips were stale. The nachos were surprisingly better after the chips and salsa. Overall, the hard rock has a great name brand. With a little more thought and effort in the food and drink, the experience would be much better.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Papa John's Philadelphia Cheesesteak Papadia. Before everyone starts complaining I'm not adding it to my spreadsheet but I took pictures and video so I'm posting it. Spoiler alert This thing is good! $6! I'm in Delaware so $6 is $6. Pizza dough roll, nice, light and airy, got to like that. Very cheesy, you have to love that. The meat was not horrible and it was actually kind of tasty. I see more of these in my future. I don't think I saw a pepperoni one but I hope they have a pepperoni one.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Desserts, Restaurants, Food
text: I came in for lunch and ordered a Baja roll, which is supposed to have blackened tuna but instead the tuna was raw. I spoke to a lady who was supposed to be the manager and let her know about it. She couldn't have cared less and did nothing to make it right. There are plenty of great sushi restaurants in Reno/Sparks so don't waste your time and money here. I will be going elsewhere from now on.

place_category: American (Traditional), Fast Food, Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: Slow slow slow! Typical Popeyes.. the people are generally nice and the food was pretty good but the wait time is just too long for fast food. It just seems like they would figure out the service times and I would stop more often.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Hotels & Travel, Restaurants, Hotels, Seafood
text: The Loew's hotel is very clean and looks very nice. The service is amazing. My family and I wanted to stay for a whole month. The breakfast there is fantastic! My son said it looked like it was the future. That's how nice it was! The rooms were nice size and the parking is convenient. That's why I give the Loew's hotel 5 stars.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Italian
text: Horrible- my family went here the other day for a catered funeral luncheon. The food was terrible, the servers appeared angry and were rude. The worst part was when a MOUSE fell out of a ceiling panel. Disgusting.... And instead of a discount on the nearly $2000 bill, the manager gave my brother a $50 gift certificate to come back ---are you kidding????

place_name: Tir Na Nog Kitchen & Irish Pub
place_category: American (New), Irish, Bars, Irish Pub, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Went for lunch twice this week and both times it was very good service was good too will be back can't wait to see what the chef brings to the table

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Burgers, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sports Bars
text: Service is good. Beer is good. Plenty of TV'S to watch sports. Food is below average. Cleanliness of dining areas is way below average. I'm assuming the convenient location is what keeps this place in business.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Second meal in a week. Last week had delivered. Tonight went inside and ordered. Food has gotten progressively worse. Hot and Sour soup was neither. It was lukewarm, had consistency of gelatin and tasted awful. Egg rolls not cooked all the way. Triple Crown had no taste. Delivered food was cold and tasteless. I won't go back.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Clean friendly. Pizza heavy on the cheese light on the toppings and sauce. Good otherwise. 16 for 16" pizza and 1 drink. Nice location across from park.

place_category: American (Traditional), Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Nothing special about this place. A bar with a lot of TVs. It gets expensive here for no reason. Food is not even that great. Service was ok. Long story short; not gonna be back.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Desserts, Food
text: You just earned a 5th star for offering fresh lychee. Don't ever change, baby. No seriously. I wouldn't be able to forgive you.

place_category: Seafood, Nightlife, Piano Bars, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Cajun/Creole, Bars, Sandwiches
text: This is a restaurant and bar and club.... supposedly OWNED by celebrity Channing Tatum. I waltzed in and they gave me a seat. Then they walked away and had me sitting there begging for food. Finally a bartender took over and served me. Are you getting any of this Channing, huh are you? Anyway.... the food here was good. I had seafood gumbo which I liked and this crawfish pie with cheese and puff pastry. Would like to go back if I ever go to New Orleans again unless they don't want me to come???

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches
text: The food was terrible. Pizza ,everything seems frozen and store bought. A expensive disappointment

place_category: Seafood, Japanese, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Bars
text: First time here. Service and food were excellent. The staff were all very friendly. Lunch was only $15.95. All you can eat appetizers, salad bar, sushi and comes with dessert. Same decor as Ijji in Sparks. The place is smaller which I liked. Plenty of parking. Loved the yellow tail, scallop hand roll, veggie tempura. I need to come back to try the Godzilla Deluxe Roll.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, American (Traditional)
text: I was eating lunch with my African American colleagues when I was asked to leave with no explanation. When asked why, she replied, "Everybody has to leave as of now." She did not tell anybody else and everyone was still sitting down, eating, people were still ordering their food. Keep in mind, it's only 6pm and there was about 20 people in their staff. Would not recommend or tolerate this.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Cupcakes, Custom Cakes, Food
text: I ordered a cake 48 hours in advance for pickup today. Requirement is only 24 hours. Got an email very late last night saying that my order was not confirmed. They do not give you 24 hours notice so that you can find alternative arrangements. This is an about joke! I needed that cake today for a birthday party and now I have no cake! Will never do business with them again!!

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Went here for New Years Eve. The atmosphere was festive, service was great, place was jammed but the food... disappointing. I had Tuttomare and the fish was definitely over cooked and the sauce bland. My husband's dish was so bad he didn't really eat it. When will Tucson catch on to decent Italian food.

place_category: Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Salad, Sandwiches, Food, American (New)
text: I love Rybrew and so does my extended family - they always insist on going there when they are in town. I have several favorite sandwiches and, this goes without saying, highly enjoy their beverage selection. Lots of seating as well. Plus, you can play shuffleboard while you wait. I have little ones who usually share part of my sandwich, but in a couple of years they might want their own. Would be awesome if there was a small $3 sandwich option for kids (something to think about Rybrew).

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Local Flavor, Desserts
text: Meh, it's good frozen yogurt. But for the drive required, it is JUST frozen yogurt. I didn't see the "extra special" quality everyone always talks about. I'd go again ONLY if i was in the neighborhood -- would not go out of my way for it. Just my opinion - I know many will disagree.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Pizza, Cheesesteaks
text: Food: 3.5 Service: 2.5 Value: 3 Pretty good cheesesteak spot in Reading Terminal. Longer lines, and a tad pricey, but a satisfying meal.

place_category: Restaurants, Persian/Iranian, Mediterranean
text: Absolutely stunning decor, great service and wonderful food. It had been a while since Nancy and I ate Persian and glad we found this restaurant.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Pizza
text: I ordered Margherita pizza. I found it to be small. Could have had more seasoning. Very plain. Limited menu. Atmosphere was ok.

place_category: Salad, American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New)
text: Went with a group for dinner. A few of us really wasn't hungry but tagged along. So we ordered appetizers as our meal. It was pretty good for the price. Recommend the Thai rib stack & the Asian almond shimp. Someone ordered the Valentine dinner and they totally enjoyed it. The Mardi Gras parade goes right pass this place.

place_category: Cuban, Restaurants
text: Come hungry. The portions are huge. I had their ropa vieja, beat one I've had at a restaurant so far. Would definitely come again.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: I've been to the University City location (which earns 4 1/2 stars) and the Manayunk location lacks something. The food is quite good (Dan Dan noodles are simply amazing) but the overall experience is second rate compared to the University City location. There is not much in the way of good Chinese food in Roxborough/Manayunk, so I'd highly recommend take-out...but the restaurant experience is shabby, the service is poor, and the vibe sterile.

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Never disappoints! The food is delish! I ordered a lot of food just because i was starving. And i have to say, my stomach is saying it's full but my eyes, brain and sense of smell makes me want to have more! It was definitely packed well, neatly and organized. No spills from any sauce. The place is also organized well for pick up orders. The food was ready right when they said it would be. Koodos Mikado, you did it!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Breweries, American (Traditional), Brewpubs
text: Decent food, average service, average beer. The food is a step up from your normal pub fare, but it's at a premium price even at Santa Barbara prices. The beer is average, nothing really stands out. This was a favorite when I moved here a few years ago, but since then the prices have gone up while the quality has fallen. There are too many breweries in the area to reward mediocrity.

place_category: Restaurants, Latin American, Mexican, Salvadoran
text: Any of the El Paisano locations are awesome, and I recommend them over any other place for pupusas and Salvadoran tamales! You can order them with beans, cheese, meat, chocaron, and eat them with the special slaw they make and tomato sauce. It's absolutely delicious and can never go wrong with them. They do take a little time but are well worth the wait!

place_category: American (New), Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: I liked it - a bit pricey and I don't remember if they charge you an uncorking fee if you bring your own wine.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Bakeries
text: This really pains me to write this review, but there have been serious fails and the last time was actually inedible. Their king cakes this season are dry, skimpily filled and totally overpriced. Went in the other day for the ham and cheese croissant, had one bite and ended up throwing it away because it was so bad. I've had so many good things here in the past. I don't know what is going on, but I really hope it is fixed. We love having this neighborhood spot and want it to be great, again!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: This store is dirty and gross. Employees are rude and I even saw water leaking from their ceiling onto their coffee machines for hours. Dirty!! Onto their drinks. AVOID. Go local!!! So many other cheaper and better local coffee places within the same block.

place_category: Hot Dogs, Restaurants, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: The whole reason we drive out of the way and come to this Twistee Treat is because they have no sugar added/sugar free ice cream that is extremely hard to find. But today the machine was "broken", trip wasted. My not seem like a big deal to most people, but when sugar is an issue these places stand apart, but like I said, not today.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Pizza here is pretty good. The first time I ever tried it was better than the second time. The employees look fun and enthusiastic. Overall it's pretty good. Their salad bar is delicious and I highly recommend it. The wait is about 25 minutes but it's worth it. I wish they had more choices for fountain drinks. Prices are ok. Just like any other pizza place.

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, American (New)
text: We were looking forward to a fabulous dinner, but found ourselves faced with ordinary meals and what appeared to be a rather bored and insincere wait staff. It was difficult not to feel offended by the ridiculously exorbitant wine list, especially considering all the delicious and reasonably priced wines available in the U.S. and abroad. Skip Emeril's. It doesn't match the hype.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Called in for a carry out order. I asked if they had any specials, (usually the other pizza places tell you about immediately), owner preceded to go off on me about asking. Sorry but you just lost another customer. Wish the former owner still owned it.

place_category: Desserts, Arts & Entertainment, Food, Festivals
text: Grossly oversold. Appropriately named Dessert Wars, because it was a battle to get to the vendors or even walk through the venue. Entrance was $38 after fees and in exchange you receive 30 tickets to visit vendors between 4 to 7 PM. Well, by 5:30 PM 80% of the vendors ran out of desserts, so we're left with a ream of tickets and PTSD from claustrophobia.

place_category: American (Traditional), American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Seafood, Cafes
text: Trouble in paradise! Was headed to a different restaurant but smelled the oak grill. Ordered oak grilled filet mignon with shoe string fries. The meal was overall disappointing. Filet was not grilled correctly and tasted just ok. The "shoestring" fries were not shoestring at all but were like any burger joint but tasted much worse. Garlic bread portions were small and overcooked. I wasn't paying for the meal but for that price you should get much much better food. Service was decent.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Lounges, Sandwiches, Bars, Wine Bars
text: The royal Room is a very intimate setting, sooo if you're looking to come on a Friday date bases. Be ready for an amazing meat and cheese board with a side of wine and maybe some king of the hill. Be sure to order at the bar, grab your drinks at the bar because the services is on you. Don't forget to tip yourself 20% cause I know your service is better then silent bob and girl with the bun.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Food Delivery Services, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Bars, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Restaurants, Indian
text: Nowhere near Indian taste. 80℅ American 20℅ Indian in terms of taste. Expensive menu items. Not much encouraged to try again.

place_category: American (New), Italian, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Food, Coffee & Tea, Caterers
text: I was greatly disappointed with the wait. We were told that they could seat us, but after a 40-minute wait and after being passed over by numerous other parties, we were sent away. Not to mention that my wife and I were accompanied by 2 small children. I will not go back, ever!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Bars, Barbeque, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Food Delivery Services, Food, Pizza, Restaurants
text: Typically avoid brand new places for 6 months while they work the kinks out....well they have not worked the kinks out. SLOW service, long wait for food, tenderloin was too big and thin, the fish sandwich was awful....owner follows up reviews with rude responses. Won't be back. Too many other options....too bad the owners do not realize they aren't the only place in town!

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Diners
text: Went in the one time, waited 15 minutes at the door for someone to serve us. No one ever came out of the kitchen, though we can clearly see people back there, lights were all on, door was open. What great service. And after reading other reviews, Im glad no one came out to serve us. Don't go here.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: I ordered the chicken enchiladas and was rather pleased with them. I wouldn't say they're better than any other place, but they were satisfying. I didn't enjoy the beans that came with them, though. They were a little bitter in my opinion. The rice was dry. This doesn't affect my view of the place, but the plate was so dang hot! I accidentally touched the edge of the plate with my pinky and burned myself instantly. I now have a fat blister because of it.

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars
text: Great time at this restaurant. Good selection and great service. Entertainment was a great treat!

place_category: Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Pubs, Gluten-Free
text: The Southouse was a quiet place,with a home town feel. They have a large beer menu. The four of us had the burgers and fries. Food was very good,cooked as requested,service was good. Prices are reasonable.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Seafood
text: It's fast food, so it's never particularly fresh, healthy, or spectacularly good. However, service at this location was prompt, and it seems slightly less filthy that most LJS's. I was shocked though, that lunch for two cost us $15. It's fish, chicken, and fries that all taste the same. $15!?!?!?

place_category: Buffets, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Pakistani, Indian
text: Did not have a good experience here. The elderly man at the receptionist desk was rude and very short with us for no reason. The food was ok. Place is run down, dirty and old. Not really a great place for a sit down meal. I will not be returning.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Salad
text: The pizza, calzone, meat balls, and sauce are great. Very much has an East Coast Italian Street food vibe. Fun place!

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Shaved Ice, Desserts
text: This was the worst ice cream experience I've ever had. The girl working was so rude, the place had a weird vibe and the ice cream was terrible. My husband and I literally just threw ours away and we're on our way to Franklin Fountain as I write this review. Never again.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Excellent coffeeshop. Plenty of outlets on the restaurant side of the shop. Kaldis coffee. Good atmosphere for the most part. The old Cairdeas was def better, there's no doubt about that. What the new place has going for it is the outdoor seating. During the spring it is absolutely awesome to sit out there and read.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza, Burgers
text: Everything we've ordered- sandwiches, burgers, pizza and salads have been delicious! The homemade bread is amazing. Family friendly and the owners are always super nice!

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Southern
text: Let me explain: Our server was so nice and charming. Except his counterpart, was a rude disgrace. She picked up my plate while I was still eating and then decided to pick up my drink. Mind you, that my party was undisturbed and was allowed to continue with their festivities. It felt targeted and disturbing and, infuriating. I WILL NEVER RETURN TO The Mill Nola.

place_category: Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Gelato, Food
text: Always amazing ice cream, great selection of flavors, and patient and friendly staff. I highly recommend this place if you haven't tried it. Buy some now and take some to go! They often have flavors you cannot buy in the grocery stores who sell Graeters

place_category: Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Restaurants, Bars
text: So tasty! Standouts were the soul potato nachos (GREAT combo), the Mac & cheese (so creamy), and the banana pudding (real bananas inside!). The only thing I wasn't a fan of were the smoked green beans-- too smoky for my taste. Lots of outdoor seating on the rooftop and out front!

place_category: Smokehouse, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Barbeque
text: Average bbq like what you'd get from local school bbq. The sides are pretty decent have some good Cole slaw here. I wasn't wowed by it but I'll definitely give it another try

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, British, Pubs, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: This place has a nice beer and cider selection, but the staff has a really hard time keeping up with the number of tables (especially on nights when they have trivia going on), so we had a bunch of mistakes with our orders and had to wait for ages and keep reminding them about our drinks repeatedly.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Thank you, Sankyu, for having such a convenient location, right smack dab in the middle of downtown. LRT station right outside? Check. Bus route? Check. Walkable to bars for post-sushi drinks? Triple check! But really, it is the only excellent thing about you. Your food is OK, your service is slow, your prices are a bit pricy for the amount of food you get. At least they have plenty of the free newspapers for while you wait.

place_category: Food, Coffee Roasteries, Coffee & Tea
text: I've been a regular here for a while despite being treated horribly until the day I was treated like I was trespassing when I walked in for a coffee two minutes after closing when the doors were wide open with thirty people still sitting on the patio, that's the last straw for me, I'll NEVER be back, I'm done

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Fast Food, Food, Delis, Food Delivery Services, Sandwiches
text: Blah! No Flavor Boring Yankee food! Terrible service from the kids inside! And there is actually a sign that says "no hippies allowed" at all of their stores. Im not a hippie, but why would a sandwich shop discriminate against anyone coming in hungry to buy food. In addition to their plain, and bland food. I wouldn't recommend to anyone with taste buds.

place_category: Pubs, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, British
text: Great to have a new restaurant in this location and the interior looks really great! The service is friendly and fast and the menu is huge. My fish and chips, one of their specialities, was pretty good, the burger was great, but the wings were a little disappointing (small with too much sauce). We will be back again for sure.

place_category: Nightlife, Seafood, Bars, Restaurants, Tiki Bars, American (Traditional)
text: The waitstaff was very good however, the food was bland and overpriced. The restaurant is living on a reputation. We won't be back.

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Restaurants, Cafes
text: Best place on earth!! Love all the food!! Great place to sit and relax. I go regularly!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: This place is a great local breakfast and lunch staple. Great food every time I eat in there. My only complaint is the take out is never as good. But they more than make up for that with an extremely friendly staff! It has a great small town feel and friendly people!

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Ethnic Food, Mexican, Restaurants
text: They are closed on Sundays out of respect for the lord. I just moved here and I will definitely be trying this place out .

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: I'd like to give 3 1/2 stars as the food was good and the service staff was very friendly but they are also a little pricey and the portions are rather small. It is much more formal than we expected but we were ok in a t shirt and shorts although perhaps slightly underdressed. They have some unique options on the menu that I suppose are authentic to New Orleans cuisine. They restaurant itself is a beautiful old building and they have additional seating in an outdoor courtyard area.

place_category: Florists, Flowers & Gifts, Specialty Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Shopping, Grocery
text: Finally made it! Same old Trader Joe's, I was glad. Flowers were beautiful and price was reasonable. But few items I bought were bad quickly, which was organic shredded cabbage, organic apples, box of 3 tomatoes, etc. Which I will prefer to purchase somewhere else. As for box tissue at $1.39 each? I cant believe I used to buy a lot, not only its expensive, its rough on the skin. You will have to figure what you like here, and what else you can buy at other stores/organic farm.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Tacos, Fast Food, Southern, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Amazing burritos, salads and rice bowls. I could drink the chipotle ranch dressing :) staff is always very friendly. Prices are great too and portions are large!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Probably the best Nico's out there. Love their green chile burritos. Their ground beef tostadas actually has flavor! Can't go wrong with a big breakfast burrito at anytime of the day! Over all this is a great Nicos for something cheap and quick or if you just don't want to cook.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Would be great to have vegan options. Pineville Tavern seems kind of anti-vegan. I have had enough french fries in life, thanks.

place_category: Noodles, Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Ordered ramen and chicken teriyaki bowl. The teriyaki had a,little too much vinegar taste to it. The ramen was substandard. It was suppose to be miso tasting, but it smelled and taste bad with very soft noodles. Go into philadelphia or Chinatown and get a great bowl or ramen or even chicken teriyaki.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Came here for years, always good. Very disappointed tonight. Found out the owners sold, definitely a difference in taste of food...no flavor....

place_category: Pasta Shops, Bars, Nightlife, Specialty Food, Cocktail Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Pizza, Food, Italian
text: Terrible, load, don't waste your time or dime. Go to Mia for a great meal. Bad service and the food was Luke warm. Waited 15 minutes to pay the bill.

place_category: Poke, Food, Restaurants, Hawaiian
text: My first Poke experience outside of a food station at some elegant wedding or other affair. Major props to the young lady who was very patient with me as she made my bowl. It was very tasty and filling.

place_category: Greek, Fast Food, American (New), Sandwiches, Mediterranean, Cafes, Restaurants, Kebab
text: This place is delicious. Got the chicken shawarma wrap and fries and every bite was perfect. The fries were fresh and crisp. The chicken was perfectly seasoned and juicy.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife
text: Love going to this place because of the food and the atmosphere. Be aware that the food is spicy. Weird thing is they do not have takeout. They have takeout containers if you want to take home your leftovers, but you cannot call them and order to take out.

place_category: Gastropubs, Bars, Burgers, Pizza, Restaurants, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Cocktail Bars
text: We were told the place is good. We stopped for lunch. The wait was reasonable. The Chinese chicken salad was very good. The buffalo chicken was enjoyed in our party. Overall it was a pleasant experience.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Sandwiches, Pizza, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Food Delivery Services
text: Great food and excellent service. Owner Grant is extremely friendly and helpful. He has always been great for custom orders and catering needs for my small office. Everything is always consistent and fresh.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Irish, Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Came here with my sister. We both had a burger (ask for fries). The Burger was ok... As good as a bar burger can get I guess. The drinks were strong. Good place to hang out with friends. I like that the brand their burger buns.
