place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Sports Bars, Pubs, Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: The service was Extremely slow today; it's always the kitchen fault. We waited for an hour... tried the new chicken and it has a good flavor.

place_category: Food, Grocery
text: Wow, this place gets worse every day.... The employees don't seem to care at all.. They smoke right outside the main entrance, swear in front of customers and carry on inappropriate conversations with each other in front of customers... I'm sorry but I'm not going back there until something changes.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, German
text: My only complaint about Uschy's is that they're not open on the weekends. I went in for sausages and had a great chat with the manager - she helped me select the sausages and offered recommendations on how to prepare. They also sold peanut flips!

place_category: Restaurants, Ramen, Japanese
text: They let the clients sit outside in a very hot atmosphere while the workers are in the airconditioned room. Who's paying for your salaries? You need to know your priorities! Why are we eating outside while you guys are comfortable??? Go somewhere else where you can be comfortable eating ramen- Kiwami, Ja Ramen, Raijin Ramen ... BAD CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!

place_category: Wine Bars, Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Italian, Bars, Nightlife
text: Me and a few friends went during restaurant week and the owner was very impolite and yelled at us after he made us push back out reservation from 7:30 to 8 and made us wait over 20 minutes. He told us a table was getting their check when they were just getting served their food. Terrible way to treat potential new customers, never going back

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Good stuff, good food, good people, fun times. Check it out! I enjoy going there everytime. The giant frosted mugs are a plus!

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Southern, Taiwanese, Seafood, Bars, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Live/Raw Food, Wine Bars, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: We had the pleasure of attending this restaurant during Sunday brunch menu and services. It was a very intimate restaurant with dimmed lighting, grime and sexy atmosphere, and a jazz band. Considering I'm a nola foodie, born and raised here, the food was just okay. Nothing to write home about but definitely an experience worth trying.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Food, Salad, Seafood
text: Did not meet expectations , I had shrimp fettuccine and my husband had shrimp in grits being from New Orleans I just expected it to be more flavorful. Many people talked about it so I was super excited about going but unfortunately I was let down. The appetizer was the same the seasoning was just not there. For dessert we had bread pudding. That tasted yummy like a traditional bread pudding. The wait staff was awesome. I really wish the food would have been better.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Nightlife, Sandwiches, American (New), Bars, French, Cocktail Bars
text: Special occasion dinner. Ordered most expensive starter of bar b que oysters. Not at all as described and very small. Not a good choice at $16...

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Comfort Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: This place is very historic and popular. The po boys ate amazing and the people are cool. Just be ready to answer if you want your poboy dressed are not.

place_category: Italian, Food, Nightlife, Pizza, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants
text: Nice locale, good service. We had an arugula salad, very good, charred octopus, very good, pappardelle with lamb ragu, good, fried artichokes, OK. We also had a margherita pizza. The initial impression of the pizza was excellent. As it got colder the flavor of the dough changed, it felt greasy, disappointing. It needs another visit.

place_category: Food, Burgers, Restaurants
text: Are there better burger joints in Philadelphia? Yes there are. One good item is that they have REAL SODA - and not that high fructose corn syrup crap that turns you into a fat whale. Warning - hipsters flock here so if you are allergic to flannel and to irony then avoid it at all costs. Also the music is too loud. Do you really need to play Slayer that loud?

place_category: Steakhouses, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Disappointed in the food. We got the hibachi scallops. They were rubbery and tasteless. The "shrimp flambe" was three tiny, forlorn shrimp with no flavor. Plating was inelegant. Sushi was ok

place_category: Ramen, Restaurants, Japanese, Noodles, Chinese
text: Really loved the way of the food delivery, but wasn't impressed with the food at all. Seemed very pricey and pretty average. I had the chicken hibachi and the chicken was very boring and bland, and same with my noodles. The Crab Rangoon was very good though. It was a nice atmosphere and cute, and our server was very sweet. but food was nothing special.

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Restaurants, Eatertainment, Arcades, Nightlife
text: Dave & Buster's is one of my kids favorite places to hangout and grab a bite to eat. They offer a wide variety of video games and a few VR experiences to keep everyone entertained for hours. The food at Dave & Buster's is just average. I ordered the fire grilled salmon today and the Asian nachos as my appetizer. Both were good, but not great.

place_category: Italian, Salad, Pizza, Burgers, Restaurants
text: they used to have this amazing broccoli veggie burger and replaced it with a different veggie burger/patty which i personally do not like. i used to exclusively come here for the veggie burgers cause i thought they were some of the best in the area but sadly no longer dine here bc they dont have it anymore. the fries are phenomenal and and crispy and would recommended. pretty solid place and the food comes out quick.

place_category: Sandwiches, American (New), Lounges, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: EXCELLENT service. Food? Uninspired and predictable.

place_category: Polish, Restaurants, American (New)
text: My husband and I had dinner here over the weekend, and the food was delicious. I had the vegetarian combo (pierogies, potato pancakes, and polish salad), and my husband had the Zurek Soup. Both were excellent! The service was fantastic as well. My only issue was it felt a little pricey. We paid $45 for two meals, a cup of soup, and one soda, which I thought was a little high for what we received.

place_category: Nightlife, Diners, Restaurants, Food, American (Traditional), Bars, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Just that A-OK..... Not bad for a fast breakfast if you want a sit down in the North Valley. Service is good, food was filling and a lot of locals come here. The waitress knew a few peoples orders as soon as they walked in. I would drive into town or head out to Lemmon Valley for a 4 star plus breakfast....

place_category: Gluten-Free, Food, Bakeries, Restaurants, Vegan
text: YES. gluten-free and super healthy...and still delicious. yes, I will admit that some of the items on the menu taste unique, and maybe not like typical bakery items...BUT as a gluten-free consumer, I am impressed with the creativity of the desserts, given the limited ingredients. I'm also always excited for donuts and cupcakes.

place_category: Burgers, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Vegan
text: this place is in rittenhouse so obviously it's expensive, it has to be. i like the chopped med salad, and thats what i normally order if i go there with friends. ( i'm trying to avoid mock meats in general, so i stay away from the burgers.) the smoothie is great but i found out its like almost 400 calories, again i avoid it. this place isn't for me like 90% of the time, but when you're hungover and want something greasy: stumble in and you'll leave happy.

place_category: Drugstores, Food, Grocery, Shopping
text: Visit this store a lot Eat in cafe all the time. I see fruit flies in the bakery case, black flies in the marketplace cafe ALL THE TIME. Sign of chronic unsanitary and unclean conditions that they are able to continue to breed. Management tries but I think they are understaffed or have poor staff training and execution on cleaning and sanitation needs. Such a shame.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Food, Restaurants
text: It's been a good place before now is turned into a dirty and ugliest faces that never smile

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: I always get.good service when I come here. The remodel helped greatly showing pride in ownership which made me enjoy my visit even more.

place_category: Nightlife, Cajun/Creole, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Good food but could be better. It was a bit greasy and salty. We got the sauce they recommended. The next day me and my BF had tummy aches . Overall experience was nice...staff seemed very polite. Is a bit over priced but that's expected at seafood restaurants. Will give a second try.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Nightlife, Bars, Delis, Food, Beer Gardens, Sandwiches, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Gastropubs
text: Great place! Great selection of beer, great food and great owner! It's more then a craft beer shop it's a place where there is always something happening, you can tell that they want to be part of the community.

place_category: New Mexican Cuisine, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Nightlife, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Mexican, Latin American, Restaurants, Food, Tacos
text: Love this place! Fun drinks with delicious queso! The tacos are tasty. The atmosphere is upbeat and the bathrooms are cute (love the penny tile).

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: Love this place!! Great food, great service. We had the roasted oysters combo platter, raw oysters, and the pepper jelly oysters. Sooo good!! We will definitely be coming back.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: I tried the Salmon BLT without bacon. Sandwich was cooked just the way I like it, crispy on the outside and moist on the inside. Suave on top was good as well. Had fruit as my side and unlike most places they give a fair amount fruit.

place_category: Bars, Pubs, Irish Pub, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New)
text: This bar is standard. The food is standard Irish/American bar food but is a little over priced. The atmosphere is ok. I like the three levels. The crowd is late 20's. However, the bar smells like feet. I don't know why it smells so bad but others bars have figured out how to rid themselves of stale beer smell. Day or night winter or summer it always stinks. Staff is nice. Have never had a bad experience. Go here if someone can't think of anywhere better.

place_category: Cafes, Burgers, American (Traditional), Tacos, Seafood, Restaurants, Mexican
text: 3.5 stars I used to cross the street during track meets at SBCC to get snacks here. Tonight I had dinner here - wasn't expecting a whole lot from a snack shack but the seafood soup and burrito were surprisingly decent and palatable. The soup in particular was a good amount of fresh seafood and very welcome on yet another chilly night in SB.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Spanish, Cuban
text: Blech! Only went there cuz we had a gift cert. Their Cuban sandwich is by far NOT the best in town. Far from it. Take it from a local. It sucked.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Automotive, Convenience Stores, Restaurants, Food, Gas Stations, Sandwiches
text: My wife and I ordered quesadillas for lunch. Mine had more ridiculous toppings than my wife's, and of course that's the quesadilla they chose to make twice instead of the proper items. Exactly the kind of thing that the touch screen ordering should eliminate. It's Wawa.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian
text: My company is in the business park next to them so we were given a coupon for a free pizza. That was the best thing that they could have done. In just minutes my employee was back with a very good pepperoni pizza. To my surprise he didn't call it in. Fast service - to the disappointment to my employee. Now for a incentive we're having pizza Friday from Marco's. Let's be honest it is a franchise pizza place but a good one. Give it a try I think you might be surprised.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Bars, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: This used to be a great place to go. The bartenders aren't what they once were, food is only ok, and owners son has a lot to learn still.

place_category: Cafes, Food, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Coffee Roasteries, Restaurants
text: A little hidden except for the tables outside. Great vibe, great coffee blends, so worth the walk a few blocks from Rittenhouse Square. The pour-overs are delightful and there are options for every mood you're in.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: A lovely brunch place. Great location as well. This was our first breakfast in New Orleans and it definitely lived up to our expectations. The staff and the hostess were nice, warm, and welcoming. We sat at the bar, and weren't rushed at all. We liked our dishes; had fantastic conversation; and got lost in the moment of the charisma that is New Orleans.

place_category: Food, Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Steakhouses, Japanese, Restaurants
text: Have had dinner at Kobe's many times and it's always been very good...we always try to get there for the early bird...entrees are basically $ 9 or $15...you get plenty of food for your money...you will not go away hungry...you can sit around the typical cook in front of you chef or sit at a private table...the table chefs are entertaining and put on the usual show...if it's anyone's birthday, take them here...the dinner is free for them....check it out and enjoy!

place_category: Southern, Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Amazing- get the ribs. These are seriously thebest I've ever had and I've vever eaten across the country

place_category: Mediterranean, Greek, Restaurants
text: Their falafel is the best I've ever had!! The portions are huge and priced fairly. They even have free hot tea. Unlike the other reviews, the fries we received were hot and delicious. The employees were friendly and happy to help us order. They cleaned off a table outside for us and brought out all our food. I will definitely be back!

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Italian, Sandwiches
text: So I got the Sicilian combo which was really good it had lasagna ,manicotti and veal.. my wife got the world famous crab cakes they were very large and very good ....lotts of lump crab in them.. the waitress is very nice but the wait for the food is what takes this rating down to a 3... we waited 45 minutes to get our dinner.. if you're looking for some really good crab cakes this is definitely a place to go!!!

place_category: Hot Dogs, Bars, American (Traditional), Burgers, Soup, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Salad, Nightlife
text: Our favorite burger place in town. Fresh burgers, amazing sweet potato tots. Excellent customer service.

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Southern, Taiwanese, Seafood, Bars, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Live/Raw Food, Wine Bars, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Good food, nice menu options, good beer and wine list. Service was good, not memorable.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: Good food, decent prices - poor communication. When making a reservation for 12, we asked if we could be fiaranteed there'd be carrot cake for dessert - as it is our mother's favorite and we were celebrating her 73rd. They said yes, we could order one for the table. What they failed to mention is that it was a sheet cake with 22, wouldn't fit on the table unless served as slices on individual plates, and cost $100.

place_category: Hot Dogs, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, American (New), Burgers, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Bam Dog!! When you advertise the Righteous Hot Dog, you need to deliver. And they did!! I had the Italian Stallion. Being someone who grew up in New Jersey eating Sausage & Pepper sandwiches, I had mixed emotions that this would deliver. But the local made Italian sausage, the house made bun and the house made tater tots were great. I can't wait to try the Texas dog the next time I go there. If you like Hot Dogs(and who doesn't), you need to try Bam Dog.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Diners, Burgers, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Fast Food
text: The best thing that happened to this Steak n Shake location was closing indoor dining due to Covid. The service sucked and it made the kitchen slow and the food cold. With only drive through available now, the food is closer to the old quality of Steak n Shake, and the service faster now that they aren't doing double duty with indoor dining.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, American (Traditional)
text: South Jersey Glitz meet average food... Food is Okay, dining room is awesome and well appointed, service is perfect. Crowd is overdressed South Jersey prom. Carrot cake is to die for.

place_category: Bars, Mexican, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Foods great, atmosphere great, staff is rude and inconsiderate. Wanted to work here but glad I didn't Personally I'd be looking for new employees because the staff is some of the worst I've ever experienced

place_category: Halal, Donairs, Restaurants, Pizza, Food
text: The donairs are quite good and we would order those again. The pizza however is quite greasy and the toppings are not placed consistently on the pizza.

place_category: German, Beer Bar, Food, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Beer Gardens
text: great beer list - lots if choices !!! great sausage!!! horrible service go some place else!!!

place_category: Chicken Wings, Bars, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Burgers, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Horrible service. Sign states "Please Seat Yourself". Sat at booth table, there were no other customers in the dining area, all were at the bar. Sat there for 3-4 minutes and was never acknowledged by any employee. Needless to say, we left the establishment. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone!

place_category: Restaurants, Gastropubs
text: Went here on a first date, and the atmosphere was kinda strange for that. The beer selection is great, but food menu didn't seem that appetizing. Seems more like late-night bar food than a place where you would go to eat a meal.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Pie Hole is fun for me. The pizza is great, and has some wonderful ideas to mix things up like the decadent Gorgonzola Pesto Pizza, which is awesome, and the Thai Chicken is the best one I've had in Boise. The music is good, the atmosphere is pleasant. I really enjoy hopping in for a bite to eat when I need something quick and good and satisfying.

place_category: Caterers, Venues & Event Spaces, Breakfast & Brunch, Gastropubs, American (New), Restaurants, Food, Event Planning & Services, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: Horn's was an amazing local breakfast spot that treated us very well after some long evenings in NOLA. The menu is full of options and the staff is great. We loved everything from the Guatamalan to the Basic Breakfast. I recommend sitting outside if there's room!

place_category: Barbeque, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Southern, Breakfast & Brunch, Comfort Food, Nightlife, Music Venues, Restaurants, Food, Grocery
text: I really like this place. I grew up in a small town and it has that type of feel to it. I don't think this is a place for a vegetarian... This is good southern food, and without a doubt has the best sweet potato fries around

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Dive Bars
text: Oscar's Tavern is delightfully grimy. When I think of what a bar in Philly was approx 15 years ago, I think of Oscar's Tavern. My tutor partner and I go to a different dive every Monday. I am pushing to go back! It was the perfect blend of chatter, quiet, and character. The fried food looks delicious. I didn't eat it, but was a little regretful that I didn't. The waitress was sincere and delightful.

place_category: Bars, Sandwiches, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Pizza, American (New), Salad, Gastropubs, Restaurants
text: Don't expect fancy (or anything remotely close to that) at this joint. It's as straightforward "here's a bar stool, here's a beer, and oh yeah, we serve pizza" kinda place as you'll ever get. That said. The pizza was decent. It's Chicago style, and my family and I did enjoy it.

place_category: Food, Smokehouse, Restaurants, Barbeque, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: Great brisket plate. Nice smoke flavor and the brisket was perfectly tender. Add some of the best baked beans around and the always fun hush puppies and you have a great meal. Service was friendly as it always is.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses, Japanese
text: This place is pretty cool. The sushi was excellent and my girlfriend's bento box was full of food and pretty good. However, it is pretty overpriced.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners, Burgers, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: This was my boyfriend's and my go-to breakfast place EVERY DAY while we were in town! We looked forward to coming here every morning and trying different things on the menu..although my bf did get the breakfast burger twice!! And my favorite was the breakfast quesadilla and omelettes were fantastic too. The staff was so sweet and service was prompt, and we only wished we had enough time to come here to try the lunch items too!!! If we lived in the area this place would see so much of us

place_name: E Sushi Japanese Grill & Sushi Bar
place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Steakhouses, Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion
text: Just had lunch there for the first time, started off with complimentary clear soup and holiday roll appetizer, served even before they took our drink order. I had Hibachi Scallop and my daughter had 3 different rolls. The scallop was cooked right. Everything was fresh and reasonably priced. They have an online menu, check it out you will not be disappointed. Don't forget to try the green tea tempura ice cream!

place_category: Sandwiches, Barbeque, Steakhouses, Southern, Restaurants
text: My burnt ends chili was served to me lukewarm, but tasted OK... Very fatty. Their Turkey sandwich is a joke so I suggest you stick with the brisket.

place_category: Diners, Tex-Mex, Restaurants
text: Great food - I love the biscuits and gravy here! The wait can be long for brunch but they've got a cool school bus you can wait on where they serve drinks AND you can also save your spot in line through yelp so you can get there closer to the time that your name would be called rather than waiting there.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Hotels & Travel, Hotels, Bars
text: Very crowded. Service was difficult due to the amount of peoole. Good cocktails but pricey. I did not sample their food because it wasn't comfortable to eat there - way too many people and not enough spots to sit. If you do go, make a reservation well ahead of time. My impression: overrated

place_category: Food, Fast Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea
text: Awful... the staff has to be careless to let this be sold to someone to eat. I'll be reaching out to corporate about this matter, I really fear for the safety of food that is being served out of this location. My salad looks weeks old

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Burgers, Nightlife, American (New), American (Traditional), Pubs, Gastropubs
text: First time eating here and I was not impressed enough to go back. Honestly, it was disappointing considering all the rave reviews. We all know how that goes sometimes, some places get raves and turn out to suck, others get poor reviews and you have a great experience so oh well. Tips: Don't get the wings. Terrible. The fries were tasty, as well as the Potato Skins stuffed with spinach artichoke dip.

place_category: Active Life, Bowling, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Party & Event Planning, Arcades, Event Planning & Services, Arts & Entertainment
text: GREAT TIMES! Their happy hour is ridic. Soooo good. Get your pale ass off your computer, walk to Bill's Bus, and get a damn drink in yo' face! God bless this place.

place_category: Active Life, Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Bowling, Restaurants, American (New), Gastropubs
text: If you don't have a reservation I would skip this place. They will send you down to the basement past all of the kitchen doors and bathrooms into a bar. If you want to pay a lot of money to sit on a bar stool to eat your dinner that would be the place for you to go. Even if you do I have a reservation I might skip it. Very dark. Hard to see what you're eating. Upstairs is one big open room. Very noisy. Don't plan on hearing any conversation while you're there.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Japanese, Sushi Bars, Thai
text: Hands down the best sushi in the West Chester/Chadds Ford area. Staff is beyond friendly. Very clean restaurant and great menu. Japanese, Chinese and Thai. Appeals to everyone. A few of us went and thoroughly enjoyed everything. The Yummy roll was great. The seared tuna appetizer was great and the spicy miso sauce it was served with. With definitely be back!

place_category: Food, Pizza, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Chicken Wings
text: Tried to order a pizza during their business hours but was called and told that no delivery drivers were "on duty". I'm unsure why we were able to fill out a delivery order online when the location wasn't able to fulfill such a request. The gentleman who called was awkward and almost sounded under the influence. We were not offered anything for the inconvenience nor any apology given. Never ordering from this place again, pizza isn't that great anyway.

place_category: American (Traditional), Gluten-Free, Steakhouses, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Crab cakes were okay. Nothing special. The fish was excellent. A white fish served Mediterranean style. Really good. Rice'd cauliflower also really good.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Pizza
text: Grimaldi's is super good! My friend and I decided to go here for dinner one night. The wait was around 15 minutes which we didn't mind. We ordered a 16" margarita pizza and i ordered a summer sangria. We also ordered bruschetta as an appetizer. It all came pretty fast and it was delicious! The Olive bruschetta was the best. The crust on the pizza was phenomenal and crunchy. I highly recommend grimaldis!

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries
text: Tried the smoked salmon and cream cheese bagel with scrambled egg. The salmon was too darn salty. I literally could not finish the the plate because I thought that I would have had a stroke from my blood pressure skyrocketing from the salt. Kidding but no really it was extremely salty, not too clean either. Pretty cool that you can add a cupcake to your meal for $1 and it was worth it! I tried the wedding cake flavor and it taste homemade and the almond flavor buttercream icing was good too.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants
text: Not much to look at but the place seems to be busy which is good. Hot wings are really good but bbq left something to be desired.

place_category: Sandwiches, Greek, Restaurants, Mediterranean
text: Service was long, hummus was watery, and bland. The pitas were pretty good though! Would try again

place_category: Cajun/Creole, American (New), Southern, Restaurants
text: Underwhelmed. For an Emeril restaurant, and at these prices, I'd expect more. The dessert was likely the best part of the meal. Enough said. The decor is cool, and it's an interesting touch to travel up a glass elevator to get to your table.

place_category: Dive Bars, American (Traditional), Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Sports Bars
text: Just a good old bar where people take full advantage of the smoking policy- which IS allowed. Nice bartenders - very friendly.

place_category: Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Although I was pleased to see syrup in a bottle and not that awful stuff in the little packets, I didn't get to use it due the inflexibility of the place. I wanted to order a single pancake as a side to my breakfast, but only stacks are on the menu and our server told me I can't order a single one. That seems silly. The Eggs Benedict was okay, nothing special. We probably will not return.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (New), Gastropubs, Restaurants
text: Great drink selection, food just OK. Menu is limited, so you'd think the food that they do have would be a slam dunk but it was pretty average. Definitely a great place to come for happy hour or drinks.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Amazing food! Quick and good service. Highly recommend! Great quality food, we all thoroughly enjoyed our lunch. Chimichanga and enchiladas were absolutely the best we've had.

place_category: Bakeries, American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners
text: I hate to give this place a bad review but my last experience sucked. My waitress, although really nice, was not very attentive. We waited a long time to order and receive our food. The food was not great ether. The Spanish omelette was disgusting! The waffles were alright. Also, we asked for plastic utensils because of how filthy the silverware looked. They didn't have plastic forks. Nothing too great about this place.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Horrible! Wings are pretty decent but pizza is terrible. Too much cheese & grease and never any sauce. Pizza has been like that on several occasions.

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Burgers, Barbeque, American (New), Bars
text: Upon entering, we had to wait to be addressed by the hostess. They were not busy and no one was waiting. Seemed more concerned with chatting with a coworker. The waiter was very good and attentive. We had the fried fish and the hot Nashville chicken sandwich. The fish was good. However, the sandwich was very greasy with no heat.

place_category: Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Mexican
text: I went here yesterday with my family I got a Chile verde burrito with Enchilada Style green salsa the salsa they put on top of it must of been rotten it tasted nothing like salsa it tasted like something that came out of a can and was expired cause it was sour I was highly disappointed Tucson has a lot of bad Mexican food but this was one of the worst place I have tried I couldn't even eat my food if you like to be disappointed and waste your money for fun this is the place for you

place_category: Nightlife, Beer Gardens, Breweries, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Was there in January, great beer, cool vibe, but...colder than a witches t__ty in there.

place_category: American (New), Wineries, Food, Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Bars, Wine Bars, Sandwiches, Pizza, Nightlife
text: This was our first experience. The menu has a nice selection of food. Our party of three ordered pizzas which were ok. I will plan to give it another try but will try something different. We went at lunch so it wasn't busy but we had to ask numerous times for sweetener. It was nice that without asking they removed the charge for our ice tea. We will definitely try this place again.

place_category: Greek, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (New)
text: Enjoyed a nice lunch on Tuesday, July 31. Since our last visit on Feb 24, 2012, the service had improved dramatically. Prompt, friendly, and efficient. We were there at about 1:30pm, so there were only about 3 or 4 other active tables, but this was much, much better than our prior experience. The food was excellent, and the time between courses was just right for a leisurely, pleasant experience.

place_category: Grocery, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Convenience Stores, Chocolatiers & Shops, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: It's a lovely place. It is cheap and has great coffee. It's ideally located. Perfect mood for studying or for a relaxing cup of coffee. Highly recommend it!

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Nightlife, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Tapas/Small Plates
text: Most innovative modern Italian restaurant in Brentwood. I almost don't want to leave any review because I don't want it to be too crowded! Food is great, cocktail is great, atmosphere is great! Servers are super nice too!

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: If you search yelp for "Italian Express" your will find the real reviews on this place. It's a horrible place with horrible food and horrible service. It looks like they just made a duplicate page and added "Brandon" to the name in hopes of fooling people.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Chinese
text: The food wasn't bad, it just came cold. Nothing the trusty microwave can't fix. The problem, I think, is that I ordered delivery and the person who delivers rides a scooter so the food basically gets cold on the way over. I don't know if he's the only delivery guy or if they always deliver by scooter, but my advice would be to make sure you're not too far away if you do order for delivery... Which sorta defeats the purpose of delivery.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Desserts, Food, Restaurants, Burgers, Comfort Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Cocktail Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Great theme bar, the food has slipped since they opened. However, it is still a good burger place.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Italian, Salad, Wine Bars, Nightlife
text: We made our own 4 course set and ate like tapas style. One course is half the Ala Carte portions. Enough for sharing that i tasted the dish around 4- 6 times. Then, I will not be so full and also enjoyed the desserts. We had: White Anchovies which was the best version we tasted; crudo which is like a tuna tartare; wild mushroom pasta which was creamy and must try; Egg Raviolo is definitely unique and delicious - try please. Other food that I dont have time to finish the review for now. Lazymode

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bakeries, Food, Caterers, Event Planning & Services
text: This place has stayed true for decades I have been told. Even today youngsters like me have frequently enjoyed the food available here. This is definitely a family/meeting place. get ready for some home-style cooking, it truly is good here!

place_category: Restaurants, Spanish
text: This place use to have good Spanish food, but must be new owners because the food doesn't have any Spanish flavor at all. Not any of the food,the food looks Spanish style but thats about it. If you want good Spanish tasting food, this is not the place.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, Food
text: My mom had ordered a meal and while she ordered the employee had laughed at what she ordered. This is very unprofessional. It's a fast food place I already had low expectations but now they've been lowered even more. Ridiculous.

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New), Coffee & Tea, Food, Nightlife, Vegetarian
text: While the food here is pretty decent, the kitchen service is incredibly slow. The past two times I've been, my order has been an uncooked vegetarian option and it took an hour to get to the table. If you have all day to wait for lunch, then it's not a bad option. Otherwise, there are plenty of efficient and good spots to check out elsewhere.

place_name: Ms. P's Soulful Dash Bar and Grill
place_category: Restaurants, Soul Food, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: First let me say I will be coming back with the hope of giving this restaurant five stars. The owners are sweet and the location is fun. Their food is pretty good, but a bit too greasy for my taste. However, I don't eat meat, and I believe this is a great place for meat eaters. Worth my time and money.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional)
text: Two locations. We visited the original location and the food was what you would expect from any breakfast diner establishment.

place_category: Restaurants, Soul Food
text: Oh my god so good. I've been driving by this place for months and I'm so glad I finally stopped in. The food is amazing- especially the turkey wings. The service is great, very friendly people. Highly recommend.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: The best Italian home-cooked meal in a restaurant, love this place, Great people great food, I don't know what to say i'm not much of a writer but Tony's is the best Italian food I've had in a long time

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: I had a good experience here. Decent food and not bad prices. The service was great, and every time I've been here its been empty so quick service. No complaints here.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Good but my only complaint is that they update their system with a credit card machine. Not to many people carry cash as one would assume and you definitely need cash for this place.

place_category: Acai Bowls, Food Delivery Services, Salad, Poke, Juice Bars & Smoothies, American (Traditional), Food, American (New), Restaurants
text: Disappointed - shrimp (additional upcharge) was overly salty, made it unpleasant! They did serve a generous amount of protein - The pic. is missing at least 4 - 5 pieces of shrimp that I already ate FYI!). The broccoli was just okay, got a ton of it - lightly seasoned. I liked the consistency of the sweet potato noodles - besides that, really plain tasting...They need to step up their game to Fresh Kitchen level; I want something that's more flavorful & tasty for similar prices - okie?!

place_category: Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Dance Clubs, Bars, Music Venues, Mexican, Sports Bars
text: Sadly, the phrase, "cheap is cheap" is true at this restaurant. When I first went by it, I was excited. It has a great ambiance and an awesome happy hour. I got some nachos with chicken for under $5. Great price, but when I got the food, I wasn't impressed. The nachos tasted as if they were missing something.

place_category: Vegetarian, Malaysian, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Absolutely disgusting establishment! For waiting an hour you'll get watered down food and the portion size is a straight up joke due to the price. Empty restaurant, flat drinks, old and watery food, crusty soup, floors that look like they have never been cleaned, and UNBELIEVABLY RUDE STAFF. The manager Tina was very snotty and a total bully to the staff, anyone I know will never be back to this landfill of utter shit.

place_category: Bars, Pubs, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Salad, Pizza
text: The service is horrible! We waited over 45 mins to be told the pizza we ordered never was sent back to be made. Now waiting for another 30 mins.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Soup, Diners, Food
text: It was my first time here. I got a couple of the Mediterranean sandwiches and a cup of the tomato soup. I was very impressed with both the sandwiches and the soup. I would certainly go again.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Visiting from Calif. Found this great restaurant just down street from my hotel. Great food reasonable price and good service. Go happy hr. Margarita was great

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Shaved Ice, Desserts
text: A litttttle pricy if you ask me. But, the ice cream is good! Nice selection of ice cream, water ice, froyo, sundaes, shakes and more. Cookie Ice cream sandwiches are HUGE! This place gets packed in the summer! I had recently had a "make your own" cookie ice cream sandwich and got Reese's swirl ice cream sandwiched between two peanut butter cookies. It was HUGE and more than $6, but delicious.

place_category: Steakhouses, Barbeque, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: This place could be good but the past two times I have come here there has been a debacle. Either out of food, under staffed, or there system is down. Unfortunately the food isn't awesome to overcome other issues. I will not be back to this location.

place_category: Restaurants, Dim Sum, Chinese, Vietnamese
text: So, after my review was posted I got a reply from one of the owners of Lee House. He was apologetic and offered to make up for my bad experience. THAT'S THE SPIRIT!! I agree that everybody makes mistake and I am always willing to give a second chance. That attitude alone worth the extra two stars I am giving now and will update this review when I go back again.

place_category: Food, Bagels
text: Bagels are good but that kiosk needs to go. Bagel shop's should be bang bang quick with several people working behind counter taking each customers orders and making them. It takes too long to stand there and order. Place isn't big enough for that. Too much time is wasted. Also engage with every customer when they walk in. Kiosk makes it unfriendly with zero conversation. Hope efficiency picks up to match quality of bagel.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: I like PJ's iced coffee. The workers are nice. The cafe is spacious and usually clean. My only complaint is that the wifi is really slow, so I can't do all of my work here.

place_category: French, Event Planning & Services, Seafood, Salad, Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Caterers, Restaurants, Modern European, Barbeque, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: My experience at wild garlic was decent. I can see why people are very die hard about it as its own little niche restaurant. First off; the atmosphere was fantastic, I will give them that. However, the food was overhyped for me. I really liked the all the flavors of the plate included between the greens, pork etc, downside was that the preparation was somewhat iffy for me, bust I could put it, it was too wet? Overall it's a spot worth checking out.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caterers, Barbeque, Food Stands
text: This place is ridiculous. Their ribs and pork is fantastic. I'll go in there and get some takeout spend 30 bucks on a rack of ribs couple sides and be happy as a clam. Absolutely delicious food and great sides. Nice little quaint place. I have an eaten inside yet but I do take out all the time. If you want to Breckenridge better get them before they run out because if you go there too late they won't have any left.

place_category: Restaurants, Fish & Chips, Food, Seafood, American (Traditional), Fast Food, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Usually go for some fish and chips when I visit Stearn's Wharf. I know there are other options but I'm usually either too lazy or broke to go for the nicer places. Never ordered anything other than the fish and chips. The fish is okay. Pretty crispy but kind of tasteless. Needs to be dipped in sauce for sure. The fries are okay...a bit greasy but otherwise good. It's not the best fish and chips I've had but it's not terrible either.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Pubs, Bars, Nightlife, Music Venues, Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment
text: Sat at the bar 10 minutes with the bartender text and talked to the delivery guy. Never even acknowledged me. F on service

place_category: Indian, Restaurants
text: Food was good but not service. Papadam was burnt and ask to change, they says we have all like that

place_category: Chinese, Indian, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars
text: So after I posted the review about the receipt goof up they did, the manager reached out to apologize and refunded the money. I'm updating my review to only mention the effort they put in to fix the issue at hand. So hoping they have better practices set to avoid future such incidents.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Burgers, Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Foods good. Can never get good service. You can finish your drink and wait 15 minutes for another if you don't stand up and yell. The last 8 times I've been here it's the same with different employees. Apparently it's in their training manual to not care about customers.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Pizza
text: I want this place to survive because it's a great location and it's super cute with TLC. However, the pizza was inedible because it was so salty. My boyfriends family couldn't eat theirs at all and threw it away. The bears dug thru the trash and ate everything but the pizzas. It seems like it was because of the sauce because the crust was fine. Not sure if the recipe has been edited but less salt and it would have been great!

place_category: Salad, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Delis
text: Tritip and Salsa panini was excellent! The Asian chicken salad was HUGE with a nice kick.

place_category: Seafood, Noodles, Chinese, Restaurants
text: One of the worst customer service. Owners were demanding 20% tip for a lousy service. I am never going back there again.

place_category: Comfort Food, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Your typical diner with decent breakfast when you don't have the will and/or money to navigate Sabrina's or other similar hip brunch places. Good food, cheap prices, quick service, lots of cute old heads. The coffee refill was a little slow but besides that I have no complaints.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries
text: A very long line. Very long. Even on a Monday morning at 10 am. Oh well. There was a lot of talk about it. It was either this place or Puckett's. We chose Pancake Pantry. It was good, not great. Definitely not worth the long line. But I guess a lot of people still choose to wait. Your call. Everyone has to do their own thing I suppose.

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: We got there late in the day and only 2 lb crabs were left so we opted for other menu items instead. I got lobster pasta (very little lobster was evident) and my wife got crab cakes (mostly filler and seasonings). We also had shrimp bisque (very little shrimp taste) The food was not bad, but not great either. Very middle of the road, thus 3 stars. I think if you're not going to get the locally caught crab you'd be better off dining somewhere else.

place_category: Cafes, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: My neighbor and I ate here Tuesday March 4. Very good service. Loved the bacon. Oj was good, fresh squeezed, bit too much pulp, but some love that. Pancake was huge. Great hot syrup was a plus. Eggs cooked well. Nice interior change from McAllisters. It is s chain out of Colorado. Tuesday at noon was not busy at all. Food was quick. Hot. And tasty.

place_category: Bars, Pubs, Sports Bars, Meat Shops, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Arcades, Specialty Food, Food, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: The food was ok but the service is horrible. Never again will I return here. They took forever to get our drink order. Longer to take our actual order. Never came by with refills. Also took forever to get more ranch. Server wasn't even friendly. She looked like she was just there to do her job. While other tables looked like they got a friendly happy server. We had to go to the bar to get our check because they took too long.

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Music Venues, Restaurants, Irish, Bars, Arts & Entertainment
text: This pub is across the street from my office, so I have come a few times with colleagues. It's definitely the kind of place you want to go with friends as its chipper with some good tunes playing. There is a good selection on the menu, but I like to stick with the pub fare. Chicken fingers with yam fries and gravy. Decent size. I think it is a little on the expensive side for a pub lunch, but once in awhile it's ok!

place_category: Thai, Cafes, Vegan, Laotian, Vegetarian, Seafood, Restaurants, Salad, Soup
text: Small, but modern & clean establishment tucked in a small strip mall. I ordered the Chicken Pad Thai and my friend ordered a combination plate of various appetizers. The staff was friendly and the food was delicious!

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Beer, Wine & Spirits, Gastropubs
text: First time in Philadelphia... great food, plenty of TV's and great service. Go Sweden

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants, Food, Barbeque, Italian
text: Nice place! I had lunch there with my boyfriend, and we had a good time. Really nice barbecue!

place_category: Seafood, Sandwiches, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: This review is based off of our visit about 3 months ago. Lots of oysters. We had 3 or 4 dozen raw oysters and a dozen chargrilled oysters between 3 of us. Along with some Boom Boom Shrimp, potato salad, fried oysters, Fried Fish Pontchartrain, and a 1/2 shrimp 1/2 fried oyster po'boy. Everything was good. Service was average but not bad. Pricing was decent and lower than I thought it would come out to be. Good experience!

place_category: Hot Dogs, Restaurants, Cafes
text: I got the border dog, sure, shame on me when El Guero is there, but it was a strong performing dog. Wouldn't mind trying their chili dog or burgers, the burgers were smelling good.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Southern
text: If I could give no stars I would. Ordered online and said 30 mins. Arrived after 30 mins. They haven't started and lady said at counter that she didn't know when they would get to it. Very abrasive. I asked for money back since they hadn't started and she said that no manager was around to help and I could leave with out money. Horrible service and horrible planning by management. Now 45 mins since order and worker just says she doesn't know.

place_category: Diners, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Food, American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants
text: COUPONS are NOT accepted at this franchise. Plan to wait a hour for your food. 2019.

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Went once within a few months of it's opening. Was far from impressed. Pretty young girls in short skirts does not a great eatery make. They were out of the first item I ordered, and what I wound up with was lackluster to say the least. With so many other options, I highly doubt I will return.

place_category: Greek, Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Mediterranean
text: Both of our Gyros had A LOT of burned meat. We couldn't even finish eating them it was so bad (and we were starving). We were also shorted a tzatziki sauce (we ordered 2 gyros, both with tzatziki, plus a spanakopita with a side of tzatziki). Upon pickup, the employee said that everything was in there, which was incorrect. Extremely disappointed with the quality of food and felt like we got ripped off.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Last time I ordered here, I got hush puppies, codfish basket and one blue claw crab with garlic and Cajun seasoning. The crab was so good and tasty. The codfish nuggets lacked flavor in my opinion. They also left out the coleslaw in my basket. The hush puppies were fine. I would order from them again when I want something a little different. The seasonings on their crabs are great.

place_category: Food, Cafes, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: This place seems to be all hype. A good friend suggested it to me and man I just don't get it. The coffee was bitter, the cinnamon roll wasn't even sweet, it was so plain that my kids wouldn't even eat it. This place is really cute and I wanted so badly yo like it. But I gotta be honest it's just over priced stuff for hipsters.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Canadian (New), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Pubs, Bars, Burgers, Nightlife
text: My favs at this place are their peach margaritas and their chocolate peanut butter fried dough dessert. Sooo good. Its a great happening place to watch a hockey game too. Only cons I have experienced is when the staff say the "blender is broken" and that you feel like you are sitting in the road with a bunch of fumes when on their patio. lol. I wish they could have a rooftop patio like O2s!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Tonight was our first time here. No wait at all to be seated even though they were quite busy. We started with the sizzling rice soup which was good. We then had the orange beef, honey walnut shrimp and the house fried rice. All was good but we weren't crazy about the house fried rice. We'll try just the fried rice next time.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Creperies, Coffee & Tea, Vegetarian, Restaurants, Food
text: One of the first places I ate in Clayton, and I still think about it even though I'm not living there anymore. Though a little overpriced, the portions are generous and nearly all the flavors I've tried are delicious (try the Florentine, and when berries are in season, the berry crepes). And I absolutely LOVE the ambience - the interior is small with some outdoor seating; reminiscent of a small European cafe. A lovely place to visit on a Spring St. Louis morning.

place_category: Food, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: OwowCow has great fresh ice cream. Do not miss the opportunity to try it if you are in Lambertville or New Hope. I really liked the strawberry and pumpkin flavors. The blueberry lemon is good too.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Me encanta la comida en este lugar ordenó algunas veces en la semana y siempre quedo complacida los ingredientes son frescos

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: Oops! Waited too long to write this review, but I'm not surprised they closed... Seemed like overpriced food that didn't taste that great. Pork was overcooked.

place_category: Adult Entertainment, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Eatertainment, Pool Halls, Bars, Active Life, Arts & Entertainment, American (Traditional), Bowling, Arcades, Nightlife
text: While this is a great place to entertain yourself with electronic games and things. Think twice about eating here. The fare is sub par to other local restaurants and along the lines of mediocre chain restaurant food. While I don't like to pick on the wait staff because I've worked in the service industry. I will just say it was less then attentive. The food was edible but room temperature by the time it got to the table. Luckily we were not in a rush because everything was a slow process.

place_category: Food, Tobacco Shops, Shopping, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: The cashiers are very rude for no reason, at all. They act like it's your fault that they work there. All I said was "Have a nice night" and she glared at me for no reason. Will never come here again after that.

place_category: Desserts, Food, Bakeries
text: No chips, just a couple of shavings of chocolate in my chocolate chip cookie, peanut butter cookie was bland. Definitely no "wow" factor in any of the cookies. If your looking for a sweet treat - go someplace else.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: I've lived in Upper Darby for 5 years and never came to this place until recently. My husband and I wanted Italian but didn't want to go far. Bona Cucina is truly a gem. It's not the fanciest place in town, but the food is excellent and the prices are reasonable. The staff is friendly and service was good. Give it a try!

place_category: Mexican, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Seriously!! Amazing tacos and the salsa... outstanding. If you are anywhere near this place and don't eat here, you are wrong.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: Can't say enough about their burgers. Without a doubt the best place for casual dining. We will definitely be coming back here.

place_category: Arabic, Lebanese, Mediterranean, Restaurants, Middle Eastern
text: Sorry but I probably won't be back. I waited about a half hour for a $5 lunch take out order when the restaurant only had one table of 4 already finishing up. Otherwise the place was empty. The sandwich was small and mediocre in quality. I commented to the manager about it taking so long and he didn't seem to care about me as a first time customer.

place_category: Japanese, Food, Tapas/Small Plates, Restaurants
text: This place had an interesting layout. I noticed it was quiet for a Friday night but it could be because the nearby schools are out. It was also easy for me to park on the street last night; I was surprised. They had an interesting twist on Japanese food as we stuck to little plates. I liked the Drexel inspired maki roll, very non-traditional. The other items were pretty standard. No complaints. The servers were very nice.

place_category: Restaurants, Mongolian, Chinese
text: Scheswan and Mandarin, my favs. A nice find. Decent food, good prices.

place_category: Caterers, Venues & Event Spaces, Breakfast & Brunch, Gastropubs, American (New), Restaurants, Food, Event Planning & Services, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Nightlife
text: This is my favorite breakfast spot in New Orleans! Everything is delicious. The service is also very good.

place_category: Food, Event Planning & Services, American (Traditional), Caterers, Smokehouse, Barbeque, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: There is no other way to say this, but Bogart's has the best ribs I have ever had hands down. Baked beans are almost as good as the ribs-they are exceptional (smokey and flavorful). While waiting in the obligatory line being sampled from the smoked hog in the entry way, everyone was so friendly including the locals and staff. A+ for food and service. Now you can't say that about many restaurants anywhere. Highest recommendation.

place_category: Food, American (New), Caterers, Barbeque, Event Planning & Services, Food Delivery Services, Diners, Restaurants
text: My one time visiting and I won't be back. Food had no flavor, no smoke flavor at all and portions small for a $7 plus plate. The coleslaw was dry, and just not a good meal for the money with so many other choices available.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Went to a high school reunion. The food was less then stellar. I'm not sure what merits any recommendation. The bartenders were very nice . The food was kind of sad. We were stuck in a basement on a really nice day. No one was on the deck so I'm not sure why they did offer to move us. Mold on the ceiling was gross. Is that ok?

place_category: Vietnamese, Restaurants
text: Apparently the chicken curry soup is good, maybe I should have tried that....anyway, I got the Single Person Rice Entree (Beef & Pineapple with bell Peppers & boiled rice - disgusting.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Went today and loved the food! We ordered chicken fried rice, vegetable pho, salad with shrimp, vegetable roll with peanut sauce. Everything was fresh and flavorful. Perhaps they are putting it all together. The service was excellent and there are No leftovers.

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: We went because its our first time in Philadelphia and heard it's one of the things to do. It was ok. After a long walk from the society hill stop (trolley tour) through very dubious neighborhoods we made it. We chose Genos because the line was shorter. Meat was not seasoned but at least it was real meat. Definitely greasy. Fries were ok. There wasn't any seating left so we ate along the fence across the street. Previous reviews about customer service is accurate.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Custom Cakes, Food, Cupcakes, Desserts, Specialty Food, Chocolatiers & Shops
text: Cool concept but the ice cream wasn't anything special. They have a cool mixing device that puts the toppings into the ice cream. But the base is store bought average ice cream. We were very disappointed when we left. Oh ya, there are so many options of toppings it gets confusing. They need to streamline the concept.

place_category: Chicken Shop, Korean, Restaurants
text: The chicken is crunchy and the meat is tender. It seems like a perfect piece of fried chicken, however the pieces of chicken had little meat - mostly bone, cartilage and fat, which was quite disappointing. Anyhow, it remains a good fried chicken joint.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Italian, Food Delivery Services, Pizza
text: Best pizza in palm harbor! Always hot and fresh. We have been ordering from queens for over two years now and have never had a bad experience.

place_category: Southern, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Steakhouses, Breakfast & Brunch, Buffets, American (New)
text: My wife and I had Sunday brunch and it was decent. It is a typical brunch buffet divided among several stations including breakfast, salad bar, an omlet/pasta station, hot bar with lunch entrees, and desert. There is also a Bloody Mary station where you can customize your drink if you ordered one. Not the best brunch we've ever had but definitely good!

place_category: Bars, Food, Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Diners, Bakeries
text: BAKERY is AWESOME - when we have dinner parties, we always pick up the cake from Ponzios. Breakfast is good, however DINNER, not so great. During our last visit, the spaghetti was very overcooked (couldn't eat it and I'm not a picky eater) and there as a gnat in my husband's salad. I do love that this is a mom and pop place.

place_category: Nightlife, Pubs, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (Traditional), Burgers, Bars, Food, Restaurants
text: Skip it for something better... I've been here twice now. The first time I had a killer burger and the service was fair. The second time, the burger was mediocre, the fries were greasy and uncooked all the way through and the service was way below par. Don't waste your time. There are better burgers and much better service in Santa Barbara.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: I wavered between 4 and 5, and landed on 5 because of the creativity and flavor executed in most dishes. One dish was way over salted but everything else was flawless. This had been on my list for awhile and I'm so happy to have finally eaten here. Perfect service, and an amazing array of food. Recommend it for sure!

place_category: Specialty Food, Cheese Shops, Cafes, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Sandwiches, Food, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Bars, Nightlife
text: This is a great place good quality food good menu, but like so many places in Santa Barbara, $12 for a grilled cheese and bacon sandwich, is just way too much to charge. The blueberry cffee cake ,on the other hand, was only four bucks and the slce was large.

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: Ordered chicken pad Thai take out and it was tasty, but definitely not close to the best in st Pete. It will give you your fix, for sure, but I won't be banging down their door for more. The good news is they are one of the few open on Sunday's, so if you need it in a pinch, this is a good spot.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Food was just OK... nothing special to write home about... just VERY average breakfast food. Was there with 3 other people we all had different dishes and they said the same. I'd come here again but it definitely would not be my first choice. The best thing about this place was the atmosphere. Service was pretty slow for it not being very busy.

place_category: Pubs, Music Venues, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Gastropubs, Restaurants, Food, Breweries, Arts & Entertainment
text: I've never had a good experience here. My server let our drinks go empty and took a while to come back to check on us. She even recommended an appetizer to us and then messed up the order. How can you mess up something you specifically recommended? This place has potential because of the drink menu but the service needs to be better. They should also think about putting more lights/a live band or loud music out near the games on the side of the building.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian, Chicken Wings
text: We ordered a supreme pizza and this is what we got. Never ordering from there again. Customer service was the worst.

place_category: American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Chicken Shop, Caterers, Comfort Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: Dinner for 2 tonight. Cornbread and corn. Yum!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Be careful I was in there today getting pizza the woman making the pizza doesn't' wear a mask and I see the delivery person doesn't also. in this day of covid 19 and people dying you should be aware of this. When I asked about her about wearing it I said " Do you ever where that mask " she " Said a course with the mask still down if you want to be served by a no mask wearing Karen's it good place to go with a snide look you should beware and maybe concern .

place_category: Fast Food, Mexican, Tex-Mex, Restaurants
text: My sour cream was soupy and I think they cut it with water. There must be a shortage of sour cream. Times are tough I guess. The food made my tummy not feel good :/ also whoever is in charge of the music should be jailed for playing a 30 minute mix of tropical garbage

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Ew. Can I give less than one star? It's very hard to screw up the classic General Tso's chicken but this place accomplished that. It tasted like old barbeque chicken that sat out all day. The vegetable lo mein was cold and bland. We ordered a "large" Shrimp and broccoli and there were like 7 shrimp. Can't imagine what the small is. The sweet and sour chicken is pretty much just fried batter with no chicken. Just don't.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: This location just opened and it was not friendly at all. They messed up my order, i didn't get a receipt, and the food was nasty. Anyone who asks their customers do they want chicken or tenders needs to be trained on better customer service. Instead of taking my order the staff were fascinated by a baby that they were playing with. I will not be returning to Popeyes and I'm even more upset they are building a Florissant location.

place_category: Japanese, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Ramen, Restaurants
text: Although the ramen was delicious, the whole restaurant feels like so much pretentious twaddle. Diners are jammed into a small room so the front room/bar area remains completely empty. The music is loud and filled with profanity and the decode is more Russian gulag than welcoming. I'm out.

place_category: Restaurants, Lounges, Bars, Mexican, Nightlife, Tex-Mex, Breakfast & Brunch
text: We order the chicken tacos and the fish tacos. They were both just ok. Not too much flavor and they were small. Food was a bit over priced and I left unsatisfied. There are plenty of other good Mexican places in Philadelphia to go to over El Rey.

place_category: American (Traditional), Seafood, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: DIrty tables, poor service, over priced food, and its in the Mills nuff said stay away.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Bars, Pubs
text: I like Mac's. A simple, nicely redone bar with a good beer selection. The atmosphere was busy, but mellow. I was a huge fan of Skinner's, so it will always be missed. From the few experiences I had at Mac's, they offer good specials and better than average pub grub. It may not be a destination spot for me, but I think it offers a good alternative in Old City. I don't know what it's like on a normal weekend night but for a lazy, cold Sunday, it fit just fine.

place_category: Children's Clothing, Comfort Food, Fashion, Department Stores, Beauty & Spas, Women's Clothing, Restaurants, Men's Clothing, Cosmetics & Beauty Supply, Shopping
text: I bought a Michelle watch , which broke and now the store is charging me to have it fixed?

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: My wife and I weren't terribly impressed. We found the food overpriced and just okay. Service was mediocre as well. Seemed like the value in this place was the beautiful view. But it's a popular joint so maybe we just didn't order wisely. We also sat on the pier and it was very cold, even in early September, which could have skewed our feelings.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Tea Rooms, Coffee & Tea, Bubble Tea, Food
text: I had the rose milk tea with boba. The drink was good, and the boba had good flavor but was on the chewier side. They also need to have a little more more ice in their drinks to keep the milk tea cold.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Cute place to get drinks and take pictures, not so great for dinner. The food was okay, the service was not good.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Wasn't really all that impressed with the meal. Was just kind of mediocre and may have been better had I tried something not breakfast related. place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Greek, Restaurants

place_category: Italian, Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch

place_category: American (New), Lounges, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Restaurants
text: #37StoriesUp What a night! If my married (or courting singles) friends are looking for delicious dining ideas...#R2L is the best and most excellent choice.

text: Great space in a converted train station acts as lobby and bar area. Good location. Its a little awkward that many of the rooms are across a small footbridge in a newer part of an attached mall. Try and stay in the original part of the building. We had a group of 17 visiting and to watch the Cardinals at Busch Stadium. Very convenient. Hospitality was up to Marriott standards. Dinner was slow for a party of 10. Room service excellent. Randy at the front door with the Bellmen was a standout!

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Music Venues, Breweries, American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese

place_category: Korean, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Thai, Japanese

place_category: Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Restaurants, Bars
text: Finally ate there today. The food was good but in my opinion not the best in Nashville. I got a half rack dry, baked beans, and fries. The baked beans were really good. The ribs were good but now that I have been, I don't feel the need to rush back anytime soon.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Burgers, Bars

place_category: Mexican, Salad, Fast Food, American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants, Tex-Mex

place_category: Wine Bars, Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Nightlife, Gluten-Free, Italian

Will have to try the pizza next time

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: I will never eat there again. I ordered chicken Parmesan and after about four bites I realized my chicken was raw! The manager Gary said this hardly ever happens. What? Like it was a common occurrence. This place will never last. I ignored a good friends advice saying he had a bad meal there. Next time I will listen.

place_category: Bars, Lounges, American (New), Restaurants, Nightlife, Wine Bars
text: Disappointed in last Saturday's meal. Our server was very good and attentive, but the food (sauerbraten and salmon) were not up to par. We eaten here before, and this is one of my wife's favorites, but not sure what happened last week.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, Chicken Shop, Chicken Wings, Food, Greek, Mediterranean
text: Absolutely the best chicken ever. My sister has actually driven from Pasco County to get this chicken - it's that good. My husband opts for ribs sometimes and they are hard to resist - meaty and tender. The decor leaves much to be desired, but the food is amazing.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants

place_category: Indonesian, Singaporean, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Specialty Food, Food, Ethnic Food
text: I love this place. I especially love that it's less than 2 blocks from my house, but I'd also travel for it. I've only ordered take-out from the hot bar. It's so good. You can get three veggie dishes over rice - a huge amount of food - for $10. My favorites are the collards and the eggplant, and the seitan and tofu is pretty tasty too. If you're looking for textural variation, this isn't your place, but I love stewy, tender, mushy food so that is a-ok with me. Service is great too!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Hookah Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Food, Restaurants, Cafes
text: Wondered upon this spot one day in early January of 2013. It's a cute little cafe with a lovely worn couch, a few tables and nice owner. Coffee was pretty tasty and the crepes sound lovely, although I have yet to try them.

place_category: Restaurants, Hot Dogs
text: If you like your sausage (tube steak) boiled in water of questionable origin (storm drain run off), and served up by a local character of note (homeless man), then Lucky Dog (run, run and don't look back) is your place (place of gastrointestinal distress)! Granted, after ____ (insert number) of Hurricanes and Budweisers (Redneck Lite), your impaired judgement (munchies) will probably lead you to a Lucky Dog, whether you read this or not.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Food was good, nothing really exceptional. Our server, Christine, was wonderful, however. For the price, there are places I would rather go, but it was a good experience. My steak was cooked perfectly, as was my wife's salmon. However, once again, the taste was nothing extraordinary.

place_category: Desserts, Salad, Cajun/Creole, Food, Restaurants

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, Italian, Gluten-Free

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Comfort Food

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Sushi Bars
text: Food: ROLLS 8/10, sashimi 2/10. Sashimi was NOT fresh. Both of my friends got food poisoning after eating here. Also, it is $60 for the sushi platter pictured below. However, I think the price we paid for were the decorations and not for the food. I would have liked better fresher sashimi rather than pretty decorations. However, rolls were great and I'd get takeout of the rolls. Service: 8/10 Atmosphere: 6/10

place_category: Greek, Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Mediterranean
text: Awesome food! I had the pasta with salmon and my friends got the tortellini and the steak. We shared, all were fantastic! Definitely going back!

place_category: Greek, Restaurants, Mediterranean
text: Awesome find. We stopped by for a drink and found they have 2x1 sangrias and half Off Sangria pitchers. The red sangria was awesome topped with fresh apples. They also have shisha, which is an interesting pairing. We didn't eat but I would go back simply for those delicious sangrias.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Italian, Soup
text: We tried to get a reservation at Vechia Osteria and couldn't. Tried this alternate Italian restaurant. The service was awful and the food average. Had a larger party so were charged a mandatory 20% tip. Took over an hour before our appetizers. Dinner did not include anything green on plate so a blob of beige. Tasted fine but unappetizing presentation. Worth the effort to get to Vechia Osteria. Skip this restaurant. Very disappointing.

place_category: Food, Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers, Coffee & Tea
text: This is the worst McDonalds in the United States. Consistently bad service - in fact, the staff might try to make you have a bad day. Not sure if I'm being punked when I go here.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Pubs, Gastropubs, Japanese, Restaurants, Czech, Nightlife, Bars
text: The food is excellent, but the music is way too loud. My half-Japanese boyfriend was impressed with the Ramen. Bring ear plugs and enjoy the delicious menu. place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Not a fan and service was terrible. Staff overwhelmed with crowds. Food was not good either and it was overpriced. I will stick with the pizza place across the street!!! 5 stars there!

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Fast Food

place_category: Grocery, Desserts, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Bakeries, Restaurants, Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Nightlife, Bars
text: Service at this location seems to take FOREVER! The food I got here did not do justice for the price... over $11 for a salad w/ chicken strips and a drink. I love Bw3's but maybe this location just needs a little help.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Salad, Sandwiches
text: Food was good enough to order from again but it took forever. I was the only person in the restaurant and all I ordered was a chicken Caesar and water. Waitress Did the best she could but 20 minutes with no other customers in there doesn't work for me.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: We purchased The Don - Very good pizza but everything is a la carte. Our server was great but the wait for food was almost to the lengthy side of time. place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood
text: my husband and I bought one pound each of crawfish and shrimp, both were amazing flavor, the shrimp we had a little trouble peeling as the meat seemed to want to stick to the shell but we worked it out.. watch the time because these guys close when the market does. we went back the next day for to grab some more for dinner at 7pm and they were closed.

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Japanese, Sushi Bars
text: Awful. The sushi was full of rice with hardly any fish or toppings like avocado. Even so, the rice was soggy.
