For two people at an ayce late lunch the total came out to 49.00 which is pretty pricey for terrible sushi. On a positive note, the service was attentive but we will not be coming back.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Pizza, American (Traditional), Italian
text: Granted I don't eat cheese so reviwing a pizza joint is a little off, but myself and all the other vegans and ex-vegans I know swear by the alegro tomato pie. It's fricken delicious. Beare in mind this place in university city so your going to have to put up with more drunk jocks then you can shake a stick at but hey if you can't beat 'em join 'em...alegros sells beer.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: It is a typical chinese restaurant. The food is good. I recommend general tso's chicken, shrimp with garlic sauce and hot and sour soup. U must try shrimp with garlic sauce, it will surprise you.

place_name: One 19 North Tapas and Wine Bar
place_category: Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Tapas Bars, Bars, Tapas/Small Plates, Nightlife
text: Tried a lot. Loved it all. Calamari, baked goat cheese, hummus, lamb chops, bbq shrimp, Brussel sprouts, pork carnitas. All Yum. Can't wait to go back. They have live music on Saturday nights. Awesome girls night out! Tried a new wine. Loved it too. We had great service. Highly recommend.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Fast Food
text: The salsa is too spicy and the cheese tastes fake. Chips taste just like any other chip. Chicken is rubbery. Burritos are too messy to eat without a container. A bit overpriced. Save your money and go to costa. They have better coupons and better service.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Gastropubs, Sports Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Lounges, Bars

Parking is the worst here, valet only. Take an Uber or Lyft and you will be happy. That is true for anything in the area though.

Service was a bit spotty, esp. for not being that busy on a Fri. night. Might give it a try for their weekend brunch sometime.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian, Sandwiches
text: The food here is consistently good but the service is so hit or miss. I went in for a coffee (they heavily advertise the cafe), waited for and 10 minutes with absolutely no acknowledgement and so decided to leave. I really like this place, just wish the service was more considtent.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, American (New), Pop-Up Restaurants, Asian Fusion
text: Probably the worst tom kha soup I have ever had, and I eat at a thai place almost every other day! The soup was so milky, almost tasted like you are drinking whole milk, no coconut flavor, no lemongrass or ginger flavor. The spicy flat noodles was good. The portions are small for the price. Nothing out of the ordinary.

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Thai
text: I've only tried the chicken pad Thai so far but it was great. I'll definitely be back.

place_category: Seafood, American (Traditional), Burgers, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Cafes, Sports Bars

place_category: Food Delivery Services, Pizza, Sandwiches, Italian, Food, Restaurants
text: Would have been a 5 but... I love that this Jet's carries GF pizza. However, when I get psyched up to eat pizza and go there and they're out of stock, my tastebuds cry. Please keep on top of the GF crust orders!

place_category: Gluten-Free, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Barbeque, American (New)
text: I didn't come here expecting more than the standard sports bar fare. I went on a quiet night, but the staff was super attentive. Our waiter was a craft beer aficionado and have me a free sampling of some beers. The food was pretty decent and above average. I got the turkey burger which was a bit soggy but good. If you're looking for a sports night out with the guys in Indianapolis your first and only stop should be Colts Grille.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Creperies
text: Crepe and coffee were good. Got the ABC crepe with an americano. The place was easy to get to had a nice seating area. Not sure if I am prepared to pay that price again.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: For the money you can't beat it large size omelettes everything else is very good. You won't leave their hungry!

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Gluten-Free, Breakfast & Brunch

Everything was amazing! Very filling and flavorful. The latkes are massive! Wish I lived nearby to go again :)

place_category: American (Traditional), Japanese, Restaurants, Korean, Sushi Bars

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Overall experience was ok. Service was good, but the menu felt like it was lacking options. I had a chicken sandwich with a side of hummus and veggies. This with a drink cost a little more than i would typically pay. Not sure if I'll be back.

place_category: Mexican, Wine Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Beer Bar

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Tiny little place with homemade ice cream. Had the dark chocolate. - love the description - dark, like my soul...lol. Vintage video game idea was pretty cool. My kids would like this place.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Barbeque, Desserts
text: Place was alright! Wasn't to fond of the mac n cheese or the ribs. The brisket on the other hand, is out of this world. These guys have a really good business and I hope this place stays! The rea is really good too. There's quite a bit of places to select from when wanting some nice BBQ, and this place goes above and beyond. Hope they are here to stay!

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Caterers, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Custom Cakes
text: CAKES ARE CUTE BUT DRY AS DUST Like others I really wish I liked their cakes. They do a pretty good job on the decorating. The cake however, is dry as dust. We ordered one cake for our kid's first birthday that was really cute. When you cut into it, it literally fell apart like dust. Once again, I had another one this week and the same thing. I thought a moist cake was what people wanted. Maybe that just is our taste and not what other people want. CAKES ARE CUTE BUT DRY AS DUST!

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: A really good place to order out from. My dad and I got extra sushi when we ordered out. The delivery is super fast too.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Food, Pan Asian, Asian Fusion, Cantonese, Thai, Chinese
text: I do not know why I keep trying to order takeout from here because everytime I do I regret it because they are very rude over the phone and at the window. Now when you are dining inside they are nice to you but the food is okay especially when you compare it to the many other great Chinese places in New Tampa. Just a little further north up BBD, SushiKo offers more robust authentic Chinese cuisine, and in my view fresher ingredients.

place_category: American (New), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Burgers
text: Figured it was pointless to ask for egg beaters and dry toast when I saw how much butter they used when frying their eggs and hash browns. A good way to meet fellow travelers and locals and get travel tips. All-in-all, a great experience.

place_category: Salad, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Sandwiches, Do-It-Yourself Food, Soup, Vegetarian, American (New)

text: The server Nick was on the ball Saturday afternoon. Good waiter wit great guest presence! The sweet potato fries in my order were cold and mushy, then when I moved my food over there were 100's of nasty greasy things left over from the deep fryer- did I get last nights dumpings? Maybe The did not bring the appetizer until after the food came out snd the expeditor was totally clueless- but trying- Yaaay!? $5.00 off the meal from the manager- Yuuummm? Missed the mark--

place_category: Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Thai, Chinese
text: Fun fact: Odds are the Best of Cher will be playing in the background. We go here once every other week and sure enough, Cher is always playing. I got you....da da da da da da. Check out my previous review. This place is still good. Good stuff.

place_category: Beer Gardens, Restaurants, Food, Breweries, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Gastropubs, Nightlife
text: Good beer. Bad soft pretzels. I could've made a better pizza at my house. No sauce. Really cool bocce area and bar area

place_category: Food, Farmers Market
text: My first time to a farmers market in Arizona. I had expected more fruits and veggies like in the mid West. This place only had one or two stalls. The rest of the stalls were mostly trinkets and trades. I would not call it a true farmers market.

place_category: Japanese, Thai, Chinese, Restaurants
text: If you are looking for anything close to authentic Chinese food you will not get it here. Every dish tastes remarkably the same with a disproportionate amount of vegetable filler. Even staples like dumplings or fried rice are almost unrecognizable. I've tasted 8 different dishes and none would be worth ordering again. The staff is very nice and takeout is ready on time but the quality of the food is not even close to acceptable.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Pizza, Italian
text: Worst Pizza Hut in the area. Every order I have ever had is either late or the wrong order completely! Either something missing or sent the wrong thing. Once I revived a pizza that only had cheese on half the slices! One night I called and it rang forever. I waited a few minutes and called back and a frantic employee answered the phone and said they were short handed and that the manager told him not to answer the phone anymore. Total waste of time!

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Cafes, Comfort Food, Vegetarian, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Ended up checking out Sabrina's for breakfast. Ordered Ultimate Mexi Scramble and STUFFED CHALLAH FRENCH TOAST we shared the two dishes. The ultimate Mexi scramble had awesome eggs, the potatoes were over and undercooked. The Stuff French toast was decent, the toast itself didn't have much flavor other than the toppings.

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, Nightlife, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Burgers
text: Standard franchise Applebee's. They had some plexiglass barriers between the booths which was nice. They were short staffed so social distancing was not an issue. It was $6.99 burger night with endless French fries. Great deal for a Monday night. Service was great, seemed like she was an old Chick-Fil-A employee with her mannerisms. It was pleasant to have her as our server.

place_category: Sandwiches, Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Chicken Wings, Burgers, Cheesesteaks
text: Literally got the whole order wrong. Forgot dressings for all three salads, and for something simple that requires dressings how can you forget all of them? The ticket clearly stated what we ordered and it still came out all wrong. They messed up a cheesesteak order that just had extra cheese and onions. Instead, they put the extra cheese and on a side order of grilled chicken that was meant for a salad. Also the side order of grilled chicken we got came with a bone.

place_category: Cafes, Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: This was very close to Sabino Canyon, so after a morning of hiking, I checked it out for lunch on Saturday. I loved the downtown restaurant during my last trip to Tucson, and this location did not disappoint! Wonderful service and tasty food! Wanted something sweet to end the meal, and the small ice cream was the perfect size after the big lunch portions!

place_category: Hawaiian, Tiki Bars, Gastropubs, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars
text: Do not come here with a large group. They don't know how to handle it. Probably fine if you are just a small gathering.

place_category: Seafood, Party & Event Planning, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Mexican
text: This is not real Mexican food! They used the same ground beef Taco Bell uses, no flavoring. The rice looks like orange rice, not Mexican. They don't even use corn tortillas. The caso was water like soup. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant!

place_category: Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, American (New), Restaurants, Jazz & Blues
text: Fun place to go listen to live Jazz music. The food, although they try to be more upscale and innovative, lacks flavor, execution and quality. There cocktails and wine list are ok. My tip- go sit in the bar to listen to live music, have a cocktail and order an appetizer.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: Friendly service, great food. I had the chicken red curry and it was delicious. Small place but clean with quick service.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Best Q in Indiana, never had better ribs. The brisket is always the downfall of wannabe Q masters. They nail it - gimme the hot sauce Ok, we came back a week later with son and daughter in law. Everyone ordered a different dish. They both agreed Brisket and Pulled pork were the best they tasted in 15 years. And who can stop eating the biscuits?

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: This is quick spot for pizza slices if you have a craving for pizza in the area. It's not the greatest in the city and not the worst. You can order whole pies as well. Their customer service is always good.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Pakistani, Indian, Cocktail Bars, Food, Food Delivery Services, Soup, Halal, Bars, Nightlife
text: I have to give this 3 star because of the wine. It was a amazing wine can't remember the name. Food was ok afterwards it gave me very bad heart burn. Service was pretty ok. Buy the time we got out of the restaurant it was full so this must be a good place to eat. I might try it again sometimes but not now.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, American (New)
text: Went for lunch with some coworkers, initially agreeing because I saw that they had a cauliflower crust option for those of us with dietary restrictions. I was so impressed with it! It was just like a thin crust pizza, I'll absolutely go back simply because they have this option. My colleagues were pleased with the value of the lunch option, so this will likely be part of our regular rotation!

place_category: Tex-Mex, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Not my favorite of the Tijuana Flats locations but the food is good and the service is usually friendly. You can't go wrong with Taco Tuesdaze - two tacos, chips, and a soda for $5.99. Their nachos are amazing and my friends always comment on how fresh they look when I post them online. Their hot sauce bar is lacking in variety but their craft beer menu is A+!

place_category: Sandwiches, Salad, American (Traditional), Cheesesteaks, Breakfast & Brunch, Active Life, American (New), Beaches, Restaurants
text: Don't let the name fool you. Very good Cheesesteak. Small outfit, but highly recommended by Philly fans. Did not disappoint. Serving portions generous . Sort of seedy sitting area outside, but I understand it has a rich history in Philadelphia. Would definitely go back.

place_category: American (Traditional), Diners, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: The customer service was terrible the our waitress ignored us most of the time I had to catch her while she was walking past serving other customers the people at the register acted like they was red to go home the food was very sub par it was pretty cheap and I still felt like I over paid I would never spend another dime in that place I would re-gift a gift card if someone tried to give it to me it really was an overall bad experience

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food
text: There's was a dearth of servers here on a Saturday during Homecoming at the local university. Not sure how that happened, but they were a bit slower than normal because of it, but at least they noticed us. Food here isn't anything remarkable, but the TBM and wasabi roast beef sandwiches are usually acceptable. Chai Tea Latte is decent, although the House Coffee has no refills.

place_category: Seafood, Venues & Event Spaces, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Bars, American (New)
text: Mediocre service and cuisine with tourist prices. We got the swordfish and sole almandine. Portions of the dish were cold or lacked flavor. Great location though and might be a better option for HH rather than a meal.

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Latin American, Venezuelan, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: We were the first ones here and the last ones served. It's a new place and maybe they are working out the kinks but they need to get this together. I had to ask for syrup for my waffles and I still don't have margarine.

place_category: Home & Garden, Shopping, Appliances, Burgers, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Seafood, Italian
text: I sat at the bar and it had a stale musty odor. The filet mignon tasted like an ashtray and was tough. . They had 2 servers for the whole place.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Sullivans steakhouse completely blew me away! From the moment we walked in to the moment we walked out! Brandon, our server, also stellar in every regard! The food, the room,the service, the people, the atmosphere....... If I could give it more stars I would. Outstanding! And will definitely return!

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Very disappointed. We decided to try this place out cuz we saw the sign special for $20. We were here at 7 pm. Saturday night. Restaurant open till 10 pm. But server told us special is run out. !!!! We alway runout. Well it's alway happen just put the sign down. For me this call you a'll cheat to customer...

place_category: Music Venues, Bars, Restaurants, Italian, Steakhouses, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Cocktail Bars
text: Went here last Tuesday for Ladies Night. The Sangria was really tasty and my friend liked her martini. We were lucky enough to get a spot near the bar so that we could enjoy the specials. However-the musicians were SO LOUD! It's nice to hear live music, but I was screaming to hear my friend and we were practically right in each other's face. The next morning I woke up with a sore throat from having to yell. I would like to go back.....provided the music is turned down.

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, Hot Dogs, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Burgers
text: A full crowd, MANY TV's with plenty of sports ..looked like everyone was having a good time. But the food..eh. Double Dogs is the name and I love hotdogs and anticipated something extraordinary and what I got was a plain hotdog slathered in some kind of fake cheese with onions and tomato. Seriously, no taste. And the fries... zero seasoning-tasted like plain potato and grease..blah. Note: Husband did like his hamburger. But it's a hot dog place for goodness sake!

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Barbeque, Bars, Music Venues, American (Traditional)
text: I had the pork salad, the pork was good the salad was ordinary and the waiter jokes were rude

place_category: American (New), American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Server was ok, food was garbage tasted like everything was cooked old rancid oil. Had eggs benedict, muffin was dripping in oil. My wife had pancakes and scrambled eggs NOT GOOD EITHER. This place is really bad, do not waste your money here. I complained to cashier and she gave me a 3.00 dollar discount, I will not go back. These shithole so called out dated restaurants should either remodel, re invent or shut it down.22.00 for breakfast-ripoff.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries
text: I admit the pancakes were perfectly made, but it seems a little over hyped for me. This is just your run of the mill breakfast joint. Everything else was alright, and they have an extensive menu. Fun spot to go to as a tourist!

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Average place overall. Chicken cheese steaks are very good, but their regular beef cheese steaks are a little too greasy for me. Subs are very mediocre, but have more meat than say a Wawa, but that's not saying much. Customer service bland, and I can't stand it when they hang those damn beads you have to walk through at the front entrance, disgusting...not a germophobe by a long shot, but pretty damn unsanitary if you ask me.

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Piano Bars
text: This was a fun place to hang out on a Friday night. Pretty crowded, but my friends and I were able to chill without getting bumped by others. We tried the famous hurricane, which none of us liked very much. It wasn't our type of drink (a bit too much of rum and cranberry flavor) but glad I tasted it for myself.

place_category: Restaurants, Gelato, Coffee & Tea, Food, Italian, Bakeries
text: Owner of the restaurant is great, very generous, and helped out for a sponsored event! Food and gelato delicious as well!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: When you walk into this place, just take a second to take in a nice big whiff of yummy pizza heaven. We ordered carry out off of a recommendation from a friend and I'm so glad we did. Delicious! A few things - there were a TON of kids in the dining room. If that's not your scene, you may want to consider having it delivered or carry out. Also, the sauce is on the sweeter side. I loved it but may not be for everyone.

place_category: Southern, Restaurants
text: Bright spot here is the service. Other than that, not much else going. Girlfriend and I wanted a quiet night in and a simple dinner. Welcomed by a menu that is different than the website and nothing jumped out as great so we went with just desserts. Found out all they had was bread pudding and ice cream (they were out of "death by chocolate"). Avoid.

place_category: Spanish, Cafes, Cuban, Latin American, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Best tofu ever -- garlicky delicious. The tofu plate with Madurese and beans and rice is so very good! The veggie tofu sandwich is too. The seitan sandwich is delicious also. Super friendly folks and fast service. Can't wait to go back!

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers
text: Well it's a BK so I already like it better than McDonald's. I like rate fast food chain restaurant against other like chains, it's not fair to put against real establishments. So this location is clean and the food good for Burger King. Now the service is hit or miss depending on the time your there. But you know the chance your taking eating at theses places.

place_category: Barbeque, Vietnamese, Restaurants, Korean
text: Pretty good Korean BBQ considering this place is in Indiana. The kimchi is good, and the marinate for bulgogi and kalbi is good, can't complain. Only complaint is the slow and bad service, but that is to be expected at a Korean restaurant.

place_category: American (Traditional), Diners, Restaurants, Salad
text: I have been driving past this diner for years and finally tried it out. It's nice inside, large menu typical of diners. On this day i tried the chicken souvlaki pita, which is a big sandwich but good tasting with fresh toppings. The chicken was tender and a bit too much tzatziki sauce but good none the less. Plenty of parking here and prices are not bad at all. Lots of meals here are served with fries as a side. Family friendly, service just fine.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Southern, Comfort Food
text: We've eaten at Chedders maybe 4 times. Only once were we satisfied. We thought we'd try it one more time. Again very dissatisfied. If you want salad with steak dinner it is an extra charge. Rolls with dinner an extra charge. We won't be back. You get better food for the money at Texas Roadhouse.

place_category: Lounges, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (New), Bars
text: We go here for drinks and app style food. Always nice and friendly in there.

place_category: Seafood, Steakhouses, Brazilian, Restaurants
text: This is one of th best Brazilian Steakhouses, compared to two others (one in SJ and the other north of Philly. Food: Well cooked and prepared. Meat preparation is executed well and delicious. LOVE their salad bar. I could eat my way through the entire salad bar, even if no meat was provided. Service: The 'waiters' (I forgot what they are called here) were attentive and came to check out our table many times. Definitely make reservations ahead of time as it can get back in the off-shore season.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Nightlife, Southern, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza
text: My boyfriend and I went here on a date a few months back. Food wasn't good at all and was overpriced. The waitress was amazing though and the decor was nice.

place_category: American (New), Venues & Event Spaces, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Party & Event Planning, Nightlife, Music Venues, Restaurants, Wine Bars
text: Just OK. Been there several times, saw a manager / owner get in a shouting match with a customer. How professional. Seems like the son is the Chief Apologist.

place_category: Belgian, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Great Bakery with a variety of options but so over priced!! A salad and a small pie or dessert dish ran me well over $12. Granted their service is always top notch, very friendly. The soups are great as well and won't break the bank as much. Plus try their mini quiches for that quick sweet snack (they usually have unique flavors)

place_category: Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Burgers, Fast Food, Food
text: :( 45 minute wait for 3 items. Order was wrong, they gave us ranch with our mozzarella sticks lol, no cheese with pretzel ?

place_category: Shopping, Butcher, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Meat Shops, Specialty Food
text: Muffuletta was absolutely delicious. Got the mac and cheese as a side...very savory and rich. There was infusion of mushroom and pork (maybe bacon?) that made that mac and cheese that much better. If I knew about this place earlier in my trip, I would have gone back multiple times.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese, Korean
text: The place was simple and set like a fast food! Order, wait and eat! The service - ok. The food - ok. The price - too high for less! However, overall the neighboring is vibrant/hip!

place_category: Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Italian
text: Three stars pretty much describes our experience. My wife sent back her entree twice because her spaghetti was cold. Still cold the third time so she gave up. The manager brought the second try but didn't wait to ask if it was better. No more Old Spaghetti Factory for us. There are too many other good choices.

place_category: Steakhouses, Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: So this place is usually awesome with great staff. This time though the wait staff needed some help. I think we ended up waiting 15 minutes before someone came and asked us for our drinks and it was a what you want not hi what Can I get you. The food is always on point here which is why I'm still giving it a higher review then I should. They have raised prices so be prepared.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Soul Food, Fast Food, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional)
text: Go to Brothers three blocks up the street. you will get more chicken for less. Brothers is $2.99 for a two piece. I remember this place being like $7.99 for two pieces. this chicken looked as if had been there all day. i actually watched in being made at Brothers. Just my humble opinion. 1starffor the location.

place_category: Ethnic Food, Food, Cajun/Creole, Specialty Food, Comfort Food, Restaurants
text: Picked up a to go order from the gumbo stop because of Yelp reviews. Gumbo, red beans and rice and a side of jambalaya. Red beans were the best followed by the gumbo. jambalaya wasn't what I was expecting, not my style. Overall very good.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: Jim's hands down best steak in Philly. If you are a tourist, don't waste you time at Geno's or Pat's when you can have Jim's. Staff is really nice and the lines move very quickly. They chop up my meat just the way I like it and I never find chunks of fat in my steak. Jim's is a cash only establishment but don't worry there is an ATM inside.

place_category: Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Three stars is the highest I can give chains, I do make exceptions. This Outback is great, servers are super friendly, foods is consistent and in a pinch when I can't get to my favorite steak place their ribeye is great. I eat my steak Pittsburgh rare and they know how to cook it.

place_category: American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Bars, Nightlife, Sports Bars, Restaurants
text: Great location! Lots of room, neat setup with the bar in the center. Very popular at game time and other events, it can get packed! As the other reviewer stated, Hooters is upping their game to stay competitive with the other chains that have popped up. Food is better than it ever has been! If you have not been in a few years, try it again, you will be surprised!

place_category: Steakhouses, Japanese, Sushi Bars, Seafood, Restaurants
text: I stopped here for a To-Go meal, and my expectations were low. I'm glad they were because their food left a lot to be desired. The flavors were bland and the noodles were so sloppy wet that the sauce was spilling all over the bag. The parking was awful, literally 5 spots to choose from and it's directly off of a huge highway so coming out in such cramped quarters is dangerous. There's a law office next door and if you park there, you'll be towed. Just not worth the meal to be honest.

place_category: Mediterranean, Restaurants, Salad, Greek
text: I placed a take out order for the first time and when I got home I realized that my ordered was totally messed up! I upgraded my salad, but the order came with the basic salad and no rice! I called back and expected to hear that they are sorry for messing up my order but they said there is not much we can do since the upgrade price is $1.5! The fact that they dont understand that messing up some one's order is frustrating! Very disappointed and never going back.

place_category: Lounges, Restaurants, Tiki Bars, Dive Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Caribbean, Hawaiian, American (Traditional)
text: Stay away. Not worth the time unless you really fit in with the crowd there. Much worse than how it was a decade ago.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: Pricing is really cheap and the customer service is okay. It seems like their prices went up overall recently though... it was cheaper when I went in a few months ago.

place_category: Food, Vegetarian, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Wraps, Restaurants, Salad
text: This place was ok. It's very expensive for a salad but if you're looking for something healthy I guess it's good. When I went, there were also barely any people there showing it's probably not great.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Slow service. Was picking up delivery app order. They had time that I had to drive there to prepare it. Waited an additional 15 mins. C'mon. It was also late at night. It was just me & one vehicle in front of me. Not like I was 5th in line. How many orders would you crank out an hour, if you only get one out every 15-20 mins? Fml. You're killing me, Smalls.

place_category: Restaurants, Delis
text: First time I went there, it was a bellyful. And for a few times after that. However, he has cut way down on the amount of meet and cheese inside it. Quality is good, roll is crisp, but it's alot smaller over the last few mos. Sorry, Tim, you can't start cutting back portions just cause you're making some money now.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: Good food and quiet! I liked it a lot. Close to the house and the food was good. Sports bar type place but I watched a game and had tacos. Not a bad way to grab a bite.

place_category: Bars, Mediterranean, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Corner bar is great , but the bathrooms are horrible! VERY DISGUSTING! Stink like mold and no paper towels been like this forever.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: I've had my fair share of Chinese takeout spots and this one isn't any different than the rest. Average food at decent prices. I had the general tsos which didn't come out as crispy as I expected. It came out too soft for something that's breaded and fried as if it had been sitting in the sauce forever and got mushy on the outside. Still an okay place to go

place_category: Restaurants, Mediterranean, Greek, Seafood
text: Meh... stopped by on a Friday around 9:30. Out of spinach pie AGAIN. Our server was too busy enjoying his staff meal to check on our outside table. If I dine here again, it will be early and inside.

place_category: Vegan, Arts & Entertainment, Shopping, Restaurants, Vegetarian, Art Galleries, Food, Cafes, Bakeries, Desserts
text: THE BEST VEGGIE BURGER!!!! I could go on and on about how great their veggie burgers are! However, I could go on and on about how great their food is in general! My friend got their nachos one day and I tried some of hers and they were amazing. Their cupcakes are so good too. This place is a vegan MUST!!! I just wish their hours were open a bit more, but luckily they are open later on Friday's!!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Food Trucks, Asian Fusion
text: The employees here are very rude, when you order they stare at you and when you ask for something they give you a very aggressive voice Tone! They don't wear their masks all the way up, no gloves while cooking either. But I do recommend their Sweet and Sour Chicken!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants
text: The restaurant did not live up to the Yelp reviews in my opinion, or maybe I did not get the right stuff. It is smack dab in the middle of New Orleans and just parking is a nightmare. I came in to review the drip coffee but hungry, my friend and I tried some of the food. Get the breakfast sandwich, because damn. Other than that, it was a sold B. Not too great and not too bad.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Beer Bar, Pubs, Nightlife, Bars
text: Had lunch here today, and as much as I hate to say this, the food was not good and overpriced... dry chicken in the cheesesteak, made of chicken thighs, tiny portion of shrimp and grits, and $8 beers... no one minds paying a little more for good ambience and bar food but the food has to be good. C'mon Brickwall, you can do this!

place_category: Pizza, Food, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Italian
text: Super nice people, clean, efficient. Food was good too. We were mostly impressed by their commitment to being clean and thorough.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: This was the first spot we went to during our first visit to New Orleans... and I would say their Pecan Crusted Puppy Drum was a really REALLY great welcome! :) *pls see yummy photo The place is charming ... each room has different decor. I particularly loved the room with red wall. Our server from the first day was really nice. But when we went the 2nd time, well... lets just say if he was our server first, there wouldnt be a 2nd time... so minus 1 star for that.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Service is great. The food was over cooked. Ordered the Cinnamon French toast with chorizo. Chorizo was dry and almost tasteless. The french toast was also very dry. The portions was perfect for me but would be considered small. I just don't eat much. How can you mess up French toast! Not going back.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Burgers, Fast Food, Coffee & Tea
text: The worst McDonald's I have ever been to in my life. 80% of the time the order is wrong. If you happen to go on a Friday Saturday or Sunday night, you will be in line for 30 or more minutes. If this McDonald's were in east Nashville or Franklin... I really doubt that would happen. I don't know if they have a high turnover of employees or what, I wouldn't be surprised.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Dont waste your time. It's 6ish pm on Saturday and they ran out of brisket. Couldn't order the Saturday special sandwich or a brisket plate. Guess I will be heading down to Sonny's where I have never had issues.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Fast Food, Diners
text: If you make us wear q face mask you should make your cooks too. Second time I come to a Denny's and cooks either no mask or covering their mouth only. I understand it is uncomfortable but it is important to wear a mask. Also restaurant had like 10 tables with customer and they take so long to get our order.

place_category: Seafood, Party & Event Planning, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Mexican
text: Grilled seafood dish (for the wife) and my 'unit of measurement' for new Mexican dining experiences, the pork burrito. BOTH WERE SUPERB, better yet, the service (our server VERY knowledgeable of the menu, but not 'pushy' . Better even more THE PRICES. We stopped in on a whim, but will return on purpose.

place_category: American (New), Automotive, Caterers, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Comfort Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Parking, Sandwiches, Beer Bar, Vegetarian, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: Simply put the food was bland and basically meh. Chipotle braised pork was bland and dry, even though it had been soaked in sauce. Broccoli salad tasted like raw broccoli dipped in mayonnaise and had maybe bacon and green onions.. Side salad had bagged cheese and 2 small tomatoes. Served with sliced white bread. Definitely underwhelming flavor and quality overall. On a bright note, the employees were friendly and quite efficient.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Burgers, American (New), American (Traditional), Desserts, Soup, Food, Salad
text: We just moved to Franklin and YELPED the restaurant Ground. Great burgers, service was great and all the food. Thank you for a great meal

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Japanese
text: Food was great. All the rolls were creative and delicious. I can't complain about anything that was served at all. Service was sub par. Not the worst, but we felt very rushed. They served us 6 rolls at once. Took up most of the table. They forgot my salad and it took me 5 minutes to get someone's attention. The green hornet roll was very unique and equally delicious.

place_category: Pizza, Food Delivery Services, Food, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches
text: One hour and 13 minutes from order to delivery. The tracker said it had been delivered more than a half hour before it actually was. The pizza wasn't cold, but neither was it hot, and it was dry. Dry. I ordered it with extra sauce and it was dry. I will be patronizing their many, many competitors from now on.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Whiskey Bars, Burgers, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Food looked good. Nice decor. Hip crowd, and crowded on a Tuesday - portends good things. I just thought no room at the bar, no music, just chatter. Not inviting - so we left. I'll try it again. But for now, no go.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza, Southern, Italian, Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: We went here as a last minute pick for brunch. Amazing! Great service, great drinks, great food. It's such a great twist of southern comfort with Italian flare. Will certainly become a regular here.

place_category: Burgers, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: This was my first time at Smashburger. For the price of the burger, I expected more... there was nothing spectacular about it. I would say that the burger was mediocre at best. I've had better burger for less. That's it... very disappointed.

place_category: Thai, Sports Bars, Asian Fusion, Vietnamese, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Sushi Bars, Nightlife
text: I have been here several times and the food is good but the service is hit or miss. It seems some people get served better then others. Do not try to order food in the bar section if they are even marginally busy up front. Jamie is great!

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: I ordered online and was told it would be ready in 20 minutes. All I ordered was vegetable pad Thai. When I got there I was told it would be another 20 minutes before it was ready. I could tell that the service was bad, they were telling people the wait was an hour at 6pm on a Thursday night. The host was rude and many workers were just standing around. My food was okay, the portion was rather small but it was tasty. I'd be nervous to go back there because of the poor service.

place_category: Wine Bars, Italian, Nightlife, Restaurants, Salad, Bars, Soup
text: Overall food was good. But very slow on the breadsticks! Took a half an hour to get them.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Restaurants, Burgers
text: Took 15 minutes to be greeted. Took 45 minutes to get a burger...and the server "dropped it" so had to wait even longer for a new one. No management here and just kids working. It's not even busy here...only 3 tables.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Solid spaghetti and meatballs! I highly recommend the garlic bread in addition to the meal. Great atmosphere and excellent service!

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: Rarely have I had a bad experience here other than You can tell when the waitress is having a bad day sometimes, but I've never had a problem with the food, and I am very picky about my Chinese food. Excellent food, pricing isn't bad, and they are very quick.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners
text: Ate here outside with a friend for breakfast. Food was great, service was mediocre. They only accept check and cash outside, so I had to pay by check. Had to leave check on table bc waitress never came back out to take it and there wasn't anyone available to help. Still would come again, food is cheap for what you get!

place_category: Tex-Mex, Food, Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Cajun/Creole, Breweries, Dive Bars, Bars, Sports Bars
text: My friends and I sauntered into this dive on a Saturday evening and were pleasantly surprised. Nice selection of beer, good appetizers, and plenty of seating and screens. I highly recommend the Mojo chicken wings. The service was poor - our server took a disproportionately long time (relative to the low number of customers in the bar) to bring our beers and check in on us. Otherwise this is a good place in its category.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian, Salad
text: I love the location. Everybody was very friendly. The food was hot and very delicious!!! The best pizza I ever tasted in many years!!!

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Cocktail Bars
text: The tortilla was wet and the fish tasted very fishy. Only lukewarm. The brisket taco was alright, but again, not appetizing to eat a soggy taco. I ate at the to-go window with my friends on the side of the restaurant and it was quick, easy and convenient. The street corn was flavorful, warm and yummy.

place_category: Burgers, Desserts, Restaurants, Food, Salad
text: i really enjoy the decor of this place. I had the pimento burger two days n a row and enjoyed it. It is not the best burger i have ever had---in fact it sn't even in the top 5. I did not care for the bun it did nothng to enhance my burger. If you want somethin decent to eat give it a whirl but if you are looking for the biggest, baddest juciest burger you can find....you won't find it here....

place_category: Mexican, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: My least favorite chipotle so far. Food was good but service was questionable. Lots of miscommunication, maybe a bunch of new people working not sure but not a fan of this particular chipotle.

place_category: Active Life, Bowling, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Party & Event Planning, Arcades, Event Planning & Services, Arts & Entertainment
text: $280 for 4 people to bowl. an absolute joke. bowlero can f right off. i miss the old zodos

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Chinese
text: Great food and even greater people. The owner is very sweet and this store knows how to take care of their customers. My family and I were going to take our food to go but the guy on the counter saw that our girl was wearing a disney and played toy story 4 on the tv. We stayed and it was just like a walk in theater. Food and rinks at the ready. It was a grand time. Love these people and will be back!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Mexican, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Food
text: Pretty similar menu to Jose Pistolas, margs were a little sweet, ceviche and plantains was great, tacos a bit too expensive. Staff is helpful and were prepared for a crowd even a few days after opening. The outdoor space is a nice extra element. I am guessing this place is always going to have a wait and the thing I like about Jose's is how often you can find a table.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants
text: I was disappointed with the five guys. I don't know what I expected but quite a few have suggested this joint and I was hungry and nearby. Just imagine eating at one of the Happy Days burger joints and that's what you get. Greasy, soggy and messy. I think I'll pass next time.

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Event Planning & Services, Shopping, Public Markets, Restaurants, Food Court
text: Food was okay but way over priced. Stay away from Chilangos Taco kitchen. Environment and atmosphere however 10/10

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Ok at best, but way over priced. I bought a cookies and cream milkshake and asked for some chocolate syrup in it. After tax, it was nearly $8! The cup is roughly 2/3rds of a McDonald's milkshake, so not very large. And the milkshake was so liquidity, I basically had an $8 glass of chocolate milk. Plus I tipped the lady. Too many less expensive options for ice cream out there. If you do come here, don't waste your money on the milkshakes.

place_category: Italian, Pizza, Restaurants, Seafood
text: Great pizza and food. When we r in town, we always stop in for a pizza....always good. Tonight we also had the chicken marcella......wow.....pretty good for a strip mall restaurant! Don't be afraid to try something off the regular menu....i think you will be pleased!

place_category: American (New), Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Gastropubs, Local Flavor
text: Wow definitely a new favorite. I was impressed with their beer selection, though not the largest selection, it is varied and good quality. To accompany our beers we had dinner. I had the spicy cuban and cole slaw and he had the brisket sandwich and fries. Wow... delicious! I can't wait to go back their menu looks fantastic it was so hard to choose! Food: 5/5 Service: 5/5 Location: 5/5

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Good pizza, good people. Who can you go wrong? Had an excellent large thin slice of pepperoni pizza, $5 Coming from New York, it was nice and thin with the perfect tasting pepperoni.

place_category: Soul Food, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Southern
text: I just don't get it. I got the medium spice and the chicken was too hot to eat. No flavor really, just hot spice. My daughter got the extra mild chicken, still too much spice and couldn't finish it. I got a side of fries and they looked like they had been sitting around for a while. At $45 for 3 take out containers I think I'll go to Popeye's next time. I have had Prince's hot chicken and it is awesome. It is hot but has a great flavor so I can do spicy when it is good.

place_category: Japanese, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Ramen, Restaurants
text: It was pretty loud on a Sunday afternoon, meaning it was hard to hear the table conversation. The food was ok but not as wonderful as the ramen I've had in NYC and San Francisco. I probably won't go back. There are other Asian restaurants I enjoy more. The fellow who waited on us was very nice and the venue was clean and well-decorated.

place_category: Korean, Restaurants
text: This place has a great Yelp reviews, but after having dinner here I would not give it four-star at all. We ordered the Daily specials of Shrimp Pancake and Japchae. The Pancake served with six tiny slices at $6.95 was pretty pricy and could not really taste any shrimp inside. Japchae does not have any protein and it was priced at $9.95. The rest of the party ordered Beef Bibimap, and it was decent.

place_category: Lounges, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Seafood, American (Traditional), Soup
text: I highly recommend their happy hour menu. They have a lot of options and decent prices. Their oysters are extremely fresh and delicious. The traditional Hawaiian poke is also good but the onions they topped them with were really salty and a bit of a turn off. We also had the salmon cakes and Kobe sliders. The salmon cakes were pretty good but a bit dry.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Shopping, Sandwiches, Pasta Shops, Italian, Wigs, Food, Specialty Food
text: I have been here a couple times now and I really enjoy it! Great food and the staff is very friendly and courteous! I would recommend this place to anyone!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants, Food, American (New)
text: Considering the line, got in quickly and enjoyed a vegetarian buckwheat crepe, a side of potatoes (go rosemary! yum), and fresh squeeze grapefruit juice. I'll be bringing husband back with me later in our visit.

place_category: Spanish, Cafes, Cuban, Latin American, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Amazing Cuban. I'm from Orlando and I'm super obsessed. Legit come here everyyyyytime I'm in town

place_category: Italian, Cuban, Restaurants
text: The emperor has no clothes. 4 of us on the grand tasting, the only thing grand was that it almost cost a Grand! Beige expensive food, not well prepared in a cute but cramped space. Love Osteria, hated this... Have gladly paid and eaten in the best restaurants in the country, this is not one of them.

place_category: Buffets, Indian, Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Vegan, Pakistani, Kebab
text: Hated the food... as an indian... the food lacked flavours and the authentic indian spices. Everything tasted the same. The salmon tandoori was pathetic with zero flavour. Ordered the papdy chaat and it is by far the worst that i have had in bay area and mid west. Would not recommend, waste of money

place_category: Food, Grocery, Shopping, Organic Stores, Meat Shops, Specialty Food, Fruits & Veggies, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Discount Store
text: It had very low prices it was $2 a water case! But workers in this store really don't care how they put your stuff in.But overall It is a very good super market to go to when you need to save some money.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Burgers, Southern
text: What a mess!! We walked in at 8pm. Took forever to get greeted and seated. This should have been our first warning. Restaurant was a mess - they must have been under staffed because most tables had dirty dishes. I can excuse that but the wall of our booth had multiple spots from months of not being clean. Server did her best but she was obviously over it. Food was mediocre at best.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caribbean, Caterers
text: The best Caribbean restaurant in the Burlington/Willingboro area ,Mr James is very friendly,very reasonable price and the food is superb

place_category: Diners, Restaurants
text: Great location to The Fox. Food was mediocre. Had the Cuban sandwich. It tasted microwaved. Salad was plain. Malt did not at all taste like there was malt in it. I would avoid the shakes. They were icy and mostly tasteless. I'd probably give them one more shot, but I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Seafood, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: Came here for brunch because they had availability and no wait which was nice. My group decided to do the bottomless brunch. We were cut off after the 4th round. My group was not belligerent or rowdy just enjoying the company within our group. Disappointing. We paid for bottomless. Also the waiter poured water regularly so we could "stay hydrated" and told us to "drive safely". Super insulting!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Desserts, Middle Eastern, Asian Fusion, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Food
text: So delicious and great atmosphere! Eat here regularly, the manager is so kind and always comes over to say hello. The food is always changing and always amazing. One of my favorites!

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Pizza, Burgers
text: Giving this place 5 stars for speed, friendly service and the best burger I have had so far in Mission Viejo. Fries are good too. I went with the bacon cheddar burger and it was outstanding in flavor and texture with the Ciabatta role. It's Double pattie and I love that concept! We have a winner and I will be back when I am ready for another burger! Good going staff st Rockfire!

place_category: Sandwiches, Seafood, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Cajun/Creole
text: Don't judge the book by the cover Not sure where to start. Roast beef poboy, gumbo, red beans and rice are all unbelievable. Then try the fried potato salad. Biscuits unbelievable. Eating our way back to Houston. Great with kids ( and adults)!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: This is good, reasonably priced Thai near the convention center. The crab rangoons are the best I've had, super creamy with a crispy shell. The drunken noodles were mediocre. The flavor was decent, but the noodles were a little tougher than I like and the veggies were plain. I got carry out and it was fast, accurate, and the service was very friendly!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Donuts
text: Quick and efficient, though I went inside rather than the drive-through. This location is excellent if you're heading west off the Interstate. However, it's troublesome if you're planning to return towards the Internet as you have to cross the traffic to make a U-turn. They have the usual selection of coffees and donuts and sandwiches.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Had a great burger there first time I went. Second time we arrived just after they opened, the burger was dry, overcooked, only warm, the fries were barely warm, the hot tea was tepid. Guess they weren't really open for business. Very disappointed. Won't be going back. Music too loud for conversation.

place_category: Seafood, American (Traditional), Burgers, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Cafes, Sports Bars
text: We really like to go here to unwind as it has a fab view of the harbour. We were on the search of the best Clam Chowder ( New England) and this came quite close. Not pasty and overly thick and nice texture. A bit salty, so we have added milk to cut that a bit. Popcorn machine is good for add-to with drinks at no charge.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: I had the beef cheek and shrimp tacos with amazing corn tortillas. Both were amazing but the shrimp was off the charts! The real deal and a gem of a taqueria. Best this Albuquerque guy found in Tucson!

place_category: Sandwiches, Japanese, Ramen, Noodles, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Food, Vietnamese, Asian Fusion
text: Hebrew hammer broth, complex layers of flavor. Classic ramen, classic broth flavor popped with pork and egg. Creve Coeur ramen, oh yeah. Outstanding ramen, hell yes

place_name: Blue Sea Fish Market and Restaurant
place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Food
text: Three thick pieces of whiting, lettuce and tomatoes, crispy batter on a sesame seed bun.. Perfect lunch!

place_category: Desserts, Bakeries, Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: Cookies were all great! The inside was really cute, and the service was friendly and fast. The online menu showed different ice cream flavors than they had in store, so call ahead. It would be perfect if they added a gluten free cookie option!

place_category: Indian, Restaurants, Vegan, Pakistani, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian
text: I love Indian food and this is the only option. Service is mediocre and I found a fruit fly in my food. I won't be coming back.

place_category: Pizza, Salad, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Italian
text: Came in ordered. Waited like 25 min for a grinder. Had to ask where my sandwich was. Got them, raw onions, bad flavor, not fully cooked. Will not be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Comfort Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Nice subs with a southern flare. Roast beef po boy was like a pulled pork sandwich with gravy. Clean food, fast service and full bar. Still trying to find something here better than I can't get somewhere else.My point is that the sandwich was good, but I am looking for great in New Orleans. Why go there if the food is the same everywhere else. Every restaurant here in NOLA says they are the best, the most amazing, superlative. And..........I just don't see it.

place_category: Restaurants, Vegetarian, Sandwiches, American (New), Cafes
text: Its convenient for a 65 drive-by. To find it you have to venture through the hospital. Fast--cafeteria style. Healthy options, very flavorful. Seemed like a lot of regulars. People knew each other's names. The chef came and checked on us, was kind and explained how to make the lime rice--so much flavor. Very clean, sterile even. -M+J

place_category: Bars, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Cafes, Food, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Sandwiches
text: This is a great coffee shop if you love the best of the best coffee and a healthy delicious breakfast option. I've worked in the coffee industry for 16 years. Their coffee is very good. I also had the chicken sausage breakfast burrito bowl. It had really good flavor and was a good but not excessive size. The cafe is nice and big with a great outdoor space as well.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), American (Traditional)
text: Great place to eat huge portions of food , very good service! The burgers are out of this world .Tuesday night is half price burgers special!!!! It is family friendly too! Go soon you wont be disappointed!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Gift Shops, Candy Stores, Shopping, Specialty Food, Arts & Crafts, Food, Flowers & Gifts, Cards & Stationery
text: They lost an invitation that I had brought there as a template for another invitation I needed. They promised me I would get it back. It was very sentimental to me. They said that the manager was out to lunch when I discovered it was gone and that they would call me back to let me know what happened. Well, they called me back less than 30 minutes later and said it was gone forever. Sounds like they did not even look for it. I am calling all my friends and asking them not to shop there anymore.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Tex-Mex, Tacos, Mexican
text: Stopped in today for a quick bite and to use the restroom. I hate to be negative but oh my god the lobby was dirty. The men's restroom was out of order. I ordered 1 burrito, I'm not kidding I waited over ten minutes for that burrito. They weren't even busy come on Taco Bell. Fix this this place was nasty, my next phone call will be to the Health Department EWWWW!!!!!

place_name: Jake's & Cooper's Wine Bar & Wine Shop
place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Pizza, Tapas Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Nightlife, Food, Bars
text: I really like Jake's and Cooper's Wine Bar. Really good food and cocktails. Some of my favorites include the "not your mama's" maple bacon brussel sprouts, short rib with lobster mash, spicy meatball pizza, mac and cheese and spicy meatballs. They have daily drink specials posted on the chalk board next to the bar. Nice window seating on the bar side too.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Amazing barbecue. Pork steaks are amazing. Only problem is the food tends to go fast.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches
text: I did it. I caved and got the Original Hangover Hoagie. It was delicious and made me cave into my deepest desires and eat the only thing, instead of adhering to my ineffective diet. The complimentary bloody mary was a nice touch. The atmosphere is definitely homey, but it is a little too small for my taste. It seems crowded and there isn't much seating as a result. I'd come back with a hangover, but probably not during a day when I want to get work done.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: I love this place! Fresh made salsas everyday, slow cooked goodness on every page of the menu and friendly staff. I tend to stick with the barbacoa tacos but even when I stray to other meals I am never disappointed. The lengua is tender and tasty, the al pastor is flavorful and cooked on a coal fired spit, the octopus is ridiculously good too.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Been coming here for years and wow the last 4 to 5 times pre-covid and during covid the quality is just not there. Coffee is fine, the breakfast gets worse every time. Biscuits have changed and are not the flaky moist Biscuits they used to be. Maybe there just needs to be quality checks. Other shops are now beating them at what they used to dominate.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: The best thing I can say about this place is that it is close to Cottage Hospital and that it has an outside covered patio that is a pleasant place to be if you are needing to stay close. The food was fine. Not spectacular and a bit overpriced. I paid $17 for a small tostada and an iced tea. No complimentary chips! The service was good.

place_category: Steakhouses, Pizza, Burgers, Restaurants, Italian
text: Will never be ordering from her again. I ordered a pepper, onion and sausage small pizza and there was probably an entire raw onion on the pizza in little shavings. I get I ordered onion, but there was more onion than cheese.

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Seafood, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: We had pretty standard C&P fare; classic & south Philly cheese steaks, crab fries, & a crab cake sandwich. Everything was good, but no better or worse than you'll get at any other C&P, including the one at the Philly airport. The waitress was friendly. On a separate note, the place was pretty "dead" for a Sunday afternoon with lots of football playing on dozens of TVs...I'm guessing nearby Alstarz Bar & Grill was probably standing room only.

place_category: Burgers, Hot Dogs, Restaurants, Salad, Fast Food
text: Not good. Had an overpriced "burger" that was not cooked right. This place is essentially fast food with pre cooked burgers that they put pre cooked toppings on.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants
text: This is great little hole in the wall bbq joint. Prices are average, but they're quite generous with their portions. Delicious pulled pork and ribs, just wish they had more bbq flavors to pick from.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Food, Salad, Desserts
text: There was a mix up when I ordered and got a margarita pizza instead of a white pizza. BUT make no mistake about how good it was. Management made it right and I will be back. The pizza didn't make it home without a slice missing.

place_category: Seafood, Southern, Food, Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Desserts, Local Flavor
text: I had a hard time with this one. Most of the options were a little pricey and not a huge variety to choose from (I mean, $17 for a burger). I ended up getting the Cajun catfish in a tomato-y sauce with rice on the side. It was alright but lacked some flavoring. Several at our table got the shrimp po'boy and looked like that would've been a much better option

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment
text: Amazing margaritas, food, live performances, and service. Definitely a must if in Nashville.

place_category: Health Markets, Restaurants, Grocery, Sandwiches, Food, Specialty Food
text: while visiting town, I stopped by for some grocery shopping for my hotel room, at the end of a Saturday. What a waste of time. This is a Trader Joe's and Whole Foods wannabe, with a limited selection. Unless you are very lucky, you will end up having to shop also someplace else to complete your shopping list. But I'll say two things - the staff is as friendly as that at Trader Joe's. And the prices are as expensive as Whole Foods.

place_category: Food, Specialty Food, Candy Stores, Souvenir Shops, Chocolatiers & Shops, Local Flavor, Shopping
text: Rude staff. Couldn't have cared less that we were there. I asked her several questions about stuff in the shop, to which she couldn't be bothered to stop her conversation with her friend to help me. I checked in to get my free praline and the rude girl just pointed to the box. Couldn't even put it in my bag with my stuff. Hence, praline was not taken.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Seafood, Breakfast & Brunch, Bars, Lounges
text: Make seaworthy a stop along your New Orleans food pilgrimage...you will not be disappointed. We stopped for oysters to eat at the bar last night and stayed for one more item on the menu after one more item on the menu. Drinks were exceptional service friendly and efficient and food balanced with traditional New Orleans flavors/ingredients with the gentle touch of a talented chef.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: Go to Gino's - the line is too long, it's not that far away and the steak is only "soso" menu is a little clouded with all their other options.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Bakeries, Pizza
text: The pizza is really good. High quality ingredients. Delivery is slow and the price was very steep for a pizza. I have not tried any other items.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Korean
text: Had a quick delicious dinner including beef bibopbim, stir fried clear noodles and spicy chicken with rice, all recommended by the server. All were delicious. Added sweet spicy sauce to the rice noodles and enjoyed by my 6 year old and us adults. Hit the spot on a cool summer evening.

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Seafood
text: This is a chain restaurant and the location is Boise is similar to the locations in other cities. We went there with a large party, and they were very accommodating. The Ahi Tuna was superb. The rest of the food is ok. It wasn't a bad experience, but nothing stood out. It doesn't seem to get very busy so it felt a bit weird. We were the only people on the patio.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Wedding Planning, Food, Bakeries, Party & Event Planning, Desserts, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Specialty Food, Venues & Event Spaces, Restaurants, Chocolatiers & Shops, Event Planning & Services
text: My 3-star rating is really not based on anything... I just wanted to post a heads up: I went there today to buy some chocolate for a gift, and they were closed, with no hours or anything posted in the window. I checked their website, and it says they are "currently only open every for private parties and events." Bummer, because I'd heard great things and really wanted to check it out.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Soup, Chinese, Cantonese, Asian Fusion
text: We had a good impression when we visited here at first time, but the second attempt was very disappointing. Went to this place for lunch, and we ordered satay beef and kung Pao chicken. We could barely find chicken pieces in Kung Pao chicken, and they gave me satay chicken instead of beef. Both dishes tasted so terrible. We also ordered shrimps with maggie sauce and it was way toooooo salty. I am not sure if I will visit this place again.

place_category: Food, American (New), Restaurants, Desserts, Italian
text: The restaurant itself has awesome decor to look at and the staff is sweet, but the food is mediocre. The last time we went in our server gave us the wrong change not once but twice. place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Chipotle is a great place. Healthy, affordable, tasty and fast food. This location has friendly staff and although the lines can be long at times they're bearable. My one issue with this location is the cleanliness. Last time I went I was impressed, but that's not usually the case.

place_category: Bars, Mexican, Seafood, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Service, food, and drinks excellent. New favorite Mexican restaurant. Ordered the pollo tapatio, chicken was moist and rice had flavor. Came with 3 tortillas, which I didn't eat, because I was enjoying the food as it was. Ordered a pina colada and my husband a mojito, best we've had by far. Highly recommended.

place_category: Food, Local Flavor, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Local liquor store near King's Highway and Center Square road. They have a large enough selection to serve must needs. The prices are fare but not the "best." Cooks single beer selection is small and basically macro beers. If you are staying at the nearby hotels this will be your go to spot. The have a very large amount of wine and local beer to pick through.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: This place is good because it's close to the house but not worth it. Very low quality and over priced. All the reviews are correct about this place. I went there when they first opened in 2010 and the let you bring all the sauces to the table to try out. Now, they charge you for extra sauce and don't allow you to try them. This place sucks.

I predict Raley's will start getting more business from Walmart customers.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food

The sales people are very knowledgeable and helpful, less pushy than usual Teavana employees. Their newest Oprah chai is my new all time favorite. I cannot wait until me next visit to pick up some more tea!

For $7 I felt that I could have gone to wawa and gotten 2 orders of chicken tenders that would have been equally as good. Very disappointed and won't be returning.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Sandwiches, Spanish, Cuban
text: Food was mediocre at best. Certainly was not the best Cuban sandwich we've had. We chose to sit at the bar and the bartender was terrible! Not once asked us if we wanted another cocktail or beverage. Highly disappointed!

place_category: Cuban, Restaurants, Food, Food Trucks

text: Incredible gem tucked away in the back of the Grand Hyatt. Food was spectacular and views are stunning. Go often but only take those very special people with you. You cannot go wrong here! Had the deliciously refreshing arugula salad to start, the stunning sea scallops on tomato risotto for the main and the date nut sticky toffee cake for dessert. Complete perfection!

place_category: Restaurants, Soul Food
text: I live a few blocks from here and just used the free ATM at the 14th Police Station. When I turned right at Germantown Avenue I remembered this Soul food Restaurant. It's a family business. Kenny Latimore and Yazz from Empire have been here and have photos on the wall. The food is excellent!!!

place_category: Fast Food, Caterers, Mexican, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants

You can choose to sample 2 things on the menu in smaller portions rather than one large item. I usually get a small chicken quesadilla and a salad. The food is consistantly good and the line moves quickly. This location is pretty clean as well.

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Chicken Wings

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Salad, Food

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian

place_category: Vegetarian, Malaysian, Seafood, Restaurants

text: Pretty good. Food is tasty and they serve nice size portions for lunch. I ordered a drink I thought would be strong but it was very week and pricey. I love going there with friends mostly for the atmosphere and we like to sit outside when it is warm. So good.. a little pricey. I heard their Sunday morning brunch is amazing so I guess we'll have to try that out!! Oh, their beer cheese soup is Yummy! Try Blackstone Brewery (Nashville) too!

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese, Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion
text: Worst all you can eat sushi in the entire Franklin Nashville area. It's more like all you can eat rolls no nigiri sushi at all. I ordered sashimi and the fish was a little frozen. Not worth the $$$..Stay away from this non authentic Japanese joint. Local Kroger sushi is 100X better than this place..

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Fish & Chips, Irish
text: Food was DELICIOUS! Portions were big and the service was excellent. I would absolutely be back. I had the Jameson chicken sandwich and the Irish cream creme brulee. My husband had the Irish bacon cheeseburger, which was a hit! Please stop by and try it. You will not be disappointed. The waitress told me that almost everything is made in house.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: The pizza's good and the staff's friendly but the prices are a little out of hand. IMO they're really only worth it if you REALLY want pizza then and there and don't feel like going elsewhere.

text: Have gotten a variety of their dips before but decided to sit and have some lunch today. I had the Zeus Pita-ini and it was very yummy! Real chicken, fresh spinach, cheese, and spinach spread on a pita that is pressed like a panini. It was hot and fresh and hit the spot. Service was friendly and the food was a nice portion for just $6.50. Will visit again.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Food, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Salad
text: If you're looking for fresh spins on the classic burger, this place is for you. Huge fan of the firequacker and the onion rings. Oh and did I mention their milkshakes are incredibleeee! The service is quick and the food is fresh every time! This place is fire.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Music Venues, Bars, Beer Bar, Italian
text: Nice atmosphere and very good service. I had a Caesar salad to start that was just ok. Ordered the beach bird pizza with a deep dish crust. This pizza has barbecue sauce, chicken, and onions. It was pretty good. The barbecue sauce was a bit overwhelming. The deep dish crust was good. They also have a pretty good selection of beers on tap to go with your pizza.

place_category: Mediterranean, Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Quick bite on Saturday before the Fox. Chico took care of us. Great service, excellent food, in and out just in time to make the show. Salads, mussels, grilled cauliflower and a succulent order of calamari. A few glasses of wine and out we went. All and all, just what we needed. Add on: realized the next day I had lost my credit card. Called and stopped by and they had secured it in the register. Made my day. Being before Christmas it could have been bad. Chico: you Rock !!

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers

Won't be back anytime soon.

text: Coffee Xchange has good blended drinks called Xtreme they are supper smooth. Try the chai with a shot, I love it. I also often get the flavored coffee, they have a new flavor daily. This is a good place to get schoolwork done but if the internet is not working, let the staff know and they will reset it. I usually get food elsewhere, it is average. They also have a drive though which is great so you can support a local place on the run.

text: Hibachi grill... This location serves good food. It was exceptional in the beginning . Piping hot morsels full of flavor, and bountiful(constantly refilled buffet pans. The hostess is friendly. place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Diners
text: Burger was excellent, but I think you do not get enough for the price you end up paying. They charge extra for everything! For eight dollars I should get a burger and fries, not have to pay an extra two dollars for fries! However on a positive note I enjoyed the helpful staff. They really made my son's birthday a pleasurable experience by doing a dance for him and giving us a complimentary ice cream. I would go back but only for a special occasion.

place_category: American (New), Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Came here for brunch at their new spot by North Shore. The menu looked good but once our food came out (30 minutes later) most of the dishes looked like they were off the kids' menu. It's a bummer because this place has a lot of potential.

text: Have been coming here since it was in the old hotel. A must every time we visit Tucson. The portions are huge, so usually take some back to the hotel. If I'm not as hungry, I order a fish plate. Always enjoy our evening here. The only drawback is that it an get quite loud here - but for one evening, we enjoy it.

place_category: Middle Eastern, American (New), Restaurants, Mediterranean, Southern

The pepper sauce that came with the wings was well suited for the wings too. I would recommend this place to all.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (Traditional)

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Japanese

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Cheese Shops, Meat Shops, Delis

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Restaurants

place_category: Comfort Food, Restaurants, Southern, American (Traditional)
