place_category: Nightlife, Mexican, Cocktail Bars, Food, Bars, Food Delivery Services, Tacos, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Nice displays of various interesting street tacos, BUT, quite small for price. Pork was fatty and portabello mushroom was large and tough. Deliverer asked how things were only when delivered, not after we started eating. We bought 4 different types and deliverer could not correctly identify which was which.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I ordered from this restaurant through grub hub and did not receive everything I paid for.I will never purchase from this place again.If you don't have an item take it off the menu.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Lounges, Tapas Bars
text: I'm obsessed with this place. The whole vibe, the food, the servers/bartenders, the view... everything is incredible. We ordered a bunch of the small plates. We demolished every crumb. The "afterthot" drink is SO GOOD. I also tried "I left my wallet in la segunda" it's really good but SO STRONG. Beware lol drink at your own risk with that one We will definitely be back !

place_category: Food, Seafood, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Specialty Food, Seafood Markets
text: A great place to take your local catch of the day and have it cooked up! We went deep sea fishing on the Queen Fleet and caught 15 grunt fish. Had them cleaned at the dock and then walked over to Crabby Bill's to have them fried and blackened - it was delicious! They come with fries and slaw for $8/lb or person. Excellent food and service!

place_category: Restaurants, Caribbean, Seafood
text: Best Jamaican food in Tampa! The oxtails are tender, saucy and delicious. The rice and peas, cabbage, festival and curry goat are delicious. No disappointments! The veggie patties are also great, I'm primarily vegetarian and I make the exception to eat meat at this local gem. The owners are friendly and the staff is attentive. Visit here, I promise you'll enjoy it!

place_category: Mexican, Pop-Up Restaurants, Desserts, New Mexican Cuisine, Restaurants, Seafood, Food
text: This place looks very unassuming from the outside but the food and atmosphere is amazing. Their salsas are fantastic and we've never had an appetizer or entree that's disappointed. They've done a great job with their outdoor area too. And BYOB! Definitely check this place out if you haven't already.

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: BEST: cioppino and crab cakes and oyster shooter OKAY: rock crab special and urchin WORST: coconut shrimp

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: This is a small pizza joint that accommodates the surrounding neighborhood that it is nestled in. Their pizzas are great and they deliver!. They also carry your basic hot wings and fresh made sandwiches. I typically get their garlic chicken pizza which is full of flavor.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Beer Bar, Nightlife, Salad, Bars, Food, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Gastropubs
text: Great atmosphere and excellent service. Food was ok. They had some different menu items but were a little pricey. Good selection of beers but definitely overpriced. The craft beers were very expensive, almost $2 over normal prices.

place_category: Bakeries, Bars, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Food, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Caterers, Restaurants, Tapas/Small Plates, Breakfast & Brunch

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Consistently received drinks that don't taste right or that are not made the way I order them. Always disappointed in this place.

place_category: Restaurants, Falafel, Fast Food, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Halal, Greek
text: Fast food style Greek food. I would bet most of the 4 or 5 stars are from late night college students after a few drinks. I would not be afraid to return for lunch as it is quick, clean, priced right, and the food was solid. However, I have had much better Gyro's and Fries. Everyone talked about the wings and the staff said they were great, so maybe next time I will go that route and update the review.

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Steaks are ok, not the best in Philly at all, but will never go there again because of Joey Vento and his hate mongering when he was alive!!!!!!

place_category: Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Nightlife, Food, Sports Bars
text: Ordered 50 wings and several adult beverages. Split the sauces among the 50 wings. Wings were not freshly prepared, you could clearly tell they're cooked and thrown into a pile under a heat lamp. Were served cold, lukewarm. I expect, for the price, to have piping hot wings that are crispy and juicy. Instead, I got cold, dry awful wings.

place_category: Mediterranean, Restaurants
text: Humus was horrible. Felafel tasted like it was from a box. Food is not good. I do not recommend this restaurant.

place_category: German, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Nightlife, Bars, Beer Gardens
text: Portions are big, so don't let the price make you think its expensive. You get a ton of food for your money. Entrees come with 2 sides plus soup or salad. I got the chicken with wild rice, green beans and baked potato and everything was good. The hot pretzel they give you with your meal wasn't very good. It was hard and not very warm. Probably had been sitting out for a while. But overall a good experience.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Rude Gal working the front. Tells us it's a 15 minute wait. So my husband leaves to get gas, and she then tells me if he's not here when a table opens up we lose the table. I don't care what kind of breakfast they serve here but I have no patience for rudeness.

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Our waitress was great, gave very friendly attentive service and the food was outstanding!!! Definitely happy I got to give this place a try!!!

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Latin American, Mexican
text: They redid the menu and are under new ownership-awesome. When they have the Stuffed Mushroom app, take full advantage! The Chiles Relleños are great! Great atmosphere and cool bar area, definitely a great place. Ask for Steven, he's a great server, knows how to pace between appetizers, dinner and dessert.

place_category: French, American (New), Restaurants
text: 5/5. Round 2 was just as good as the first. Nick made several appearances at our table to ensure that everything was perfect. The "surprise" menu kept our interest and the food was supreme!

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Spanish, Caribbean, Puerto Rican
text: This place was terrible the empanadas had no taste and the Cuban sandwich was even worst. I would never go back to this place again.

place_category: Seafood, Party & Event Planning, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Mexican
text: One of my favorite restaurants in Tampa! They have really done an overhaul on the restaurant itself. I remember first eating here when it was a little, run down restaurant next to a strip club. The neighborhood has really turned around (the strip club is long gone) and Miguel's expanded and been totally upgraded. The has food is amazing and the prices are fair. Whenever family come to visit, they always ask to get their Miguel's fix.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Joey Bs never disappoints. My husband and I try to stop here whenever we are in town. We have yet to have something we don't like. I recently ordered the buffalo chicken salad. Ummm... Yummy! I couldn't stop eating. Our wait staff was great and food came out warm.

place_category: Seafood, Salad, Bars, Nightlife, Mexican, Restaurants
text: We went to this place last night. What a deception. The food was far from good, the waitress wouldn't stop asking me if the food was ok. I really wanted to say no "it's sucks" the chicken had no taste, the beans as well. I can believe people can mess up Mexican food but there you have it. This place did for me. Horrible choice. I will never go back and do not recommend it to my friends.

place_category: Barbeque, Korean, Restaurants, Asian Fusion
text: This place is great and very traditional business. I love the food there and I can't wait to come back. I'm always crazing Korean food. This is the best one in St. Louis area for Korean food.

place_category: Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Dance Clubs, Bars, Music Venues, Mexican, Sports Bars
text: The place is pretty laid back, good drink specials and accommodating staff! Tiny dance floor though haha Had fun though :)

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Salvadoran, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, Tacos

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian, Salad

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea

place_category: Seafood, Sandwiches, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants

place_category: Seafood, Party & Event Planning, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Mexican

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Diners, Burgers
text: According to management, the fire marshal will not allow you to park your stroller by your table (despite having ample room to get through). place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: So disappointed! I asked for the homewrecker and a salad not a burrito bowl and it had no lettuce. when they started to remake it, she spilled the chicken including on herself, and put it back in my bowl! Gross! When I told the manager, all he said was that he is sorry. Since he was not pulling her off the line, or offering to have somebody else make my lunch, I did not eat there! Boo Moes! Bad form!

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Thai, Japanese
text: Best restaurant EVER!! Everything on the menu is amazing!! I go once to twice a week and never get sick of it!!

place_category: Food, Imported Food, Specialty Food, Indian, Restaurants, Ethnic Food, Buffets
text: Excellent vegetarian options. I love this food. Very authentic. Last dined with my husband for an early valentines dinner. Highly recommended. Excellent servers as well

place_category: Mexican, Latin American, Restaurants
text: Uncomfortably hot in restaurant (85 degrees+). Shredded chicken in 'house specialty' enchiladas was extremely bad tasting - nasty 'chicken' flavor I associate with really low-quality fare. The service was good and the salsa was hot, but frankly this was the worst plate of Mexican food I've had in Tucson in a very long time. You'd get better food at Los Betos for half the price, and much better food for the same price at a dozen other restaurants. Avoid.

place_category: Pubs, Bars, Distilleries, Gluten-Free, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Burgers, American (New), Food, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Cocktail Bars
text: Disappointing. Weekend special Kobe Mozzarella Meatballs were unavailable by 3pm on Saturday. Weak sauce! No consistency means doubtful a fourth visit happens.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Came in on Mardi Gras day the food was great. I had their pizza. Practically devoured the entire pizza myself. They also served Gelato and I had a scoop of chocolate cheesecake, it was delicious. After I got the check I was disappointed about their $10 "table" charge. I asked about the charge and they said because it was Mardi Gras they had to charge to eat there.

place_category: Fondue, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants
text: Meal was fine. Poor service though. Sat without drinks for a long time. Had to adjust the burner ourselves because we were never checked on and caused us to burn a lot of the food. Waited 45 minutes for last course.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Wraps, American (New), Burgers, Asian Fusion, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Cafes, Gluten-Free, Vegetarian, Hawaiian, Vegan
text: Really enjoyed our dinner here. We wanted a place that was healthy and decided to try this place. Lots of vegan, gluten free and vegetarian options as well as regular meat options. We loved the Portuguese sausage that came with our meal, very juicy and packed full of flavor. Also, really enjoyed the popovers! The macadamia sauce that came with them is to to die for. I want to go back for breakfast and try their pancakes.

place_category: Cantonese, Chinese, Restaurants, Dim Sum

place_category: Thai, Breakfast & Brunch, Chinese, American (Traditional), Restaurants, American (New)
text: New ownership done right. I've been here a few times and have been impressed with breakfast and the authentic Thai dishes. The menu is VERY extensive, but so far everything I've tried has been excellent. Not the most convenient location, but give it a shot. You'll be glad you did.

place_category: Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Seafood, Nightlife, Restaurants

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Mexican

place_category: Bars, Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (New)
text: Excellent burgers, drinks, and service from our friendly waiter, Erik! :) This is one of my go-to burger places whenever I visit Southern California.

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants

For a much better breakfast experience, cross the bridge into New Hope and stop at Fred's - you won't regret it (like you will if you eat at Sneddon's).

place_category: Cafes, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: Not impressed by the food at garden brunch. The coffee wasn't flavorful, the red velvet pancakes I ordered tasted like pancakes from a box. The turkey sausage and eggs, however, were very delicious. I will consider giving this place another shot.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Tacos, Mexican, Tex-Mex, Fast Food

place_category: Food, Burgers, Restaurants, Fast Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars

place_category: Mexican, Desserts, Food, Seafood, Restaurants
text: I came in for lunch and had the Entomotadas. They were pretty good, plenty filling for lunch. We also had the cheese dip and salsa with our chips which was alright.

place_category: Donuts, Food, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea

This DD branch is sugar-obsessed: my last three visits over the last 2 weeks have been the same: "no sugar, please" results in a giant hunk of undissolved sugar sitting at the bottom of my coffee. On the rare occasion I get a donut they've given me the wrong one as often as not. I'll go to the one up near Haverford Rd before I go back here.

place_category: Tea Rooms, Acai Bowls, Food, Coffee & Tea

place_category: Restaurants, Thai

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Latin American
text: The quality just isn't there anymore. I'm used to getting chicken instead of steak that's not the issue so much. It's the quality of the food itself. The empanadas aren't the same as they used to be for sure that really bummed us out. I get the world is hurting for good workers right now cause no one wants to pay a living wage but it's been in decline for a year now and I don't think we will be going back.

place_category: Pakistani, Restaurants, Indian
text: Food was excellent and our waitress was lovely. Minus two stars because the busboy/host was the crankiest and most antisocial person I've met. Don't work in a service industry if your vocabulary consists mostly of grunts and half-hearted gestures and you can't cobble together a smile even when people say "thank you."

place_category: Steakhouses, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: This was a great place to go when sushi was hard to find. There are now a lot of other places that are just as good in my opinion but are a fraction of the price. We like Fujiyama, but due to their prices we don't eat here as often.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: I really love this bar, but sometimes it can be hit or miss. Most of the food is great, served late, and at an awesome price. My problem lies in the service. When it's a few female bartenders, the service is laced with attitude. The guys are great though, always smiling and friendly.

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Seafood
text: The Bang Bang Shrimp is a must-try! It's in a great location downtown with parking nearby. I recommend stopping by before and after dinner times because the happy hour menu is such a great bargain. Pretty much anything on the menu is bomb! Drinks are great too!

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Loved it! I had brunch here and the food, service, ambiance were all fantastic. I had eggs benedict, and they were superb. The place is super cute and the fact you get to sit looking out into rittenhouse square is an added bonus. I will definitely be back for brunch the next time I'm in philly.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Chinese, Vietnamese
text: Absolutely disgusting!! Worst service I've ever received in my life. The rice was bland and chicken definitely was NOT chicken. Wasted my hard earned money!!! Never again, I would not recommend to anyone.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Pizza Manias is a family restaurant with great salads and sandwiches. The pizza is not much like New York Pizza, the crust is soggy and they are skimpy on the ingredients. The sauce is homemade but very light. Get the white spinach pizza with tomatoes and ask for it crispy, you wont be disappointed. The customer service is very good, however I don't go there for the pizza.

place_name: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers and Brews

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: If you want an overpriced, blend and most of all sh!tty cheese steak this is the place to go. Also RACIST, XENOPHOBIC and HOMOPHOBIC. Sorry for the all caps, just wanted to give everyone a fair warning. Wooohoo!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Pubs, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Beer Bar
text: Amazing beer selection. As I am a solid fan of anything and everything sour, dry, bitter, or fermented I really, really appreciated the wide range of sour beers. Happy hour seems pretty decent. I enjoyed a delicious salmon-bacon sandwich. Pretty solid service, too, despite all the negative reviews claiming otherwise.

place_category: Chinese, Cantonese, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food
text: I waited 2 hrs 4 mins and 29 seconds for delivery last night. I ordered general tso's, an egg roll and a small wonton soup. Yelp contacted restaurant twice and I called once. Restaurant was unapologetic nor offered any discount or credit for future orders. I paid and tipped the delivery man bc it was not his fault- it's the restaurants fault!

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, Nightlife, Salad, Bars, Sandwiches, Pizza, Chicken Wings
text: They don't offer masks for carry out, instead they would rather you get nothing. 0/10 I went here for a quick slice and got denied instantly, even with my own mask. DONT GO HERE!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Sandwiches, Chicken Wings
text: The wings are not as big as I expected. Also, I requested ranch as my dip and I received 2 containers of blue cheese dressing instead. I have had and seen better.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: This is one of the best small businesses in Ewing and I am super excited that they have a TCNJ location now! I first found out about them through a Trenton Times article and have been a steady customer ever since. Their prices are unbeatable and the quality of the food is amazing. Seriously. I'm salivating just thinking about their home made chips, salsa, and those Fish Tacos are crazy good. Stop reading this, do yourself a favor, and order everything.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Brazilian, Salad, Steakhouses, Venues & Event Spaces, Gluten-Free
text: My family of 8 went out to eat here. Food was okay, and it was a great atmosphere. I would not recommend the alcoholic beverages. The checks was a big issues to divide the checks 4 way with military discount. The check came back to the table wrong 3 different times. We had to wait over 45 mins before we received the correct bill. Maybe service would be better on another day. I would not recommend to go there when it's busy .

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: I came from Va with my family just to try those two famouse places n we r so disappointed because taste is really bad nothing special

place_category: Restaurants, Gastropubs, Bars, Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: Eh. I came in twice to the bar and both times the bar staff took more than average to get my order....not forever but they had enough time. Bar staff is not the friendliest. "What can I get you." Did not say goodbye when I left. Dropped the check and didn't say anything. The bartender was not engaging at all with the clientele....very matter of fact and not consistent with what I consider an English "Public House." I won't be back.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Irish, Nightlife, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: First visit to this venue, plenty of parking in a pretty downtown area that was nice. You enter from the parking lot side area, place feels a little dated. Staff was friendly and attentive. Sandwich was decent although a bit over priced for what was included. Would come back if in the area .

place_category: Soul Food, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Southern
text: This isn't necessarily good for your body, but it might be good for the soul. The breakfast here is great. It is down home style of food done to perfection. I love the soul playing through the speakers. Too bad the service is always unfriendly and off, otherwise I would give it five stars. And the coffee is horrible. These should be easy things to fix considering the excellent flavor.

place_category: Sandwiches, Food, Caribbean, Seafood, Desserts, Restaurants
text: I absolutely love this place. Best authentic Jamaican food in STL. Come check it out!!

place_category: Bars, Burgers, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Irish
text: So this place is decent. I would say mid prices. It is though small and cramped. The fish and chips was good but the curly fries honestly lacked flavor. Their French onion soup also was much more broth tasting than flavorful. Their chicken wings are massive, and I mean freaking huge.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Nightlife, Sandwiches, American (New), Bars, French, Cocktail Bars
text: Cute place but with a party of 9 and a reservation and a Monday night we expected a bit more. Dreadful service. Waited 2 hours for the food. No follow up at all-- was everything okay, can I bring another glass of wine? On the way out we mentioned the poor service to the mgr in charge and she was clearly not bothered. Not to mention the food was meh. Won't be back too many other good places in Tucson.

place_category: Thai, Chinese, Seafood, Restaurants
text: By far the best Pad Thai in Nashville, and trust me I know, I have tried 7 different places since moving here. Cannot praise enough. I highly recommend getting the Pad Thai with tofu I eat it way more than I should!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Pizza, Nightlife

The guys behind the take out counter are really nice and genuine and ready to go the extra mile to get me what I ask for. This is the very best restaurant I have found in Aston!

place_category: Salad, Gay Bars, Desserts, Bars, Burgers, Food, Restaurants, Nightlife, Pubs
text: Nice room, decent selection (though no bargain) but crap service. text: Dirty dishwear, and bad service. The girl who sat us was rude, and our server/bartender didn't check on us until we were almost don't with our meal. I tried to get his attention multiple times to ask for new plates, because they were dirty, but I ended up having to walk up to the bar to get them myself. The plus side, the cauliflower is good.

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Italian, Salad
text: This place is owned by Carlucci's and their food is out of bounds! Everything is homemade and the Italian hospitality is better than any I've had elsewhere. Excellent restaurant!

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Mexican, Hot Dogs, Breakfast & Brunch, Food Stands
text: Thought this was a BK Lounge at first, but nope, it's actually a Mexican joint instead. I wasn't overly impressed with the food they had here. Nothing was terrible, but at the same time, nothing was really stellar either. Nothing really struck me as being memorable or extraordinary. I also asked for a refill and they just took my drink and didn't do anything with it. Five minutes later, I went up to the counter and saw my empty cup just sitting there. No bueno.

place_category: Vietnamese, Vegetarian, Vegan, Restaurants
text: Very underwhelming pho that is overpriced. The server took a very long time to get our orders, and then proceeded to forget our drink order. I wouldn't suggest it if you want a quick service. There are definitely better options of Vietnamese restaurant in STL, and would NOT recommend this place.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Casinos, Diners, American (Traditional)
text: Food is good when they get you're order right service is the worst ever order soup and potatoes and a cup of coffee you would think that would be fast and easy no got my coffee 10 minutes later my soup 10 minutes later my potatoes never asked if I wanted more coffee had to ask the hostess if I could get more coffee it was pretty empty they need better waitresses or they will be loosing business so sad it's the only descent place to eat at the sands everything else is awful and over priced

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: El Limon is a good spot to grab lunch. Its kind of run down looking inside but the food was ok for the price.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea
text: I attempted to go in Starbucks to order a coffee. I had my small Maltese in my arms, as it was 90 deg outside and didn't want to leave him in the car. This location has no drive thru. One of the employees started yelling at me the dog could 't stay. I offered to place the order and go wait outside. She refused. I told her I would never come back to this location again. SHe laughted and said, "Good".

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Awesome little Mexican place where they put all there effort into making great tacos, tamales and tortas. All at a great price. I never had a steak and egg taco before today but it won't be the last. I need to remember this place next time I'm in Indianapolis.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Pretty big yogurt place in comparison to others. In fact, it seems to have a larger variety of flavors from the do it yourself self serve machines. Open until 11 PM. Easy strip mall parking. Cool colored LED lighting.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Comfort Food, New Mexican Cuisine, Food, Tacos
text: This is the real deal. Very authentic. Shredded beef tacos were great. Beans and rice very fluffy and tasty. Guacamole was very fresh. Chips were ok but salsa was good. Pozole with beans was very tasty, filling and healthy. Cabbage, cilantro, jalapeño and fried onions on the side. Small was large enough with a take home container. Toasted bread on the side. You won't be sorry. Walked out happy

place_category: Restaurants, Delis
text: Great food and great service. Every staff member was helpful and friendly. Hoagies we're made for me in under 3 minutes and they were delicious. Their prices are unmatched. Very cheap for a hoagie, but the quality is phenomenal. Love their sandwiches.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food, Restaurants
text: This is officially the slowest Starbucks ever. The staff just seems to wander around inefficiently with no time management or understanding that people actually have somewhere else to be. So frustrating!

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Southern
text: Every time I go there the service is terrible nd today they didn't have anything except pulled port. Terrible service and terrible management

place_category: Mediterranean, Sandwiches, Fast Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: It's a little bland. I've been to another pita pit in San Jose, CA, and the one in SJ tastes much better than this one. And the portion of meat is pretty small. The service is pretty fast.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Hot Dogs, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Burgers
text: Good burger and I got what I ordered and I didn't have to wait to long and the waitress and price was reasonable.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Always good- amazing penut salad dressing, the lunch specials are what keep me coming back!

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: The buffet: my general stance is that they can overcome quality deficiencies by offering quantity of options, and that wasn't the case here. Not very many dishes - a couple curries, pad thai, a veggie stir-fry, some deep-fried things. Dishes were generally pretty bland and not particularly fresh. Caveat: one visit and could have been an off day.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Burgers, Nightlife
text: Cool atmosphere, bad food. Something crunchy (a little too crunchy) turned up in the potato salad. My fiancée got the lamb sliders and I ordered the chicken sliders. Chicken was ok but the lamb had gristle in it - he left one sitting. Fried pickles are alright.

place_category: Chinese, Japanese, Restaurants, Thai
text: For asian food, the selection of this place is pretty huge and averagely-priced. Sushi was my favorite from here, with large rolls. The Chinese and Thai were just alright, though. I know some loyal customers of Jaysian, and they swear by everything. Ordered delivery by calling in and they dropped it off within an hour.

place_category: Bars, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Cafes, Food, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch, Wine Bars, Sandwiches
text: Tasty coffee and food, but don't expect quiet!

place_category: Pizza, Barbeque, Salad, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: OMG! I JUST PICKED UP A LARG PLANE PIZZA. IT WAS THE WORST PIZZA I EVER HAD! It was like the kind of pizza you get at a Carnival no sauce the crust was thin as a piece of paper all dough no cheese. Eww you've been warned! We threw it out.

place_category: Food, Health & Medical, Pharmacy, Shopping, Convenience Stores, Drugstores
text: While it was convieinent to have everything I needed neatly in the store, and easily accessed off the road at a lighted intersection, I found it incredibly disheartening to hear the cashier say - out loud and NOT terribly under her breath "Well I THOUGHT I'd get some shopping done." as if my being in the store and needing to check out was ruining her day.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Sports Bars, Bars, Chicken Wings, Burgers
text: Buckets has awesome food! The club (best in Tampa) and let's not forget the Rachel Rueben! Awesome live entertainment as well!

place_category: Mexican, Latin American, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Ordered delivery and it came in a flash. Not only was the service quick, but their menu is very extensive. I got the brisket tacos, which were just the right amount (3 tacos per order). They were super flavorful and not loaded with condiments either. My husband enjoyed a burrito, which was literally the size of his head. We've ordered from a few good Mexican places in the past, but El Sabor is not good, it's great!

place_category: Custom Cakes, Food, Cupcakes, Desserts, Bakeries, Restaurants, Gluten-Free
text: My sweet husband surprised me with a gluten-free chocolate cake with chocolate buttercream frosting from here. It's delicious. Nobody would know it's gluten-free; it tastes better than many chocolate cakes I've had. Very very moist. Frosting also excellent, not too sweet. My kids loved it too.

place_category: Fast Food, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Chicken Shop
text: takes forever to get food, unprofessionally run, and the people who take your order are very rude. i love kfc, but not enough to go through this terrible service.

place_category: Pakistani, Restaurants, Indian
text: I was visiting from out of town -- thought Doylestown would surely have some great restaurants. Dinner at Cross Culture was the best option I could find. I had the Mulligatawny soup and the vegetable jajouk(?). Both were acceptable but not outstanding, a little bland.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Ok. Not the best not the worse. I wish they had a better selection of flavors. The inside could have been a little cleaner and we were limited to where we could sit because there was trash and messy tables. Not sure if the worker was just busy since she was the only one working. She was very nice and did clean up between ringing up customers. I've been a few times before and never really been "impressed" by this location.

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Music Venues, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Restaurants

Food was greasy, fried were cold by the time our food came. Pretty disappointing

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, American (New), Venues & Event Spaces, Music Venues, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Musicians, Jazz & Blues, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Bars
text: Best bloody mary anywhere, they serve it up with peppered salt rimmed glasses, premium vodka and a spicey pickled crisp green bean garnish. I have been to the Gospel brunch many times where you serve yourself good Southern cooked items and hear great live music in their stadium seating dining room. I always enjoy my visit here, the ambiance and music does lots for the senses. I need to return to attend a concert one evening.

place_category: Food, Imported Food, Food Trucks, Desserts, Seafood, Steakhouses, Ethnic Food, Sandwiches, Soul Food, Specialty Food, Restaurants
text: I've been going to tasties for years now and it seems to be getting worse the more I go. The last time i went , I order 2 salmon platters and a chicken platter. It took over a hour and the salmon was COMPLETELY over cooked. If you try tasties, I recommend the Germantown location.

place_category: Food, Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Desserts
text: Dessert are goods but food need to improve a lot . Place have potential but need to work in main menu flavors and portions need to get better

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
