place_category: Nightlife, Burgers, Restaurants, Mexican, Bars, Beer Bar, Hawaiian
text: Ordering process was not all that great especially on a busy night. Food was good but there was a lot of butter added to the buns of the burgers. Only been one time. May go back for another try.

place_category: Thai, Chinese, Seafood, Restaurants
text: The best Thai food in Nashville. It may seem to be a hole in the wall but you will not be disappointed with anything you order.

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese, Korean
text: I've been coming here for 25 years. Used to be very good food. Now it seems the food has gone down hill, nothing like it used to be. There used to be women working now it's just all men and they're horrible. Asked for a refill of water and I never received it. Just my bill. Whatever you do don't ask for refills for the little side dishes. Horrible service and food mediocre. Sad what this place has become. Go to Bandos down the street instead. Better food, better sides and better service.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Bars, Salad, Nightlife, Soup, Wine Bars
text: It's an olive garden and you get exactly what you expect. Mediocrely consistent food-they aren't winning any awards for creativity. A lot of their meals are fried and lets be honest, anything tastes better fried. For better authentic Italian, hit up Mazzaro's only 5 minutes away. Even their breadsticks aren't what they use to be.

place_category: Cupcakes, Caterers, Food, Chocolatiers & Shops, Bakeries, Specialty Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Shopping, Desserts, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services
text: Great place for coffee, teas, and lots of great confections. Truffles, cakes, cupcakes (awesome cupcakes). Lattes, Italian sodas, flavored iced teas, (try the black iced teas). Prices are reasonable, staff is friendly, and service is prompt. Check out their website for a full menu.

place_category: Restaurants, Mediterranean, American (Traditional)
text: Cute place for a quick bite to eat. The staff was super sweet. The drive thru is convinent. It's on the Hillsborough River, and has a picnic table on the river side. The table makes for a cute picnic. Never really super busy and it is a decent option when you aren't feeling like pizza, Chinese or McDonald's.

place_category: Restaurants, Hawaiian, Seafood, Burgers
text: I went to L&L for the first time last week. Ordered the poke bowl, kalbi platter and a pull pork platter and 3 different musubi. (Sausage, chicken and spam) the best one is the original spam musubi. The pull pork had no flavor. The kalbi beef was small. I was expecting this place to wow me since I heard so much about it, but no it's average. Poke bowl and spam musubi are two great choice if you go there.

place_category: Burgers, Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches, American (Traditional), Cheesesteaks, Chicken Wings
text: Very disappointed with the service this morning. Our waitress was friendly but only saw her face once. She took our order and that was it. Never came back to ask how we were doing and waited 10 minutes after finishing our breakfast to drop off the check. A second cup of coffee was out of the question, clearly. Food was decent just really unhappy with the lack of service. Won't be in a rush to go back.

place_category: Mexican, Burgers, Diners, Salad, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Came here for their Chef salad, (BEST IN RENO) ! Ended up getting the special, (Corn beef and cabbage). It was AWESOME ! Very large portion, only ate half and a lot of meat ! Served with horseradish on the side and two side dishes. This is the most underrated restaurant in Reno for a coffee shop ! Never disappointed.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: The food here is freaking AMAZING , you must try the nacho supreme ;it's big enough for 2 people . The tacos are amazing, everything is fresh and authentic !! Staff is okay , just plain , not bad or rude and also not outgoing . If you wanna eat in peace it's the right type of vibe for you . I think it's hands down THE BEST TACO SPOT IN TAMPA !!

place_category: Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Restaurants
text: We were just driving through and spotted this great little oasis by the beach. We were treated like they were glad we stopped by. The rest was ice cream and toppings and whipped cream. What could be better? Highly recommended.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New)
text: Went with my sister. We got foie Gras, which was categorically excellent and as decadent as I've had it. The other dishes we had we good as well, but almost one month later, this is the one I remember. Excellent cocktails as well, did not have a chance to observe the bar craft. I am willing to pay well for a good meal, and unquestionably will go here again.

place_category: Active Life, Shopping, Zoos, Home & Garden, Food, Farmers Market, Bakeries, Flowers & Gifts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Fruits & Veggies, Specialty Food
text: $3.29/lb for just harvested tomatoes from a farm stand puts a bad taste in my mouth although Merrymead does many other things well, such as their baked goods (fresh baked pies, cakes, cookies) which are excellent. Heck, I purchased tasty tomatoes shipped from Canada in a local supermarket last week for less. Merrymead sells all vegetables for more money than the supermarkets, as far as I can tell but if you have kids, then this is the place to go. The kids love it.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Japanese
text: To Reef Sushi, Do you remember when you used to have a five star rating, what has happened here? My recent two visits were filled with mishap, shortages of plates, utensils with an obvious lack of leadership and organization. Noting marginal cleanliness and the aforementioned issues this was quite notably less than what I experienced in earlier visits

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, American (New), Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars
text: Music outside on Saturdays is good. Cuban is good. Not impressed with the pizza. Jerk chicken wrap is good and spicy. Happy hour even on weekends, very nice!

place_category: Delis, Caterers, Restaurants, Salad, Sandwiches, Event Planning & Services
text: The food is not bad a little pricy and the staff are always really friendly, but no matter what location I go to there always seems to be a fly issue. I really have no complaints about the food or people, just the flies.

place_category: Steakhouses, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Now that I have experienced other sushi resturants, I better appreciate the ambience, service and sushi quality. I really like the Playboy and temptation

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Fish & Chips, Nightlife, Seafood, Restaurants, Bars
text: Fresh & superb! View is great, too, but the fish is worth a trip, even if you are out of town.

place_category: Delis, Food, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Convenience Stores
text: They have some nice employees at the sandwich counter that do a good job . the coffee area is almost always a disaster area would be a higher rating if it was clean

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Restaurants, Active Life, Sports Bars, Bars, Seafood, Breakfast & Brunch, Beaches
text: Apparently the name changed but the management stayed the same. Subpar customer service. Sad thing was it wasn't even the staff this time it was actually one of the mangers. Plenty of other places in Tampa to check out.

place_category: Pizza, Nightlife, Food, Restaurants
text: It seems to me every time I order from them the quality goes down. One order took over an hour to deliver, next time the pizza was barely warm. There's seems to be no consistency. It's not bad pizza but for the price and customer service its just okay

place_category: Restaurants, Party & Event Planning, Specialty Food, Delis, Food, Meat Shops, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: Amazing sandwiches. Definitely worth what you pay and I'd even go as far as to say one of the best sandwich shops I have ever eaten at. The problems for me and why I don't go here often is that they have limited hours, are often quite busy and slow when they are open, they are out if the way for me, and it's relatively expensive for a sandwich. But these issues are definitely outweighed by the great food!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Food, Ethnic Food, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian, Specialty Food, Israeli, Restaurants
text: Best Hummus ever, the appetizer are delicious and very rare. great service, we bring our own cake for my moms birthday and they help us out with everything. the server suggest a great wine option. and even the chef came by and allowed my mom to take a pic with him. we have a blast. the decoration is beautiful, i will definitely come back as soon as i can.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Wine Bars, Bars, Seafood, Cocktail Bars
text: Great food, prepared and presented beautifully. Fun atmosphere. Best lamb ever!!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, French
text: This place is adorable. I had a pre-paid group discount voucher, so I was excited to try it for the first time in downtown Carmel. I went for lunch and had the Croque Provençal, which is a delicious veggie version of the traditional French sandwich with carmelized onions, tomatoes, and fantastic cheese and bread. The atmosphere is cheery and bright. My boyfriend said it felt too girly for him, but maybe that was just the French brunch place feel. :-)

place_category: Mediterranean, Italian, Turkish, Restaurants
text: Jessica was really great and professional. I hope their cook would take her as example to present his food better. Lamb meatball and fillet tasted good but sides in dish and presenting was disappointing. Half tomato, few beans and 4 meatball thats it. Mussels were good also, but you dont put lettuce in shepard salad specially if its dead lol. Service was good but kitchen need improve much more...

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Burgers
text: The food here was amazing. The Mac n Cheese burger was to die for- lots of food, which made it well worth the price. For a Saturday night, the restaurant/bar was a little empty. But they had the preds game on and great music, which made for a fun atmosphere. Nothing amazing/something I couldn't get elsewhere in Nashville, but overall great dinner!

place_category: Pubs, Nightlife, American (New), Restaurants, Bars
text: If you're hungry and you want to go casual, this is the place for you. Home Style cooking with fresh ingredients. HUGE portions. Everybody leaves with a take out bag. This place is a homey dress down place. Italian is the Fare of the day and the owner is proud of the freshness and portions. A nice place to stop to or from the shore.

place_category: Tex-Mex, Breakfast & Brunch, Mexican, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Tacos
text: This is the best place for Tacos in Boise. I was spoiled while in Jacksonville, Florida with all of the great taco trucks and taco stops. Boise does not have this variety, and Tin Roof Tacos brings a lot to the table other than just tacos.

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: Walked into Toby Keith's Bar and Grill tonight at 4:40 pm. Wife and I found a seat at the bar. We sat there for 15 minutes before we left, not a bartender, not a waitress, no one acknowledged our existence. Others at our end of the bar had almost empty glasses. Bartender was working the opposite end of the bar and seemed to have no concern for customers at our end. After 15 minutes we got up and left without spending a penny. No one seemed to care. Will not be back.

place_category: Caterers, Nightlife, Home Services, Bars, American (New), Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Hotels & Travel, Hotels, Real Estate, Coffee & Tea, Event Planning & Services, Tapas/Small Plates, Cocktail Bars, Food, Shared Office Spaces
text: Very disappointed! Steak was bland, cold no flavor. No originality or concept of flavor. Service was slow. Hate to be honest but worst place so far that I've been to in St Pete at the price point.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Delicious! Very creamy and fresh ingredients that take it to a whole new level. The line is often out the door but moves quickly. Very friendly staff!

place_category: Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Fast Food, Asian Fusion
text: Just spent $30 on sushi delivery. All of the sushi tasted and felt like it had been sitting out for a while. I got the tropical roll (which has coconut shrimp in it...which is an ingredient I often get in my sushi at different restaurants) and the shrimp tempura was cold and hard like it has been sitting out. Same with the appetizer of crab tempura. I didn't eat but one piece of the $14 roll, it was just so bad :(

place_category: Restaurants, Comfort Food, American (Traditional), Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Barbeque
text: Place was empty. Service was indifferent. Ordered the Pulled Pork with streamed broccoli and collard greens. Pork: Inedible fatty salt bomb. Collard greens: Enough salt to start your own ocean. Sent 'em back and walked out. Now I now why the place was empty.

place_category: French, Coffee & Tea, Cafes, Food, Restaurants
text: I have had lunch many many times at Caribou Cafe and it was always wonderful. I love the ambiance and no loud music. Today the food was bland and disappointing. A friend and I wanted French cuisine and we were choosing between Parc and Caribou. The food is much much better at Parc but the noise level is so loud at Parc that we can't have a conversation there. At Caribou there was good jazz background music and it was relaxing and enjoyable. I wish Caribiou would improve the food.

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, Party & Event Planning, Party Supplies, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Southern, Event Planning & Services
text: We came here for Mother's Day brunch and was our first visit. The biscuits and caramel rolls were awesome starters. My Irish coffee was outstanding and smooth. My entree was the salmon eggs Benedict. Again, outstanding. So this place is a hat trick for you hockey fans. Highly recommend this for ambience and food.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants, Bagels, Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches
text: Usually a fan of this place. Came here for the white fish special bagel. There is barely to no whitefish on here. I basically just taste cream cheese, tomato, and onion. Also there were supposed to be capers on here. Nope. Very disappointed..

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: So much has changed since my last visit. Floors are noticeably dirtier, the dining area has no AC, overheard who I'm assuming is the owner, talking down to his employees, and food quality isn't the same. Service is still great, but they deserve a better working environment.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: You get a nice view but that's about it. Food is poor quality for a restaurant and small portions. Enjoy your beachfront view and a meager meal. Drug addicted homeless people are complementary.

place_category: Cafes, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries
text: Absolutely love the coffee here at Ren. There are so many other delicious-sounding beverages to choose from - but the coffee here has stolen my heart! I just have one request - please offer an organic whole milk option - If you had this, your coffee shop would be perfect!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Bars, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: I had to try the French 75, which I would recommend. We ordered appetizers and drinks. Will go for the oysters next time and skip the boudin. They were short on staff, but service was friendly.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Chinese, Bubble Tea, Taiwanese
text: I feel like this place has gone down in quality. Their popcorn chicken isn't as crispy and their spicy isn't as spicy without the add-ons. I asked for extra, extra spicy and the food tasted bland. Also, their "traditional" Chinese dishes are just insulting. A majority of them are Americanized Chinese dishes, like orange chicken, lemon chicken, etc. The authentic Taiwanese dishes are great, though. Also their appetizers are incredible, to the point where I'd eat them as main dishes sometimes

place_name: M.L.Rose Craft Beer & Burgers - Sylvan Park
place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Sports Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Burgers, Bars, Beer Bar, Nightlife, Pubs
text: Wasn't too impressed with my visit. Staff was extremely nice & service was great, but food wasn't what I expected it to be. Maybe it was talked up, or they weren't having a great night? I will say, don't skip the sweet potato waffle fries & make sure you ask for ranch, they are very delicious. And of course, beer never fails! They have many choices for the beer lovers!

place_category: Diners, Restaurants, Cafes, Internet Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Coffee & Tea, Jewelry, Shopping
text: So satisfying and value is more than excellent! Our work orders it on waitr all the time. Breakfast sandwiches and bowls are where it's at! And coffee is so good too! Worth the wait

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian
text: This place is great! The menu had a lot of great options & it was hard to decide what to order. Our server, Sara, was great & recommended some of her favorites. She didn't disappoint! The service and the food were equally as good. Definitely recommend for a nice, causal place to eat and relax.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Hate to leave a bad review. I wish someone would have warned me. Ordered three meals all three were in edible. Being the only Chinese food place on the island is the reason I tried them for the second time but from now on I will be travelling for Chinese. Sorry

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: They claim to deliver but their deliverymen never work or go home early. Food is good, but i'll just order from Jimmy Johns.

place_category: Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Seafood, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Cocktail Bars
text: I got the pork chops and they were cooked perfectly. Not over cooked and dry. And the sauce that was with was delicious. The restaurant was very nice and had a great vibe to it. It was very clean and the staff was very nice. My friend got the salmon and said it it was delicious as well.

place_category: Beer Gardens, Restaurants, Food, Breweries, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Gastropubs, Nightlife
text: This place has a cool setup but horrible customer service with long waits, dirty tables, and rude hostesses. We came here on the 14th and were directed to our table in 5 minutes. We then waited 20 minutes without being helped while at the same time being swarmed by a nest of bees in which the youngest member of our party got stung. After complaining to the waitress(when she finally came). She responded with a, "yeah... it is bad today).

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, American (New), Nightlife
text: First and last visit for brunch. We ordered two of the simplest dishes, scrambled eggs with home fries, salad and bacon and eggs. Forty five minutes later still no food, we left. I will say their coffee is good,

place_name: Chicago's Pizza With A Twist - Reno, NV
place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Gluten-Free, Vegan
text: Great customer service! We ordered the chicken tikka masala pizza and it was delicious!! We will definitely be back here to try the rest.

place_category: Italian, Pasta Shops, Specialty Food, Food, Vegan, Restaurants
text: Overpriced and underserved. Pasta was great but price and portion size sucks. Very limited seating. Staff was nice.

place_category: Chicken Shop, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Tried using your drive thru today, your employee clearly hasn't been trained so it's not their fault but it's ridiculous that that you aren't able to accommodate someone who wanted to spend money with you. Thanks for building across from McDonald's, went there and was treated fine.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Fast Food, American (New), Gluten-Free
text: Great place, great food and amazing customer service. Always very warm and welcoming. This one of my favorite places to eat in Boise. Don't miss out.

place_name: The Happy Mixer Gluten Free Bakery
place_category: Food, Grocery, Restaurants, Bakeries, Gluten-Free
text: Gluten free dessert Mecca!! The best part, besides eating all the treats, is the delicious smell of a real bakery that washes over you when you walk through the door. Heavenly. Every cookie: to die for, and I'm pretty discerning when it comes to dessert. The donuts: not the same as regular donuts. Cupcakes and other fancy delights: delicious! I will return as often as I possibly can!!

place_category: Mediterranean, Greek, Restaurants
text: Waiting on food for 50 minutes? 50 minutes for a grilled chicken breast? 50 minutes for food that isn't that great? This restaurant has management issues. Not worth a wait that I wasn't even warned about.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque
text: Can't even review this place, because they were CLOSED. They're website doesn't indicate fall hours, but apparently they're only open one day a week. Seriously? If you don't go there on that day (I believe Wednesday), I guess you get leftovers. No thanks. We'll not even try to go back.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Noisy, overpriced, and way douchebaggy. I will not come back unless I am forced to.

place_category: Seafood, Pizza, Restaurants, Greek, Mediterranean, Italian
text: Been coming here for years and always great. The falafel and pita is amazing , best middle eastern/mediterranean food in the area. Huge menu so everyone can leave happy. Their new location is even better

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Latin American, Tex-Mex, Mexican
text: Craving nachos & had driven by MANY times. Today was the day & disappointed doesn't begin to describe My beef nachos. It's certainly a lot of food but just a mound of chips held together by melted cheddar cheese & covered in beef, looks like there may have been sour cream somewhere but not much. Nothing special & not much flavor...Needless to say, I won't return

place_category: Bars, Desserts, Italian, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Pizza, Restaurants
text: Interesting take on pizza and wings. Very upscale and pricey for pizza but different and tasty. The place was packed for a Saturday lunch but I was surprises to see all the kids, most of which were misbehaving. Why can't they go to ChuckECheese where they belong? They cost Peel a star because I hate going anywhere that uncontrolled kids rule the place.

place_category: Hot Dogs, Restaurants, Burgers, Salad
text: Just didn't think it was that remarkable. Not terrible by any means, but not that interesting.

place_category: Restaurants, Latin American, Asian Fusion, Korean, American (New), Wraps, Cafes, American (Traditional)
text: This place appears to be closed. I visited there on 7/10/19 @1:30 pm, and the security gates where pulled down, and there didn't appear to have 'signs of life'. I observed this from the street...while I was deciding to park the car. I didn't park, and got lunch further down the street.

place_category: Bars, Pizza, Nightlife, Restaurants, Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues
text: First time there and we loved it! Great atmosphere with live entertainment. Both inside and outside had a neat vibe to it. Good food, plenty of drink options and the waiter was very good.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: The service here is very rude and poor. The servers here care about solely profit and told me "hurry up and buy" when I asked about any beef dish selections. This has to be the worst customer service experience I have had. I would not recommend any one to eat here!!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Salad, Cafes, Food, Vegetarian, Desserts
text: We are really enjoying this restaurant. The pizzas and salads are original and delicious. The vibe in the restaurant is comfortable and intimate. I love how the owner is in the kitchen and dining area talking to patrons and spending time with everyone. It's bound to be a Tucson classic!

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Soul Food, Nightlife, Food, Desserts, Bars, Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants
text: Service mediocre. Waiter never asked our party for another round of drinks, nor didn't refill water glasses, until we asked. Food mediocre. Food came out in stages. Have been to numerous places in NOLA and wasn't impressed.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Southern, American (Traditional), Beer Bar, Bars
text: Don't try to book a private party with Fabiano. He will completely ghost you. He responded to messages for about 2 days, and when we decided to nail down the specifics, never heard from him again. Sent emails and called and left voicemails for an entire week, and nothing. It's hard to talk to anyone at Aldeans, Luke Bryan's and FGL via phone. It's unfortunate because we really wanted to have a private party there.

place_category: Delis, Restaurants, Italian, Event Planning & Services, Sandwiches, Caterers
text: Great food, super nice guy running the place. $10 for a 6" combo (/med drink & chips) was kind of steep though. Different sandwich styles don't show a pricing difference, so maybe the #16 & #17 are just unusually expensive?

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food
text: Went here a few years ago and was not impressed. But today, different story. Bacon cheese omelette, home fries, all good, hot and fast. Would like cheddar instead of white American. Potatoes were tender and crispy. Pancakes were huge, crispy edge, springy center. Orange juice, sweet and fresh squeezed. Table settings were non existent, ambience eh. Could certainly use a decorator. But it seemed clean. We live in walking distance so will go again.

place_category: Restaurants, Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Delis, Seafood
text: The 3-star is for the cheesesteak. Rolls are big soft and perfect. While big as advertised, flavor-wise, the cheesesteak just wasn't there. While they were making other folks' hoagies, I was wishing that I had tried one of those instead. I'll go back for a hoagie but try elsewhere for a cheesesteak.

place_category: Seafood, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Chinese
text: My "go-to" place for a catfish Po-Boy. It's huge and several dollars cheaper than surrounding places. The only other thing I have gotten there was a fish plate for $7.00 It had 2 huge pieces of catfish, a salad, and a whole lot of fried rice. I can get several meals out of one heavy plate. Always cooked just right and very good.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: The pasta sauce was runny as hell, like they forgot to drain the water or didn't care to drain it well. They do get the 1 star for the sauce tasting very good despite how watery it was.

place_category: Barbeque, Buffets, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Food, Smokehouse
text: We had an excellent server at dinner. They serve very large portions and have a large selection of foods. I tried the fried flounder special. While I was pleased with the side items, the main entree was chewy and bland -- not what one would expect for fish. I'd gotten carry out before from here and had a better experience with the fried chicken salad. I may give it one more shot with the ribs but so far it's a good place to grab a salad but haven't found much else I enjoy.

place_category: Italian, Sandwiches, Pizza, Restaurants
text: I guess it's Under New Management.stopped in last night to pick up a order. Only to see the owner arguing with an elderly couple about a gift card from previous owner. My order was delayed fifteen minutes or so due to the problem. Finally couple was taken care of. Not sure if I will go back, longtime customer. It looks like a buy and flip of business. Hope not.

place_category: Steakhouses, Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: The absolute WORST! They literally tried to feed me steak from the grease trap/garbage rail! STAY AWAY. Undercooked rice, rude staff and horrible service. I have no idea how this place gets good reviews.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Food
text: The food is completely underwhelming. Didnt see what all the fuss is all about. Definitely a tourist trap not worth the hype.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Great dive bar and restaurant, as long as you love dive bars and restaurants...fortunately, I do. Apps are great. Oysters, alligator and especially the sautéed crab claws. The four of us split two whole fish dinners--2.5 pounds of cleaned and slightly overcooked snapper. The sides were very good, and the key lime pie for dessert, just okay. For good food at a great price with an atmosphere that is as laid back as a lounge chair on a sandy beach, definitely stop in to the Shack.

place_category: Gastropubs, Cajun/Creole, Southern, Burgers, American (New), Restaurants
text: This place is firing on all cylinders - nice atmosphere, live entertainment fitting the setting and great food. Skillet cornbread, bacon popcorn, shrimp and grits - all excellent. Highly recommend ....

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Japanese
text: I went for a solo sushi date with myself to satisfy my craving and get some homework done. The place was quiet enough with only 2 other tables but there was very little variety of choice on the menu (especially for an all you can eat) and I felt very rushed by the staff. They were friendly enough but I couldn't help the feeling they wanted me out even though they were no where near closing time.

place_category: Salad, Steakhouses, Restaurants, Nightlife, Seafood
text: I was very disappointed with Chucks. I was told by a local it was a great place. The salad bar was sparse and my salmon was dried out to say the least. My husband ordered the $29.99 sirloin special and had to pay another $3.95 for the baked potato... I think they believe they are Morton's or Ruth Chris with the Ala Cart potato, BUT trust me the food was far from fine dining, only the prices were fine dining... Disappointed with Chuck... Saw the cook reheating crab legs on grill???

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Gluten-Free, Bars, Diners, Vegetarian, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Pubs
text: Great for brunch, but a little pricey. Definitely a hipster bar/restaurant, but still very good & cool atmosphere.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Lounges, Tapas Bars
text: Loved this place when it first opened but very disappointed when I went to check this place out the other night they were closed 45 mins before their listed closing time (on the door). No explanation or anything from the employees who clearly saw us waiting at the front door. Just a heads up if you are looking for a GREAT rooftop hangout spot in the Tampa area checkout the one at the end of the new St. Pete Pier! It is definitely worth the drive and the walk to get to it!! :)

place_category: Diners, Restaurants
text: This location is gross. The waitresses are usually nice but the clerk isn't. Maybe it's because it's mostly a drunk stop after midnight. However I do not drink and got very sick immidatly after eating the turkey club. It's a shame because it was 1 of the only places open late but I'll never go back.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Acai Bowls, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: Waited nearly 30 minutes for an açaí bowl only to be told they were out of açaí. Asked about it 15 minutes in and they said it was being prepared. Late for work and hangry. Not cool.

place_category: Steakhouses, Nightlife, Bars, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Ordered 2 prime ribs with 2 shrimp and scallop Oscar's. The majority of the shrimp had not been deveined. I prefer not to eat shrimp shit. Called the restaurant and they took our name and number. They called us back in 15 minutes or so and told us that they went through their supply of shrimp and it was up to their quality. I had a whole shrimp not deveined and multiple ones that I had to tear off half the shrimp. Disgusting! Terrible management and will never order from here again. Beware

place_category: Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Fast Food
text: * Casual and cute decor * Outdoor seating * Good for groups * Excellent tater tots- wish they served a sweet potato version * Loved the Barnyard (Pulled Pork BBQ, BBQ sauce and creamy slaw)- great combination of flavors. Could use a stronger bun because it got soft so quickly from soaking up all the juices.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Food, Ethnic Food, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian, Specialty Food, Israeli, Restaurants
text: Excellent in every way! The best hummus ever !! Keep in mind small plates! You definitely should make a reservation in the summer it was a 2 month in advance wait!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: I give it a 4 star because it's my first visit. Can't get too excited too fast you know! lol But I totally enjoyed my lunch today. No doubt about it. FYI: I judge a Mexican restaurant by its guacamole And this guacamole was an A+ Mmm Was back tonight for a second time in one week So it's official I'm LOCO!! for El Toro Loco :) I suggest you try it soon It's a small place. ...And it's going to be popular The food is delicious and the servers and staff are friendly and attentive

place_category: Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bagels, Restaurants, Delis
text: What this place lacks in terms of aesthetic, it more than makes up for in delicious bagel offerings. Located right off 13 and conveniently adjacent to a liquor store, this very unassuming shop offers the perfect bagel sandwich to cure any hangover (and believe me, I needed every bit of help). Their steak, cheese, and egg bagel was so good I had to get two. It was also a pleasant surprise being so satisfied and not spending more than $10. Be sure to check out this hole in the wall!

place_category: Food, Salad, Barbeque, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: My wife and I tried this place today after a round of golf in the Nashville area. We were both impressed with the place. She tried the catfish with hush puppies and green beans and I had the pulled pork , fries, and baked beans. We also shared a half dozen chicken wings. We both agree that the quality of the food was very good and next time we want some good BBQ in the area, we would indeed return..

place_category: Restaurants, Peruvian, Latin American
text: Great "Aji Gallina", "Ceviche" was average, not that great & over priced Excellente service, but drinks are also over-priced . PiscoSour $20 each? Crazy ! This is a casual dinner place, not the most elegant place in town. In the other hand, management should try to keep the area floors clean. Let's hope things get better. I brought friends for the 1st time. They were not impressed!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: This is definitely the best sushi I have had in St. Louis. The wait staff is incredibly nice and the service is very quick! I highly recommend the trio roll, spicy girl roll, Rangoon roll. But you cannot go wrong with any order here!

place_category: Peruvian, Chinese, Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Latin American
text: I enjoyed the food immensely. It was smaller portions but that was explained to us and being there with a larger group several of us shared. The service was not the level of service was not the best and I expected better at a Jose Garces restaurant, especially after having been to Amada. I would go back and give it another shot, because the food was outstanding.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Saturday night. Large cheese pizza and some hot wings. After a night of many beers and a delivery at 11pm it was.. ok. The pizza wasnt bad. I have gotten bad service here in the past but this was...ok. the wings are gross though. Chewy and gooey. Blah. Delivery was quick, pizza..better than before. Wings, poor chickens.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Sports Bars, Burgers
text: Food was ok..kinda over priced though..nice building...a single waffle was $9. The vibes was cool cause the dj was nice too

place_category: Mexican, Tex-Mex, Tacos, Breakfast & Brunch, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Reviewing a Taco Bell? Sure, why not. The late night folks were really nice and threw in an extra just for long wait (which seems to be other reviewers biggest complaint here). I can't fault anyone for the meal taking a little longer than normal. It's late night and no one wants to cook except these folks, so I'm willing to cut them some slack. A fun personality goes a long way; thanks, Kimanthi, for making me laugh.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I'm giving Parc three stars for it's wonderful ambiance, and exceptional service. The food was good (though not great), and the price tag befit Rittenhouse, but the service during a crowded brunch period was impressive. I really did feel like I could be at a Bistro in France, and my Bellini did not disappoint. I'll come back if I am in the area, but I wouldn't rave about it to friends. A solid option, but nothing more in my opinion.

place_category: Restaurants, Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Steakhouses, Local Flavor
text: The cashier was pretty unsanitary, even though she had gloves on she was touching money, wiping down the table, and scratching her arm with the same gloves on then making sandwiches. That's not clean. Also if you have customers waiting, take down their order first then continue on wrapping sandwiches. Poor management and unsanitary

place_category: Discount Store, Shopping, Food, Outlet Stores, Grocery
text: My go to market for almost all my grocery needs. Food is fresh ... Store is well stocked... workers are very helpful and nice..,

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: Food is decent. Quick service. Just went there today. New rule: credit card purchase must be greater than $10. Had no cash walked out. ... what is this the 80's. I can use my Iphone to board a flight. I know it cost money to have merchant account but in a world where many consumers don't carry cash this a bad business decision.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars
text: The environment and atmosphere is amazing, very family and kids friendly, also it has two bars. The staff are nice and the bathroom is clean. The bottle beer selection is nice but the beer selection on draught was meh. We ordered Mussels, it was still smelling too fishy for me but some people might like it that raw and simple.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Longest wait time ever. Took almost 30 mins to get 2 iced coffees. Line doesn't move at all. VERY SLOW. Avoid drive-thru

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: This location is my favorite! I drive the extra distance just to go to this location of Buffalo Wild Wings. Their wings come out hot, service is friendly and fast and their outdoor seating is so nice. I've come here to watch hockey games, for dinner with friends or family, or for just a quick lunch break. Their wings have always been hot, fresh and tasty. Toni is normally our waitress and she is awesome! They have specials that keep me coming like boneless Thursday's and the lunch specials.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Pubs
text: Call me spoiled but .... This place needs to step up its game. I ordered the smoked bbq platter not only was it dry and drenched in horrific bbq sauce, my baked beans were under seasoned and the waitress forgot my app. Forgive me as I cannot comprehend how one can mess up "forgetting" a simple app order when there are only 4 people eating "in the entire restaurant "... At least the music is decent and the beer is cold.. WOOSAA

place_category: Smokehouse, Barbeque, Food, Restaurants, Buffets
text: Good food, reasonable prices, terrible counter service. Watched staff serve the wrong orders to diners, place to-go food on the counter and fail to call out customers name (until food was getting cold) and by the time they let me know my order had been sitting there with out my knowing, I rushed out only to find (once home) an item missing from my order. Could use some management oversight.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Completely overpriced and the quality is sub par at best. Don't waste your money or time here. Go to the many other great French restaurants in Philly.

place_category: Automotive, Convenience Stores, Coffee & Tea, Food, Gas Stations
text: I will not spend my money at a place that has two fake "out of order bathrooms". There's no way all the rest rooms in this building are out of order. I'll spend my money elsewhere

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: chicken was not spicy, looks like chicken was sitting around for awhile dry, red bean rice was good, had better chicken back in long island , n.y., very disapointed.

place_category: Vegetarian, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Sandwiches, Food
text: The French toast was the best that I have ever had!!!! We also ordered the shrimp grit and and crab omelet, both being amazing as well. The only thing is the biscuit was quite bland, not living to NOLA standards of biscuits. Expect a long wait. We were there on a Saturday morning and waited for 45 minutes, and we came back on Monday, still an half-hour wait.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Steakhouses, American (New), Bars, Sports Bars, Burgers, American (Traditional)
text: The apples are not falling from the tree and re-growing everywhere. Let's face it, they came about, after T.G.I. Friday's and we all for a short time enjoyed the change, but did we really? Now with so many chains, I am frankly tired of them all! They all offer similar menu's and young kids needing a place to work, even on the grill line. Simple food and easy to fix. I was never big on Applebee's.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Service here was dreadful. I called back to amend an order and was tossed from employee to employee. The latter of which was rude and was ultimately hung up on. Never have I been so disrespected as a customer.

place_category: Seafood Markets, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Salad, Italian, Food, Specialty Food, Seafood
text: I don't get it the rave about this place. Mediocre pre breaded seafood. Staff was nice, beer fridge n8ce but I won't go back to buy breaded seafood.

place_category: Restaurants, Donuts, Chicken Wings, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: I have to admit, I only had the coffee so far BUT I'm very picky about coffee and it was delicious. Even though I can walk to this location, I'm guessing the parking lot is a big benefit for those passing by. I'll be bok.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: The food was OK but I'm a bit put off by the plate they served it on. Look at the bottom of your plate be for eating.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Vegetarian, Caterers, Restaurants, Caribbean, Vegan
text: Great vegan and vegetarian options! The vegan jerk chicken is to die for! Loved the plantain it was cooked perfectly and they give great portions!

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Mediterranean, Greek, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Decent array of Greek/Turkish food, the falafels are a bit too dry, however. Good baba ganoush and hummus!

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: ABC is the absolute worst liquor store/chain in Florida. They hide the decent bottles behind the counter, then act like you are annoying them when you ask about them. Want a hard to find bottle of bourbon? Gotta spend $1,000 for a one time chance to get in their "vault". Don't waste your time or money here. They don't care about you.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), American (New), Bars, Nightlife
text: Went in for a drink on a calm and rainy Thursday night. Our bartender made some great old fashioneds. Had the duck meatballs and some fries, delicious. Would definitely head back in for cocktails and appetizers, as well as dinner too!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: The food is alright. The lady that took our order was rude and not friendly at all. Speaks no English and there is not a place to sit. Having a picnic table would make a great improvement. They were out of fajita meat. I have had better.

place_category: Specialty Food, Mediterranean, Restaurants, Italian, Food
text: Delicious dishes, outstanding cocoanut cake for dessert, service was friendly, prompt, and informative, water glasses constantly refilled. Seating a little tight, but a popular place, and a lively room. Very pleasant experience.

place_category: Mexican, New Mexican Cuisine, Restaurants
text: Red Habanero is always amazing. The margaritas are on another level! So many creative choices and I've never had a bad one. The Xicaru mezcal in my Beso Del Dragon cocktail was sooo good. Tip: you can buy it at Sam's and Total Wine And More. The food is top notch always. They are constantly adding new items to the menu as well. I have never had anything bad here. Here's pictures of our dinners and drinks tonight.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Japanese, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Best sushi in Boise. Authentic Japanese cuisine, atmosphere and even the music. Impressed with service also. Will be back....!

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Not that good. Not really awful. Very Average pizza. Bland rust and sauce with a little cheese. Wish I could say more.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Gluten-Free, Bars, Diners, Vegetarian, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Pubs
text: Can you spell pretentious? I have been coming to the WD for years but tonight is the end of the road. Entrees were stone cold; service glacially slow; and someone needs to tell the pasty chef that just because she can spell a lot of different ingredients doesnt mean she has to use them. You guys have blown it. You took a friendly warm, yummy neighborhood restaurant and went all pretentious Brooklyn on us. Mike drop, I'm done

place_category: Specialty Food, Indian, Vegetarian, Seafood, Restaurants, Burgers, Wraps, Desserts, Buffets, Vegan, Food
text: They really bring the heat at this place, and in my opinion, that is a good thing. The issue has nothing to do with the food, prices, or decor but instead with the customer service. While the owner is a wonderful guy and always visits our table, we have had the worst luck with the waitresses on multiple occasions. I think that if they remedy this problem, I could add an extra two stars.

place_category: Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Burgers, Food, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Just stopped in for a bathroom break and to get a drink and a large fri Very rude service my husband and I stood there for 3 mins while the 2 ladies had there back to us and was talking . As I said can I place a order in a nice voice I was ignored so I said it again and then she turned around and was like yes!!!!!! And was pissed because I interpreted her . Rude and the fires are old

place_category: Chinese, Bubble Tea, Food, Noodles, Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Fast Food
text: We were there on Saturday. I must agree with another reviewer that the restaurant is very clean. Michael was very accommodating as one guest is gluten free and he went out of his way to make a couple of gluten free options. I had the Singapore noodles which were excellent. It's just a shame that I don't live closer as this would be my new go to place. I will, however, make it a point to order when I am in the area again. I highly recommend this new restaurant. You will not be disappointed.

place_category: American (New), Sandwiches, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Burgers, French, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: They have a rather small lunch menu, maybe 6 sandwiches and a few salads, which I actually really like, because usually it means that the quality of the dishes is high. I got the hot chicken sandwich which was just the perfect amount of spicy. My one gripe is that they seemed to be terribly understaffed. The had 2/3 of the tables open, but we had to wait 20 mins because they only had 2-3 servers. Because of this the service was quite slow and the servers seemed not very genuine.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, American (New), Tapas/Small Plates, Bars
text: Aptly named, this place is the answer! We had made a reservation for an early dinner but upon seeing the Happy Hour menu, we opted for that. Every bite was amazing. We even asked for a second serving of the trout, but the owner insisted that we try the crab toast (gratis), which we gladly did. The vibe is great, the interior is gorgeous, and the food is incredible.

place_category: Burgers, Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants
text: The best cheesesteak in town!!! I prefer Phillips among the other options..loads of steak smothered in cheese wiz (and they have the absolute best wiz)...yum!

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Cocktail Bars, Japanese, Bars
text: Great place to find out YOUR best sushi! Went during "happy hour" lots to try for cheap

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Food, Ethnic Food, Middle Eastern, Vegetarian, Specialty Food, Israeli, Restaurants
text: This place service is great. The food is a hit or miss as I've been here twice and the first time was just ok but the second time was over the top!

place_category: Middle Eastern, Restaurants
text: - TIP: Don't go with to large a group -- it's a tiny space and you'll want to get a seat in the back room if you can. - CON: The baba was drowning in tahini. I usually love tahina, but it completely overwhelmed any flavor from the eggplant. - BOTTOM LINE: Quaint spot with decent (but not great) mediterranean food.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Meh is about it. This is a run of the mill take out chinese food restaurant. Nothing seemed to special about this place. The most disappointing part of my order was the fact you can not substitute two crab rangoons for the egg roll.... I have become a custom to that ability. All I can say is Side Wok Cafe let's you do this.

place_name: Like Home Comme A La Maison
place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Restaurants, Bakeries, Food, Sandwiches, Cafes
text: Months ago I searched around for a French croissant and was unsuccessful. The seemingly factory croissants served elsewhere fall short in so many respects. I stumbled upon Like Home. I was instantly pleased to hear French being spoken; seeing the pastries made the name all so appropriate! Don't bother going anywhere else to get your francophilian fix. The buttery and flaky croissant will transport you to that French cafe you once visited. It doesn't cost a plane ticket to reminisce.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Food, Burgers, Salad, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Smokehouse, Caterers, Fast Food, American (Traditional), Barbeque
text: This bbq joint deserves every one of these stars. I dream about their burnt ends. So delicious, but order early as they sell out quickly. We also enjoy their corn dish. My son lovingly calls it "corn stuff." All of their sauces are on point and the perfect consistency. They are doing in-person dining, but we frequently do carry out. We've never been disappointed with any of the food we've ordered, but don't miss out on those burnt ends. They're even good left over.

place_category: Japanese, Ramen, Ethnic Food, Restaurants, Local Flavor, Food, Specialty Food
text: Go for the pork buns as well as the ramen. Very busy but worth the wait. Accommodating for vegetarian as well

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Lounges, Nightlife, Bars, Burgers, American (New)
text: Tried the jalepeño egg burger and the chicken wings. Food was decent, nothing too special. The service was ok as well. I do feel that this place is a bit overrated. Just an average sports bar. Overpriced if you ask me.

place_category: Restaurants, Chicken Wings, Nightlife, Bars, Italian, Pizza, Sports Bars
text: I highly recommended Buffalo chicken cheese fries! The pizza was excellent. You could tell this was a good local pizza place by all the to go orders and people coming In to eat. Staff is super friendly we will definitely be coming back! They made my birthday dinner with some deep fried Oreos

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Kids Activities, Active Life, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Eatertainment, Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Sandwiches

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Waffles, Restaurants

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: I keep giving this place a chance again..thumbs down, again....The place is dirty and the food less than mediocre. Don't think I'll try again.

text: I thought the pork egg rolls were just average, and the hot mustard wasn't so hot. The free bag of crispy noodles were stale but the bag we purchased was fresh. I was not super impressed with the house fried rice, it could have had more flavor. The Hunan Chicken and Chicken with string beans were spicy good.

place_category: Steakhouses, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, American (Traditional), Barbeque, Restaurants
text: Giving 2 stars bc we didn't get to try the food. Hostess told us it would be a 20 min wait. Turned out to be 45 mins. Waited another 5-10 mins at our table without being served so we decided to leave. This was from 8 to 9 pm. We could have decided to go somewhere else had we known it would be over an hour.

I would say it ruined the experience. Also too forever to get the bill and then even longer to get our card back.

text: I just ordered wings, fries, and a chicken caesar salad. Wings and fries were good. The Caesar dressing with some green wilted romaine was not good. Like, at all! Folks... stick with the unhealthy things like wings and fries because what should have been a healthier option was gross. Totally disappointed.

text: Overpriced but fun. Only had drinks here (Cyclone, Hurricane, and vodka with lemonade). All came with way too much ice and sugary drink mix, and not enough liquor. Service is mediocre. The ambience is fantastic, esp by the water fountain with the torch in it, and the space heaters work perfectly.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: This was a very touristy stop but we had a nice dinner and drinks. Nothing special about the food but it came out hot and it was good for the price. Very friendly waitress though the hostess upstairs had zero personable skills for customers,yet gave one of the busboys her undivided attention.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Pizza
text: I ordered the greek salad.It was horrible.The cucumbers were bitter and not fresh.Can anyone tell them that greek salad is not only plate full of tomatoes and lots and lots olive oil.The pickle was bitter too. Worst experience ever.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Diners, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Mary's Kountry Kitchen is a unique place to dine in and they also have carry-out. I have dined in two places and the staff is pleasant. The atmosphere is old fashion nostalgia and the food is very good for price. Hearty and tasty. Breakfast and Lunch is what I get carry-out for work. A little short on staff between 6 - 7am, but I will go back.

place_category: Pizza, Soup, American (New), Restaurants, Salad
text: I have always like Crushed Red but the last few times the salads are just sub par. To much lettuce stalk and not enough lettuce. Salad was kinda watery and the Caesar dressing needs an upgrade. They also need a way for you to get everything to your table with out making two or three trips from the counter. If you get a soup, salad and a drink you can't carry that all at once.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars
text: I thought they had a creative selection of bacon and bacon food derivatives.. probably not the best place if you're looking for a Kosher / Halal restaurant because even the vodka is bacon infused. Try the chocolate dipped bacon hot.. It was pretty interesting.. I was a little bummed that they were out of the Kurabota bacon, but it's a sign to me that a lot of the bacon is cooked fresh. They have great sandwiches and breakfast foods made from bacon too. check it out.

place_category: Local Flavor, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Pizza, Salad
text: Pretty decent pizza, pretty terrible customer service. I just ordered a large so cal, tried to substitute one toping on half, and was told my total was 5 dollars extra, double the cost of any topping they have. When I questioned this i was put on hold for a minute or two, and still charged an extra two bucks with no explanation, I decided to just pay it as opposed to deal more with the order taker that I had already been on the phone with for 5 minutes. Pretty insane.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: We really enjoyed the food but it was on the expensive side for what we got. Service was ok, but a little slow. Overall, it was OK.

place_category: Restaurants, Donuts, Coffee & Tea, Food, Fast Food
text: I have to say the manager at this Dunkin' Donuts (Michelle) is an absolute professional in every sense of the word. She has gone above and beyond to correct a quality issue and made sure I as a customer was 100% completely satisfied. And sent me off happy and with a fresh free cup of coffee to my liking. An absolute professional!

place_category: Tacos, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Fast Food, Mexican
text: The service was really nice but I asked for NO tomatoes and they added tomatoes on everything. The worst part is one of the tomatoes on my taco is something someone should never eat, a bad tomato! I didn't even ask for tomatoes so to have a bad one on there is strange. I will never eat here again.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Just finished eating a burrito bowl with Chili Verde, black and refried beans, rice, cabbage, pico, fresh jalapeños, and fresh avocado, then doused with copious hot sauce! This was a great brunch!! A jewel of a find in the Reno area!! They have a large hot sauce collection to add more heat. Very reasonable price for fresh and tasty food. If you like spicy food, this is your place. My wife, who does not like spicy food, also enjoyed her meal.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Restaurants
text: Love Stanley! Food is great, service was awesome. StFf is attentive. Right in the heart of the Quarter.

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants, Peruvian, Seafood
text: How is this place in Tampa?! And Carrollwood of all places?! Food is amazing and service is great!!!

place_category: Southern, Seafood, Burgers, Restaurants
text: The Jambalya was cold and tasted like it was Chef Boyardee. I would not recommend this place. DEFINITELY NOT WORTH THE LONG WAIT

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Great place to grab some quick food. They could use some music in the background, way to quiet...somewhat awkward. Salsa of every heat, so you can't go wrong with salsa selection. There was an upcharge for flour tortillas, not sure if $2.50 was justified from corn tortillas. If you get chip and salsa, separate charge...you will get your money's worth.

place_category: American (Traditional), Chinese, Restaurants
text: Called to make a delivery and refused to deliver to us and we were only 6 miles away. They've delivered to us before so I was PISSED when they said they wouldn't deliver Super inconvenience

place_category: Restaurants, German
text: The establishment is clean and well kept, nothing fancy. Faux wood panelling and pictures/postes of Germany; beer steins on theh wall as others have said. There was no 'menu' per se, just our choice of the three combination plates they offer. We asked for a menu from the waitress, but she said that was it; which kinda bummed my wife as she really wanted the rouladen. The food was good, nothing fantastic or spectacular as was the dessert.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Chinese, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Caterers, Noodles, Vietnamese
text: Okay, I need to try what Ernie and Wan tried... because after trying #1 (pho w/everything) and the steamed vermicelli w/ beef lemongrass and veggies, I wasn't too impressed. The pho broth was good, but the temperature wasn't hot enough for me to really enjoy the flavor. As for the beef vermicelli salad, the noodles were overcooked and stuck together and I couldn't quite mix the components up. Good, not great. I'll give it a second try though!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Don't order the garlic & rice, I mean, shrimp and snow peas! I love garlic, but it was so overwhelming in the dish that it was not edible. I've been here many times before and never had such a horrible dish. It was take out and I called to let them know it was bad, she suggested it was because I don't like garlic. Wrong. Totally missed the point. You lost a customer.

place_category: Fast Food, American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Ordered salad through drive through today. The service was great and the girl working drive thru was friendly but when I got home with the salad it was not very appealing. Just a blah salad. Not much color and lacking on the ingredients. Needless to say I was bummed. I was thinking for the price it would've been a better quality. Oh well. Live and learn.

place_category: Live/Raw Food, Restaurants, Seafood, Beer Bar, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Bars, Food, Nightlife
text: Great location, friendly staff but food, meh. The guy making the food was a professional but the taste was lacking. Worth the trip but probably won't be going back for many reasons but mainly, other options. Cheers

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Gluten-Free, Cafes, Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: If you are looking for a healthy breakfast and lunch choice, A&M Factory is on point.

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Breweries, Restaurants, American (New), Pizza
text: I can't believe I came here twice in a day, different locations of course. My friend and I came here for dinner. I had wings and fries. Nothing to complain about. Good portions.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Food, Diners, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts, Sandwiches
text: I been here many times with my kids for breakfast . Food is away on point , if you guys can get the service to speed up a little it would be better . Staff is always friendly. I would of given a 5 star but just have to get the service to speed up a little other than that you guys are excellent

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Chicken Wings, Pubs, Pizza, Beer Bar, Restaurants
text: Have had downtown location multiple times before and loved it. Was underwhelmed by this Fishers location takeout experience. The Large Supreme pan pizza was like a loaf of bread. It was way too much bread, it was thicker than a good Chicago style pizza, but not nearly as good. Not enough sauce either. Will be last time getting food from this location. Either the Pearl Street brand is declining Or this location not living up to Downtown location expectations.

place_category: Restaurants, Buffets, Southern
text: My boyfriend was really hyping this place up. It's a breakfast buffet. Honestly, the food was just alright. It wasn't the great southern food I expected. The grits didn't have much flavor and the fried green tomatoes were hard. You would think that a southern buffet would have some interesting items, but this place was soooo standard. Also, if you take more food than you eat they will charge you for the uneaten food.

place_category: Pakistani, Indian, Restaurants
text: I have only been there for lunch, but their buffet is AWESOME. Never had to wait and their wait staff does a great job keeping your water glass full. Note : Coupons available at Coupons4Indy.com

place_category: Tacos, Mexican, Nightlife, Bars, Tex-Mex, Restaurants
text: Always amazing food although Mexican always my fave. Waitress did say pitcher was 6 drinks which we knew could not be true and was only 3.5 drinks so save ur money as just mediocre margarita with too much ice therefore less margaritas. We were at Carmel location. Was busy so again be patient.

place_category: Latin American, Restaurants
text: Very bad service which is funny considering we had at least three servers that were "helping" us. Our food arrived before our silverware. They told me my entree came with rice on the side but it did not. Chicken- just two heavily seasoned pieces of chicken. Plain plate. Tuna steak- good flavor but again, plain dish with a handful of greens thrown on the plate.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: I went back here and either I didn't remember the prices (because someone else had paid last time) or their prices had gone up. It was almost $20 for 2 basic sushi rolls!! While the portions are big, they aren't filling enough to justify such a high price for 2 rolls for lunch. Will not be coming back at those prices.

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Caterers, Salad, American (Traditional), Spanish, Comfort Food, Food, Southern, Breakfast & Brunch, Desserts
text: Service is very slow, the first time I experienced slow service at this location, I dismissed it because Cracker Barrel's in general are wonderful. Today is the second time we've experienced bad service. Food has taken (on a Friday morning at 11) literally 30 minutes and our server blamed the kitchen having "training". Several tables seated after our four top were served their food before us.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Seafood
text: Meh. Service and decor were good. Food just so so. Had oysters and crab cakes. Nothing was bad, just didn't sing. Martini was good

place_category: Indian, Restaurants, Himalayan/Nepalese
text: Ordered dinner from here once. Everything tasted ordinary. The samosas were good and the bi bim bop was not bad either.

place_category: Restaurants, Korean, Barbeque
text: Great lunch for five. We chose to order Galbi ribs, Bibimbap, and a couple of chicken bowls. Kids and adults enjoyed bright clean flavored. Don't go for a 20 minute lunch, because it won't happen. This is food that takes time to prepare as well as to eat.

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, Food Trucks, American (New), Food
text: The worst service I've received in my life. My food sat for over 10 minutes before it came to the table. We never got napkins and to top it off it was completely wrong from the order I placed. Worst place to visit on a vacation I highly discourage anyone from coming here

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: V.good wonton soup, but use ground pork, nicely flavored. NO sliced pork strip OR scallions. EXCELLENT broth. Wonderful General Tso's Chicken, Chicken w/Snow Peas, but does not put snow peas in their lo mein.

place_category: Barbeque, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Fantastic Q. Extensive menu and honest folks. I spent 300 bucks and got way too much great food for my last party. I have leftovers in my freezer that just keep getting better and better. The meat can be frozen and placed in a double boiler for better than the first time eats. This is the real deal for Q. It's not perfect mall food. It's Q. It's real food and real happy people trying to earn an honest living. Reggie and company have the absolutely finest family business. I'll be back.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: Starbucks. The usual sort. A seriously crappy parking lot kinda sucks the awesome out of the joint, and I'm not a fan of the velvet chairs (the leather on S Howard is superior) And the phalanx of loser smokers out front kinda ruins the entry... but thats everywhere these days, so I can't blame Starbucks for idiot addicts killing themselves... Friendly and helpful staff make it all OK. :-)

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Local Services, Southern, Soul Food, Food, Restaurants, Community Service/Non-Profit, Food Delivery Services
text: A place to get a stick to your ribs meal and a very reasonable price and help some kids out in the process. The food is accpetable and sometimes quite good. The service is always with a smile. Love visiting this place and I continue to go back. Very light on the wallet also

place_category: Seafood, Fast Food, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Restaurants
text: This has got to be the worst Popeyes Chicken ever!?!? We ALWAYS say we are not going back... chicken is never ready..always a wait ..no matter what time of day it is.. I liked the strips until today... dry, cold, horrible.. needs new management.. never ever again will they get us.. KFC or MCL from now on..SAD

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food
text: Best ice cream I think I've ever had. If you're looking for awesome, unique flavors, this is the place. And not to mention how great the service is- the owners are equally awesome. I had the blueberry basil and the blimey- both are super good. And I tried their strawberry cheesecake and banana pudding as well- really really good.

text: We had the Veterans meal plank salmon skimpy on veggies. Shrimp scampi not worth mentioning. I am from New England so the clam chowder had a lot to live up too I give it a 4 out of 5. The chocolate box was the best. Like creme fraiche fruit in chocolate shaped box. Silk pie was good according to my daughter. Her crab cakes were delish the cole slaw was bland though.

place_category: American (New), Chicken Shop, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Restaurants
text: If you expect even average service do not come to Bacon Bitch. We sat at a table for 15 minutes and not one waiter/waitress even offered us a glass of water. I asked for assistance several times and only received, "they'll be right there." The restaurant was not busy. Staff stands around talking with each other. No one pays attention to the paying customer. When we finally got up to leave, they didn't care at all. Don't come here.

place_category: Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food Trucks, Bars, Burgers, Nightlife, Chicken Wings, Chicken Shop, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Service with NeNe was great! The food was over priced. My dad got the Wings On The Bone and the menu says "Six JUMBO applewood smoked chicken wings, flavored to your liking." Although you actually get average size wings. The menu is miss leading. We mention this to the server and she after only being here for 2 wks was unable to give an explanation. I had Thighs On Texas Toast which was good. My father doesn't plan to come back, because he thought the food was average. I am undecided.

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Piano Bars
text: If you stop in a souvenir gift shop in NOLA you are more likely to find a hurricane drink mix made by Pat OBriens. The hype on the drink is over the top. Completely unaware of the tourist hype at the time, I stopped in for a hurricane and thought, "zzzzzz....my hotel bar could do better."

place_category: Shopping, Department Stores, Grocery, Fashion, Food, Electronics, Furniture Stores, Home & Garden
text: This Target is way better than the Walmart down the street. It's clean. The staff is ok. There's not usually long lines. Not much more I can ask for. Of course it has its problems but its pretty good.

place_category: Restaurants, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Comfort Food, American (New), Sandwiches, Nightlife, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Love this restaurant. Have gone to 2 locations. Food & service are great. My favorite is the duck. Pastries are yummy but get there early as they sell out.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Not one of my favorite Italian spots. I'm not sure if they had a different chef that night, but the food I ordered wasn't very good. Spaghetti was more watery than ever. But our service was pretty good, and she was very nice and didn't rush us to hurry up and order.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: Aaaaaamazing!!! My new favorite Italian restaurant! Doesn't even compare to Olive Garden. Authentic great food. Their steaks are great and the chicken stuffed spinach and cheese with Alfredo was to die for. We will definitely be going back!

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars
text: Love going to Nicks roast at Katie O's except the live music on Friday nights. Can't even have a conversation with the people you're with it's so load in there and never a crowd listening. We would definitely be going there more if there wasn't live music all the way past midnight!

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: Not a big recommendation here. Service was spotty and prices were high. Started out with oysters Rockefeller they were covered in cheese wiz! They were awful! Should have gone with the raws. Our main was the blackened Mahi with gulf shrimp. It was good. Glad we split it. Was the perfect amount for 2 with a baked potato. Highlight was the corn fritter! A bit of powdered sugar and honey finished the meal nicely. Just really wish the service and the oysters were better.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: 0 Stars if I could. I ordered through Door Dash and I will never do that again. The meat fell out of the pot stickers and looked like they were originally filled with rotting meat. I ordered 3 orders and could not even eat one pot sticker. Worst Chinese food i've had in STL.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Food
text: Flavor! Flavor! Flavor! This very small restaurant has limited seating and is quaint, but the food is beyond good. My wife and I had four different flavored tacos for lunch there with guacamole and chips. Best fish tacos ever and I have been to bigger places with reps. Hands down, a great treat for a lunch outing or take out for home. Don't go expecting ambiance of comfort. Go for the sabor.

place_category: American (Traditional), Steakhouses, Nightlife, Bars, Seafood, Restaurants, Lounges
text: Marmont is the reason I will never try a new place with out yelping. My guest and I got 2 plates of friends and one steak (I already ate by accident) and the tab was $80. Also, the waitress brought out my check before my company or myself requested this. We felt rushed and this was kind of unprofessional. As for the food. The fries were oily. Never again :)

place_name: The Ultimate Bake Shoppe of Ardmore
place_category: Specialty Food, Restaurants, Desserts, Bakeries, Food, Health Markets, Coffee & Tea
text: MINI CAKES! THEY ARE SO GOOD! This bakery is located in the Ardmore Farmers Market in Suburban Square. They have a plethora of cookies. From festive designs to standards to cartoon characters. The cookies are a bit pricey. They sell mini and full-sized cakes. Did I mention the mini cakes are good? They're usually packed with customers, so get to the front, catch a staff member's eye, and place your order!

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Ahhhh... the gumbo combo platter is not good. Dont try this. I recommend Royal House. The restaurant is very nice but food is OK.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Cafes, Coffee & Tea
text: This place is very cool and has potential. Great ice cream and drink options. My issue is the staff. Not very friendly at all. I was there for 1 hour and observed them being super friendly to the "hipster" customers but those who came not dressed to the atmosphere were treated completely different. Very disappointing.

place_category: Restaurants, Japanese
text: Pretty good sush, but not great, which is why I'm only giving 4 stars. Not a bad second choice to Morimoto. The Saki flights are a great way to try different kinds, without buying a whole cup. The Philadelphia roll here is pretty good.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Everything was just "ok". A very basic unimpressive restaurant. No reason to choose this over any other pizzaria. It's quite lame. Could be- should be a lot better. Ordered eggplant sub and buffalo fingers.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Asian Fusion, Chicken Wings, Korean
text: Way too expensive compared to cafe soho. And much smaller, only limited choices. Cafe soho is way better compared to this place.

place_category: Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Dance Clubs, Bars, Music Venues, Mexican, Sports Bars
text: Bad, Bad, Bad....3 times had to ask for water, waited 40 minutes for food and it was not the what we asked for- waitress blamed the kitchen - whatever...do not waste your time ...I am sure if you want to get drunk the two for ones are a deal.

place_category: Barbeque, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: A girlfriend of mine had a Groupon type thing and invited me to try this place. Our waitress was very sweet but that is about all the compliment I can muster. The food was sub par (pizza, tempura asparagus, fries)and I don't think there was a drop of alcohol in my drink. We were the only people in the place when we arrived and it took about 10 minutes to get our first drink. The outdoor area has potential but I probably won't go back...no reason to with so many other options in no-libs.

place_category: Juice Bars & Smoothies, American (New), Cafes, Food, Comfort Food, Desserts, Restaurants, Canadian (New), Coffee & Tea, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Came across this place through yelp and all the amazing reviews! And man O man, does it ever deliver! I mean their team was on the ball from the get-go! We were seated promptly, ordered a few beverages and followed up with our meals! Which I got to say, though simple; it sure tasted alot like heaven. I plan on returning here with my fiancé to just sit down and feast on their menu offerings. The atmosphere, food and people were great, can't complain. Planning on a second visit very soon.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Stopped in for lunch and was not disappointed. The staff was attentive and my food arrived quickly. Carne Asada with rice and a salad. The grilled jalapeño with the wonderfully flavored carne asada is a great touch. Just enough heat to bring out the flavor and not overpowering. If your in Victorian Square in Sparks you should give them a try. Certainly Not your typical Mexican fare. And they have a bar!

place_category: Halal, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern
text: This will be my third time ever going to a Halal Guys, but my second time at this location. The service is not as good as a few weeks back, the food was put together a lot better though. One thing I'd like to note is, I am well aware of how hot the hot sauce is. I eat very spicy, I see the hesitation when I say fire away, but momma ain't raise no bitch, I eat really hot. Had to add hot sauce when I got home. Just keep firing away, please. I mean other than that, my experience wasn't bad.

place_category: Venues & Event Spaces, American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Breweries
