text: Terrible from service to food and beer was okay but not cold! I ordered pizza and it had a nasty taste so I sent it back and got an under cooked soft pretzel. I would recommend avoiding this place as there are plenty of other choices in the area.

place_category: Belgian, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: This is the second time the 8th and walnut location has ran out of hot cocoa. For a company that calls themselves "daily bread," you should have at least have the daily essentials of any bakery/coffee shop.

place_category: Salad, Pizza, American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants
text: Delicious Wish they offer small size like a personal pizza for myself. I travel and my body size is petite. Too much pizza for me but the taste is so good I asked for box to go twice They brought me wAter and didn't fill up more

place_category: Pubs, Bars, Irish Pub, Irish, American (New), American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife
text: This was my first visit to McCreary's. I am from Buffalo and I was looking for somewhere that had real good food but not a chain restaurant. It was all that I was looking for. I ate the fish and chips and it was delicious. Big selection of bottled beer.

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Food, Specialty Food, Italian, Thai, Comfort Food, American (New), Fast Food, Mediterranean, Noodles, Salad, Pasta Shops
text: Horrible beyond words. I was STARVING and it was still so bad I couldn't eat the "pad Thai" with chicken. Waffle House has better food--I knew I was making a mistake when the place was EMPTY at 6 pm. NEVER AGAIN!

place_category: American (Traditional), Southern, Food, Buffets, Restaurants
text: We are at a conference and saw this as we were looking for a department store. So glad we decided to try it. It feels like you're at Grandmothers house. The food is really good and a good variety. The salad was very fresh also. The owner has a beautiful story of her life, also. I feel like I've had an enjoyable meal.

place_category: Custom Cakes, Food, Bakeries
text: I had a cake specially sculptured and needed it in a very short deadline. All was done over the phone and strongly suggest you do it in person to get a better idea of size. The outcome was awesome. I requested Carrot cake and I must say I have had better thus only giving a three star for the quality versus

place_category: Cafes, Food, Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Coffee Roasteries, Restaurants
text: I'll have to try Elixr again for the coffee before making up my mind, but I'm more of a tea person...and I was really turned off that their $4 chai tea latte was just milk with a splash of the same Oregon Chai mix that I buy in stores. At least add your own spices or something...felt gypped. Atmosphere is good for doing work, but barstool chairs aren't very comfortable.

place_category: Nightlife, Comfort Food, Restaurants, American (New), American (Traditional), Soul Food, Southern, Bars, Beer Bar, Sandwiches
text: In town for a conference and chose to come here on our finial night in town. We ordered the party meal that is $16 per person and included chicken, salad, mac and cheese, and spoon bread. The food was very all good and the outdoor patio was nice. Would recommend if stopping through Indy.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Food, Salad, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Pizza, Breweries
text: Food was very good. Staff was polite and our order was ready for pick up at the time that it said it would be. Food was very flavorful and the portions were large. I got the Penniwise and cheese sticks. Enough food to last for 3 meals. Wayyy worth it!

place_category: Restaurants, Donuts, Coffee & Tea, Food
text: I love this spot the one in the French Quarter is always busy and you can run into lines from time to time but the place is always great customer service and quick no long line's.

place_category: Restaurants, Cafes, American (New), Italian
text: Hostesses were dressed inappropriate. Horrible service. Average food for such a high price. This place used to have some class back in the day. Now it's just trashy. The only thing keeping it open is the location.

place_category: Bars, Active Life, Restaurants, Nightlife, Golf, American (New), Sports Bars, Food
text: Fingers crossed this place lowers their prices soon! I really wish this place would have opened in the summer like the website said for months. All well. This location so far is great and their staff is really on top of their stuff. The management here is way better than their Edison location. Please keep up the good work!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian
text: Absolutely the best pizza in the area. People working there are friendly and happy to serve you. Salad is beyond great. All fresh ingredients and the best dressing. Pizza incredible. A must go to place. Next time will try the cannoli I heard it is great.

place_category: Korean, Restaurants
text: This place has a great Yelp reviews, but after having dinner here I would not give it four-star at all. We ordered the Daily specials of Shrimp Pancake and Japchae. The Pancake served with six tiny slices at $6.95 was pretty pricy and could not really taste any shrimp inside. Japchae does not have any protein and it was priced at $9.95. The rest of the party ordered Beef Bibimap, and it was decent. Overall, the food here was over-prices for what they served.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Fast Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Tacos, Tex-Mex
text: A big no for me. It lacks cleanliness and when I was there the manager had the music in the dining area so loud we had to yell at each other to be heard while we were dining. We asked the cashier if they could turn the music down a bit. She asked the lady manager and then told us that the manager told her if they don't like it to bad! Who does that but a stupid store manager? Also, the music was old off-tune Jazz of all things.

place_category: Farmers Market, Specialty Food, Food
text: Nice homemade jams and spreads. Nothing extra added other than natural ingredients. Nice products, but don't expect them to be cheap.

place_category: Arts & Entertainment, Restaurants, Skating Rinks, Festivals, Shopping, Food Stands, Public Markets, Active Life
text: Fun, German-themed Christmas market. Reminiscent of a renaissance fair, there are lots of shops to buy authentic, German wares (some even imported directly from Germany specifically for this event). The food is really great, too. It's a bit crowded because the ice rink takes up a bulk of the space, and the lines for food are quite long. There isn't much to see/do besides buy things, so it's probably not something we'll do again; once you've seen it, you've seen it.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Asian Fusion, Japanese
text: Nice atmosphere, clean; service was OK. The food itself was uninspiring. The sushi we ordered didn't seem fresh - the teriyaki chicken seemed like someone has just poured some grocery store sauce over some steamed (ewww) chicken and plated it with 1/2 a pound of broccoli. Definitely edible - but probably won't return.

place_category: Restaurants, Greek
text: BEST EVER! My family has been going here for decades! Ive sneaked around a bit and "tried" others but ALWAYS come back here to the best gyro known to man. Just the idea, makes me tell hubby to prepare for lunch here tomorrow. Mouth watering thoughts...thanks! Will update w photos.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea, Pizza
text: Very awesome spot and waitress was extremely polite and recommended some gems. Milk and Honey latte is fantastic and she recommended with Almond Milk and it was great! Brunch menu is super good and the vibe was very cool. I'll come here again for sure on my next visit to Nashville!

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Desserts, Food, Restaurants, Burgers, Comfort Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Cocktail Bars, American (Traditional)
text: Awful game day experience. Female manager berated me and my guest while trying to watch Bucs game. Refused to turn on Bucs game on bar tv. I drove from Sarasota to see the game here. We left as did a party of 7 who had kids there to watch. Not family friendly. Plenty of better options and I don't appreciate being spoken to condescendingly because it seemed the staff wanted to watch a game of the Bears and ignored patrons who actually came to see their local team play.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Burgers
text: Service is a little slow every time I come in. Not like the original one in Sharon Pennsylvania. But the taste is still there, plus got a 10% discount for being on yelp.

place_category: Steakhouses, Bars, Barbeque, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: My coworkers and I came here for lunch and it was great! The place was very clean, everyone wore masks, they had the tables separated and I felt very safe. I loved the Wood Grilled Chicken, loaded baked potato, Country Style Buttermilk Chicken, and the cinnamon apples. The staff was super friendly and accommodating.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Sushi Chef Brus is great at making sashimi!!! Really the tastiest I had in Indiana. This place is new!! What a gem to find in the mid-west!!!! And the beer... OMG. ONE DOLLAR ONLY!?!!!!!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: I can't say enough good things about this location. The staff are super great people and they do a great job. I actually drive farther just to go to this location.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: I wish I could say something good but oh my! So bland...cheap ingredients...just not a good choice of a Mexican food restaurant.

place_category: Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch, Cajun/Creole, Cafes, Food, Restaurants, Donuts
text: Loved the outdoor seating with a jazz band playing....really great NOLA atmosphere. We had breakfast there with a side of beignets. The breakfast was unremarkable and the beignets weren't so great compared to Cafe Du Monde.

place_name: South Of Chicago Pizza & Italian Beef
place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Italian
text: I'm sorry but this place won't be in business long, pizza is greasy and very blah. Got the breadsticks too and they are nothing fancy greasy sticks with no breadstick look to them. Jackamoes, jacks and bobs to your door is the place to go... I am sorry I will not be coming back

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian, Salad
text: Went here to get a couple of slices. They only had 2 choices otherwise I would have had to have waited 30 minutes for the pesto pizza. Should have had more pizza out. Still the best pizza in Reno but it's so out of the way for me to drive here.

place_category: Fast Food, Burgers, Restaurants
text: Good cheeseburgers ! But the fries and fry sauce ? Through the roof delicious!!!! Looks like a sketchy place but you go through the drive thru and they offer excellent food :)

place_category: Burgers, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Pizza
text: Good, greasy, basic pizza - a little expensive for what it is. Plus they sell gelato, subs & salads. I had a single slice with spinach (very good spinach topping by the way) for $3.25 to go. BIG parking lot and a large bar.

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese
text: This is a solid place, I do not get why it has only 3 starts. I mean not the best Chinese food you will ever eat but is what you would expect, again solid option for delivery and take out. Good price and a lot of food.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Donuts, Food
text: This was my first time experience a beignet. I had high hopes but I wasn't impressed. Just tasted like a funnel cake with a pound of powdered sugar. They should of asked if I wanted any beignets with my powdered sugar. I'm planning on exploring New Orleans again to find a better quality beignet.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: Went through the drive thru and got lukewarm food. The breakfast sandwich--which was supposed to be on grilled bread was soggy at most, and cold, not to mention not grilled at all! The sandwich was squished together and lacking. Not to mention the hash browns that were supposed to be with order--non existent in the bag. Definitely not what we paid for! Skip this joint and go to a better place their service has just gotten worse each time we end up going there!

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Best pizza in the world! I live in Boston and crave this pizza daily. Me and my family have been in love with Kate & Al's our whole lives! You MUST stop here if in the area!

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Pizza, Italian, Chicken Wings
text: Always consistent and never had an issue with the quality. Inexpensive and prompt with delivery.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants, Italian
text: This is great for pizza! If anything, get the margarita pizza! My family goes there ever Sunday because on Sunday, it's free salad night! And they have great customer service! The only thing is on crowded nights, the parking is bad. But all in all, it is most certainly a 5 star review!

place_category: Specialty Food, Food, Chocolatiers & Shops, Desserts, Shopping, Gift Shops, Candy Stores, Flowers & Gifts
text: Very yummy place to go into...lots of tempting sugar treats! Service was pleasant, selection was endless! I got taffy that ended up sticking to the waxed paper & losing a good portion of goodness, bummer. The pralines were dry, almost grainy in comparison to samples offered at so many other shoppes. Their taffy apples looked divine, unfortunately we hadn't purchased any. What I did get & loved were the milk chocolate covered marshmallows on a stick for $2.95!

place_category: Food Trucks, Restaurants, Street Vendors, Food, Mexican
text: The fish tacos here are SO good. That's it for me though. Everything else is so-so. The service is just ok and the wait after you order is always too long. Half the time my order is messed up (and it's nothing complicated, I literally only order fish tacos) with sauce missing, or very skimpy on fish. I have had only bad experiences picking up a to-go order. The prices went up again recently, so i'll probably only be going back here if I'm desperate.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Pubs, Nightlife, Bars, Irish, Food
text: I can't say enough good thinks about this place! Friendly service, unique and romantic atmosphere, delicious food and the largest Belgian beer menu in Delaware. If you can find room, sit at the bar and be in awe of their awesome whiskey selection. Must tries are the cheese board, the shepherds pie and the peach cobbler!! Don't worry about the calories. You can walk it off afterward while strolling the cobblestone streets and historic cemetery's of Old New Castle.

place_category: Pubs, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, American (Traditional), Irish
text: This was our first time there. The food was ok. We had the Shepard's pie, which was alright kinda just basic. The Rueben rolls were pretty good. My wife had the fish and chips. We ordered our 2 year olds meal first and an appetizer. ALL our food came at the same time:( appetizer and meals all at once. Service not so good. And it was pretty pricey for just run of the mill food. I would go back to try a Reuben and a burger though.

place_category: Bakeries, American (Traditional), American (New), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Food, Desserts, Cafes
text: Decent food, but I ended up having problems with very bad (apparently malicious) service, likely due to mistaken political assumptions about me. Potentially dangerous place to eat if you don't fall in with right crowd.

place_category: Food, Convenience Stores, Gas Stations, Automotive
text: Very shady gas station with many questionable people hanging out around there probably not the safest gas station and they only accept debit and cash on some transactions

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Bars, Nightlife, Mexican
text: Expensive hipster polluted hangout. Positive: pumps money into Fishtown economy, cliental mostly ride bikes so doesn't really affect neighborhood parking Negative: Pretentious "Cash Only" policy, subpar food, expensive drinks served to you like you should be grateful to be given a can to drink out of

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Food, Desserts, Bakeries, Comfort Food, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Parkway does it right. They are well known so it can get very busy but grab a drink from the bar and wait it out! I almost always get the fried shrimp poboy. It just can't be beat. Don't forget the condiments! There is a condiments cooler near the soda machine. Also, the bar is seat yourself with table service. If the line is long, pop in the bar and look for an open seat, you'll often get lucky.

place_category: Mexican, Bakeries, Restaurants, Food
text: The first time I tried anything from here was at the mexican heritage festival in Soulard. Really great churros, the vanilla ones are my favorite! I also have tried the peach tres leches which was pretty good but I cant say it was the best I've had. I am a huge tres leches fan and this was good but there is still better in St. Louis I have found. I love that its locally owned and I would come back here anytime.

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: The Fork was a pleasant find! Upscale, updated twists on old favorites. Could go there for a casual dinner or special occasion. Service was ok but could have been better at checking in once food delivered and refilling water.

place_category: Pubs, Pizza, Sandwiches, Brewpubs, Beer Gardens, Breweries, Nightlife, Food, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Bars
text: I had no idea a brewery would have such amazing food! In my past experiences they usually offer just a few mediocre items, but daredevil did NOT disappoint for pizza! Got the pretzels and breadsticks with beer cheese so delicious and I am VERY picky with pretzels. Light crunch and very flavorful. Definitely wish I dined in I'm sure it would've tasted even better with a beer

place_category: Food Stands, Chinese, Restaurants
text: this place is so insanely cheap! the mapo topu is under $4 bucks, and it is probably the only decent thing on the menu. however, as a student, i end up coming here once or twice a semester just because its close and cheap and edible (for the most part). if im in the mood for really cheap chinese food, ill eat here. otherwise, ill pay up and go to sangkee.

place_category: Restaurants, Tacos, Latin American, Bars, Mexican, Breakfast & Brunch, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife
text: It's honestly not that great, the only thing they have going for them is the margarita flight. The food was uninspiring and just bland. The atmosphere was alright but the prices set high expectations for quality. Blanco is a way better restaurant both in regards to drink and food and atmosphere. Reforma has the same prices as Blanco but fails to be at the level of Blanco

place_category: Donuts, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Worlds slowest drive through. And once you are in line you can't bail. Do not make the mistake of stopping here.

place_category: Food, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Coffee & Tea
text: Great flavors, but the mix-ins were a little limited in selection. It's easy to go overboard and load your cup so full that you have a six-dollar bowl of great frozen yogurt. Be careful. Mass Ave parking meters are now in effect on Saturdays and until 9 p.m. They were only handing out warnings when I was there, but I got one.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Wine Tours, Food, Tours, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: We went to wine country looking to learn the basics about great wine and the wine making process and found Wine Edventures through yelp. All the reviews were right on.. Great guide who were very knowledgeable. The wineries all had a great selection of wines to taste and each place had very friendly staff. Overall My girlfriend and I found exactly what we were looking for.

place_category: Discount Store, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Shopping
text: Stop trying to rip off customers Joe Canal's. $800-$850 over MSRP. You guys are price gauging your customers. It's disgraceful and pathetic!

place_category: Restaurants, Sandwiches, Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Bakeries
text: Food is amazing definitely try the pecan pancakes if you have a sweet tooth ! Food :5/5 Cleanliness:5/5 Service :5/5 Attitude:5/5

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: I was the only customer and with four workers here, they couldn't bring my food to me when I chose to eat here. Not great service, but good makes up for it. Good, could be ideally priced a couple dollars cheaper, and not the nicest atmosphere inside

place_category: Tiki Bars, American (New), Bars, Food, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Local Flavor, Restaurants
text: Beautiful view, limited but decent drink selection, service is pretty crummy, bad music constantly detracting from the scenery.

place_category: Casinos, Hotels, Arts & Entertainment, American (New), Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Hotels & Travel
text: We had prime rib, a petite filet, and a ribeye steak... And all of the things that come with those and everything was amazing! The prime rib melted in your mouth and we had enough extra left over from our dinners to have breakfast tomorrow and lunch! We also tried the bananas Foster and shrimp cocktail ... The shrimps were gigantic!

place_category: Falafel, Mediterranean, Salad, Middle Eastern, Restaurants
text: They always treat me right, friendly customer service. The guy always hooks it up with a bit extra meat compared to most Naf Nafs I go to. I eat this once a week during lunch at least!

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Diners, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Large menu and great food. Reuben was excellent,very tasty and very good rye bread. Cream of chicken soup was good also, almost ordered a second bowl. Friendly and professional staff.

place_category: Restaurants, Barbeque, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Burgers, Seafood, Sports Bars
text: Worst experience ever. If this is the first Hooters then it's hard to believe that this one could stay in business much less branch out. We received our appetizer and drinks and then nothing. Finally took our meal order but left us thirsty for 30 min. Ask for the manager but was told she was only one person and was busy in the kitchen. I will never go back. I give it one star only because the app makes you rate at least one

place_category: Restaurants, Italian, Pizza
text: Ok pepperoni pizza. You can tell they slice it super thin to save a penny. Courtesy cup of water was a plus, and the girl behind the counter (who will probably be gone if I went again next week) was friendly.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Brazilian, American (New), French, Asian Fusion
text: A very good meal and service; pleasant atmosphere; extensive drink, cocktail, and wine menu; well worth the money; you get what you pay for! I would recommend this establishment. Everyone should take advantage of this establishment, in my opinion. Whoever approaches me with a question about this establishment will receive my highest recommendation.

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: We called and ask what the wait is and was told there was no wait. Then we arrived and with empty tables and still have a 30 to 45 min wait. The problem is is that you can still sit at the bar and order... So people that have came in after us have ordered and we still don't have a table. I am unable to sit at a tall table because of a leg injury. So ridiculous!

place_category: Cafes, Mexican, Restaurants
text: always turned off by being charged for chips and salsa. that being said, the salsa is pretty good. i'll probably give them another try and write more later.

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: I'm sitting here ready to order for past 10 min. the waitress keeps walking around and serving people who came after me . I'm about to switch locations. horrible .

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: The food took almost an hour to get to us. They gave us complimentary soup that wasn't too great to keep us pre-occupied while our food was still being prepared. Other than the long wait to get our food, the waiter was extremely friendly and was on top of refilling our service bread (which was my favorite part of the whole dinner). The pasta we ordered was the handmade pasta with marinara sauce and basil. It was pretty good, but not worth the wait.

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood, Bars, Salad, Tapas/Small Plates, Nightlife
text: Main course was good I had tge NY strip my wife had shrimp. Only starch offered was mashed potatoes or rice. My wife's salad was full of brown spots and they will charge you a 1.50 for blue cheese dressing. It wasn't what I expected but wasn't bad

place_category: Chinese, Asian Fusion, Indian, Restaurants, Thai
text: I was with a group of five and we enjoyed our meal. I had the butter chicken and it was very tasty. The Samosa and corn toast appetizers were both delicious. Our server was very polite and the chef came out to introduce himself at the end of our meal. Recommend

place_category: Sandwiches, Vegan, Restaurants, Pizza, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Let me start this by saying I'm not the biggest pizza fan. I enjoy all of the non traditional style pizza's. That being said, I got the BBQ chicken pizza and it just wasnt very good. The chicken was bland, pepperoni's were slightly blackened, the bell peppers still crunchy, and the bbq sauce was sub par as well as the crust being really thin and lacking flavor.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Love this place!!! Servers are all so sweet to you! Food is so good! Best breakfast/lunch spot around!

place_category: German, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Venues & Event Spaces, Nightlife, Bars, Beer Gardens
text: Visited during a large holiday bar crawl but found that the bar area wasn't super crowded. Highly disappointed and surprised that the service was slow and somewhat rude. Decent drink specials. If you need some bar food - the chex mix is very good. I do not recommend the pretzels though as they tasted like they were nuked in the microwave from the freezer. Hard to believe since it's a German restaurant.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Asian Fusion, Sandwiches, Seafood, Steakhouses
text: 2 weeks new. Needs a bit more time on the presentation. Seafood fresh - limited menu. Good wait staff

place_category: Delis, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Food, Bakeries
text: Husband and I bought two sandwiches and a few bakery goodies. Not overly impressed. Sandwiches and goodies were ok. Nothing like OMG, lemme run out and get something from this place. I may give this place another try soon as I like to see small businesses succeed in hernando county.

place_category: Gastropubs, Restaurants
text: Excellent beer menu with much more than your typical IPA's. Food was not nearly as good as I remember from my first visit about 2-3 years ago.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: We stopped here after a day of golf. It was a smaller place than expected, but so nice inside! Very friendly staff!! Food came out promptly and was very good! We had soft shell crab- very good! Soup was wonderful as well!

place_category: Seafood, Soup, Restaurants, Chinese
text: This is your typical Chinese American food place. I am part Chinese and know real Chinese food. There is a few real Chinese dishes you can get but they are not on the menu and if you know the owner they will make it for you. The service is always excellent though and the owner is friendly and usually knows your order when you come in. Very clean as well. The other thing is most Chinese places have their own recipes and this one does have a special general tsos tofu that is excellent.

place_category: Cheesesteaks, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches
text: Long lines but needed to try one visiting Philly and eat indoors. Not the best but good enough.

place_category: Gluten-Free, Brazilian, Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: The experience was fun but the food was just ok. The glazed ham and filet were the best along with the grilled pineapple. The dessert, chocolate cake, was very disappointing. It was warm only in places like it had been microwaved.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Fast Food, Burgers
text: Ghetto food - sits in my gut like a rock.

place_name: Strawberry Fields Organic Juice and Smoothie Bar
place_category: Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies
text: I have only been twice, but have enjoyed both juice blends I have purchased. The place has a food menu with vegan egg salad...I'm definitely going to be back to try (and maybe update my review!).

place_category: Asian Fusion, Restaurants, Chinese, Vietnamese
text: The pork chops are not like typical Vietnamese pork chops. These were pieces and they just weren't good. The pho soup base reminded me more of a wonton soup. The lo mein wasn't too bad but nothing to write home about.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Overpriced and snobby, but good. What can I say? If you like Bon Iver, herbal infused hoosy-whatses, and transplant hipsters from Brooklyn, it's perfect. If not, you may want to just go to Frothy Monkey.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Pubs, Nightlife, Gastropubs
text: Only reviewing on the atmosphere/bar. This is your standard dive bar. Good beer list but the hipster/I don't really care vibe the bartender had was enough to make me not want to come back. Bathrooms were gross, door didn't lock. When your bathrooms are gross at 2pm, I can only imagine what they're like at 1am. I would never eat here considering how dark it was. If you're going just for a beer, worth checking out.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese
text: love love love. The prices for the quality are on point. The owners are warm and friendly. The young girls who run the show are knowledgeable and sweet!!! Great place for a quick sushi fix!!!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Restaurants, Beer Bar
text: Yummy food, great service. I'm a fan for sure.

place_category: Burgers, Pubs, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Bars, Chicken Wings, Food, Sports Bars, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Barbeque, Pool & Billiards, Shopping, Restaurants
text: Food was not great and they were out of a bunch of options. Went on a Monday for lunch and half of our party bailed before turning in the parking lot. Thought we had stumbled into the bar from Talladega Nights...there's even a stuffed cougar on the wall by the door to keep the giant stuffed marlin company. It wasn't completely tragic, but it wasn't the best.

place_name: Hattie B's Hot Chicken - Nashville West
place_category: Beer Bar, Bars, Southern, Soul Food, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Chicken Wings
text: Three of us went and we collectively tried the Southern, mild and medium. They were all delicious! The firsts two were not spicy at all, the medium had a small kick. Next time I'll try the hot. Mac n' cheese was delicious, potato salad was good, and the black eyed peas were good as well. The atmosphere was calm and relaxed. We'll definitely be returning soon!

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Bakeries, Donuts, American (Traditional), Food, Restaurants, Fast Food
text: The girls at work begged me stop and get donuts... so glad I did. Shop local! I don't know why anyone would still go to Dunkin, they don't even bake on site! This place is fresh, and oh so yummy. Will definitely revisit, but not too often ;) Adorbs place to chill with a good cup of joe!

place_category: Sandwiches, Salad, Mediterranean, Restaurants
text: Delicious! Don't let the outside fool you. Everything is cooked fresh. It takes a little longer but completely worth it.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Restaurants
text: Worth the walk off the beaten path focused on breakfast and it shows. I selected the basic breakfast: eggs, bacon, English muffins, and tasty country potatoes looked similar to other venues but better. Wife French Toast vanilla deliciousness thin country ham and eggs.

place_category: Fast Food, Hot Dogs, Restaurants, Soup, Sandwiches, Delis, Salad
text: Shop was sub par. We weren't greeted when we walked in. Girls carried on a 5 min conversation. Bacon was fatty and salt, angus steak was fatty and chewy. Owner came out and rang us out. He played on his computer. Never asked if we like our food even though we threw out half our subs. Never thanked us for coming. We will not be going back to this place.

place_category: Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch, American (New), Fast Food, Restaurants, Diners, American (Traditional)
text: This place needs a visit from corporate. Pulled up to the drive thru and what do we hear? "just so you know it's going to be about 30min"...so we ask why and are told staffing. So as a reasonably minded man I say they must be packed inside, no problem, and I pull off. Then I saw 6 cars in the parking lot and knew they weren't slammed..the mgr either tried to save some money on staff or they just did their job wrong.

place_category: Salad, Bars, Nightlife, Italian, Restaurants, Wine Bars, Soup
text: We placed a catering order for our employees to celebrate. This order is already a 1/2 hour late. I called and was placed on hold twice with no one picking up I called again and talked to a manager named Anthony, all he could say was sorry, he must have gotten caught in traffic. That was it. I will never never again order from this place. I am still waiting for the order as I am typing this!!

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Nightlife, Bars, Gastropubs, Breweries, Sandwiches, Pubs
text: One of my new favorite places yo eat! The layout of the place is great! The menu is so good! It's a great house cured meats are amazing and my favorite is the bacon Fat candle! The Chef does a great job! The beer is fantastic as well! It a great place to bring family and for s guys night out! Service has always been great too!

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, Music Venues, Nightlife, American (New), Food, Arts & Entertainment
text: its pretty.but i'm not a beer fan. and the food is just ok. it is loud in there. i found myself having to yell to my date. i have been here 3 times. all different experiences. i dont think there is anything wrong with the place. not saying i will or will not go again. i just dont care either way. it didnt leave that much of an impression on me. the bathrooms are cool tho.

place_category: Bakeries, Specialty Food, Food, Pretzels, Hot Dogs, Restaurants
text: This place is AWESOME! I recommend everything nthe white American cheese sauce is really good. My co-workers and I frequently (as in one or two times a week) order a bunch of nuggets with couple things of cheese and lunch is served. Not sure what the negative reviewers are thinking. It's pretzels and cheese. Pretzels are not an artisanal bread with gourmet dipping sauces, as some in west county are expecting. Very affordable, great snack for kids. Dare I say.......better than Gus's.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Cafes, American (New)
text: This place is awesome. Food is great service was spectacular. My husband and I went two days in a row for brunch. Will definitely be returning!!

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea, Bagels, Internet Cafes
text: Great coffee, amazing pastry and delightful atmosphere, featuring disinterested hipster baristas who smile once or twice a week.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Breweries, American (Traditional), Brewpubs
text: Came here with a friend on Friday and had a great meal. I'm not a beer drinker but my friend is and he thoroughly enjoyed the beer he decided upon. For food I got the Mac n' Cheese which had little bits of pancetta in it and was definitely yummy. The Panna Cotta was also very smooth and creamy while still being light - very nicely done! Service was all around fast and friendly so I would definitely come again!

place_category: American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants, Pubs, Nightlife, Local Flavor
text: Apparently, the fish on the menu is not a good choice. Another review cited an "ammonia" smell emanating from her order of fish and chips. Maybe, the Bucks County Health Department should investigate.

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: We ordered lunch with work and it was below mediocre. I ordered General Tso's Chick with "Pork" fried rice. The chicken was ok, they rice doesn't look anything like the pictures online and there's very little pork in there. I tried it a few years ago and didn't like it but thought i'd give it another try and it still disappoints. The only good thing about it was since I didn't finish the rice, I saved a few calories!

place_category: American (New), Bars, Sandwiches, Salad, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Pizza, Sports Bars, Nightlife
text: There's nothing wrong with stopping in at this chain restaurant but don't expect anything out of the ordinary. There was a decent number of TV screens as well, but for a sports bar the staff seemed to have little to no knowledge of what sports were actually on or how to change the channels. If you've got no place better to go it's not bad for a stop, but wouldn't be at the top of my list for places to stop while in town.

place_category: Hotels & Travel, Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, Hotels, Resorts
text: Awesome outdoor atmosphere with a live band. Terrible SLOW service. The worst we've had in Clearwater so far. Mixed drinks were not good AT ALL. We've been to dive bars and ordered cheap vodka that was much better than the "grey goose martini's" we ordered here. This place has potential but with the bad service, we will not be coming back.

place_category: Mexican, Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife
text: Honestly, I was hoping for more. Mexican food can be really competitive space, and I was super excited one was opening up close by. Maybe my expectations were too high. I liked the ambiance and what they have done to the patio area, but the food needs to be revisited with better ingredients and flavor

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: This is an adorable little restaurant and simply delicious! Our table got the Melazane and Burrata as appetizers and the Carbonara, Pappardelle, Salmon, Lasagna and Pollo Angelina for entrees. Everyone was basically licking their plates clean. The owners are literally the nicest people- overall it's a great neighborhood spot! We will absolutely be back!

place_category: Restaurants, Beer Bar, Salad, Burgers, Bars, Nightlife
text: I came to the restaurant opening week and I have been dreaming about how delicious the burger was. This trip I had the pleasure of trying the fried cauliflower, fried zucchini and the beer cheese tater tots and none of them disappointed me! I did try the burger with the egg! Yummy . I was very satisfied with not only the food but our service was great. We couldn't leave without trying the cheesecake which was very good. Great company! Great food! Great service!

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Food, Salad, Seafood
text: Came in for lunch today, Friday around 12 Noon. Had the half dozen charbroiled oysters. They were decent. I had a few pieces of shell in mine which is the reason for three stars and me not trying anything else after. Atmosphere is nice. Parking adequate.

place_category: American (New), Burgers, Restaurants
text: I had the incredible pleasure of finally trying this highly recommended restaurant. To say the food was delicious and the service was impeccable would be an understatement. If you love gourmet food paired with yummy wine, you are absolutely in for a treat. It is reminiscent of eating in a Michelin star rated restaurant. Fantastic meal!!!

place_category: Food, Street Vendors, Thai, Restaurants
text: I am an avid fan of Thai food, and Phaya Thai left something to be desired. The food was not up to the usual quality I expect, came in small portions, and was too costly for my taste.

place_category: Sports Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars
text: Good sports bar scenery. Adequate amount of TVs. Fire grilled wings are very good with good flavors to choose from. Burgers are good sized and pretty good. Strawberry lemonade is awesome, pricey but awesome. Good drink selection.

place_category: Wine Bars, Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Mediterranean, Restaurants
text: AMAZING MENU. I've been there several times, picking different items each time. Wow. Really amazing stuff to pick at. It seems like a true tapas place even though they aren't really that at all. Definitely check it out.

place_category: Irish Pub, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Irish, Pubs, Restaurants
text: Come to Tir Na Nog and ask for Taylor. She is the best bartender there. She knows every drink and will take care of you.

place_category: Food, Donuts, Bakeries, Coffee & Tea
text: I have mixed feelings on this place but I can't get past a 3 Star. I like the location close to the Monon and the atmosphere of the place. They have a lot of fun donuts and especially for the kids but overall the donuts aren't anything more than that. The lucky charms one was decent and the ET with Reese's as well. But the Jane and John were mmmeeehh for the standard. Fruity pebbles I was excited about but the cereal was stale.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Kebab, Sandwiches, Mediterranean, Greek
text: I have nothing bad to say. The cashier was super nice and welcoming. The building was clean. Their was hand sanitizer out. The food was delicious and large portions.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Nightlife, Tapas Bars, Cocktail Bars, Bars
text: The place is absolutely gorgeous. The food was decent... Wasn't impressed but wasn't disgusted. The waitress was average... Didn't really check on us much and the orders came out wrong. She also had a problem splitting the check. I probably won't come back because everything was such an issue.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants
text: We love this local Thai BYO. The owners are warm and welcoming, and the food had never disappointed us. We like spicy, and they go all out to satsfy our tastes. The seafood is always fresh, the duck and chicken are flavorful, and the dressing on the cucumber salad is yummy. We recommend checking the specials for new and interesting offerings.

place_category: Chicken Shop, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Soul Food, American (New), Cajun/Creole
text: Food was fab, music was great and service was fast. Highly recommend. I'll come back to this spot for a quick and comfy bite.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Shopping Centers, Shopping
text: Termini Brother's. Enough said. The rest is just whatever... typical shops that you would expect to see under the Comcast Center. But tucked away in the corner of the food court is Termini Bro's... Leave the gun. Take the cannoli.

place_category: Restaurants, Korean
text: Bulgogi quite disapppointed. It is dry,and looks red, different from what I always have in NYC .

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Steakhouses, Greek, Cocktail Bars, Seafood, Southern, American (Traditional)
text: Host staff told us "Adios" as they told us to go to the bar then the bar tender told me we had to be of age to sit at the bar. Hire someone over 16. New to town definitely won't be back.

place_category: Restaurants, American (New)
text: I really enjyed my chicken dish and side of garlic mashed potatoes, here. However, I must say that if I am hankering for a truly European-stles-prepared roastes chicken (savory, light crispy skin, juicy meant), Audrey Claire comes much closer. It's a great location and the atmosphere is really nice.

place_category: Restaurants, Desserts, Japanese, Ramen, Food, Sushi Bars
text: Sushi was good...ramen no so much. I was disappointed because after watching tons of ramen videos I was excited to find a local place that served ramen. My daughter and I got two different styles and mine was bland and hers was inedible. Sorry I can't remember our orders and I didn't take pictures. Probably not going back.

place_category: German, Restaurants, Seafood, Cocktail Bars, French, Brasseries, American (New), Nightlife, Bars, Cajun/Creole, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Food very good - waitress had a bit of an attitude and rather spoiled the experience - Shawn just acted like she wasn't trying.

place_category: Food, Sandwiches, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Comfort Food, Breakfast & Brunch, Diners, Restaurants, Desserts
text: Although there's more, I've only had ice cream here. 2 or 3 times and loved it every time!! The cinnabon ice cream is amazing!! And my sister adores the tiramisu ice cream. We go here for a sweet treat whenever we happen to be in the area. The service is always friendly as well. They'll even let you sample if youre unsure about a flavor or 2.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, Gluten-Free, Bars, Diners, Vegetarian, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Pubs
text: Food.. eh, drinks... ! I would say this place is good for Happy Hour. Go somewhere else if you're looking for a satisfying meal.

place_name: Grillshack Fries and Burgers - East Nashville
place_category: American (New), Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Burgers, Breakfast & Brunch
text: This place was eh. The fries were the best part. The buffalo chicken tenders were frozen tenders with a little bit of buffalo sauce poured over them. The wings weren't anything special, they were very small and didn't have a lot of flavor.

place_category: Fast Food, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Mediterranean
text: Food was vey good and we'll priced. Meats are cooked to order, veggies/ toppings fresh. The staff was friendly and polite. The place looked vey clean. Only suggestion would be to give yourself plenty of time. It took almost 25 minutes for me to get 2 sandwiches and 2 smoothies, with only a couple people ahead of me. This is not to say the staff is terribly slow or goofing off, but the process takes a while. Three people there- one taking orders, one cooking, one assembling sandwiches.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: My wife and I ate here a few weeks ago. The food is decent, but extremely over priced for Mexican food. I ordered one of the tortas and my wife ordered a burrito. Both were good, but not for the prices. I think Burritos and Beer in Noblesville has better tasting food at a fraction of the price.

place_category: Restaurants, Thai
text: Had this on christmas day. Super awesome Thai food. Fresh ingredients. Thai decor. Worth every single penny. Try the gulf of Siam, eggplant tofu with basil and penang curry. Bring a bottle of domaine Chandon extra dry Riche to suppress the spicyness. Ask for extra chilli if you dare!

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Food, Shaved Ice
text: Good stuff, they never disappoint! Be ready to wait a little bit bc there's always a line! Well worth the wait though!

place_category: Restaurants, Italian
text: The atmosphere was charming, food was good and service was very good. I feel spoiled to live in the Bay Area, so I may be somewhat snobby. This is not 5 star in my book, but would go back. A little pricey for what is being served, in my opinion.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Based on the ratings, I had higher expectations. The environment, food, and service were just okay, nothing spectacular. I did really enjoy the blackberry cinnamon margarita.

place_category: Bars, Mexican, Sports Bars, Music Venues, American (New), Tacos, Arts & Entertainment, Chicken Wings, Food, Nightlife, Beer Bar, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (Traditional), Beer Gardens
text: Good beer selection but food is horrible and even though the service is great please please please check your tab. I get overcharged EVERY TIME. I don't mind paying what I owe but I absolutely hate being scammed. And every time I leave Brass Tap I feel cheated. By the way every single person around me after checking their tab was over charged. Seems to be their MO. You have been warned.

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, Food, Bars, Burgers, Pubs, Brewpubs, Nightlife
text: I was enticed by the menu and great options. Service came up short thought. Our waitress was short and not very friendly. To really disappoint us she didn't even offer us the chance to order desert! Just brought the check and left. Also we wanted to ask questions about their beers...which they make In house and we got a rude "ID please" Food and beer was good with decent prices otherwise.

place_category: Southern, Comfort Food, Caterers, Breakfast & Brunch, Event Planning & Services, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: I like you, Cracker Barrel. Your bacon is delicious, I could live on your hash brown casserole, and I enjoy your Old Country Store. I don't like visiting you on a Sunday when you're inundated with church goers, though. Your food is yummy and your waitresses are friendly despite the fact that they almost always mess up my order or forget something. But I forgive, because you give me warm syrup with my French toast. You know how I feel about warm syrup, and for that, I appreciate you.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Place was empty the entire time we were there, although it was off season. Restaurant was also very cold!! I had a taco salad which was good, but nothing to write home about. The girl who was working there was very nice and since we were the only ones there, the food came quickly, but I don't think I would go back again.

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: Terrain is beautiful! My meal was delicious and well executed, while others I was dining with were not quiet up to par. That being said, they were willing to correct their errors (uncooked, almost raw potatoes). The other issue was the time we waited for drinks. It took over 15 minutes for 4 drinks, one which was a beer. No apology for the wait was given. The service was fine, but understand they are still working out the kinks.

place_category: Sandwiches, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Cute small place. We got the trio plate which includes shrimp, crab and lobster rolls. All 3 were excellent, but to our surprise, all were served cold. That, and the price, not sure why it is only two dollars signs, should be at least 3, are the reasons it gets a 3 star review.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars, Mexican, Tex-Mex
text: The servers at Jose Pistolas are AMAZING! The food has always been super heavy and greasy to me instead of that fresh, clean, tex-mex feel. The drinks feel pretty sugar-y (although I don't like my cocktails sweet so that might be a "me" problem). Although the servers here are INCREDIBLE, so so kind and helpful and the Ahi Tuna Guac is a MUST order.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: This place had mediocre food and mediocre service to match. The food looked better in the pictures. Not a great place for New Orleans style food. We only stopped there b/c we where already in the French Quarter and starving. FYI the tour booth by the steam boat has free drink tickets. St. Charles Tavern a little hole wall in the Garden District was even better than this place. Malone's on Magazine St. in Garden District was even better than the Tavern. I wouldn't eat here again

place_category: Chinese, Fast Food, Restaurants
text: Nothing spectacular, but nothing major to complain about. Portions were a little small at this location, but the food tasted good. I ordered the orange chicken, "Panda Express chicken", and noodles. I was still hungry, but I eat A LOT!!!

place_category: Bars, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: I had an excellent lunch today at this restaurant. I had the kimchi chicken sandwich and superfood slaw. Best chicken sandwich I have ever had. I ate this treat with fork & knife. Very good service too!

place_category: Fondue, Restaurants
text: The restaurant was very elegant and the chocolate fondue is tantalizing , however I'm not a fan of cooking my own food. Advice... Don't go here hungry and expect to eat a heaping meal right away.. And you need a lot of patients because the portions are tiny and takes time to skew and cook all your food on one skewer at a time... Also though it was a little pricey on the wallet...

place_category: Restaurants, Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Burgers
text: Very, very, very slow service. If you have two hours to kill waiting for nachos and wings then this is the place for you.

place_category: Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Asian Fusion, Restaurants
text: This place had ok food, nothing amazing, but if you are in the mood for chinese or korean, and you don;t want to drive far, go here. It's a small business and I like to support our local businesses. I have never had the japanese food so I can't really speak for it, but they make everything pretty fast. A couple minute wait time. will I go here again? Next time I want Korean or Chinese, i will.

place_category: Chinese, Asian Fusion, Japanese, Sushi Bars, Restaurants
text: Absoloutly love there food there sushi is to die for.

place_category: Bars, Chicken Wings, Sports Bars, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: Was in from out of town and our home team was on Sunday night football. Wanted to watch game while having some beer and wings. Beer fine.. Wings average.. As we walked in we noticed that they closed at 11 and asked if we should head elsewhere to watch game. They assured us they would be open til game was over. They were open but they shut down all tv's except one and turned off the sound. Not a great way to watch a close division clenching game. Boo! **wait staff was nice and attentive **

place_category: Thai, Asian Fusion, Noodles, Restaurants
text: This place is amazing!! Fills you up, is a lot cheaper than most Thai places and definitely cheaper than any Indian place. Best Thai Iced Tea I've had around here, and I've tried almost every Thai Iced Tea around here because I love it so much. It's also the only Thai or Asian place I've been to in the States that has my favorite Thai dessert, Mango and Sticky Rice. Highly recommend getting that, it's the perfect end to the meal.

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Thai
text: The vibe in this restaurant is vibrant, they played upbeat music, and the service was great! The restaurant itself is small but the flavors were big! I got the chicken Pad Thai and ordered a jasmine milk boba to go, the boba was soft and delicious! Best I have ever had!! Truly authentic Thai restaurant!

place_category: Nightlife, Seafood, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars
text: Amazing service and food. Our server was so friendly and gave us awesome recommendations. Very courteous with making sure we had everything we needed. The Bang Bang shrimp was out of this world. We also appreciated the fun drawings on our to-go boxes done by our talented service. Will be back!

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Steakhouses, Burgers
text: My brother recommended this place as "the spot" for burgers. I was a little let down after he had been raving about it. Our waitress was not friendly and only stopped by 3 times during the hour and something that we stayed for. The burgers were mediocre (I can get a better one at a burger chain in MS-Mugshots) and the baked potatoes were fantastic. I was disappointed that they didn't have sweet tea, but neither did any other restaurants I went to while visiting.

place_category: Soul Food, Drugstores, Shopping, Health & Medical, Nutritionists, Restaurants
text: Had breakfast here before and it was somewhat dry and bland. Eggs, sausage & grits or potatoes and a coffee for under $5!! And they're also running a pharmacy here! 3-stars.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Chinese, Asian Fusion, Desserts, Szechuan
text: Just had lunch here. Had Dan Dan noodles, Vegetable Tofu Soup, and Double Cooked Pork in Dry Pot. Food was amazing especially their Dan Dan noodles. Gonna come back and try their hot or dry mushroom pot dishes and Hot Pot Delight soon.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants, Specialty Food, Food
text: The local frozen yogurtry. Like the town, it's tiny. There are few choices than others of its kind, but a half dozen or so yogurt choices and about a dozen toppings to choose from should be a enough for most people. Usually clean and tidy. The kids running the place are always attentive and friendly.

place_category: Vegan, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Restaurants
text: Ate there for lunch. The food was okay but not very imaginative. Just basic stuff that's easy to prepare. I had the chick pea wrap and my companion had a tofu scramble.. The experience felt lacking. Not sure if I'll return.

place_category: Food, Shopping, Department Stores, Fashion, Drugstores, Grocery
text: The store's layout is a mess, the parking-lot is a pain in the ass to get into and the customer service in this particular store can be a nightmare. Pricing and selection is never that great at Acme (I have noticed) I prefer the local Shop-Rite, personally

place_category: Burgers, Restaurants, Food
text: The worker did not fully and carefully wrap my burgers and when I was boarding back home, the grease and oil made the bottom of the bag rip open. My food all fell out and I asked if I could at least get free fries but they declined. Make sure they wrap your burgers right. Oh and they messed up on my order of a burger, horrible

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Sandwiches
text: Been open for a hour. Dining room is dirty, an employee came in, checked in then told the manager he was going to walk over to (? Someplace ?) and get a coffee. The manager asked if he was on the clock. When the employee said yes, the manager asked for a cafe latte with something (couldn't hear). I prefer a place with friendly, easy got employees but this place seems to be a little too loose.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Burgers, Sandwiches, Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Slow service. Not gonna lie, this place was not on par with the service I was expecting. I think I could've done a better job than them.

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican, Salad
text: I absolutely love this place. Can't beat their margaritas. The food is always good and the service is what makes it an all around great experience. Hmmm.... it's Taco Tuesday tomorrow. I think I might have to head over there for their dollar tacos!

place_category: Breweries, Pizza, American (New), Nightlife, Food, American (Traditional), Bars, Restaurants
text: This was a bad bad experience that started w a fork w old food stuck to it in my napkin roll, my husband ordered a burger WELL WELL done that was raw in the middle that he wouldn't eat but was charged for anyway, the server said the manager took half off but the manager never bothered to say a word to us. Server would walk off while i was talking to her. They were crazy busy but understaffed. It was just a bad time. BJs is awsome in texas, i was excited to show my husband but wow they blew it.

place_category: Chinese, Cafes, Taiwanese, Restaurants
text: This place has the okest food around. If your hungry and don't care how a place smells or what u eat as long as there is not a crowd this is the place. Try their water! It's not terrible.

place_category: American (New), Soup, Vegetarian, Salad, Sandwiches, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: salad had way to much dressing, vegetable soup was pretty spicy way to much pepper , lettuce was turning brown at the edges

place_category: Bars, Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Restaurants, Hotels & Travel, Bed & Breakfast, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Pubs
text: Love the Inn of the Hawke - consistently great food and service - and a lovely location with very nice outdoor seating. Our favorite place in town. Knocking off a star because the menu is a little monotonous and my real pet peeve - the signature "chips" are hit and miss. Sometimes they are perfect, other times... ugh, not so much.

place_category: Southern, Barbeque, Restaurants
text: 06/2021 Not LGBTQ friendly.. The waitress gave my partner and I a funny look when we walked in. Just two males dressed appropriately, nothing to bat an eye at one would think. Since being seated we were told to remove our masks as well. Service was short, and the quarter chicken was raw. The pulled chicken was OK but at least the sauces were really good. I just wish the service could be on par with the bbq sauces. 2/5, pls drop the homophobia.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Event Planning & Services, Venues & Event Spaces, American (New), Food, Restaurants
text: The appetizers were very strange, almost inedible. Food was decent but overpriced.

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Arts & Entertainment, Barbeque, Bars, Music Venues, American (Traditional)
text: Good atmosphere. Terrible service. The bartender checked in on us every 45 minutes. She proceeded to sing on stage and then text on her phone leaving us wanting the bill and waiting for it for 40 minutes. Now she's at the punching bag game as we sit and wait without service for going on an hour.

place_category: Soul Food, Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Southern
text: Gross as all life. Please do not believe the hype. The chicken is NOT seasoned. They didn't include the spice seasoning on our food, nor the side condiments we asked for. Sides are terrible. If you want a pound of sugar in your potato salad, go here. Spaghetti? Gross. Mac and cheese had more pepper than the chicken we received. Worst ever!! Truly had to redeem ourselves after wasting time here.

place_category: Sports Bars, Pubs, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife
text: It was a very quiet night in STL when I stopped here for a couple of adult beverages. Great service in a great location.

place_category: American (Traditional), Chicken Wings, Southern, Barbeque, Restaurants
text: I ordered the the big western sandwich & was very disappointed. The meat wasn't hot, had very little flavor, & for over $11 one would expect something great! The fries I ordered were luke warm & barley a McDonalds small for over $2.00! I'm only down in Nashville for another six weeks & go out o dinner every night & still looking for great BBQ.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, American (New), Salad, Sandwiches
text: I was super excited to try this place and was severely let down. This was my first time and I ordered a double char, but well done and with no mayo and no tomato. I got a soggy burger with more cheese on the paper than on the burger that was not well done, and had mayo and tomato. Super disappointing. This place seems like it could've been awesome, but was a huge let down.

place_category: Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Breweries, Pizza, Restaurants, German
text: Only local place where your can get a jagerschnitzle. If you are German, I apologize if I butchered the spelling of that dish. Suffice it to say that if you are German or have been there, you know what I am talking about. An amazing traditional German dish that is guaranteed to put a smile on your face. The beer selection is quite good as well.

place_category: Spanish, Cafes, Cuban, Latin American, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Food, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: I grew up in S Florida and miss Cuban food terribly. We visited Bodega during a short trip to St. Pete. The food was amazing! We had a Cuban sandwich and a lechon sandwich. Both were perfect. The mojo marinade on the lechon was so good. We also had maduros and a guava and cheese pastry. I tried the cold brew coffee. I am not a coffee drinker and I really enjoyed this and drank the whole thing. Definitely recommend you trying this place. We will be back!

place_category: Vegetarian, Malaysian, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Wanted to like this place, but was always vaguely disappointed the few times I've been there. They have lovely decor and the menu's not bad, but the food doesn't justify the prices they are charging. I lived in SE Asia for years and loved the food, but this doesn't seem to be the place to get my fix in Tucson.

place_name: Columbia Cafe on the Tampa Riverwalk
place_category: Restaurants, Cuban, Cafes, Spanish
text: A fine place for a small lunch. Nothing super exciting. The Mahi Mahi Cubano was just ok, although the plantain chips were amazing. Reasonably priced and a good view of the water if you sit outside. I came right around the lunch rush and the service was, understandably, slow, but it got to be a little ridiculous after nearly 45 minutes of trying to pay my bill. All in all just an ok experience made a bit better by a nice view and some sunshine.

place_category: Pizza, Restaurants
text: Nice little place off of emerson. Had pasta with vegetables. My only complaint was that it tasted like it had a little too much onion on it. Their bread sticks were delicious. I would recommend them to others

place_category: Bars, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Nightlife, Pizza, Pubs, Food
text: Definitely a fan. Great bar food: wings, mushrooms, cheese garlic bread. Also great Fried Chicken night on Wednesday, but go early!

place_category: Delis, Italian, Restaurants
text: as a native new yorker I can confirm for you that cibo has the best new york sandwiches in new orleans. I get sandwiches or pasta here at least once a week. all of the spaghetti dishes, the chicken parm, and the tribeca are bangin. The sauce cheese and everything are all perfectly blended. the side salads are also crispy and tasty. if you dont like the food at cibo I have no hope for you.

place_category: Uzbek, Restaurants, Middle Eastern, Russian
text: Interesting decor was the high part of my visit to the restaurant. I noticed a number of flies and gnats on the premises. A 40 min wait time for the first appetizer that I tried to order and found a bone in the veal soup that I did order. The schnitzel for my main course was amazingly dry. I'm amazed that Phila Magazine recommended this restaurant in a recent edition.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Salad, Event Planning & Services, Caterers
text: This was a very small restaurant. Service was not that great, but not horrible either. Price's were okay. My wife had the chicken parm and it was very good. I had the lasagna it was pretty bland and the noodles were rubbery. I would not go out of my way to go to this place.

place_category: Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: $10.95 for 4 mozzarella cheese sticks!! Make that make sense. Nowhere else on Gulfview Blvd are they serving a qty of 4. Either the server was hungry and helped himself to 2 or Jimmy's is really bat sh!t crazy. Not to mention the weak a$$ mixed drinks. I know I know stick with beer or wine. Just for the record Salty's, Frenchy's & The Brown Boxer NEVER disappoint.

place_category: Restaurants, French, Wine Bars, Nightlife, American (New), Bars, Cafes, Breakfast & Brunch
text: prices are a little more than they should be, but the service was friendly and the quality of the food was fair to good. all in all, you pay more for the location of the place, but the steak tartar (which i usually am weary of) was incredible! not the best beer or wine selection either (overpriced). all in all, the place has a very interesting modern yet old school feel, with fairly good food, so i would definitely still recommend it.

place_category: Food, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Sandwiches, Pizza, Italian
text: We came to Boise from Arlington, Texas for a wedding, and found Flatbread through Yelp. Turns out the reviews were dead-on. Wonderful lunch, very attentive service and great family atmosphere! Boffo!

place_category: American (Traditional), Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, American (New), Cocktail Bars, Wine Bars
text: Hendel's is an awesome place to enjoy drinks on the patio when the weather is nice or dinner inside the historic building. My favorite is the Pasta Fleurissant. Great atmosphere and food!

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, German, Gastropubs, Restaurants, American (New)
text: Loin Nachos were great and I'm not even a chips person... The entrees we got were overall good. Burger was juicy. One of the entrees was a bit cold and our service was a bit slow. The place inside is very pretty and new!

place_category: Chinese, Restaurants
text: Very underwhelming Chinese food experience based on the reviews that I read. Most of the americanized food that we ordered was bland and overcooked. I found the combination fried rice to be very disappointing with very little flavor beyond your run of the mill rice. The food was also overpriced based on what we received. I will likely try to find better Chinese food elsewhere in Carmel in the future.

place_category: Specialty Food, Farmers Market, Food, Ethnic Food, Grocery, Imported Food
text: It's a little Korean market with a decent selection of dry goods, some frozen items, and a small section of produce. Depending on the time you go, some of the produce can be a little old. It's also wise to check the expiry dates on some goods, as some are past their expiry dates. I usually come to this store mainly to buy the dry goods since it's the closest to where I live. Prices are in the moderate range.

place_category: Desserts, Breakfast & Brunch, Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea, Restaurants, Cafes, Food
text: Creamed chip beef? Where?? Had a plate of potatoes with a heavy tasteless cream sauce. My guest ordered scrambled eggs-first time we were ever served one egg. Nice concept-below average food and overpriced. One time try-won't return.

place_category: American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Music Venues, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Cocktail Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Nightlife, Food, Piano Bars
text: I was told that Pat O'Brien's is famous and that I should go there. So i did and I was not impressed! NO Draft Beers! The only Irish beer is Guinness Stout. Just a tourist trap to me, nothing bad but nothing out of the ordinary at all.....

place_category: Food, American (Traditional), Cafes, Coffee & Tea, Salad, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, Sandwiches
text: Stopped in for lunch and had the WB club and the beat and carrot juice. Was fresh and delicious. The decor was clean and modern and the service was great. Definitely be back.

place_category: Vegetarian, Restaurants, Beer, Wine & Spirits, American (New), American (Traditional), Seafood, Food, Wine Bars, Nightlife, Bars, Gluten-Free
text: I really enjoyed dining here this evening. Service was professional and good. Had the tomato soup and seared scallops. It's very tasty and well prepared. We had a table in the bar area. There was a piano player. He was fine. Good atmosphere. I was pleased with the experience and would recommend this place.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Cafes, Cajun/Creole
text: Very good! Too bad I don't live closer. I got the jambalaya and eggs and the hubs got the seafood gumbo. Everything was delish with a slight kick. The cornbread that comes with it was pretty good too, my son gobbled it up!

place_category: Asian Fusion, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (New), Bars, Pubs
text: Okay beer selection, but overpriced. The food is okay bar food. Lots of button-up and polo shirt types. Me? I'll stick to Grace or Pub & Kitchen (also button-up-y). Or Doobie's. Or...anywhere else.

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Adv: Good, strong coffee (incl. iced coffee), open early every day., friendly staff. Dis: Cash-only, small & always crowded, hipster to the point of superficial and ostensibly cheap interior (e.g. plastic, wobbly chairs).

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers, Bars, American (Traditional), Nightlife
text: This used to be my favorite restaurant. However, it's gone continually downhill for years. My wife and I gave it one more chance tonight. Never again. Poor service, marginal food, issues with the bill. Sad to see how far this place has fallen.

place_category: Diners, Restaurants
text: Best inexpensive breakfast in town, although they have recently raised them from $3.85 to $4.95. Still, choose any 4 items and I challenge you to find a better price. Today the hash browned potatoes were particularly fabulous.

place_category: Restaurants, Salad, Vegetarian
text: Sweetgreen is a KOP favorite of ours! So fresh, healthy and all the employees are so nice every time. I highly recommend it :) They have tons of options for build your own and the selected specials are excellent! My one complaint is that the last time I went for lunch they were "cash only". Def not ideal if you are expecting to use your card...and only have your card. May have been a one time thing...not sure. Besides that- awesome!

place_category: Nightlife, American (Traditional), Burgers, Sports Bars, Restaurants, Bars, Pubs
text: The "scarecrow" that you chose to display is in poor taste. Is a motor vehicle accident that seriously injured people a JOKE to you? Disgusting.

place_category: Barbeque, Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants
text: Wasn't impressed with the fancy mixed drinks. Food was sub par. Atmosphere for beer and drinks in the summer though is relaxing and fun!

place_category: Sandwiches, American (New), Vegetarian, Vegan, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: Vegetate went downhill FAST after its grand opening in 2013, But I still pop in once awhile to get my favorite Sweet Potato Cupcake and Warm Bread pudding for my sweet tooth fix. Some employees definitely are not as enthusiastic as others. And I also noticed that they changed managers, too, which impacted their management style. I do hope they step up their game and make this golden property (Chestnut Square) on Drexel worthwhile.

place_category: Local Flavor, Food, Grocery, Specialty Food, Fruits & Veggies
text: This place is perfect! Bakery, wine cellar, deli...and everything from local organic to Doritos! It's super convenient to get to, very clean, and the staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. It's the only place I will be shopping!

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Salad, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Delis, Steakhouses
text: All in all it was a decent place to eat, but really didn't leave me eager to come back. Just a cheesesteak and small fries will set you back $11+. Too expensive, especially since you can get a better cheesesteak in town at the same price or less.

place_category: Mediterranean, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Greek, Restaurants
text: The waiters are extraordinarily unfriendly/unhelpful. They seemed taxed to take a to-go order. We have a dairy allergy and the waitress could not answer questions of what was dairy free and had no interest in making sure. We went back every 20 minutes to see if the order was ready (as she said that was how long it would take) and After an hour of waiting, I asked for my money back. Terribly run. Don't go.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza, Italian
text: Friendly staff and loaded pizzas, but the crust leaves something to be desired. A decent option for a foothills American-style pizza.

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Restaurants
text: The rough neighborhood in which this gem is nestled should not deter you from risking the venture. I've been getting pizza from them since I moved to the area about 8 months ago, and have yet to be disappointed. The pizza is good (but not the best) and is very consistent. The service is awesome. I would recommend it to anyone.

place_category: Restaurants, Burgers
text: All I have to say is...Sweet Potato SmashFries. I can die now.

place_category: Food, Coffee & Tea
text: Believe it or not, this has nothing to do with the overpriced, cheap coffee. Everyone knows about that. It depends. Sometimes there's no line. Sometimes there's a huge line. Sometimes the baristas are great, and sometimes they give me a ton of attitude for requesting they put half and half in my coffee because I'm late and don't have time to do it myself. Like, sorry you have to actually put effort into your job???

place_category: Steakhouses, Sushi Bars, Japanese, Restaurants
text: HORRIBLE! The food took forever to come out..people sat down before our table and got theirs first..organization seems to be an issue..after forgot everything we asked for..sushi was bland and absolutely terrible! Do not go to this place! Overpriced bad food

place_category: American (New), Restaurants, Sandwiches, Seafood, Cajun/Creole
text: Ordered the "Taste of New Orleans" (gumbo, jambalaya, and etoufee sampler), marinated crab claws, crawfish ravioli, and the oyster duo. The crab claws were by far the tastiest and most flavorful. Everything else was quite bland to be honest, and each dish came out lukewarm which was disappointing. The atmosphere is cute though, especially the upstairs balcony area. I probably would not come back though due to my lackluster experience.

place_category: Food, Grocery, Fruits & Veggies, Meat Shops, Specialty Food, Seafood Markets, Ethnic Food
text: Good selection, HORRIBLE service. Incompetent produce workers and very bad customer communication.

place_category: Bakeries, Coffee & Tea, Food, Bagels, Sandwiches, Restaurants, Shopping, Bookstores, Music & DVDs, Toy Stores, Books, Mags, Music & Video
text: Ok I love books and I'm the kind of person that can spend half a day in a bookstore, however I went in there last weekend, and it was scorching hot in there. I took my jacket off and was still about to break a sweat! Overall this place is pretty good. No creepos in there. Lots of reading material for a city location, and they even have a cafe and free wifi! Wohooo. I might end up spending a while day in there once it's not hotter than the amazon in there!

place_category: American (New), Restaurants
text: It's nothing fancy , yes the place do look fancy out side and the food is just plain and over price like crazy but anyway it's just a typical food ... service was excellent five star but the food I would give 1 star ..

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Service is ok and friendly. Menu is a good pub menu but watch they get you on the add-ons. $2.75 to add gravy to my burger today which tasted like vegetable stock. It wasn't really thick. My burger was a decent size and at $12.95 pretty reasonable but if I wanted to add bacon to my burger it would be $3.00. Great little pub off track betting and a good selection of VLT's but stay away from the add-ons as you could double the price of a meal if you added bacon,mushrooms, and gravy.

place_category: Thai, Restaurants, Buffets
text: I had a nice meal but nothing special. Good tom ka soup and nice fresh roles. I had the chicken sweat and sour - it was average . Inside is small and tight so feels uncomfortable when full. Service was basic and ok. Toward closing they are dragging tables and chairs around while customers are still eating.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Pizza, Cheesesteaks, Italian, Beer Bar, American (Traditional), Local Flavor, Nightlife, Sandwiches
text: First time in Philly and this place did not disappoint!! Was so stoked to come here and try a legit cheesesteak for the first time evaaaa.
