Can literally watch them make your cheesesteak and smother it with lots of . Go upstairs and eat bc there's a sick view of the street below. Also side note it's cash only so be sure to bring that coin

place_category: Restaurants, Coffee & Tea, Sandwiches, Desserts, Food, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Tried this place out for breakfast once. I thought they were a little pricey for basic breakfast food. I ordered an egg sandwich with turkey bacon. It came with fruit, but you had a choice of different sides. Overall, I thought their selection was good, but the quality of the food was just ok.

place_category: Seafood, Food, Desserts, Pasta Shops, Restaurants, Specialty Food
text: I have had very many good experiences at Pinchers. Today was an exception. I ordered oysters and they were smaller than I have ever seen. No plates, napkins or silverware. May not be their thing, but it seemed more upscale there before. Sorry. Probably won't return.

place_category: Restaurants, Latin American
text: Went there today for lunch. Got a Cuban and tasted very good. The restaurant was very clean and the help was very courteous. The only thing ai would like to see would be, for them to have a sandwich combo with chips & drink. Most sandwich shops have that.

place_category: Sports Bars, Chicken Wings, Bars, Cafes, Nightlife, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: The customer service is horrible! Don't know if it's because of a young group they gave employed. We waited 15 mins before I had to get the managers attention to let her know that we haven't seen anyone since sitting at the table. The waitress didn't have good customer service skills at all.

place_category: Restaurants, Fast Food, Sandwiches
text: They lacked crucial ingredients and professionalism. I suggest choosing another subway.

place_category: Greek, Restaurants
text: Went on a Sunday and tried to use a groupon that had not expired. I was told I could not use it and that they no longer accept them. They said it was the owners orders to not take them. I decided to try the food anyway and afterwards, I could see why they wanted to use groupons to try to attract people in. The food was not good at all, the chicken gyro I had was dry and had no flavor. The baklavla must of been days old as it was stale. Overall this place had horrible service and horrible food.

place_category: Photography Stores & Services, Shopping, Grocery, Drugstores, Food
text: Just your average smiths. Nothing special about it. I did however walk in one night pretty late, around 10 or 11, and watched a rat run from the bottom of one aisle into the bottom of the other. The bottoms of the aisles have some type of plastic at the bottom that I think allows rats to climb into & hide. Pretty gross. This was on the asian food aisle too so not very far from all of the fresh veggies and meats laying out.

place_category: Middle Eastern, Food, Halal, Specialty Food, Meat Shops, Grocery, Restaurants
text: Walked in the other day after being in the neighborhood hitting up the liquor store a couple of blocks over. Was looking for some original ethnic cuisine in the area. This was a good spot where I was pleasantly surprised getting a lamb platter, with rice, and two sides (roasted spicy egg plant &lentels) for about $8. Also got some non-alcoholic beverages. Really original.

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, Food Trucks, American (New), Food
text: If you have 2 hours to spare this is a great place to eat. Sat and enjoyed the scenery as tables came and went around us.

place_category: Restaurants, Pizza
text: Food is still quality, but, they messed up last week. -forgot/mixed up part of the order -no utensils or cups

place_category: Japanese, Teppanyaki, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: Awesome sushi and great service! Love the concept and restaurant has a very fun vibe to it. Server was Ryan and he did an amazing job! Will definitely be coming back again.

place_category: Restaurants, Food, Cafes, Bakeries, Italian
text: I am so glad to see that this place is still open. Years ago we had been travelling on business and staying in the King-of-Prussia area for several days. We went to the Corner Bakery Cafe "every morning" for breakfast. I "really" looked forward to having breakfast there. That's because this Corner Bakery Cafe sold fresh fruit and I felt better after eating a little healthier. I believe the Corner Bakery Cafe kept me healthy during our trip.

place_category: American (New), Fast Food, Restaurants, Mexican
text: I absolutely love Jimboy's tacos, come here as often as we can, we get the taco party pack and ground beef quesadillas they are to die for I definitely recommend them they're a little expensive but totally worth it!

place_category: Soul Food, Restaurants
text: The customer service that we receive was perfect. I ordered fried chicken wings, candied yams, cabbage, and baked mac. I was offered desserts-- I chose to have the banana crumble (which tasted a little bland). The fried chicken was cooked a little too hard for my liking. Nevertheless, the food was still good.

place_category: Restaurants, Bars, Music Venues, Dance Clubs, Coffee & Tea, Arts & Entertainment, Lounges, Nightlife, Food, Dive Bars
text: Hands down best michelada the atmosphere a lil different but they are very respectful. Very grudge time of dive bar they play 1960 music. Not a bar to watch football their is only one projector but great bar for date night went on a Sunday and Saturday n Saturday gets really packed but enjoyable

text: Average all around... Good mole, BAD paella. Excellant home made corn tortillas. Very Good service!

place_category: French, Event Planning & Services, Seafood, Salad, Bars, Wine Bars, American (New), Caterers, Restaurants, Modern European, Barbeque, Nightlife, American (Traditional)

place_category: American (New), Caterers, Food, American (Traditional), Venues & Event Spaces, Bars, Nightlife, Event Planning & Services, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Restaurants
text: This place baffles me. There are times I dine there and it's amazing and other times it's "why do I come here". The staff is excellent and aim to please. The kitchen needs to work on consistency if they really want to be an awesome restaurant. You would probably have the best cheesesteak in the area if they got a good roll to put it on.

place_category: Desserts, Sandwiches, Food, Fast Food, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Restaurants
text: This Eegee's is always busy. They take forever to make a sandwich. The last time we went to this location the employee taking orders in the drive thru was extremely rude. Go to another location if you can.

place_name: The Red Cedar Grill and Cocktails
place_category: American (Traditional), Seafood, Restaurants, Steakhouses
text: Made a reservation, but still had to wait 20 minutes. Our food took 45 minutes to be delivered to our table. Burger came with under cooked wilted fries. Seafood pizza special had chewy over cooked scallops and shrimp and did not have bacon as described. Cedar plank salmon was good. Very long, disappointing experience.

place_category: Restaurants, Breweries, Food Trucks, American (New), Food
text: We stopped in for lunch and the food was fresh and hot with good service. We had good view of the action in broadway. The beer selection was great.

place_category: American (Traditional), Food, American (New), Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits
text: Excellent setting in a neighborhood environment. Good local draft selection and the pretzel was awesome!

place_category: Caterers, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Italian
text: Food was good. Calamari had a great sauce with a bit of a kick. Love bringing the kids here with the fun vintage atmosphere and train car that you can eat in. Love the tortellini and garlic bread... haven't been able to try anything else.

place_name: The Hog Pit Smokehouse Bar & Grill
place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Barbeque, Restaurants
text: We had a great dinner there. The family dinner had a variety of meats much more than the three of us could eat! Reminds me of an old Texas Roadhouse BBQ place.

place_category: Pizza, Italian, Sicilian, Restaurants, Food, Food Delivery Services, Sandwiches
text: Great pizza! Friendly staff too. Don't let the poor reviews fool you. Some people are impossible to please. We had the supreme and the toppings definitely seemed fresh. If you like New York style pizza I'd definitely try Sal's.

place_category: Restaurants, Asian Fusion, Sushi Bars, Thai
text: I've been here for lunch both dine in and take out. My only reason for less than 5 Stars is the slow service. Don't get me wrong, the food is worth the wait, but it takes incredible too long. Servers did not follow up and we had to keep asking where certain things orders were. What took even longer was asking for our check.

text: Not 1, 2 , or 3 times have I been denied service. Four times !!! Be truthful to what time you are open and I wouldn't have any issues. But after this last time being denied service i will never return. Food is mediocre.

place_category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Italian, Food, Pizza, Restaurants, American (New)
text: I live in Reno and like to eat at Atlantis often. I took 2 friends to lunch at Cafe Alfresco and was greatly disappointed to find that my favorite dish, the lasagna, had been removed from the menu. I have recommended this dish to several friends in the past and I was looking forward to having it again. Sometimes change is not a good thing. Please bring back my favorite!

place_category: Food, Hotels & Travel, Restaurants, Hotels, American (New), Event Planning & Services
text: Service for our large group of 13 was so slow it was painful. Food was good when it finally arrived. One waiter with no help. Not an equation for success.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Seafood, Restaurants
text: Great food and fantastic service! I especially recommend the shrimps and chicken salad. Loved Karrie!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: An all together all right experience. We got both hard and soft tacos with shredded beef, the sauces provided were interesting. A little spicy but mostly sour. The beef did not come apart easy and you basically pull the entire taco apart in one bite. Decent salsa a little chunky but not excessively so. The Mexican soda was also good. Had I gone again I would have gotten chicken instead of beef.

place_category: Mediterranean, Cafes, Mexican, Gastropubs, Juice Bars & Smoothies, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food, Gay Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Bars
text: Different, eclectic spot. Friendly staff, great people watching, typically has live music. Has food, choices of which, appears very interesting but will have to try another time.

place_category: Patisserie/Cake Shop, Food, Restaurants, Bakeries, Cafes, French
text: What can I say about duchess that hasn't already been said? Amazing decor and the macarons are to die for! Actually every dessert is amazing. It's really something to be said when you can capture the feeling of going to tea or being in a French cafe in the middle of ice cold Edmonton. Everyone should go to duchess once in their lives!!

place_category: Seafood, Specialty Food, Food, Seafood Markets, Fish & Chips, Restaurants
text: Arrived today and requested a customization to my order, "Could they heavily salt the fish before deep frying?" I was told, "No". Me, "WHY?" "We don't salt the Fish, and we won't do it!" I was actually very shocked by this reply! UNACCEPTABLE! Of course, I walked, and typed this! GOOD BYE SMEES!

place_category: Mexican, Latin American, Restaurants
text: Came here for lunch and was seated quickly. They had about 4-5 choices on lunch menu and they were just under $8 which I thought was good for lunch. I opted for the taco/enchilada combo. It was solid average Mexican food. I wasn't overly impressed but nothing was wrong. It was a typical meal. The portion was a good size. The chips and salsa were decent and service was solid. I'd try it again for dinner and hope the meal stands out.

place_name: The Continental Restaurant and Martini Bar
place_category: Restaurants, American (New), Lounges, Nightlife, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Great spot been there about four times and the ambience of the restaurant is great servers are always excellent food is very good drinks are awesome and it's a great location to be right in the middle of everywhere before you go out whether it's dancing , or just enjoying a night out with the girls !! I always enjoy stopping by the the continental . Weather it's just for appetizers and drinks or dinner usually I've never had a bad experience , always has a great crowd

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: This place is great! Friendly staff and amazing food. I went here for Brunch on New Years day and was so happy with my food that I returned with more friends the next morning . Just yummy! Lots of handcrafted and in-house-made items, so many options, one tastier than the next, not to mention the enormous portions.. I mean, their pancakes alone are the size of a large dinner plate . Love it here and will be back soon.

place_category: Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Sandwiches, Diners, Restaurants

place_category: Restaurants, Cajun/Creole, Seafood
text: Food was decent. Not the best, but it was alright. I'd say way overpriced, but that's typical due to the location. Good view while you eat.

place_category: Seafood, French, Restaurants, Cajun/Creole
text: Went there for Thanksgiving, and we were slightly disappointed: we had reserved well in advance, and by 4:45 pm they were already out of some menu items--and it was a very limited menu. It took us 3 requests to have the wine we had ordered brought to our table, and everyone seemed to be blaming someone else. We just wanted to be able to drink our wine with our dinner. The food was good, but it wasn't special. Given the high quality of restaurants in New Orleans, I couldn't recommend this place.

place_category: Cafes, Mexican, Restaurants
text: Average, uninspiring food. It's a hole in the wall. Cheap diner decor. You have to pay $2 for chips and salsa. I will not return. Life is too short for mediocre Mexican food.

place_category: Breweries, American (Traditional), Restaurants, Bars, American (New), Nightlife, Beer, Wine & Spirits, Food

I'm not sure I would pay for it on food alone, but it's a happy, lively, place to entertain.

place_category: Mexican, Tacos, Restaurants

place_category: Japanese, Restaurants, Sushi Bars
text: It's my birthday and I was craving for a sushi dinner. We've never been to this place. It's a quaint little nice restaurant. Clean interior, friendly and efficient staff. We ordered different rolls and fried pork dumpling which comes with complimentary small salad and miso soup. Everything tasted so good! It hits the spot and satisfied my cravings. We will definitely go back!

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, American (Traditional), Seafood
text: Service slow took 2 hours to be seated and we got there at 5pm also took anouther 1 1/2 hours to get food had to go to the bar to get drinks food was mediocre at best and over priced . Better choice If you like lakeside dinning is Gallitin marine resturant just the other side of lake great food and service or Cherokee steak on the lake.

place_category: American (Traditional), Restaurants, Burgers
text: Boo. Took forever to get seated in the seat that was open when we walked in. Waiter forgot to give us drinks until we were half way through our salad. The salad bar had dirty plates. Sub par. Not impressed.

Good food, great selection of beer, round bar with multiple bartenders. From what i know, authentic style irish pub decorations and very friendly attentive staff. No negatives in my book and really helped save my saturday St. patty's day pub crawl from being just average.

place_category: American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: They are known for their amazing PIES!! But breakfast not too bad either. I have to say their pancakes are made with buttermilk and rival IHOPS. Not bad for breakfast at all!

place_category: Restaurants, Nightlife, Bars, Sports Bars, American (Traditional)
text: I don't want to sound picky, but.... I had the Reuben. The taste of the individual parts were good, but the sandwich was piled together so that I never got a taste of all the ingredients in any one bite. I tried eating it with a knife and fork....... same deal. The steak fries were either overcooked or reheated, I'm going with reheated because they were a little greasy. The saving grace was that the beer was very cold! If you're going, don't have the Reuben. Have a beer and an app of some sort.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Hot Dogs, Burgers, Seafood, American (Traditional)
text: Solely based on my casual sunset drinking experience this place is A-OK. Service was a little slow but friendly nevertheless. The view is amazing and I really like the $5 Parking spots that gets you a $5 bar tab... couldn't ask for a better arrangement. I'll update again when I actually try some of the food, but it wasn't bad for a quick sunset stop for a couple of beers.

place_category: Distilleries, Bars, Food, Cocktail Bars, Beer Bar, Wine Bars, Nightlife
text: Over priced and not great!! We ordered 4 specialty drinks and they were so strong you couldn't taste the flavors they had listed. They came in a tiny cup not even half full. 2-3 ounces of liquid for $15 each! This is in the very busy Bottleworks garage. The other ten restaurants don't serve food at this price point. They are set up like a good court. So getting a full meal for $15 you don't want to get a $15 drink!

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants
text: Damm this is good...even great....still thinking about this a week later! The BEST mole I've had outside if Mexico...dark complex and downright delicous. The freshest green salsa and excellent chilaquiles. Can't wait yo come back for the famous tamales and lamb barbecue

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Hot Dogs, Sandwiches
text: This place is small and it is expensive. Almost $4 for 2 dipped cones?!?!? Total ripoff.

place_category: Cafes, Restaurants, American (Traditional), Breakfast & Brunch
text: First and last time I am coming here. I feel that the restaurant has a responsibility to its patrons to warn about restricted parking areas that are not properly labeled. Thanks for not warning and not providing directions to where your parking lot is located. $130 dollar towing bill on top of okay tasting food. No thanks. Oh and I was told within the hour I was in the restaurant 6 cars were towed.

place_category: Chicken Wings, Restaurants, Vietnamese, Soup, Chinese

place_category: Restaurants, Sushi Bars, Seafood, Japanese
text: Always one of our favorites. Long time go to place. Everything is always fresh and the ponzu sauce they use is the best I've ever had. Food and service are consistently good, I enjoy trying the specials that change frequently.

place_category: Cocktail Bars, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Bars, Nightlife
text: The food is good and our waiter tried his best to overcome managements decision to make the "happy hour " confusion as palatable as possible. place_category: Italian, Restaurants
text: We met friends here for dinner. It is located in the corner of a strip center. It is BYOB which is always a good thing. Much cheaper than buying. We had some appetizers, cannelloni and chicken parm. Food was good. Service was quick and friendly.

place_category: Bars, Restaurants, Nightlife, American (Traditional)
text: What a great spot! Loved everything about it here. Food was awesome, great beer selection... Great location downtown!

place_category: Restaurants, Chinese, Thai
text: We have been customers of Bamboo House for over 10 years. This is our go-to Chinese restaurant. The crab Rangoon is the best that I have ever had. Both the chicken and beef with broccoli is our favorite. The sesame chicken and moo sho shrimp are also family favorites. I highly recommend Bamboo House and wish the had a location on the north side of Indianapolis so I could have it more often!

place_category: Nightlife, Salad, Bars, Restaurants, Caterers, Chicken Wings, Sandwiches, Event Planning & Services, Pizza, Italian

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Japanese
text: Chef Tyler and Tuyen treated us to a great family dinner! Chef Tyler was great with our kids and had us all laughing.

place_category: Restaurants, Diners, American (Traditional)
text: This place was truly awful.....diners are diners.... food is usually good enough in most diners... but this place....not so much!! Do yourself a favor... keep on driving .....

place_category: Greek, Persian/Iranian, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, Indian
text: Nice friendly environment! The owner explained various menu choices patiently. The chef was moving around and talking to every one. Falafel, hummus were nice and tasty, but a bit less spicy for my taste. Naan was very good, but it became a bit hard when left for 10-15 mins. "The Awesome Dudette" with pistachio nuts in the ice cream was tasty. One negative thing was that it took a long time for them to bring each ordered dish. I wouldn't mind coming to this place again after a couple of months.

place_category: Fast Food, Burgers, Food, Restaurants, Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt
text: I do not recommend. Ordered a chili dog and a corn dog asked for mustard. Waited for ever. When it was brought to us I asked again for mustard, the guy said it's in the bag. Got back with out food and I think corn dog was made YESTERDAY and as for the mustard that I confirmed twice was actually honey mustard..... with a chili dog and corn dog.

place_category: Desserts, Italian, Pizza, Food, Restaurants

We had to ask for a check. The manager NEVER came over. Lost us as a customer.

place_category: Nightlife, Restaurants, Eatertainment, Bars, American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment, Sports Bars, Arcades
text: Ugh. About a year ago I came here with my arcade-loving girlfriend. We had a great time playing games and drinking a few beers. Last weekend we revisited with a bunch of friends. Worst idea ever. The front bar was barely busy but the two 'tenders had a tough time keeping up with the crowded pool table area and the bar patrons. I won't gross you out with details of the bar stench, but just know that there was one and it was fierce. We shoulda played games.

place_category: Nightlife, American (New), American (Traditional), Beer Bar, Bars, Restaurants, Cocktail Bars

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Delis, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants
text: In terms of ripoff airport food, this is by far the worst I've ever experienced. The "sourdough" was basically grocery store wonderbread, and the turkey was more than likely that fake, salt-pumped turkey restaurants get a GFS. Save your money and buy one of those "on-the-go sandwiches." It'll be the same quality and more than likely cheaper.

place_category: Food, Bakeries, Desserts, Coffee & Tea

place_category: Sandwiches, Greek, Restaurants, Mediterranean
text: Solid food. I had their gyro, it was ok. The meat was not seasoned well and the flavors just wasn't there. The inside of the restaurant is posh, they decorated really well. I love the chalk board menu. I just wish the food wowed me, I was yearning for so much more. This location is in a really nice area too. They need to step up their food game.

place_category: Barbeque, Restaurants, American (Traditional)
text: Food is good, but we stopped going because they always had the back "quiet" area closed off. The front area is noisy and does not have a trace of privacy. May check sgain in a few months.

place_category: Italian, Restaurants, Mediterranean, Greek
text: First of all the food is fantastic, service was wonderful. It's authentic and so flavorful. If that wasn't enough, my car broke down in their parking lot, and John, the owner, couldn't have been nicer. Offered is his jumper cables, but it ended up being an electrical problem, and needed a tow truck. John, kept us in the restaurant, even after closing. Even gave me a wonderful portion of my favorite dip to take home! This place is wonderful, a family feeling...

place_category: Food, Diners, Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch, Coffee & Tea
text: Great breakfast tacos!! The bacon fried rice was insane!!!! Quick service at the bar for my buddy and I! Bartenders we're sweet and quick! Coffee never ran out!! Great place for a morning hang! TIP YOUR SERVERS!!! THEY DESERVE IT!!!!

place_category: Restaurants, Cheesesteaks, Sandwiches, Salad
text: Me on my mobility scooter - they couldn't have been nicer.. However, the hoagie was good, but had shredded pizza cheese on it instead of provolone.. ~ $9.50 ~ All in all, the sandwich was good, Primo's is better... I will give it another try... .. I love the Reading Terminal...

place_category: Restaurants, Vietnamese
text: Best Vietnamese hoagies in the area. My family and I have been going here for years. It's $4 per hoagie, it's delicious! Get the classic.

place_category: Bars, Pizza, Wine Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants, Sports Bars
text: Best pizza in Dunedin! The most important part of a pizza experience is the crust. The crust here is phenomenal.

place_category: Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Southern, Nightlife, Diners, Bars, Breakfast & Brunch
text: We came with a group of 17 people. The environment and service was good. A parade came by while we were having drinks and we were able to go out in the balcony and enjoy it. The food however came out cold and was overall disappointing. The people who got steak were pleased with their food. So fun spot... Food is underwhelming.

place_category: Fast Food, Chinese, Restaurants
text: Only because it's my son-in-laws favorite place do we stop and it's the closest to their house. This place totally sucks EVERY TIME we go in the evenings there's always a wait of at least 15 minutes or more. Then they mess up on your order. How can you mess up when you only order 2 plates to go!!!!! This place only gets business because it's the only place in Sahuarita!!! Get it together people!!!

place_category: Sandwiches, Cheesesteaks, Steakhouses, Restaurants
text: Geno's and Pat's -- Perhaps the worst quality steak you can find in Philly. BUT If you love: -Stomach Pain -Diarrhea -Standing inline with drunk idiots from out of town who don't know any better You will love this place.

place_category: Restaurants, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Had the Chicken St. Charles(a must try there) and some pancakes. Great food, as expected from eating at the one uptown before, if not better here. Also there Vanilla Iced coffee is so good. Really like the environment of the restaurant in Old Metairie. It was a calm but busy morning but the staff was handling it well. Liz was my fiancée and I's server. She made sure we had everything and consistently checked on us. Will definitely be back and asking for her!

place_category: Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, American (New), Cajun/Creole, Bars, Caterers, Breakfast & Brunch, Seafood, Nightlife
text: I very much enjoyed my brunch here. I've had the bloody mary before at one of their New Orleans locations. I remember it being a lot better than the one I got here. The price was great though. It was $8 and they refill it for you. The waitress was very nice. The prices are not bad. The dining area was clean. The food was great and a big portion. I think I was missing the New Orleans feel of it though.

place_category: Bars, Event Planning & Services, Nightlife, Salad, American (Traditional), Tapas/Small Plates, Venues & Event Spaces, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New)

place_category: Sandwiches, Nightlife, American (Traditional), Burgers, Restaurants, Bars, Asian Fusion
text: They really need to step up the service in this place. Took forever to get seated, forever to order. Ordered a coffee and it was cold and SO old. Again, took forever to track someone down and send it back. Ordered a grill chicken sandwich and the quality of the chicken was high, but the Caesar salad was just drenched in dressing and was awful. Not overly impressed.

place_category: Mexican, Restaurants, Tex-Mex, Fast Food
text: The drive thru microphone sounds like two tin cans on a string, I can imagine for the employees that would grow very frustrating very quickly. I know as a 'sometimes by accident' customer I grew tired of shouting my order for clarification. Even if you are on foot, it's worth to walk to the location at Indiana and University Blvd. This location closes earlier too. Drug dealing in the parking lot leaves the only satisfied patrons.

place_category: Sandwiches, Burgers, Restaurants
text: I really expecting something special by the review, and hey...stuffed burgers. The burger could have been grilled a little more, it seemed to be steamed instead of griddled. It was good, though not as much as I expected.

place_category: Local Flavor, American (New), Breakfast & Brunch, Performing Arts, Event Planning & Services, Restaurants, Dance Clubs, Arts & Entertainment, Nightlife, Bars, Karaoke, Music Venues, Hotels, Hotels & Travel
text: Arguably a busy night with Zombie Walk. But we waited 15 and not the 5 advertised minutes. Then it took a good 25 minutes to get our drink orders. Oh and next time ill take my water with out the wilted piece of lettuce in it. I've been here other times where I was wowed and it was a great experience, so I look forward to a better follow up in the future!!

place_category: Food, Donuts, Burgers, American (Traditional), Coffee & Tea, Restaurants
text: DO NOT go in here hungry. If you do....you will end up with three huge cake donuts, two cups of coffee, and many cavities. I came in here on Saturday, after I had already eaten lunch and still managed to scoop up a Vietnamese Iced Coffee donut, a Satsuma Blueberry donut and a Chocolate Glazed Donut, as well as two coffees. Awesome staff, delicious donuts, really cool vibe. Really happy I live down the street from this place!

place_category: Sandwiches, Restaurants, Cheesesteaks
text: classic steak shop with extra thick milk shakes. They have fountain sodas and egg creams what ever that is. The steaks are cooked in front of the window which is different for most steak shops that usually hide their grill in the back. The most redeeming aspect: VERY CUTE YOUNG LADIES COOKING AND SERVING. sad part: the bathrooms up a flight a stairs

place_category: Caribbean, Restaurants
text: Went for the first time and was pleased with my food and finding some great soursop juice! Will be back for sure

place_category: Japanese, Cocktail Bars, Bars, Nightlife, Diners, Ramen, Restaurants
text: Cool late night snack place with good service, but if you're expecting an authentic ramen, skip this place. Flavors not fully developed like they should be.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, Restaurants, Music Venues, American (New), American (Traditional), Arts & Entertainment
text: This was our first stop in Nashville and the Margarita's were good as well as the appetizers. We sat at the bar and the bar tender was friendly and very helpful recommending other sites to see and restaurants to stop in while we were in town.

place_category: Southern, Diners, Restaurants, Sandwiches, Breakfast & Brunch
text: We love Picnic Cafe! It's a great lunch spot - leaving you plenty full but not stuffed! I normally order the scoop of pimento and chicken salad with a muffin. Every muffin is so amazing! The chicken salad is very good, but I feel the pimento cheese is the star - some of the best I've had anywhere! While I normally stick with my usual, my sister ordered the quiche last time which looked incredible! Definitely a great stop for lunch in Nashville!

place_category: Restaurants, Wine Bars, Italian, Food, Sandwiches, Nightlife, Breweries, Bars, Pizza
text: Foods good! Blue haired girl at register not so good. Be aware when taking payment by card. The register has a 20% tip set as a default tip. Very presumptuous for take out !!! and very rude attitude when I declined to pay it. I purchased a Diet Coke as I waited and was told twice to put my mask on as I was sitting drinking the soda they sold me. I guess I should have given them the twenty dollar tip they suggest or I could just not go back. Hmmmm

place_category: Sushi Bars, Cajun/Creole, Restaurants, Nightlife, Japanese, Bars
text: LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this place. Their menu is non traditional sushi and it's awesome how they add that NOLA flair to their rolls and dishes. It's a fun and upbeat time everytime. My only grievance is how LOUD they play the music. It's honestly a bit out of control. Though I enjoy the fun of having pop music playing while at dinner...the volume makes it very difficult to hold a conversation without yelling across the table. If they could turn it down a few notches...they'd be 5 stars for sure!

place_category: Restaurants, Mexican
text: Not impressed with the ahi poke. Didn't taste like quality fish and way too much mustard. Chicken tacos were just ok. And $6 for a fish taco?? Seriously?

place_category: Coffee & Tea, Food
text: Place is cool place to people watch on Passyunk, but redhead as cashier / barreista is one slow and either confused or just doesn't care what she serves. Was in today and witnessed 3 customers get at best a 70% full cup of whatever they were buying. Terrible attitude from this women. Guy with the beard and holes in the earlobes is cool and serviced minded.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants, Steakhouses, Bars, Nightlife
text: Great fresh seafood! I have had so many great meals here that have included raw oysters, (west coast oysters which are so good!), raw clams, lobster bisque, surf n turf, red snapper. You name it and you are always having a fresh, flavorful meal here! The servers are really nice too. If you need a place for a good date night and to be wined and dined with an upscale setting this is the place! definitely check it out

place_category: Restaurants, Seafood
text: Their charbroiled oysters were very, very delicious. Just don't get the raw ones. Weren't that good. The florentine shrimp pasta was tasty too. Service wasn't exceptional but acceptable. Don't think we'll be back when we visit NOLA again.

place_category: Fast Food, Restaurants, Burgers
text: A little on the dirty side, food was good but messed up my stomach mins later. Probably never go there again.

place_category: Caterers, Specialty Food, Mediterranean, Moroccan, Restaurants, Event Planning & Services, Greek, Food
text: The restaurant is above average , its more like a Mediterranean fast food. I expected more from gyro than flavored rice , plain cooked meat and sour cream.

place_category: Seafood, Restaurants
text: This is another Burlington NJ staple. The restaurant is small and cramped. If you like seafood then this is the place to go. Seafood is always fresh. Prices aren't cheap but you get good food. It is located in a small strip center. When you go in you are going to think why did I come here. The restaurant looks small and dirty but the food is good. They also have a big takeout counter.

place_category: Sushi Bars, Restaurants, Japanese, Food
text: I wonder if I was here on an off night. I've heard good things, but when I visited, everything was lacking. Slow service, slow kitchen, forgettable food. Squid was pretty rubbery and plainly seasoned with teriyaki and black pepper. The Dynamite roll was pretty delicious, but it should be at a price like $12. I wouldn't visit again.

place_category: Mexican, Pop-Up Restaurants, Desserts, New Mexican Cuisine, Restaurants, Seafood, Food
text: Everything was delicious, service was good. There were a lot of small touches (fresh flowers on the table, a flower on the dessert, homemade chips!) that added even more to the great food. Would definitely recommend.

place_category: Nightlife, Bars, American (New), Restaurants, American (Traditional), Sports Bars
text: I started to come here years ago, and every time I am in town I stop by, unfortunately the waitress I make the journey to see is no longer there. This lady was beautiful, funny and just a great waitress. (Beth) where'd you go? This place is just not the same without you, she really made this place a joy to come to. I not saying the other waitress are bad but when you have had the best it's hard to settle for an average one.

place_category: Bars, Breakfast & Brunch, Restaurants, American (New), Coffee & Tea, Food, Nightlife, Vegetarian
text: My sandwich and salad were good. Nice atmosphere. Our server appeared distracted by waiting on only one table of guest who it appeared that she knew. The only words she said besides asking us for our order was "have a good one" when she gave us our change for our bill. I'll go somewhere else next time. It was obvious my business didn't matter.

place_category: Restaurants, Spanish, Basque, American (New), Mexican, Breakfast & Brunch
text: Poor customer service from the older waitress there. She's dismissive and extremely rude. Owner is non responsive to issues concerning service and doesn't return calls. I have up after a week. If you gave an issue with your food or order, just forget it. They could care less. Other staff members appear to agree.

text: I love coffee. Hold all the flavors, sugary additives, whip creams and foo foo stuff. Just coffee. I love all roasts, all boldness, and most any type of beans. Starbucks coffee is ok. Their dark roast is a bit too burnt flavored (just not well done... or too well done i guess). Their medium roasts are decent. If you are a real coffee lover, I'm not sure starbucks is for you. If you like desert drinks, this is your place.

text: Have wanted to try this place for a year. If you're a newly to Creole or Cajun cuisine then this is probably a 4 star, but I was reared on it so the 3 star review. Had the Gumbo YaYa and crabcake. Gumbo was okay. It has the dark roux that I like, but not as flavorful as it could be. Mine didn't have the kick other reviewers experienced. The crabcake wasn't bad, lots of lump crab but also more filler than I would prefer. All in all worth the try but go for lunch.
